action.name: Quickdraw Pocket
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can assign up to four stored items to quickdraw slots. Swapping to a quickdraw weapon or using a quickdraw consumable takes no time and does not interrupt movement or channelled abilities.
The first attack made with a weapon drawn this way gains a brief burst of attack speed.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
action.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

adept.name: Drilled Loadouts
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can save up to three complete loadouts of weapons, armour and consumable slots. Switching to a saved loadout is a single action.
Switching weapons mid-combo carries the combo across: the first attack with the new weapon continues the chain rather than starting it again.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
adept.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

alchemy.name: Crucible Satchel
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

Reagents left in your inventory slowly combine according to recipes you know. A potion you have brewed before can be brewed from inside storage, consuming the reagents over a short time without a station.
Potions brewed this way come out at full potency regardless of where you are.
This is a dimensional storage and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a dimensional storage and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Hand
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a prepared trap without disarming it. Drawing a stored trap places it, already armed, at a tile you can see within a short distance.
A trap placed this way is invisible to enemies until it triggers, and its first trigger inflicts a brief stun on top of its normal effect.
This is a dimensional storage and trap effect.
ambush.tag: This is a dimensional storage and trap effect.

animate.name: Wakeful Hoard
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can spend mana to throw a stored weapon or piece of armour out of storage as an animated guardian. It fights at your side using the item's own stats for a short time, then returns to storage on its own.
Only one item can be animated at a time. An animated item destroyed in combat returns damaged.
This is a dimensional storage and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a dimensional storage and animation effect.

anzu.name: Thunderhead Satchel
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you are struck by lightning damage, part of it is drawn into your inventory and stored as a charge, up to a limit that scales with rank.
You can release the stored charge as a lightning bolt that strikes the nearest enemy and arcs to others close by. Charges fade slowly while unused.
This is a dimensional storage and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a dimensional storage and storm effect.

ape.name: Hurled Stores
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can pull any stored item straight out of storage and throw it as a projectile. Heavier items travel shorter distances and deal more impact damage; armour and ingots knock lower-rank enemies down.
A thrown item can be recalled into storage from anywhere within a short range. Throwing costs stamina scaled to the item's weight.
This is a dimensional storage and impact effect.
ape.tag: This is a dimensional storage and impact effect.

armour.name: Spare Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Unequipped armour in your inventory contributes a portion of its defence to a layered ward around you. The ward absorbs damage before your equipped armour does.
When the ward breaks, the stored piece that contributed most to it loses durability, and the ward recovers slowly while you are out of combat.
This is a dimensional storage and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a dimensional storage and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Ready Rack
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can equip stored weapons and armour onto your summons and familiars directly from storage. A summon gains the stats of anything you equip on it, and you can recall the gear to storage at any time.
When an equipped item breaks on a summon, a stored item of the same kind is swapped onto it automatically.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

aspect.name: Kept Faces
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

When you loot a humanoid enemy, you can store its appearance as well as its belongings. You can wear a stored appearance as a disguise, and townsfolk, guards and lower-rank monsters treat you as that person until you attack or are identified.
You can keep up to three stored appearances. Wearing one costs mana over time.
This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.
aspect.tag: This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.

avatar.name: Regalia Vault
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a full set of equipment as a regalia. Recalling a regalia changes your entire loadout at once, out of combat or in it.
While you wear a complete regalia, your aura is more imposing. Enemies of lower rank suffer reduced damage against you, and townsfolk recognise you on sight.
This is a dimensional storage and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a dimensional storage and transformation effect.

axe.name: Overhead Release
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can release a stored item into the air above any point you can see, so that it falls on whatever stands below. A falling item deals impact damage scaled to its weight, and a stored weapon with an edge strikes as a cleave against everything it lands among.
Released items return to storage when they land. This costs mana and can only be done once every few seconds.
This is a dimensional storage and impact effect.
axe.tag: This is a dimensional storage and impact effect.

balance.name: Even Ledger
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Durability damage to your equipped gear is shared out across every stored item of the same type, so no one piece breaks first.
Your inventory has no carrying weight. Once per fight, you can spend mana to set your current health and mana to the same percentage of their maximums.
This is a dimensional storage and equilibrium effect.
balance.tag: This is a dimensional storage and equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Roost
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A colony of shadow bats roosts in your storage space. You can release it to fly ahead of you and sweep an area, revealing it on the map along with any hidden or invisible creature inside it.
In darkness, the colony can be loosed on enemies instead, blinding them briefly. Released bats return to the roost on their own. The colony recovers over a short time after use.
This is a summoning and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a summoning and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Supply Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Allies and companions in your party can draw consumables from your inventory during combat, provided they are within a short distance of you.
While an ally is drawing from your stores, they recover stamina over time, and the first potion they use in each fight is not consumed.
This is a dimensional storage and command effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a dimensional storage and command effect.

bear.name: Winter Larder
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Food in your inventory never spoils. While you are out of combat, your health recovers over time at a rate set by the variety of food you are carrying.

Once per day, you can gorge on your stored food. This consumes a large share of it and grants a long-lasting boon of increased maximum health and resistance to being knocked down. Recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and sustenance effect.
bear.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sustenance effect.

bee.name: Hive Stores
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

Flowers, blossoms and plant reagents left in storage are slowly worked into honey by a hive that lives inside it. Honey is a consumable that restores health over time and cleanses one poison affliction.
You can release the hive's workers as a swarm against a target, inflicting a stacking sting affliction. The hive produces no honey while its swarm is out.
This is a dimensional storage and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a dimensional storage and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Bottomless Hold
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory accepts objects too large to carry: fallen trees, boulders, carts and the corpses of large monsters.
You can drop a stored heavy object from above onto a tile you can see. It inflicts crushing damage to everything beneath it, and knocks back enemies of lower rank around the impact.
This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.

bird.name: Courier Wing
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can send a stored item to an ally anywhere in the same region. It flies to them as a bird of light and arrives in their hands, ready to use.
Allies can send items back to you the same way. Sending costs mana scaled to the item's rarity, and a courier can be struck down in flight, dropping its item where it falls.
This is a dimensional storage and messenger effect.
bird.tag: This is a dimensional storage and messenger effect.

blight.name: Rot Cellar
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Organic loot and monster parts can be left to rot in a sealed corner of your storage. Over time they become blight reagents for alchemy and crafting.
You can hurl a handful of rot from storage to leave a patch of creeping blight on the ground. Enemies standing in the patch gain a stacking decay affliction that reduces their healing received.
This is a dimensional storage and blight effect.
blight.tag: This is a dimensional storage and blight effect.

blood.name: Blood Bank
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Out of combat, you can draw health from yourself into storage as blood phials. A phial drunk in combat restores that health instantly and cannot be prevented by healing reduction.
You can always spend health to pull an item from storage, even while silenced, disarmed or bound.
The number of phials you can hold scales with rank.
This is a dimensional storage and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a dimensional storage and blood effect.

bone.name: Ossuary
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
The bones of every creature you loot are kept in a separate ossuary within your storage.
You can spend bones to raise a barricade of fused bone at a point you can see. It blocks movement and projectiles until destroyed, and its durability depends on the rank of the bones used.
Bones from higher-rank monsters can also be traded to crafters as rare material.
This is a dimensional storage and conjuration effect.
bone.tag: This is a dimensional storage and conjuration effect.

boundary.name: Threshold Cache
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can set a cache point at any tile you have stood on. Items placed in the cache remain there in the world, but only you can see or take them.
While standing at the cache point, you can pass items between it and your inventory freely. Only one cache point can exist at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and space effect.
boundary.tag: This is a dimensional storage and space effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Purse
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Stacks of common materials in your inventory slowly grow while you travel, up to a limit that scales with rank.
When you hand an item from storage to an ally or a townsperson, they receive a second copy of any consumable among it. This can happen only once per day for each recipient.
This is a dimensional storage and abundance effect.
bounty.tag: This is a dimensional storage and abundance effect.

bow.name: Quiver Without End
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Ranged weapons draw ammunition directly from storage and never need reloading from a separate quiver.
Any small stored item can be nocked and loosed as a projectile. It carries one of its own properties: a potion shatters on impact with its effect, and an ore shard pierces armour.
Loosed items are lost.
This is a dimensional storage and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a dimensional storage and ranged effect.

brush.name: Seed Satchel
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Seeds and cuttings you collect are kept alive in storage. You can throw a seed at any open ground to grow a dense thicket in moments.
A thicket blocks line of sight, slows enemies moving through it and gives you and your allies cover. It withers after a short time.
Each thicket uses up its seed. Seeds can be gathered from flora across the regions.
This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.
brush.tag: This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.

cage.name: Pocket Menagerie
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A lower-rank creature below a portion of its health can be caged into your storage instead of killed. A caged creature does not age, heal or escape.
You can release a caged creature at any point you can see. It attacks the nearest enemy for a short time and then turns on whoever is closest.
You can hold up to three caged creatures at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and binding effect.
cage.tag: This is a dimensional storage and binding effect.

cat.name: Soft Paws
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Drawing, stowing and using items makes no sound and does not break stealth.

At melee range, you can reach into an unaware creature's belongings and take one item straight into your storage. Doing this to a townsperson risks being caught if they turn to face you before the reach completes.
This is a dimensional storage and stealth effect.
cat.tag: This is a dimensional storage and stealth effect.

cataclysm.name: Fault Store
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can sacrifice a stored item to release it all at once as a shockwave around you. The shockwave's damage and size scale with the item's rarity and rank.
Terrain struck by the shockwave cracks open, slowing anything that crosses it for a short time. The item is destroyed.
This is a dimensional storage and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a dimensional storage and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Beast of Burden
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Party members and companions can deposit items into your storage and withdraw items you have marked as shared.
While you are carrying a large number of items, you resist knockback and being pushed, and your stamina recovers steadily as long as you keep walking.
This is a dimensional storage and endurance effect.
cattle.tag: This is a dimensional storage and endurance effect.

chain.name: Hold Fast
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can pull a length of chain out of storage and throw it at an enemy, tethering it to you. A tethered enemy cannot move further from you than the chain allows. Pulling on the chain drags lower-rank enemies toward you.
The tether lasts until it is broken or you release it. Throwing it costs stamina.
This is a dimensional storage and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a dimensional storage and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Gambler's Sack
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Once per day, you can reach into your inventory blind. You draw out a random stored consumable whose effect is doubled, or a random weapon whose next special attack deals critical damage.
Unidentified items stored overnight have a chance to reroll one of their properties.
This is a dimensional storage and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a dimensional storage and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: False Bottom
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items you sell from your inventory appear to the buyer as one rarity higher than they are, until the trade is complete.
Stolen and contraband items you store cannot be detected by guards, searches or identification effects.
This is a dimensional storage and deception effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a dimensional storage and deception effect.

chicken.name: Brood Pocket
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Monster eggs found in the world can be stored and incubated. After enough time in storage, an egg hatches into a young familiar of its species that follows and fights alongside you.
If you are knocked below a portion of your health, any hatched familiars throw themselves between you and the attacker.
You can raise one familiar at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and familiar effect.
chicken.tag: This is a dimensional storage and familiar effect.

chimera.name: Grafting Pouch
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can store monster parts that you loot: claws, hides, horns and stingers. Spending mana grafts one stored part onto yourself for a short time, granting an attack or resistance drawn from the monster it came from.
Grafting a part consumes it. Only one graft can be active at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and transformation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a dimensional storage and transformation effect.

claw.name: Torn Open
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Locked chests, strongboxes and sealed containers can be stored whole. The storage space rips them open, and their contents spill into your inventory without needing a key or lockpick.
Trapped containers spring their traps inside storage, where they harm nothing. Containers warded by higher-rank magic take longer to tear.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
claw.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

cloth.name: Mending Lining
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Stored equipment slowly regains durability. Cloth and leather pieces recover fastest.

You can spend thread and fibre from storage to stitch a torn piece back into shape mid-fight. This repairs a portion of an equipped item's durability and, on armour, grants a brief boon of increased defence.
This is a dimensional storage and repair effect.
cloth.tag: This is a dimensional storage and repair effect.

cloud.name: Bottled Weather
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can draw a cloud, fog bank or gas cloud you are standing in into your storage, clearing the air around you. This includes enemy poison clouds.
A stored cloud can be released at any point you can see, with the same effect it had when it was taken.
You can hold one cloud at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and air effect.
cloud.tag: This is a dimensional storage and air effect.

cold.name: Cold Store
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can store the whole corpse of a creature you killed rather than looting it on the spot. A stored corpse stays frozen and fresh, and can be harvested later at a crafter or butcher for its complete yield of parts and materials.
Reagents and monster parts in your storage never lose potency.
This is a dimensional storage and preservation effect.
cold.tag: This is a dimensional storage and preservation effect.

coral.name: Reef-Grown Plate
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Armour left in storage slowly grows a living reef crust. When you equip a crusted piece, the crust grants extra defence until it has absorbed enough damage to break away.
A crust that breaks in combat scatters coral shards that wound enemies close to you.
Crusts regrow over time while the piece is stored.
This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Hoard
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

An item left in a sealed corner of your storage for a day can be corrupted. A corrupted item gains a dark property suited to its type, such as a weapon that inflicts a decay affliction or a ring that drains a little health from attackers. It also gains a drawback of matching weight.
Corruption cannot be undone. Each item can be corrupted only once.
This is a dimensional storage and corruption effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a dimensional storage and corruption effect.

crocodile.name: Snapping Jaw
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can open your storage in front of you like a jaw for a brief moment. Projectiles and thrown objects that enter it are caught and stored.
A caught projectile can be thrown back from storage at its original force. Catching costs stamina, and spells are not caught.
This is a dimensional storage and interception effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a dimensional storage and interception effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Rack
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

Your storage holds a small crystal lattice. Spare awakening stones and gems set into it resonate with the stones socketed in your essences, granting a portion of their passive effects as if partly socketed.
Stones set next to each other on the lattice strengthen one another. The lattice gains spaces as you rank up.
This is a dimensional storage and resonance effect.
crystal.tag: This is a dimensional storage and resonance effect.

cycle.name: Seasonal Store
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Consumables in your inventory never spoil. A potion or food item used from storage returns to your inventory after a long time, recovering over 24 hours.
Only one item can be returning at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and renewal effect.
cycle.tag: This is a dimensional storage and renewal effect.

dance.name: Repertoire
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Each different item you draw and use in combat without repeating one grants a stack of tempo, increasing attack and movement speed.
Using an item already in the current sequence resets the tempo.
At maximum tempo, your next item draw is instant and briefly makes you immune to slows.
This is a dimensional storage and rhythm effect.
dance.tag: This is a dimensional storage and rhythm effect.

dark.name: Shadow Mouth
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

The opening to your storage can be placed in your own shadow. Enemies standing in your shadow can be partially swallowed by it, which roots them and inflicts a stacking darkness affliction until they break free.
Items can also be drawn from your shadow without using your hands.
Swallowing costs mana over time.
This is a dimensional storage and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a dimensional storage and darkness effect.

dawn.name: Lantern Pocket
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory stores light. Standing in daylight or near a fire for a while fills a reserve that scales with rank.

You can release stored light as a flash around you, revealing hidden and invisible enemies nearby and blinding enemies who are facing you. In dark places, the reserve can instead light your surroundings for a long time.
This is a dimensional storage and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is a dimensional storage and light effect.

death.name: Final Keeping
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Once per day, when an ally within range would die, their body is taken into your storage instead. Inside it, time and dying are held still.
You can release them at any later point. They return at a small portion of their health, and are briefly immune to damage. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and death effect.
death.tag: This is a dimensional storage and death effect.

deep.name: Fathom Hold
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can draw large volumes of water into storage from any body of water you stand beside.
Stored water can be released as a crushing jet in a line, inflicting damage and pushing enemies back, or poured out to fill a pit or put out fires.
The pressure of the jet scales with the volume you release at once.
This is a dimensional storage and water effect.
deep.tag: This is a dimensional storage and water effect.

deer.name: Startle Reflex
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You choose one stored consumable as a startle item. When you take a heavy hit or are ambushed, it is used instantly without any action from you, and you bound a short distance away from the attacker.
This can only trigger once every short while.
This is a dimensional storage and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a dimensional storage and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Salt Locker
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Anything living or rotting placed in your inventory is preserved exactly as it was: plants, flesh, eggs and bodies.
A stored corpse cannot be raised, possessed or used by enemy abilities. Storing the corpse of an undead creature destroys it permanently.
This is a dimensional storage and death effect.
desolate.tag: This is a dimensional storage and death effect.

dimension.name: Folded Room
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can step into your own storage space for a few moments. While you are inside you cannot be targeted or harmed, and you can rearrange and use items freely.
When you step out, you can emerge anywhere within a short distance of where you entered.
Entering costs a large portion of your mana and recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a dimensional and teleport effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and teleport effect.

discord.name: Rattling Hoard
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can shake your storage, making everything inside it ring at once. This inflicts sonic damage on enemies around you and interrupts spells being cast nearby.
The more metal items you are carrying, the wider the effect and the more it disrupts. Enemies caught in it are briefly confused about which way to move.
This costs stamina.
This is a dimensional storage and sound effect.
discord.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sound effect.

discordant.name: Jangling Pack
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can hurl the contents of a stored stack of scrap, coins or bones out in a clattering spray. Enemies caught in it are disoriented for a short time and cannot coordinate: pack bonuses, auras and shared buffs between them are suppressed.
The thrown stack is lost.
This is a dimensional storage and discord effect.
discordant.tag: This is a dimensional storage and discord effect.

dog.name: Pack Stores
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items in your inventory can be equipped onto your summons and familiars directly from storage. A summon wearing gear you gave it gains that gear's stats and fights to stay close to you.
A summon can return the loot it is carrying by reaching your side, where the loot passes straight into your inventory.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
dog.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

doom.name: Condemned Shelf
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can mark a stored item for ending. After a long delay, the item breaks down in storage into monster cores and crafting materials matching its quality.
An enemy struck by a weapon marked this way is itself marked; when it dies, its loot arrives in your inventory without looting the body.
This is a dimensional storage and doom effect.
doom.tag: This is a dimensional storage and doom effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirror Pack
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a likeness of yourself. Drawing it out places a decoy wearing your current equipment where you stand while you step a short distance away unseen.
Enemies attack the decoy until it is destroyed or a short time passes. The likeness recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.

dragon.name: Dragon's Hoard
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You gain fire resistance and armour that scale with the total value of coins and treasure in your inventory.
You can spend stored coins to breathe fire in a cone in front of you. The more coin spent, the larger and hotter the cone.
This is a dimensional storage and fire effect.
dragon.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fire effect.

duck.name: Unruffled
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you are disarmed, robbed, or hit by an effect that would destroy or steal an equipped item, the item goes into your storage instead.
Stored items cannot be stolen, cursed or damaged by any effect while they remain in storage.
This is a dimensional storage and protection effect.
duck.tag: This is a dimensional storage and protection effect.

dust.name: Grey Grindings
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Any stored item can be ground to dust. This yields crafting powder suited to the item's material, plus a dust charge.
A dust charge can be thrown to fill an area with settling grey dust. It blinds enemies in the area and coats invisible or hidden creatures, making them visible until the dust falls away.
This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.
dust.tag: This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.

earth.name: Quarry Pocket
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can scoop a block of earth or stone from the ground into storage, leaving a pit that enemies can fall into.
A stored block can be set down at any point you can see as a wall, step or ramp of jagged stone. It blocks movement and line of sight and lasts until destroyed.
You can hold a number of blocks that scales with rank.
This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.
earth.tag: This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.

echo.name: Second Swallow
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you use a consumable drawn from storage, its effect echoes a short time later at a reduced strength, without using up another one.
A potion echoes as a smaller restore, a bomb as a smaller blast in the same spot.
The same consumable cannot echo again until its own cooldown has passed.
This is a dimensional storage and echo effect.
echo.tag: This is a dimensional storage and echo effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Hold
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can step into your inventory for a short time. While inside, you cannot be seen, targeted or damaged, and you cannot act except to leave.
You reappear where you entered. This effect costs mana for every moment you remain inside and cannot be used again for a short time after leaving.
This is a dimensional storage and dark effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a dimensional storage and dark effect.

edifice.name: Mason's Store
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Stone and timber materials in your inventory can be set into the world as walls, steps or barricades at tiles you can see. Each piece blocks movement and projectiles until destroyed.
Pieces you set can be taken back into storage at any time, returning the materials undamaged.
This is a dimensional storage and construction effect.
edifice.tag: This is a dimensional storage and construction effect.

effigy.name: Straw Proxy
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can bind a stored item as your proxy. When you would take lethal damage, the proxy breaks instead and you survive with a small portion of health.
The item is destroyed when the proxy breaks. The more valuable the item, the more health you are left with. Binding a new proxy requires being out of combat.
This is a dimensional storage and sacrifice effect.
effigy.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sacrifice effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Reservoir
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Elemental hazards you touch, such as burning ground, live lightning or freezing pools, and the remains of slain elementals, can be drawn into storage as elemental charges.
Spending a charge converts the damage of your equipped weapon to that element for a short time and adds a matching affliction to your hits.
This is a dimensional storage and elemental effect.
elemental.tag: This is a dimensional storage and elemental effect.

elixir.name: Blended Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Two potions in storage can be combined into a single blended draught that grants both effects at once. A blended draught shares a single cooldown.
Potions left in storage slowly settle into a purer form, strengthening their effect over the course of a day.
Blending costs mana scaled to the potions' quality.
This is a dimensional storage and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a dimensional storage and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Charged Arms
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can spend mana to charge a stored weapon. A charged weapon deals increased damage for its next several hits after it is drawn.
A charged weapon handed to an ally carries the charge with it. Only one weapon can hold a charge at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is a dimensional storage and empowerment effect.

eye.name: Watched Things
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items you have stored and then dropped, placed or given away stay marked. You can see the area around any of them within a long range, as though standing beside it.
If anyone picks up or uses a marked item, you know who it was and where they are, until the item returns to your storage.
This is a dimensional storage and scrying effect.
eye.tag: This is a dimensional storage and scrying effect.

feast.name: Laid Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Out of combat, you can lay a feast from your stored food. You and every ally who eats from it gain a long-lasting well-fed boon of increased health recovery and stamina.
The strength of the boon scales with how many different foods were laid out.
Each feast uses up the food it was made from.
This is a dimensional storage and sustenance effect.
feast.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sustenance effect.

feeble.name: Pilfered Vigour
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you strike an enemy that has active boons, you can tear one boon away and keep it in storage, unused, until you choose to take it yourself.
You can store up to three boons, and each lasts its full duration once you take it.
Tearing a boon costs mana scaled to the enemy's rank.
This is a dimensional storage and theft effect.
feeble.tag: This is a dimensional storage and theft effect.

fertile.name: Seedbed Pocket
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Seeds, cuttings and spores planted in your inventory grow there over time into harvestable plants and herbs.
You can sow a stored plant onto any tile you can see. It takes root at once as a harvestable node that regrows for as long as you remain in the region.
This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.

fey.name: Bargain Bag
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can strike a bargain with a willing townsperson or creature by placing an item in their hands from storage. If they accept, they owe you one favour: a discount, a secret, safe passage or help in a single fight.
Breaking a fey bargain afflicts the one who broke it with a lasting curse. Only three bargains can be held at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and fey effect.
fey.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fey effect.

fire.name: Banked Embers
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Ore and raw metal left in storage slowly smelt into ingots.
You can burn stored items as fuel. Each item burned grants a boon of bonus fire damage on your attacks, lasting for a time that scales with the item's value.
Burned items are destroyed.
This is a dimensional storage and fire effect.
fire.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fire effect.

firebird.name: Ember Nest
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

When you are reduced to low health, you can drop into your inventory as ash and reappear at a tile of your choosing within a short distance, wreathed in flame and restored to a portion of your health.
Enemies near the spot you left are set burning. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage, fire and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is a dimensional storage, fire and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Shoal Net
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Anything you lose in water, including dropped items and thrown weapons, comes back to your storage.
While you stand beside open water, your storage passively catches fish and aquatic reagents over time. Caught fish can be cooked or sold.
Wading into water with a fish stored quickens your stamina recovery for a short time.
This is a dimensional storage and water effect.
fish.tag: This is a dimensional storage and water effect.

flea.name: Hitchhiker
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can mark one item before you throw, drop or give it away. Once per short while, you can leap to the marked item's location from anywhere within a long range, landing beside it, and the item returns to your storage.
Leaping onto an item thrown at an enemy lands you behind that enemy.
This is a dimensional storage and teleport effect.
flea.tag: This is a dimensional storage and teleport effect.

flesh.name: Graft Pouch
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

Monster parts in your storage can be grafted onto your body for a short time. Each graft grants one trait of the creature it came from, such as a carapace's damage resistance, a hunter's claws or a beast's thick hide.
Grafting costs health and uses up the part. Only one graft can be active at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and flesh effect.
flesh.tag: This is a dimensional storage and flesh effect.

foot.name: Change of Step
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Swapping your boots for another pair from storage is instant, even mid-stride. Each time you swap, you gain the new pair's movement bonuses at greatly increased strength for a brief moment.
While walking out of combat, you never tire, and long journeys between settlements cost no stamina.
This is a dimensional storage and movement effect.
foot.tag: This is a dimensional storage and movement effect.

force.name: Driven Return
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A thrown weapon or projectile you have thrown returns to your inventory once it lands.
You can spend stamina to launch any stored object straight out of storage at high speed. It strikes the first enemy in its path for blunt damage and knocks it back.
This is a dimensional storage and force effect.
force.tag: This is a dimensional storage and force effect.

forge.name: Anvil Within
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can smith inside your inventory. Repairing, reforging and upgrading equipment can be done anywhere out of combat, using stored ore and fuel, as if you were at a forge.
An item you reforge in storage gains one additional socket for an awakening stone, once per item.
This is a dimensional storage and crafting effect.
forge.tag: This is a dimensional storage and crafting effect.

fork.name: Branched Dose
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A stored consumable can be split into two half-strength doses. Each half has its own cooldown, separate from the other's.
A split bomb or throwable can be thrown as two halves in a single motion, landing at two different points you can see.
Doses that have been split cannot be recombined.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
fork.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

fortress.name: Gatehouse Store
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can set a stored shield or piece of armour into the ground as a fortified post. Allies standing beside the post take reduced damage, and enemies cannot pass through the tile.
The post absorbs damage on the item's behalf and returns to storage when it breaks or when you recall it.
This is a dimensional storage and fortification effect.
fortress.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fortification effect.

fox.name: Bait and Switch
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can drop a stored item as bait. Enemies that notice it break off and go to investigate it, and the item appears more valuable than it really is.
When an enemy picks up the bait, it bursts into a flash of foxfire that confuses everything nearby, and the real item returns to your storage.
Only one bait can be set at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and trickery effect.
fox.tag: This is a dimensional storage and trickery effect.

frog.name: Long Tongue
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can lash out with a sticky tongue of storage-space to snatch any loose item, dropped loot or pickup within a medium range straight into your inventory.
The same lash pulls light enemies of lower rank a short distance toward you and holds them briefly.
Each lash costs stamina.
This is a dimensional storage and pull effect.
frog.tag: This is a dimensional storage and pull effect.

fungus.name: Mycelial Cache
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can seed a fungal patch at any point in the world. Every patch is threaded to your storage, so items can be deposited into or withdrawn from any patch you are standing on, by you or by party members.
Patches can be seen on the map. Enemies who disturb a patch release a cloud of spores that briefly slows them.
You can maintain a number of patches that scales with rank.
This is a dimensional storage and fungal effect.
fungus.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fungal effect.

garuda.name: Nectar Flask
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Once per day, a healing potion drawn from your inventory becomes amrita, healing you fully and cleansing poison and venom afflictions.
Serpentine and naga enemies flee from you briefly when you drink it. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and healing effect.
garuda.tag: This is a dimensional storage and healing effect.

gate.name: Portal Pocket
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory can hold a doorway. Opening it at a settlement you have visited stores that place; opening it again elsewhere creates a portal back there that lasts a short time.
You and your party can pass through the portal. The stored doorway is used up and recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and portal effect.
gate.tag: This is a dimensional storage and portal effect.

gathering.name: Drawn In
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Loot dropped anywhere within a wide radius of you gathers into your storage automatically, without you needing to approach it.
Once per fight, you can call back every weapon, projectile and item you have thrown or dropped, wherever it lies. Each returning item strikes enemies along its path.
This is a dimensional storage and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a dimensional storage and gathering effect.

glass.name: Glass Case
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
One stored item of your choice floats beside you in a case of clear glass. Its passive effects apply to you as though it were equipped, without using an equipment slot.
When you take a heavy hit, the case shatters. It throws glass shards into nearby enemies, and the item returns to storage. The case reforms over a short time.
This is a dimensional storage and glass effect.
glass.tag: This is a dimensional storage and glass effect.

glimeron.name: Prism Case
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a spell projectile that strikes you. Part of its damage is absorbed, and the stored spell can later be released back as a split beam that strikes up to three enemies.
Only one spell can be stored at a time, and it is lost if not released before a long time passes.
This is a dimensional storage and light effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a dimensional storage and light effect.

goat.name: Eats Anything
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can eat any stored junk item, including scrap, broken gear and inedible reagents, to restore stamina.
Cursed or poisonous items can be eaten safely. Each one grants a brief resistance to the curse or poison it carried.
While your stamina is above half, you cannot be knocked down on uneven or steep ground.
This is a dimensional storage and endurance effect.
goat.tag: This is a dimensional storage and endurance effect.

gorgon.name: Statue Gallery
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
An enemy of lower rank that you have petrified, or that died while petrified, can be stored whole as a statue.
You can set a stored statue down on a tile you can see. Enemies looking at it are slowed. You can shatter it to spray stone shards at everything nearby.
This is a dimensional storage and petrification effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a dimensional storage and petrification effect.

griffin.name: Aerie Cache
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you leap or dash, you can draw a weapon as you move. The first strike after landing is a special attack, dealing bonus damage in proportion to how far you travelled.
Items you mark on the map from a vantage point are pulled into your inventory if they are within a short distance of where you land.
This is a dimensional storage and flight effect.
griffin.tag: This is a dimensional storage and flight effect.

growth.name: Ripening Hold
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can set one stored item to ripen. Over several days in storage, a ripening item gains one quality tier, increasing its stats.
An item can ripen only once per rank you achieve, and while ripening it cannot be equipped or used.
This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a dimensional storage and growth effect.

guardian.name: Shield Bearer
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When an ally within a short distance is about to be hit, you can spend stamina to draw a stored shield onto their arm. The shield blocks the hit and returns to your inventory.
A shield used this way cannot be used again for a short time.
This is a dimensional storage and protection effect.
guardian.tag: This is a dimensional storage and protection effect.

hair.name: Strung Snares
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

You can string fine strands between any two stored items you set down, up to a short distance apart. An enemy that crosses a strand trips over it and is staggered, and both anchoring items snap back into your storage.
You can maintain several snares at once. Strands are invisible to lower-rank enemies.
This is a dimensional storage and trap effect.
hair.tag: This is a dimensional storage and trap effect.

hammer.name: Flattened Stack
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Duplicate pieces of equipment in storage can be hammered together into one. The result keeps the strongest stats of the pieces used, gains extra durability, and has a small chance to gain a socket.
The duplicates are consumed. Merging costs mana scaled to the items' rarity.
This is a dimensional storage and forging effect.
hammer.tag: This is a dimensional storage and forging effect.

hand.name: Steady Grip
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You cannot be disarmed. Weapons and shields knocked from your grip go straight back into your hands.
You can take items out of chests, containers and corpses within arm's reach without opening or searching them, as though they were part of your own storage.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
hand.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Set
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Pieces of an equipment set that are kept in storage count toward that set's bonuses, as long as at least one piece of the set is equipped.
When every piece of a set is either equipped or stored, the set gains a resonance bonus of increased resistances.
This is a dimensional storage and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a dimensional storage and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Snatching Wind
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can spend stamina to snatch an item from an enemy within a short distance: a dropped weapon, a thrown object, or a consumable the enemy is about to use.
The item goes straight into your inventory and the enemy is left disoriented by a shrieking gust. Enemies of higher rank resist this effect.
This is a dimensional storage and air effect.
harpy.tag: This is a dimensional storage and air effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning Sack
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you harvest a crafting node, you gather twice the materials. The extra share goes straight into storage.
At the end of each day, the materials you have gathered yield a bonus share of the most common material you harvested, scaling with how much you gathered.
This is a dimensional storage and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a dimensional storage and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Stabled Pocket
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Mounts can be stabled in your storage, where they do not tire and slowly heal.
You can call a stabled mount instantly and mount it in the same motion, even moments after leaving combat.
Mounts that have rested in storage start each ride with a burst of extra speed.
This is a dimensional storage and mount effect.
heidel.tag: This is a dimensional storage and mount effect.

hook.name: Barbed Take
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
At close range, you can hook an enemy's shield or weapon out of its grasp and into your storage. The enemy fights without it until the effect ends, when the item drops at its feet.
This does not work on enemies of a higher rank than you.
Hooking costs stamina and can only be done once every few seconds.
This is a dimensional storage and disarm effect.
hook.tag: This is a dimensional storage and disarm effect.

horse.name: Lance from the Saddle
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

While you are mounted and moving at full gallop, you can draw a polearm or heavy weapon from storage into a charge. The first hit of the charge deals additional damage based on your speed and knocks lower-rank enemies down.
Your mount can carry an extra set of saddlebags, adding storage space while you ride.
This is a dimensional storage and mounted effect.
horse.tag: This is a dimensional storage and mounted effect.

hunger.name: The Maw
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A lower-rank enemy below a small portion of its health can be devoured into your storage. It is killed outright, and its loot is stored.
Each creature devoured grants a brief boon of health and mana recovery.
Devouring costs no resources, but it can only be done once every short while.
This is a dimensional storage and execution effect.
hunger.tag: This is a dimensional storage and execution effect.

hunt.name: Trophy Rack
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Trophies taken from slain monsters, such as horns, fangs and pelts, are kept on a rack in your storage.
You deal increased damage to every monster species you have a trophy from. The nearest member of that species within aura-sense range is shown on the map.
You can keep trophies from a number of species that scales with rank.
This is a dimensional storage and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a dimensional storage and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Pack
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When a stored weapon breaks, it splits into two lesser copies of itself rather than being lost. Each copy has reduced durability.
Consumables in a stack of three or more cannot all be used up. The last one regrows slowly, recovering over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and regeneration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a dimensional storage and regeneration effect.

ice.name: Rime Pouch
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Weapons drawn from storage come out coated in frost. The first strike with a freshly drawn weapon applies a chill affliction that slows the target.
Thrown consumables drawn from storage shatter on impact into a patch of slick ice. Enemies crossing the ice may slip and fall.
This is a dimensional storage and ice effect.
ice.tag: This is a dimensional storage and ice effect.

immortal.name: Timeless Vault
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items in your inventory do not age, wear or lose durability while stored. Charges and enchantments on stored items never fade.
If you die, everything in your inventory remains in storage rather than dropping where you fell.
This is a dimensional storage and immortality effect.
immortal.tag: This is a dimensional storage and immortality effect.

iron.name: Iron Strongbox
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your storage is lined with cold iron. The curses of cursed items are suppressed while those items are stored, so you can carry them safely.
A weapon drawn from storage cuts through magical barriers and wards with its first strike, inflicting increased damage on fey and conjured creatures.
This is a dimensional storage and anti-magic effect.
iron.tag: This is a dimensional storage and anti-magic effect.

juggernaut.name: Momentum Stow
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Carrying a heavier load does not slow you. Instead, the total weight of your inventory adds to the damage and knockback of your charges and body-blows.
While you are moving in a straight line, enemies of lower rank cannot stop or slow you.
This is a dimensional storage and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a dimensional storage and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Ledger Box
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items stolen from you by enemies or traps are returned to your inventory when the thief dies, along with a share of whatever the thief carried.
When you give an item away freely, a random item of similar value enters your inventory later that day.
This is a dimensional storage and fate effect.
karmic.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fate effect.

knife.name: Sleeve Edge
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Weapons in your storage cannot be found by searches, identification or detection effects.
Drawing a blade on an enemy who is unaware of you, or has its back to you, makes the first strike a hidden-edge attack. It deals heavy damage and inflicts a bleeding affliction.
This is a dimensional storage and concealment effect.
knife.tag: This is a dimensional storage and concealment effect.

knowledge.name: Catalogue
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
An item left in storage for a full day is catalogued. Cataloguing reveals one hidden property it carries, or teaches you its crafting recipe if it has one.
You can read any catalogued item's notes at any time, including items you have since sold or lost.
This is a dimensional storage and knowledge effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a dimensional storage and knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Deep Grasp
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your reach into storage extends outward. You can pull loot, dropped items and harvestable materials into your inventory from a long distance away without walking to them.
You can drag an enemy of lower rank a short distance toward you by seizing the item it is holding.
This is a dimensional storage and grasping effect.
kraken.tag: This is a dimensional storage and grasping effect.

leviathan.name: Sounding Hold
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory holds water. You can store a large volume from any lake, river or sea.
You can release stored water as a surging wave in front of you, knocking back and soaking enemies in its path and putting out fires.
This is a dimensional storage and water effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a dimensional storage and water effect.

life.name: Living Keep
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Living plants and reagents kept in storage continue to grow, multiplying slowly over time.
Healing consumables in storage regain a single use over the course of a day after being used. This only works once per item per day.
This is a dimensional storage and life effect.
life.tag: This is a dimensional storage and life effect.

light.name: Bright Draw
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you draw an item from storage, you can make it emerge in a flash of light. The flash blinds enemies facing you and reveals invisible creatures nearby.
The flash costs mana and can only be used once every short while.
Stored light sources glow from your storage, lighting the area around you without being held.
This is a dimensional storage and light effect.
light.tag: This is a dimensional storage and light effect.

lightning.name: Static Charge
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Every item you draw or swap in combat builds a stack of static charge.
At maximum charge, your next hit discharges as chain lightning that leaps between nearby enemies, and it clears the stacks.
Swapping items is instant while you hold any charge.
This is a dimensional storage and lightning effect.
lightning.tag: This is a dimensional storage and lightning effect.

lizard.name: Shed Tail
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you are grabbed, rooted or held, you can shed a stored item in your place. You slip free, and the enemy is left holding the item, which looks like part of you for a moment.
You keep the shed item if you are close enough to pick it up again.
This can only be done once every short while.
This is a dimensional storage and escape effect.
lizard.tag: This is a dimensional storage and escape effect.

locust.name: Swarm Satchel
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can release a locust swarm from storage over an area. The swarm devours the corpses and vegetation in that area, damaging any enemies inside it.
When the swarm returns, it brings back crafting fibre, plant reagents and any small loot it found.
The swarm needs a short time in storage before it can be released again.
This is a dimensional storage and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is a dimensional storage and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Cursed, tainted or corrupted items placed in your inventory are slowly purified. When purification is complete, the curse is removed and its hidden property is revealed.
While you carry an item being purified, afflictions you suffer last a shorter time.
This is a dimensional storage and purification effect.
lotus.tag: This is a dimensional storage and purification effect.

lurker.name: Something Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Something lives in the dark of your storage. Anyone who tries to take an item from you, or reaches into your belongings, is bitten and gains a darkness affliction.
Once per fight, you can let it lunge out from beneath your feet at an enemy near you. The lunge deals heavy damage and drags the enemy down, rooting it briefly.
This is a dimensional storage and ambush effect.
lurker.tag: This is a dimensional storage and ambush effect.

magic.name: Arcane Reservoir
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store mana in your inventory as a separate reserve, filling it while out of combat. When your mana runs dry, the reserve drains into your mana pool automatically.
Spells cast with mana drawn from the reserve cannot be interrupted.
The reserve holds more mana at each rank.
This is a dimensional storage and mana effect.
magic.tag: This is a dimensional storage and mana effect.

malign.name: Grudge Ledger
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When an enemy strikes you, you can store a portion of the damage in your inventory as a grudge instead of taking it. Each grudge decays slowly over time.
You can release every stored grudge at once onto a single enemy as dark damage. A grudge stored against a specific enemy deals significantly more damage when released onto that enemy.
This is a dark and retribution effect.
malign.tag: This is a dark and retribution effect.

manatee.name: Slow Keeping
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items in your inventory do not age, spoil or lose charges. Potions, food and conjured items that would expire stay as they were when stored.
Out of combat, you can lay down an item from storage to drift beside you, where it slowly restores health to you and any ally resting nearby. Only one item can drift at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and restoration effect.
manatee.tag: This is a dimensional storage and restoration effect.

manticore.name: Quill Quiver
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Spines, quills and stingers you loot are stored as ammunition. You can fire them from storage in a volley at the enemy in front of you, each one inflicting a stacking venom affliction.
Firing a volley costs stamina. Quills from higher-rank monsters inflict stronger venom.
This is a dimensional storage and venom effect.
manticore.tag: This is a dimensional storage and venom effect.

master.name: Settled Kit
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can save up to three loadouts of weapons, armour and quickbar consumables. Switching to a saved loadout is instant out of combat and takes a moment in combat.
For a short time after switching, abilities that match the new loadout's weapon type cost less stamina.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
master.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

might.name: Heavy Hand
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
The weight of items you carry does not slow you. You can store objects too large to lift, such as boulders, felled trees and broken wagons.
You can recall a stored heavy object directly above an enemy, dropping it for physical damage scaled to its size. The object returns to the world where it lands.
This is a dimensional storage and force effect.
might.tag: This is a dimensional storage and force effect.

ministration.name: Field Dressing
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can tend a downed ally or companion by placing bandages and potions from storage directly on them. They recover health over time and are cleansed of bleeding afflictions.
Any healing consumable used this way on an ally also heals you for a smaller amount.
This is a dimensional storage and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a dimensional storage and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Pocket
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can lock an enemy of lower rank inside your inventory for a short time. While inside, it is lost in a maze: it cannot act, and it takes no damage.
When it is released, it reappears in front of you and is stunned briefly. This effect costs mana scaled to the enemy's rank, and cannot be used on the same enemy twice in one fight.
This is a dimensional storage and space effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a dimensional storage and space effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Bag
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items you drop from your inventory can be left as mirages. A mirage looks real to enemies, monsters and scavengers, and draws them toward it.
Enemies that reach a mirage find nothing and are left confused for a short time. Up to three mirages can exist at once.
This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.
mirage.tag: This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.

mirror.name: Second Satchel
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can mark one item in your inventory as a reflection. A reflected item appears in your hand as a perfect copy that lasts a short time, while the original stays in storage.
Copies of consumables work once and then shatter. Copies of weapons and armour carry the original's stats but none of its enchantments.
Making a copy costs mana scaled to the item's rarity.
This is a reflection and conjuration effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and conjuration effect.

monkey.name: Quick Fingers
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Switching weapons or gear from your inventory takes no time and does not interrupt an attack in progress.
Once per fight, you can reach into an adjacent enemy's pack and pull a random item it carries into your inventory. Lower-rank enemies do not notice the theft.
This is a dimensional storage and theft effect.
monkey.tag: This is a dimensional storage and theft effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory holds a single standing stone. You can raise it from storage on a tile you can see. While it stands, you and allies near it cannot be knocked back or knocked down.
You can return to the stone's location once per day from anywhere in the same region. Raising it again elsewhere moves it.
This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.
monolith.tag: This is a dimensional storage and earth effect.

moon.name: Tide Pocket
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory waxes and wanes with the night. On nights near the full moon it gains extra slots, and items stored in it slowly recover lost durability and charges.
On moonless nights, anything stored in your inventory cannot be detected, identified or tracked by any means.
This is a dimensional storage and lunar effect.
moon.tag: This is a dimensional storage and lunar effect.

mouse.name: Burrow Cache
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can leave a hidden cache anywhere in the world and send items into it from your inventory at any distance. Only you can find or open a cache.
Up to three caches can exist at once. Standing beside one of your caches lets you swap its contents with your inventory.
This is a dimensional storage and concealment effect.
mouse.tag: This is a dimensional storage and concealment effect.

myriad.name: Many Hands
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can set up to three loadouts of weapons, armour, rings and amulets in your inventory. Swapping to a loadout changes everything at once.
When you swap loadouts mid-fight, a brief, intangible double of you in the old loadout stays behind and repeats your last attack before fading.
This is a dimensional storage and duplication effect.
myriad.tag: This is a dimensional storage and duplication effect.

mystic.name: Inner Shelf
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Unidentified items in your inventory are identified on their own over time, without being held.
Mana potions and mana-restoring items in storage passively feed your mana pool. You recover a small amount of mana over time for each one you carry, up to a limit.
This is a dimensional storage and mana effect.
mystic.tag: This is a dimensional storage and mana effect.
