nebula.name: Dust Veil Store
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory has no fixed capacity. Instead, its space spreads thinner as it fills: past a threshold, retrieving items takes longer.
You can release fine dust from storage as a drifting cloud that hides you and allies from ranged attacks while you stand inside it.
This is a dimensional storage and space effect.
nebula.tag: This is a dimensional storage and space effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Draw
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can recall a stored weapon or projectile so that it appears in flight, already aimed at a target in sight rather than in your hand.
Weapons that arrive this way strike exactly where you choose, ignoring armour on the first hit, and then return to storage.
Each throw costs stamina.
This is a dimensional storage and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a dimensional storage and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Trophy Case
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a trophy from an enemy that has escaped or defeated you. While you carry it, that enemy is shown on your map whenever it is in the same region.
You deal increased damage to the trophy's owner and its kind. Only one trophy can be held at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and tracking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a dimensional storage and tracking effect.

net.name: Gathering Mesh
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can cast an open mesh from your inventory over an area. Loose items, drops and gatherable materials beneath it are swept into storage.
Enemies caught under the mesh are entangled briefly. A lower-rank enemy small enough to fit can be caught entirely and stored as a captive until released.
The mesh costs mana and cannot be cast again for a short time.
This is a capture and dimensional storage effect.
net.tag: This is a capture and dimensional storage effect.

network.name: Shared Satchel
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Members of your party can each open a shared compartment in your inventory. Items placed in it are available to every party member at any distance.
Messages written on paper placed in the compartment are read instantly by every party member, wherever they are.
This is a dimensional storage and communication effect.
network.tag: This is a dimensional storage and communication effect.

oasis.name: Wellspring Flask
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can set a stored waterskin down to create a small spring that lasts a long time. You and allies resting at the spring recover health, mana and stamina significantly faster.
Enemies will not path to a spring unless they are already in combat with you. Only one spring can exist at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and sanctuary effect.
oasis.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sanctuary effect.

ocean.name: Tidewrack Store
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Each time you return to an area you have looted before, a share of fresh loot has washed up there, delivered straight to your inventory.
Items lost when you die wash back into your inventory over the following day.
This is a dimensional storage and tide effect.
ocean.tag: This is a dimensional storage and tide effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Armed Reach
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can use consumables from your inventory without stopping, even while attacking, casting or moving. Up to two can be used at once.
Ink stored in your inventory can be released as a cloud around you that blocks sight and breaks enemy tracking effects on you. Ink refills slowly while you stand in water or are out of combat.
This is a dimensional storage and obscuring effect.
octopus.tag: This is a dimensional storage and obscuring effect.

omen.name: Fated Pack
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Before you enter a fight, the item you will most need in it rises to the top of your inventory and is marked.

Once per day, when you would die, an item you are carrying breaks in your place instead and you are left at a sliver of health. You cannot choose which item breaks. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a divination and protection effect.
omen.tag: This is a divination and protection effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Supply
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When a weapon you are using breaks or runs out of ammunition mid-combo, an identical stored weapon or ammunition replaces it in your hand without interrupting the attack.
Each consecutive hit without a gap increases the damage of the next, until you stop attacking for a moment.
This is a dimensional storage and onslaught effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a dimensional storage and onslaught effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Hoard
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Armour pieces in storage that you are not wearing still contribute a portion of their defence to you.
When you curl up to block, your stored armour plates over you, briefly making you immune to physical damage while you cannot move or attack.
This is a dimensional storage and defence effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a dimensional storage and defence effect.

paper.name: Pressed Pages
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can press an active spell or effect into a blank page in your inventory, storing it unused. Each page holds one effect.
Reading a stored page releases the effect exactly as it was, including heals, wards and buffs cast on you by allies.
Pages crumble after a day. You can hold more pages at each rank.
This is a scroll and storage effect.
paper.tag: This is a scroll and storage effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Nightmare Drawer
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can open your inventory outward on enemies around you. For a short time, they see its contents spilling over them as a shifting nightmare and attack random targets, including each other.
This effect costs mana and does not affect enemies of higher rank. It cannot be used again for a long time.
This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a dimensional storage and illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Ash Reliquary
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
An item destroyed while in your possession leaves ash in your inventory. Over the following day, the ash reforms into the item, fully repaired.
Items reborn this way gain fire resistance. Only one item can be reforming at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a dimensional storage and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Seed Vault
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Seeds, cuttings and herbs stored in your inventory grow over time, multiplying into harvestable reagents without needing soil or light.
You can plant a stored seed in the world during combat. It sprouts at once as a rooting vine that holds enemies in place, or as a healing bloom that restores health to allies near it.
This is a growth and dimensional storage effect.
plant.tag: This is a growth and dimensional storage effect.

potent.name: Distilled Stores
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can combine stacks of the same potion or consumable in your inventory into a single concentrated dose. A concentrated dose has a much stronger effect and a matching cooldown.
Concentrating costs the full stack and cannot be reversed.
This is an alchemical and dimensional storage effect.
potent.tag: This is an alchemical and dimensional storage effect.

predatory.name: Stalker's Bag
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store the scent of a creature you have damaged. While you carry it, its trail is visible to you and your stealth is not broken by moving toward it.
The first hit you land on that creature after tracking it this way is a special attack that deals critical damage.
This is a dimensional storage and tracking effect.
predatory.tag: This is a dimensional storage and tracking effect.

prison.name: Cell Block
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A defeated humanoid enemy can be taken prisoner and stored instead of killed. Prisoners can be handed over to guards and the Society for bounties, or released to be questioned.
A prisoner cannot escape, act or be rescued while it is held. Only a few prisoners can be held at once.
This is a dimensional storage and imprisonment effect.
prison.tag: This is a dimensional storage and imprisonment effect.

prosperity.name: Coin Purse of Plenty
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Coins in your inventory earn interest overnight, up to a limit that scales with rank.
Shopkeepers offer better prices when you buy with stored coin. When you are carrying a large sum, rare stock appears in their shelves.
This is a dimensional storage and fortune effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fortune effect.

pure.name: Clean Keeping
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items placed in your inventory are cleansed of curses, poisons and corruption over time. Cursed items lose their curse entirely after a full day in storage.
You can store an affliction. Drawing an affliction from yourself into storage removes it, and you can later release it onto an enemy you touch.
This is a cleansing and dimensional storage effect.
pure.tag: This is a cleansing and dimensional storage effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt Hole
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Once per fight, you can step into your own inventory, vanishing from the world for a brief moment. Enemies lose track of you and attacks in progress miss.
You re-emerge a short distance from where you vanished, in a direction you choose, with a burst of movement speed.
This is a dimensional and escape effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a dimensional and escape effect.

rake.name: Long Rake
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can draw any item lying on the ground within a short range straight into your inventory without walking to it, including items across gaps or behind enemies.
Raking an area costs stamina and also drags lower-rank enemies standing in it a step toward you.
This is a dimensional storage and pull effect.
rake.tag: This is a dimensional storage and pull effect.

rat.name: Scavenger's Stash
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Broken items in your inventory are not lost. They are slowly picked apart into crafting materials.
When your health falls low, you automatically eat the lowest-value food or consumable in storage for a small heal, without spending an action. This can happen once per fight.
This is a scavenging and dimensional storage effect.
rat.tag: This is a scavenging and dimensional storage effect.

reagent.name: Crucible Pocket
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can brew potions inside your inventory without a workstation. Reagents placed together in storage combine over time into the potion they make.
Potions brewed this way cannot be made by others and are worth more when sold.
This is an alchemical and dimensional storage effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemical and dimensional storage effect.

refracting.name: Angled Pocket
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When a projectile would hit you, you can spend stamina to catch it in your inventory. A caught projectile can be fired back out at any angle you choose.
Only one projectile can be held at a time. Projectiles from higher-rank enemies cost more stamina to catch.
This is a dimensional storage and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a dimensional storage and deflection effect.

renewal.name: Turning Store
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Damaged gear in your inventory repairs itself fully over a day.

When you fall in battle, a revival charm forms in your inventory, if one is not already there. Using it on a downed ally revives them with a portion of their health. Only one charm can exist at a time.
This is a renewal and dimensional storage effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal and dimensional storage effect.

resolute.name: Planted Stores
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items in your inventory cannot be stolen, destroyed, dropped on death or removed by any effect.
While you stand still, your stored armour lends you resistance to being knocked down, pushed or pulled. The resistance builds the longer you hold your ground.
This is a protection and steadfast effect.
resolute.tag: This is a protection and steadfast effect.

resonating.name: Humming Hoard
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Stored items of the same kind resonate. Each additional copy of a weapon type in storage increases the damage you deal with that weapon type, up to a limit.
You can strike a stored bell, gong or instrument to release a pulse of sound that damages enemies around you and grows louder with each pulse in a short span.
This is a dimensional storage and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a dimensional storage and resonance effect.

roc.name: Talon Freight
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can carry a willing ally or companion in your inventory while travelling, releasing them beside you at any time.
Released at speed, an ally lands with a crashing impact that damages and knocks back enemies around them.
This is a dimensional storage and flight effect.
roc.tag: This is a dimensional storage and flight effect.

rune.name: Inscribed Satchel
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can inscribe a rune on any item in your inventory. A rune adds a single minor enchantment, chosen from those you have seen, and fades after a day.
An item recalled from storage with a rune on it flashes the rune on arrival, applying its effect to the nearest enemy.
Inscribing costs mana scaled to the item's rarity.
This is a rune and enchantment effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and enchantment effect.

sacrifice.name: Altar Satchel
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can offer up a stored item to gain a boon of your choice for a long time: increased damage, defence, mana recovery or movement speed. The boon's strength scales with the item's rarity.
The item is destroyed. Only one boon from this effect can be active at a time.
This is a dimensional storage and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Hoard
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store sand from any desert, beach or ruin. Stored sand can be poured out as a swirling cloud that blinds enemies inside it and slowly grinds down their armour.
You can also bury an item from your inventory in the ground. It cannot be found by anyone else and can be recalled from any distance.
This is a sand and dimensional storage effect.
sand.tag: This is a sand and dimensional storage effect.

sceptre.name: Regalia
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can grant an ally a key to your inventory. An ally holding a key can draw consumables from your storage and return items to it.
You can revoke keys at any time. Items an ally draws are taken from your stock.
While an ally holds a key, their attacks gain a portion of your power.
This is an authority and dimensional storage effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and dimensional storage effect.

scribe.name: Indexed Archive
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Every item that passes through your inventory is recorded in an index, including its properties and where you found it.
You can copy a skill book, map or written recipe you have stored onto blank paper, creating a duplicate that can be read once by someone else.
This is a dimensional storage and record effect.
scribe.tag: This is a dimensional storage and record effect.

serene.name: Still Waters
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Opening your inventory pauses the world around you for a moment, letting you rearrange gear and choose consumables. This works once per fight.
Items drawn from storage while you are calm, with full health and no afflictions, have their effects lengthened.
This is a time and calm effect.
serene.tag: This is a time and calm effect.

serpent.name: Shed Skins
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you are hit by a grab, root or constricting effect, you can shed the armour piece in that slot into your inventory and slip free.
The shed armour can be re-equipped from storage after a short time. You gain a brief burst of speed when you slip free.
This is a dimensional storage and escape effect.
serpent.tag: This is a dimensional storage and escape effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When an enemy is bleeding, you can sense the items it carries and the cores within it.
Enemies killed while bleeding drop an additional item from their loot table, which goes straight into your inventory.
Stored weapons that have drawn blood in the last day deal bonus damage to bleeding enemies.
This is a hunting and dimensional storage effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and dimensional storage effect.

shield.name: Bulwark Recall
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When an attack you can see is about to hit you, you can recall a stored shield into its path even if your hands are full. The shield takes the hit and returns to storage.
A shield used this way cannot be recalled again for a short time. Store more shields to block more often.
This is a dimensional storage and defence effect.
shield.tag: This is a dimensional storage and defence effect.

shimmer.name: Glimmer Cache
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can release a stored item as a glittering decoy of itself. Enemies are drawn to attack or pick up the decoy, which bursts into dazzling light when touched and blinds everything nearby.
Decoys can be made from gold. Stored coin is spent to create them, scaled to your rank.
This is a light and illusion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and illusion effect.

ship.name: Ship's Hold
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory gains a hold of extra space for bulk goods such as ore, timber and trade cargo.
Goods carried in the hold between regions sell for a better price at their destination. Carrying the hold through a sea crossing, astral portal or dangerous road raises the price further.
This is a trade and dimensional storage effect.
ship.tag: This is a trade and dimensional storage effect.

shovel.name: Buried Fortune
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can dig anywhere outdoors to pull up buried materials straight into your inventory. What you find depends on the region and its rank.
Digging opens a trench you can stand in, which reduces damage you take from ranged attacks until you leave it.
Digging costs stamina and can only be done out of combat.
This is an earth and gathering effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and gathering effect.

sickle.name: Reaped Stock
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you harvest a node or gather a plant, you can sweep through every matching node within a short range, gathering them all at once into storage.
Enemies caught in the sweep take slashing damage.
The sweep costs stamina scaled to the number of nodes gathered.
This is a harvesting and blade effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvesting and blade effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Kit
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a near-copy of any item you have identified. The copy has the original's appearance and half its stats, and fades after a long time.
Copies can be traded, equipped and given as quest items, but merchants who identify them pay nothing.
This is a dimensional storage and replication effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a dimensional storage and replication effect.

sin.name: Forbidden Pocket
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store stolen, cursed and contraband goods in a hidden pocket that no guard, shopkeeper or identification effect can detect.
Cursed items in the hidden pocket lend you their power without their curse, but only while they stay unused. Each one you carry slowly drains your health.
This is a dark and concealment effect.
sin.tag: This is a dark and concealment effect.

skirmish.name: Loose Kit
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Each time you use a movement ability, you can drop a consumable from storage at your starting point. Healing items heal allies who pass over them; bombs and caltrops harm enemies who do.
Dropped items fade if not used within a short time.
This is a dimensional storage and movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a dimensional storage and movement effect.

skunk.name: Rank Reserve
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When an enemy grabs, steals from or pins you, your inventory releases a choking cloud that forces lower-rank enemies to let go and flee. This can happen once per fight.
Monsters that have been driven off this way avoid you for the rest of the day.
This is a repulsion and fear effect.
skunk.tag: This is a repulsion and fear effect.

sky.name: Cloud-Floor Cache
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items in your inventory weigh nothing. You take no falling damage while your inventory is more than half full.
You can draw a cloud from storage to spring from. It carries you across gaps and water in a single bound, and you cannot be knocked down while it lasts. This effect costs mana.
This is a dimensional storage and air effect.
sky.tag: This is a dimensional storage and air effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Inventory
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
The longer an item sits unused in your inventory, the stronger it becomes, up to a limit. A potion left for a day heals more; a weapon left for a week strikes harder its first time back in hand.
The bonus is spent when the item is used.
This is a storage and accumulation effect.
sloth.tag: This is a storage and accumulation effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Satchel
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store smoke from any fire. Released, it fills an area and makes you and allies inside it invisible to enemies outside it.
You can step out of the smoke at any point along its edge as if you had been standing there.
This is a smoke and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and stealth effect.

snake.name: Venom Vial
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can milk venom from the corpses of venomous monsters you loot. Stored venom can be applied to any weapon you recall, which then inflicts the monster's poison affliction on hit.
Venom from higher-rank monsters is more potent. Each coating lasts a set number of hits.
This is a poison and dimensional storage effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and dimensional storage effect.

soaring.name: Glider's Pack
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can draw a stored cloak or banner to catch the wind, bounding far in a single leap. The leap costs no stamina.
As you leap, you can drop stored consumables onto the ground behind you, and bombs dropped this way deal increased damage.
This is a dimensional storage and flight effect.
soaring.tag: This is a dimensional storage and flight effect.

song.name: Music Box
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a song you have heard or performed. Releasing it plays the song around you for a short time, carrying its effect to every ally who can hear it.
Stored songs keep the strength they had when stored, even if the singer was stronger than you.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Sealed Writ
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a seal. Pressing it onto a document, door or chest from storage claims it as yours. Claimed chests and doors open only for you, and claimed contracts pay you an extra share.
Guards and officials treat a claimed document as an order from someone with authority. Only a few seals can be active at once.
This is a dimensional storage and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a dimensional storage and authority effect.

spear.name: Javelin Rack
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can throw any stored polearm or spear. After it lands, you can recall it to your hand, and it strikes every enemy between you and where it landed on the way back.
Thrown spears pin smaller enemies to the ground briefly.
This is a dimensional storage and throwing effect.
spear.tag: This is a dimensional storage and throwing effect.

spider.name: Web Larder
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Enemies you defeat while they are entangled can be wrapped and stored whole rather than looted at once. Wrapped prey keeps until you choose to loot it.
Wrapped prey of a higher rank yields richer loot when finally opened, and can be offered at a shop or Society contract as proof of a kill.
This is a capture and dimensional storage effect.
spider.tag: This is a capture and dimensional storage effect.

spike.name: Spiked Stash
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can scatter caltrops from your inventory in a line behind you. Enemies crossing them take piercing damage and are slowed.
Any enemy that tries to steal from you or open your storage is struck by spikes and takes heavy damage.
This is a trap and defence effect.
spike.tag: This is a trap and defence effect.

staff.name: Walking Pack
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You travel faster on roads and paths while carrying a staff in storage.
You can plant a stored staff in the ground to mark a waypoint. Once per day, you can return to a planted staff from anywhere in the same region. Only one staff can be planted at a time.
This is a travel and teleport effect.
staff.tag: This is a travel and teleport effect.

star.name: Starlit Chest
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items stored under the open night sky gather starlight. A starlit item glows, reveals hidden and invisible things near you while held, and deals bonus damage to creatures of darkness.
You can spend a starlit item's glow to fire it as a falling star at a distant target, dealing fire and light damage. The item returns to storage without its glow.
This is a star and light effect.
star.tag: This is a star and light effect.

stellar.name: Star Chamber
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Monster cores in your inventory burn slowly, feeding you mana over time while you carry them. Higher-rank cores burn hotter and longer.
You can expend a stored core all at once to fire a burning star that strikes an enemy far away for heavy fire damage.
This is a dimensional storage and stellar effect.
stellar.tag: This is a dimensional storage and stellar effect.

storm.name: Squall Pouch
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you are caught in a storm, you can gather it into your inventory. The storm ends where you stand.
You can release a stored storm on an area you can see. Rain, wind and lightning lash enemies inside it for a short time. A storm stored this way fades after a day.
This is a dimensional storage and storm effect.
storm.tag: This is a dimensional storage and storm effect.

succubus.name: Given Gifts
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].

When you hand a humanoid an item from storage and they accept it, they become charmed for a short time. A charmed enemy will not attack you, and a charmed townsperson offers you something of theirs in return.
Charm does not work on enemies of higher rank, or on anyone currently in combat with you.
This is a dimensional storage and charm effect.
succubus.tag: This is a dimensional storage and charm effect.

sun.name: Sunlit Stores
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory soaks up sunlight during the day. At night or underground, you can release stored sunlight as a blaze around you that burns undead and creatures of darkness and lights the area.
Food and potions stored during daylight restore stamina as well as their usual effect.
This is a sun and light effect.
sun.tag: This is a sun and light effect.

swarm.name: Hive Hold
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory can house a swarm of insects, gathered by looting insect monsters. You can release the swarm onto an area to sting enemies over time and obscure their vision.
When recalled, the swarm brings back small loose items and materials it found in the area.
This is a dimensional storage and swarm effect.
swarm.tag: This is a dimensional storage and swarm effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Draw
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Using a consumable from storage grants a brief burst of movement and attack speed.
If you use three different consumables within a short time, the burst is doubled and your next dodge costs no stamina.
This is a speed and dimensional storage effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and dimensional storage effect.

sword.name: Armoury of the Drawn Blade
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you draw a sword from storage, the draw itself is a strike against the nearest enemy, dealing damage as if it were a special attack.
Swords that sit in storage stay sharp and gain a small amount of damage for each enemy killed with them, up to a limit set by their rarity.
This is a blade and dimensional storage effect.
sword.tag: This is a blade and dimensional storage effect.

talisman.name: Charm Thread
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can thread up to three rings or amulets from storage onto a charm-cord. Their passive effects apply to you while they are in your inventory, without occupying equipment slots.
Awakening stones placed on the cord grant a weak echo of their effect without being socketed.
This is a dimensional storage and talisman effect.
talisman.tag: This is a dimensional storage and talisman effect.

tentacle.name: Reaching Hold
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Tentacles reach from your storage to seize an enemy within a short range, holding it in place and dragging it toward you.
While an enemy is held this way, you can pull an item it is wielding straight into your inventory. Higher-rank enemies resist the theft.
Each grasp costs mana.
This is a binding and theft effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and theft effect.

thread.name: Tethered Pack
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can tie a thread to any item or ally you touch. A tethered item can be pulled back into your inventory from any distance, and a tethered ally can be drawn to your side once per fight.
Weapons you throw while tethered always return to storage after they strike.
Up to three tethers can exist at once.
This is a binding and recall effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and recall effect.

thunderbird.name: Storm-Kept Arms
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A weapon drawn from your inventory arrives in your hand with a thunderclap. Enemies around you are deafened and briefly interrupted.
Your first hit with a newly drawn weapon calls down a lightning strike on the target. This can only occur once every few seconds.
This is a dimensional storage and storm effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a dimensional storage and storm effect.

time.name: Held Second
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Time does not pass inside your inventory. Buffs on stored potions, brewing timers and crafting timers are paused.
Once per day, you can store the current moment. Restoring it within a short time returns your health, mana and stamina to what they were when it was stored. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a dimensional storage and time effect.
time.tag: This is a dimensional storage and time effect.

tranquil.name: Quiet Box
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Sounds you would make can be stored. While moving with a stored silence, your footsteps, equipment and doors you open make no noise and do not alert enemies.
You can release the stored silence over an area. Enemies inside cannot cast spells for a short time.
This is a dimensional storage and silence effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a dimensional storage and silence effect.

transfiguration.name: Remaking Chest
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can transfigure a stored item into another item of the same rarity and slot, choosing its type. A sword can become an axe; a helm can become a hood.
The item keeps its rarity and socketed awakening stones. Each item can be transfigured once per rank.
This is a dimensional storage and transfiguration effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a dimensional storage and transfiguration effect.

transgression.name: Contraband Pocket
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store and use items from restricted essences and awakening stones without guards, sensors or wards detecting them.
Items you take from a restricted area or a vault you entered without leave grant you a brief burst of speed when stored.
This is a dimensional storage and transgression effect.
transgression.tag: This is a dimensional storage and transgression effect.

trap.name: Snare Locker
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can set traps directly from your inventory at any point in sight. Traps set this way are fully armed on arrival and invisible to lower-rank enemies.
A sprung trap returns to storage if it survives, ready to be reset after a short time.
This is a trap and dimensional storage effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and dimensional storage effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Store
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a living sapling. While you carry it, you regenerate health slowly whenever you stand on soil or grass.

Once per day, you can plant the sapling to raise a great tree in an instant. Allies sheltering beneath it are healed over time and shielded from ranged attacks. The tree withers after a short time and the sapling regrows in storage over 24 hours.
This is a growth and sanctuary effect.
tree.tag: This is a growth and sanctuary effect.

troll.name: Mending Hold
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Monster flesh and hide you loot can be stored and consumed. Eating stored flesh grants regeneration for a short time, closing wounds and healing over time.
Fire damage interrupts the regeneration. Flesh from higher-rank monsters regenerates more.
This is a dimensional storage and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is a dimensional storage and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Kit
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store building stone and lay it out again as a wall, a ramp or a short bridge at a point in sight. Laying stone costs stamina scaled to the size of the structure.
Structures you lay are solid to enemies and can be taken back into storage, intact, while you stand beside them.
This is a construction and earth effect.
trowel.tag: This is a construction and earth effect.

turtle.name: Shell Retreat
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can pull your whole party into your inventory for a brief moment, out of the world. While inside, allies cannot be harmed and slowly recover health.
Everyone returns to the place they left. This effect cannot be used again for a long time and costs a large amount of mana.
This is a dimensional and sanctuary effect.
turtle.tag: This is a dimensional and sanctuary effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Satchel
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store the twilight hour. Releasing it dims the area around you for a long time: enemies see a shorter distance, and you and allies are harder to spot.
Items drawn from storage in dim light cannot be seen by enemies until used.
This is a dimensional storage and dark effect.
twilight.tag: This is a dimensional storage and dark effect.

undeath.name: Grave Locker
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store the corpse of a defeated enemy. Drawing out a stored corpse raises it as an undead servant for a short time, fighting with a portion of its living strength.
You can equip weapons from storage directly onto the servant. It returns to storage as a corpse when the effect ends, and can be raised again after a long time.
This is a dimensional storage and necromancy effect.
undeath.tag: This is a dimensional storage and necromancy effect.

unity.name: Common Store
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When an ally in your party is hit, part of the damage is absorbed by armour stored in your inventory. The armour loses durability instead of the ally losing health.
Stored armour that breaks this way cannot absorb damage again until repaired.
This is a dimensional storage and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a dimensional storage and unity effect.

vast.name: Boundless Hold
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory has no slot limit. Items of the same kind always stack without limit.
You can open a doorway into your inventory and walk inside it. Within it is a quiet, empty space where time passes as normal and no enemy can follow. You leave the way you came in.
This is a dimensional space effect.
vast.tag: This is a dimensional space effect.

vehicle.name: Hitched Wagon
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store and recall a mount, cart or boat at any time, even mid-stride or while wading. Mounts recalled this way arrive already moving at full speed.
Anything stored on a recalled cart or boat counts as part of your inventory while you ride it.
This is a dimensional storage and mount effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a dimensional storage and mount effect.

venom.name: Tainted Stock
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can turn any healing potion in storage into its poisoned counterpart. A poisoned potion can be thrown, breaking on impact and inflicting a stacking poison affliction on every enemy splashed.
Enemies who loot or steal your stored items are poisoned when they touch them.
This is a poison and alchemical effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and alchemical effect.

verdant.name: Rooting Pack
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Vines and creepers grow from your inventory. You can throw a stored length of vine onto enemies near you, rooting them for a short time.
Harvested plants stored in your inventory keep growing, yielding extra materials each day.
This is a dimensional storage and plant effect.
verdant.tag: This is a dimensional storage and plant effect.

vessel.name: Open Cup
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store mana in your inventory. Excess mana you would recover while already full is kept in storage, up to a limit that scales with rank.
You can draw stored mana back into yourself or pour it into an ally within a short distance.
This is a dimensional storage and mana effect.
vessel.tag: This is a dimensional storage and mana effect.

visage.name: Wardrobe of Faces
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store the face and clothing of anyone you have defeated or spoken with. Wearing a stored appearance makes you look and sound like them to everyone who is not of higher rank than you.
Attacking or casting while wearing an appearance ends the disguise.
This is a disguise and illusion effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and illusion effect.

vision.name: Foretold Reach
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you are about to need an item, it is already in your hand. A potion is offered the moment your health falls low, and the right weapon type is offered when you engage an enemy weak to it.
Using an item that has been offered this way takes no time.
This is a dimensional storage and foresight effect.
vision.tag: This is a dimensional storage and foresight effect.

void.name: Swallowing Dark
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can open your inventory toward an incoming spell or projectile and swallow it whole. A swallowed attack can be released later from your hand at a target of your choice.
Only one attack can be held at a time. Swallowing an attack costs mana scaled to its power, and attacks from higher-rank enemies cannot be swallowed.
This is a void and absorption effect.
void.tag: This is a void and absorption effect.

volcano.name: Magma Pocket
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Ore and stone in your inventory melt down over time into a reserve of magma.
You can pour stored magma onto the ground in front of you. It creates a pool that burns enemies standing in it and hardens into impassable stone after a short time.
This is a dimensional storage and fire effect.
volcano.tag: This is a dimensional storage and fire effect.

vortex.name: Pulling Centre
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can open your inventory as a vortex at your feet. For a short time, loose items, loot and enemy projectiles near you are drawn into storage.
Enemies of lower rank caught nearby are pulled toward you. This effect costs mana for as long as it stays open.
This is a dimensional storage and air effect.
vortex.tag: This is a dimensional storage and air effect.

wasp.name: Paper Nest
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
A wasp nest grows in your inventory. While you carry it, a swarm stings any enemy that strikes you in melee, inflicting a poison affliction.
Once per fight, you can throw the nest. It breaks open where it lands and the swarm attacks every enemy nearby until it disperses. The nest regrows over time.
This is a swarm and poison effect.
wasp.tag: This is a swarm and poison effect.

water.name: Flooded Pocket
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store water from any river, lake or sea. Stored water can be released as a crushing wave that knocks enemies back and puts out fires.
Water drawn from a high-rank region carries its region's power, dealing more damage and pushing harder.
This is a water and dimensional storage effect.
water.tag: This is a water and dimensional storage effect.

weave.name: Warp and Weft
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can weave two stored items of the same slot together. The woven item keeps the stronger stats of both and one property from the weaker.
Thread, fibre and cloth in storage can be woven into nets that you throw from storage to entangle enemies.
This is a dimensional storage and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is a dimensional storage and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Starving Store
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Food you carry feeds you while you fight. Each stored ration slowly recovers stamina when you would otherwise run out, and is consumed in doing so.
When your inventory holds no food, your attacks inflict a frost affliction that drains enemies' stamina.
This is a dimensional storage and cold effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a dimensional storage and cold effect.

whale.name: Song of the Deep
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory can hold a living creature you have tamed. A stored creature is safe from harm and does not age or hunger.
You can call a stored creature out at any time with a low, resonant call that briefly stuns smaller enemies around you.
This is a dimensional storage and sound effect.
whale.tag: This is a dimensional storage and sound effect.

wheel.name: Rolling Stock
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Items in your inventory turn over continuously. Each time you use a consumable, the next consumable in rotation is drawn into your hand automatically, ready to use.
Wheeled objects, such as carts, barrels and siege engines, can be rolled out of storage at speed, crushing enemies in their path.
This is a dimensional storage and momentum effect.
wheel.tag: This is a dimensional storage and momentum effect.

whip.name: Lash Draw
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can crack a lash toward a distant object or item and snatch it straight into your inventory, even if an enemy is holding it.
Snatching a weapon out of an enemy's hand disarms it briefly. The lash costs stamina and cannot snatch from higher-rank enemies.
This is a disarming and theft effect.
whip.tag: This is a disarming and theft effect.

wind.name: Bottled Gale
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can store a gust of wind each time you dodge. Up to three gusts can be held.
Releasing a gust launches you a short way in any direction, even mid-leap, or blasts lower-rank enemies away from you with slashing wind.
This is a wind and movement effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and movement effect.

wing.name: Feathered Vault
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
When you would be knocked off your feet, your inventory catches you on a cushion of feathers and you keep your footing.
You can release stored feathers as a flight of blades that seek the nearest enemies, dealing slashing damage. Feathers are gathered from flying monsters you loot.
This is a flight and conjuration effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and conjuration effect.

wolf.name: Pack Provisions
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can equip items from your inventory directly onto your summons and familiars. A summon wearing your gear gains its stats and counts as a member of your pack.
When you use a consumable, every summon in your pack within a short distance gains a portion of its effect.
This is a pack and dimensional storage effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and dimensional storage effect.

wood.name: Living Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Wooden weapons, shields and tools in your inventory slowly mend and grow stronger over time, gaining durability.
You can graft two wooden items together in storage, merging their stats into one item. The weaker item is lost.
This is a growth and crafting effect.
wood.tag: This is a growth and crafting effect.

wrath.name: Grudge Chest
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Damage you take is stored as anger, up to a limit. You can spend the stored anger to empower your next special attack, which deals additional fire damage for each portion spent.
Stored anger fades slowly when you are out of combat.
This is a dimensional storage and wrath effect.
wrath.tag: This is a dimensional storage and wrath effect.

zeal.name: Votive Stores
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
You can dedicate an item in your inventory to a cause or a quest. While the quest is active, the dedicated item grants you increased damage and resistance to fear.
When the quest is completed, the dedicated item gains a permanent enchantment matching the quest. If the quest is abandoned, the item is destroyed.
This is a devotion and enchantment effect.
zeal.tag: This is a devotion and enchantment effect.

ziz.name: Horizon Hold
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Inventory]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Inventory].
Your inventory spans the sky. Items you leave in any region can be retrieved from any other region.
You can draw a vast shadow from storage over an area you can see. Enemies beneath it are slowed and feel the dread of something very large overhead.
This is a dimensional storage and shadow effect.
ziz.tag: This is a dimensional storage and shadow effect.

action.name: Quickdraw Appraisal
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Any item you have identified can be swapped into your hands from your inventory instantly, without interrupting movement or an ability already in progress.
The first attack made with a weapon in the moment it is swapped in is treated as a special attack and cannot be dodged. This can only trigger once every few seconds.
This is a perception and readiness effect.
action.tag: This is a perception and readiness effect.

adept.name: Master's Notation
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a weapon or focus also reveals the technique it was made for. While you wield it, the first special attack or spell you use with it each fight costs no mana or stamina.
Identified gear you have used for a full day counts as practised: it can be equipped regardless of rank or attribute requirements one rank above your own.
This is a perception and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a perception and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Reagent Eye
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification shows what an item would become if rendered down: the reagents, essences of potency and residues it contains.

You can spend mana to transmute an identified item into one of those reagents on the spot. Potions you brew from transmuted reagents gain a minor secondary effect drawn from the original item's enchantment.
This is a perception and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a perception and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Edge
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Traps, concealed blades, poisoned locks and trapped chests are identified on sight within a short distance, without being held.
An identified trap can be claimed. A claimed trap is disarmed and stored in your inventory, and can be set again elsewhere. Set traps do not trigger for you or your allies.
This is a perception and trap effect.
ambush.tag: This is a perception and trap effect.

animate.name: Wakened Gear
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can spend mana to wake an identified weapon or piece of armour. The woken item rises and fights beside you as a temporary summon with a portion of its wielder's stats, using the item's own enchantments.
Only one item can be woken at a time. When the effect ends, the item drops to the ground undamaged.
This is a perception and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a perception and animation effect.

anzu.name: Stormfeather Ledger
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item also reveals its maker's mark and every enchantment ever placed on it, including ones since stripped.
You can tear a stripped enchantment back out of an identified item as a crackling charge. Releasing the charge calls down a lightning strike on a target area. Each item yields its charge once.
This is a perception and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a perception and storm effect.

ape.name: Rough Handling
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Any identified object you can lift can be thrown as an improvised weapon. Thrown objects deal blunt damage scaled to their weight and break on impact, scattering their crafting materials on the ground.
Identifying a trap, lock or mechanism shows the one place to strike it. A single heavy blow there breaks it open without triggering it.
This is a perception and force effect.
ape.tag: This is a perception and force effect.

armour.name: Plate Reading
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Holding a piece of armour for a moment lets you stack it as a layer over what you are already wearing. A layered piece adds a portion of its protection but no other effects. Only one piece can be layered at a time.
Identifying an enemy's worn armour shows its weakest plate. Your attacks against that plate ignore part of its protection.
This is a perception and armour effect.
armour.tag: This is a perception and armour effect.

arsenal.name: Quartermaster's Read
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification compares any held weapon or armour against everything you have equipped and stored, and shows which enemy types it would serve best against.
You can hold up to three identified weapons as a ready set. Switching between ready-set weapons is instant and costs no stamina, and the first hit after each switch deals bonus damage.
This is a perception and arsenal effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a perception and arsenal effect.

aspect.name: Second Face
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item with a former owner reveals the shape of that owner. You can spend mana to take on that appearance for a short time, including their voice and bearing, though not their abilities.
Items you are wearing while disguised in this way report their former owner's name and worth instead of their own when another being identifies them.
This is a perception and disguise effect.
aspect.tag: This is a perception and disguise effect.

avatar.name: Crowned Relic
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items you have identified that are worn on the head, chest or shoulders can be invested. An invested item grows with you, raising its quality one step each time you rank up.
Only one invested item can be held at a time. While wearing it, your aura reads to lower-rank beings as greater than it is.
This is a perception and investiture effect.
avatar.tag: This is a perception and investiture effect.

axe.name: Splitting Edge
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a shield, door, barricade or wooden structure shows its grain. A heavy attack along the grain splits it in a single blow, regardless of its durability.
Identified wooden and bone items can be split in your hands into two lesser items of the same kind, each carrying half of the original's bonuses. Each split item can never be split again.
This is a perception and sundering effect.
axe.tag: This is a perception and sundering effect.

balance.name: Even Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Holding two identified items lets you weigh them against each other. You can move one bonus from the stronger item to the weaker, provided both are the same rarity. This consumes a portion of mana and can be done once per item.
Merchants who see you weigh their goods cannot set prices above an item's true worth.
This is a perception and equilibrium effect.
balance.tag: This is a perception and equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Echo Sounding
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can identify items without holding them by clicking your tongue. Every item within a short radius is identified at once, including items behind walls, buried in rubble or inside closed containers.
Containers identified this way show whether they are trapped or mimics before you open them.
This is a perception and echolocation effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and echolocation effect.

battlefield.name: Spoils of the Field
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
During combat, every item carried or wielded by an enemy in sight is identified automatically, including consumables they are about to use.
An enemy whose potion or scroll you have identified cannot use it while you can see them. Weapons you have identified on an enemy deal reduced damage to you.
This is a perception and battlefield effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a perception and battlefield effect.

bear.name: Den Hoard
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified food, honey and meat can be eaten from your hand in combat. Each restores a portion of health and stamina, scaled to the item's worth, and grants brief resistance to being knocked down.
Monster dens, hives and hoards are identified from outside, including their contents and how many creatures guard them.
This is a perception and sustenance effect.
bear.tag: This is a perception and sustenance effect.

bee.name: Hive Inventory
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying a crafting material shows every other piece of the same material within the explored part of the region. Your summons and familiars will gather any of it they pass and carry it back to you.
Identified flowers, honey and wax yield twice their normal crafting value when used in potions and salves.
This is a perception and gathering effect.
bee.tag: This is a perception and gathering effect.

behemoth.name: Unbreakable Heft
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified weapons and armour can be anchored. An anchored item cannot be broken, disarmed, stolen or knocked from your hands, and does not lose durability.
Heavy weapons you have anchored can be wielded without their usual stamina penalty, and their attacks knock back lower-rank enemies.
Up to two items can be anchored at once.
This is a perception and weight effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a perception and weight effect.

bird.name: Feather Weight
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified items can be made weightless for as long as you carry them. Weightless armour imposes no movement penalty and weightless weapons attack faster.
A weightless item thrown into the air hangs there for a short time, and can be recalled to your hand from anywhere in sight.
Only a limited number of items can be weightless at once, scaling with rank.
This is a perception and air effect.
bird.tag: This is a perception and air effect.

blight.name: Creeping Assay
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can spend mana to rot an identified item held by an enemy. The item loses durability over time and its bonuses weaken until it breaks or is dropped.
Identifying a plant, crop or harvested material shows whether it is diseased. Diseased materials can be brewed into poisons that inflict a stacking rot affliction.
This is a perception and blight effect.
blight.tag: This is a perception and blight effect.

blood.name: Blood Signature
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a bloodied item reveals whose blood it carries. That being is marked for a long time: you can sense their direction, and your attacks against them inflict a bleed affliction.
You can bind an identified weapon with your own blood, costing a portion of health. A blood-bound weapon cannot be disarmed or stolen and returns to your hand when thrown.
This is a perception and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a perception and blood effect.

bone.name: Marrow Count
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying bones or a skeleton reveals the creature they came from, its rank, and the cause of its death.

You can break identified bones in your hand to draw out the marrow. Marrow can be socketed into gear like a lesser awakening stone, granting a small effect drawn from the creature's nature. Marrow fades after several days.
This is a perception and death effect.
bone.tag: This is a perception and death effect.

boundary.name: Warded Threshold
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a door, gate, lock or ward reveals what it keeps out and how. You can rewrite an identified lock or ward so that it admits you and your party alone.
You can spend mana to set an identified item down as a boundary marker. Enemies cannot pass between two of your markers without breaking one. Only two markers can exist at a time.
This is a perception and boundary effect.
boundary.tag: This is a perception and boundary effect.

bounty.name: Generous Measure
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification shows the true worth of an item to every merchant and Society contract you have encountered, and which of them will pay the most.

Consumables you identify have a chance to be doubled. Food, potions and crafting stock identified this way can be shared with your party at no loss, splitting the effect between everyone who receives a share.
This is a perception and abundance effect.
bounty.tag: This is a perception and abundance effect.

bow.name: True Flight
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an arrow, bolt or thrown weapon in flight shows where it will land. You can mark that point; projectiles aimed at you that would land on a marked point miss instead.
Ammunition you have identified flies further, and recovers itself into your quiver after the fight if it did not break.
This is a perception and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a perception and ranged effect.

brush.name: Undergrowth Lore
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying any plant reveals what can be made from it. You can push mana into a seed or cutting you hold to make it erupt into a thicket on the ground ahead. The thicket blocks movement and line of sight and can be passed through by you and your allies.
Thickets wither after a short time and leave behind one harvestable plant of the same kind.
This is a perception and growth effect.
brush.tag: This is a perception and growth effect.

cage.name: Lockwright
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying a lock, cell, trap or binding shows how it is made. You can open any identified lock of your rank or lower by touching it, and seal any identified door or container so only you can open it.
Identified shackles and restraint items can be thrown at an enemy to bind them in place. Stronger enemies break free sooner.
This is a perception and binding effect.
cage.tag: This is a perception and binding effect.

cat.name: Light-Fingered
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item carried by another being, including an enemy, also tells you whether you could take it unnoticed. You can lift an identified unequipped item from an enemy's belt or pack in melee range without breaking stealth.
Lifting an item from a creature that has not noticed you costs no time and does not provoke an attack.
This is a perception and theft effect.
cat.tag: This is a perception and theft effect.

cataclysm.name: Breaking Point
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification reveals the flaw in any object, structure or worn armour, including on enemies.
Striking an identified flaw shatters the item. Shattered enemy armour is destroyed for the rest of the encounter, and shattered walls, doors and barricades cannot be repaired.
You can expend a held item to shatter it deliberately, releasing a shockwave of force damage scaled to the item's quality.
This is a perception and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a perception and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Herd Reckoning
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a pack, cart, saddlebag or mount's gear shows its capacity and load. Your inventory gains a portion of extra capacity for every mount or beast of burden in your party.
Identified heavy items, including armour and two-handed weapons, carry no stamina cost while you are walking rather than running.
This is a perception and endurance effect.
cattle.tag: This is a perception and endurance effect.

chain.name: Linked Knowledge
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can link two identified items. Whatever happens to one happens to the other: a broken link breaks both, a link carried by an enemy pulls them toward the other item, and a linked weapon strikes once more at the target of its partner.
A link holds for a short time, or until either item leaves your sight.
This is a perception and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a perception and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Loaded Dice
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item shows the full range its random properties could have rolled, and where it actually landed.

Once per day you can reroll one random property on an identified item. The new roll can land higher or lower than the old one, but never at the lowest possible value. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a perception and chance effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a perception and chance effect.

charlatan.name: Counterfeiter's Touch
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can make an identified item read falsely to every other identification effect, choosing the name, worth and function it appears to have.
Items you have disguised this way sell for the worth they appear to have, and cannot be detected as stolen.
You can spend mana to create a short-lived illusory copy of an identified item, which an enemy will try to take or use in place of the real one.
This is a perception and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a perception and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Nest Egg
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Once per day you can sit on an identified item of common rarity until it hatches into a lesser copy of itself. The copy has the same name and function but half the worth and no bonuses.
Eggs of any kind are fully identified, including what will hatch from them and whether it can be raised as a familiar.
This is a perception and nurturing effect.
chicken.tag: This is a perception and nurturing effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Kit
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification reveals which enchantments on an item could be lifted and grafted onto another item of a different kind.

You can graft one enchantment from an identified item onto a piece of your own gear, destroying the source. A grafted item can hold one grafted enchantment alongside its own, and gains a random third trait drawn from the creature that dropped the source item.
This is a perception and grafting effect.
chimera.tag: This is a perception and grafting effect.

claw.name: Talon Grip
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an enemy's weapon shows how it is held. Your melee attacks against an enemy carrying an identified weapon can rip it free, disarming them. A disarmed weapon falls to the ground near you.
Weapons you take this way are already identified and can be used immediately by you or your summons.
This is a perception and disarming effect.
claw.tag: This is a perception and disarming effect.

cloth.name: Weaver's Eye
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying cloth, leather or a garment lets you unpick it into thread in your hands. Thread from an enchanted garment carries one of its bonuses, and can be stitched into another garment to add that bonus.
A garment can carry only one stitched bonus. Unpicking destroys the original garment.
This is a perception and crafting effect.
