cloth.tag: This is a perception and crafting effect.

cloud.name: Mist Appraisal
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can breathe on an identified potion, poison or liquid to turn it into a mist. The mist fills a small area and affects everything in it, instead of a single drinker.
Gases, smokes and clouds are identified on sight, including whether they are poisonous, flammable or magical.
This is a perception and vapour effect.
cloud.tag: This is a perception and vapour effect.

cold.name: Cold Storage
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified food, potions and creature parts held in your hands for a moment are chilled. Chilled items do not spoil, and chilled potions and salves last longer when used.
An identified weapon chilled the same way inflicts a cold affliction on its next several hits, slowing the target.
This is a perception and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a perception and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Growth
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identified armour and shields can be left submerged in water overnight to grow a living coral crust. The crust adds protection and reflects a portion of melee damage back at attackers. It slowly wears away in dry air.
Pearls, shells and coral are identified with their full crafting value, and coral can be planted to grow more over several days.
This is a perception and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a perception and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Rot
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can corrupt an identified item. A corrupted item gains a powerful random bonus and a drawback that cannot be removed. Corruption shows both before you commit.
Items another being has corrupted are identified in full, including the hidden drawback and the one who corrupted them.
An item can be corrupted only once.
This is a perception and corruption effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a perception and corruption effect.

crocodile.name: Lying in Wait
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can leave an identified item on the ground as bait. Enemies that notice it are drawn toward it, and the first enemy to reach it is seized: it is rooted in place and takes damage over time until it breaks free.
Only one bait item can be set at a time. The item is returned to you when the trap springs.
This is a perception and lure effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a perception and lure effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Sight
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a gem, crystal or awakening stone reveals its internal structure, including any flaw. You can cut along a flaw to split a single awakening stone into two lesser stones of the same kind.
Gems you have identified can be set into gear as focusing crystals, causing spells cast through that gear to strike a second, nearby target at reduced effect.
This is a perception and crystal effect.
crystal.tag: This is a perception and crystal effect.

cycle.name: Second Season
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Consumed potions, spent scrolls and broken items you identified before using them leave behind a husk in your inventory.
After 24 hours, a husk renews into the item it was, at one quality step lower. An item renewed from a husk cannot leave a husk again.
This is a perception and renewal effect.
cycle.tag: This is a perception and renewal effect.

dance.name: Footwork Study
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an enemy's weapon shows the rhythm of its attacks. While you are wearing no heavy armour, the first attack from that weapon in each exchange can be stepped around automatically.
Dodging an attack this way grants a stack of momentum. At several stacks, your next special attack strikes twice.
This is a perception and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is a perception and movement effect.

dark.name: Shadow Pocket
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can sink an identified item into your own shadow. Items in your shadow cannot be seen, stolen or identified by anyone else, and can be drawn out instantly, even while you are disarmed or bound.
In darkness, you can draw an item out of any shadow within a short range of you instead of your own.
Only a few items can rest in your shadow at once.
This is a perception and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a perception and darkness effect.

dawn.name: First Light Reading
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Hidden, invisible and sealed items within a short distance glow faintly and can be identified without being held.

Holding an identified item up to light reveals any secret compartment, concealed enchantment or illusion on it, and dispels the illusion. Cursed items you identify this way can have the curse burned away at the cost of a portion of your mana.
This is a perception and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is a perception and light effect.

death.name: Last Owner
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item taken from the dead reveals how its owner died and where. Items from the dead can be laid on a grave or corpse to call up the owner's spirit for a short time. The spirit answers a single question truthfully and can name its killer.
An item can only be used to call its owner once.
This is a perception and spirit effect.
death.tag: This is a perception and spirit effect.

deep.name: Fathom Weight
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified items can be made crushingly heavy for a moment. A heavy item thrown or dropped onto an enemy knocks them down and pins them under it until they spend stamina to lift it free.
Items lost in water, sunken wrecks and drowned containers are identified and marked on the map, however deep they lie.
This is a perception and pressure effect.
deep.tag: This is a perception and pressure effect.

deer.name: Startle Sense
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Any identified item you are carrying warns you when someone tries to take it or when a trap it could trigger is close. You flinch clear by a short dash the instant the warning comes.
This dash costs no stamina and cannot happen more than once every few seconds.
This is a perception and alarm effect.
deer.tag: This is a perception and alarm effect.

desolate.name: Salted Earth
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
An identified item can be stripped bare. Stripping removes every enchantment, curse and property, leaving a plain item and a measure of ash.
Ash scattered on the ground creates a dead zone for a short time. Within it, enemy boons expire, enemy healing has no effect and nothing can be summoned.
This is a perception and desolation effect.
desolate.tag: This is a perception and desolation effect.

dimension.name: Folded Contents
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a bag, chest, quiver or container reveals the space inside it. You can fold that space, making the container hold far more than its size while weighing the same.

Containers that are already dimensional storage, including enemy spatial pouches, are identified in full. You can reach into an identified enemy's dimensional storage while they are stunned and take one item.
This is a perception and dimensional effect.
dimension.tag: This is a perception and dimensional effect.

discord.name: Off-Key
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can strike a dissonant note into an identified enchanted item. For a short time, its bonuses invert: a bonus to damage becomes a penalty, a resistance becomes a weakness. The effect lasts longer on items held by lower-rank beings.
Each item can be made dissonant only once per fight.
This is a perception and dissonance effect.
discord.tag: This is a perception and dissonance effect.

discordant.name: Jarring Note
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an enemy's set of gear reveals which pieces work together and which bonuses they share.

You can spend mana to put an identified enemy's gear out of tune. For a short time, its set bonuses switch off and its enchantments work against each other, inflicting a small amount of damage on the wearer whenever one triggers.
This is a perception and discord effect.
discordant.tag: This is a perception and discord effect.

dog.name: Fetch
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Once an item has been identified, you can always sense its direction and distance, even if it is lost, stolen or traded away.
Your summons and familiars can be sent to fetch a remembered item. They track it, take it from whoever holds it if they can, and bring it back to you.
You can remember a limited number of items at once, scaling with rank.
This is a perception and tracking effect.
dog.tag: This is a perception and tracking effect.

doom.name: Final Appraisal
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

An identified item can be condemned. A condemned item is destroyed after a short delay, yielding monster cores whose rank matches the item's quality. Condemnation cannot be undone once the delay ends.
Identification also reveals any curse, hidden enchantment or doom-mark the item carries, and who placed it.
This is a perception and disintegration effect.
doom.tag: This is a perception and disintegration effect.

doppelganger.name: Twin Make
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can spend mana to create a copy of an identified item. The copy has the original's appearance, stats and enchantments, but lasts only until the next time you rest.
Only one copy can exist at a time. A copy cannot be sold, crafted with or copied again. Copied consumables vanish when used without taking effect a second time.
This is a perception and duplication effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a perception and duplication effect.

dragon.name: Hoard Sense
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items you have identified are added to your hoard. You can sense the direction of any hoard item you have lost, dropped or had stolen, at any distance within the same region.
For every rare or better item you carry in your inventory, you gain a small amount of fire resistance and maximum health.
This is a perception and hoard effect.
dragon.tag: This is a perception and hoard effect.

duck.name: Unbothered Hands
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified curses on items you are holding do not take hold of you. You can still use a cursed item's benefits, and you can remove an identified item that has bound itself to you.
Afflictions carried by items, including poisoned blades and plagued food, are shown on identification and do not affect you when you handle them.
This is a perception and warding effect.
duck.tag: This is a perception and warding effect.

dust.name: Grey Dust
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can grind an identified item of no further use into dust. Its dust holds a fraction of its worth and can be scattered in a small area. Scattered dust reveals invisible and hidden beings, footprints and concealed doors within it.
Dust from magical items also suppresses enemy magic within the cloud for a moment.
This is a perception and earth effect.
dust.tag: This is a perception and earth effect.

earth.name: Bedrock Reading
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Touching the ground lets you identify every ore vein, buried item and stone node beneath you within a moderate range.
You can draw an identified buried item or chunk of ore straight up through the earth and into your hand, costing mana scaled to its depth and rank.
This is a perception and earth effect.
earth.tag: This is a perception and earth effect.

echo.name: Retold Tale
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a weapon reveals the last ability it was used with. Once per fight you can use that ability through the weapon yourself, at reduced strength, paying its normal cost.
Identifying a spent scroll, empty potion or used consumable lets you recover one final, weaker use from it.
This is a perception and repetition effect.
echo.tag: This is a perception and repetition effect.

eclipse.name: Corona Read
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
An identified item can be shadowed. A shadowed item cannot be seen, identified or detected by anyone but you, including on your person.
A weapon you have shadowed is invisible to enemies. Attacks with it cannot be parried, and the first hit against an enemy that has not seen it applies a brief blind.
This is a perception and concealment effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a perception and concealment effect.

edifice.name: Mason's Eye
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification extends to buildings, walls, bridges and terrain features: their material, condition and load-bearing points.

You can spend crafting materials you have identified to raise a short section of wall, a step or a barricade at a point you can see. Structures you raise last until destroyed or until you leave the area.
This is a perception and construction effect.
edifice.tag: This is a perception and construction effect.

effigy.name: Stand-In Token
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can bind an identified item to yourself as an effigy. Once per day, when you would take a killing blow, the effigy takes it instead and is destroyed, leaving you at a small portion of health. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
Afflictions placed on you can be moved onto the effigy for a cost of mana, damaging the item's durability by an amount based on the affliction's strength.
This is a perception and substitution effect.
effigy.tag: This is a perception and substitution effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Infusion
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item shows which element it is most attuned to. You can spend mana to infuse an identified weapon with that element for a long time, adding damage of that type and an elemental affliction to its hits.
Elemental cores, crystals and essences of raw elements are identified with the exact element and strength they contain.
This is a perception and elemental effect.
elemental.tag: This is a perception and elemental effect.

elixir.name: Perfect Measure
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a potion shows its full recipe, and you can brew it again from memory if you have the reagents. Potions you brew from a recipe you identified this way are of higher quality.
You can combine two identified potions in your hands into one draught that carries both effects. The combined draught takes longer to drink.
This is a perception and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a perception and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Lent Edge
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can spend mana to overcharge an identified item for a short time. An overcharged weapon deals significantly increased damage and its enchantments trigger with greater strength; overcharged armour grants significantly increased resistance.
An item loses durability while overcharged. You can overcharge an ally's identified item by touching it.
This is a perception and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is a perception and empowerment effect.

eye.name: All-Seeing Appraisal
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify items by looking at them rather than holding them, at any distance you can see. This includes items carried and worn by enemies.
Enemy gear identified this way shows its bonuses above them in combat. Your attacks deal additional damage to an enemy whose resistances come from identified gear.
This is a perception effect.

feast.name: Banquet Sense
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identified food and drink can be laid out as a meal for your party out of combat. Everyone who eats gains a boon for a long time, drawn from the qualities of the food served. Finer food grants a stronger boon.
Identifying a meal shows exactly which boon it will give before it is served.
This is a perception and feasting effect.
feast.tag: This is a perception and feasting effect.

feeble.name: Sapped Strength
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Touching an identified item an enemy is wearing or wielding drains its bonuses into you for a short time. The enemy loses those bonuses while you hold them.
Draining an item costs mana. It cannot be used on the same enemy's gear again until they have recovered.
This is a perception and draining effect.
feeble.tag: This is a perception and draining effect.

fertile.name: Seeded Stock
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identified plant, wood, fibre and creature materials can be planted. A planted material grows into a harvestable node over the course of a day, yielding more of the same material at one quality step higher.
Only a few planted nodes can exist at a time. Nodes planted in an astral realm grow faster.
This is a perception and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a perception and growth effect.

fey.name: True Name
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identification reveals an item's true name, which may differ from the name it is sold under. Speaking an item's true name while holding it binds the item to you: it cannot be used against you, by anyone.
You can bargain with a bound item. Once per day, you can trade away a portion of its stats for the rest of the day to grant it a single new effect of your choosing from among its enchantment family.
This is a perception and binding effect.
fey.tag: This is a perception and binding effect.

fire.name: Kindling Lore
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item tells you how it burns. You can set an identified item alight in your hand and throw it; it bursts into flame on impact, inflicting fire damage and a burn affliction scaled to its worth.
Burning an enchanted item releases its magic in the blast, adding one of its bonuses as a further effect.
The item is destroyed.
This is a perception and fire effect.
fire.tag: This is a perception and fire effect.

firebird.name: Kindled Relic
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
When an identified item breaks, it bursts into flame instead of being lost. The flames inflict fire damage on nearby enemies.
The ashes remain in your inventory. After 24 hours, they rekindle into the item, fully repaired, with its fire-related enchantments strengthened. An item can rekindle in this way once per rank.
This is a perception and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is a perception and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Shoal Count
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying one item of a set reveals every other item of that set, with each one marked on the map once you have seen it. Wearing several pieces of a set grants an additional bonus for each piece worn, even when the set is incomplete.
Fishing spots and the catch available in them are identified on sight.
This is a perception and gathering effect.
fish.tag: This is a perception and gathering effect.

flea.name: Spring Loaded
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Any identified item you are touching can be sent leaping back to your hand from where it lies, crossing gaps and walls in a single bound. Thrown weapons leap back automatically after striking.
You can also push off an identified item lying on the ground to launch yourself a long way in its direction.
This is a perception and movement effect.
flea.tag: This is a perception and movement effect.

flesh.name: Living Graft
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified creature parts, including claws, scales and hides, can be grafted onto your body for a long time at a cost of health. A graft grants a minor effect drawn from the creature it came from.
You can carry only a few grafts at once. Removing a graft returns the lost health over time.
This is a perception and flesh effect.
flesh.tag: This is a perception and flesh effect.

foot.name: Long Road Knowledge
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified footwear grants you the tread of whoever wore it most. You leave no tracks, move faster on the terrain it was made for, and ignore slowing ground of that kind.
Identifying a track, path or footprint shows who made it, how long ago, and which way they went.
This is a perception and travel effect.
foot.tag: This is a perception and travel effect.

force.name: Weight of Intent
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Any identified item can be thrown as a weapon. Thrown items deal force damage based on their weight and quality, and knock the target back.
You can recall a thrown item to your hand by reaching for it through your inventory, as long as it is within a short distance. Items broken by being thrown are refunded as crafting material.
This is a perception and force effect.
force.tag: This is a perception and force effect.

forge.name: Smith's Reading
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification shows the exact crafting recipe, materials and steps that made an item, adding the recipe to your crafting list if you have the skill to use it.
Items you craft from a recipe learned this way are made at one quality step higher than your skill would normally allow, and carry your maker's mark.
This is a perception and crafting effect.
forge.tag: This is a perception and crafting effect.

fork.name: Branching Use
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item reveals a second use it was never designed for. A sword becomes a lever, a shield a sled, a potion a fuel. Each identified item gains a single alternate function that you can use from your hotbar.
An item's alternate function is fixed once revealed.
This is a perception and improvisation effect.
fork.tag: This is a perception and improvisation effect.

fortress.name: Gatehouse
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can plant an identified shield, armour piece or heavy item on the ground as a bulwark. The bulwark blocks projectiles and movement, and has health equal to the item's durability.
While you stand behind your own bulwark, you take reduced damage from all sources. Only one bulwark can stand at a time; picking it up returns the item with any durability it lost.
This is a perception and fortification effect.
fortress.tag: This is a perception and fortification effect.

fox.name: Swapped Goods
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can make an identified item look like any other item you have identified, to anyone but you. A merchant will pay the disguised item's worth; an enemy will reach for the wrong weapon.
The disguise breaks when the item is used or after a long time. A being of higher rank sees through it immediately.
This is a perception and illusion effect.
fox.tag: This is a perception and illusion effect.

frog.name: Sprung Charge
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can store an identified throwing item, bomb or potion under your tongue. It can be spat out at an enemy at long range with no wind-up, carrying its full effect.
Only one item can be held this way. Spitting it out does not interrupt any ability you are using.
This is a perception and projectile effect.
frog.tag: This is a perception and projectile effect.

fungus.name: Spore Print
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can seed spores into an identified item. Anyone else who carries a seeded item is tracked on your map, and you can trigger the spores at will to burst from it, inflicting a choking affliction on the carrier and anyone near them.
Seeded items show nothing unusual to other identification.
This is a perception and spore effect.
fungus.tag: This is a perception and spore effect.

garuda.name: Amrita Measure
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying a poisoned or venomous item reveals the poison's source and its cure. Holding an identified antidote or cleansing item lets you cleanse a poison from yourself or an ally without consuming it, once per item per day.
Weapons you have identified deal increased damage to serpents, nagas and other poisonous creatures.
This is a perception and purification effect.
garuda.tag: This is a perception and purification effect.

gate.name: Keyhole Read
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a key reveals the lock it opens, anywhere in the world, and marks that lock on your map.
You can spend mana to turn an identified door, frame or archway into one end of a portal. The other end opens at the last door you marked this way. Only one pair of ends can exist at a time.
This is a perception and portal effect.
gate.tag: This is a perception and portal effect.

gathering.name: Gathered Set
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can call every identified loose item within a moderate range to you at once. Items fly to your feet; items held by enemies of lower rank are pulled from their grip.
Calling items costs mana for each item moved. Items fixed in place, worn, or held by beings of equal or higher rank do not move.
This is a perception and space effect.
gathering.tag: This is a perception and space effect.

glass.name: Clear Pane
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Holding an identified lens, mirror or pane of glass lets you see through walls and closed doors within a short range while you look through it.
You can shatter an identified glass item into a burst of shards that inflict a bleed affliction on enemies near it. Enchanted glass shatters with its enchantment added to the burst.
This is a perception and glass effect.
glass.tag: This is a perception and glass effect.

glimeron.name: Faceted Sight
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a gem, crystal or lens shows how it would split light and magic passed through it.
You can set an identified gem into the air for a short time. Spells and projectiles you send through it split into several weaker copies, each taking on one of the gem's enchantments.
Only one gem can be set at a time.
This is a perception and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a perception and refraction effect.

goat.name: Mountain Pack
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying climbing gear, rope or a staff marks every climbable surface around you on the map. While holding an identified staff or rope, you can scale steep slopes and cliffs that are normally impassable.
Identified items cannot be knocked out of your hands while you are standing on high ground.
This is a perception and climbing effect.
goat.tag: This is a perception and climbing effect.

gorgon.name: Petrified Inventory
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can turn an identified item to stone. A petrified item cannot decay, spoil, break or be stolen, and keeps any effect it had at the moment it was turned.
Turning a petrified weapon back to normal releases its stored stillness: the next enemy it strikes is petrified for a brief time. Higher-rank enemies are slowed instead.
This is a perception and petrification effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a perception and petrification effect.

griffin.name: High Claim
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items lying in the open can be identified from any height or distance you can see them from.
You can claim an identified item from a distance. A claimed item is pulled to your hand as long as nothing holds it, including from ledges, across water and from beneath enemies.
This is a perception and claiming effect.
griffin.tag: This is a perception and claiming effect.

growth.name: Grown Gear
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified wooden or living items you have used for a long time slowly grow. Each time one grows, it gains a bonus drawn from what you used it to do, up to a limit set by its rarity.
Identifying an item shows how close it is to growing again.
This is a perception and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a perception and growth effect.

guardian.name: Shieldbearer's Read
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying the gear of an ally shows which of their pieces is weakest against the enemies nearby.
You can lend an ally the defensive stats of one identified piece of your own armour for a short time, as an aura around them. While the loan is active, you lose that piece's stats.
This is a perception and protection effect.
guardian.tag: This is a perception and protection effect.

hair.name: Strand Trace
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying hair, fur or feathers reveals the being they came from. You can tie an identified strand around a weapon; the weapon deals additional damage to that being and anything of its kind.
A single strand can bind a weapon to a quarry for a long time. Only one strand can be tied to a weapon at once.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
hair.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Sense
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified metal items can be hammered back into shape with any blunt weapon. A few strikes restores a portion of an item's durability, even in the middle of a fight.
Identifying an item damaged in combat shows exactly where it is weakest. Your blows against an enemy's damaged gear destroy it outright.
This is a perception and smithing effect.
hammer.tag: This is a perception and smithing effect.

hand.name: Maker's Grip
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a crafted item reveals how it was made. You can craft that item yourself without a recipe if you have the materials, regardless of whether you have trained the crafting skill involved.
Items you craft this way are always identified at the moment of completion and cannot fail.
This is a perception and crafting effect.
hand.tag: This is a perception and crafting effect.

harmonic.name: Sympathetic Tone
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Striking an identified item rings out its tone. Every other item of the same material within a moderate range rings with it, revealing its position and shaking it. Enemies holding a ringing weapon have their attacks slowed for a short time.
Enchantments that resonate with each other are identified as harmonies, and wearing gear in harmony grants a small bonus to all resistances.
This is a perception and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a perception and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Snatching Talon
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

When you hit an enemy carrying an item you have identified, you can spend stamina to snatch it. Snatched consumables and loose items go straight into your inventory; snatched weapons are knocked away out of their reach.
An enemy can be snatched from only once per encounter.
This is a perception and theft effect.
harpy.tag: This is a perception and theft effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a crafting node shows how much it will yield and at what quality before it is harvested.

Nodes you harvest after identifying them yield an extra share. When you identify an item crafted from harvested material, you see which node the material came from, and that node is marked on your map.
This is a perception and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a perception and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Saddle Knowing
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying a saddle, harness or bridle reveals every beast it could be fitted to. You can fit an identified saddle to any beast or summon of your rank or lower that is willing or subdued, and ride it as a mount.
Mounts you ride in an identified saddle do not tire and are not frightened by combat.
This is a perception and mounting effect.
heidel.tag: This is a perception and mounting effect.

hook.name: Barbed Inventory
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can throw a hook at any identified item within a moderate range, including items carried by enemies. The hook catches the item and drags it back to you, pulling the carrier along with it if they do not let go.
Throwing the hook costs stamina. Beings of higher rank are not moved.
This is a perception and pulling effect.
hook.tag: This is a perception and pulling effect.

horse.name: Gallop Fitting
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
While you are moving at speed, identified items can be swapped in and out of your hands and equipment slots instantly, without stopping.
The first attack you make with a weapon you have just swapped to during a charge deals additional damage and knocks the target back.
This is a perception and swiftness effect.
horse.tag: This is a perception and swiftness effect.

hunger.name: Hungry Appraisal
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can devour an identified item. Eating it destroys it and restores health, mana and stamina in proportion to its worth.
Devouring an enchanted item also grants one of its bonuses to you for a short time. Devouring a monster core grants a portion of its experience directly.
This is a perception and consumption effect.
hunger.tag: This is a perception and consumption effect.

hunt.name: Quarry's Kit
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item an enemy dropped, broke or left behind marks that enemy as your quarry. You can see its trail on the map, and it cannot hide from your aura sense.
Your attacks against a quarry ignore a portion of its resistances. Only one quarry can be marked at a time.
This is a perception and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a perception and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Grip
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
When an identified weapon breaks in your hands, it splits into two lesser copies instead of being destroyed. Each copy has a portion of the original's damage and one of its enchantments.
You can hold both copies at once, attacking with each in turn. Copies cannot split again.
This is a perception and regrowth effect.
hydra.tag: This is a perception and regrowth effect.

ice.name: Frost Tempering
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can form a temporary copy of any identified weapon or shield out of ice. The copy has the original's base damage or protection and none of its bonuses, and inflicts a freezing affliction.
Ice copies melt after a short time or when broken. Only one ice copy can exist at a time.
This is a perception and conjuration effect.
ice.tag: This is a perception and conjuration effect.

immortal.name: Undying Heirloom
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items you have identified cannot be permanently destroyed. A destroyed identified item returns to your inventory after a full day, at the condition it was in before it broke.
Identification shows the full history of an item, including every person who has owned it and how each of them died.
This is a perception and permanence effect.
immortal.tag: This is a perception and permanence effect.

iron.name: Cold Iron Truth
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identified iron and steel items strip illusions and disguises from any being they touch. Striking a shapeshifted, disguised or invisible enemy with an identified iron weapon forces it into its true form for a short time.
Fey, spirits and illusion-based beings are identified on sight when you are carrying iron.
This is a perception and truth effect.
iron.tag: This is a perception and truth effect.

juggernaut.name: Rolling Load
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
The weight of identified items you carry adds to your momentum. While moving, you gain damage resistance based on the total weight of your equipped gear.
Colliding with an enemy during a movement ability deals damage based on that weight. Heavy armour you have identified does not reduce your movement speed.
This is a perception and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a perception and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Ledger of Hands
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification shows the harm an item has done and to whom. A weapon that has been used to injure you is marked as owing you.
When you hit an enemy with a weapon that owes you, or hit an enemy wielding one, the debt is collected as bonus damage equal to a portion of the harm it did to you. A debt is settled once collected.
This is a perception and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is a perception and retribution effect.

knife.name: Concealed Edge
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified small weapons can be hidden on your person so that they cannot be found by searches, identification or disarming effects.

Drawing a hidden weapon for an attack against an enemy who did not know it existed guarantees a critical hit. A weapon cannot be hidden again until it has been out of sight of enemies for a short time.
This is a perception and concealment effect.
knife.tag: This is a perception and concealment effect.

knowledge.name: Marginalia
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a book, scroll or skill book shows everything it contains before you read it, including what a skill book will teach and at what level.
You can copy an identified skill book or scroll onto blank paper. The copy works once and is lost when used. Copying a skill book takes a long time and cannot be done in combat.
This is a perception and knowledge effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a perception and knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify items underwater, buried or at the bottom of pits, at a distance, as long as you can sense them.
An identified item you cannot reach can be pulled to you by an unseen tentacle. You can spend mana to have the tentacle pull an enemy holding an identified item toward you instead.
This is a perception and reach effect.
kraken.tag: This is a perception and reach effect.

leviathan.name: Sounding Depth
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification reveals everything sunk, lost or hidden in a body of water you are standing in or beside, and marks it on your map.
Wading while carrying an identified item costs no stamina, and an identified item recovered from the depths keeps you steady and unhindered while you stand in water.
This is a perception and depth effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a perception and depth effect.

life.name: Vital Count
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a living being's bandages, salves or healing items shows its exact health and any wounds it is carrying.
You can spend an identified healing item on an ally without touching them, within a short range. The healing is stronger when used on an ally whose wounds you have identified.
This is a perception and healing effect.
life.tag: This is a perception and healing effect.

light.name: Illuminated Truth
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Holding an identified item up to the light reveals hidden writing, enchantments and runes on it, including ones placed to stay secret from identification.
You can make an identified item shine. While it shines, it lights the area around you, reveals invisible beings near it, and inflicts a brief blinding effect on enemies who look directly at it.
This is a perception and light effect.
light.tag: This is a perception and light effect.

lightning.name: Charged Grip
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can charge an identified metal item with lightning. A charged item arcs to the nearest enemy when it is thrown, struck or dropped, inflicting lightning damage and a brief stun.
An enemy who picks up or blocks with a charged item takes the discharge directly. An item stays charged until it discharges or for a short time.
This is a perception and lightning effect.
lightning.tag: This is a perception and lightning effect.

lizard.name: Shed Skin
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
When an enemy grabs, binds or seizes you, you can leave an identified item of clothing or armour behind in their grip and slip free. The item can be recovered later.
Identifying an item shows whether it can be shed in this way. Shedding an item cannot be done again until you have rested.
This is a perception and escape effect.
lizard.tag: This is a perception and escape effect.

locust.name: Swarm Strip
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can loose a swarm onto an identified item an enemy is carrying. The swarm devours leather, cloth, wood and food, stripping those items away and inflicting a stacking affliction on their carrier while it feeds.
Metal and stone items are not affected. The swarm disperses when nothing it can eat remains.
This is a perception and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is a perception and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can cleanse an identified item, removing any curse, corruption or taint while keeping every other enchantment. Cleansing costs mana based on the strength of what is removed.
A cleansed item carries a lotus mark. While you wear an item with a lotus mark, the first affliction applied to you in each encounter has no effect.
This is a perception and purification effect.
lotus.tag: This is a perception and purification effect.

lurker.name: Watcher's Cache
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can leave an identified item behind as a watcher. While it remains where you left it, you can see and hear everything around it as though you were standing there.
Only one item can act as a watcher at a time. Moving or picking it up breaks the effect, and you know who did it.
This is a perception and scrying effect.
lurker.tag: This is a perception and scrying effect.

magic.name: Arcane Grammar
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a magic item also reveals the enchantments woven into it, listed one by one.

You can spend mana to unpick one enchantment from an identified item and hold it for a short time. While held, it can be set into another item of equal or lower quality. If the time runs out, the enchantment is lost.
This is a perception and enchantment effect.
magic.tag: This is a perception and enchantment effect.

malign.name: Grudge Ledger
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can lace an identified item with a delayed curse before selling, trading or dropping it. The next creature to equip it suffers a stacking affliction that reduces its healing received until it removes the item.
Curses you place cannot be identified by other people, and you always know where a cursed item of yours is.
This is a curse and tracking effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and tracking effect.

manatee.name: Drift Reckoning
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Any identified item can be set adrift. It sinks out of sight, drifts slowly toward the nearest settlement you have visited, and arrives in that settlement's storehouse for you to collect after a long delay.
Items lost in water, including your own dropped gear, are always shown on the map and can be identified from a distance.
This is a water and transport effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and transport effect.

manticore.name: Quill and Sting
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can spend stamina to coat an identified weapon in venom. The next few hits with it apply a stacking poison affliction.
Enemies hit by a coated weapon cannot identify, conceal or switch items until the poison expires.
This is a perception and venom effect.
manticore.tag: This is a perception and venom effect.

master.name: Practiced Grip
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification shows the skill an item rewards and how well you currently meet it. Each identified weapon tracks its own mastery as you fight with it.

At full mastery, a weapon's basic attacks gain one effect from its highest special attack, and it can never be disarmed from you. Mastery carries over to any other weapon of the same kind you identify.
This is a perception and mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a perception and mastery effect.

might.name: Stress Fracture
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an enemy's weapon or armour as you strike it reveals the item's breaking point. Your next special attack against that piece of equipment shatters it if the enemy is of equal or lower rank, removing its stats for the rest of the fight.
Shattered equipment drops as salvage when the enemy dies.
This is a perception and sundering effect.
might.tag: This is a perception and sundering effect.

ministration.name: Bedside Kit
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an injured ally shows each of their wounds and afflictions as if they were items: what each is, how severe, and what treats it.
Healing items and potions you use on an ally whose wounds you have identified have increased effect, and also cleanse the affliction they are best suited to treat.
This is a perception and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a perception and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Read
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification extends to dungeon layouts. Holding an identified map, key or dungeon trophy reveals the full floor plan of the place it came from.

While inside a place whose layout you have identified this way, you and your allies cannot be lost to confusion or teleport effects, and your charges and movement abilities ignore wall-hugging penalties.
This is a perception and labyrinth effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a perception and labyrinth effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Decoy
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can drop an identified item as a lure. The dropped item shimmers and appears, to enemies, to be wherever you choose within a short distance of where it fell.
Enemies who go to pick up a lure are briefly confused when they reach the false position. Picking the item back up yourself ends the illusion.
This is a perception and illusion effect.
mirage.tag: This is a perception and illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Copy
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can spend mana to create a reflected copy of an identified item. The copy has the original's stats and effects but cannot be sold, traded or socketed.
The copy lasts until you rest or until the original leaves your possession. Only one copy can exist at a time.
This is a conjuration and reflection effect.
mirror.tag: This is a conjuration and reflection effect.

monkey.name: Light Fingers
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify items carried by other creatures within reach, including unequipped items in their packs.
Once per fight, you can spend stamina to snatch an identified unequipped item from a lower-rank enemy within reach. The item goes straight into your inventory.
This is a perception and theft effect.
monkey.tag: This is a perception and theft effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can set an identified stone, idol or statue into the ground as a waystone. Each waystone projects a field in which you and your allies cannot be knocked back, knocked down or moved by force.
Waystones remain where you set them, across sessions, and their positions are marked on your map. Only a few can exist at once.
This is a perception and endurance effect.
monolith.tag: This is a perception and endurance effect.

moon.name: Tidemark
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item reveals how its power waxes and wanes. Many items gain a bonus at night, by water or under certain conditions, and these are listed along with when they next apply.
You can spend mana to hold an identified item at the height of its tide until the next dawn. Only one item can be held this way at a time.
This is a perception and light effect.
moon.tag: This is a perception and light effect.

mouse.name: Unseen Inventory
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Hidden caches, loose floorboards, buried coin and dropped valuables within a short distance are identified without being touched, and show on the map as small marks.
You can retrieve a small marked item through any gap a mouse could fit through, without opening the container or wall it is behind.
This is a perception and retrieval effect.
mouse.tag: This is a perception and retrieval effect.

myriad.name: Many Hands, One Blade
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item reveals every other copy of it you have ever held, and the current location of any copy within this region.
Duplicate identified items in your inventory can be fused into one. The fused item keeps the best values of each duplicate's random stats.
This is a perception and fusion effect.
myriad.tag: This is a perception and fusion effect.

mystic.name: Inner Appraisal
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify items without touching them, by closing your eyes and reaching with your senses, within aura-sense range.
Identifying a magical item this way draws a small amount of its stored mana into you. An item drained this way recovers its mana over 24 hours.
This is a perception and mana effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and mana effect.

nebula.name: Dust-Veil Assay
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can disperse an identified item into a cloud of glittering dust that you carry around you. While dispersed, the item grants its stats and enchantments as an aura to you and allies near you, at reduced strength.
Only one item can be dispersed at a time. Gathering it back takes a moment out of combat.
This is a perception and dispersal effect.
nebula.tag: This is a perception and dispersal effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Flaw
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a piece of armour reveals its seams. When you strike an identified piece of enemy armour, your attacks ignore a portion of the protection it grants.
You can mend a seam in your own identified armour out of combat, restoring its durability without a crafting station.
This is a perception and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a perception and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Marked Possession
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item dropped or touched by a creature marks that creature as your quarry. You know the direction of your quarry while it is in the same region, and it is shown on your map when within aura-sense range.
You deal increased damage to your quarry, and it cannot hide from you by stealth or invisibility. Only one quarry can be marked at a time.
This is a perception and tracking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a perception and tracking effect.

net.name: Dragnet Survey
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can spend mana to cast a wide identification mesh around you. Every item on the ground and on defeated enemies within the area is identified at once, and you can choose which of them to pull into your inventory.
Items you leave behind are marked on the map until you leave the region.
This is a perception and gathering effect.
net.tag: This is a perception and gathering effect.

network.name: Shared Ledger
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Everything you identify is identified for your party and companions as well, and they can see each other's inventory and equipped items at a glance.
You can pass an item from your inventory to an ally's at any distance within the same region, at the cost of mana scaled to the item's quality.
This is a perception and communication effect.
network.tag: This is a perception and communication effect.

oasis.name: Wellspring Read
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification reveals whether water, food and drink are safe, and how much they would restore.

Food and drink you identify restore stamina and mana as well as health. Once per day, you can turn an identified waterskin or flask into a spring that heals you and allies standing beside it for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a perception and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a perception and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Tidewrack
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Items you discard, sell or lose to breakage are not gone. Over time, the tide returns them: each day, a portion of what you have lost washes up on the nearest shore you have visited, marked on your map.
Items returned by the tide gain a minor water enchantment.
This is a perception and tide effect.
ocean.tag: This is a perception and tide effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Handed Appraisal
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can keep up to eight identified items held in a loose, unseen grip beside your inventory, swapping any of them into your hands instantly in combat without a delay.
Consumables in that grip can be used without interrupting an attack or spell in progress.
This is a dimensional storage effect.
octopus.tag: This is a dimensional storage effect.

omen.name: Reading the Sign
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item reveals the next event it will be part of: whether it will break, be lost, be stolen or save your life.

Before opening a chest, crate or reward, you can identify its contents without opening it. Once per day, you can refuse a reward you have read and have it rerolled. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a precognition effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a weapon reveals its natural attack rhythm. Each consecutive hit you land with an identified weapon, without being interrupted, increases its attack speed slightly.
At the top of the rhythm, your next special attack with that weapon costs no stamina. Taking a stagger or switching weapons resets the rhythm.
This is a perception and momentum effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a perception and momentum effect.

pangolin.name: Overlapping Plate
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can layer an identified shield or armour piece over the one you are wearing in the same slot. The layered piece adds a portion of its protection but none of its other effects.
When you curl up to block, both layers count fully, and you cannot be knocked back.
This is a defensive and equipment effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and equipment effect.

paper.name: Paper Trail
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item writes it into a ledger you carry in your inventory. You can recall the full details of any ledgered item at any time, including its price at every shop you have visited.
You can tear a page from the ledger to create a paper copy of a scroll or recipe you have identified. The copy can be used once.
This is a record and conjuration effect.
paper.tag: This is a record and conjuration effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Haunted Curio
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item reveals the memory most strongly impressed on it. You can release that memory as a short-lived illusion around you: a scene from the item's past that enemies within it perceive as real.
Enemies inside the scene are confused and attack phantoms from the memory. Each item can release its memory once per day.
This is a perception and illusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a perception and illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Ash-Bed Assay
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can burn an identified item in your hands. Burning destroys the item and grants a boon of fire and renewal based on its quality: health regeneration, fire damage on your attacks, and resistance to afflictions.
Burning a cursed item burns the curse into its source instead, inflicting fire damage on whoever placed it if they are within range.
This is a perception and fire effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a perception and fire effect.

plant.name: Root and Graft
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying a seed, herb or wooden item reveals what it can grow into. You can plant an identified seed in any soil to raise a harvesting node of that plant over a long time, which only you can harvest.
Identified wooden gear repairs itself slowly while you stand on grass or soil.
This is a growth and life effect.
plant.tag: This is a growth and life effect.

potent.name: Distilled Worth
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can reduce an identified consumable to a concentrate. The concentrate takes up less space and has a significantly stronger effect, but it can only be used out of combat or at the start of a fight.
Only one concentrate effect can be active on you at a time.
This is an alchemy and enhancement effect.
potent.tag: This is an alchemy and enhancement effect.

predatory.name: Chosen Prey
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify living creatures as you would items. Identification shows a creature's worth in loot, its drop table, and which of its drops it is currently carrying.
Creatures you have identified this way drop their rarest carried item first. Wounded identified creatures are shown on the map until they die or leave the region.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

prison.name: Lock and Key
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can lock an identified item. A locked item cannot be moved, used, picked up or destroyed by anyone but you, wherever it lies.
Locking an identified weapon held by an enemy jams it in their hands for a short time, preventing attacks with it. Only one item can be locked at a time.
This is a perception and binding effect.
prison.tag: This is a perception and binding effect.

prosperity.name: Golden Year
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items you have identified are worth more to merchants. Selling an identified item also grants a small amount of reputation with that merchant's settlement.
Coins and valuables you identify while looting have a chance to multiply. Each settlement's shops restock with better goods for each identified item you have sold there.
This is a perception and fortune effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a perception and fortune effect.

pure.name: Clean Assay
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item reveals any corruption, curse, poison or taint in it. You can spend mana to purge one such flaw from an identified item, leaving the item intact.
Purging a monster core or awakening stone of taint raises its value at shops.
This is a cleansing and purification effect.
pure.tag: This is a cleansing and purification effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt-Hole Satchel
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

When you are struck below a portion of your maximum health, you can drop one identified item to vanish it and yourself a short distance away along a hidden path. The dropped item stays where you were and distracts nearby enemies, who move to take it.
This can trigger once per fight.
This is a movement and decoy effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and decoy effect.

rake.name: Gleaner's Eye
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items too broken or common to be worth picking up are identified for the salvage hidden in them. Walking over them rakes the salvage into your inventory as crafting materials.
Spent arrows, broken bolts and thrown weapons are recovered automatically when you pass over them.
This is a gathering and salvage effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and salvage effect.

rat.name: Survivor's Stash
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Spoiled food, cracked potions and tainted water are identified as safe or unsafe for you. You can consume items marked unsafe for others without suffering their negative effects.
When you are near death, the healing items in your inventory are listed in order of how quickly they can save you, and the first one can be used instantly.
This is a perception and survival effect.
rat.tag: This is a perception and survival effect.

reagent.name: Transmutation Notes
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying any material reveals every alchemical recipe it can be part of, including recipes you do not yet know. Those recipes can be brewed once from your notes.
You can transmute three identified materials of the same type into one material of the next tier up, at the cost of mana and a long wait.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

refracting.name: Angle of Return
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

An identified shield, mirror or polished item can be set to deflect. While held, it turns aside the first projectile or spell aimed at you in each short span, sending it off in a direction you choose.
Deflected spells retain their effects but change damage type to match the item's highest enchantment.
This is a perception and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a perception and deflection effect.

renewal.name: Seasoned Gear
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified items you carry are restored to full durability whenever the day turns over.
Once per day, you can spend mana to return a destroyed identified item to whole. The item comes back with its random stats rerolled. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a renewal and restoration effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal and restoration effect.

resolute.name: Planted Grip
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified items cannot be stolen from you, knocked from your hands or forcibly unequipped by any effect.
While you hold your position without moving, identified weapons deal increased damage with each consecutive hit, resetting when you move.
This is an equipment and resolve effect.
resolute.tag: This is an equipment and resolve effect.

resonating.name: Struck Tone
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item reveals its tone. You can strike two identified items that share a tone to set them resonating.

While resonating, both items' enchantments trigger whenever either does. Striking a resonating weapon against an enemy releases a ringing pulse that damages and briefly staggers enemies near the target.
This is a perception and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a perception and resonance effect.

roc.name: Shadow Cast
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items you have identified can be seen from far above. When you stand on high ground, every identified item in the region within sight is marked on your map.
You can drop an identified heavy item from height onto a marked point. It lands with crushing force, damaging and knocking down enemies around it, and stays where it lands for you to retrieve.
This is a perception and impact effect.
roc.tag: This is a perception and impact effect.

rune.name: Graven Mark
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item reveals any empty rune slots it has. You can engrave a rune you have learned into an empty slot, adding a minor effect such as light, warmth, durability or resistance to one damage type.
Engraving costs mana and can be done out of combat only. Each item can carry one engraving.
This is a rune and enchantment effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and enchantment effect.

sacrifice.name: Price of Knowing
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can pay health to identify an item that resists identification, including sealed, divine and higher-rank items. The price scales with the item's rank.
You can also pay health to temporarily raise an identified item's quality one step, for the rest of the encounter. The health cannot be recovered until the encounter ends.
This is a perception and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a perception and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Grain Count
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can grind an identified item into a pouch of sand that remembers it. The pouch weighs almost nothing and can be poured out later to rebuild the item exactly, taking a short time to settle.
Sand you throw from a remembered pouch blinds enemies it hits for a brief moment, and pouring it out this way loses the item.
This is an earth and storage effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and storage effect.
