sceptre.name: Royal Warrant
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Merchants accept your identification as binding. Items you sell fetch their full identified worth, and shopkeepers cannot refuse to buy an item you have identified.
You can declare one identified item a symbol of office. While you carry it openly, guards and townsfolk of lower rank obey simple commands from you.
This is an authority effect.

scribe.name: Annotated Margin
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Everything you identify is written into a catalogue you can read from your interface, including items you have sold or lost.

You can inscribe a short note into an identified item's description. The note becomes true in a minor way: an inscription naming a damage type adds a small amount of that damage, and one naming a creature type adds a small bonus against it. One inscription per item.
This is a perception and inscription effect.
scribe.tag: This is a perception and inscription effect.

serene.name: Still Water Reading
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
While you are out of combat and standing still, you can identify an item's full history: who made it, who carried it and how each owner's story ended.
Holding an identified item for this long calms you. Afflictions on you that cause fear, rage or confusion are cleansed when the reading completes.
This is a perception and calming effect.
serene.tag: This is a perception and calming effect.

serpent.name: Constricting Knowledge
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

The longer you hold an identified item without using it, the more you learn. After a weapon has been held for some time out of combat, its first strike in the next encounter is a guaranteed critical hit.
A held consumable that you wait to use grows slowly in potency, up to a limit, until you use it.
This is a perception and patience effect.
serpent.tag: This is a perception and patience effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Enemies carrying valuable items are marked on the map, and the more an enemy carries, the brighter its mark.
Your attacks deal increased damage to an enemy carrying an item worth more than anything you hold. When it dies, that item is guaranteed to drop.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
shark.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

shield.name: Borrowed Bulwark
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

When an ally within reach is struck, you can spend stamina to throw a barrier shaped like an identified shield in your inventory in front of them. The barrier absorbs one hit using that shield's block strength.
The shield is unavailable to you until the barrier breaks or fades.
This is a barrier and protection effect.
shield.tag: This is a barrier and protection effect.

shimmer.name: Glamour Trade
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can spend mana to give an identified item the appearance of any other item you have identified. The glamour fools identification effects of lower rank than you.
An item glamoured as something worthless is ignored by thieves, monsters and loot-seeking effects.
This is an illusion effect.

ship.name: Bill of Lading
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can consign identified items to any harbour or river settlement you have visited. The items are shipped there and wait in its storehouse.
Bulk goods you have identified, such as ore, timber and cloth, sell for more at any settlement far from where they were gathered.
This is a trade and transport effect.
ship.tag: This is a trade and transport effect.

shovel.name: Buried Truth
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items buried beneath the ground within a short distance are identified and marked on the map, including graves, caches and old battlefields.
You can spend stamina to dig up a marked item in a single motion. Digging up a grave this way also identifies the remains, revealing who they were and how they died.
This is a perception and excavation effect.
shovel.tag: This is a perception and excavation effect.

sickle.name: Harvest Rights
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Monster parts you identify reveal which ones can be taken from a living creature. A special attack on a creature at low health can sever an identified part, which drops as a crafting material immediately.
Parts taken from living creatures are of a higher quality than those taken from corpses.
This is a perception and harvest effect.
sickle.tag: This is a perception and harvest effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Gear
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can spend mana to project an identified set of gear onto an outline of yourself. The outline stands where you leave it, draws enemy attention as if it were you, and uses the gear's defensive stats.
When the outline is destroyed, the gear it was wearing takes no durability loss. Only one outline can exist at a time.
This is a perception and decoy effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a perception and decoy effect.

sin.name: Covetous Gaze
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item someone else owns reveals what they would give up to keep it. You can name a price for it, and if they are of lower rank they must either surrender the item or suffer a guilt affliction that weakens their attacks against you.
Taking an item this way marks you with a sin that law-keepers can sense.
This is a sin and compulsion effect.
sin.tag: This is a sin and compulsion effect.

skirmish.name: Light Kit
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can drop an identified item mid-fight and pick it back up instantly by passing over it. Picking up a dropped weapon grants a burst of movement speed and makes your next attack strike from the side.
You can have a few items dropped at once. They return to your inventory if you leave the area.
This is a perception and skirmish effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a perception and skirmish effect.

skunk.name: Tripwire Musk
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can scent an identified item. Any creature other than you that picks it up or touches it is doused in a lingering stench, revealing it on the map and causing animals and lower-rank monsters to flee from it.
Scented items cannot be carried away without your knowledge.
This is a marking and repulsion effect.
skunk.tag: This is a marking and repulsion effect.

sky.name: Hovering Charm
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified items carry no weight in your inventory.
You can release one identified item to float at your shoulder. A floating item grants its passive enchantments as though equipped, without taking an equipment slot. Only one item can float at a time.
This is a perception and air effect.
sky.tag: This is a perception and air effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Appraisal
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Consumables you have identified take effect slowly but last significantly longer, spreading their healing, mana or buff across a longer duration.
While you are resting, identified items in your inventory slowly recover any charges they have spent.
This is a duration and recovery effect.
sloth.tag: This is a duration and recovery effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Pocket
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can release an identified item as a puff of smoke, hiding it from the world. The item cannot be found, detected or stolen until you call it back, and calling it back takes a moment.
Releasing an item in combat leaves a cloud of smoke that hides you from enemies of lower rank for a short time.
This is a concealment and smoke effect.
smoke.tag: This is a concealment and smoke effect.

snake.name: Poisoner's Inventory
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a venom, toxin or poisoned item reveals its exact affliction and what cures it.
You can coat an identified weapon with an identified poison out of combat. The coating lasts for several strikes, and the first strike against an unaware enemy applies the poison at full strength.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

soaring.name: Updraft Gear
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a cloak, cape or pair of boots reveals how it would catch the wind. While wearing an identified cloak or boots, you can spring forward in a long wind-borne bound, steering freely.
Attacks made as you land from such a bound with identified gear deal increased damage. The bound costs little stamina.
This is a perception and flight effect.
soaring.tag: This is a perception and flight effect.

song.name: Resonant Pitch
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Every identified item has a pitch you can hear. Lost or hidden identified items can be found by listening for their pitch from a moderate distance.
Striking an enemy's identified weapon or armour at its pitch causes it to ring painfully, stunning the wielder briefly. This can affect each enemy once per fight.
This is a sound and tracking effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and tracking effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Seal
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can set your seal on an identified item. Merchants must buy sealed items at their full worth, and sealed items cannot be confiscated, taxed or refused at any gate.
Once per day, in a settlement where your reputation is high, you can requisition one item from a shop without payment by naming it as needed. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a perception and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a perception and authority effect.

spear.name: Return Throw
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Any identified weapon can be thrown with full accuracy, regardless of its type, and returns to your inventory after it lands.
A thrown identified weapon deals its normal damage plus a portion scaled to the item's quality, and pins lower-rank enemies in place briefly.
This is a throwing and weapon effect.
spear.tag: This is a throwing and weapon effect.

spider.name: Web of Ownership
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can tie an invisible thread to any identified item. You feel every tug on a tethered item and always know where it is, and you can reel it back to your hand from a moderate distance.
An enemy carrying a tethered item is slowed while within reach of the thread.
This is a tracking and binding effect.
spider.tag: This is a tracking and binding effect.

spike.name: Concealed Point
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can set an identified item as bait. Any enemy that picks it up or steps over it triggers hidden spikes, which inflict piercing damage and a bleed affliction.
Up to three items can be set this way at a time, and they appear harmless to identification effects other than your own.
This is a trap effect.

staff.name: Walking Stick
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a road, trail or waystone reveals where it leads and how far, and it is added to the map.
While you carry an identified staff or walking implement, you travel faster on roads and trails and use less stamina while travelling.
This is a travel effect.

star.name: Starlit Provenance
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items from astral realms, beyond the world or of divine make are identified fully, including properties that are hidden from other identification effects.
Once per day, you can attune an identified astral item to yourself, unlocking a hidden property that works only for you. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an astral and perception effect.
star.tag: This is an astral and perception effect.

stellar.name: Starfall Assay
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification reveals meteoric, astral and star-touched materials, including those hidden within ordinary items.

An identified item left exposed to the night sky charges with starlight. A charged weapon's next spell or special attack deals bonus fire damage that ignores resistance. The charge is spent on use and refills on the next night.
This is a perception and star effect.
stellar.tag: This is a perception and star effect.

storm.name: Weather Wise
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identification shows how an item behaves in each kind of weather. Identified items gain a bonus matching the current weather: rain strengthens water and lightning enchantments, wind strengthens projectiles, and clear skies strengthen fire and light.
You can spend mana to bring a short squall of the weather an item favours down on yourself and enemies near you.
This is a perception and weather effect.
storm.tag: This is a perception and weather effect.

succubus.name: Willing Gift
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item that someone else is carrying shows what they would accept in exchange for it. Non-hostile characters will trade identified items for anything of equal worth to them, even when not merchants.
In combat, you can spend mana to borrow one enchantment from an enemy's identified item for a short time. The enemy loses that enchantment while you hold it.
This is a perception and charm effect.
succubus.tag: This is a perception and charm effect.

sun.name: High Noon Proof
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Holding an identified item up to the light reveals any undead, shadow or demonic taint in it and burns it away, along with any hiding creature bound to the item.
In daylight, identified weapons you wield deal additional radiant damage to undead and shadow creatures.
This is a light and purification effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and purification effect.

swarm.name: Shattered Cloud
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can break an identified weapon into a swarm of fragments that circle you for a short time. The fragments strike nearby enemies on their own, each hit carrying a small part of the weapon's damage and enchantments.
When the effect ends, the fragments reassemble into the weapon. A weapon can be broken this way once per encounter.
This is a perception and swarm effect.
swarm.tag: This is a perception and swarm effect.

swift.name: Quick Draw
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Swapping between identified weapons is instant and resets your basic attack timer.
The first attack after a weapon swap deals increased damage. This can only trigger once every few seconds.
This is a speed and weapon effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and weapon effect.

sword.name: Edge Lore
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying a blade reveals the techniques of its past wielders. While you wield an identified blade, you can use one special attack it remembers from a previous owner, even if you have not awakened it.
The remembered technique costs more stamina than its original and is forgotten if you sell or lose the blade.
This is a weapon and memory effect.
sword.tag: This is a weapon and memory effect.

talisman.name: Charm String
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying small charms, tokens and keepsakes reveals a hidden minor effect most people never notice.
You can string identified charms onto a single cord and wear it as your amulet. Each charm on the cord grants its hidden effect. The cord holds more charms at each rank.
This is a perception and talisman effect.
talisman.tag: This is a perception and talisman effect.

tentacle.name: Grasp of the Deep
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can reach for an identified item within a moderate distance with a conjured tentacle and pull it to your hand, including items held by lower-rank enemies.
If the item is held, the tentacle also grips the holder briefly, rooting it in place.
This is a conjuration and grab effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a conjuration and grab effect.

thread.name: Unravel and Rewind
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified cloth and leather items can be unravelled into thread, then rewoven out of combat into a different cloth or leather item of the same quality that you have identified before.
Rewoven items keep one random stat of your choice from the original.
This is a crafting and transformation effect.
thread.tag: This is a crafting and transformation effect.

thunderbird.name: Lightning Rod
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can plant an identified metal weapon or item in the ground as a rod. Lightning damage you deal near the rod is drawn to it and strikes every enemy between you and the rod.
Recovering the rod releases its stored charge as a thunderclap that staggers enemies near it. Only one rod can stand at a time.
This is a perception and lightning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a perception and lightning effect.

time.name: Rewound Condition
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identification shows an item as it was at any earlier point in its history. You can spend mana to rewind an identified item to an earlier condition: unbroken, unspent, or before a curse was placed on it.
Rewinding cannot take an item back past the moment you first identified it. Each item can be rewound once per day.
This is a perception and time effect.
time.tag: This is a perception and time effect.

tranquil.name: Stilled Enchantment
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Cursed, volatile and unstable items you identify fall quiet while you hold them. Their drawbacks and backlash do not affect you, though their benefits remain.
You can spend mana to project a stillness around you. Within it, the enchantments on enemies' identified weapons and armour do not trigger, for a short time.
This is a perception and calm effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a perception and calm effect.

transfiguration.name: Reforged Form
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can change an identified item into another item of the same slot: a sword into an axe, a robe into a coat, a ring into an amulet. The item keeps its quality and enchantments, and its stats adjust to suit its new form.
Changing an item's form costs mana scaled to its quality, and cannot be done in combat.
This is a perception and transfiguration effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a perception and transfiguration effect.

transgression.name: Contraband Eye
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identification reveals whether an item is stolen, forbidden or bound to another owner, and who has broken a rule to hold it. Characters carrying such items are marked to you.
You can use forbidden and owner-bound items without penalty, and items whose rank is higher than yours, at the cost of a slow drain of health while they are equipped.
This is a perception and transgression effect.
transgression.tag: This is a perception and transgression effect.

trap.name: Defuse and Rearm
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Traps, wards and pressure plates within a short distance are identified without being triggered, and appear on the map.
You can disarm an identified trap by touching it, storing it in your inventory as an item. A stored trap can be set again anywhere and triggers against your enemies.
This is a perception and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a perception and trap effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Ring
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an item reveals its age. Each item you carry gains a ring every season it stays with you, slowly raising its durability and, at many rings, one of its stats.
An item is reset to no rings if you sell, trade or lose it.
This is a growth effect.

troll.name: Mending Hide
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified armour and weapons regenerate durability over time, even in combat.
While wearing identified armour that has taken damage, you regenerate health at a rate tied to how quickly the armour repairs. Fire damage stops this regeneration for a short time.
This is a perception and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is a perception and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Builder's Survey
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Walls, buildings, bridges and ruins can be identified, revealing their weak points, hidden rooms and how they were made.
You can spend stamina to seal a breach or doorway you have identified with quick mortar, blocking it until it is broken down.
This is a perception and construction effect.
trowel.tag: This is a perception and construction effect.

turtle.name: Shell Keeping
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified armour you wear cannot lose durability while you are blocking or standing still.
When you take a hit large enough to reduce your health below a portion of its maximum, you can withdraw into your identified armour for a brief moment, taking no damage but unable to act.
This can trigger once per fight.
This is a defensive effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Lot
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
In darkness and at dusk, you can identify items by touch at any distance within reach of your shadow.
Identified items you carry cannot be seen by enemies in low light. Weapons you draw in darkness deal increased damage on their first strike, and leave the target unable to see you for a moment.
This is a perception and shadow effect.
twilight.tag: This is a perception and shadow effect.

undeath.name: Grave Goods
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identifying an item taken from a corpse reveals the last thing its owner did with it. You can spend mana to raise that owner's echo, which wields the item for a short time as a summon, fighting with the dead owner's skill.
When the echo fades, the item returns to your inventory. Each corpse's goods can raise an echo once.
This is a perception and necromancy effect.
undeath.tag: This is a perception and necromancy effect.

unity.name: Common Kit
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Set bonuses from identified gear count pieces worn by any member of your party. Two allies each wearing part of a set both receive the bonus for the full count of pieces between them.
Damage that would break an identified item is spread across the gear of everyone in your party instead.
This is a perception and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a perception and unity effect.

vast.name: Wide Assay
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify any item you can see, at any distance, without holding it.
Identifying a container from afar reveals its full contents, and you can see the total worth of every item in an entire room or camp at a glance.
This is a perception effect.

vehicle.name: Cart and Carry
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Carts, wagons, boats and mounts can be identified, revealing their condition, capacity and the best route for them.
An identified vehicle or mount you are using carries items that do not count against your inventory, and moves faster on roads you have travelled before.
This is a travel and storage effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and storage effect.

venom.name: Slow Ruin
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can corrode an identified item held by an enemy within reach. The item loses durability over time and its stats weaken while the corrosion lasts.
When a corroded item breaks, its wielder suffers a poison affliction.
This is a corrosion and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a corrosion and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Rootbound Grain
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified wooden items, bows and staves put out roots when set down. A planted staff or bow roots enemies who step near it for a brief time, and regrows durability while planted.
Wooden weapons you have identified heal you for a small amount whenever they strike a living target.
This is a perception and growth effect.
verdant.tag: This is a perception and growth effect.

vessel.name: Held Charge
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can pour one of your own abilities into an identified item, spending its mana cost. The ability is held in the item until released.
Releasing it uses the ability without spending mana and without triggering its cooldown. Only one item can hold an ability at a time, and the item must be held to release it.
This is a perception and storage effect.
vessel.tag: This is a perception and storage effect.

visage.name: The Worn Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying a mask, helm or piece of clothing reveals the face of the person who last wore it. You can spend mana to wear that face as a disguise while the item is equipped.
The disguise fools identification effects of lower rank than you, and ends if you attack.
This is a disguise and illusion effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and illusion effect.

vision.name: Foretold Drop
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can identify the contents of chests, caches and reward bags before they are opened, and see what an enemy will drop before it dies.
Once per day, when you see a drop you do not want, you can turn the vision aside. The drop is rerolled at the moment it is revealed. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a perception and foresight effect.
vision.tag: This is a perception and foresight effect.

void.name: Unmaking Hunger
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can feed an identified item to the void. The item is erased, and you absorb a portion of the mana value it held, restoring mana and briefly raising your spell damage.
Higher-quality items restore more mana. Items with an essence or awakening stone in them cannot be fed this way.
This is a void and consumption effect.
void.tag: This is a void and consumption effect.

volcano.name: Building Pressure
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified weapons build heat with each strike, shown on the item's description. At full heat, the weapon's next strike erupts, inflicting fire damage in an area and knocking enemies back.
A weapon that erupts loses some durability. While heat is building, the weapon deals a small amount of bonus fire damage.
This is a perception and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is a perception and eruption effect.

vortex.name: Pulling Centre
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Loose items, drops and thrown objects within a short distance are pulled toward you and identified as they arrive.

You can spend mana to create a spiralling pull around you for a short time. Projectiles entering it are dragged off course, and lower-rank enemies within it have their weapons torn from their hands and drawn toward you.
This is a perception and pull effect.
vortex.tag: This is a perception and pull effect.

wasp.name: Stinger Charge
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

Identified arrows, bolts and throwing weapons can be charged with a sting out of combat. A charged projectile inflicts a stacking pain affliction that worsens with every further charged hit on the same target.
Each projectile holds one charge.
This is a projectile and affliction effect.
wasp.tag: This is a projectile and affliction effect.

water.name: Low Places
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Items submerged in water, wells, rivers and lakes are identified and marked on the map.
You can call a marked submerged item to the surface and into your hands from a short distance, with the water carrying it.
Identified potions you drink while standing in water take effect faster.
This is a water and retrieval effect.
water.tag: This is a water and retrieval effect.

weave.name: Woven Pair
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can weave two identified items of the same slot into one. The woven item has the higher of each stat from the two, and carries the strongest enchantment from each.
A woven item cannot be woven again, and unweaving it destroys one of the originals at random.
This is a perception and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is a perception and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Appraisal
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can devour an identified item. A devoured item is destroyed and you gain its stats and enchantments as a boon for a short time, chilling enemies who strike you while it lasts.
After the boon fades, you are hungry for a short time and your stamina recovers slowly until you devour another item or eat food.
This is a perception and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a perception and hunger effect.

whale.name: Deep Song Catalogue
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Every item you have identified sings faintly to you across long distances. You can always find any item you have ever identified that is still in the same region as you.
Once per day, you can call a lost or stolen identified item home. It returns to your inventory after a long delay, as though carried by the tide. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a tracking and recall effect.
whale.tag: This is a tracking and recall effect.

wheel.name: Turning Wheel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can set up to three identified items on a wheel. Each time you use a special attack, the wheel turns and equips the next item in that slot automatically.
Each item on the wheel deals increased damage on the first attack after it turns into place.
This is a weapon and rotation effect.
wheel.tag: This is a weapon and rotation effect.

whip.name: Snap Disarm
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identifying an enemy's weapon reveals how loosely it is held. Your next whip, chain or reach attack against that enemy can disarm it, sending the weapon to the ground.
Disarmed lower-rank enemies deal significantly reduced damage until they recover the weapon.
This is a weapon and disarm effect.
whip.tag: This is a weapon and disarm effect.

wind.name: Carried on the Wind
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Light identified items can be sent on the wind to an ally within a moderate distance, arriving in their hands.
You can scatter a handful of light identified items, such as coins or feathers, into a cutting gust that inflicts slashing damage on enemies in a line.
This is an air and transfer effect.
wind.tag: This is an air and transfer effect.

wing.name: Pinion Ledger
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Feathers, quills and flying-creature parts you identify can be woven into a feather token. While you carry a token, you land lightly from any drop and cannot be knocked down.
You can spend a token to make a single long, light leap, crossing gaps and springing up to ledges.
This is a flight effect.

wolf.name: Pack's Share
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Party members and companions can identify any item you have already identified, and see its worth and stats through you.
When a party member equips an identified item you passed to them, both of you gain a minor bonus to damage while within close range of each other.
This is a party and pack effect.
wolf.tag: This is a party and pack effect.

wood.name: Living Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
Identified wooden weapons, bows, staves and shields bend instead of breaking. They cannot be destroyed and slowly regrow their durability while not in use.
You can coax an identified wooden item to sprout, briefly entangling an enemy struck by it.
This is a wood and growth effect.
wood.tag: This is a wood and growth effect.

wrath.name: Grudge-Bearer
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
An identified weapon remembers every blow you take while holding it, building a grudge shown on its description.

You can spend the grudge on a single strike, adding bonus damage based on all the damage you have taken since the grudge began. Spending it empties the grudge. The grudge fades slowly outside of combat.
This is a perception and wrath effect.
wrath.tag: This is a perception and wrath effect.

zeal.name: Zealot's Blessing
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].
You can consecrate an identified weapon to a cause. While you fight toward the active objective of a quest, a consecrated weapon deals additional damage and cannot be disarmed.
Only one weapon can be consecrated at a time, and changing it requires resting.
This is a conviction and weapon effect.
zeal.tag: This is a conviction and weapon effect.

ziz.name: Horizon-Scale Gear
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Item Identification]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Item Identification].

You can identify, carry and wield items made for creatures far larger than you, including boss trophies, siege weapons and giant's arms. Oversized weapons you wield sweep through every enemy in a wide arc.
Oversized armour you identify can be worn as a mantle, granting significant resistance to weather, wind and knockback.
This is a perception and colossus effect.
ziz.tag: This is a perception and colossus effect.

action.name: Decided Instant
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can queue one long-cooldown ability while it is still recovering. It fires the moment its cooldown ends, aimed at the target you chose when you queued it, even if you are mid-action.
Using a queued ability this way grants a brief burst of stamina recovery.
This is a time and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a time and haste effect.

adept.name: Practiced Instant
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Each time you use a long-cooldown ability, the moment is recorded as a rehearsal. Using the same ability again within a short window of its cooldown ending lets you perform it without its cast or wind-up time.
Rehearsals are lost if you use a different long-cooldown ability first.
This is a time and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a time and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Steeped Hour
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Potions in your inventory steep while you carry them. A potion held long enough before drinking gains an extra effect matching its family, such as a lingering heal-over-time on a healing potion.
You can spend mana to age a single potion instantly. That potion's cooldown is shared with your longest-cooldown ability.
This is a time and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a time and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: The Moment Before
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you are unseen, time passes for your long-cooldown abilities but not for the enemies that cannot see you. Their afflictions, boons and cooldowns hold still until they notice you.
The first long-cooldown ability you use from stealth on an unaware enemy has its cooldown halved.
This is a time and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a time and stealth effect.

animate.name: Clockwork Servant
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When you use a long-cooldown ability, you can leave behind a wound-up figure of yourself. When its spring runs down a short time later, the figure repeats the ability once at reduced strength, from where it stands.
Only one figure can exist at a time. Enemies can destroy it before it acts.
This is a time and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a time and animation effect.

anzu.name: Gathering Thunderhead
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, a storm builds above you. When the ability becomes ready, the storm breaks: lightning strikes several nearby enemies once.
The longer the ability's cooldown, the more strikes the storm holds.
This is a storm and time effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and time effect.

ape.name: Ape's Recollection
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You remember the last special attack an enemy used against you. For a short time after being struck by it, you can spend stamina to throw that same attack back, mimicked at your own power.
A mimicked attack shares a single long cooldown, however many different attacks you have copied.
This is a time and mimicry effect.
ape.tag: This is a time and mimicry effect.

armour.name: Stilled Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to freeze your armour in its current condition. While frozen, damage to your armour is held rather than applied, and you take reduced physical damage.
When the effect ends, the held damage is applied at once. It cannot reduce your armour below a portion of its durability. The effect has a long cooldown that scales down with rank.
This is a time and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is a time and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Spare Moment
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You keep one spare charge in reserve, assigned to a long-cooldown ability of your choice outside of combat. Using that ability while it is on cooldown spends the spare instead.
The spare recharges over 24 hours. Changing which ability holds it empties it.
This is a time and preparation effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a time and preparation effect.

aspect.name: The Kept Self
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Once per day you can preserve your current form: health, mana, stamina, boons and position. For a short time afterward, you can step back into that preserved self, discarding everything that happened since, including afflictions and damage.
Stepping back does not refund cooldowns or consumed items. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a time and identity effect.
aspect.tag: This is a time and identity effect.

avatar.name: Ascendant Hour
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Once per day, you can enter an ascendant hour, which lasts a short time. While it lasts, your size and presence grow, lower-rank enemies are slowed in your vicinity, and your long-cooldown abilities recover at a greatly accelerated rate.
When the hour ends, all of your abilities go on cooldown at once. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a time and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a time and transformation effect.

axe.name: Felling Stroke
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities store the force of every weapon blow you land while they recharge. When one is used, the stored force is added to its first hit as physical damage.
Stored force is capped by rank and is lost if you leave combat.
This is a time and force effect.
axe.tag: This is a time and force effect.

balance.name: Even Hours
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Your cooldowns tend toward each other. While two or more of your abilities are recharging, the one furthest from ready recovers faster, and the one nearest to ready recovers slower, until they finish together.
When three or more abilities come off cooldown in the same instant, you gain a brief boon of increased damage and mana recovery.
This is a time and equilibrium effect.
balance.tag: This is a time and equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Echoing Night
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When you use a long-cooldown ability, a soundless pulse records the position of every creature nearby. For a short time afterward, those creatures stay marked on the map at the place the pulse found them, even if they move out of sight or turn invisible.
A creature that has moved far from its recorded position is shown with a line to where it went.
This is a time and tracking effect.
bat.tag: This is a time and tracking effect.

battlefield.name: Held Ground
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, the ground you stand on is marked as held. For as long as that ability is recovering, allies standing on held ground recover their own cooldowns faster.
Enemies standing on held ground recover their cooldowns more slowly.
This is a time and battlefield effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a time and battlefield effect.

bear.name: Long Winter's Sleep
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Resting out of combat banks time. Banked time can be spent during a fight to make one long-cooldown ability ready immediately, at a cost of stamina.
Time banks slowly and is capped. Taking damage while resting stops the banking.
This is a time and endurance effect.
bear.tag: This is a time and endurance effect.

bee.name: Hive Hours
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your summons and allies within your aura share a common clock. When any of them uses a long-cooldown ability, the others each recover a portion of their own longest cooldown.
An ally can benefit from this only once every short interval.
This is a time and cooperation effect.
bee.tag: This is a time and cooperation effect.

behemoth.name: Slow Tread
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Knockbacks, pulls, stuns and other forced movement applied to you are delayed. They take effect only after a short pause, during which you can act normally or move out of the effect's reach.
Each delayed effect shortens the cooldown of your longest-cooldown ability slightly.
This is a time and fortitude effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a time and fortitude effect.

bird.name: Migration's Return
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can mark a place on the region map as your roost. Once per day you can spend mana to return there instantly from anywhere in the same region, outside of combat.
Using the return within the same region as a quest objective counts the journey as already made for any timed quest step. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a time and travel effect.
bird.tag: This is a time and travel effect.

blight.name: Slow Ruin
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can age an enemy's wounds. Spending mana on an afflicted enemy advances all of its afflictions forward in time, dealing their remaining damage immediately and consuming them.
Aged afflictions cannot be cleansed in the instant they resolve. Higher-rank enemies resist a portion of the advanced damage. This effect has a long cooldown.
This is a time and decay effect.
blight.tag: This is a time and decay effect.

blood.name: Remembered Wound
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend health to make a long-cooldown ability ready early. The health cost is equal to a portion of your maximum health scaled to how much cooldown remains.
Health spent this way is recorded as a bleed you inflict on the next enemy you strike with that ability.
This is a time and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a time and blood effect.

bone.name: Fossil Record
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

The bones of any creature that died within the last day hold an imprint of its final moment. Touching a corpse or skeleton replays that moment for you as a brief vision, showing what killed it and from where.
Absorbing an imprint grants a short-lived resistance to the damage type that killed the creature.
This is a time and divination effect.
bone.tag: This is a time and divination effect.

boundary.name: Before and After
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to draw a line in time across a small area. Enemies inside it when the line is drawn are locked out of every ability they used in the last few seconds until the line fades.
Only one line can exist at a time. Its cooldown is long.
This is a time and boundary effect.
boundary.tag: This is a time and boundary effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Hour
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When one of your long-cooldown abilities becomes ready while it is already ready, the extra time is not wasted. It spills to the nearest ally, reducing one of their recovering abilities by the same amount.
Allies who receive spilled time gain a brief boon of increased healing received.
This is a time and generosity effect.
bounty.tag: This is a time and generosity effect.

bow.name: Held Draw
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can hold a fully drawn attack indefinitely without spending stamina. While held, the shot gathers time and grows in damage and range, up to a cap set by rank.
Releasing a shot that reached its cap causes the projectile to arrive the instant it is loosed, ignoring travel time.
This is a time and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a time and ranged effect.

brush.name: Season of Undergrowth
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to advance the season in a small area. Plants within it grow years in a moment, creating thick undergrowth that slows enemies and conceals allies.
Harvestable nodes inside the area that were spent become ready to harvest again. This can be done to a given node once per day.
This is a time and growth effect.
brush.tag: This is a time and growth effect.

cage.name: Prison of Seconds
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can lock an enemy inside a single moment. The enemy cannot act, move or be damaged while locked, and any afflictions on it are suspended.
The lock lasts briefly and has a long cooldown. Higher-rank enemies break free sooner. A locked enemy cannot be locked again for some time.
This is a time and imprisonment effect.
cage.tag: This is a time and imprisonment effect.

cat.name: Ninth Life
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you would take lethal damage, time rewinds a heartbeat for you alone: you are returned to where you stood an instant before the blow, unharmed by it.
You can do this a limited number of times per day, determined by your rank. Each use leaves you briefly unable to use movement abilities. Uses recover over 24 hours.
This is a time and evasion effect.
cat.tag: This is a time and evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Aftershock Hour
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities echo through the ground they strike. A short time after one resolves, an aftershock repeats a portion of its damage to every enemy that was hit.
Terrain struck by the original ability stays cracked and difficult to move across until the ability's cooldown ends.
This is a time and earth effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a time and earth effect.

cattle.name: Turning of the Herd
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities recover faster while you stand your ground. Not moving for a short time accelerates every recharging cooldown you have.
Moving resets the acceleration, but the time already gained is kept.
This is a time and endurance effect.
cattle.tag: This is a time and endurance effect.

chain.name: Linked Hours
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can chain two of your abilities together. Using the first triggers the second immediately afterward, without spending its resource cost. Both then share the longer of their two cooldowns.
Only one chain can exist at a time, and changing it can only be done out of combat.
This is a time and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a time and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Unwound Clock
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each time you use a long-cooldown ability, its next cooldown is rolled anew between a very short and a very long duration.
When the roll is long, the ability's next use is significantly stronger. When the roll is short, the ability's next use applies a random affliction to its targets.
This is a time and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a time and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: Borrowed Time
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can use a long-cooldown ability while it is still recovering by borrowing against its future. The debt is added to its next cooldown, and until it is repaid, enemies who inspect you see the ability as ready.
If you are defeated while in debt, all of your abilities go on full cooldown.
This is a time and deception effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a time and deception effect.

chicken.name: Morning's Crow
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
The first long-cooldown ability you use each day after resting resolves twice, its second resolution following a moment after the first.
When an ally near you is reduced to low health, you can spend mana to make one of their cooldowns ready immediately. This can be done once per fight.
This is a time and protection effect.
chicken.tag: This is a time and protection effect.

chimera.name: Three Clocks
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your abilities are split across three clocks: special attacks, spells, and everything else. Using a long-cooldown ability from one clock speeds the recovery of the other two.
Using a long-cooldown ability from each clock within a short window grants a brief boon of increased damage and movement speed.
This is a time and beast effect.
chimera.tag: This is a time and beast effect.

claw.name: Retracing Talons
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Each wound you open with a melee attack is remembered. Once per fight you can spend stamina to make every remembered wound on an enemy open again in the same instant, dealing their original damage a second time.
Wounds are forgotten when the enemy is healed or cleansed.
This is a time and rending effect.
claw.tag: This is a time and rending effect.

cloth.name: Unravelled Hours
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Worn gear does not wear out while a long-cooldown ability of yours is recharging. Gear that has been damaged slowly weaves itself back together in that time instead.
You can unpick one boon from yourself to return a portion of the cooldown of the ability that granted it.
This is a time and restoration effect.
cloth.tag: This is a time and restoration effect.

cloud.name: Drifting Afternoon
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to wrap an area in a slow-moving cloud where time drifts. Enemies inside move and recover cooldowns more slowly; allies inside are unaffected.
The cloud drifts with the wind and dissipates after a short time. This effect has a long cooldown.
This is a time and air effect.
cloud.tag: This is a time and air effect.

cold.name: Frozen Instant
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Enemies slowed by your cold effects also have their ability cooldowns stop recovering for as long as they are slowed.
An enemy that is frozen solid by you has its next ability delayed after it thaws, as though the frozen moment never passed for it.
This is a time and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a time and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Ages
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can plant a coral marker that grows over time. The longer it has grown, the more it does when you shatter it: a short-grown marker heals nearby allies slightly, while a long-grown one heals them heavily and deals damage to nearby enemies.
Only one marker can exist at a time, and it survives leaving the area.
This is a time and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a time and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Spoiled Hour
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can corrupt an enemy's timing. A corrupted enemy's boons expire early, and the cooldowns of its abilities run backward for a short time, moving further from ready.
Corruption costs mana and has a long cooldown. Enemies of higher rank are corrupted for a shorter time.
This is a time and corruption effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a time and corruption effect.

crocodile.name: The Patient Jaw
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
The longer you go without using a long-cooldown ability after it becomes ready, the stronger it becomes, up to a cap set by rank.
While an ability is at its cap, enemies within melee range of you are briefly rooted when you first strike them, as the waiting ends all at once.
This is a time and ambush effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a time and ambush effect.

crystal.name: Facet of the Hour
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, a crystal records it. While the crystal stands, you can spend mana to strike it and release a weaker copy of the recorded ability from its position.
The crystal shatters after releasing the copy or after a short time, and can be destroyed by enemies.
This is a time and crystal effect.
crystal.tag: This is a time and crystal effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When a long-cooldown ability becomes ready, you can let it lie fallow instead of using it. While fallow, it recovers a second charge over time.
Using a fallow ability spends both charges at once in a single, significantly stronger use, then the ability returns to its normal cooldown.
This is a time and cycle effect.
cycle.tag: This is a time and cycle effect.

dance.name: Repeated Measure
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Using abilities in the same order twice in a row completes a measure. Completing a measure reduces the cooldown of every ability used in it by a portion.
Repeating the same measure a third time in a fight resets your longest cooldown. Breaking the sequence ends the measure.
This is a time and rhythm effect.
dance.tag: This is a time and rhythm effect.

dark.name: Hour Between Hours
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
In darkness or deep shadow, you can step into the moment between two moments. For a brief time you are hidden from all sight and tracking, and your cooldowns continue to recover.
Attacking or using an ability ends the effect. It costs mana and has a long cooldown, and it cannot be used in bright light.
This is a time and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a time and darkness effect.

dawn.name: First Light
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
The first long-cooldown ability you use each day is ready instantly the moment you enter combat, regardless of its recovery.
When you use it, light breaks over the area, revealing hidden and stealthed enemies and cleansing one darkness or blindness affliction from each ally.
This is a light and time effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and time effect.

death.name: Last Breath Kept
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When an enemy dies near you, you can keep its final moment. A kept moment can be spent to make your next long-cooldown ability cost no mana or stamina.
You can hold a small number of kept moments, set by rank. Moments kept from higher-rank enemies refund part of the ability's cooldown as well.
This is a time and death effect.
death.tag: This is a time and death effect.

deep.name: Pressure of Ages
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Your long-cooldown abilities grow heavier the longer they recharge. When used, they apply a crushing weight to every enemy struck, slowing their movement and attacks for a time proportional to the cooldown the ability had.
Enemies already slowed are knocked down instead.
This is a time and pressure effect.
deep.tag: This is a time and pressure effect.

deer.name: Startled Moment
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When an enemy begins an attack against you, the moment can stretch: time slows briefly around you, giving you a window to move before the attack lands.
This can happen once every short interval. Moving during the stretched moment costs stamina.
This is a time and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a time and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Stopped Ground
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Where your long-cooldown abilities land, time stops for anything that heals or regenerates. Enemies standing on that ground cannot recover health, mana or stamina while the ability is on cooldown.
The ground stays bare and silent until the ability is ready again.
This is a time and desolation effect.
desolate.tag: This is a time and desolation effect.

dimension.name: Folded Interval
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can fold the cooldown of one ability into a pocket of space. While folded, the ability is ready to use, but its remaining cooldown waits in the pocket.
After a short time, or when you use another ability, the folded cooldown unfolds and is applied to the ability in full, plus a portion more.
This is a time and dimensional effect.
dimension.tag: This is a time and dimensional effect.

discord.name: Mistimed
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Enemies near you lose their sense of timing. Their attacks have a chance to come out early or late, missing their intended moment and dealing reduced damage.
Enemies that coordinate attacks as a group are disrupted more heavily. Higher-rank enemies are less affected.
This is a time and discord effect.
discord.tag: This is a time and discord effect.

discordant.name: Off the Beat
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Enemies struck by your long-cooldown abilities fall out of step with their allies. Their attacks and abilities land a short beat late, and boons cast on them by allies resolve after a delay.
Two out-of-step enemies near each other interfere, interrupting each other's channelled abilities.
This is a time and discord effect.
discordant.tag: This is a time and discord effect.

dog.name: Faithful Return
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A summon or familiar that dies is held in a kept moment rather than lost. For a short time after its death, you can spend mana to return it to the instant before it fell, with the health it had then.
Each summon can be returned this way once per fight.
This is a time and summoning effect.
dog.tag: This is a time and summoning effect.

doom.name: Counted Hour
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can name an enemy and set an hour on it. When the cooldown of the long-cooldown ability you used to name it ends, that ability strikes the named enemy again wherever it is, at full strength.
The named enemy can see its hour counting down. Only one enemy can be named at a time.
This is a time and doom effect.
doom.tag: This is a time and doom effect.

doppelganger.name: Echo of Yourself
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can call up the version of yourself from a few seconds ago. It appears where you were standing, repeats everything you did in those seconds, then fades.
The echo's abilities do not trigger your cooldowns, and enemies treat it as you.
This is a time and duplication effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a time and duplication effect.

dragon.name: Banked Fire
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, heat banks behind your breastbone. When you use the ability again, the banked heat is released as a cone of fire breath that scales with how long the ability waited.
While heat is banked, you resist fire and your skin hardens, reducing physical damage taken.
This is a fire and time effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and time effect.

duck.name: Unhurried Water
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Stun, knockdown and interrupt effects on you pass in an instant of your own time: their duration is greatly shortened, while your cooldowns keep recovering at full speed.
Being interrupted while using a long-cooldown ability refunds its cooldown entirely.
This is a time and composure effect.
duck.tag: This is a time and composure effect.

dust.name: Settling Grey
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Places you have fought in remember. Dust settles where you used each long-cooldown ability. Returning to that dust and spending mana replays a weaker echo of the ability where it was first used.
Each patch of dust lasts until the end of the day and can be used once.
This is a time and earth effect.
dust.tag: This is a time and earth effect.

earth.name: Strata
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each long-cooldown ability you use leaves a layer of stone underfoot. Standing on the layers grants damage reduction, and the reduction stacks for each layer present.
Layers last a short time and are shared with allies standing on them. Using an ability while standing on three or more layers consumes them to reduce its cooldown.
This is a time and earth effect.
earth.tag: This is a time and earth effect.

echo.name: Second Hearing
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your last long-cooldown ability echoes. A short time after it resolves, a fainter repetition resolves in the same place, dealing a portion of its damage or healing.
The echo can be cancelled by an enemy that stands in its centre when it arrives.
This is a time and sound effect.
echo.tag: This is a time and sound effect.

eclipse.name: Penumbral Pause
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, the light dims around you for a short time. Inside the dimmed area, enemies' cooldowns are frozen and your own continue.
Allies inside the dimmed area are concealed from enemies outside it.
This is a darkness and time effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and time effect.

edifice.name: Load-Bearing Moment
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, you can raise a pillar where you stand that lasts until the ability is ready again. While it stands, allies within its shadow take reduced damage.
If the pillar is destroyed, the ability's remaining cooldown is shortened by half.
This is a time and construction effect.
edifice.tag: This is a time and construction effect.

effigy.name: Burnt Double
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
For a short time after you use a long-cooldown ability, damage you take is held in a straw effigy at your feet instead of reaching you. When the effigy burns out, the held damage arrives all at once.
Healing and shielding you receive before then reduce the held damage first. The effigy can be targeted and destroyed by enemies, releasing it early.
This is a time and effigy effect.
effigy.tag: This is a time and effigy effect.

elemental.name: Cycle of Elements
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your abilities are tied to an elemental cycle that turns over time. Abilities whose element matches the current phase recover their cooldowns faster.
You can spend mana to turn the cycle forward to the next phase. This has a long cooldown.
This is a time and elemental effect.
elemental.tag: This is a time and elemental effect.

elixir.name: Aged Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Potions you carry age while they sit in your inventory, growing stronger the longer they are kept, up to a cap set by rank.
Drinking a potion while a long-cooldown ability is recharging reduces that cooldown by a portion.
This is a time and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a time and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Lent Hour
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can touch an ally and give them your readiness. One of your ready long-cooldown abilities goes on cooldown, and the ally's longest recovering ability becomes ready.
The ally's next use of that ability is empowered with a portion of your power. This cannot target the same ally again until your ability is ready.
This is a time and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is a time and empowerment effect.

eye.name: The Watched Clock
