eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can see the cooldowns of enemies you look at. Each enemy displays which of its abilities are ready and how long until the others will be.
An enemy whose strongest ability you watched recharge takes increased damage from you in the brief window after it uses it.
This is a time and perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a time and perception effect.

feast.name: Second Course
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Food you eat lasts longer, and its effects can be stored rather than spent. Stored meals can be eaten in an instant during a fight, granting their full benefit.
Eating a stored meal during a fight reduces your longest cooldown by a portion. You can store a small number of meals, set by rank.
This is a time and sustenance effect.
feast.tag: This is a time and sustenance effect.

feeble.name: Withered Hours
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can steal time from an enemy. Striking an enemy with a long-cooldown ability adds a portion of that ability's cooldown to the enemy's own cooldowns.
An enemy that has had time stolen is also weakened, dealing reduced damage until its abilities recover.
This is a time and weakening effect.
feeble.tag: This is a time and weakening effect.

fertile.name: Sown Seconds
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, a seed of time is planted where you stand. It sprouts as the ability recovers and ripens when the ability is ready.
An ally who walks over a ripe seed is healed and has the cooldown of their slowest ability shortened. Unharvested seeds wither at the end of the fight.
This is a time and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a time and growth effect.

fey.name: Fairy Ring
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Once per fight, you can spend mana to raise a ring of mushrooms. Inside the ring, time runs fast for allies: their cooldowns recover at a greatly accelerated rate. No one inside can leave until the ring fades.
Enemies that step inside lose track of time and stand dazed until struck.
This is a time and fey effect.
fey.tag: This is a time and fey effect.

fire.name: Banked Ember
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Fire you set does not go out; it waits. Burning effects you inflict that expire leave a banked ember on the ground.
You can spend mana to rekindle every banked ember in sight at once, each erupting into a burst of fire damage. Embers fade at the end of the fight.
This is a time and fire effect.
fire.tag: This is a time and fire effect.

firebird.name: Ember Return
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Using a long-cooldown ability leaves an ember where you stood. Until the ability is ready again, you can spend mana to return to the ember, which bursts into flame as you arrive.
The burst inflicts fire damage on nearby enemies and cleanses one affliction from you.
This is a fire, teleport and time effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire, teleport and time effect.

fish.name: Turning Shoal
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you are in water, your long-cooldown abilities recover faster, and moving through water grants a brief boon of movement speed after leaving it.
You can spend mana to have water flow backward in a small area, pulling enemies inside toward its source.
This is a time and water effect.
fish.tag: This is a time and water effect.

flea.name: Skipped Instant
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can skip forward through a moment. You vanish and reappear a short distance away, a brief instant later, as though you had been there all along. Attacks aimed at you in that instant miss.
This costs stamina and can be used a few times before its long cooldown begins.
This is a time and movement effect.
flea.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

flesh.name: Flesh Remembers
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your body remembers its unhurt state. A short time after you take a heavy hit, a portion of its damage is undone as your flesh returns to how it was.
Damage that would kill you is not undone. Catastrophic wounds are partly restored.
This is a time and restoration effect.
flesh.tag: This is a time and restoration effect.

foot.name: Measured March
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Distance you travel is counted as time. Walking or running without using abilities recovers your long cooldowns faster.
When you enter combat after a long march, you gain a brief boon of increased movement speed and stamina recovery.
This is a time and endurance effect.
foot.tag: This is a time and endurance effect.

force.name: Withheld Blow
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can choose to hold the impact of a long-cooldown special attack. It strikes with no damage, and its full force is stored in your hands.
Your next ordinary attack within a short window releases the stored impact on its target, adding the held damage and a heavy knockback.
This is a force and time effect.
force.tag: This is a force and time effect.

forge.name: Tempered Hours
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each heavy blow you take while a long-cooldown ability is recovering shortens its cooldown slightly.
An ability that becomes ready this way is tempered: its next use ignores a portion of the target's armour.
This is a time and forging effect.
forge.tag: This is a time and forging effect.

fork.name: Branching Moment
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When you use a long-cooldown ability, the moment branches. For a short time afterward, you can choose to use it again on a different target or place, resolving as though the first use never happened. The first use is then undone.
Using the branch places the ability on a longer cooldown than normal.
This is a time and choice effect.
fork.tag: This is a time and choice effect.

fortress.name: Keep's Hour
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can stop your own time. For a short duration you cannot act or move, and nothing can damage you, afflict you or move you.
While you are stopped, your cooldowns continue to recover at an accelerated rate.
This is a time and fortification effect.
fortress.tag: This is a time and fortification effect.

fox.name: Borrowed Minute
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can borrow a cooldown from the future. A recharging ability becomes ready immediately, but the time is owed: your next use of it carries double its normal cooldown.
If an enemy dies to the borrowed use, the debt is forgiven. Only one cooldown can be borrowed at a time.
This is a time and trickery effect.
fox.tag: This is a time and trickery effect.

frog.name: Spring Tadpole
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can coil a leap and hold it. A held leap grows in distance the longer it is held, and landing from a fully held leap knocks back enemies around you.
While coiled you cannot attack, but your cooldowns recover faster.
This is a time and movement effect.
frog.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

fungus.name: Spore Clock
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can sow a ring of spores that matures over time. Enemies who enter an immature ring are briefly slowed; enemies who enter a mature ring are afflicted with a stacking poison and lose a portion of their boons' remaining duration.
Rings mature over a short time and can be sown a limited number of times per fight.
This is a time and fungal effect.
fungus.tag: This is a time and fungal effect.

garuda.name: Suspended Wing
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
At the peak of a leap or movement ability, you can hold the moment while the world around you slows, giving you time to aim.
A long-cooldown ability used in that held moment has a shorter cooldown and drives down onto its target, ignoring cover.
This is a time and flight effect.
garuda.tag: This is a time and flight effect.

gate.name: Threshold of Hours
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Passing through a threshold such as a region border, an astral portal or a dungeon door resets the cooldowns of all of your long-cooldown abilities.
Once per day, you can spend mana to conjure a doorway and step through it to the other side of a nearby wall, counting as a threshold. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a space and time effect.
gate.tag: This is a space and time effect.

gathering.name: Gathered Hours
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can draw scattered time to yourself. Using this pulls a portion of the remaining cooldown from every ally nearby and spreads it across your own recharging abilities, recovering theirs in exchange.
Allies must be within a short distance and must not be in the middle of using an ability.
This is a time and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a time and gathering effect.

glass.name: Pane of Then
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can conjure a pane of glass that shows the area as it was a short time ago. Enemies seen through it are shown at their past positions, and attacks you make through the pane strike where they were.
An enemy struck through the pane is briefly returned to that past position. The pane breaks after a short time or one returned enemy.
This is a time and glass effect.
glass.tag: This is a time and glass effect.

glimeron.name: Faceted Hour
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can split a long-cooldown ability into three facets. Each facet is a third of the ability's strength with a third of its cooldown, and can be used independently.
Using all three facets on the same target within a short window refracts them into a burst of light damage.
This is a light and time effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and time effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Hour
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Effects that would increase your cooldowns or slow their recovery are refused by you. Each refusal costs a small amount of stamina.
When you refuse an effect from an enemy, you gain a brief boon of increased resistance to being knocked back or moved.
This is a time and resistance effect.
goat.tag: This is a time and resistance effect.

gorgon.name: Statue's Second
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

An enemy that looks at you while you use a long-cooldown ability is turned briefly to stone and held out of time. Damage dealt to it while it is stone is stored, then applied all at once when it returns.
Higher-rank enemies resist the effect and are only slowed.
This is a petrification and time effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and time effect.

griffin.name: Talon's Appointment
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While a long-cooldown special attack is recovering, you can mark an enemy for it. When the attack becomes ready, you leap from where you stand onto the marked enemy and the attack lands on arrival.
The marked enemy is shown on your map until the appointment is kept.
This is a time and pursuit effect.
griffin.tag: This is a time and pursuit effect.

growth.name: Growing Season
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Boons you grant grow over their duration. A boon is weakest when first applied and strongest just before it expires.
You can spend mana to advance every boon on an ally to the end of its growth at once, granting its strongest effect for a brief time before it ends.
This is a time and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a time and growth effect.

guardian.name: Standing Watch
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can set one ally under your watch. The first time they fall below a quarter of their health, their time stops for a brief moment, during which nothing can harm them.
Triggering this extends the cooldown of your longest ability. It can trigger once per fight.
This is a time and protection effect.
guardian.tag: This is a time and protection effect.

hair.name: Grey Hairs
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Strands of your hair hold time. You can bind a strand to an ally, who can spend it to shorten one of their cooldowns. You can have a small number of strands bound at once.
A bound strand that goes unused returns to you at the end of the day, carrying a portion of the ally's spent cooldowns back to your own.
This is a time and binding effect.
hair.tag: This is a time and binding effect.

hammer.name: Struck Hour
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your heaviest blows ring like a bell. Striking an enemy with a long-cooldown ability tolls the hour: every enemy within the sound is briefly stunned as their next moment is struck out of them.
Each tolled enemy cannot be tolled again for some time. Higher-rank enemies are stunned for less.
This is a time and force effect.
hammer.tag: This is a time and force effect.

hand.name: Sleight of Hours
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can pass a cooldown from one of your abilities to another. The ability you take time from becomes ready faster, and the ability you give it to recharges slower.
Passing time between abilities costs nothing but can only be done while out of combat or in the instant after using a long-cooldown ability.
This is a time and craft effect.
hand.tag: This is a time and craft effect.

harmonic.name: The Tuned Hour
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When an ally uses an ability at the same moment you do, the two resonate. Both abilities resolve with increased effect, and both have their cooldowns reduced.
The window for resonance is short. Resonating with the same ally again within a short time has no effect.
This is a time and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a time and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Snatched Seconds
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Your long-cooldown abilities steal time from what they strike. Each enemy hit has the cooldown of its strongest ability extended, and your ability's own cooldown is shortened by a portion of what was taken.
Enemies robbed this way shriek, and nearby enemies are briefly distracted.
This is a time and theft effect.
harpy.tag: This is a time and theft effect.

harvest.name: Gleaned Hours
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
An enemy killed by one of your long-cooldown abilities gives back time to it, shortening its next cooldown in proportion to the enemy's rank.
Killing several enemies with one use banks the excess as stored time, which you can spend on any other ability.
This is a time and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a time and harvest effect.

heidel.name: The Long Haul
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While mounted, your long-cooldown abilities recover while you travel as though you were resting, and your mount does not tire.
When you dismount into a fight, you can spend the time gathered on the journey to have one long-cooldown ability immediately ready.
This is a time and travel effect.
heidel.tag: This is a time and travel effect.

hook.name: Caught Moment
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can hook a fleeting moment and drag it back. When an enemy uses a movement ability to get away from you, you can spend stamina to pull it back to where it started, cancelling the movement.
This has a long cooldown and higher-rank enemies are pulled back only partway.
This is a time and restraint effect.
hook.tag: This is a time and restraint effect.

horse.name: Gallop's Lead
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Moving quickly carries you ahead of time. While at full movement speed, every few seconds you gain a brief window in which your next ability resolves before enemies can react, ignoring their dodges and interrupts.
Stopping or being slowed ends the effect until you build speed again.
This is a time and movement effect.
horse.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

hunger.name: Starved Hours
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your cooldowns feed on enemies. Each enemy you kill recovers a portion of every recharging cooldown you have; higher-rank kills recover more.
While you have gone without a kill for a long time in combat, your cooldowns recover more slowly, but your next kill recovers them entirely.
This is a time and hunger effect.
hunger.tag: This is a time and hunger effect.

hunt.name: The Chase Remembered
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can mark an enemy as your quarry. For as long as it is marked, you can see the path it has taken over the last short while, drawn on the ground and on the map, even after it escapes sight.
A marked quarry that flees you takes increased damage from your next long-cooldown ability. Only one quarry can be marked at a time.
This is a time and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a time and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrown Moment
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
If a long-cooldown ability is interrupted, countered or misses every target, it is not spent. It becomes ready again at once and its next use fires twice.
An ability can regrow this way once per fight.
This is a time and regeneration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a time and regeneration effect.

ice.name: Rime of Ages
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can encase a recharging ability in ice. While encased, its cooldown is paused, and it cannot be used. Encasing an ability also encases you in a thin shell of ice that reduces incoming damage.
Breaking the ice early releases the paused cooldown with an additional reduction. The encasement lasts a short time.
This is a time and ice effect.
ice.tag: This is a time and ice effect.

immortal.name: Refused Hour
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, a lethal blow rewinds you instead. Your health, position and afflictions return to what they were a few seconds earlier.
Any long-cooldown ability you used during those seconds stays spent. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a time and rebirth effect.
immortal.tag: This is a time and rebirth effect.

iron.name: Cold Iron Hour
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your cooldowns cannot be lengthened or tampered with by enemies. Effects that would do so instead fail and grant you a brief boon of increased physical resistance.
Your longest cooldown cannot be reset or refreshed by any means, but while it is recharging you resist knockdown and stun.
This is a time and iron effect.
iron.tag: This is a time and iron effect.

juggernaut.name: Unbroken Hour
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you keep moving without stopping, your long-cooldown abilities recover faster, and the effect builds the longer you move.
Being stopped by a root, stun or knockback ends the build-up, and the enemy that stopped you takes damage in proportion to it.
This is a time and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a time and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Settled Account
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, every enemy that damages you has the damage recorded against them.
When the ability becomes ready, each recorded enemy in sight takes a portion of the damage it dealt you. The ledger then clears.
This is a time and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is a time and retribution effect.

knife.name: Edge Between Ticks
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can strike in the gap between an enemy's moments. An attack made in the instant after an enemy finishes an action ignores its defences and cannot be dodged.
The window is brief and appears as a flicker on the enemy. Hitting it reduces the cooldown of your next special attack.
This is a time and precision effect.
knife.tag: This is a time and precision effect.

knowledge.name: Annotated Hour
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You keep a journal of each fight. After any fight against an enemy type, its abilities and their cooldowns are written down, and you can read them during later fights against that type.
Enemies you have fully documented take increased damage from your long-cooldown abilities. Absorbing a skill book while a cooldown is recharging resets that cooldown.
This is a time and knowledge effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a time and knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under the Hour
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Your longest-cooldown ability can drag an enemy under time. The enemy vanishes from the fight and is held in a slowed instant. It returns where it was when the effect ends, unaware that any time has passed.
Higher-rank enemies return sooner. Only one enemy can be held at a time.
This is a time and banishment effect.
kraken.tag: This is a time and banishment effect.

leviathan.name: Long Wake
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities leave a wake behind where they resolve. Until the ability is ready again, the wake rolls outward at intervals, pushing enemies away and slowing them.
Allies caught in the wake are carried along it, gaining movement speed.
This is a water and time effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and time effect.

life.name: Season's Return
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Healing you receive is remembered. Once per fight, when you fall below a portion of your health, all the healing you received in the last short time is applied to you again at once.
The remembered healing cannot exceed a cap set by rank.
This is a time and healing effect.
life.tag: This is a time and healing effect.

light.name: Afterimage of Noon
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Light remembers where you were. Each time you use a long-cooldown ability, an afterimage of you is left behind in light. Enemies that look upon an afterimage are blinded briefly.
You can spend mana to swap places with your most recent afterimage. Afterimages fade after a short time.
This is a time and light effect.
light.tag: This is a time and light effect.

lightning.name: Stopped Bolt
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can halt a lightning strike between moments. The strike hangs in the air as a crackling line until you release it or until a short time passes, damaging and stunning any enemy who walks through it.
Releasing the bolt sends it to its original target with increased damage. Only one bolt can be held at a time.
This is a time and lightning effect.
lightning.tag: This is a time and lightning effect.

lizard.name: Basking Hours
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Standing in sunlight or near heat stores warmth. Stored warmth can be spent to make your cooldowns recover rapidly for a short time.
In cold or darkness your cooldowns recover slightly slower, but you also regenerate lost limbs and severe wounds over time.
This is a time and regeneration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a time and regeneration effect.

locust.name: Plague Year
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can call down a swarm that eats time. Enemies within the swarm have their boons consumed one by one, and each boon consumed reduces one of your cooldowns.
The swarm lasts briefly and can only be called once per fight. Boons granted by higher-rank enemies take longer to eat.
This is a time and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is a time and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Once per fight, you can return your body to the moment before your most recent afflictions landed. Every affliction applied to you in the last few seconds is removed, along with the damage those afflictions dealt.
While you sit at rest out of combat, your long-cooldown abilities recover at an accelerated rate.
This is a time and cleanse effect.
lotus.tag: This is a time and cleanse effect.

lurker.name: Waiting Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can sink beneath the moment. While submerged, you are hidden from enemies and cannot act, but your cooldowns recover at a greatly increased rate.
Surfacing next to an enemy grants your first attack increased damage. You can remain submerged only briefly, and this has a long cooldown.
This is a time and stealth effect.
lurker.tag: This is a time and stealth effect.

magic.name: Suspended Casting
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can hold a long-cooldown spell at the instant of release, keeping it poised for a short time without its cooldown beginning. Releasing it casts it at full effect at any target in range.
While a spell is held, your mana recovers rapidly. If the hold runs out, the spell fizzles and its cooldown begins at full length.
This is a magic and time effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and time effect.

malign.name: Grudge Ledger
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When an enemy strikes you with a heavy blow, the moment is recorded against it. The next long-cooldown ability you use on that enemy inflicts additional damage equal to a portion of every recorded blow.
A grudge against a named or elite enemy is not cleared by leaving the fight. It waits until it is paid.
This is a dark and retribution effect.
malign.tag: This is a dark and retribution effect.

manatee.name: Slack Water
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you are out of combat and standing in water or walking slowly, your long-cooldown abilities recover significantly faster.
When you enter combat with a long-cooldown ability ready, an unhurried current spreads from you for a brief time, slowing the attacks and movement of nearby enemies.
This is a water and time effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and time effect.

manticore.name: Patient Quill
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A long-cooldown special attack plants a quill in its target. The quill waits until that enemy uses its own strongest ability, then stings, poisoning it and adding to that ability's cooldown.
A quill that never triggers stings when the enemy falls below half health instead.
This is a poison and time effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and time effect.

master.name: Practiced Hour
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each use of a long-cooldown ability builds practice in it, up to a limit. Each stack of practice shortens that ability's cooldown, and practice carries over between fights.
Practice in an ability fades if you go a full day without using it.
At full practice, the ability can be used without its wind-up animation.
This is a time and mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a time and mastery effect.

might.name: Gathered Blow
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A long-cooldown ability that is ready but unused gathers force. The longer it waits, the more damage and knockback it carries, up to a limit.
Used at its limit, it staggers every enemy it strikes, including enemies of higher rank.
This is a force and time effect.
might.tag: This is a force and time effect.

ministration.name: Quiet Room
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When you use a long-cooldown ability, you can lay a quiet room around nearby allies for a short time. Inside it, harmful afflictions on allies run their course at a greatly accelerated rate, while their boons hold still.
Allies leaving the room keep whatever boons remained.
This is a time and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a time and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Hour
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your longest-cooldown ability closes the area around its impact into a loop for a short time. An enemy that tries to leave the area reappears at the point where it first entered.
While the loop holds, you take reduced damage from enemies inside it.
This is a time and space effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a time and space effect.

mirage.name: A Moment Behind
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
For a short time after you use a long-cooldown ability, enemies see you as you were a moment ago. Their attacks and abilities aim at that image.
Attacks that strike the image deal no damage, and each miss shortens your ability's cooldown slightly.
This is an illusion and time effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and time effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, a reflection of that moment hangs in the air where you stood for a short time.
You can spend mana to have the reflection answer, repeating the ability from its original position at a portion of its effect. Each use can be reflected only once.
This is a reflection and time effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and time effect.

monkey.name: Nimble Minute
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can swap the remaining cooldowns of two of your abilities, provided neither is ready.
The swap costs stamina. Two abilities swapped this way cannot be swapped again until both have been used.
This is a trickery and time effect.
monkey.tag: This is a trickery and time effect.

monolith.name: Waymark Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can raise one standing stone in each region. It stays there permanently and is marked on your map.
When you return to one of your stones, your long-cooldown abilities reset, and you recover your health and mana. Each stone can do this once per day.
Moving a stone requires raising it again somewhere else in that region.
This is a time and earth effect.
monolith.tag: This is a time and earth effect.

moon.name: Waxing Hour
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Your long-cooldown abilities turn through phases shown on your status bar: waxing, full and waning. Used while full, they have significantly increased effect. Used while waning, their next cooldown is shortened instead.
The phases turn over a few minutes. At night, the full phase lasts longer.
This is a moon and time effect.
moon.tag: This is a moon and time effect.

mouse.name: Stolen Seconds
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each time an attack misses you or you dodge it cleanly, you steal a few seconds from it. They come off whichever of your abilities has the longest cooldown remaining.
Seconds can be stolen only once every brief interval, and not from attacks you block or absorb.
This is an evasion and time effect.
mouse.tag: This is an evasion and time effect.

myriad.name: Countless Instants
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, you can spend a large amount of mana to have a version of yourself from a few seconds earlier appear where you stood then and use it as well, at reduced effect.
The earlier self vanishes once the ability resolves and cannot be targeted. This can happen once per cooldown of the ability used.
This is a time and duplication effect.
myriad.tag: This is a time and duplication effect.

mystic.name: Known Hour
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can see how long each enemy within aura-sense range has before its strongest ability is ready.
When an enemy's strongest ability is about to become ready, you are warned. The next dodge or movement ability you use within that window costs no stamina.
This is a time and perception effect.
mystic.tag: This is a time and perception effect.

nebula.name: Smeared Moment
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can release a long-cooldown ability as a slow cloud instead of a single burst. The cloud drifts over its area and applies the ability's effects over time, for greater total damage and a wider area.
An ability released this way recovers only after the cloud disperses.
This is a time and space effect.
nebula.tag: This is a time and space effect.

needle.name: Pinned Instant
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A long-cooldown special attack that strikes an enemy's weak point pins its moment. For a short time the enemy's own cooldowns stop recovering and the afflictions on it stop expiring.
Enemies of higher rank are pinned for a briefer time.
This is a precision and time effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and time effect.

nemesis.name: The Long Grudge
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can name an enemy as your nemesis. The mark persists between fights and is tracked on your map. While you fight your nemesis, your long-cooldown abilities recover at an accelerated rate.
If your nemesis escapes, the next time you meet it all of your long-cooldown abilities are ready.
Only one nemesis can be named at a time.
This is a time and pursuit effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a time and pursuit effect.

net.name: Closing Mesh
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A long-cooldown ability that strikes several enemies weaves a mesh of time between them. For a short time, every enemy caught acts at the speed of the slowest among them.
Enemies caught in the mesh cannot use movement abilities.
This is a time and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a time and restraint effect.

network.name: Synchronised Hour
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Party members and companions are linked to your clock. Whenever any linked ally uses a long-cooldown ability, every linked ally's long-cooldown abilities recover slightly.
You can see the cooldowns of linked allies.
This is a time and connection effect.
network.tag: This is a time and connection effect.

oasis.name: Shaded Interval
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can open a shaded interval: a small area where allies recover health, mana and stamina as though they were out of combat, for a short time.
For the first moments it stands, enemies cannot enter it.
This is a time and refuge effect.
oasis.tag: This is a time and refuge effect.

ocean.name: Tidal Clock
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your cooldowns follow a tide. At flood, your long-cooldown abilities recover quickly. At ebb, they recover slowly, but any long-cooldown ability you use then deals significantly more damage.
The tide is shown on your interface. Using a long-cooldown ability at the turn of the tide reverses it immediately.
This is a water and time effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and time effect.

octopus.name: Eight Patient Hours
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While one of your long-cooldown abilities is active or being channelled, you can activate another without interrupting the first.
Each additional ability held at once raises the mana cost of the next. Being stunned drops all but the first.
This is a time and concurrency effect.
octopus.tag: This is a time and concurrency effect.

omen.name: Read Hour
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Shortly before a powerful enemy uses its own long-cooldown ability or strongest attack, a sign marks the ground where it will land and when.
If you strike that enemy with one of your long-cooldown abilities in the instant before its attack resolves, its attack is interrupted and its cooldown begins again from the start.
This is a precognition and time effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and time effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each hit you land within a short gap of the last builds rhythm. Each beat of rhythm shortens the cooldown of your long-cooldown abilities slightly.
At full rhythm, you can use a long-cooldown ability without breaking your attack chain or cancelling your current attack. Missing a beat resets the rhythm.
This is a time and momentum effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a time and momentum effect.

pangolin.name: Curled Hour
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can spend stamina to curl into a single moment. For a brief time you cannot act or move, you take no damage, and all your cooldowns recover at a greatly accelerated rate.
Enemies who strike you while you are curled are knocked back.
This is a defensive and time effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and time effect.

paper.name: Written Hour
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to write a ready long-cooldown ability onto a page, starting its cooldown. The page goes into your inventory as an item.
Reading the page uses the ability once, with no cooldown. You can hold one page per ability, and pages crumble after a day.
This is a scribing and time effect.
paper.tag: This is a scribing and time effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Phantom Replay
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Enemies struck by a long-cooldown ability keep reliving it. At intervals until the ability is ready again, they see it strike them a second time as an illusion and flinch, interrupting whatever they are doing.
Each replay deals a small amount of mind damage.
This is an illusion and time effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and time effect.

phoenix.name: Ashen Restart
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, falling to low health resets every one of your cooldowns in a burst of flame. The burst inflicts fire damage on nearby enemies and heals you for a portion of your maximum health.
This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, time and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire, time and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Patient Bloom
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Using a long-cooldown ability while standing still plants a seed at your feet. The seed grows for as long as the ability's cooldown lasts.
When the ability is ready again, the seed blooms, healing allies near it and restoring a portion of your mana and stamina. A seed withers if you travel far from it.
This is a plant and time effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and time effect.

potent.name: Distilled Moment
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can pour a ready long-cooldown ability into another, starting its cooldown without using it. The receiving ability gains significantly increased effect on its next use.
An ability can hold only one distillation at a time.
This is a power and time effect.
potent.tag: This is a power and time effect.

predatory.name: Stalker's Patience
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you are tracking one enemy without being noticed, patience builds over time.
Your next long-cooldown ability used on that enemy deals bonus damage that scales with your patience, and has its cooldown refunded in part.
Being noticed by the enemy halves the patience you have built.
This is a time and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is a time and hunting effect.

prison.name: Held Sentence
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When your longest-cooldown ability strikes an enemy, you can imprison one of that enemy's abilities. The imprisoned ability cannot be used for as long as your ability is recovering.
Only one ability can be imprisoned at a time. Higher-rank enemies serve a shorter sentence.
This is a time and binding effect.
prison.tag: This is a time and binding effect.

prosperity.name: Bought Time
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend gold to reset the cooldown of a long-cooldown ability. The price scales with your rank and with how much cooldown remains.
Each time you buy time in a fight, the price for the rest of that fight rises.
This is a time and wealth effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a time and wealth effect.

pure.name: Unmarked Moment
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, you are cleansed of all afflictions and are immune to new ones for a short time.
Long-cooldown abilities you use cannot be reduced, resisted or reflected by enemy effects.
This is a purity and time effect.
pure.tag: This is a purity and time effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt Hour
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When your health falls below a quarter, the cooldowns of your movement abilities end at once, and your next movement ability carries you significantly further.
This happens once per fight.
This is a movement and time effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and time effect.

rake.name: Gathered Leavings
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
An enemy that dies while its own abilities are on cooldown leaves that unspent time behind as motes on the ground.
Walking through the motes gathers them. Each one shortens your longest remaining cooldown. Motes fade after a short time.
This is a harvest and time effect.
rake.tag: This is a harvest and time effect.

rat.name: Surviving Swarm
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities recover faster for each enemy within a short distance of you.
When you use a long-cooldown ability while surrounded, you can scatter into a swarm of rats that reforms a short distance away, out of reach of the enemies around you.
This is a survival and time effect.
rat.tag: This is a survival and time effect.

reagent.name: Steeping Time
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A potion you drink while a long-cooldown ability is recovering steeps into it, shortening its remaining cooldown.
When a long-cooldown ability becomes ready, the next potion you drink has increased effect.
This is an alchemy and time effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and time effect.

refracting.name: Bent Hour
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
For a short time after you use a long-cooldown ability, projectiles that reach you stop in the air.
When the effect ends, each held projectile resumes travelling, back the way it came, towards the enemy that fired it.
This is a time and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a time and deflection effect.

renewal.name: The Turning Season
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

Each long-cooldown ability you use advances the season by one and carries its gift. Spring heals allies near you. Summer grants you a boon of increased damage. Autumn strips a boon from each enemy struck. Winter slows each enemy struck.
The season resets to spring when you rest.
This is a life and time effect.
renewal.tag: This is a life and time effect.

resolute.name: Unmoved Hour
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

While you stand without moving, time cannot be taken from you. Your cooldowns cannot be lengthened, your boons cannot be shortened or stripped, and enemies of your rank or lower cannot stun you or knock you down.
Moving ends the effect. It returns once you have stood still for a moment.
This is a resolve and time effect.
resolute.tag: This is a resolve and time effect.

resonating.name: Resonant Hold
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each long-cooldown ability you hold ready, unused, hums. The hum stacks, and every ready ability increases the damage of all of your other abilities.
Using a humming ability releases its tone as a pulse that interrupts nearby enemies' channelled abilities.
This is a sound and time effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound and time effect.

roc.name: Shadow Before
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can aim a long-cooldown ability at a distant point and delay it. Your shadow falls across that point at once, slowing every enemy beneath it.
After a short delay, the ability lands there at significantly increased strength.
This is a time and shadow effect.
roc.tag: This is a time and shadow effect.

rune.name: Graven Hour
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can carve a rune into the ground where you stand. It records the next long-cooldown ability you use within it.
While you stand inside the rune, that ability's cooldown recovers significantly faster. You can keep only one rune, and it fades if you travel far from it.
This is a rune and time effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and time effect.

sacrifice.name: Paid in Years
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can reset the cooldown of a long-cooldown ability by paying for it out of your own lifespan. Your maximum health is reduced by a portion for each reset, until you rest out of combat.
Paying with a quarter or more of your maximum health also empowers the ability's next use.
This is a time and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a time and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Numberless Grains
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Every hit you land drops a grain into an hourglass on your status bar. When the hourglass is full, your longest remaining cooldown ends and the glass empties.
Enemies struck by a long-cooldown ability used from a full glass are half-buried for a brief time and cannot move.
This is an earth and time effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and time effect.

sceptre.name: Court Time
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you hold a long-cooldown ability ready, allies within your aura recover their own long-cooldown abilities faster.
When you use it, every ally in that aura has a portion of their remaining cooldowns cut away.
This is an authority and time effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and time effect.

scribe.name: Written Moment
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Outside of combat, you can write a ready long-cooldown ability onto a blank page. The ability goes on cooldown, and the page becomes an item in your inventory.
Reading the page later uses the ability once, regardless of its cooldown. You can carry only a few written pages at a time.
This is a time and inscription effect.
scribe.tag: This is a time and inscription effect.

serene.name: Still Water
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
After a short time without taking damage, you settle into stillness. While still, your cooldowns recover faster and enemy effects that slow, stun or steal time have no effect on you.
A long-cooldown ability used from stillness costs no mana. Taking damage breaks the stillness.
This is a calm and time effect.
serene.tag: This is a calm and time effect.

serpent.name: Coiled Wait
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A long-cooldown ability that sits ready and unused coils over time, up to a limit.
A fully coiled ability strikes instantly with no wind-up and cannot be dodged by enemies that are unaware of you.
This is a time and serpent effect.
serpent.tag: This is a time and serpent effect.

shark.name: Circling Hour
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
An enemy below half health bleeds time. Each hit you land on it shortens the cooldowns of your long-cooldown abilities.
You move faster toward bleeding enemies, and you can sense them through walls within a short distance.
This is a predation and time effect.
shark.tag: This is a predation and time effect.

shield.name: Held Moment
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to hold back a moment in front of you. For a brief time, every attack or projectile that would strike you or the allies behind you stops in mid-air.
When the hold ends, stopped projectiles fall harmlessly and enemies whose melee attacks were stopped are staggered. This has a long cooldown.
This is a defensive and time effect.
shield.tag: This is a defensive and time effect.

shimmer.name: Flicker
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, you flicker out of step with time for an instant. You cannot be targeted, and you reappear at a point of your choice a short distance away.
Enemies who were targeting you are dazzled and lose track of you for a brief time.
This is a light and time effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and time effect.

ship.name: Ship's Log
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can log your position, health and mana as an anchor. For a short time afterward, you can spend mana to return to the anchor, restoring the health and mana you had when you set it.
Afflictions gained after the anchor was set are not carried back. This has a long cooldown.
This is an anchor and return effect.
ship.tag: This is an anchor and return effect.

shovel.name: Buried Hour
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can bury a ready long-cooldown ability in the ground where you stand, starting its cooldown. Later you can dig it up from that spot and use it once without a cooldown.
A buried ability grows stronger the longer it stays in the ground. Allies in your party can dig it up as well. It is lost if you leave the region.
This is an earth and time effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and time effect.

sickle.name: Curved Harvest
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each enemy killed by one of your long-cooldown abilities gives back a portion of that ability's cooldown.
Killing enough enemies with a single use ends the cooldown entirely. This cannot happen twice in a row for the same ability.
This is a harvest and time effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and time effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Hour
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can step out of time for a few seconds. A likeness of you stays where you were, drawing enemy attention and taking hits.
When you step back in, you reappear anywhere near the likeness. Any long-cooldown ability you use on reappearing has its cooldown shortened.
This is a time and duplication effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a time and duplication effect.

sin.name: Borrowed Hour
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can use a long-cooldown ability that is still on cooldown by borrowing against the future. It fires at full effect, but its next cooldown is significantly longer.
While the debt is open, you carry an affliction that slowly drains your health. You can carry only one debt at a time.
This is a sin and time effect.
sin.tag: This is a sin and time effect.

skirmish.name: Given Ground
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each time you dodge away from an enemy's attack, your long-cooldown abilities recover slightly.
For a moment after a dodge, a long-cooldown ability costs no mana or stamina to use.
This is a time and movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

skunk.name: Lingering Warning
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Enemies struck by one of your long-cooldown abilities remember it. For a short time they will not approach you of their own accord.
A remembering enemy that is forced into melee range or chooses to attack anyway has its next attack slowed.
This is a fear and time effect.
skunk.tag: This is a fear and time effect.

sky.name: Held Height
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each time you leap, dash or use a movement ability, your long-cooldown abilities recover at a greatly accelerated rate for a moment.
Your leaps and dashes carry you further, and you cannot be knocked down while one carries you. A long-cooldown ability used straight after a leap can be aimed anywhere you can see.
This is an air and time effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and time effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Certainty
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities cannot miss and cannot be dodged.
Each one takes a moment to wind up. During the wind-up you cannot be interrupted, stunned or knocked down.
This is a certainty and time effect.
sloth.tag: This is a certainty and time effect.

smoke.name: Vanished Hour
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While no enemy can see you, your cooldowns recover significantly faster.
A long-cooldown ability used while unseen does not reveal you until it resolves.
This is a stealth and time effect.
smoke.tag: This is a stealth and time effect.

snake.name: Coiled Hour
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can coil a long-cooldown ability around yourself: it is activated but held, and strikes on its own the moment an enemy comes within reach.
An enemy struck this way is envenomed in time. Its own cooldowns recover slower for a short time.
This is a venom and time effect.
snake.tag: This is a venom and time effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Hour
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each long-cooldown ability you use leaves a rising updraft where you stood, lasting until the ability is ready again.
While standing in an updraft, you and your allies pay no stamina for attacks or movement, and the rushing air keeps ground effects from taking hold of you.
This is an air and time effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and time effect.

song.name: Refrain
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, a refrain sounds in time with it for a short while.
Any ability you or an ally uses on the beat of the refrain has its cooldown shortened. The beat is shown on your status bar and on the bars of allies in your party.
This is a sound and time effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and time effect.

sovereign.name: Decreed Hour
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use your longest-cooldown ability, you can decree that the enemies who heard it wait. No enemy within range can finish recovering an ability until yours is ready again.
Higher-rank enemies ignore the decree after a short time. The decree has its own cooldown, recovering over 24 hours.
This is a time and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a time and authority effect.

spear.name: Thrown Hour
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can throw a long-cooldown ability forward in time. It lands at a chosen spot a few seconds later, and its cooldown begins the moment you throw it.
An enemy standing on the spot when it lands cannot dodge it.
This is a time and projectile effect.
spear.tag: This is a time and projectile effect.

spider.name: Web of Hours
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to lay threads of sticky time across the ground. Enemies crossing a thread are slowed in movement and action for a short time.
You feel every crossing. Your next long-cooldown ability against an enemy caught in a thread takes no time to cast.
This is a web and time effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and time effect.

spike.name: Waiting Point
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
An enemy that stays in one place near you is marked by a growing point. The longer it stays put, the more damage your next long-cooldown ability deals to it.
The mark is lost the moment the enemy moves a significant distance.
This is a precision and time effect.
spike.tag: This is a precision and time effect.

staff.name: Third Leg
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities recover as you travel. Every stretch of ground you cover shortens them, in combat or out.
Standing still for a moment after a fight ends restores your stamina and ends the cooldown of your movement ability.
This is a travel and time effect.
staff.tag: This is a travel and time effect.

star.name: Old Light
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can see faint afterimages of where enemies stood a short time ago.
A long-cooldown ability aimed at an afterimage finds the enemy at its present position, ignoring cover and line of sight.
This is a light and time effect.
star.tag: This is a light and time effect.

stellar.name: Burning Core
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, heat gathers in you, rising as it nears readiness. In the last moments before it is ready, you radiate fire damage to every enemy near you.
Using the ability in that window adds the gathered heat to it as bonus fire damage.
This is a fire and time effect.
stellar.tag: This is a fire and time effect.

storm.name: Called Weather
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, you choose a weather that holds over the area until the ability is ready again.
Rain slows enemies. Wind quickens allies' movement. Lightning periodically strikes the enemy you most recently hit. You can only hold one weather at a time.
This is a storm and time effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and time effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities briefly charm lower-rank enemies they strike. While charmed, an enemy will not attack you.
The cooldown progress of a charmed enemy's abilities flows to you, shortening your own recovering abilities instead.
The charm breaks if the enemy takes damage.
This is a charm and time effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and time effect.

sun.name: High Noon
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When a long-cooldown ability becomes ready, it blazes for a short time. Used while blazing, it has significantly increased effect and blinds every enemy it strikes.
In daylight the blaze lasts longer. An ability whose blaze fades unused stays ready at normal strength.
This is a sun and time effect.
sun.tag: This is a sun and time effect.

swarm.name: Covering Cloud
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, a cloud of small biting things follows you, nipping at nearby enemies.
Each enemy the cloud bites shaves a little time off the ability's cooldown. The cloud disperses when the ability is ready.
This is a swarm and time effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and time effect.

swift.name: Quickened Hour
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
After you use a long-cooldown ability, you are hastened for a short time. Your attack, cast and movement speed increase, and your short-cooldown abilities recover faster.
Using another long-cooldown ability while hastened extends the haste instead of restarting it.
This is a speed and time effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and time effect.

sword.name: First Cut
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
The first special attack you make in a fight happens in a stopped instant. Enemies cannot react to it, and it strikes as though they were unaware.
If this first strike kills its target, its cooldown is significantly shortened.
This is a blade and time effect.
sword.tag: This is a blade and time effect.

talisman.name: Pocket Watch
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You carry a pocket watch that cannot be stolen or dropped. While it is in your inventory, your cooldowns recover at double rate out of combat.
You can hand the watch to a companion or party member, giving them the same effect. Only the person holding it benefits.
This is a time and talisman effect.
talisman.tag: This is a time and talisman effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Hour
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can spend mana to seize an enemy's most recent ability. Its cooldown is significantly lengthened, and you gain a brief boon that adds that ability's damage type to your attacks.
Enemies of higher rank lose less time to the seizure.
This is a time and theft effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a time and theft effect.

thread.name: Binding Strand
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can tie a thread between two of your abilities. Whenever either one is used, the other's cooldown advances by a portion.
Threads can only be tied or retied out of combat, at a cost of mana. Only one thread can exist at a time.
This is a binding and time effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and time effect.

thunderbird.name: Loyal Storm
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Using a long-cooldown ability calls a storm cloud that follows you until the ability is ready again.

Allies beneath the cloud recover cooldowns faster. Enemies beneath it are drenched and take increased lightning damage. When the cloud departs, it ends with a single thunderclap that interrupts nearby enemies.
This is a storm and time effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and time effect.

time.name: Rewound Hour
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, you can rewind the last few seconds for yourself and every ally near you. Health, mana, stamina, position and afflictions return to what they were.
Enemies are not rewound, and everything that happened to them in those seconds stands. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a time effect.

tranquil.name: Settled Dust
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Effects that lengthen your cooldowns, slow your actions or speed up enemies' actions have no hold on you.
While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, enemies near you lose their haste boons, and their channelled abilities take longer to complete.
This is a time and calm effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a time and calm effect.

transfiguration.name: Second Clock
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You keep two clocks. Once per fight, you can transfigure your body and switch to the second clock, on which every one of your abilities has its own separate cooldown, all of them ready.
Switching back restores the first clock as you left it, with the time spent on the second clock added to its recovery.
This is a time and transformation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a time and transformation effect.

transgression.name: Broken Rule
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

You can use a long-cooldown ability while it is recovering by breaking the rule that binds it. Until the ability would have been ready, you are marked as a transgressor and take increased damage from every source.
Enemies that strike a transgressor are revealed on your map.
This is a time and transgression effect.
transgression.tag: This is a time and transgression effect.

trap.name: Sprung Instant
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
