You can spend mana to set a snare of stopped time on the ground. The first enemy to step on it is frozen in place for a brief time.
Your long-cooldown abilities deal increased damage to frozen enemies. You can have a few snares set at once, and they last until triggered or until you leave the area.
This is a trap and time effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and time effect.

tree.name: Rings of Years
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Each long-cooldown ability you use grows a ring. Every ring raises your maximum health slightly, and rings last until you rest.
You can spend all your rings at once to end the cooldown of one long-cooldown ability. The more rings spent, the more health you are healed as well.
This is a life and time effect.
tree.tag: This is a life and time effect.

troll.name: Closing Hour
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While your longest-cooldown ability is recovering, you regenerate health at a pace that keeps time with it. By the time it is ready, you have recovered a large portion of your maximum health.
Fire damage halts the regeneration until the ability is next used.
This is a regeneration and time effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and time effect.

trowel.name: Layered Hours
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
A long-cooldown ability used at the same place as your previous use is laid over it. Each layer leaves a lingering zone that repeats a portion of the ability's effect for a short time.
Layers stack up to a limit and crumble if you use a long-cooldown ability elsewhere.
This is a construction and time effect.
trowel.tag: This is a construction and time effect.

turtle.name: Long Shell
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you use a long-cooldown ability, a shell forms around you that absorbs damage until the ability is ready again. The longer the cooldown, the stronger the shell.
If the shell breaks, that ability's remaining cooldown recovers faster for the rest of its duration.
This is a defensive and time effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and time effect.

twilight.name: Stayed Dusk
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, you can hold the grey hour over the area around you. Until you leave that area, it stays at dusk, whatever the time of day.
In the held dusk, you and your allies are harder to see, and your long-cooldown abilities recover faster. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a darkness and time effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and time effect.

undeath.name: Stopped Heart
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When your health would reach zero, your heart stops instead. You keep fighting for as long as your longest-cooldown ability still needs to recover, up to a short limit, and you cannot be healed during that time.
If you are not healed above a quarter of your health when the time runs out, you die. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a death and time effect.
undeath.tag: This is a death and time effect.

unity.name: Shared Hour
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].

When you use a long-cooldown ability, nearby allies can take on part of its cooldown. Each ally who does so has one of their own abilities delayed slightly, and your cooldown is shortened by the same amount for each.
Allies who shared the burden gain a brief boon of reduced damage taken.
This is a time and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a time and unity effect.

vast.name: Borderless Moment
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, you can spread a single moment across a wide area. For a short time, everything in it except you and your allies is stopped.
Stopped enemies cannot be damaged. Damage you deal to them is held and lands all at once when time resumes. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a space and time effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and time effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling League
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While mounted, your long-cooldown abilities recover significantly faster and can be used without dismounting.
Dismounting during combat ends the cooldown of your movement ability.
This is a mount and time effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a mount and time effect.

venom.name: Slow-Working Hours
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Enemies struck by your long-cooldown abilities are poisoned in time. Their own cooldowns recover slower for a long duration, stacking with each strike.
The poison is an affliction and can be cleansed.
This is a venom and time effect.
venom.tag: This is a venom and time effect.

verdant.name: Overgrown Hour
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Where your long-cooldown abilities land, creepers begin to grow, spreading across the ground as the ability recovers.
Enemies caught in the creepers are slowed, and are rooted once the growth is mature. Burning the creepers clears them.
This is a growth and time effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and time effect.

vessel.name: Held Vessel
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When an enemy's spell strikes you while your longest-cooldown ability is ready, you can catch the spell instead of being hit, spending your ability's readiness.
The caught spell is held in you until your ability is ready again. You can then release it at an enemy of your choice, at its original strength.
This is a time and absorption effect.
vessel.tag: This is a time and absorption effect.

visage.name: Old Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, you can put on the face you wore when the fight began. Every one of your abilities returns to the cooldown state it was in at that moment.
Health, mana and afflictions are unaffected. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an identity and time effect.
visage.tag: This is an identity and time effect.

vision.name: Ghosts Ahead
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While a long-cooldown ability is recovering, faint ghosts show where each nearby enemy will be a moment later.
A long-cooldown ability aimed at a ghost strikes the enemy at that future position and cannot be dodged.
This is a time and foresight effect.
vision.tag: This is a time and foresight effect.

void.name: Unmade Moment
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, you can cast the last moment that struck you into nothing. The damage and afflictions from that attack are undone.
The enemy that made the attack loses the ability it used for the rest of the fight. Enemies of higher rank lose it only for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a void and time effect.
void.tag: This is a void and time effect.

volcano.name: Pressure Valve
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Every other ability you use while your longest-cooldown ability is recovering adds pressure.
When that ability is next used, it vents all of the pressure as an eruption around you, inflicting fire damage and leaving burning ground that scales with how much pressure was built.
This is a fire and time effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and time effect.

vortex.name: Drawn Hour
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities open a vortex at their point of impact that pulls nearby enemies inward for a short time.
Each enemy drawn all the way to the centre shortens the ability's cooldown slightly.
This is an air and time effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and time effect.

wasp.name: Many Stings
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
You can break a long-cooldown ability into several weaker stings used in quick succession, each at a portion of its effect.
Each sting that hits shortens the ability's cooldown slightly, and enemies struck by every sting take damage over time.
This is a venom and time effect.
wasp.tag: This is a venom and time effect.

water.name: Running Time
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
While you stand in water or rain, your cooldowns recover faster.
A long-cooldown ability used while you stand in water sends a wave of slowed time through all connected water, slowing every enemy standing in it.
This is a water and time effect.
water.tag: This is a water and time effect.

weave.name: Woven Hours
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Outside of combat, you can weave two long-cooldown abilities together. Using either one advances the other's recovery.
Using both within a short window binds them into a single combined effect that carries both abilities' effects at once.
Only one pair can be woven at a time.
This is a time and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is a time and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Hunger Clock
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown abilities recover only while you are fed. Killing an enemy feeds you for a short time.
While you are starving, each kill instantly resets one recovering long-cooldown ability, and your attacks chill their targets, slowing them.
This is a cold and time effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and time effect.

whale.name: Long Note
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per fight, you can sing a long note. For as long as you hold it, draining mana, the cooldowns of every ally in a wide area recover at a greatly accelerated rate.
You cannot act or move while you sing, and taking heavy damage ends the note.
This is a song and time effect.
whale.tag: This is a song and time effect.

wheel.name: Turning Rim
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When you have used every one of your long-cooldown abilities, the wheel comes round. For the next turn, all of them recover significantly faster.
The turn is lost if you leave combat before completing it.
This is a cycle and time effect.
wheel.tag: This is a cycle and time effect.

whip.name: Cracked Moment
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Your long-cooldown special attacks crack the moment around their target. The enemy skips forward a few seconds: its current action is interrupted, and its boons lose that much of their duration.
Enemies of higher rank skip only a brief instant.
This is a lash and time effect.
whip.tag: This is a lash and time effect.

wind.name: Gale Hour
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Using a long-cooldown ability ends the cooldown of your movement ability.
Passing through enemies with a movement ability cuts the remaining cooldown of your long-cooldown abilities for each enemy passed through.
This is a wind and time effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and time effect.

wing.name: Hour Aloft
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
At the peak of a leap or a dash, time slows for you, and for a moment you cannot be knocked down.
A long-cooldown ability used in that slowed moment affects a significantly larger area.
This is a flight and time effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and time effect.

wolf.name: Pack Hour
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
When an ally, companion or summon near you uses a long-cooldown ability, your own long-cooldown abilities recover a portion.
When you use one, theirs do the same.
This is a pack and time effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and time effect.

wood.name: Heartwood
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Once per day, a blow that would deal catastrophic damage sets your body like wood for a moment. Its damage is spread over a long time rather than landing at once.
Healing received while the damage is spread reduces what remains of it. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a wood and time effect.
wood.tag: This is a wood and time effect.

wrath.name: Held Grudge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Damage you take builds wrath, up to a limit. You can spend all of your wrath to finish the cooldown of a long-cooldown ability at once.
An ability readied with wrath deals bonus fire damage on its next use. Wrath fades slowly out of combat.
This is a fire and time effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fire and time effect.

zeal.name: Sworn Hour
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
The first enemy you strike with a long-cooldown ability in a fight becomes your sworn target.
While you attack only your sworn target, your cooldowns recover faster. Attacking any other enemy ends the oath until the sworn target dies.
This is a conviction and time effect.
zeal.tag: This is a conviction and time effect.

ziz.name: Vast Hour
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Keeper of Moments. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Keeper of Moments].
Lower-rank enemies cannot lengthen your cooldowns, slow your actions or apply time effects to you.
Against lower-rank enemies, your long-cooldown abilities cover a significantly larger area, and their shadow on the ground slows those enemies before the abilities land.
This is a time and immensity effect.
ziz.tag: This is a time and immensity effect.

action.name: Quickened Tongue
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand intent in body language as plainly as speech. When an enemy within sight prepares a special attack, its name is spoken aloud in your mind before it resolves.
Speaking a single word of command costs stamina and makes a lower-rank enemy hesitate, delaying its next action by a moment.
This is a perception and command effect.
action.tag: This is a perception and command effect.

adept.name: Master's Marginalia
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

When you absorb a skill book, you can choose to keep a copy of its knowledge as marginalia instead of consuming it. Marginalia can be studied out of combat to raise that skill's level by one, once per rank.
You can read a skill book without absorbing it to learn what the skill does, how it advances and what it pairs well with.
This is a knowledge and absorption effect.
adept.tag: This is a knowledge and absorption effect.

alchemy.name: Formulary
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the recipe of any potion, elixir or poison by holding it, including ones you have never brewed. A recipe read this way is learned permanently.
Reading a recipe aloud while brewing it lets you substitute one reagent for another of the same family without loss of potency.
This is a comprehension and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a comprehension and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Hand Signs
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You and your companions share a silent sign language that needs no teaching. Orders given in it cannot be overheard and do not break stealth.
When you signal an attack on a target, every companion who can see you strikes it at the same moment. The first hit from each counts as an attack from concealment.
This is a communication and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a communication and stealth effect.

animate.name: Waking Word
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak to golems, animated armour, constructs and possessed objects, and they understand you regardless of who made them.
Spending mana, you can give a lower-rank construct a single instruction that overrides its maker's for a short time. A construct of equal rank resists unless already damaged.
This is a communication and command effect.
animate.tag: This is a communication and command effect.

anzu.name: Thunder Speech
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the speech of storms and storm-beasts. Lightning-aligned monsters are marked as able to parley, and some can be talked out of a fight.
Once per day you can shout a word in the storm-tongue. The shout deals lightning damage in a cone and deafens enemies, silencing their spells briefly. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a storm and sound effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and sound effect.

ape.name: Mimic's Throat
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the calls, hoots and warning cries of beasts as plainly as speech, including monsters with no language of their own.
You can spend stamina to imitate a beast's call. Beasts of that kind and of lower rank stop to answer it, breaking off pursuit or turning toward the sound for a short time.
This is a communication and lure effect.
ape.tag: This is a communication and lure effect.

armour.name: Plated Script
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the maker's marks, ward-script and runes worked into armour and shields, revealing the protections they grant and the damage types they leave exposed.
Once per rank, you can inscribe a line of ward-script into a piece of armour you own, adding a resistance to one damage type of your choice.
This is a perception and inscription effect.
armour.tag: This is a perception and inscription effect.

arsenal.name: Weapon Lore
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can read the maker's marks, inscriptions and runes on any weapon or armour, learning how it was meant to be used. Wielding a weapon whose marks you have read removes any proficiency penalty for its type.
Weapon skill books can be absorbed by touching the weapon type they describe, without the book itself.
This is a comprehension and martial effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a comprehension and martial effect.

aspect.name: Second Face
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You speak any language with the accent, idiom and manner of a native. People you speak to assume you belong to their own people unless you give them reason to doubt it.
You can adopt the bearing of a faction you have spoken with. While you do, members of that faction treat you as one of their own for the purposes of disposition and access.
This is an identity and social effect.
aspect.tag: This is an identity and social effect.

avatar.name: Proclamation
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your voice carries to everyone within a wide radius and is understood by every listener in their own tongue, including monsters capable of thought.
Once per fight you can proclaim yourself. Allies gain a boon of increased damage and resistance to fear, and lower-rank enemies must resist or be cowed for a short time.
This is a voice and aura effect.
avatar.tag: This is a voice and aura effect.

axe.name: Headsman's Verdict
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a sentence of judgement at an enemy within earshot by spending mana. The enemy understands it regardless of language.
The next special attack you land on that enemy within a short time deals significantly increased damage. If it is below a quarter of its health, the attack also staggers it.
This is a declaration and execution effect.
axe.tag: This is a declaration and execution effect.

balance.name: Even Tongue
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

In any negotiation, trade or dispute, you can see the point at which both sides would accept the outcome. Shop prices settle at the fairest value available to you rather than the merchant's opening price.
You can mediate a quarrel between two non-hostile characters. Both treat you favourably afterwards.
This is a perception and social effect.
balance.tag: This is a perception and social effect.

bat.name: Night Echoes
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak at a pitch only you and allies in your party can hear. Commands given this way travel through walls and darkness.
When you speak this way, the echo returns the shape of the space around you. Enemies hidden within a short range are revealed on the map for a brief time.
This is a communication and echolocation effect.
bat.tag: This is a communication and echolocation effect.

battlefield.name: Battle Cant
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the shouted orders of enemy groups. When an enemy leader issues a command, you learn which enemies it targets and what they will do.
You can spend stamina to shout a false order in the enemy's own tongue, causing a lower-rank group to break formation or retreat briefly.
This is a communication and tactical effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a communication and tactical effect.

bear.name: Den Speech
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can speak to territorial monsters before they attack. A beast of equal or lower rank that you address before combat begins may let you pass through its territory unchallenged instead of attacking.
If you attack a beast after it has let you pass, it and its kind in that region become permanently hostile.
This is a communication and parley effect.
bear.tag: This is a communication and parley effect.

bee.name: Hive Dance
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your summons and familiars understand one-word commands you give without speaking, and pass them to one another. A command given to one is followed by all.
Summons that receive a shared command gain a short burst of attack speed while carrying it out.
This is a command and summoning effect.
bee.tag: This is a command and summoning effect.

behemoth.name: Groundspeech
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can understand the low tremor-speech of great beasts and hear footfalls through the ground. Large creatures nearby are revealed by their tread, even out of sight.
Stamping costs stamina and speaks a challenge through the earth that forces large monsters to turn toward you, taunting them and briefly staggering any of lower rank.
This is a taunt and earth effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a taunt and earth effect.

bird.name: Songbird's Warning
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Birds and flying creatures nearby call out when an enemy approaches you, and you understand what they say: the direction, the number and roughly how dangerous.
Once per day you can ask the birds of a region to find something for you. A point near the nearest matching quest target, node or creature is marked on the map. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a communication and scouting effect.
bird.tag: This is a communication and scouting effect.

blight.name: Rot Lexicon
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read decay. Looking at a corpse, a ruined building or a withered field tells you what killed it and roughly how long ago.

Afflictions are legible to you. You see every affliction on a target, its source and how long it will last, and you can cleanse one disease or decay affliction from an ally by naming it, at a cost in mana.
This is a perception and cleanse effect.
blight.tag: This is a perception and cleanse effect.

blood.name: Blood Speaks
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can bind an agreement in blood with a willing character by spending a portion of your health. Whoever breaks the agreement takes a severe bleed affliction that cannot be cleansed by ordinary means.
While an oath with an ally holds, both of you regain a little health whenever the other deals damage.
This is a binding and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a binding and blood effect.

bone.name: Marrow Reading
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the inscriptions, carvings and grave-marks of the dead, including bone tablets and ossuaries no living scholar can translate.
Touching the bones of the dead lets you ask them one question. They answer with whatever they knew in life; a monster's bones reveal where its kind dens.
This is a necromantic and knowledge effect.
bone.tag: This is a necromantic and knowledge effect.

boundary.name: Law of the Line
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read wards, territorial markings and boundary stones, learning who set them and what they forbid. You can cross a ward you have read without triggering it.
Writing a single word on the ground costs mana and creates a line that lower-rank enemies will not willingly cross for a short time.
This is a ward and space effect.
boundary.tag: This is a ward and space effect.

bounty.name: Open-Handed Trade
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Merchants, farmers and quest-givers speak to you as one of their own. Shop prices are lower, and quest rewards include an additional item where one is available.
When you share a skill book's contents aloud, a companion learns the skill at its starting level as well. Each book can be shared once.
This is a social and teaching effect.
bounty.tag: This is a social and teaching effect.

bow.name: Called Shot
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can call out a target to your party. Every ally who hears it deals increased damage to that target with ranged attacks for a short time.
Calling a target also tells you, in plain words, the distance to it and how much its movement will throw off a shot.
This is a command and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a command and ranged effect.

brush.name: Root Whisper
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Plants, thickets and undergrowth remember who has passed through them, and you can ask. Speaking to vegetation reveals the trail of any creature that crossed it recently.
You can ask a thicket to part for you. Undergrowth and brush stop slowing your movement, and close behind you to slow anything following.
This is a nature and tracking effect.
brush.tag: This is a nature and tracking effect.

cage.name: Jailor's Word
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the binding-script on locks, seals, prison wards and magical restraints, and know the word that opens them. Locked doors and chests bearing such script can be opened at a cost in mana.
Spoken at an enemy, the same word closes around it, rooting it in place for a brief time.
This is a binding and unlocking effect.
cage.tag: This is a binding and unlocking effect.

cat.name: Silent Commerce
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can communicate with your party through glances and gestures alone, with no sound. Giving instructions this way does not break stealth.
While you are unseen, you can understand any conversation within a short range, even in a crowd, and catch the one sentence that matters most to your current quest.
This is a stealth and communication effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and communication effect.

cataclysm.name: Word of Ruin
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the stress in stone, wood and metal as if it were writing. Weak points in walls, floors and structures are revealed when you look at them.
Speaking a word of breaking to a revealed weak point costs mana and collapses it after a short delay, dealing heavy damage to everything beneath or beside it.
This is a perception and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a perception and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Herdspeaker
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Domesticated animals understand you and obey simple commands. Farm beasts, mounts and pack animals in a settlement can be asked to carry goods, block a road or stampede.
Your mount understands everything you say. While mounted it cannot be spooked, and it carries you at full speed through crowds and shallow water.
This is a communication and mount effect.
cattle.tag: This is a communication and mount effect.

chain.name: Linked Phrase
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can link two skill books you have absorbed. When you use a skill from one, the linked skill gains a brief bonus to its effect.
Links can be broken and remade out of combat. You can hold only one link per rank.
This is an absorption and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is an absorption and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Garbled Tongue
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can scramble the speech of others. Spending mana on an enemy caster garbles its incantations, giving each spell it casts a chance to fizzle or to take a random target, for a short time.
Enemies under this effect cannot coordinate with their allies; group abilities that require two or more of them fail.
This is a confusion and silence effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a confusion and silence effect.

charlatan.name: Silver Tongue
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak in any accent, dialect or voice you have heard, perfectly. Guards and townsfolk accept a plausible claim of identity or authority unless they have reason to doubt you.
Once per encounter you can talk a lower-rank intelligent enemy into believing you are an ally until you or your companions attack it.
This is a deception and social effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a deception and social effect.

chicken.name: Coop Gossip
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
In any settlement, you can hear what the townsfolk are saying about recent events. Rumours of nearby monsters, hidden caches and unfinished business are added to your quest log as leads.
When an enemy threatens a non-hostile character near you, every townsperson within earshot raises the alarm, drawing guards and revealing the attacker on the map.
This is a social and alarm effect.
chicken.tag: This is a social and alarm effect.

chimera.name: Many-Throated
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the speech of every beast. Monsters of any family can be read for mood, so you know which will flee, which will fight, and which are guarding young.
You can answer a beast in its own call. A lower-rank beast answered this way stops attacking you for a short time; one of the same family as your essences may follow you as a temporary ally.
This is a beast and communication effect.
chimera.tag: This is a beast and communication effect.

claw.name: Scored Speech
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the claw-marks, scratches and gouges monsters leave on trees, stone and bodies. Each mark tells you the species, its rank and whether it was marking territory or hunting.
Wounds you inflict with claw and blade attacks carry a mark of your own. Monsters of lower rank that find the mark avoid the area for a time.
This is a tracking and territory effect.
claw.tag: This is a tracking and territory effect.

cloth.name: Woven Word
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the patterns woven into cloth, banners and tapestries as text. Faction colours, family crests and hidden messages stitched into garments reveal their meaning.
Once per rank, you can stitch a phrase into a piece of cloth armour or a cloak. The wearer gains a minor boon matching the phrase while it is worn.
This is a perception and inscription effect.
cloth.tag: This is a perception and inscription effect.

cloud.name: Drifting Voice
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can release a sentence into the air to drift to a chosen ally anywhere in the same region. It reaches them after a short delay, whether or not they are in your party.
Spoken into fog or mist, your voice seems to come from everywhere at once. Enemies within the fog lose track of your position for a short time.
This is a communication and misdirection effect.
cloud.tag: This is a communication and misdirection effect.

cold.name: Frostbitten Word
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a single word of stillness at an enemy within earshot. It costs mana and chills the target, slowing its movement and the speed of its spellcasting for a short time.
The word cannot be shouted down. Enemies that rely on spoken incantations are silenced instead of slowed.
This is a cold and silence effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and silence effect.

coral.name: Reef Chorus
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak clearly while standing in water or soaked to the skin, and understand the language of anything that lives beneath the surface.
Allies who hear you speak while you stand in water share your calm, recovering stamina faster for as long as they stay within earshot.
This is a water and communication effect.
coral.tag: This is a water and communication effect.

corrupt.name: Honeyed Rot
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak corruption into a willing listener's ear. A non-hostile character who hears it becomes open to bribery, and asks a lower price for betraying information or opening a door.
Spoken at an enemy, the same words fester. The target takes a stacking decay affliction each time it uses an ability while within earshot of you.
This is a corruption and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Patient Interrogation
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
When an enemy is rooted, held or grappled by you, you can question it. Intelligent enemies answer one question truthfully before they break free.
Rooting or grappling a lower-rank enemy for long enough makes it surrender, ending combat with it and adding its knowledge of the area to your map.
This is a binding and interrogation effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a binding and interrogation effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Syntax
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the structure of crystals and gemstones, including those set in gear and awakening stones. Reading one tells you exactly which essence abilities it will enhance and how.
You can speak into a crystal to store a message in it. Anyone who later holds the crystal hears the message in their own language.
This is a crystal and knowledge effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and knowledge effect.

cycle.name: Second Reading
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
A skill book absorbed by you is not consumed. Once per rank, you can reabsorb a book you have already read to gain a second skill in the same discipline.
Abilities you have read about in books, but not learned, can be recognised the instant an enemy begins to use them.
This is a comprehension and absorption effect.
cycle.tag: This is a comprehension and absorption effect.

dance.name: Steps of the Dance
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the movements of any fighter as a language. An enemy's footwork tells you, a moment in advance, which way it will move and whether it is about to attack.
Dodging an attack you have read this way grants a brief boost to movement speed and a short window in which your next attack cannot be dodged.
This is a perception and evasion effect.
dance.tag: This is a perception and evasion effect.

dark.name: Shadowed Meaning
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read writing that has been hidden, erased or burned, including text concealed by magic. Secret messages, invisible ink and scraped-away runes are legible to you.
In darkness, you can speak to your own shadow. It repeats what it has seen while you were unaware, recalling the last few things that happened behind you.
This is a shadow and perception effect.
dark.tag: This is a shadow and perception effect.

dawn.name: Daybreak Script
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Hidden writing reveals itself to you: invisible inks, sealed letters, magically concealed text and secret messages in plain documents can all be read.
Speaking a hidden word aloud costs mana and dispels illusions and concealment within a short radius around you.
This is a revelation and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is a revelation and light effect.

death.name: Final Words
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
When an intelligent enemy dies near you, you hear its last thought. Last thoughts often name an ally, a hidden cache or a quest the dead was part of, and these are added to your quest log.
You can speak to a soul that has not yet departed, briefly, to ask what it wants. Granting it is a quest in its own right.
This is a death and communication effect.
death.tag: This is a death and communication effect.

deep.name: Pressure Speech
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak with the weight of deep water behind your words. Spending mana on a command pushes every lower-rank enemy in front of you backward and slows them for a brief time.
You understand the languages of creatures from the deep places of the world, and they recognise you as something that belongs there.
This is a water and force effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and force effect.

deer.name: Startle Call
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can give a warning call that only allies understand. Every ally who hears it gains a burst of movement speed and a brief chance to avoid the next attack against them.
Wild animals that hear the call scatter, revealing anything hiding among them.
This is a warning and movement effect.
deer.tag: This is a warning and movement effect.

desolate.name: Unspoken
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can take speech away. Spending mana on a target within range silences it for a short time; the effect is longer on lower-rank targets.
While you are silent and not casting, you leave no sound for enemies to track. Monsters that hunt by hearing lose your position entirely.
This is a silence and stealth effect.
desolate.tag: This is a silence and stealth effect.

dimension.name: Folded Lexicon
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read portal-script, astral glyphs and the inscriptions on dimensional doors, including hidden astral portals once your aura sense reveals them.

Reading a portal tells you what realm lies beyond, the rank of what lives there and whether it can be left the same way. Speaking its name holds a portal open for your party for a short time after you pass.
This is a space and knowledge effect.
dimension.tag: This is a space and knowledge effect.

discord.name: Discordant Tongue
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a phrase that two enemies hear differently. Each believes the other said it. Lower-rank enemies affected this way attack each other for a short time.
The effect costs mana and cannot target the same pair twice in one fight.
This is a mind and confusion effect.
discord.tag: This is a mind and confusion effect.

discordant.name: Wrong Note
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the meaning in songs, chants and rituals. Enemy channelled spells and ritual casts reveal how long they have left before they resolve.
Speaking a discordant word into a channel costs mana and interrupts it. An interrupted ritual deals a portion of its effect to its casters instead.
This is an interrupt and sound effect.
discordant.tag: This is an interrupt and sound effect.

dog.name: Faithful Hound
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your summons and familiars understand full sentences and can report back to you in kind. A summon sent ahead tells you what it saw when it returns.
You can give a summon a scent from an item or corpse. It tracks the scent's owner across the region and leads you to it.
This is a summoning and tracking effect.
dog.tag: This is a summoning and tracking effect.

doom.name: Sealed Name
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read a creature's true name in its aura while it is affected by one of your afflictions.

Speaking a true name you have read seals it with a promised end. When the sealed creature drops below a portion of its health, it takes a heavy burst of necrotic damage. Only one name can be sealed at a time.
This is a curse and death effect.
doom.tag: This is a curse and death effect.

doppelganger.name: Borrowed Voice
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can throw your voice to any point you can see, speaking as yourself or as anyone you have heard.
Enemies hearing your thrown voice treat its source as your location for a short time. Spending mana also places a brief visual double there that draws attacks.
This is a sound and illusion effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a sound and illusion effect.

dragon.name: Draconic
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You speak and read the draconic tongue, the language that magic is written in. Spells you cast are spoken in it and resist interruption.

Once per day you can speak a word of fire. It erupts as a cone of fire damage and leaves the ground burning; enemies of lower rank caught in it are also frightened. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire and voice effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and voice effect.

duck.name: Unruffled Reply
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Insults, taunts and fear effects carried by voice slide off you. You cannot be taunted or frightened by spoken abilities.
When an enemy uses a spoken ability against you and it fails, you recover a portion of your mana.
This is a resistance and mind effect.
duck.tag: This is a resistance and mind effect.

dust.name: Settled Record
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the dust of a room or road. Footprints, disturbed surfaces and drifted dust tell you who passed, how many and when.
Blowing dust across an old surface reveals any writing once inscribed there, including messages long since worn away.
This is a tracking and knowledge effect.
dust.tag: This is a tracking and knowledge effect.

earth.name: Stone Speaker
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak to stone. Asking a wall, cave or cliff what lies beyond it reveals the tiles on the far side on your map.
Pressing your hand to the ground lets you feel footsteps through it. Enemies walking on earth or stone within a short range are revealed to you, even out of sight.
This is an earth and perception effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and perception effect.

echo.name: Lingering Tongue
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
For a short time after words are spoken in a place, you can still hear them, including through walls and closed doors.
When you absorb a skill book, you also absorb an echo of the person who last mastered it. The skill begins at a higher level.
This is a perception effect.

eclipse.name: Shadow Speech
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the speech of shadow creatures, ghosts and things of the dark, and they understand you. Some can be bargained with rather than fought.
You can whisper into a shadow you can see and be heard from another shadow you can see, anywhere within range. Enemies standing in a shadow you speak through are blinded briefly.
This is a dark and communication effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a dark and communication effect.

edifice.name: Mason's Reading
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read buildings. Entering a structure reveals its full floor plan on the map, including hidden rooms, stairs and doors.
Placing your hand on a wall and speaking costs mana and opens a doorway through it for a short time. The doorway closes on its own and cannot be opened in walls of higher rank than you.
This is a comprehension and earth effect.
edifice.tag: This is a comprehension and earth effect.

effigy.name: Named Likeness
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can write a name onto a scrap of cloth, straw or paper to make a likeness. Making one costs mana, and only one can exist at a time.
While you carry a likeness bearing your own name, the first curse or affliction that would be applied to you each fight is applied to the likeness instead, which burns away.
This is a curse and warding effect.
effigy.tag: This is a curse and warding effect.

elemental.name: Tongue of the Elements
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Elementals understand you, and you understand them. Elemental monsters of lower rank do not attack you unless you attack first.
You can bargain with an elemental to fight beside you. It accepts payment in mana and serves as a temporary summon until the fight ends or it is destroyed.
This is an elemental and summoning effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and summoning effect.

elixir.name: Apothecary's Script
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read a potion by looking at it. Unlabelled, foreign and tampered potions show their true effect, potency and any poison mixed in.
Absorbing a skill book while a potion's effect is active lets you bind that potion's recipe into memory. You can brew it at any crafting station without needing the written recipe.
This is an alchemy and absorption effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and absorption effect.

empower.name: Rallying Word
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a word of strength to an ally within earshot. The ally's next ability deals increased damage or heals for more. Each ally can carry one word at a time.
Skill books you absorb grant their skill to every party member within earshot at its starting level, as long as they remain in your party.
This is a boon and teaching effect.
empower.tag: This is a boon and teaching effect.

eye.name: Reading the Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read what a creature is looking at. Enemies' targets are shown on the map, letting you see which ally each enemy is about to attack.
Meeting the eyes of a non-hostile character tells you whether they are lying in their next sentence.
This is a perception and insight effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and insight effect.

feast.name: Host's Welcome
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can share a meal with any non-hostile character. Breaking bread together raises their disposition toward you and unlocks one secret, discount or side quest they would otherwise keep back.
Food you eat in company grants its boon to every party member present at the meal.
This is a social and boon effect.
feast.tag: This is a social and boon effect.

feeble.name: Whispered Weakness
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can whisper doubt to an enemy within earshot by spending mana. It suffers a weakness affliction, reducing the damage it deals for a short time.
For each weakness affliction you have applied that is still active, you deal slightly increased damage.
This is a mind and affliction effect.
feeble.tag: This is a mind and affliction effect.

fertile.name: Root Script
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand plants. Harvestable nodes tell you where others of their kind grow, revealing them on the map within a wide radius.
Speaking to a harvested node costs a little mana and causes it to regrow over a short time instead of the usual long wait.
This is a nature and communication effect.
fertile.tag: This is a nature and communication effect.

fey.name: Fair Bargain
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can offer a binding bargain to any intelligent creature that will listen. If it accepts, both sides are bound by the terms, and whoever breaks them suffers a heavy affliction that cannot be cleansed for a long time.
Fey creatures and spirits will always stop to hear an offer before attacking you.
This is a bargain and curse effect.
fey.tag: This is a bargain and curse effect.

fire.name: Kindled Script
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can burn words into the air with a fingertip. Burning letters hang where you write them for a short time, legible to anyone in any language, and inflict fire damage on enemies that pass through them.
A skill book can be read by burning it. You gain its skill without the book being kept, and the ashes leave a temporary boon that increases fire damage.
This is a fire and inscription effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and inscription effect.

firebird.name: Ember Script
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can burn words into the air with a fingertip. Writing costs mana, and the letters hang where you wrote them for a short time, dealing fire damage to enemies that pass through them.
A burning word you leave behind can be read by allies at any distance, carrying a short message to them.
This is a fire and communication effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and communication effect.

fish.name: Shoal Signs
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You and your party move as one when you give the word. Allies who are close to you match your movement speed and change direction with you without needing commands.
While your party moves together this way, enemies find it harder to single one of you out, and ranged attacks against your party are less accurate.
This is a group and movement effect.
fish.tag: This is a group and movement effect.

flea.name: Leaping Phrase
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
A word spoken to an ally can carry you to them. Spend stamina to leap to any ally within a moderate range who heard you speak in the last few seconds.
Landing next to an ally after a leap grants both of you a brief burst of attack speed.
This is a movement and communication effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and communication effect.

flesh.name: Flesh-Writ
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read a body's condition like a page. Looking at any creature shows its current health, any wounds or afflictions eating at it and the location where it is most vulnerable.
Your attacks against a location you have read deal increased damage and apply a brief bleed.
This is a perception and wounding effect.
flesh.tag: This is a perception and wounding effect.

foot.name: Road Cant
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read road signs, waymarks and travellers' chalk marks, including the secret cant used by smugglers and the Society. These mark safe camps, dangerous roads and hidden routes on your map.
Walking a road you have read costs no stamina for sprinting.
This is a navigation and movement effect.
foot.tag: This is a navigation and movement effect.

force.name: Word of Weight
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your spoken commands carry physical force. Speaking a word at a target costs stamina and pushes it back, interrupting any ability it is preparing.
A lower-rank enemy pushed into a wall or another enemy is stunned briefly.
This is a force and voice effect.
force.tag: This is a force and voice effect.

forge.name: Smith's Cant
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read crafting manuals, schematics and maker's notes of any tradition, and learn a crafting recipe by studying a finished item.
When you speak an item's maker's mark aloud while working it at a forge, repairs to it cost no materials and its next upgrade has a chance to gain an additional bonus.
This is a comprehension and crafting effect.
forge.tag: This is a comprehension and crafting effect.

fork.name: Forked Reply
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
In conversation you can always see one extra option, a branch that leads toward a different outcome than the expected one.
In combat, when an enemy commits to an attack, you can spend stamina to name a second target near it. Your next polearm attack against the first enemy also strikes the second.
This is a social and splitting effect.
fork.tag: This is a social and splitting effect.

fortress.name: Watchword
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can set a watchword on a doorway, gate or campsite. Any enemy crossing a set watchword alerts you wherever you are in the same region, and the map shows where.
Speaking the watchword while standing within it raises a barrier at the entrance for a short time that only allies can pass.
This is a ward and barrier effect.
fortress.tag: This is a ward and barrier effect.

fox.name: Sly Tongue
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can tell a lie that is believed. Once per conversation, a non-hostile character accepts a false statement as true.
In combat, you can feint with words. Spending mana to call a false direction makes lower-rank enemies turn toward it for a brief moment, exposing their backs.
This is a deception and mind effect.
fox.tag: This is a deception and mind effect.

frog.name: Croak Across Water
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your voice carries over water without losing strength. You can speak to anyone on the far side of a lake, river or marsh as though they stood beside you.
Jumping from water to land, or land to water, launches you a long way and briefly stuns enemies where you land.
This is a water and movement effect.
frog.tag: This is a water and movement effect.

fungus.name: Spore Network
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can listen to the fungal threads beneath the forest floor. In a region with fungus growth, recent events anywhere within a large range reach you as faint rumours: fights, deaths and large creatures moving.
You can release a cloud of spores that carries a message to every ally in the cloud. Enemies inside it are briefly confused.
This is a nature and communication effect.
fungus.tag: This is a nature and communication effect.

garuda.name: High Call
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand birds and flying monsters, and they understand you. Birds report what they have seen nearby, revealing hidden enemies on the map.
Calling to your mount or familiar summons it to you from anywhere in the region. Serpent-type enemies hearing the call are frightened briefly.
This is a beast and summoning effect.
garuda.tag: This is a beast and summoning effect.

gate.name: Keyword
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the inscriptions on portals, astral gates and locked doors, learning where they lead and what opens them. Locked doors that respond to a spoken key open for you.
Once per day you can speak the name of a settlement you have visited and step through a doorway to it. The door remains open briefly for companions. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a teleport and space effect.
gate.tag: This is a teleport and space effect.

gathering.name: Common Tongue
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
When you speak, everyone around you understands each other as well as they understand you. Party members, companions and allied NPCs near you share every language you know.
You can call everyone in your party to your side. Each ally who hears the call is drawn quickly toward you, crossing obstacles in the way. This costs mana for each ally drawn.
This is a communication and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a communication and gathering effect.

glass.name: Clear Glass
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Writing behind glass, under ice or inside a sealed container is legible to you as if it were in your hand.
You can see through a window, mirror or lens into the space beyond and read what is written there, including letters on a desk inside a locked room.
This is a perception and clarity effect.
glass.tag: This is a perception and clarity effect.

glimeron.name: Prismatic Reading
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read a spell as it is cast and see its components split apart. An enemy spell aimed at you shows its damage type and area before it lands.
Reading a spell aimed at you costs mana and splits it on impact, sending part of its damage to a nearby enemy instead.
This is a light and deflection effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and deflection effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Accord
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Once you have agreed to something, nothing can talk you out of it. You are immune to charm, persuasion and command effects that would make you break your word.
When a character tries to go back on an agreement made with you, you know immediately, and the disposition loss falls on them rather than you.
This is a resistance and social effect.
goat.tag: This is a resistance and social effect.

gorgon.name: Stone Word
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand petrified creatures and can read the last moments of anyone turned to stone.

Speaking an enemy's name while holding its gaze costs mana and stiffens it, slowing it. If the slowed enemy is already afflicted, it is briefly petrified instead. Petrified enemies take increased damage from blunt attacks.
This is a petrification and gaze effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and gaze effect.

griffin.name: Eyrie Sight
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the land from above. Standing on high ground reveals the surrounding area on the map in a wide radius, including the routes of patrolling monsters.
Monsters you have watched from high ground are marked as claimed. Your first attack against a claimed monster is a critical hit.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
griffin.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

growth.name: Grafted Lore
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Skills absorbed from skill books grow on their own. Each skill you hold gains experience slowly over time, even when it is not used.
Once per rank, you can graft two absorbed skills together, merging them into a single skill that keeps the strongest effect of each.
This is an absorption and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is an absorption and growth effect.

guardian.name: Oath of Shelter
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can swear to protect an ally. The oath costs mana and lasts until the ally leaves the party or you swear to someone else.
When your sworn ally takes damage within range, you take a portion of it instead. Enemies attacking your sworn ally hear your challenge and are taunted toward you.
This is a protection and taunt effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and taunt effect.

hair.name: Ten Thousand Threads
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can braid a strand of your hair into an ally's gear. While it stays there, you can speak to that ally from anywhere in the same region, and they can reply.
You can hold one such strand per rank. Pulling a strand back draws the ally a short distance toward you.
This is a communication and binding effect.
hair.tag: This is a communication and binding effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Cadence
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the smith's marks on any forged item, learning who made it, from what and how it could be reforged. Crafting stations reveal recipes their last user knew.
Striking a forged object in rhythm with your words lets you reshape it. Once per rank, you can reforge a weapon's damage type at no material cost.
This is a crafting and knowledge effect.
hammer.tag: This is a crafting and knowledge effect.

hand.name: Sign Hands
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read any craft by watching hands at work. Watching a crafter complete an item teaches you its recipe.
Your hands speak as clearly as your voice. You can cast spells that require speech while silenced, by signing them instead.
This is a crafting and resistance effect.
hand.tag: This is a crafting and resistance effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Voice
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can find the resonant pitch of an object or barrier. Speaking at that pitch for a short time, at a cost in mana, shatters conjured walls, magical shields and brittle obstacles.
Allies who speak in unison with you for a moment gain a shared boon that increases the strength of their next ability.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Screech
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can mimic any cry, call or alarm you have heard. Mimicking a monster's alarm call draws others of its kind toward a point you choose.
A screech costs stamina and makes lower-rank enemies within range drop whatever they are carrying, including stolen items and loot. Dropped items can be picked up by you.
This is a sound and disarm effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and disarm effect.

harvest.name: Gleaner's Reading
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read what a creature is carrying and what it will drop before you kill it. The best item a monster would drop is shown above it.
Speaking the harvest-word over a fresh kill costs mana and yields an additional portion of crafting materials from its body.
This is a perception and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a perception and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Herd's Reckoning
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand the language of migrating herds and the routes they follow. Herd routes are drawn on the region map, along with the predators that shadow them.
Calling a herd lets you lead it. A herd following you tramples lower-rank enemies in its path before scattering.
This is a nature and stampede effect.
heidel.tag: This is a nature and stampede effect.

hook.name: Barbed Question
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
In conversation you can ask one question per character that cannot be deflected. The character must answer it, honestly or not, and you know which.
In combat you can hook an enemy with a shouted word, pulling a lower-rank enemy a short distance toward you at a cost in stamina.
This is a social and pulling effect.
hook.tag: This is a social and pulling effect.

horse.name: Rider's Pact
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Any untamed mount-capable beast of your rank or lower can be persuaded to carry you, without taming, for as long as you remain in its region.
While riding, you can speak to every rider and mount within a large range. Allied riders who hear you gain movement speed until they dismount.
This is a mount and communication effect.
horse.tag: This is a mount and communication effect.

hunger.name: Hungry Lexicon
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can devour a scroll, spellbook or inscribed tablet to take its magic. Devouring restores mana scaled to the item's quality and grants a short boon to spell damage.
Skill books can be devoured at any rank, even those normally restricted to higher ranks. The skill begins at its lowest level and grows normally from there.
This is an absorption and devouring effect.
hunger.tag: This is an absorption and devouring effect.

hunt.name: Named Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Speaking the name of a creature you have identified declares it your quarry. Its location is shown on the map until it dies or you name another.
Damage you deal to your quarry is increased. When it dies, you regain a portion of your stamina and mana.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
hunt.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

hydra.name: Many Mouths
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak and cast at the same time. Casting a spell does not interrupt a channel you are already holding, and vocal abilities can be used while channelling.
When you are silenced, a second voice speaks on your behalf: you can still use one spell while silenced, once per fight.
This is a voice and resistance effect.
hydra.tag: This is a voice and resistance effect.

ice.name: Rime Inscription
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words you write can be sealed in frost. A frozen inscription cannot be read by anyone but you and those you name, and it preserves anything it is written on from decay or theft.
Writing a word of frost on the ground, at a cost in mana, freezes the surface around it. Enemies crossing it are slowed, and those already slowed are briefly frozen.
This is an ice and inscription effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and inscription effect.

immortal.name: Old Tongues
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read dead languages and lost scripts as easily as living ones. Ruins and ancient sites reveal their history, and any hidden chamber described in their writings is marked on the map.
