Skill books written before the current age grant their skill one level higher when absorbed by you.
This is a comprehension and history effect.
immortal.tag: This is a comprehension and history effect.

iron.name: Iron Oath
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Fey, spirits and other creatures bound by iron understand and fear your word. Spoken commands force them to keep their distance from you for a short time.
A promise you speak in battle hardens your body. Declaring that you will protect an ally grants you increased damage reduction while you stand beside them.
This is an iron and warding effect.
iron.tag: This is an iron and warding effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Charge
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Commands spoken against you cannot take hold. You are immune to compulsion, taunts and forced movement while you are running.
Shouting a war cry as you begin to run costs stamina; you gain momentum with every stride, and the first enemy you strike at full momentum is knocked down.
This is a voice and resistance effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a voice and resistance effect.

karmic.name: Ledger Tongue
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the debts written on a creature's aura: who it has harmed, and whether it has wronged you or your party.
An enemy that has struck you this fight takes a portion of that damage back when you speak its debt aloud. Speaking a debt costs mana, and a debt can only be called once.
This is a karma and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karma and retribution effect.

knife.name: Hidden Meaning
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You hear the intent beneath what people say. A character planning to betray you, ambush you or attack you is marked on the map before they act.
Speaking to an enemy from behind before you strike makes the first attack a critical hit, provided the enemy does not see you.
This is an insight and stealth effect.
knife.tag: This is an insight and stealth effect.

knowledge.name: The Turning Page
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

Every book, letter and inscription you have read is kept in an internal library you can search at will. Searching it for a monster, place or person reveals everything any page you read said about them.
Quests that depend on lore, codes or forgotten history can be completed by consulting your library instead of finding the source again.
This is a knowledge and memory effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and memory effect.

kraken.name: Deep Voice
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak clearly while standing in water, and understand everything that lives in the deep. Aquatic monsters can be read for intent and some can be talked down.
A word spoken while you stand in or beside water costs mana and drags a lower-rank enemy toward you and into the shallows, holding it in place for a short time.
This is a water and binding effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and binding effect.

leviathan.name: Whalesong
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak across distance through water. Any ally standing in water within the region can hear you and speak back.
Singing into open water costs mana and sends a swell outward from you, knocking back enemies standing in or beside the water and dragging loose items toward you.
This is a water and communication effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and communication effect.

life.name: Breath of Life
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words of encouragement you speak heal. Calling to an ally who has fallen below a quarter of their health restores a portion of it, at a cost in mana.
A downed ally who hears you speak their name gets back on their feet with a small amount of health, once per fight.
This is a healing and voice effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and voice effect.

light.name: Illuminated Text
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Writing you look at glows, readable in total darkness. Light-script and holy inscriptions reveal their effects and who they were written to protect.
Speaking a word of light reveals invisible and hidden creatures within a short range and blinds lower-rank enemies who are looking at you.
This is a light and revealing effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revealing effect.

lightning.name: Thunderclap Order
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your commands to allies arrive instantly, regardless of distance, anywhere within the same region.
Shouting at an enemy, at a cost in mana, releases a crack of lightning that stuns it briefly and arcs to one other enemy nearby.
This is a lightning and command effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and command effect.

lizard.name: Basking Stillness
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
While you stand still and stay silent, you can understand everything said within a large range, including conversations across a room or through a tent wall.
Remaining motionless this way makes you harder to detect. Lower-rank enemies pass you by unless they walk directly into you.
This is a stealth and listening effect.
lizard.tag: This is a stealth and listening effect.

locust.name: Swarm Babel
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak in the voice of a swarm. Your words fill the air around enemies, disrupting their concentration and interrupting spellcasting within a short range.
Each enemy interrupted this way grants you a stacking boon to mana recovery for a short time.
This is a sound and disruption effect.
locust.tag: This is a sound and disruption effect.

lotus.name: Clean Words
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words of corruption, curses and cursed text cannot affect you. Cursed books and scrolls can be read and absorbed without suffering their curse.
Speaking a cleansing word over an ally costs mana and removes one curse or magical affliction. Each ally can be cleansed this way once per fight.
This is a cleanse and purity effect.
lotus.tag: This is a cleanse and purity effect.

lurker.name: Listener Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can hear through floors. Conversations, footsteps and movement in rooms beneath you, including sewers, cellars and dungeon levels, are audible and marked on your map.
Enemies below you that you have heard can be ambushed. Dropping down onto one through a hole or stairwell treats your first attack as an attack from stealth.
This is a listening and ambush effect.
lurker.tag: This is a listening and ambush effect.

magic.name: Arcane Grammar
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the structure of a spell as it is being cast, including enemy spells. While an enemy is casting, its cast bar shows the spell's name, damage type and target.
You can spend mana to speak a counter-word at a casting enemy within range, interrupting the spell. A spell from a higher-rank caster is delayed instead of interrupted.
This is a perception and counterspell effect.
magic.tag: This is a perception and counterspell effect.

malign.name: Poisoned Courtesy
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Speech you direct at an enemy can carry a curse. Taunting or addressing an enemy within range applies a stacking spite affliction that increases the damage it takes from you.
Spite cannot be cleansed while the target can still hear you. Stacks fade quickly once you fall silent or move out of earshot.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Slow Reading
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

Absorbing a skill book can be done at rest over a long, uninterrupted stretch instead of instantly. A skill book absorbed this way grants the skill along with a passive bonus to the attribute the skill relies on most.
While you are absorbing a book this way, you regenerate health and mana over time and cannot be surprised by lower-rank monsters.
This is an absorption and recovery effect.
manatee.tag: This is an absorption and recovery effect.

manticore.name: Human Mask
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak sweetly to a target you are hunting. A lower-rank intelligent enemy you address does not raise an alarm until you attack it.
The first attack you make after speaking to a target poisons it with a stacking affliction that ignores its poison resistance.
This is a deception and poison effect.
manticore.tag: This is a deception and poison effect.

master.name: Instructor's Ease
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Skills learned from skill books advance faster through use. Watching a trainer or expert demonstrate a skill you already have grants experience in it.
Once per rank, you can study a skill book you do not meet the requirements for and learn it anyway.
This is a learning and mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a learning and mastery effect.

might.name: Commanding Voice
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can spend stamina to shout a single word in any language. Lower-rank enemies within a short radius are knocked back and staggered; same-rank enemies are staggered only.
Shouting interrupts any enemy channel within the radius. The shout cannot be used again for a short time.
This is a sound and force effect.
might.tag: This is a sound and force effect.

ministration.name: Bedside Manner
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read a patient's condition from how they speak and move. Hidden afflictions, diseases and poisons on allies are shown to you.
Speaking calmly to an ally under a fear, panic or charm effect costs mana and ends it. Healing you apply to an ally you have spoken to this fight is stronger.
This is a healing and calming effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and calming effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Reading
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the layout of mazes, caves and dungeons from their walls. The route to the deepest point of any interior you enter is shown on the map.
While inside an interior, you can bellow a challenge that costs stamina. Every enemy in that interior is drawn toward you, and those of lower rank are frightened when they arrive.
This is a navigation and taunt effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a navigation and taunt effect.

mirage.name: False Distance
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read illusions as illusions. Any illusion you look at shows as translucent, and illusory enemies are marked.

Speaking a lie about where you stand costs mana and makes enemies perceive you a short distance from your true position, causing their attacks and spells to miss until the lie is broken by your attack.
This is an illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Tongue
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

After an enemy speaks an incantation, war-cry or command within earshot, you can repeat it back for mana. The repeated words reproduce the spoken ability's effect at reduced strength, with you as the source.
Only one echoed ability can be held at a time, and it fades if not used within a short window.
This is a mimicry and reflection effect.
mirror.tag: This is a mimicry and reflection effect.

monkey.name: Quick Study
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Watching a crafter, merchant or trainer work for a short time lets you learn one of their recipes, techniques or trade skills without a skill book. Each teacher can be learned from once.
You can read and operate locks, puzzle mechanisms and trap triggers on sight, disarming them with a brief interaction.
This is a learning and dexterity effect.
monkey.tag: This is a learning and dexterity effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the carvings on standing stones, obelisks and shrines, and touching one marks it on your map permanently.
Speaking a word at a stone you have read lets you return to it once per day from anywhere in the same region. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a travel and earth effect.
monolith.tag: This is a travel and earth effect.

moon.name: Moonlit Script
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Hidden writing appears to you under moonlight and in darkness: secret messages, concealed runes and directions left on walls, often leading to caches or quest leads.
At night you can read the intent of a sleeping or unaware creature within aura-sense range, learning whether it is hostile, hungry or fleeing before it wakes.
This is a perception and night effect.
moon.tag: This is a perception and night effect.

mouse.name: Small Voices
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand vermin, birds and other small creatures. Talking to one in a settlement or dungeon reveals the location of a nearby hidden passage, cache or sleeping enemy.
You can ask a small creature to run an errand for mana: it scurries to a chosen point you can see and triggers whatever lever, plate or trap is there.
This is a communication and scouting effect.
mouse.tag: This is a communication and scouting effect.

myriad.name: Choir of Selves
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can hold several conversations at once. Speaking to one member of a group speaks to all of them, and dialogue persuasion checks against groups use your best result.
In combat, you can spend mana to project your voice from up to three points you can see. Enemies that hear you are drawn toward the nearest of them, as though you stood there.
This is a sound and misdirection effect.
myriad.tag: This is a sound and misdirection effect.

mystic.name: Unvoiced Knowing
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read surface thoughts from intelligent beings you can see, learning their immediate intention: attack, flee, lie, or bargain.
In conversation, you always know when you are being lied to. Quest-givers who are hiding something are marked, and their hidden objective is added to the quest log.
This is a mind and perception effect.
mystic.tag: This is a mind and perception effect.

nebula.name: Starspeech
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand astral beings, and astral writing is plain to you. Astral portals you have sensed reveal which realm they lead to and what holds it.
Inside an astral realm, you can speak to the realm itself. Doing so costs mana and reveals the realm's cult camp, rare monsters and harvest nodes on the map.
This is an astral and perception effect.
nebula.tag: This is an astral and perception effect.

needle.name: Pointed Annotation
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can read the weak point of anything with a written or engraved surface, including armour inscriptions, golem runes and ward glyphs. Attacks against an inscribed target strike its marked weak point and ignore part of its damage reduction.
Puncturing a glyph with a precise strike unravels the enchantment it holds.
This is a perception and penetration effect.
needle.tag: This is a perception and penetration effect.

nemesis.name: Spoken Grudge
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak an enemy's name to declare it your nemesis. Only one nemesis can be declared at a time. Your nemesis is always shown on the map while in the same region.
You deal increased damage to your nemesis, and it cannot escape you through teleportation or invisibility while it is within range.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

net.name: Caught Words
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words spoken within a wide radius are gathered and held for you to read later, even if you were not there to hear them. Conversations overheard this way can reveal quest leads and patrol routes.
You can spend mana to speak a binding phrase that snares an enemy who is speaking, casting or roaring, rooting it in place briefly.
This is a capture and sound effect.
net.tag: This is a capture and sound effect.

network.name: Common Channel
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You and your party members share a silent mental channel at any range within the same region. Anything one of you sees marked on the map, the others see too.
Any party member can absorb a skill book you hold without it leaving your inventory.
This is a communication and mind effect.
network.tag: This is a communication and mind effect.

oasis.name: Traveller's Welcome
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Settlements and travellers greet you as a friend. Inns, stables and temples offer you rest at no cost.

When you rest anywhere outside of combat and speak a welcome to your party, everyone recovers health, mana and stamina significantly faster for a short time, and resting removes one minor affliction from each of you.
This is a rest and social effect.
oasis.tag: This is a rest and social effect.

ocean.name: Tidal Recitation
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Each time you repeat a spell's incantation in the same fight, the spell costs slightly less mana, to a limit.
After you reach the limit, the next cast of that spell surges like a breaking wave, dealing increased damage and knocking back lower-rank enemies, then the count resets.
This is a spell and water effect.
ocean.tag: This is a spell and water effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Handed Script
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read and write in several scripts at once. Ability scrolls and recipe sheets you write cost fewer materials, and you can inscribe two at a time.
You understand colour and body language as speech. Creatures that communicate through display, including cephalopods and chameleons, can be reasoned with instead of fought.
This is a communication and craft effect.
octopus.tag: This is a communication and craft effect.

omen.name: Read Signs
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

Omens in the world read as plain warnings: carrion birds, stopped clocks, shifting winds. Before you enter an area containing a monster of higher rank than you, you receive a written warning naming its type.
Once per day you can read the sign of a single fight before it starts, learning which enemy present poses the greatest threat. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a foresight effect.

onslaught.name: Cadence
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can call your attacks in a rhythm. Every successful attack spoken in rhythm grants a stacking boon of attack speed; missing a beat by stopping your attacks ends the boon.
At full stacks, your next special attack strikes twice.
This is a rhythm and martial effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a rhythm and martial effect.

pangolin.name: Rolled Lexicon
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words aimed at you can be refused. You are immune to command, charm and fear effects that work through speech or song.
When such an effect is refused, you can curl briefly, gaining heavy damage reduction while the speaker's next ability is turned back on them.
This is a ward and reflection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a ward and reflection effect.

paper.name: Living Page
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can write a known ability onto blank paper as a single-use scroll, at the cost of the ability's mana plus additional mana. Scrolls can be handed to allies, who use the ability at your rank.
Up to three scrolls can exist at a time. A scroll held for too long fades back into blank paper.
This is a writing and conjuration effect.
paper.tag: This is a writing and conjuration effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Night Talk
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak into the mind of an enemy you can see, filling it with whispers. Doing so costs mana and causes the enemy to perceive phantom attackers around it for a short time.
An enemy under this effect attacks phantoms at random. Lower-rank enemies may attack their own allies instead.
This is a fear and illusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a fear and illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Last Words
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

When you would be defeated, you have time for last words. Once per day, you can spend those words to burst into flame, dealing fire damage around you, then rise with a portion of your health. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
You can also hear the last words of any creature that dies near you, which sometimes reveal hidden quests or treasure.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Root Speech
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand plants. Speaking to a tree, crop or thicket reveals what passed through the area recently and where it went.
You can ask nearby vegetation to give way or close behind you. Thickets and undergrowth open for you and your allies and close against pursuers, blocking movement for a short time.
This is a communication and nature effect.
plant.tag: This is a communication and nature effect.

potent.name: Distilled Lessons
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Two skill books for the same skill can be absorbed together, granting the skill at a significantly higher level than either would alone.
A skill book absorbed this way also strengthens the ability it teaches whenever you use it while above half mana.
This is an absorption and empowerment effect.
potent.tag: This is an absorption and empowerment effect.

predatory.name: Hunter's Ear
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can understand the calls of prey and predators. Hearing an enemy speak or call marks the weakest member of its group on your map.
You deal increased damage to marked enemies while they are separated from their group, and marked enemies cannot hear you approach.
This is a hunting and perception effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and perception effect.

prison.name: Sentence
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can pronounce a sentence on an enemy within sight. Doing so costs mana and binds it to the spot where it stands, rooting it for a short time.
A lower-rank enemy that breaks its sentence by teleporting or being moved takes damage. Only one enemy can be under sentence at a time.
This is a binding and law effect.
prison.tag: This is a binding and law effect.

prosperity.name: Fortune's Favour
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the worth of things in coin and trade-value at a glance, including items behind a shop counter. Merchants buy from you at better prices.
Speaking a blessing over a treasure chest or loot pile costs mana and adds coin and a chance of an extra item to its contents. Each chest can be blessed once.
This is a fortune and trade effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a fortune and trade effect.

pure.name: Clean Translation
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Lies spoken to you are marked as false in the dialogue window. Corrupted, cursed or forged writing is shown with its corruption underlined.
Absorbing an essence, awakening stone or skill book also cleanses you of one affliction, and you cannot absorb a corrupted item by accident.
This is a perception and cleanse effect.
pure.tag: This is a perception and cleanse effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt-Hole Phrase
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Every settlement and dungeon you enter contains a password you can learn by listening. Speaking it near a door, gate or warren lets you and your party pass through without a key.
Once per fight you can speak a fleeing word, granting a burst of movement speed and causing lower-rank enemies to lose track of you briefly.
This is a communication and escape effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a communication and escape effect.

rake.name: Gleaned Tongues
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

Fragments of writing on fallen enemies, abandoned camps and ruins are collected automatically. Gathering enough fragments from one source assembles a complete text: a map, a recipe, a letter or a partial skill book.
Partial skill books can be combined. Two halves of the same skill form a complete book.
This is a gathering and research effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and research effect.

rat.name: Gutter Cant
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You speak the cant of thieves, beggars and sewer-folk. Black-market sellers, fences and informants in every settlement deal with you, and their prices fall as you return.
You can ask rats in a sewer or ruin to swarm a single target you can see. The swarm inflicts a disease affliction and disperses after a short time.
This is a communication and swarm effect.
rat.tag: This is a communication and swarm effect.

reagent.name: Formulaic Reading
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You read the formula of any potion, poison or elixir you hold, including ones you have never brewed. Reading one teaches the recipe if you have the crafting skill to brew it.
Potions you drink while knowing their formula take full effect, and you can choose to delay a potion's effect until a moment you speak aloud.
This is a perception and alchemy effect.
reagent.tag: This is a perception and alchemy effect.

refracting.name: Turned Phrase
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can turn a command back on the speaker. When an enemy uses a taunt, charm or compulsion on you, you can spend mana to reflect it, applying it to the enemy instead.
Reflected compulsions last longer on enemies of lower rank. This cannot be used again until the reflected effect ends.
This is a reflection and mind effect.
refracting.tag: This is a reflection and mind effect.

renewal.name: Seasonal Tongue
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Healing words you speak count as a spell. You can spend mana to speak to an ally within earshot, healing them over time and restarting any healing-over-time effect already on them.
Words of encouragement spoken to a downed ally let them rise with a portion of their health once per day. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and sound effect.
renewal.tag: This is a healing and sound effect.

resolute.name: Planted Word
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak an oath out of combat. While it holds, you cannot be moved, knocked down or forced to flee, and lower-rank enemies cannot make you drop your guard.
Breaking the oath by retreating from a fight ends it, and you cannot speak another until the next day. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an oath and resistance effect.
resolute.tag: This is an oath and resistance effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Voice
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can hum a tone that builds in nearby objects and enemies. Holding the hum costs mana over time and deals sound damage that increases each second it is held.
Glass, crystal and weakened armour shatter if the hum is held long enough, stripping armour from enemies who wear it.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

roc.name: Shadow Call
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak to the great birds of the high places. Rocs and giant flyers will not attack you unless provoked.

Once per day you can call a roc's shadow over an area you can see. Enemies under the shadow are frightened and slowed, and lower-rank enemies cannot use movement abilities while beneath it. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fear and summoning effect.
roc.tag: This is a fear and summoning effect.

rune.name: Graven Lexicon
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can carve a rune you have read onto a weapon, armour piece or doorway. A carved rune holds a single ability effect you know, triggering once when its condition is met: on hit, on being struck, or on an enemy crossing it.
Up to three carved runes can exist at a time. Carving costs mana and a short, uninterrupted moment.
This is a writing and enchantment effect.
rune.tag: This is a writing and enchantment effect.

sacrifice.name: Blood Oath
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read blood magic and ritual inscriptions, and use altars and sacrificial shrines without being a member of their faith.
Speaking an oath over a skill book in your own blood costs a portion of your health and lets you absorb it as though you met all of its requirements.
This is a blood and absorption effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and absorption effect.

sand.name: Sand-Scribe
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words you trace in sand, dust or dirt hold their meaning. You can leave a written warning on the ground that lower-rank monsters will not cross, creating a barrier along the line of text.
Traces left on the ground by others read to you as footprints with names: who walked here, when, and in which direction.
This is a writing and tracking effect.
sand.tag: This is a writing and tracking effect.

sceptre.name: Royal Address
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

Officials, guards and guild clerks treat your word as carrying authority. Society contracts you accept carry an additional reward, and restricted areas in settlements can be entered by speaking to their guard.
In combat you can spend mana to issue a decree to your allies and summons: attack, hold or fall back. Units obeying a decree gain a brief boost suited to the order.
This is an authority and command effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and command effect.

scribe.name: Margin Notes
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can write your own skill books. Spending time at a desk, with mana and paper, copies a skill you know into a book any character can absorb.
A skill copied this way starts at its base level for the reader. Each skill can only be copied once per rank.
This is a writing and teaching effect.
scribe.tag: This is a writing and teaching effect.

serene.name: Still Speech
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Hostile creatures of lower rank that can understand you will hear you out before attacking. Speaking first to an enemy group gives you a chance to end the encounter without a fight.
You can speak calm to an ally within earshot, cleansing a fear, rage or confusion affliction from them.
This is a calming and cleanse effect.
serene.tag: This is a calming and cleanse effect.

serpent.name: Forked Tongue
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak with snakes, lizards and serpentine monsters. Lower-rank serpents will not attack you.
Hissing a word at an enemy costs mana and weakens its resolve, reducing its resistance to poison for a short time. Poison afflictions you apply to it while weakened stack faster.
This is a serpent and poison effect.
serpent.tag: This is a serpent and poison effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Words
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You hear pain in any voice. Enemies within earshot that are below half health are marked on your screen with their remaining health.
Attacking a marked enemy grants you a short frenzy of increased attack speed, which refreshes each time you strike another wounded enemy.
This is a perception and frenzy effect.
shark.tag: This is a perception and frenzy effect.

shield.name: Warding Syllable
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a ward word over an ally within earshot, granting them a damage-absorbing shield. The shield's strength scales with your rank.
A ward word spoken over yourself instead reflects the next spell that targets you back at its caster. Ward words share a short cooldown.
This is a shield and sound effect.
shield.tag: This is a shield and sound effect.

shimmer.name: Glamour Tongue
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak in light. Words you choose appear as glowing script in the air, visible to everyone nearby, and can be placed as signs that persist for a while.
Bright script spoken directly at enemies dazzles them, reducing their accuracy for a short time. Dazzled enemies that look at you take longer to cast spells.
This is a light and illusion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and illusion effect.

ship.name: Sailor's Word
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read currents, tides and winds as plainly as writing. While travelling by water or mount, you move faster along routes you have read.
Ferrymen, caravan masters and stablehands understand you as one of their own. Travel between settlements you have visited costs less, and mounts you ride tire more slowly.
This is a travel and navigation effect.
ship.tag: This is a travel and navigation effect.

shovel.name: Buried Text
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read what is buried. Graves, ruins and dig sites within aura-sense range show the writing on what lies beneath: names on coffins, labels on crates, inscriptions on lost weapons.
Spending stamina at a read site unearths what you saw, including loot that is otherwise unreachable.
This is a perception and excavation effect.
shovel.tag: This is a perception and excavation effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Verse
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Spoken last words carry power. When an enemy that can speak dies near you, you can read its final words, which grant a random boon related to the enemy's type for a short time.
If you defeat a named enemy, its final words can reveal the location of its hidden stash.
This is a harvesting and boon effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvesting and boon effect.

simulacrum.name: Proxy
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak through a summon, familiar or conjured object as though you were standing where it is. Townsfolk and quest-givers treat it as you for conversation and trade.
A summon you speak through can use one of your vocal abilities on your behalf, at your mana cost.
This is a communication and summoning effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a communication and summoning effect.

sin.name: Confession
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can see the worst thing a person has done written plainly above their head while you speak to them. Characters with a hidden crime can be pressed for confessions, rewards or concessions.
Enemies you address by their sin are shaken, taking increased damage from you until they strike you or flee.
This is a perception and curse effect.
sin.tag: This is a perception and curse effect.

skirmish.name: Parting Words
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Taunting an enemy as you leave melee range costs stamina and makes it chase you, ignoring your allies for a short time.
An enemy chasing you this way takes increased damage from ranged attacks and spells cast by your companions.
This is a taunt and movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a taunt and movement effect.

skunk.name: Lingering Warning
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can leave a spoken warning hanging in the air of a place. Enemies that walk into it are repelled and retreat from the area for a short time unless they are of higher rank.
A warning lasts until it repels an enemy or the zone is left for long enough. Only one can stand at a time.
This is a repulsion and zone effect.
skunk.tag: This is a repulsion and zone effect.

sky.name: Wind Reading
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the wind. Its speed and direction are always shown to you, and projectiles you fire with the wind travel further and strike harder.
Speaking into the wind carries your voice to a single ally anywhere in sight, however far, and lets them hear the sounds around you.
This is an air and communication effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and communication effect.

sloth.name: Long Thoughts
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
While you stand still and speak or read, time passes slowly for you. Reading a skill book, dialogue or a note in combat pauses its pressure: enemies act at a crawl until you look up.
This effect can be used once per fight and ends the moment you move or attack.
This is a time and contemplation effect.
sloth.tag: This is a time and contemplation effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Speech
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak without being heard by anyone except the person you address, even in a crowded hall or a silent ambush.
Enemies that do not understand you lose sight of you when you speak to them in a whisper, becoming briefly unable to target you. This effect has a short cooldown.
This is a stealth and sound effect.
smoke.tag: This is a stealth and sound effect.

snake.name: Hissed Promise
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can bargain with any creature that can hear you. A deal struck with an enemy, such as "leave and live", is binding, and breaking it inflicts a severe poison affliction on the oath-breaker.
A deal can be offered once per enemy. Higher-rank enemies ignore deals unless they are below half health.
This is a pact and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a pact and poison effect.

soaring.name: Updraft Word
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Speaking a word of rising costs a little stamina and throws you into a long leap on a gust at your back, letting you reach ledges and clear gaps you could not otherwise reach.
For a moment after the leap, you cannot be knocked down and your first ranged attack has increased range.
This is an air and movement effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and movement effect.

song.name: Carrying Melody
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words you sing are understood by every listener in range, regardless of language or species. Songs you sing for allies grant a boon of steady mana recovery while they can hear you.
Any song you hear once, you can sing back, reproducing its effect at a lesser strength.
This is a song and support effect.
song.tag: This is a song and support effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Decree
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can issue a decree that lasts for a short time within a radius around you. Choose one: no enemy may heal, no enemy may teleport, or no enemy may become invisible.
Enemies of higher rank resist the decree. Issuing a decree costs mana, and only one decree can be active at a time.
This is a law and aura effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a law and aura effect.

spear.name: Flung Word
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your voice carries much further than it should. You can speak to an ally or enemy at the edge of your vision as though they stood beside you.
A word thrown at a fleeing or distant enemy pins it in place briefly. A pinned enemy takes increased damage from ranged attacks.
This is a sound and pinning effect.
spear.tag: This is a sound and pinning effect.

spider.name: Web of Whispers
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can plant a whisper on a person you speak to. Until you dismiss it, you hear everything said near them, wherever they go.
Up to three whispers can be planted at a time. Planting one on an enemy reveals its position on the map for as long as the whisper lasts.
This is a tracking and eavesdropping effect.
spider.tag: This is a tracking and eavesdropping effect.

spike.name: Barbed Retort
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Insults, threats and taunts directed at you are turned back on the speaker. An enemy that uses a taunt or war-cry against you takes damage when it ends.
When you are hit by an ability with a spoken component, you briefly bristle, dealing damage to enemies that strike you in melee.
This is a retaliation effect.

staff.name: Wayfarer's Grammar
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Road signs, waystones and trail marks you read are added to your map, and the roads they name are revealed along their full length.
Strangers met on the road share what lies ahead. Encounters on roads you have read can be avoided or approached on your terms, and travel along them costs less stamina.
This is a navigation and travel effect.
staff.tag: This is a navigation and travel effect.

star.name: Distant Speech
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the stars. At night, the direction of any quest objective, astral portal or named enemy you have learned about is shown in the sky.
You can send a message to any party member or contact, wherever they are, by speaking it to the stars. Messages arrive at the next nightfall.
This is a communication and astral effect.
star.tag: This is a communication and astral effect.

stellar.name: Celestial Script
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the stars. At night, the map shows the location of the nearest astral portal, hidden shrine or buried treasure in the region.
Spells you cast at night carry a trace of starfire, dealing additional damage to enemies of the dark and the undead.
This is a star and perception effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and perception effect.

storm.name: Weathercaller
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak to the weather. Once per day, you can call rain over a wide area for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
During rain you called, your lightning damage is increased and enemies standing in water are briefly stunned when struck by lightning.
This is a weather and storm effect.
storm.tag: This is a weather and storm effect.

succubus.name: Sweet Whisper
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can whisper to an intelligent enemy within short range. A lower-rank enemy that hears you is charmed and stops attacking for a short time; the charm breaks if it takes damage.
While an enemy is charmed by you, you drain a little of its mana and stamina over time.
This is a charm and drain effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and drain effect.

sun.name: Noon Proclamation
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a proclamation that blazes like sunlight. Undead, shadow creatures and invisible enemies within earshot are revealed and take fire damage.
In daylight the proclamation also grants allies who hear it a brief boon of increased damage. It has a long cooldown.
This is a light and holy effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and holy effect.

swarm.name: Hive Mind
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand insects and swarming monsters as a single voice. A swarm can be read for its intent and the location of its queen or nest.
Speaking to a lower-rank swarm costs mana and splits it; part of the swarm turns on the rest for a short time.
This is a beast and mind effect.
swarm.tag: This is a beast and mind effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Tongue
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Skill books are absorbed instantly, even in combat, and a skill gained in combat is usable immediately.
Spells you cast that have a spoken incantation have their cast time significantly shortened. Interrupted incantations can be resumed rather than restarted.
This is an absorption and haste effect.
swift.tag: This is an absorption and haste effect.

sword.name: Steel's Grammar
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You read a fighting style the way you read a sentence. After watching an enemy attack a few times, its next attack is telegraphed on your screen before it lands.
Parrying a telegraphed attack staggers the attacker and refunds a portion of the stamina the parry cost.
This is a perception and parry effect.
sword.tag: This is a perception and parry effect.

talisman.name: Charmwright
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can inscribe a single word onto an amulet or ring at a workbench. The inscribed word grants the wearer a small resistance of your choice.
Each wearer can benefit from only one inscribed item. Inscriptions you make can be read by others but only you can change them.
This is an inscription and warding effect.
talisman.tag: This is an inscription and warding effect.

tentacle.name: Abyssal Speech
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand creatures of the deep and the astral that communicate without words. Astral realm natives and eldritch monsters can be spoken to, and some will trade or give warnings.
You can speak a word of the deep at an enemy you can see. A grasping tendril rises beneath it, holding it in place while you keep speaking. Speaking drains mana over time.
This is a communication and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a communication and restraint effect.

thread.name: Stitched Sentence
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can link two people you have spoken to with a thread of speech. Linked allies can hear each other at any range and share a portion of the damage either takes.
Linking two enemies makes any affliction applied to one spread to the other. Only one link can exist at a time.
This is a link and communication effect.
thread.tag: This is a link and communication effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand storm-spirits and thunderbirds, and they will answer you in a storm. During a storm, you can call a storm-spirit to fight beside you for a short time.
Clapping your hands costs stamina and creates a thunderclap around you that interrupts nearby enemies' abilities and knocks back those of lower rank.
This is a storm and summoning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and summoning effect.

time.name: Recorded Moment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read what was said in a place in the recent past by standing still and listening. Conversations and incantations from the last hour can be heard again.
Once per fight you can speak a word that delays an enemy spell aimed at you, holding it in place for a short time before it resolves.
This is a time and perception effect.
time.tag: This is a time and perception effect.

tranquil.name: Hush
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a word of quiet. Doing so costs mana and calms every non-hostile and neutral creature within a radius, stopping them from turning hostile when you fight nearby.
Enraged and frenzied enemies within the radius lose their rage, and your allies gain resistance to fear for a short time.
This is a calming and mind effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calming and mind effect.

transfiguration.name: Shapespeech
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the shape a creature was born with, revealing shapeshifters, transformed beings and disguised monsters.
Speaking a shapeshifter's true form costs mana and forces it back into that form for a short time, ending any transformation-based boons it was benefiting from.
This is a transformation and revelation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and revelation effect.

transgression.name: Rule Sight
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read the laws of a place. Settlements show their laws to you, and anyone who has broken one in your sight is marked.
You deal increased damage to marked lawbreakers, and Society contracts against criminals reveal their target's location on the map.
This is a law and tracking effect.
transgression.tag: This is a law and tracking effect.

trap.name: Trick Question
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a trap word onto a tile you can see. The first enemy to step on it hears a question it cannot answer and is stunned while it tries.
Up to three trap words can be placed at a time. Trap words in a settlement can be spoken to catch thieves and spies for quest rewards.
This is a trap and stun effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and stun effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Record
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Old trees remember the history of their place and tell it to you. Speaking to one reveals nearby ruins, buried caches and the routes of monster migrations on the map.
Resting beneath a tree you have spoken to restores health and mana faster and protects you from being ambushed while you rest.
This is a memory and recovery effect.
tree.tag: This is a memory and recovery effect.

troll.name: Grunt Talk
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand trolls, ogres and other brutes, and they listen to anyone who speaks their tongue. Lower-rank brutes can be talked into leaving rather than fighting.
While you speak in the brutes' tongue, a deep growl in your throat lets you recover health over time, though fire damage interrupts the recovery.
This is a regeneration and communication effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and communication effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Mark
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You read the marks masons leave on stone, revealing the hidden rooms, secret doors and weak walls of any building you enter.
Writing a mason's mark on a damaged wall, gate or barricade repairs it over time. Writing one on a weak wall collapses it.
This is a perception and construction effect.
trowel.tag: This is a perception and construction effect.

turtle.name: Shell Script
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can retreat into a single long word. While speaking it, you cannot move or act, but take greatly reduced damage and cannot be afflicted.
Finishing the word heals you for a portion of the damage you absorbed while speaking it. It can be spoken once per fight.
This is a shell and defensive effect.
turtle.tag: This is a shell and defensive effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Murmur
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
During dawn and dusk, you can speak without being heard by enemies and cast without making sound.
Murmuring a word costs mana and spreads twilight around you for a short time. Within it, enemies cannot see further than a short distance and lose track of anyone not adjacent to them.
This is a darkness and stealth effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and stealth effect.

undeath.name: Corpse Talk
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak to the dead. A fresh corpse answers one question, revealing what killed it, where it came from, or what it was guarding.
The undead understand you as one of their own. Lower-rank undead will not attack you until you attack them.
This is a death and communication effect.
undeath.tag: This is a death and communication effect.

unity.name: Shared Burden
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your party can speak as one. When an ally is affected by fear, charm or silence, you can spend mana to share the effect across the whole party, splitting its duration evenly.
Party members who share a burden gain a brief boon of damage resistance.
This is a unity and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a unity and protection effect.

vast.name: Borderless Tongue
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Any language you understand can be spoken to anyone in the same region as you, across any distance, if you know their name.
Once per day, you can call a named contact to your side. They arrive after a short delay if they are willing and able to travel. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a communication and space effect.
vast.tag: This is a communication and space effect.

vehicle.name: Wagoner's Call
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Mounts, carts and beasts of burden understand you and work for anyone in your party. Calling your mount brings it to you from anywhere in the region.
While mounted, you can speak to any ally within earshot to give them a ride, letting a second party member share your mount and its speed.
This is a command and mount effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a command and mount effect.

venom.name: Slow Venom
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your words can carry poison. When you speak to an enemy after hitting it, the poison afflictions on it tick faster for a short time.
You read the composition of any poison or venom affecting you or an ally. Speaking its name aloud reduces its strength.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Greenspeak
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can ask the undergrowth to move. Speaking to a thicket or creeper costs mana and opens a path through it, or closes it behind you.
Creepers you speak to can also grasp enemies passing through them, rooting a lower-rank enemy for a short time.
This is a plant and control effect.
verdant.tag: This is a plant and control effect.

vessel.name: Open Vessel
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].

You can absorb knowledge from objects as well as books. Touching a weapon, tool or relic left by a skilled user teaches you a fragment of their skill, gaining experience in a matching skill you already know.
Awakening stones you absorb grant their ability with an additional effect where one is possible.
This is an absorption effect.

visage.name: Worn Voice
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak in the voice of anyone you have heard. Guards, merchants and enemies are deceived by the voice until they see you.
In combat you can speak in an enemy leader's voice to issue a false order, causing its allies to hesitate or attack the wrong target briefly. This has a long cooldown.
This is a disguise and deception effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and deception effect.

vision.name: Foretold
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can read omens. Before entering a dungeon, astral realm or boss fight, a short prophecy tells you the most dangerous enemy within and what it is weak to.
Once per day, you can speak a prophecy over an ally. The first lethal blow against them is prevented. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a foresight and protection effect.
vision.tag: This is a foresight and protection effect.

void.name: Hollow Word
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can speak a word that unmakes meaning. Enemy spells and incantations within range are silenced for a short time, and boons granted by spoken abilities are stripped from enemies.
Silenced enemies take increased damage from your dark abilities. The word costs a large amount of mana and has a long cooldown.
This is a silence and dark effect.
void.tag: This is a silence and dark effect.

volcano.name: Molten Word
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Holding a word unspoken builds pressure. While you hold it, which costs mana over time, it grows stronger.
Releasing the word erupts in a column of fire and ash at a point you can see. It deals fire damage that scales with how long the word was held and leaves molten ground for a short time.
This is a fire and charge effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and charge effect.

vortex.name: Spiral Chant
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Chanting costs mana over time and draws loose items, loot and lower-rank enemies toward you in a slow spiral while the chant lasts.
Enemies drawn all the way to you are disoriented, and their next attack has a chance to miss.
This is an air and pull effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and pull effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Rebuke
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can mark an enemy with a rebuke. Every time it attacks you or an ally while the rebuke lasts, it is stung for a small amount of damage and a stacking venom affliction.
A rebuke lasts until the target dies or flees. Rebuking another enemy moves it.
This is a mark and venom effect.
wasp.tag: This is a mark and venom effect.

water.name: Riverspeech
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Rivers, lakes and springs tell you what has entered them upstream. Bodies of water within aura-sense range reveal any creature in or near them on the map.
You can speak to a body of water to calm or raise it, letting you cross a river on foot or flood a low area to slow the enemies in it.
This is a water and communication effect.
water.tag: This is a water and communication effect.

weave.name: Woven Tongue
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can weave two skill books into one. Absorbing two books of related skills at once merges them into a single skill that carries the core effect of both.
A merged skill takes a single skill slot. You can unweave it at a desk, returning the two skills at their current level.
This is an absorption and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is an absorption and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Starving Whisper
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can whisper hunger into a target. Doing so costs mana and applies a stacking cold affliction that drains its stamina.
A target with no stamina left freezes in place for a short time, and you recover a portion of the stamina it lost.
This is a cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Deep Song
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can sing a low song that carries through stone and water. Every ally within a wide radius hears it, and their location is shown to you and to each other.
Enemies within the song's area are briefly disoriented when it begins, losing track of their target.
This is a sound and coordination effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and coordination effect.

wheel.name: Turning Phrase
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
A skill book you have absorbed can be released back into a book, returning the skill and freeing its slot. Released books can be absorbed again later or traded.
Each time you absorb a skill you previously released, it begins at the level you left it.
This is an absorption and cycle effect.
wheel.tag: This is an absorption and cycle effect.

whip.name: Lashing Tongue
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
A sharp command at a summon, familiar or tamed beast drives it into a brief frenzy of increased speed and damage.
The same command cracked at an enemy beast of lower rank makes it flinch and turn away from you, interrupting its attack.
This is a command and beast effect.
whip.tag: This is a command and beast effect.

wind.name: Wind-Borne Speech
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Words you speak can be sent on the wind to any point you can see, where they are heard clearly. Sounds from far upwind reach you, warning you of approaching enemies.
Spending mana, you can speak a cutting gust that pushes enemies in a line away from you and inflicts a brief bleed affliction.
This is a wind and sound effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and sound effect.

wing.name: Feathered Script
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You understand birds and winged creatures. Flying monsters of lower rank can be persuaded to carry a message or scout a route, revealing it on your map.
Once per day, a winged creature you have spoken with will beat its wings at your back, carrying you in one long leap across a gap, river or wall. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a communication and flight effect.
wing.tag: This is a communication and flight effect.

wolf.name: Pack Talk
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your party shares a wordless pack language. Allies within a wide radius always know each other's health, mana and target.
When you call a target, every ally and summon that hears you gains increased damage against it for a short time.
This is a coordination and pack effect.
wolf.tag: This is a coordination and pack effect.

wood.name: Grain Reading
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You read the grain of wooden objects: staves, bows, shields and doors reveal their maker, age and any flaw. Striking a revealed flaw breaks the object.
Wooden weapons and staffs you carry grow with you. Their stats rise as you rank up.
This is a perception and growth effect.
wood.tag: This is a perception and growth effect.

wrath.name: Grudge Speech
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Every insult, threat or taunt directed at you is remembered. Each one grants a stack of wrath, up to a limit.
Spending your wrath with a shouted curse deals fire damage to the enemy that taunted you most recently, increased for every stack spent.
This is a fire and retribution effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fire and retribution effect.

zeal.name: Burning Sermon
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
You can preach to allies within earshot, spending mana each second. While you preach, they gain increased damage and resistance to fear.
Each enemy defeated while you are preaching extends the sermon without cost. The sermon ends when you take damage from a higher-rank enemy.
This is a sound and empowerment effect.
zeal.tag: This is a sound and empowerment effect.

ziz.name: Horizon Voice
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Language Adaptation]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Language Adaptation].
Your voice carries to the edge of the region. Once per day you can broadcast a message heard by every ally and every intelligent creature in the region. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
Monsters of lower rank who hear the broadcast avoid you for a long time afterward, and your path through the region is safer.
This is a voice and fear effect.
ziz.tag: This is a voice and fear effect.

action.name: First Call
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summoning abilities used as the first action of a fight resolve instantly, and the summons they create act before any enemy does.
Your summons begin moving toward a target the moment you face it, before you issue a command.
This is a summoning and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a summoning and haste effect.

adept.name: Drillmaster's Host
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each of your summons learns from the fights it survives. A summon that has fought alongside you for long enough gains one of your own special attacks as a lesser version it can use on its own.
Dismissing a trained summon keeps what it learned. The next time you call it, it returns with that training intact.
This is a summoning and training effect.
adept.tag: This is a summoning and training effect.

alchemy.name: Brewed Familiar
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can feed a potion from your inventory to a summon. The summon gains that potion's effect at full strength for its whole duration, rather than you.
A summon that dies while carrying a potion's effect bursts, splashing the effect over allies around it.
This is a summoning and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a summoning and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Host
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can summon into concealment. Summons called this way are unseen until they attack or are struck.
The first attack each concealed summon makes is a guaranteed critical hit and briefly stuns its target.
This is a summoning and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a summoning and stealth effect.

animate.name: Wakened Furnishings
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can spend mana to animate a nearby object, such as a statue, a cart, a suit of armour or a fallen weapon, as a temporary summon. Its health and strength depend on what it was made of.
When the effect ends, the object returns to stillness where it stands.
This is a summoning and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a summoning and animation effect.

anzu.name: Storm Retinue
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
While you have summons active outdoors, a thunderhead gathers over them. Each time one of your summons lands a hit, lightning may strike its target.
When a summon is dismissed or dies, the storm discharges where it stood, inflicting lightning damage on nearby enemies.
This is a summoning and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a summoning and storm effect.
