ape.name: Mimic Troop
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you use an ability, your nearest summon copies the gesture a moment later as a crude imitation that deals a portion of its damage. Imitated healing and support abilities are not copied.
Summons pick up and throw loose objects, rubble and fallen weapons at enemies when they have nothing better to do.
This is a summoning and imitation effect.
ape.tag: This is a summoning and imitation effect.

armour.name: Plated Retinue
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons arrive wearing a layer of conjured plate that absorbs damage before their health. The plate does not recover while the summon is in combat.
You can spend mana to strip the plate from one summon and fasten it onto another, or onto yourself, for a short time.
This is a summoning and conjuration effect.
armour.tag: This is a summoning and conjuration effect.

arsenal.name: Ready Ranks
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each summon arrives armed with a weapon suited to its target. Melee summons carry a polearm against charging enemies, a blade against unarmoured ones, and a hammer against armoured ones.
You can spend stamina to make all of your summons switch weapons at once, to counter whichever damage type the current enemy is weakest to.
This is a summoning and conjuration effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a summoning and conjuration effect.

aspect.name: Shared Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].

Once per fight you can take the form of one of your active summons. You gain its movement, size and basic attack while the summon stands beside you in your own likeness, using your special attacks at reduced effect.
Ending the form returns both of you to your own shapes. This effect recovers after the fight ends.
This is a transformation and summoning effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and summoning effect.

avatar.name: Standard of the Host
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can spend mana to designate one summon as your avatar. It grows to a greater form, gaining health, size and damage, and other summons near it fight harder.
While your avatar lives, damage dealt to you is partly redirected to it. Only one avatar can exist at a time.
This is a summoning and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a summoning and transformation effect.

axe.name: Felling Line
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you strike an enemy, every summon within range drops its current target and strikes the same enemy in turn, each blow falling a moment after the last.
An enemy struck by every one of your active summons in a single falling line is staggered.
This is a summoning and coordination effect.
axe.tag: This is a summoning and coordination effect.

balance.name: Even Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Damage taken by any of your summons is spread evenly across all of them. A summon cannot be killed while another of your summons has more than a sliver of health left.
When you have exactly as many summons as there are enemies in a fight, your summons deal increased damage.
This is a summoning and balance effect.
balance.tag: This is a summoning and balance effect.

bat.name: Roost of Echoes
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be dismissed into a roost of bats that circles above you. While roosting they cannot be harmed, and they reveal enemies hidden by darkness or invisibility within aura-sense range.
Recalling a roosted summon brings it down at any point you can see, landing among enemies and scattering them.
This is a summoning and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a summoning and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Drilled Formation
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can order your summons into a line, a wedge or a ring. A line blocks enemy movement, a wedge pushes forward with increased damage, and a ring protects whatever stands inside it.
Summons holding formation take reduced damage. Breaking formation by moving a summon out of place ends the bonus for all of them.
This is a summoning and command effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a summoning and command effect.

bear.name: Den Mother
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
While a summon is below half health, you can spend stamina to shield it with your own body, taking the hits meant for it. Damage you take this way is reduced.
When a summon you are shielding is struck, you can answer with a counter-swipe that knocks the attacker back.
This is a summoning and protection effect.
bear.tag: This is a summoning and protection effect.

bee.name: Hive Mind
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons share a single awareness. What one summon sees, all of them know, and an enemy targeted by one is targeted by all.
When a summon dies, it leaves behind a small swarm that stings nearby enemies for a short time before dispersing.
This is a summoning and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a summoning and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Colossal Servant
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].

You can sacrifice your entire summon limit to call a single colossal summon. It has health and size far beyond any one ordinary summon, and lower-rank enemies cannot knock it back, root it or move it.
Its steps shake the ground, briefly staggering nearby enemies as it walks.
This is a summoning and earth effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a summoning and earth effect.

bird.name: Messenger Flight
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can send one summon away to scout a point on the map. It flies there unseen, reveals the area as explored, and returns with any loose loot it finds on the way.
A scouting summon cannot fight. If attacked, it returns to you immediately.
This is a summoning and scouting effect.
bird.tag: This is a summoning and scouting effect.

blight.name: Rot Brood
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons carry a creeping rot. Enemies they strike suffer a blight affliction that weakens healing received.
An enemy that dies while blighted rises briefly as a withered husk under your control. Husks are weak, cannot be healed and crumble after a short time.
This is a summoning and blight effect.
blight.tag: This is a summoning and blight effect.

blood.name: Blood Oath
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can pay health instead of mana to call a summon. A summon called with your blood is stronger and fiercer, but its life is tied to yours: when it takes damage, a portion is drawn from your health.
When a blood-called summon kills an enemy, you recover health.
This is a summoning and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a summoning and blood effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Guard
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When one of your summons falls, its bones remain where it fell. You can spend mana to raise the bones as a skeletal guard that holds that position and attacks anything that comes near.
Only a few skeletal guards can stand at once. A skeletal guard cannot move from where it was raised.
This is a summoning and necromancy effect.
bone.tag: This is a summoning and necromancy effect.

boundary.name: Warden Line
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be told to hold a line between two points. Enemies cannot pass between them without first breaking the line, which requires defeating one of the two summons anchoring it.
While anchoring, those summons are rooted but take significantly reduced damage.
This is a summoning and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a summoning and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Muster
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you summon at your summon limit, one extra summon still answers. It lasts only a short time and cannot be healed.
Your summons can pick up loot from defeated enemies and share it out: healing items and potions they collect are used on the most wounded nearby ally.
This is a summoning and abundance effect.
bounty.tag: This is a summoning and abundance effect.

bow.name: Volley Order
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Every summon you control gains a ranged attack, firing conjured arrows when it cannot reach its target.
You can spend mana to give a volley order. All of your summons stop, draw and loose at once on a single point, inflicting heavy piercing damage across a small area.
This is a summoning and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a summoning and ranged effect.

brush.name: Thicket Spawn
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
While your summons stand in grass, brush or forest, they are hidden from enemies until they attack.
A summon that dies in undergrowth regrows from it after a short time at a portion of its health. Each summon can regrow once per fight.
This is a summoning and nature effect.
brush.tag: This is a summoning and nature effect.

cage.name: Kennel Bars
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When three of your summons surround one enemy, conjured bars close between them, trapping the enemy inside. A trapped enemy cannot leave the cage until a summon forming it moves or dies.
Attacks on a trapped enemy from outside the cage deal increased damage.
This is a summoning and imprisonment effect.
cage.tag: This is a summoning and imprisonment effect.

cat.name: Prowling Familiar
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
One summon at a time can be set to prowl. A prowling summon slips out of sight and stalks the enemy furthest from you, striking from behind for heavy damage when that enemy is distracted.
A prowling summon always lands on its feet; it takes no damage from falls or knockdowns.
This is a summoning and stealth effect.
cat.tag: This is a summoning and stealth effect.

cataclysm.name: Ruin Bearers
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can command one summon to sacrifice itself. It tears open the ground where it stands, inflicting heavy damage in an area and leaving broken terrain that slows enemies for a long time.
The ground stays broken after the fight, so it can be used to wall off paths. This command has a long cooldown.
This is a summoning and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a summoning and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Yoked Herd
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be yoked to carry. A yoked summon follows you outside combat and holds a portion of your carrying capacity; anything it carries returns to your inventory when it is dismissed.
In combat, yoked summons can stampede in a line, trampling enemies in their path.
This is a summoning and burden effect.
cattle.tag: This is a summoning and burden effect.

chain.name: Linked Host
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons are bound to you and to each other by visible chains of light. Enemies that cross a chain are slowed and take damage.
You can spend mana to yank every chain at once, pulling all of your summons to your side.
This is a summoning and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a summoning and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Wild Muster
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each time you summon, roll for a random trait on the summon: frenzied, armoured, swift, venomous, giant or splitting. The trait lasts as long as the summon does.
A summon that rolls splitting divides into two smaller copies when it dies.
This is a summoning and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a summoning and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: Borrowed Banners
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can disguise your summons as creatures native to the area. Monsters of equal or lower rank do not treat a disguised summon as hostile until it attacks.
A disguised summon can walk into an enemy group, and the first hit it lands when the disguise falls deals greatly increased damage.
This is a summoning and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a summoning and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Mother Hen
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your weakest summon is always the one enemies find hardest to reach. Enemies that attack it are pecked at by every other summon nearby.
When you are reduced to low health, every summon drops what it is doing and gathers around you, absorbing a portion of the damage aimed at you.
This is a summoning and guardian effect.
chicken.tag: This is a summoning and guardian effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Brood
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can merge two of your active summons into one chimera. It keeps the abilities of both, along with their combined health.
If the chimera's health drops low, it tears apart into the original two summons, each with a portion of the health remaining.
This is a summoning and fusion effect.
chimera.tag: This is a summoning and fusion effect.

claw.name: Talon Pact
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you hit an enemy with a melee attack, you leave rending marks on it. Your summons tear those marks open, dealing bleed damage for every mark they strike.
A summon can carry a portion of your claw marks into its own attacks while it stays close to you.
This is a summoning and bleed effect.
claw.tag: This is a summoning and bleed effect.

cloth.name: Stitched Host
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can stitch a fallen summon back together with mana and time. A stitched summon returns at full health with a seam that marks it, and it gains a resistance to whatever damage type killed it.
Each summon can carry only a few seams. A summon with every seam used cannot be stitched again.
This is a summoning and mending effect.
cloth.tag: This is a summoning and mending effect.

cloud.name: Vapour Host
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can scatter a summon into drifting vapour. While scattered it cannot attack or be attacked, and it drifts wherever you direct it, passing through gaps, bars and narrow places.
Reforming the summon makes it condense among enemies, blinding those nearby for a moment.
This is a summoning and mist effect.
cloud.tag: This is a summoning and mist effect.

cold.name: Rime Kin
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons radiate a deep chill. Enemies fighting them are slowed, and grow slower the longer they stay engaged.
A summon that dies leaves a statue of ice where it stood. The statue blocks movement and shatters for cold damage when struck.
This is a summoning and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a summoning and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Colony
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summons that stand still for a short time take root as living reef. A rooted summon cannot move, but it gains damage reduction and slowly heals any summon within reach of it.
Enemies that strike a rooted summon are cut by its edges and take damage in return.
This is a summoning and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a summoning and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Spoiled Offering
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can corrupt one of your own summons, making it grotesque and stronger. A corrupted summon gains damage and an aura that afflicts enemies near it, but it slowly loses health and cannot be healed.
When a corrupted summon dies, it bursts in a cloud of decay that afflicts every enemy it touches.
This is a summoning and corruption effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a summoning and corruption effect.

crocodile.name: Lurking Pool
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can sink a summon into water or mud, where it waits submerged and unseen. The first enemy to step within reach is seized and held in its jaws, unable to move or attack until it breaks free.
A summon holding an enemy this way deals damage over time and takes reduced damage from the enemy it holds.
This is a summoning and ambush effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a summoning and ambush effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Bond
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].

When three or more summons are active, lines of crystal join them into a lattice. Spells cast through the lattice by any of you are refracted, striking an additional enemy for a portion of their damage.
Breaking the lattice by losing a summon shatters it, dealing damage to enemies standing on its lines.
This is a summoning and crystal effect.
crystal.tag: This is a summoning and crystal effect.

cycle.name: Seasons of the Host
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a summon's duration ends naturally, it leaves behind a seed. Summoning the same type again from the seed's position costs no mana, and the new summon arrives with increased health.
A summon that dies in combat leaves no seed.
This is a summoning and renewal effect.
cycle.tag: This is a summoning and renewal effect.

dance.name: Circle Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons move with you in formation. When you dodge, they dodge with you, and enemy attacks aimed at a dodging summon miss.
Every few dodges, your summons swap places with each other in a turning step, confusing enemies who lose track of their targets.
This is a summoning and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is a summoning and movement effect.

dark.name: Shadow Kennel
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be stored in your own shadow, where they cannot be harmed and do not count against your summon limit. While stored, they mend over time.
A summon released from your shadow emerges behind any enemy standing in shadow within range.
This is a summoning and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a summoning and darkness effect.

dawn.name: Sunrise Vanguard
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons shed light around them, revealing stealthed and invisible enemies within its radius.
For a short time after dawn in the game world, your summons arrive with full boons of increased damage and speed.
This is a summoning and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is a summoning and light effect.

death.name: Last Rites
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When one of your summons is about to die, you can spend mana to grant it a final stand. For a short time it cannot fall, and its attacks deal increased damage; when the stand ends, it dies.
An enemy killed by a summon in its final stand cannot be resurrected or raised by anyone but you.
This is a summoning and death effect.
death.tag: This is a summoning and death effect.

deep.name: Fathom Call
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summons you call in deep water arrive larger and heavier, gaining health and knockback resistance.

Once per day you can call a summon of the deep from any body of water you can see: a creature of crushing weight that drags enemies beneath the surface. It remains only while water is within its reach. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a summoning and water effect.
deep.tag: This is a summoning and water effect.

deer.name: Startled Herd
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you are struck by a surprise attack, every summon bolts to your side instantly and the attacker is revealed on the map.
Summons that bolt this way gain a brief burst of speed and evasion.
This is a summoning and alarm effect.
deer.tag: This is a summoning and alarm effect.

desolate.name: Bare Ground Watch
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons drain the life from the ground they stand on, leaving it ashen. Enemies standing on ashen ground cannot be healed.
Your summons recover health while standing on ashen ground they made.
This is a summoning and desolation effect.
desolate.tag: This is a summoning and desolation effect.

dimension.name: Folded Barracks
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You keep a fold of space that holds dismissed summons exactly as they were, health and afflictions included. Recalling one places it anywhere you can see.
You can swap places with any summon in sight by spending mana.
This is a summoning, dimensional and teleport effect.
dimension.tag: This is a summoning, dimensional and teleport effect.

discord.name: Turned Ranks
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When an enemy summon or minion is struck enough times by your own summons, it breaks from its master and fights for you for a short time.
Only one turned enemy can serve at a time, and enemies of higher rank than you cannot be turned.
This is a summoning and discord effect.
discord.tag: This is a summoning and discord effect.

discordant.name: Discord Herald
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Enemy summons and familiars near your summons lose their bond to their masters. They stop obeying commands and attack the nearest creature.
Enemy groups fighting your summons cannot coordinate. They do not share targets, call for help or use combined attacks.
This is a summoning and discord effect.
discordant.tag: This is a summoning and discord effect.

dog.name: Faithful Hound
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
One summon can be named as your companion. It persists between fights, follows you outside combat and is never dismissed by your summon limit.
Your companion fetches loot from fallen enemies, guards you while you rest, and grows stronger the longer it stays at your side without dying.
This is a summoning and loyalty effect.
dog.tag: This is a summoning and loyalty effect.

doom.name: Sealed Name
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can write an enemy's name onto one of your summons. The summon pursues that enemy alone, ignores every other target, and deals greatly increased damage to it.
When the named enemy dies, the summon fades. If the summon dies first, the named enemy carries a doom-mark that makes your next summon bound to it arrive instantly.
This is a summoning and doom effect.
doom.tag: This is a summoning and doom effect.

doppelganger.name: Echo Host
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can spend mana to have a summon take your shape. Enemies cannot tell it from you, and it uses your basic attacks at reduced strength.
You can swap places with your copy once while it lives.
This is a summoning, illusion and teleport effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a summoning, illusion and teleport effect.

dragon.name: Hoard Warden
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
One summon at a time can be raised as a drake. It breathes fire in a cone, its scales reduce the damage it takes, and it grows stronger with every rank you hold.
The drake guards whatever you set down. Loot, crafting materials or an ally placed near it is defended until you return.
This is a summoning and fire effect.
dragon.tag: This is a summoning and fire effect.

duck.name: Unruffled Brood
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons shrug off control. The first stun, fear, root or charm applied to each summon in a fight has no effect.
Summons can cross water freely, floating on it as easily as standing on land.
This is a summoning and resistance effect.
duck.tag: This is a summoning and resistance effect.

dust.name: Dust Ranks
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].

When a summon is dismissed or killed, it settles as a mound of grey dust. You can spend mana to raise all nearby dust mounds as a single sweeping dust storm that blinds enemies and conceals your allies.
While concealed by the storm, your summons and allies cannot be targeted from range.
This is a summoning and earth effect.
dust.tag: This is a summoning and earth effect.

earth.name: Stoneborn Guard
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can call a summon up out of the ground beneath an enemy. A summon that rises this way throws the enemy into the air on arrival.
Summons standing on natural ground take reduced damage and cannot be knocked back.
This is a summoning and earth effect.
earth.tag: This is a summoning and earth effect.

echo.name: Answering Call
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a summon dies, its echo lingers for a short time: a translucent copy that repeats the last attack the summon made, once more.
You can call one echo back as a full summon at a portion of its health, spending mana. Each summon's echo can be called back once per day.
This is a summoning and echo effect.
echo.tag: This is a summoning and echo effect.

eclipse.name: Shadowed Escort
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons stand in your light. Attacks and spells aimed at you from the front strike the nearest summon in that direction first.
While a summon is shielding you this way, its body casts a shadow that conceals you from ranged targeting.
This is a summoning and shadow effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a summoning and shadow effect.

edifice.name: Garrison Spirits
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can bind a summon into a wall, gate or tower. While bound, it has no duration limit, defends that structure, and repairs damage done to it.
Bound summons count against your summon limit. They can be recalled to your side at any time.
This is a summoning and structure effect.
edifice.tag: This is a summoning and structure effect.

effigy.name: Straw Bodyguard
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can name one summon as your effigy. While it lives, any blow that would reduce you below a portion of your maximum health is taken by the effigy instead.
When the effigy is destroyed this way, it burns, and the enemy that struck the blow is set alight.
This is a summoning and substitution effect.
effigy.tag: This is a summoning and substitution effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Conduit
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons take on the element of the last spell you cast. Their attacks deal that damage type and they resist it.
You can spend mana to discharge a summon's element, detonating it in an elemental burst. The summon survives the burst but loses its element until you cast again.
This is a summoning and elemental effect.
elemental.tag: This is a summoning and elemental effect.

elixir.name: Shared Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you drink a potion, every summon within range gains its effect at reduced strength.
You can feed a potion directly to one summon instead. It gains the full effect, extended in duration.
This is a summoning and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a summoning and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Lent Might
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Boons you receive are copied onto every summon within a short distance of you.
You can spend mana to pour your own strength into a single summon. For a short time it deals damage as if it were your rank, while you deal reduced damage.
This is a summoning and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is a summoning and empowerment effect.

eye.name: Watchful Sentries
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can post a summon as a sentry. A posted summon does not move, but it sees further than you do: invisible and hidden enemies within its sight are revealed to you and to the map.
You can see through a posted sentry's eyes from anywhere in the same area.
This is a summoning and perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a summoning and perception effect.

feast.name: Victory Feast
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can devour fallen enemies. A summon that eats a corpse recovers health and gains a stacking boon to its damage for the rest of the fight.
After a fight, you share in what your summons ate, recovering mana and stamina for each corpse devoured.
This is a summoning and feast effect.
feast.tag: This is a summoning and feast effect.

feeble.name: Sapping Brood
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each hit a summon lands steals a sliver of the enemy's strength, weakening its attacks and passing that strength to the summon.
Strength stolen this way fades after a short time, from both the enemy and the summon.
This is a summoning and weakening effect.
feeble.tag: This is a summoning and weakening effect.

fertile.name: Rooted Brood
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Where your summons fall, plants spring up. Each plant grows over a short time into a sapling sentry that attacks nearby enemies with thorns.
Sentries cannot move and wither when you leave the area. They do not count against your summon limit.
This is a summoning and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a summoning and growth effect.

fey.name: Bargained Servants
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a lower-rank monster is reduced to low health, you can offer it a bargain instead of a killing blow. If it accepts, it serves you as a summon until the next dawn, then leaves.
A monster bargained with this way never attacks you again. Higher-rank monsters refuse every bargain.
This is a summoning and pact effect.
fey.tag: This is a summoning and pact effect.

fire.name: Kindled Host
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons burn. Enemies that strike or are struck by them suffer a burn affliction.
You can spend mana to sacrifice a summon in a column of flame, dealing heavy fire damage around it. Its flame passes to your other summons, increasing their fire damage for the rest of the fight.
This is a summoning and fire effect.
fire.tag: This is a summoning and fire effect.

firebird.name: Embered Flock
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons burn. Enemies that strike them in melee take fire damage.
When a summon dies, it bursts into embers that reform, after a short delay, into a smaller fire-bird summon that lasts a short time. A fire-bird cannot reform again.
This is a summoning and fire effect.
firebird.tag: This is a summoning and fire effect.

fish.name: Silver Shoal
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Instead of one summon, you can call a shoal: many small, weak copies that move as one. Damage spread across the shoal is mostly wasted, so area attacks against it deal reduced damage.
When the shoal is struck, it scatters and reforms around you, confusing enemies about where you are.
This is a summoning and swarm effect.
fish.tag: This is a summoning and swarm effect.

flea.name: Leaping Pest
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can leap from one enemy to the next instead of walking. A summon that kills an enemy jumps immediately to the nearest one, landing with an attack.
Small summons can ride on larger ones. A rider attacks whatever its mount attacks.
This is a summoning and leaping effect.
flea.tag: This is a summoning and leaping effect.

flesh.name: Flesh Tithe
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can graft two summons together into one larger creature that has both their health and both their attacks. A grafted summon counts as one summon against your limit.
Grafts are unstable and split apart after a time, each half returning at a portion of its health.
This is a summoning and flesh-shaping effect.
flesh.tag: This is a summoning and flesh-shaping effect.

foot.name: Long March
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can stay summoned while you travel. Summons that have marched with you across a long distance without being dismissed gain stamina and health for the next fight.
Marching summons quicken your travel speed outside combat.
This is a summoning and travel effect.
foot.tag: This is a summoning and travel effect.

force.name: Battering Host
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons' attacks knock their targets back. An enemy knocked into a wall, obstacle or another enemy is stunned briefly.
You can spend stamina to command every summon to charge the same target at once. Each one that connects adds to a stacking knockback.
This is a summoning and force effect.
force.tag: This is a summoning and force effect.

forge.name: Anvil-Born
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each time a summon survives a hit, it hardens. It gains stacking damage reduction for as long as it lasts.
You can spend crafting materials at a forge to temper one summon type permanently. Every summon of that type then arrives with a portion of its hardened stacks already in place.
This is a summoning and forging effect.
forge.tag: This is a summoning and forging effect.

fork.name: Forked Command
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can split your summons into two groups with separate orders, each following its own target or position.
When both groups strike the same enemy from opposite sides, it is pinned in place briefly.
This is a summoning and command effect.
fork.tag: This is a summoning and command effect.

fortress.name: Walled Guard
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
While you stand still, your summons close around you in a guarded ring. Enemies cannot reach you in melee until they break through a summon.
Archers and spellcasters among your summons gain range and damage while the ring holds.
This is a summoning and fortification effect.
fortress.tag: This is a summoning and fortification effect.

fox.name: Trickster Kit
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can steal. A summon that strikes an enemy has a chance to snatch something it carries, a consumable or loot item, and bring it back to you.
A summon that is targeted by an enemy can feint, leaving an illusory copy behind as it slips away.
This is a summoning, illusion and theft effect.
fox.tag: This is a summoning, illusion and theft effect.

frog.name: Spring Brood
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can spring across short gaps and over enemies, landing behind them.
A summon's long tongue can snatch an enemy's projectile out of the air before it reaches you. Each summon can do this once every short interval.
This is a summoning and interception effect.
frog.tag: This is a summoning and interception effect.

fungus.name: Spore Seeding
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A summon that dies leaves a cluster of spores where it fell. After a short time the cluster sprouts a small fungal summon that fights for you until the fight ends.
Enemies standing in a spore cluster before it sprouts are slowed and coughing, unable to use abilities that require speech.
This is a summoning and spore effect.
fungus.tag: This is a summoning and spore effect.

garuda.name: Gold Pinion Mount
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
One summon at a time can carry you. You ride it as a swift mount, bounding across gaps in great leaps, while it keeps attacking.
Your mount is immune to poison, and snake and serpent enemies flee from it.
This is a summoning, mount and flight effect.
garuda.tag: This is a summoning, mount and flight effect.

gate.name: Doorway Muster
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can summon through a gate opened at any point you can see, rather than beside you. Summons arrive at that point.
You can recall all of your summons to your side through the same gate at any time.
This is a summoning, space and teleport effect.
gate.tag: This is a summoning, space and teleport effect.

gathering.name: Rally Point
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can set a rally point anywhere you can see. Spending mana draws every summon to it instantly, along with any enemy standing between them and the point.
Summons that arrive at a rally point together gain a brief shield.
This is a summoning and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a summoning and gathering effect.

glass.name: Glass Menagerie
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can call summons made of glass. They cost little mana and deal heavy damage, but they shatter on the first hit they take.
A shattering glass summon showers nearby enemies in shards, inflicting a bleed affliction.
This is a summoning and glass effect.
glass.tag: This is a summoning and glass effect.

glimeron.name: Prism Guard
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Spells that strike your summons split. Part of the spell's damage is absorbed and the rest scatters as beams toward nearby enemies.
Your spells passing through one of your summons are split into several weaker beams that each seek a different enemy.
This is a summoning and light effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a summoning and light effect.

goat.name: Mountain Herd
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can climb cliffs, ledges and walls that you cannot, reaching high ground to attack from above.
A summon attacking from higher ground than its target deals increased damage, and a charging summon headbutts enemies off ledges.
This is a summoning and climbing effect.
goat.tag: This is a summoning and climbing effect.

gorgon.name: Stone Watch
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Enemies that meet a summon's gaze while attacking it begin to petrify, slowing with each hit they make against it until they are briefly turned to stone.
A petrified enemy takes increased damage from your summons. Higher-rank enemies resist petrification.
This is a summoning and petrification effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a summoning and petrification effect.

griffin.name: Height Stoop
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your flying summons can circle high above the field, out of reach of melee attacks. You can mark a target, and every circling summon stoops on it at once.
A stooping summon's first strike deals heavy damage and pins the target to the ground for a brief time.
This is a summoning and flight effect.
griffin.tag: This is a summoning and flight effect.

growth.name: Swelling Host
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons grow larger the longer they stay summoned, gaining health, reach and damage over a fight. Growth is lost when the summon is dismissed.
A summon at its full size can be split into two smaller summons at their starting size.
This is a summoning and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a summoning and growth effect.

guardian.name: Shield-Bonded
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can bond one summon to an ally. The summon stays beside that ally and intercepts attacks aimed at them.
Each attack the bonded summon intercepts grants the ally a stacking barrier. The bond lasts until the summon dies or is dismissed.
This is a summoning and protection effect.
guardian.tag: This is a summoning and protection effect.

hair.name: Woven Leash
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Fine strands tie each of your summons to you. You can reel any summon to your side, or reel yourself to it, along the strand.
Enemies that try to pass between you and a summon are tangled in the strands and briefly rooted.
This is a summoning, movement and binding effect.
hair.tag: This is a summoning, movement and binding effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Guard
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can strike your own summon with a weapon attack to temper it. A tempered summon gains damage reduction and its next attack lands as a flattening blow that knocks enemies down.
Tempering a summon deals it no damage.
This is a summoning and forging effect.
hammer.tag: This is a summoning and forging effect.

hand.name: Many Hands
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can work. Out of combat, they gather from crafting nodes, carry materials and assist at crafting stations, shortening the time crafting takes.
In combat, a summon can hand you any item from your inventory without you breaking stride.
This is a summoning and labour effect.
hand.tag: This is a summoning and labour effect.

harmonic.name: Chorus of the Host
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summons that attack in rhythm resonate. When several summons hit the same enemy within a short window, each hit deals bonus damage that grows with the number of summons in the chord.
You and your summons share a single pulse: when one is healed, the others recover a portion of it.
This is a summoning and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a summoning and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Thieving Wings
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons snatch things. Each summon's hit has a chance to steal a boon from its target or knock a carried item loose.
Stolen boons pass to you; stolen items drop at your feet. Your summons' shrieking makes enemies near them miss more often.
This is a summoning and theft effect.
harpy.tag: This is a summoning and theft effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning Host
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When an enemy dies near your summons, they reap it. Each nearby summon gains health and duration from the kill.
When you are near crafting nodes, your summons can be sent to gather them, bringing the materials back to your inventory.
This is a summoning and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a summoning and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Bonded Steed
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
One summon can be called as a mount. You ride it outside and inside combat, moving at its speed, and it attacks with its hooves whenever you attack.
If your mount falls, you land on your feet and it can be called again after a short time.
This is a summoning and mount effect.
heidel.tag: This is a summoning and mount effect.

hook.name: Barbed Tether
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can hook an enemy and drag it toward you or toward another summon.
An enemy dragged into a cluster of your summons is struck by every one of them in turn.
This is a summoning and pull effect.
hook.tag: This is a summoning and pull effect.

horse.name: Cavalry Charge
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can spend stamina to send every summon charging in a single direction at great speed. Enemies they pass through are trampled and knocked aside.
Summons that finish a charge together gain movement speed for a short time.
This is a summoning and charge effect.
horse.tag: This is a summoning and charge effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Brood
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons are always hungry. Each one gains attack speed for every enemy that has died nearby in the fight.
When a summon goes too long without attacking, it turns on the nearest enemy regardless of your orders, gaining a burst of speed to reach it.
This is a summoning and hunger effect.
hunger.tag: This is a summoning and hunger effect.

hunt.name: Pack Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can name one enemy as the quarry. Your summons track it anywhere within the area, ignoring other targets, and it cannot shake them by stealth or invisibility.
When the quarry dies, its loot drops at your feet and your summons gain a brief boon to damage.
This is a summoning and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a summoning and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrown Necks
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When one of your summons dies, two weaker copies of it rise from where it fell. Each copy has a portion of the original's health and duration.
Copies created this way cannot split again. Only fire or acid damage prevents the split.
This is a summoning and regeneration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a summoning and regeneration effect.

ice.name: Frost Wardens
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can freeze one of your summons solid, making it immune to damage but unable to act. While frozen, it chills every enemy that stands beside it.
Thawing a frozen summon releases a burst of frost that slows nearby enemies.
This is a summoning and ice effect.
ice.tag: This is a summoning and ice effect.

immortal.name: Undying Retinue
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons remember. A summon type you have called many times grows stronger with every summoning, and keeps that growth between fights and across rest.
Once per day, a summon that would die refuses to. It survives at minimum health and becomes untargetable for a moment. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a summoning and endurance effect.
immortal.tag: This is a summoning and endurance effect.

iron.name: Iron Muster
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons stand in a shield wall when they are next to each other. Enemies cannot pass through a shield wall, and ranged attacks that strike it are stopped.
Spirits, fey and other creatures harmed by cold iron take increased damage from your summons.
This is a summoning and warding effect.
iron.tag: This is a summoning and warding effect.

juggernaut.name: Stampede Order
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summons that move in a straight line build momentum. The further they travel before striking, the harder they hit.
At full momentum, a summon cannot be slowed, stopped or knocked back, and it tramples lower-rank enemies in its path.
This is a summoning and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a summoning and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Owed Blows
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Every enemy that damages one of your summons is written into a ledger. Your other summons deal increased damage to enemies in the ledger, scaling with what each one has taken.
When a summon dies, the enemy that killed it carries the full debt, and every summon you call next targets it first.
This is a summoning and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is a summoning and retribution effect.

knife.name: Unseen Retainer
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can hide a summon in plain sight. A hidden summon follows you unseen and does not draw aggression.
When you land a special attack, the hidden summon strikes the same enemy from behind at the same moment. The summon is revealed after striking.
This is a summoning and stealth effect.
knife.tag: This is a summoning and stealth effect.

knowledge.name: Bestiary
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You keep a record of every kind of monster your summons have fought. Your summons deal increased damage to monster types already in your record.
When you absorb a skill book, your summons gain a lesser share of the skill for as long as they remain summoned.
This is a summoning and lore effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a summoning and lore effect.

kraken.name: Deep Reach
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can summon a tentacle from any patch of water, mud or deep shadow you can see. It seizes the nearest enemy and drags it toward the tentacle's source.
An enemy dragged into water is held under and cannot act until the tentacle is destroyed or its duration ends.
This is a summoning and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a summoning and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Wake of the Great
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your largest active summon carries the others in its wake. Every other summon moving behind it gains speed and cannot be knocked back.
When it charges, a surge follows it, sweeping lower-rank enemies off their feet and dragging them along behind it.
This is a summoning and tide effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a summoning and tide effect.

life.name: Lifeblood Pact
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Healing you receive is shared with your summons. Healing your summons receive is shared with you.
Once per day, when one of your summons would die, it is restored to full health instead. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a summoning and life effect.
life.tag: This is a summoning and life effect.

light.name: Radiant Vanguard
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons shine. Darkness around them is dispelled, and enemies hidden by stealth are revealed when they come near a summon.
You can spend mana to make a summon flare, blinding every enemy facing it.
This is a summoning and light effect.
light.tag: This is a summoning and light effect.

lightning.name: Storm Riders
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Lightning arcs between your summons when they are close enough to each other. Enemies standing between two summons are struck by the arc.
You can spend mana to pass a bolt of lightning along every summon in turn, ending at the target of your choice.
This is a summoning and lightning effect.
lightning.tag: This is a summoning and lightning effect.

lizard.name: Cold-Blooded Kin
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A summon that loses a limb or is badly wounded sheds the injury and grows it back, recovering health over a short time.
Summons that stand motionless in sunlight or warmth recover health and stamina.
This is a summoning and regeneration effect.
lizard.tag: This is a summoning and regeneration effect.

locust.name: Locust Tide
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].

You can spend mana to break all of your summons down into a single devouring swarm. The swarm moves as one, strips health from everything in its path and consumes loose food, crops and corpses for health.
When the swarm ends, your summons reform at the size their feeding has earned them.
This is a summoning and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is a summoning and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons cannot carry afflictions. Any affliction applied to a summon is shed after a short time, and the summon blooms, healing allies around it.
You can dismiss a summon to cleanse yourself of one affliction.
This is a summoning and purification effect.
lotus.tag: This is a summoning and purification effect.

lurker.name: Things Beneath
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can move beneath the ground, floor or water, invisible and untargetable, surfacing only to attack.
An enemy attacked from beneath is dragged down briefly, unable to move.
This is a summoning and lurking effect.
lurker.tag: This is a summoning and lurking effect.

magic.name: Arcane Tether
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each of your summons is linked to you by a visible thread of mana. Spells you cast can be channelled down a thread so they originate from that summon instead of from you.
A spell cast through a summon costs additional mana. Summons that channel a spell are unaffected by it.
This is a summoning and channelling effect.
magic.tag: This is a summoning and channelling effect.

malign.name: Grudgebound
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When one of your summons is struck, it remembers the attacker. Your summons deal increased damage to any enemy that has struck one of them, and the bonus grows with each summon that enemy has harmed.
When a summon dies, its grudge passes to the others and does not fade until the attacker dies.
This is a summoning and malice effect.
malign.tag: This is a summoning and malice effect.

manatee.name: Drifting Herd
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be sent to graze. A grazing summon wanders away from combat at a slow pace and recovers health over time, and enemies of lower rank ignore it.
Recalling a grazing summon returns it to your side at full speed with a brief shield that scales with how long it grazed.
This is a summoning and recovery effect.
manatee.tag: This is a summoning and recovery effect.

manticore.name: Masked Hunter
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your beast summons wear human faces. Humanoid enemies hesitate before striking them, losing their first attack.
Each beast summon fires spines from its tail at range, applying a stacking poison affliction.
This is a summoning and poison effect.
manticore.tag: This is a summoning and poison effect.

master.name: Practiced Hands
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons learn. Each summon type gains proficiency each time it is called, improving its accuracy and how quickly it attacks.
At full proficiency, the summon type learns one of your special attacks and uses it on its own.
This is a summoning and mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a summoning and mastery effect.

might.name: Weight of the Host
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can spend stamina to throw your weight behind a summon. For a short time it shares your physical power, and its attacks knock lower-rank enemies off their feet.
While a summon carries your weight, your own attacks deal reduced damage. Only one summon can carry it at a time.
This is a summoning and empowerment effect.
might.tag: This is a summoning and empowerment effect.

ministration.name: Field Physicians
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can command a summon to tend a wounded ally. It stops fighting, kneels beside them, and heals them steadily while it remains undisturbed.
A tending summon also removes bleed afflictions and slows the spread of others.
This is a summoning and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a summoning and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Keeper
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Inside interiors, caves and dungeons, your summons know the layout. They take the shortest route to any target and flank enemies by unseen passages.
You can summon a horned guardian at a corridor's end. Enemies that enter its corridor are charged and knocked back the way they came.
This is a summoning and maze effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a summoning and maze effect.

mirage.name: Shimmer Host
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each real summon is accompanied by an illusory twin. Enemies cannot tell twin from summon until they strike one.
An illusory twin vanishes when struck, and the enemy that struck it loses its next attack.
This is a summoning and illusion effect.
mirage.tag: This is a summoning and illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can spend mana to have a summon take on your reflection. It wears your appearance, and enemies treat it as you for targeting and taunts.
Damage the reflection takes is split between it and you. If the reflection dies, the effect breaks and it cannot be used again for a short time.
This is a summoning and illusion effect.
mirror.tag: This is a summoning and illusion effect.

monkey.name: Light Fingers
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be ordered to steal. A summon that reaches an enemy's side takes a consumable, a held item, or an active boon and carries it back to you.
A stolen boon applies to you for its remaining duration. Each enemy can be stolen from once per fight, and enemies of higher rank notice the attempt.
This is a summoning and theft effect.
monkey.tag: This is a summoning and theft effect.

monolith.name: Standing Sentinel
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can summon a monolith that does not attack and cannot be moved. Every summon within its shadow-line takes reduced damage and does not expire.
The monolith lasts until it is destroyed or you leave the region. Only one can stand at a time.
This is a summoning and earth effect.
monolith.tag: This is a summoning and earth effect.

moon.name: Tidecalled
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons rise and ebb with the night. After dark, summons gain increased health and damage, and you can sustain one more summon than usual.
At full moon, you can spend mana to pull every summon to your side in a single surge that pushes nearby enemies away.
This is a summoning and lunar effect.
moon.tag: This is a summoning and lunar effect.

mouse.name: Walls Have Paws
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can shrink a summon into a tiny form. A shrunken summon is untargetable by enemies that have not seen it and can pass through gaps, grates and under doors.
A shrunken summon that attacks returns to full size with its first strike, which deals bonus damage. Shrinking a summon costs mana.
This is a summoning and stealth effect.
mouse.tag: This is a summoning and stealth effect.

myriad.name: Countless Called
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When you summon, a portion of the mana spent creates faint copies of the summon alongside it. Copies have a fraction of its health and damage and vanish after a short time.
Copies can be ordered to scatter, drawing enemy attacks away from the original. The number of copies scales with your rank.
This is a summoning and multiplication effect.
myriad.tag: This is a summoning and multiplication effect.

mystic.name: Seen Through
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can close your eyes and see through any one of your summons, including summons out of your sight or behind walls.
While you look through a summon, it senses the auras of every creature near it, and you share that sense.
This is a summoning and perception effect.
mystic.tag: This is a summoning and perception effect.

nebula.name: Scattered Legion
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can disperse a summon into a cloud of dust that drifts across an area. While dispersed, it cannot be harmed and slows and blinds enemies inside the cloud.
Recalling the cloud reforms the summon at its centre with full health.
This is a summoning and space effect.
nebula.tag: This is a summoning and space effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Command
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can mark a single point on an enemy. All your summons strike that point, and attacks that land on it ignore a portion of the enemy's armour.
Each strike on the marked point increases critical chance for the next summon attack on it. The mark breaks if the enemy is stunned or knocked down.
This is a summoning and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a summoning and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Appointed Pursuer
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can bind a summon to an enemy that escaped you. The summon follows that enemy anywhere, across regions and through astral portals, and marks it on your map.
When you are near that enemy again, the summon appears at your side and attacks it with increased damage.
This is a summoning and tracking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a summoning and tracking effect.

net.name: Casting the Net
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
While two or more summons are active, you can order them to hold a net between them. Enemies crossing the line between them are snared and slowed.
Spending mana tightens the net, pulling everything inside toward the midpoint. A summon holding the net cannot attack.
This is a summoning and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a summoning and restraint effect.

network.name: Linked Minds
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons share what they see. An enemy spotted by one summon is known to all of them, and any summon can target it.
When one summon is struck by an attack, every other summon gains resistance to that damage type for a short time.
This is a summoning and communication effect.
network.tag: This is a summoning and communication effect.

oasis.name: Spring Keepers
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can command a summon to plant itself and become a spring. Allies resting near it recover mana and stamina quickly, and environmental afflictions such as heat, cold and thirst are lifted.
A spring lasts until it is attacked. It can be uprooted to fight again at any time.
This is a summoning and sanctuary effect.
oasis.tag: This is a summoning and sanctuary effect.

ocean.name: Returning Tide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a summon is dismissed, it washes back into you and returns a portion of its summoning cost as mana.
A summon called again immediately after being dismissed returns stronger, carrying a stack of tide. Stacks build with each return, up to a limit.
This is a summoning and tide effect.
ocean.tag: This is a summoning and tide effect.

octopus.name: Many-Armed Bond
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each of your summons can grip one enemy at a time. A gripped enemy is slowed and cannot move further than a short distance from the summon holding it.
You can hold up to eight grips across all summons. Releasing a grip early returns a portion of the summon's stamina.
This is a summoning and grappling effect.
octopus.tag: This is a summoning and grappling effect.

omen.name: Read in the Flock
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons react to danger before it arrives. Each summon dodges the first incoming attack that would kill it, once per fight.
When a summon senses an attack aimed at you, it calls out, showing the attack's area on the ground a moment early.
This is a summoning and divination effect.
omen.tag: This is a summoning and divination effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons attack in turn. Each summon that strikes the same target within a short time of the last builds a chain, and each strike in the chain deals increased damage.
If the chain reaches a full rotation of every active summon, the target is staggered.
This is a summoning and combo effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a summoning and combo effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Phalanx
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can curl into a defensive shell on command. A curled summon takes greatly reduced damage and cannot attack or move.
Summons curled side by side share their shells, and damage to one is spread across all of them. Uncurling grants a brief burst of attack speed.
This is a summoning and defensive effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a summoning and defensive effect.

paper.name: Written Into Being
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can fold a summon into a written page and store it in your inventory. A stored summon keeps its current health and does not count against your summon limit.
Unfolding the page releases the summon instantly at the page's location when thrown. Writing a summon onto a page costs mana and can only hold one summon per page.
This is a summoning and conjuration effect.
paper.tag: This is a summoning and conjuration effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Nightmare Procession
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Enemies fighting your summons see more of them than there are. Each enemy wastes some of its attacks on phantoms that are not there.
Enemies of lower rank that are surrounded by real and phantom summons become terrified and flee.
This is a summoning, illusion and fear effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a summoning, illusion and fear effect.

phoenix.name: Ashen Returning
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons fall to ash rather than dying. After a short delay, the ash rekindles and the summon returns at a portion of its health.
Each summon can return once. When it rekindles, it cleanses nearby allies of one affliction.
This is a summoning, fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a summoning, fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Rooted Guard
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A summon ordered to hold its position puts down roots. A rooted summon regains health over time, cannot be moved by knockback, and slows enemies within reach.
Roots spread slowly while it stays planted, extending the slowing area. Uprooting a summon takes a moment.
This is a summoning and nature effect.
plant.tag: This is a summoning and nature effect.

potent.name: Concentrated Host
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can dismiss summons to pour their strength into one that remains. The remaining summon gains a share of each dismissed summon's health and damage for a short time.
Concentrating into a single summon costs no mana, but dismissed summons cannot be called again until the concentration ends.
This is a summoning and empowerment effect.
potent.tag: This is a summoning and empowerment effect.

predatory.name: Chosen Prey
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons single out the weakest enemy in a group, the one with the lowest health relative to its maximum, and hunt it together.
Summons stalking a chosen target are camouflaged until they close to striking distance. Their first strike from camouflage deals critical damage.
This is a summoning and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is a summoning and hunting effect.

prison.name: Gaoler's Host
