prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When four of your summons surround a single enemy, they form a cell. The enemy inside cannot leave, cannot be reached by its allies, and takes damage from every summon forming the cell.
The cell holds until one of the four summons is defeated or moved.
This is a summoning and imprisonment effect.
prison.tag: This is a summoning and imprisonment effect.

prosperity.name: Generous Service
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Enemies slain by your summons drop additional coin and have a higher chance to drop items of greater rarity.
Your summons can be lent to townsfolk for work while you rest in a settlement, earning coin and reputation with that settlement over time.
This is a summoning and fortune effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a summoning and fortune effect.

pure.name: Clean Bond
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Afflictions on a summon can be drawn into you through your bond and cleansed there. Drawing an affliction costs mana scaled to its stacks.
Your summons cannot be charmed, possessed or turned against you while within a short distance of you.
This is a summoning and purification effect.
pure.tag: This is a summoning and purification effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt-Hole
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a summon falls below a portion of its health, it bolts to your side and becomes briefly untargetable, recovering some health.
While one of your summons is fleeing this way, the rest gain movement speed. Each summon can bolt once per fight.
This is a summoning and evasion effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a summoning and evasion effect.

rake.name: Gleaners
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons gather what the fight leaves behind. They collect loot, dropped consumables and loose crafting materials within a wide area and carry them back to you.
A summon carrying gathered items gains a brief shield when it reaches you and hands them over.
This is a summoning and gathering effect.
rake.tag: This is a summoning and gathering effect.

rat.name: Survivor's Swarm
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a summon dies, it breaks apart into a handful of small, weak creatures that fight on for a short time.
The more summons you have lost in a fight, the faster your summoning abilities come off cooldown, until the fight ends.
This is a summoning and swarm effect.
rat.tag: This is a summoning and swarm effect.

reagent.name: Transmuted Host
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can feed a potion or reagent to a summon instead of using it yourself. The summon gains the item's effect at greater strength and for longer.
Feeding a summon two different potions in quick succession produces a mixed effect of both. Each summon can be fed once per fight.
This is a summoning and alchemy effect.
reagent.tag: This is a summoning and alchemy effect.

refracting.name: Bent Ranks
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Projectiles that strike your summons are deflected at an angle toward the nearest enemy.
Your own projectiles can be angled off a summon on purpose, bending around cover to reach targets you cannot see directly.
This is a summoning and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a summoning and deflection effect.

renewal.name: Seasonal Return
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A summon that dies leaves a seed. Once per fight, you can spend mana at a seed to return the summon with half its health and its afflictions cleansed.
Outside combat, your summons heal to full over a short time rather than needing to be recalled.
This is a summoning and renewal effect.
renewal.tag: This is a summoning and renewal effect.

resolute.name: Unbroken Line
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A summon ordered to stand its ground cannot be knocked back, stunned or feared while you remain within sight of it.
Summons standing their ground gain damage reduction for each other summon also standing beside them.
This is a summoning and resolve effect.
resolute.tag: This is a summoning and resolve effect.

resonating.name: Choir of the Host
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Each of your summons hums a tone. Summons near each other fall into harmony, and each harmonizing summon adds to a building resonance.
At full resonance, the hum shatters outward, inflicting sound damage on every enemy around your summons and resetting the resonance.
This is a summoning and sound effect.
resonating.tag: This is a summoning and sound effect.

roc.name: Shadow of the Roc
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your largest flying summon casts a vast shadow. Lower-rank enemies within it are terrified and cannot attack.
That summon can seize an enemy or an ally and carry it a short distance before dropping it. An enemy dropped from a height takes falling damage.
This is a summoning, flight and fear effect.
roc.tag: This is a summoning, flight and fear effect.

rune.name: Graven Seal
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can inscribe a rune onto a summon. A runed summon gains one passive effect from your awakening stones of your choice for as long as it lives.
A summon carries only one rune at a time. Inscribing a rune costs mana and takes a moment of uninterrupted casting.
This is a summoning and inscription effect.
rune.tag: This is a summoning and inscription effect.

sacrifice.name: Blood Price
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can pay health instead of mana to summon. Summons paid for in blood arrive with greatly increased strength.
You can sacrifice a summon to restore health to yourself in proportion to the health it had remaining.
This is a summoning and blood effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a summoning and blood effect.

sand.name: Dune Legion
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When a summon is dismissed or dies, it collapses into a drift of sand rather than vanishing. You can call a new summon out of a drift instantly and at reduced mana cost.
Enemies standing in a drift are slowed and lose accuracy. Drifts blow away after a short time.
This is a summoning and earth effect.
sand.tag: This is a summoning and earth effect.

sceptre.name: Raised Authority
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can raise your weapon to issue a decree to every summon at once. Decrees are hold, advance, guard me and fall back, and every summon obeys instantly regardless of what it was doing.
Summons acting on a decree gain increased damage and resistance to fear for a short time. Issuing a decree costs stamina.
This is a summoning and command effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a summoning and command effect.

scribe.name: Written Muster
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can record a summon's current state, including its health, boons and position. Once per fight, you can restore any recorded summon to exactly that state.
A recorded summon that has died can be restored the same way, as long as the record is still kept.
This is a summoning and record effect.
scribe.tag: This is a summoning and record effect.

serene.name: Still Waters Bond
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
While you are not attacking, your summons share your calm. They recover mana and stamina quickly and their abilities come off cooldown faster.
A summon that has not been struck for a short time cannot be critically hit.
This is a summoning and tranquillity effect.
serene.tag: This is a summoning and tranquillity effect.

serpent.name: Coiled Watch
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summons left unmoving coil and wait. A coiled summon is hidden, and its waiting builds stacks of patience over time.
When an enemy comes within reach, the summon strikes, dealing damage that scales with its patience stacks, and constricts the enemy in place.
This is a summoning and ambush effect.
serpent.tag: This is a summoning and ambush effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons circle a bleeding enemy. Each summon attacking an enemy below half health gains attack speed, and the bonus doubles when the enemy is bleeding.
When a wounded enemy tries to flee, your summons pursue it at increased speed and ignore your orders until it dies or escapes.
This is a summoning and frenzy effect.
shark.tag: This is a summoning and frenzy effect.

shield.name: Bodyguard's Oath
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can swear one summon to your defence. A sworn summon intercepts the first ranged attack or projectile aimed at you every few seconds, taking it in your place.
A sworn summon reflects a portion of blocked melee damage back at the attacker. Only one summon can be sworn at a time.
This is a summoning and guarding effect.
shield.tag: This is a summoning and guarding effect.

shimmer.name: Glittering Decoys
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons scatter dancing light as they move. Enemies attacking a summon that has moved recently have a chance to miss.
You can spend mana to make every summon flash at once, blinding enemies that are looking at them for a brief time.
This is a summoning and light effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a summoning and light effect.

ship.name: Crew and Captain
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can carry you. A large summon can be ridden as a mount, and smaller summons can bear you along together while you travel, increasing your speed for each one.
While you ride a summon, you can still cast and command, and the mount shares a portion of the damage you take.
This is a summoning and mount effect.
ship.tag: This is a summoning and mount effect.

shovel.name: Dug In
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can burrow. A burrowed summon travels underground, cannot be targeted, and resurfaces beneath an enemy of your choice with an upward strike that briefly stuns.
Burrowing costs the summon stamina. Summons cannot burrow through stone floors or in astral realms with no ground beneath them.
This is a summoning and burrowing effect.
shovel.tag: This is a summoning and burrowing effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Rows
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
When three or more of your summons stand in a line, their attacks sweep in a wide arc that strikes every enemy in front of the line.
Each enemy cut down by a sweep restores a portion of health to every summon in the line.
This is a summoning and harvest effect.
sickle.tag: This is a summoning and harvest effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Host
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can create a simulacrum of a defeated enemy you have looted. It fights for you as a summon with that enemy's abilities, at reduced strength.
Only one simulacrum can exist at a time, and it cannot be of a rank higher than yours.
This is a summoning and copy effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a summoning and copy effect.

sin.name: Shared Sin
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].

You can bind a summon to commit a wrong on your behalf. Damage the summon deals while bound counts as yours for on-hit effects, but any retribution, reflected damage or curses it triggers fall on the summon instead of you.
A bound summon gains damage the more enemies it has wronged this fight, and dies when the binding ends.
This is a summoning and sin effect.
sin.tag: This is a summoning and sin effect.

skirmish.name: Hit-and-Fade Band
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
After each attack, your summons break contact and step back out of reach. Enemies chasing a retreating summon are struck by the others.
Your summons gain dodge chance while they are moving, and an enemy that misses one is briefly exposed.
This is a summoning and skirmishing effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a summoning and skirmishing effect.

skunk.name: Stink Line
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A summon that is struck in melee releases a choking cloud. Enemies in the cloud suffer reduced accuracy and lower-rank enemies flee from it.
Each summon can release a cloud once every short interval. Your summons are immune to each other's clouds.
This is a summoning and repellent effect.
skunk.tag: This is a summoning and repellent effect.

sky.name: Open Sky Host
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Any summon you call outdoors can fly. Flying summons ignore terrain, cross water and walls, and cannot be reached by enemies without ranged attacks.
Flying summons deal reduced damage in melee but cannot be surrounded.
This is a summoning and flight effect.
sky.tag: This is a summoning and flight effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Host
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be told to fight slowly. A slowed summon attacks at reduced speed, but every attack it makes lands with greatly increased force and cannot be dodged.
Slowed summons do not lose health over time to summon duration limits and stay until dismissed or killed.
This is a summoning and patience effect.
sloth.tag: This is a summoning and patience effect.

smoke.name: Smokebound
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can dissolve a summon into smoke. In smoke form it cannot attack or be harmed and drifts toward a point you choose.
When the summon reforms, enemies caught in the smoke are blinded briefly. Dissolving and reforming costs mana each time.
This is a summoning and smoke effect.
smoke.tag: This is a summoning and smoke effect.

snake.name: Fangs of the Brood
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons' first attack against each enemy injects venom. Venom from different summons stacks on the same enemy.
An enemy carrying venom from every active summon you have is paralysed briefly, once per fight.
This is a summoning and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a summoning and poison effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Riders
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your flying summons gain height when they are not attacking. The higher they rise, the harder their next diving attack strikes.
Rising costs your summons nothing, and a summon at full height is out of reach of every enemy attack except spells.
This is a summoning and flight effect.
soaring.tag: This is a summoning and flight effect.

song.name: Marching Song
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons move in rhythm with a song only they hear. Summons that attack together within a short window deal increased damage for each summon in time.
You can spend mana to change the tempo, trading attack speed for damage or damage for speed across every summon at once.
This is a summoning and rhythm effect.
song.tag: This is a summoning and rhythm effect.

sovereign.name: Sworn Fealty
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can give a command aloud. Every summon obeys it at once and gains increased damage and speed for as long as it is carrying out that order.
Lower-rank enemy summons and familiars that hear the command also obey it, for a brief time.
This is a summoning and command effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a summoning and command effect.

spear.name: Volley of the Host
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can hurl a summon. A thrown summon flies to the target point, strikes the first enemy in its path with piercing damage, and lands ready to fight.
Throwing costs stamina scaled to the summon's size. Each summon can be thrown once every short interval.
This is a summoning and throwing effect.
spear.tag: This is a summoning and throwing effect.

spider.name: Web of Bonds
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons spin silk between themselves as they move. Enemies touching a strand are stuck for a moment.
Through the web, you can feel where any summon is and what it touches, and you can swap places with any summon connected to the web by spending mana.
This is a summoning and web effect.
spider.tag: This is a summoning and web effect.

spike.name: Bristling Guard
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons grow spines while guarding. Enemies that strike a guarding summon in melee take piercing damage.
A summon that dies while guarding bursts, launching its spines at every nearby enemy.
This is a summoning and retaliation effect.
spike.tag: This is a summoning and retaliation effect.

staff.name: Companion on the Road
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
One summon can walk with you as a lasting companion. It does not expire, persists across regions and between fights, and gains strength over days of travel together.
If your companion dies, it cannot be called again until the next day. You can only keep one companion at a time.
This is a summoning and companionship effect.
staff.tag: This is a summoning and companionship effect.

star.name: Constellation Host
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can set your summons into a constellation shape on the ground. While they hold the shape, a field of starlight between them damages enemies inside it and empowers your spells cast within it.
Larger constellations require more summons and produce a stronger field. Any summon leaving its place breaks the shape.
This is a summoning and star effect.
star.tag: This is a summoning and star effect.

stellar.name: Star-Kindled Host
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons burn far hotter than they appear. Each summon's attacks inflict additional fire damage that grows the longer the summon has been active.
A summon at the end of its duration collapses like a dying star, inflicting heavy fire damage on enemies around it.
This is a summoning and fire effect.
stellar.tag: This is a summoning and fire effect.

storm.name: Squall Line
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can call your summons in along a storm front. They arrive in a line, and lightning strikes every enemy standing along it as they land.
Summons arriving this way are driven by the storm and gain movement speed for a short time. Driven rain soaks enemies near them, making them more vulnerable to lightning.
This is a summoning and storm effect.
storm.tag: This is a summoning and storm effect.

succubus.name: Willing Thralls
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons drain warmth from enemies they strike, transferring a portion of the damage dealt to you as health.
A lower-rank humanoid enemy struck repeatedly by the same summon can be charmed. A charmed enemy fights beside your summons for a short time.
This is a summoning, drain and charm effect.
succubus.tag: This is a summoning, drain and charm effect.

sun.name: Noonday Host
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons blaze in daylight. Under an open sky by day, their attacks deal additional fire damage and they cast no shadow, making them immune to shadow-based effects.
You can spend mana to have a summon flare like the noon sun, burning enemies around it and revealing invisible creatures nearby.
This is a summoning and solar effect.
sun.tag: This is a summoning and solar effect.

swarm.name: One Mind, Many Wings
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can summon a swarm instead of a single creature. A swarm covers an area and damages every enemy inside it, and single-target attacks against it deal greatly reduced damage.
Area attacks deal full damage to a swarm. A swarm counts as one summon.
This is a summoning and swarm effect.
swarm.tag: This is a summoning and swarm effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Call
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Summoning abilities you use take effect instantly, with no casting time, and your summons arrive already moving at full speed.
For a short time after arriving, a summon acts twice as often. Summoning while moving costs no additional mana.
This is a summoning and haste effect.
swift.tag: This is a summoning and haste effect.

sword.name: Sworn Blade
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can lend your weapon's edge to your summons. While lent, each summon's attacks gain your weapon's damage type and on-hit effects, and your own weapon deals reduced damage.
A summon that lands a killing blow with a lent edge returns it to you sharpened, briefly increasing your damage.
This is a summoning and weapon effect.
sword.tag: This is a summoning and weapon effect.

talisman.name: Carried Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can bind a summon into a talisman you carry. While bound, it does not count against your summon limit, and it grants you a minor boon related to its nature.
Releasing it from the talisman calls it instantly at full health, with no mana cost. A talisman holds one summon.
This is a summoning and binding effect.
talisman.tag: This is a summoning and binding effect.

tentacle.name: From Below
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can call a summon partway, so that only its reaching limbs emerge from the ground or water beneath an enemy. A partial summon cannot move, but it drags the enemy down, holding it in place.
A partial summon costs a fraction of the usual mana and counts against your limit only while it holds something.
This is a summoning and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a summoning and restraint effect.

thread.name: Threadbound Pair
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can stitch two summons together. Stitched summons share health, healing either one heals both, and an effect that would kill one is split between them.
Pulling the thread snaps them together to the same spot instantly. A stitch breaks if the two move too far apart.
This is a summoning and binding effect.
thread.tag: This is a summoning and binding effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Escort
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
A storm-bird summon follows you between fights without expiring. When you are struck, it answers with a thunderclap that stuns your attacker briefly.
In rain or storms, the storm-bird grows larger and its lightning arcs between enemies.
This is a summoning and storm effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a summoning and storm effect.

time.name: Held Moment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can pause a summon in time. A paused summon cannot act or be harmed, and its duration does not run down.
Unpausing it resumes it exactly where it left off. You can also summon in advance, delaying the summon's arrival until a moment you choose.
This is a summoning and time effect.
time.tag: This is a summoning and time effect.

tranquil.name: Quiet Company
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Enemies near your summons are calmed. They cannot enter rage, frenzy or berserk states, and their next attack is slowed.
Summons in quiet company make no sound, so they do not draw enemies that have not yet noticed you.
This is a summoning and calm effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a summoning and calm effect.

transfiguration.name: Shapeless Servant
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can change a summon's form without dismissing it. It keeps its health and duration but takes the shape, abilities and role of another summon type you know.
Changing form costs mana and can be done once per summon.
This is a summoning and transformation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a summoning and transformation effect.

transgression.name: Rulebreakers
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can exceed your summon limit by one. Every summon over the limit drains your health over time while it remains.
Enemies that have just broken a rule, such as fleeing combat, healing during a taunt or attacking a downed foe, are marked, and your summons deal increased damage to marked enemies.
This is a summoning and transgression effect.
transgression.tag: This is a summoning and transgression effect.

trap.name: Laid in Wait
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can prepare a summon in advance and leave it sealed at a point on the ground. A sealed summon is invisible and costs nothing to maintain.
When an enemy steps onto the point, the summon springs out with a stunning attack. You can hold a number of sealed summons that scales with your rank.
This is a summoning and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a summoning and trap effect.

tree.name: Grove Host
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can plant a summon as a standing tree. A planted summon cannot move but has greatly increased health, and lashes at enemies that come within reach of its branches.
Allies sheltering beneath a planted summon recover health over time. Planting and uprooting each take a moment.
This is a summoning and nature effect.
tree.tag: This is a summoning and nature effect.

troll.name: Regenerating Brutes
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons regenerate health continuously, even mid-combat. Their wounds begin closing as they are dealt.
Fire and acid damage stop the regeneration for a short time.
This is a summoning and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is a summoning and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Line
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can build. Ordered to a spot, a summon raises a low wall of stone over a short time that blocks movement and projectiles.
Walls your summons build stand until destroyed or until you leave the area. A summon building cannot attack, and the wall's size scales with its rank.
This is a summoning and construction effect.
trowel.tag: This is a summoning and construction effect.

turtle.name: Carried in the Shell
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can recall a summon into a shell on your back instead of dismissing it. A carried summon recovers health over time and grants you damage reduction while carried.
Releasing a carried summon is instant. You can carry one summon at a time.
This is a summoning and protection effect.
turtle.tag: This is a summoning and protection effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Followers
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons carry a grey hour with them. Within it, enemies cannot see further than a short distance, and ranged attacks against your summons often miss.
At dusk and dawn in the game world, your summons last twice as long.
This is a summoning and twilight effect.
twilight.tag: This is a summoning and twilight effect.

undeath.name: Refused Graves
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Enemies that die near your summons can be raised. A raised corpse fights for you as a summon at reduced strength, with the abilities it had in life.
Raised corpses decay over a short time and cannot be healed. Higher-rank corpses resist being raised.
This is a summoning and necromancy effect.
undeath.tag: This is a summoning and necromancy effect.

unity.name: Shared Burden
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Damage dealt to any one of your summons is split evenly across all of them. A summon cannot die while the others still hold health.
You can choose to share in the burden yourself, taking a portion of the split, so that your summons last longer.
This is a summoning and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a summoning and unity effect.

vast.name: Borderless Host
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons have no leash. They can be sent anywhere on the region map you have explored and remain under your command at any distance.
Through a distant summon, you can see what it sees. Commanding a summon outside your sight costs mana over time.
This is a summoning and space effect.
vast.tag: This is a summoning and space effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling Column
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can link into a column behind you. While linked, they move at your speed, cannot be separated from you by terrain or enemies, and strike anything you pass close to.
Breaking the column releases every summon at once with a burst of momentum that knocks back nearby enemies.
This is a summoning and travel effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a summoning and travel effect.

venom.name: Venom-Fed
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your poison afflictions feed your summons. A summon attacking a poisoned enemy recovers health based on the poison's stacks.
When a poisoned enemy dies, its remaining poison is absorbed by the nearest summon, which can expel it as a venomous spit at another enemy.
This is a summoning and poison effect.
venom.tag: This is a summoning and poison effect.

verdant.name: Overgrown Host
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Wherever your summons walk, creepers grow. Enemies caught in creepers are slowed, and enemies that stand still in them are rooted.
Your plant-based summons can travel through creeper-covered ground instantly, emerging anywhere it reaches.
This is a summoning and growth effect.
verdant.tag: This is a summoning and growth effect.

vessel.name: Hosted Power
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can pour one of your active abilities into a summon. The summon carries it and can cast it once on its own, at full strength and at no cost to you.
While a summon carries an ability, that ability is unavailable to you. If the summon dies before casting it, the ability's cooldown begins.
This is a summoning and vessel effect.
vessel.tag: This is a summoning and vessel effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Faces
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can wear the faces of enemies you have killed. A summon wearing an enemy's face is treated as an ally by creatures of that kind, which will not attack it until it attacks them.
Townsfolk and guards cannot tell a disguised summon from the creature it imitates. Changing a summon's face costs mana.
This is a summoning and disguise effect.
visage.tag: This is a summoning and disguise effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Guard
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons see attacks coming. Each summon automatically dodges the first attack aimed at it in a fight.
When a strong attack is about to land on you, the nearest summon steps into its path. This happens once every short interval.
This is a summoning and foresight effect.
vision.tag: This is a summoning and foresight effect.

void.name: Hollow Pact
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can let a summon be consumed by the void. A consumed summon vanishes, and for a short time any enemy that touches the place where it stood takes heavy damage and loses an active boon.
Feeding the void restores a portion of the summon's mana cost to you. Summons called back after being consumed cost more mana for the rest of the fight.
This is a summoning and annihilation effect.
void.tag: This is a summoning and annihilation effect.

volcano.name: Pressure Vents
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons build pressure as they take damage. When their pressure is full, they erupt, inflicting fire damage on every enemy around them and leaving magma that burns for a short time.
A summon that erupts survives the eruption with its pressure emptied.
This is a summoning, fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a summoning, fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Spiral Guard
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can make your summons circle you in a whirling spiral. Enemies near the spiral are drawn into it and struck by every summon as it passes.
While the spiral holds, projectiles aimed at you are pulled off course.
This is a summoning and wind effect.
vortex.tag: This is a summoning and wind effect.

wasp.name: Swarm Sting
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Any enemy that strikes you is marked. Your summons fly at a marked enemy, and their attacks against it apply a stinging affliction that reduces its damage.
Each summon can sting a marked enemy only once before the mark must be renewed.
This is a summoning and retribution effect.
wasp.tag: This is a summoning and retribution effect.

water.name: Tide-Formed
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons can be called out of any body of water, including puddles and rain. Summons called from water cost less mana and pass through enemies as they move.
A summon standing in water can merge into it and reappear in any other water within a short distance.
This is a summoning and water effect.
water.tag: This is a summoning and water effect.

weave.name: Woven Ranks
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Threads join your summons to one another. An enemy that passes between two joined summons is snared and briefly rooted.
Boons placed on one joined summon travel along the threads to every other.
This is a summoning and binding effect.
weave.tag: This is a summoning and binding effect.

wendigo.name: Starving Hunters
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons are always hungry. Each one gains stacking damage and speed every time it kills, and loses stacks over time if it does not.
Enemies struck by a hungry summon are chilled, slowing their movement and recovery.
This is a summoning and cold effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a summoning and cold effect.

whale.name: Whale's Calling
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons hear a song across any distance. You can call every summon to you from anywhere in the region, and they arrive after a delay that depends on distance.
While your summons are within earshot of each other, they share their senses and cannot be surprised.
This is a summoning and communion effect.
whale.tag: This is a summoning and communion effect.

wheel.name: Turning Rotation
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons rotate in and out of the front. Every few seconds, the summon that has taken the most damage swaps positions with the one that has taken the least.
A summon rotated to the back recovers health quickly. A summon rotated to the front gains a brief burst of damage.
This is a summoning and rotation effect.
wheel.tag: This is a summoning and rotation effect.

whip.name: Lash of the Handler
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can crack a lash over a summon. A lashed summon gains a burst of attack speed and movement speed but takes a portion of its health as damage.
Lashing a summon that is fleeing, feared or charmed snaps it back under your control. Each summon can be lashed once every short interval.
This is a summoning and command effect.
whip.tag: This is a summoning and command effect.

wind.name: Windborne Host
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons are carried by the wind. They ignore terrain that slows movement and can cross gaps and water as though they were solid ground.
You can spend mana to send a gale through your summons, hurling them forward and cutting every enemy along their path.
This is a summoning and air effect.
wind.tag: This is a summoning and air effect.

wing.name: Pinion Guard
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons sprout wings when you leap or dash. When a blow would throw you off your feet, your summons catch you and you cannot be knocked down.
Winged summons can lift an ally a short distance out of danger. A summon carrying an ally cannot attack.
This is a summoning and flight effect.
wing.tag: This is a summoning and flight effect.

wolf.name: Den of the Host
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons count as a pack. Each summon gains attack speed for every other summon close to it.
When one of your summons dies, the rest gain a brief frenzy of increased damage.
While three or more summons are active, you can spend mana to make them howl together, sending nearby lower-rank enemies fleeing.
This is a summoning and fear effect.
wolf.tag: This is a summoning and fear effect.

wood.name: Grain of the Bond
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
You can carve a summon's form into a wooden figure. Calling a summon from its figure costs no mana, but the figure cracks and must rest a day before it can be used again.
A summon called from a figure keeps the upgrades and runes it had when the figure was carved.
This is a summoning and craft effect.
wood.tag: This is a summoning and craft effect.

wrath.name: Spent Fury
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons store anger when they are hit. You can spend their stored anger at any time to send them into a rage, gaining damage and attack speed in proportion to what they stored.
A raging summon ignores your commands and attacks whatever struck it most.
This is a summoning and rage effect.
wrath.tag: This is a summoning and rage effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Host
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Your summons share your conviction. While you are below half health, your summons fight with increased damage and ignore fear and charm.
You can spend health to inspire a summon, granting it a burst of damage that scales with the health spent.
This is a summoning and zeal effect.
zeal.tag: This is a summoning and zeal effect.

ziz.name: Horizon-Wing
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Legion. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Legion].
Once per day, you can summon a sky-spanning bird. Its wings cover the battlefield, blocking weather, and it shields every ally beneath them from attacks coming from above.
While it remains, enemy flyers are grounded. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a summoning, flight and protection effect.
ziz.tag: This is a summoning, flight and protection effect.

action.name: Snatch Reflex
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill grants a brief window in which your next ability activates with no cast or wind-up time.
Killing a second enemy within that window renews the window and restores a small amount of stamina.
This is a momentum effect.

adept.name: Studied Spoils
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

When you loot an enemy that used a technique against you during the fight, you have a chance to receive a skill-book fragment for that technique. Gathering enough fragments of the same technique binds them into a complete skill book.
Fragments are only produced by enemies of your rank or higher.
This is a learning effect.

alchemy.name: Field Distillation
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Creature parts looted from a kill can be rendered immediately into a single-use tincture. The tincture's effect is drawn from the creature: a fire beast yields fire resistance, a venomous one yields a poison coating for your weapon.
Rendering costs mana. Only one tincture from this ability can be held at a time.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: Silent Takings
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting makes no sound and leaves no corpse for other enemies to find. Enemies that have not yet noticed you remain unaware of the kill.
The first attack you make within a short time of looting, while still unseen, inflicts additional damage.
This is a stealth effect.

animate.name: Stripped Puppet
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Once looted, a corpse can be animated by spending mana. It rises as a mindless husk that walks to a point you choose and stands guard there, attacking enemies that come close.
A husk lasts until it is destroyed or until you animate another. Corpses of higher-rank enemies make sturdier husks.
This is an animation and necromantic effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and necromantic effect.

anzu.name: Stormfeather Gleaning
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Loot is carried to you on a gust of wind from anywhere within a long range, including from kills made by your allies, from the far side of chasms, and from bodies that fell into water.
Each gust that carries loot to you also strikes enemies along its path with lightning damage.
This is a wind and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a wind and storm effect.

ape.name: Brute Pickings
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

When you loot a corpse, you can rip the heaviest piece of it free and hurl it at an enemy within a short range. The throw costs stamina, inflicts physical damage scaled to the corpse's size and briefly stuns lower-rank targets.
The thrown piece is lost, but the rest of the drop arrives as normal.
This is a physical and throwing effect.
ape.tag: This is a physical and throwing effect.

armour.name: Plundered Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Armour that drops from a kill can be broken down the moment it is looted. Each piece broken this way grants a stack of plating that absorbs a portion of incoming physical damage before being stripped away.
Plating stacks up to a limit set by your rank and falls away over time outside combat.
This is a defensive and salvage effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and salvage effect.

arsenal.name: Battlefield Requisition
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Weapons carried by a looted enemy can be taken as conjured duplicates instead of items. A duplicate can be thrown once for heavy damage of the weapon's type, then vanishes.
You can carry several duplicates at once, up to a limit set by your rank. They do not take up inventory space.
This is a conjuration effect.

aspect.name: Mantle of the Fallen
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

When you loot an enemy of higher rank than you, you can take up its aspect instead of one item from its drop. For a short time, you gain one of that enemy's passive traits, such as its movement type, its resistance or its aura.
Only one aspect can be worn at a time. Taking a new one ends the last.
This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Tribute of the Fallen
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot adds a stack of tribute, increasing your size and physical damage slightly. Tribute stacks decay while you are out of combat.
At maximum tribute you can spend all stacks to briefly take a greater form, increasing your damage, reach and resistance to knockback.
This is a transformation effect.

axe.name: Woodsman's Cut
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Enemies killed by a special attack are split open as they fall. Their drop includes an additional share of crafting materials: hide, bone, timber from wooden creatures, or ore from stone ones.
Splitting a corpse this way leaves no corpse behind for enemies to raise or consume.
This is a harvesting effect.

balance.name: Even Shares
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill restores a portion of whichever of your health, mana or stamina is lowest, and drains a smaller portion from whichever is highest.
If all three are full, the loot instead rolls one additional common item.
This is a restoration effect.

bat.name: Night Gleaning
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
In darkness, you can loot corpses at range by sound alone, anywhere within the reach of your hearing. Looting this way never breaks stealth or invisibility.
Each kill looted in darkness reveals the positions of nearby enemies on the map for a brief moment, as though echoing off them.
This is a perception and stealth effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and stealth effect.

battlefield.name: Spoils of the Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot any enemy killed by an ally in your party without needing permission.
Each loot taken during a fight raises a banner where the kill happened. Allies standing near a banner deal increased damage and recover stamina faster. Banners fade when combat ends.
This is a battlefield and banner effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a battlefield and banner effect.

bear.name: Larder Fat
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot lays down a stack of fat, raising your maximum health by a small amount. Stacks build up to a limit set by your rank.
Outside combat, fat burns away slowly and restores stamina as it goes. Being reduced below half health consumes all stacks at once to heal you.
This is a vitality effect.

bee.name: Royal Jelly
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Kills of plants, flowering creatures and insects can yield honey alongside their normal drop. Honey is a consumable that restores health over time and cannot be interrupted by damage.
Rarely, a drop contains royal jelly instead, which also increases health and stamina recovery for a long duration.
This is a harvesting and restoration effect.
bee.tag: This is a harvesting and restoration effect.

behemoth.name: Carcass Hide
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a large creature lets you draw its hide over yourself as a temporary layer of armour that absorbs damage until broken. Larger and higher-rank creatures give a thicker layer.
While the layer holds, you cannot be knocked back or knocked down.
This is a conjuration and armour effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a conjuration and armour effect.

bird.name: Carrion Wheel
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

When you loot a kill, a flock of carrion birds rises from the corpse and circles the most wounded enemy in sight. While circled, that enemy is shown on the map and takes small amounts of physical damage over time.
The flock disperses when its target dies or leaves sight. Only one flock exists at a time.
This is a tracking and conjuration effect.
bird.tag: This is a tracking and conjuration effect.

blight.name: Rotting Bounty
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

A corpse you loot collapses into a patch of blight for a short time. Enemies standing in the patch receive significantly less healing, and plants and wooden creatures within it wither and take damage over time.
Blight patches do not stack. A new patch replaces the oldest when there are more than three.
This is a disease and anti-healing effect.
blight.tag: This is a disease and anti-healing effect.

blood.name: Blood Price
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, you can pay a portion of your current health to roll its drop a second time and keep the better result.
Health paid this way cannot be restored by magical healing for a short time afterward. You cannot pay with health you do not have, and the price rises with the enemy's rank.
This is a blood effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Guard
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
After looting a corpse, you can spend mana to raise its skeleton as a short-lived guard. The guard taunts nearby enemies and crumbles when its time runs out or it takes enough damage.
Only one guard can stand at a time. Skeletons of higher-rank enemies hold longer and hit harder.
This is a necromancy and summoning effect.
bone.tag: This is a necromancy and summoning effect.

boundary.name: Drawn Perimeter
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, you can spend mana to stake the corpse as a boundary post. Enemies cannot step within a small radius of the post, and enemies already inside are pushed out.
Two posts within a short distance of each other join into a wall between them. Posts last a short time.
This is a barrier and space effect.
boundary.tag: This is a barrier and space effect.

bounty.name: Plentiful Share
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Kills you loot have a chance to drop an additional item from the creature's loot table.
When extra loot is produced, the ally nearest to you receives a portion of its value as a boon that restores health and mana over time.
This is a fortune and blessing effect.
bounty.tag: This is a fortune and blessing effect.

bow.name: Long Shot Claim
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Enemies killed by a ranged attack are looted instantly, at any distance, as long as you could see them when they fell.
The first ranged attack you make after a long-range kill is a guaranteed critical hit.
This is a ranged effect.

brush.name: Undergrowth Claim
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot is swallowed by a thicket of undergrowth that lasts for a short time. You and your allies are concealed while standing in the thicket, and enemies moving through it are slowed.
Ranged attacks made from inside the thicket do not reveal your position.
This is a plant and concealment effect.
brush.tag: This is a plant and concealment effect.

cage.name: Live Capture
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A monster of lower rank than you, brought below a small portion of its health, can be caged instead of killed. A caged monster is stored as an item in your inventory.
Caged monsters can be sold to the Society, delivered for contracts, or released to fight at your side for a short time before fleeing.
This is a capture effect.

cat.name: Silent Pickings
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot living enemies that are unaware of you. Pickpocketing an unaware enemy takes one item from its drop without alerting it; you can only pickpocket each enemy once.
Looting never breaks stealth, and the first loot you take while hidden extends your stealth for a short time.
This is a stealth and theft effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and theft effect.

cataclysm.name: Fault Line Harvest
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill cracks the ground beneath the corpse. A short time later the crack erupts, inflicting heavy earth damage on enemies standing over it and knocking them down.
Terrain broken this way stays broken, slowing anyone who crosses it for the rest of the fight.
This is an earth and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an earth and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Herd Share
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, each party member and companion within a short distance receives their own roll of its drop.
Each ally who receives a share also recovers a portion of their stamina. Allies who did nothing to help with the kill receive only common items.
This is a party effect.

chain.name: Linked Spoils
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Kills looted in quick succession form a chain. Each link raises the chance that the next kill's drop rises by one rarity.
The chain breaks if too long passes between kills, or if you take a heavy blow. The longest chain you can build scales with your rank.
This is a momentum effect.

chaotic.name: Loaded Dice
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each looted item can be rerolled once, at a mana cost. A reroll replaces the item with a random item of the same slot, whose rarity can be higher or lower than the original's.
Rerolling an item also applies a random boon or affliction to you for a short time.
This is a chaos and transmutation effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and transmutation effect.

charlatan.name: Sleight of Hand
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot living enemies. Taking an item from a living creature requires getting close to it while it is not attacking you, and it can only be done once per enemy.
Townsfolk you pick from do not notice unless they pass a check against your rank.
This is a theft and deception effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a theft and deception effect.

chicken.name: Brood Gleaning
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Kills you loot have a chance to leave an egg alongside their drop. An egg can be thrown to hatch a short-lived, furious hen that taunts every enemy close to it and pecks at them.
Eggs keep in your inventory indefinitely. A hen fights hardest when an ally near it is below half health.
This is a summoning and taunt effect.
chicken.tag: This is a summoning and taunt effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Trophies
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a beast lets you graft one of its traits onto yourself: a wolf's bite, a spider's climb, a drake's scales. One graft can be held at a time, and it replaces the last.
Grafted traits fade at dawn, or when you graft a new one.
This is a transformation effect.

claw.name: Trophy Taker
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Every kill you loot also yields a trophy of claw, fang or horn from the enemy's species. You can carry up to three trophies as charms.
Each charm increases the damage you deal to its species and to that species' close kin. Kills of higher rank yield trophies that grant a larger bonus.
This is a trophy effect.

cloth.name: Shroud Wrap
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot is wrapped in a shroud. Shrouded corpses cannot be raised, possessed, consumed or used as a resource by any enemy.
Breaking a shroud is possible only for necromancers of a higher rank than you, and when it happens you know where.
This is a warding effect.

cloud.name: Mist Gathering
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

A corpse you loot breaks apart into a low bank of fog that spreads across a small area. Enemies inside the fog lose sight of anything beyond arm's reach, and ranged attacks into it are more likely to miss.
Items dropping inside a fog bank drift to you as vapour from anywhere within it.
This is a weather and concealment effect.
cloud.tag: This is a weather and concealment effect.

cold.name: Cold Larder
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot freezes solid where it lies, becoming an obstacle that blocks movement and projectiles until it thaws. You can choose to leave a corpse unfrozen.
Food and perishable reagents you loot never spoil and keep their full potency for as long as you carry them.
This is a cold and terrain effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and terrain effect.

coral.name: Reef Remains
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
After looting a kill, you can seed its corpse with living reef. Over the following day, the site grows into a harvestable node that yields materials tied to the creature that died there.
Reefs grown from higher-rank creatures yield rarer materials. You can tend up to a few reefs at once.
This is a growth and crafting effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and crafting effect.

corrupt.name: Tainted Spoils
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot equipment, you can corrupt it before it reaches your hands. A corrupted item gains one powerful additional property and one curse, both revealed on identification.
Corruption cannot be undone, and an item can only be corrupted once.
This is a corruption effect.

crocodile.name: Soaking Kill
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Instead of looting a kill immediately, you can drag it beneath the nearest water and leave it to soak. A soaked corpse yields a larger drop when you return, growing richer the longer it is left, up to a day.
Scavengers and other looters cannot find a soaked corpse.
This is a patience effect.

crystal.name: Flawless Cut
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Monster cores you loot are always flawless. A flawless core is worth more to merchants and counts as one grade higher when used in crafting.
Cores looted from crystal, stone and earth creatures also leave a shard that can be thrown to burst into a brief prism, scattering the light of any spell that passes through it across nearby enemies.
This is a crystal and crafting effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and crafting effect.

cycle.name: Fallow and Return
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A looted corpse leaves a seed behind. The next time you return to that spot after a day has passed, the seed has grown into a harvestable node of a material the creature was made of.
Seeds planted in the same region share a limit set by your rank.
This is a growth and cycle effect.
cycle.tag: This is a growth and cycle effect.

dance.name: Unbroken Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting never slows or stops your movement. Each kill looted while moving adds a beat to your rhythm, increasing your movement and attack speed slightly.
Beats build up to a limit set by your rank and are lost all at once if you stand still for more than a moment.
This is a movement effect.

dark.name: Shadow Larder
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Your shadow can loot any corpse lying in shadow within a moderate range, without you moving to it.
After the loot is taken, your shadow devours what remains of the corpse, restoring a portion of your mana. Devoured corpses leave nothing behind for enemies to use.
This is a shadow effect.

dawn.name: First Light Spoils
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill releases a flash of light that reveals invisible, stealthed and illusory enemies nearby for a short time.
Hidden caches, secret doors and buried items within the flash are marked on your map.
This is a light and revelation effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

death.name: Final Accounting
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot grants a mark of death's accounting. Marks gather up to a limit set by your rank.
When you would take a lethal blow while holding the full count of marks, every mark is spent and you survive with a sliver of health. Marks are lost if you rest in a settlement.
This is a death effect.

deep.name: Salvage from the Deep
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot corpses that fell where they cannot be reached: into deep water, chasms, lava or the astral void.
Looting a kill while standing in water restores a little stamina. Kills made in or beside deep water yield an additional item salvaged from the bottom.
This is a water and salvage effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and salvage effect.

deer.name: Startled Flight
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill grants a burst of movement speed while moving away from the nearest enemy. While the burst lasts, the first attack aimed at you has a chance to miss outright.
The burst cannot trigger again for a few seconds.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Salt the Earth
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
The ground where you loot a kill becomes barren for a long time. Enemy healing, regeneration and summoning fail within it, and no spawns appear there.
Barren ground can be laid in up to three places at once. Laying a fourth clears the oldest.
This is a death and suppression effect.
desolate.tag: This is a death and suppression effect.

dimension.name: Folded Reach
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot through walls, floors and closed doors, from any corpse within a short distance, whether or not there is a path to it.
Killing a creature that carries a dimensional store, such as a mimic or a summoner, opens its store as an extra drop.
This is a dimensional effect.

discord.name: Grating Spoils
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a corpse releases a grinding, dissonant shriek. Nearby enemies of your rank or lower are confused for a short time and may attack one another.
Enemies cannot be confused again by a shriek for a while after recovering.
This is a sound and mind effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and mind effect.

discordant.name: Broken Accord
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a pack member strips its pack of cohesion. The surviving members stop sharing buffs and auras, and for a short time they may attack one another.
Bosses and their minions lose the bond between them for a short time instead.
This is a discord and mind effect.
discordant.tag: This is a discord and mind effect.

dog.name: Fetching Hound
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can call a spectral hound to fetch loot from kills made by your allies, your summons or traps you set, from anywhere on the same map.
The hound can also follow the scent of a fled enemy back to its lair, marking the lair on the map.
This is a summoning and tracking effect.
dog.tag: This is a summoning and tracking effect.

doom.name: Counted Hour
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Before a fight you can name one enemy you can see. If that enemy dies while the mark lasts, its loot is drawn from a higher-rank loot table.
If the named enemy escapes or the mark expires, you take an affliction that slows your mana recovery until the next dawn.
This is a doom and fate effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and fate effect.

doppelganger.name: Borrowed Faces
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a humanoid lets you take its likeness. Wearing a likeness disguises you as that person, letting you pass members of their faction without being attacked until you act against them.
One likeness can be worn at a time. Taking damage or attacking ends it.
This is a disguise and illusion effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a disguise and illusion effect.

dragon.name: Hoard Claw
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
The total value of everything in your inventory feeds a hoard. The larger the hoard, the more fire damage you deal and the greater your resistance to fire.
Looting gold or valuables also restores a small amount of health, scaling with their value.
This is a fire and hoard effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and hoard effect.

duck.name: Unbothered Gleaning
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
For a short time after looting a kill, you cannot be knocked back, knocked down, stunned or pulled.
This effect can trigger once every several seconds, and only on kills of enemies that were in combat with you.
This is a resistance effect.

dust.name: Settling Grey
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot crumbles into dust. You collect the dust as a crafting powder used in alchemy and enchanting.
As the corpse crumbles it throws up a cloud of grey that blinds enemies standing beside it for a moment.
This is an earth and harvesting effect.
dust.tag: This is an earth and harvesting effect.

earth.name: Barrow Mound
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot sinks into the ground and raises a stone mound in its place. Mounds block movement and give cover from ranged attacks, and last until you leave the area.
Creatures of stone and earth yield ore when looted.
This is an earth and terrain effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and terrain effect.

echo.name: Second Return
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each drop you loot leaves an echo. The next kill of the same species within a short time also returns an echoed copy of one common item from the earlier drop.
Echoes do not copy rare or better items, and only the most recent echo is kept.
This is a sound and duplication effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and duplication effect.

eclipse.name: Swallowed Light
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill casts a disc of darkness over the corpse for a short time. Enemies inside the darkness cannot see past its edge, and you and your allies are hidden from ranged attacks while inside it.
Light-based abilities cast into the darkness are absorbed.
This is a darkness and concealment effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and concealment effect.

edifice.name: Cairn Builder
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill raises a waist-high cairn of stone where the body lay. Cairns block movement and projectiles, and allies standing behind one take reduced damage.
Raising a cairn costs stamina. Up to several can stand at once, and they crumble when combat ends.
This is an earth and construction effect.
edifice.tag: This is an earth and construction effect.

effigy.name: Straw Proxy
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Looting a kill lets you bind a lock of the creature into an effigy of yourself. While you hold an effigy, the next blow that would reduce you below a quarter of your health strikes the effigy instead and destroys it.
Only one effigy can be held at a time. Effigies made from higher-rank creatures can absorb heavier blows.
This is a sacrifice and protection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sacrifice and protection effect.

elemental.name: Raw Distillate
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
