Looting a creature aligned with an element draws a charge of that element into you. Your next attack or spell inflicts additional damage of that element and applies its signature effect: burning, chilling, shocking or knocking back.
You can hold a single charge at a time.
This is an elemental effect.

elixir.name: Draught of the Fallen
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, the reagents in its body can be brewed on the spot into a single potion. The potion restores whichever of health, mana or stamina you are lowest on.
A potion brewed from a higher-rank enemy is stronger. You can only brew once every few minutes.
This is an alchemy effect.

empower.name: Charged Spoils
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets you pass its remaining vitality to an ally you can see as a boon that increases their damage for a short time.
Each additional loot passed to the same ally before the boon ends extends it and adds a stack. The boon cannot be placed on yourself.
This is a boon and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is a boon and empowerment effect.

eye.name: Appraising Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looking at a living enemy within sight shows what it will drop if killed, including any rare items it is carrying.
Enemies carrying an item of rare quality or better are outlined in gold while they are within aura-sense range.
This is a perception effect.

feast.name: Victor's Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each beast you loot can yield a portion of meat. Outside combat, you can lay out the meat as a feast that grants every ally who eats from it a lasting boon.
The boon grows with the number of different species on the table. Each ally can only benefit from one feast at a time.
This is a cooking and boon effect.
feast.tag: This is a cooking and boon effect.

feeble.name: Stolen Vigour
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill steals a portion of whichever attribute the enemy was strongest in, adding it to your own for a short time.
Stolen attributes from different kills stack, up to a limit set by your rank. Each stack fades on its own timer.
This is a theft and drain effect.
feeble.tag: This is a theft and drain effect.

fertile.name: Grave Garden
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A looted corpse sprouts a cluster of healing herbs within moments. Walking through the cluster restores health over time to you and your allies, and the herbs can be picked as crafting reagents.
Clusters wither after a short time.
This is a life and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a life and growth effect.

fey.name: Fair Bargain
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Before you take the loot from a kill, you can offer to leave it. The creature's spirit grants a favour in exchange: a single question about the area answered truthfully, a hidden path shown on the map, or safe passage past its kin for the rest of the day.
Breaking a granted safe passage by attacking its kin inflicts a curse that lasts until dawn.
This is a fey and bargain effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey and bargain effect.

fire.name: Pyre Harvest
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

When you loot a corpse, you can spend mana to leave it burning as a short-lived pyre. The pyre inflicts fire damage over time on enemies standing in it, and applies a stacking burn affliction to any enemy that passes through it.
The corpses of higher-rank enemies burn larger and longer.
This is a fire and conjuration effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and conjuration effect.

firebird.name: Ember Plume Pickup
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets you trade places with its corpse in a burst of flame, teleporting to where the body lies. The place you left erupts in fire, damaging enemies near it.
This can only be done once every few seconds. Teleporting to a corpse further than a short distance costs mana.
This is a fire and teleport effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and teleport effect.

fish.name: Shoal Haul
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Kills made close together in time are looted as a single haul when the last one falls. A haul of five or more kills adds one bonus item, rolled at the quality of the strongest enemy in it.
Fish and water creatures caught in a haul always count double toward its size.
This is a collection effect.

flea.name: Corpse Hopper
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
After looting a corpse, you can leap to any other unlooted corpse within a moderate range, looting it on landing. Each leap after the first in a sequence costs more stamina.
Landing on a corpse with enemies standing beside it knocks them back.
This is a movement effect.

flesh.name: Living Harvest
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Instead of taking a corpse's materials, you can absorb its flesh to heal. Absorbing flesh restores health over time and is particularly effective against wounds, bleeding and lost limbs.
Absorbing the flesh of a creature far below your rank heals very little.
This is a flesh and healing effect.
flesh.tag: This is a flesh and healing effect.

foot.name: Roadworn Bounty
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
The further you have travelled on foot since your last loot, the better your next drop. Long journeys between kills can raise the drop by one or two rarities.
Distance travelled by mount, portal or teleport does not count.
This is a journey effect.

force.name: Recoil Collection
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When loot arrives in your hands, a shockwave rolls outward from the corpse, knocking back nearby enemies and inflicting disruptive-force damage.
Enemies driven into walls or other enemies by the shockwave are stunned briefly.
This is a disruptive-force effect.

forge.name: Battlefield Smithing
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Metal items looted from a kill can be fed to equipped weapons and armour on the spot, restoring their durability and raising their quality gradually. A piece of gear can only be raised so far above its original quality.
Feeding a looted item to your gear destroys the item.
This is a crafting and forging effect.
forge.tag: This is a crafting and forging effect.

fork.name: Branching Yield
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, its drop is rolled twice and you choose which of the two to keep. The other is lost.
The choice must be made before you move on. Enemies below your rank only give a choice if they are carrying a rare item or better.
This is a fate effect.

fortress.name: Taken Ground
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
The place where you loot a kill becomes held ground for a short time. While you stand on held ground you take reduced damage and cannot be pushed off it.
Looting a second kill while standing on held ground widens the area to cover nearby allies.
This is a defensive and territory effect.
fortress.tag: This is a defensive and territory effect.

fox.name: Sly Hands
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot an enemy in the middle of a fight. Snatching from a living enemy takes the weapon or held item it is using, disarming it until it recovers a new one.
Snatching costs stamina and only works on enemies of your rank or lower. Each enemy can only be robbed once.
This is a theft effect.

frog.name: Spring Glean
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Dodging over a corpse loots it mid-leap. Each kill looted this way resets your dodge immediately.
Landing in water or mud after a dodge loot creates a splash that slows nearby enemies.
This is a movement effect.

fungus.name: Spore Ring
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot sprouts a ring of mushrooms. Enemies that step into the ring release a cloud of spores that puts them to sleep for a short time; damage wakes them.
Mushroom rings last until you leave the area, and the first enemy through a ring is always caught.
This is a fungus and sleep effect.
fungus.tag: This is a fungus and sleep effect.

garuda.name: Sun-Wing Ascent
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill springs you into a short leap in any direction. Melee attacks struggle to reach you while the leap carries you.
Looting a serpent, snake or naga-type enemy also cleanses one poison affliction from you.
This is a flight effect.

gate.name: Hinged Doorway
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill opens a short-lived portal over the corpse. Another portal opens at the last place you looted. Stepping into either carries you, or any ally, to the other.
Only one pair of portals can be open at a time. Opening a pair across a long distance costs significant mana.
This is a portal and dimension effect.
gate.tag: This is a portal and dimension effect.

gathering.name: Drawn Together
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When a kill falls, every unlooted drop within a wide radius is drawn to you at once.
Enemies close to the corpse are pulled a short distance toward it as it falls, gathering them into a tighter group.
This is a space and gravity effect.
gathering.tag: This is a space and gravity effect.

glass.name: Shatter Spoils
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot shatters into glass shards spread across the ground. Enemies that move across the shards take physical damage and bleed.
Gear in the drop arrives already identified, its full properties laid as clear as glass.
This is a glass and bleed effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass and bleed effect.

glimeron.name: Split Takings
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looted gems, crystals and cores can be split into several lesser fragments. Each fragment can be socketed into gear separately for a weaker version of the original's effect.
Fragments from the same source socketed into different pieces of gear resonate, increasing the effect of each.
This is a crafting and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a crafting and refraction effect.

goat.name: Iron Stomach
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Junk and common-grade items from a drop can be eaten on the spot. Eating an item restores stamina and a small amount of health, scaled to its worth.
Eating cursed items is possible and harmless to you, and removes the curse from the world.
This is a consumption effect.

gorgon.name: Stone Trophy
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can turn a looted corpse to stone. Enemies that look at the statue are slowed and may be petrified briefly if they are of lower rank than you.
Only one statue can stand at a time. Statues shatter when struck, inflicting earth damage on enemies nearby.
This is a petrification effect.

griffin.name: Hunter's Claim
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can claim any monster you can see from above, such as from a cliff or wall. When a claimed monster dies to anyone, its loot comes to you.
Leaping onto a claimed monster from close by inflicts heavy damage on landing.
This is a hunting and claim effect.
griffin.tag: This is a hunting and claim effect.

growth.name: Ripening Spoils
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Equipment you loot can be marked as unripe. An unripe item cannot be equipped, but over the following day it grows by one rarity, gaining a new property as it does.
Only one item can ripen at a time. Equipping or selling it early ends the ripening.
This is a growth effect.

guardian.name: Shield of the Fallen
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When an enemy dies while attacking one of your allies, the loot passes through that ally on its way to you, granting them a damage-absorbing shield.
The shield is stronger if the enemy was of higher rank than the ally.
This is a protection effect.

hair.name: Kindred Lock
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Looting an elite or named enemy yields a lock of its hair, fur or feather. While you carry the lock, you know when any creature of its pack, cult or family comes within aura-sense range, and from which direction.
You can carry up to three locks at a time.
This is a sympathetic and tracking effect.
hair.tag: This is a sympathetic and tracking effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Breaker
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Metal equipment in a drop can be flattened into ingots the moment it is looted. Ingots made this way can be used at any forge, or spent on the spot to repair the gear you are wearing.
Enemies killed by a crushing blow yield an additional ingot.
This is a smithing effect.

hand.name: Steady Grip
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting never interrupts a spell, channel or charging attack.
While you are holding an item, it cannot be knocked or stolen from your hands. You can catch thrown weapons and hurled objects aimed at you, adding them to your inventory, once every few seconds.
This is a physical effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Set
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Drops are more likely to contain pieces belonging to sets you are already wearing.
Looting a piece that matches your set rings it in resonance. For a short time, every set bonus you have counts one piece higher than it is.
This is a resonance effect.

harpy.name: Snatch from the Air
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Projectiles, thrown weapons and dropped items in flight can be looted mid-air. A projectile looted this way never lands, and can be sent back at its source for the damage it would have done.
This can only be done once every few seconds and costs stamina.
This is a theft and air effect.
harpy.tag: This is a theft and air effect.

harvest.name: Gleaner's Due
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Crafting nodes you harvest count as kills for this ability, and yield their materials instantly with no gathering time.
Each node harvested this way grants a stacking increase to your stamina recovery that lasts until you rest.
This is a harvest effect.

heidel.name: Saddlebag Haul
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot from the saddle without dismounting or slowing. Loot taken while mounted goes into your mount's saddlebags, which hold a large amount of extra weight.
Each kill looted while mounted restores some of your mount's stamina.
This is a mount effect.

hook.name: Barbed Claim
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can spend stamina to set a barbed hook in an enemy. If the hooked enemy dies before the hook falls away, its drop is pulled straight to you and includes one additional item.
Only one enemy can be hooked at a time. Larger enemies shake the hook loose sooner.
This is a physical and marking effect.
hook.tag: This is a physical and marking effect.

horse.name: Thundering Plunder
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot builds momentum, up to a limit set by your rank. Your next charge, mounted or on foot, spends all of it to deal additional damage and knock aside every enemy in its path.
Momentum fades if you go a short time without looting.
This is a momentum and charge effect.
horse.tag: This is a momentum and charge effect.

hunger.name: Empty Maw
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot feeds your hunger, granting a stack of increased damage. Stacks fade one at a time unless they are fed by another loot.
At the full count of stacks, the next kill you loot is devoured whole: its drop is lost and you recover a large portion of mana and stamina.
This is a hunger effect.

hunt.name: Quarry's Due
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can declare a single enemy within sight as your quarry. Your quarry's position is shown on the map for as long as it lives.
When your quarry dies by your hand, its drop is guaranteed to include an item of rare quality or better. Declaring a new quarry abandons the last.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
hunt.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

hydra.name: Severed Heads
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Severing a part from a multi-limbed, multi-headed or regenerating enemy lets you loot that part without killing the creature. A looted part cannot regrow while you are within sight of the creature.
Looted parts can be used as crafting reagents of the creature's rank.
This is a severing effect.

ice.name: Frost Shatter
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot freezes and bursts into a spray of ice shards. The shards inflict cold damage on enemies near the corpse and apply a stacking chill affliction that slows them.
Corpses of enemies killed with cold damage burst wider.
This is a cold effect.

immortal.name: Unspent Years
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot stores a sliver of the creature's remaining life. When you would die, stored life is spent to keep you standing with a small amount of health.
The amount stored is limited by your rank, and all stored life is lost at dawn.
This is a life and survival effect.
immortal.tag: This is a life and survival effect.

iron.name: Cold Iron Tithe
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Looting a kill coats your weapons in cold iron for a short time. While coated, your attacks disrupt magic, inflicting additional damage on spirits, fey, summons and conjured objects, and stripping one boon from any enemy they strike.
Coating does not stack. Each new loot refreshes it.
This is an anti-magic effect.

juggernaut.name: Rolling Pickup
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each loot taken while you are moving adds momentum. At full momentum, your movement cannot be slowed, rooted or interrupted, and enemies you run into are knocked aside and damaged.
Momentum is lost if you stand still for more than a moment.
This is a momentum and unstoppable effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and unstoppable effect.

karmic.name: Settled Account
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Damage an enemy dealt to you during a fight is recorded against it. When you loot that enemy, a portion of that damage returns to you as healing.
Damage it dealt to your allies returns to them in the same way, provided they are in your party.
This is a karmic and healing effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and healing effect.

knife.name: Pristine Parts
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Creature parts in your drops are always of pristine grade, worth more in trade and in crafting.
Kills finished with a critical hit yield one additional part, cut cleanly from the most valuable part of the creature.
This is a harvesting effect.

knowledge.name: Field Notes
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot writes a page about its species into your field notes. Once enough pages are written, the species' weaknesses, resistances and habits are revealed whenever you look at one.
A completed entry can be sold to the Society or copied into a skill book for an ally.
This is a knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Tentacles rise from the corpse when you loot a kill, grasping enemies nearby and holding them in place for a short time. Held enemies take damage over time.
Near water, the tentacles drag held enemies a short distance toward the water's edge.
This is a conjuration and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a conjuration and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Wake of Plenty
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Loot from kills you make in or near water is carried to you on a rolling wave, which knocks down enemies in its path.
Creatures killed in or beside deep water can be looted from any distance you can see.
This is a water effect.

life.name: Stubborn Remains
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A corpse you loot releases motes of life that drift to the most injured ally nearby, restoring a portion of their health.
If no ally is injured, the motes linger at the corpse for a short time and are taken by the first ally who passes.
This is a healing effect.

light.name: Revealing Spoils
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill releases a flash of light from the corpse. The flash strips invisibility and stealth from every enemy within a moderate range, and blinds those facing it for a moment.
Hidden caches, traps and secret doors caught in the flash are marked on the map.
This is a light and revealing effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revealing effect.

lightning.name: Arc Gather
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill sends lightning arcing from the corpse to the nearest enemy, then jumping onward to further enemies a few times, inflicting lightning damage with each jump.
Each enemy killed by the arc is looted along the path of the lightning.
This is a lightning effect.

lizard.name: Sloughed Prize
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, you can shed one affliction onto the corpse, removing it from yourself.
Afflictions shed this way can be picked up again by any enemy that touches the corpse. Shedding can only happen once every short while.
This is a cleanse effect.

locust.name: Stripped Field
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

You can spend mana to release a swarm across an area. The swarm strips every corpse in that area down to nothing, yielding all their drops plus additional crafting materials, and inflicts damage over time on enemies within it.
Corpses stripped by the swarm leave nothing behind, and crops and plants in the area are stripped too.
This is a swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Cursed, corrupted or poisoned items arrive in your hands purified. Their harmful effects are removed while the rest of their properties remain.
Each item purified this way also cleanses one affliction from you.
This is a purification effect.

lurker.name: Silent Deaths
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Kills you loot are dragged beneath the ground, leaving no corpse. Enemies do not become alerted by the death or by finding the body.
While unseen, you can loot any kill made within a short range without leaving cover.
This is a stealth effect.

magic.name: Arcane Residue
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a creature that used spells draws out the mana left in its body, which restores your own mana. Spellcasters of higher rank yield more.
Occasionally a looted spellcaster leaves a spell remnant: a single-use charge of one of the spells it cast, usable once before it fades.
This is a mana and magic effect.
magic.tag: This is a mana and magic effect.

malign.name: Spite Ledger
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot an enemy that damaged you, you take a grudge from it. The next enemy of the same kind you strike takes additional damage over time for each grudge you hold against its kind.
Grudges fade over 24 hours. You can hold grudges against only a few kinds of enemy at once.
This is a dark and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a dark and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Drifting Spoils
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot creatures that die in water, beneath you or beyond reach in deep water, and drops lost to rivers, lakes and the sea float to you instead of sinking.
Looting while standing in water heals you slowly for a short time.
This is a water and recovery effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and recovery effect.

manticore.name: Quill Trophy
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill grows a venomous quill on you. Quills are held up to a limit set by your rank and can be flung at enemies, inflicting physical damage and a stacking poison affliction.
Quills are lost when you rest.
This is a poison and projectile effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and projectile effect.

master.name: Practiced Plunder
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each creature type you loot is tallied. Once you have looted enough of one type, you deal increased damage to that type, and its loot includes its rarest drop more often.
The tally needed rises with the creature's rank.
This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Trophy Strength
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting an enemy that was stronger than you grants a brief boon of increased physical damage and knockback, which stacks for each such enemy looted in quick succession.
Heavy drops such as armour, monster parts and ore weigh nothing while carried for a short time after looting.
This is a strength effect.

ministration.name: Bedside Pickings
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Bandages, potions and healing consumables looted from a kill can be applied instantly to an ally you can see, without passing through your inventory.
A consumable applied this way also cleanses one affliction from the ally.
This is a healing effect.

minotaur.name: Maze of Corpses
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each corpse you loot during a fight stays as an obstacle until combat ends. Enemies treat corpse-obstacles as walls and must path around them.
Charging an enemy into a corpse-obstacle stuns it and inflicts additional damage.
This is a terrain and maze effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a terrain and maze effect.

mirage.name: Haze Over the Body
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, an illusion of the creature stands back up where it fell and fights on for a short time. Enemies target the illusion as though it were real.
The illusion inflicts no damage and breaks after being struck a few times.
This is an illusion effect.

mirror.name: Twin Takings
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Once per day, when you loot a defeated enemy, you can reflect the loot. A copy of one non-unique drop of your choice appears alongside it. Reflected copies of consumables are full copies; reflected equipment is of one quality lower.
This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a reflection and duplication effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and duplication effect.

monkey.name: Pickpocket's Reach
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot a living enemy. Touching an enemy of your rank or lower while unseen takes one item it carries straight into your hands. Each enemy can be pickpocketed once.
A pickpocketed enemy is distracted, searching for what it lost, and attacks with reduced accuracy for a short time.
This is a theft and stealth effect.
monkey.tag: This is a theft and stealth effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Once per fight, looting a kill raises a standing stone at your side. While you stay within a short distance of the stone, you cannot be moved by any effect and you regenerate stamina over time.
The stone lasts until combat ends. It cannot be destroyed.
This is an earth and fortitude effect.
monolith.tag: This is an earth and fortitude effect.

moon.name: Tidal Harvest
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Drops you leave behind are not lost. They are pulled into a pale pool that rises at your feet the next night, wherever you are standing.
Enemies looted under moonlight yield an additional moonsilver crafting material.
This is a light and recall effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and recall effect.

mouse.name: Hidden Cache
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot without being noticed. Looting does not break stealth, does not alert nearby enemies, and leaves no sign on the body that it has been searched.
Small items such as coins, rings, keys and seeds that a kill would not normally drop are occasionally found tucked away in the body.
This is a stealth effect.

myriad.name: Countless Hands
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
All enemies you or your allies have defeated within a wide area are looted at once with a single action, each by a fleeting copy of you that appears beside the body and vanishes.
Copies that form near living enemies draw their attention for a moment before fading.
This is a duplication and space effect.
myriad.tag: This is a duplication and space effect.

mystic.name: Second Sight Salvage
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill shows you a vision of the creature's last moments before you arrived, including who or what it fought and where it came from.
If the vision shows a lair, den or nest, that location is marked on your map.
This is a divination effect.

nebula.name: Scattered Dust
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill disperses the corpse into a drifting cloud of glittering dust. Enemies in the cloud have reduced accuracy, and your spells cast into it spread to every enemy inside.
The cloud drifts slowly toward the nearest enemy and fades after a short time.
This is a cosmic and dispersal effect.
nebula.tag: This is a cosmic and dispersal effect.

needle.name: Surgeon's Extraction
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can choose which part of a defeated creature to take before looting it. A chosen part is always extracted whole and undamaged, at the highest quality the creature can yield.
Choosing a part means the creature's other drops are lost.
This is a precision effect.

nemesis.name: Marked Quarry
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a creature, you can choose to mark its kind. Members of that species always appear on your map, and you deal increased damage to them.
Only one species can be marked at a time. Changing the mark can only be done once per day.
This is a tracking and enmity effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a tracking and enmity effect.

net.name: Dragnet
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can spend mana to cast a net over a wide area. Every drop, loose coin and harvestable item within it is gathered into your hands.
Enemies caught beneath the net when it lands are briefly entangled and slowed.
This is a conjuration and gathering effect.
net.tag: This is a conjuration and gathering effect.

network.name: Shared Spoils
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Every member of your party can loot as you do, and whatever any of them loots can be sent to any other member's inventory instantly.
A party member who loots a kill passes a small burst of mana to every other member.
This is a link and party effect.
network.tag: This is a link and party effect.

oasis.name: Spring in the Waste
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
In deserts, wastelands and astral realms, looting a kill draws up a small spring where the body lay. Drinking from it restores health, mana and stamina, and removes heat and thirst afflictions.
Each spring can be drunk from once by each ally.
This is a water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Pulling Tide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each loot you take draws a tide toward you. Loose items, dropped currency and the drops of nearby kills made by anyone are pulled to your feet over a few moments.
Enemies caught in a strong tide are dragged a short way toward you.
This is a water and pull effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and pull effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Fold Grasp
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot from a distance. Shadowy tentacles reach out to bodies within a short range and draw their loot back to you, even while you are fighting.
The tentacles can also pull a fallen ally's dropped weapon or item back to them.
This is a conjuration and reach effect.
octopus.tag: This is a conjuration and reach effect.

omen.name: Portent of Spoils
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Before you attack a creature, you can read what it will drop when it dies. The most valuable item shows as a sign above its head that only you can see.
Once per day, you can mark one creature as fated. When a fated creature dies, it always yields its rarest possible drop. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a divination effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets your next special attack begin as though it were already wound up, skipping its windup.
Looting mid-combo does not break your combo, and adds a hit to it.
This is a combat rhythm effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a combat rhythm effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Plunder
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting armoured creatures strips a plate of their hide, which overlaps your own armour as a temporary layer that absorbs a portion of incoming physical damage.
Plates stack up to a small number and fall away one at a time as they absorb blows.
This is a defensive and armour effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and armour effect.

paper.name: Written Account
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting an intelligent enemy also takes its knowledge: letters, orders, maps and journal pages it carried or knew by heart appear in your inventory as written documents.
Documents can reveal quest leads, hidden caches marked on the map, or the location of the enemy's allies.
This is a knowledge effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Restless Dead
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill fills the area with nightmare figures for a short time. Enemies in the area see the creature you killed in many places at once and may attack the figures, each other or empty space.
Enemies of higher rank than you can resist the effect.
This is a nightmare and illusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a nightmare and illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Ash Feather
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill has a chance to yield an ash feather. Laying an ash feather on a fallen ally revives them with a portion of their health in a burst of flame that damages nearby enemies.
Only one ash feather can be held at a time. Feathers from higher-rank kills restore more.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Seeded Remains
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a body, you can plant it. Within the hour, a harvestable plant grows where it fell, yielding alchemical reagents that match the creature it grew from.
Plants grown this way can be harvested once and persist until harvested.
This is a nature and growth effect.
plant.tag: This is a nature and growth effect.

potent.name: Distilled Essence
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can forgo a creature's ordinary drops to distil its body into a single concentrated core. The core is one rank higher than the creature's ordinary core would be.
Distillation costs mana and stamina, and cannot be performed on creatures more than one rank above you.
This is a refinement effect.

predatory.name: Chosen Prey
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill reveals the weakest enemy within aura-sense range, marking it on your map.
Your first attack against the marked enemy is a guaranteed critical hit, and killing it renews the mark on the next weakest.
This is a tracking and predation effect.
predatory.tag: This is a tracking and predation effect.

prison.name: Bound Soul
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can capture a looted creature's spirit in a soul lock. A held spirit can be released at an enemy, binding it in chains that root it for a short time.
Soul locks are held up to a limit set by your rank. A spirit released against a creature of higher rank than its own holds for a shorter time.
This is a soul and binding effect.
prison.tag: This is a soul and binding effect.

prosperity.name: Fortune's Overflow
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Currency looted from kills is increased. Whenever your carried currency passes a threshold, you gain a lasting boon that increases your luck with item rarity.
Spending currency below the threshold removes the boon.
This is a fortune effect.

pure.name: Cleansed Spoils
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Cursed, corrupted and tainted items you loot arrive cleansed of their curse and corruption, keeping all other properties.
Looting a creature that was corrupted or undead purges a portion of any affliction affecting you.
This is a purification and cleanse effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and cleanse effect.

rabbit.name: Snatch and Bolt
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body grants a burst of movement speed. For a brief window after looting, the next movement ability you use costs no stamina.
Looting while at low health makes you briefly untargetable as you bolt away.
This is a movement effect.

rake.name: Gathered Leavings
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Everything left behind in an area — broken weapons, spent arrows, torn hide, discarded scraps — can be raked in alongside a kill's loot, and is broken down on arrival into crafting materials.
Raking an area after a large fight also returns arrows, bolts and thrown weapons you used during it.
This is a gathering and salvage effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and salvage effect.

rat.name: Swarm Scavengers
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Bodies you have not yet looted are picked over by a scurrying swarm of rats that only you can command. The rats carry everything back to you, however far you have travelled, by the end of the day.
Looting while surrounded by enemies summons a brief rat swarm from the body that harries the nearest of them.
This is a summoning and gathering effect.
rat.tag: This is a summoning and gathering effect.

reagent.name: Field Transmutation
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a creature, you can transmute one of its drops into a related alchemical reagent of the same quality, chosen from those the drop could be refined into.
Transmuting a monster core this way produces a single-use potion matching the creature's nature instead.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

refracting.name: Bent Light Collection
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When loot arrives, a beam of light bends from the corpse to you, refracting off nearby surfaces. Enemies crossed by the beam take light damage and are blinded briefly.
You can choose the beam's bend point within a short range before it fires.
This is a light effect.

renewal.name: Season's Return
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a defeated enemy restores a portion of the health and stamina you lost fighting it.
Once per day, looting a slain ally's companion or summon restores it to life with a portion of its health. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and renewal effect.
renewal.tag: This is a healing and renewal effect.

resolute.name: Spoils of the Stand
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
For every enemy you loot without having moved from where you stood when it died, you gain a stacking boon of damage reduction.
The boon is lost the moment you take a movement action. Looting does not interrupt channelled abilities or break a defensive stance.
This is a stance effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Hum
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each loot taken during a fight adds a layer to a hum around you. Enemies near you take sonic damage over time that grows with each layer.
At full strength the hum shatters, stunning every enemy nearby, then begins again.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

roc.name: Carried Off
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a large kill casts a great shadow over the area for a short time. Lower-rank enemies within the shadow are frightened and cannot approach you.
Once per day you can call the shadow down to lift a looted corpse and drop it on an enemy, inflicting heavy damage.
This is a fear and impact effect.
roc.tag: This is a fear and impact effect.

rune.name: Graven Takings
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a creature that carried enchantments or runes lets you lift one rune from it. A lifted rune can be inscribed onto one of your own items, granting its effect until the item is next repaired.
Only one lifted rune can be held at a time; taking another replaces it.
This is a rune and inscription effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and inscription effect.

sacrifice.name: Price in Blood
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Before you loot a kill, you can spend a portion of your health to raise the loot by one rarity tier.
The health spent cannot be restored by healing until your next rest.
This is a blood and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Sifted Ground
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When a creature dies on sand, soil or dust, the ground beneath it is sifted along with the body. Buried coins, gems and lost items within a short distance are added to the loot.
Looting on sand raises a brief dust devil that blinds enemies close to the body.
This is an earth and search effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and search effect.

sceptre.name: Rightful Claim
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can claim any kill made within your sight by an ally, a companion or a summon, and loot it as your own without needing permission.
Looting the leader of a group of enemies makes the remaining members falter, reducing their damage for a short time.
This is an authority effect.

scribe.name: Recorded Find
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Every unique item you loot is recorded in a ledger. You can recall an exact copy of any recorded item for a short time by spending mana. The copy vanishes when the time runs out or when it leaves your hands.
Only one recalled copy can exist at a time.
This is a record and conjuration effect.
scribe.tag: This is a record and conjuration effect.

serene.name: Untroubled Hands
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting calms you. Each looted body removes one stack of a fear, rage, confusion or other mind affliction from you.
Looting the last enemy in a fight restores your mana to full if you took no damage during it.
This is a calm and cleanse effect.
serene.tag: This is a calm and cleanse effect.

serpent.name: Shed Skin
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets you shed your skin, removing every affliction on you and leaving the husk behind. Enemies that were targeting you attack the husk instead until it breaks.
This can be done once every few minutes.
This is a renewal and decoy effect.
serpent.tag: This is a renewal and decoy effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body that is still bleeding marks every wounded enemy nearby on the map. You deal increased damage to marked enemies and move faster toward them.
The mark lasts until the enemy is healed or dies.
This is a tracking and predatory effect.
shark.tag: This is a tracking and predatory effect.

shield.name: Shieldbearer's Share
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a defeated enemy raises a brief barrier around you and any ally within a short distance, absorbing the next hit each of you takes.
Shields looted from enemies arrive fully repaired.
This is a barrier effect.

shimmer.name: Glittering Lure
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can leave a looted body glittering with false treasure. Enemies of animal or greedy nature are drawn toward it, ignoring you for a short time.
An enemy that reaches the glittering body is dazzled and briefly unable to act.
This is an illusion and light effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and light effect.

ship.name: Ship's Hold
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Loot you take while travelling — riding, on a vehicle or aboard ship — is stowed without counting toward your inventory's capacity until you next make camp or enter a settlement.
Looting aboard a vessel or mount does not slow it.
This is a storage and travel effect.
ship.tag: This is a storage and travel effect.

shovel.name: Unearthed
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Graves, burial mounds and buried caches are marked when you stand near them, and can be looted as though they were a fresh kill, without digging.
Looting a grave occasionally disturbs what lies in it. The disturbed dead rise as hostile undead of a rank appropriate to the region.
This is an earth and excavation effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and excavation effect.

sickle.name: Curved Harvest
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Killing several enemies with a single sweeping attack loots them all instantly, as part of the same swing.
Each body harvested in one sweep reduces the cooldown of the attack that killed them.
This is a harvest effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets you leave a near-copy of yourself standing in your place while you step a short way off. The copy draws attacks and mirrors your basic attacks at reduced damage.
The copy lasts a short time. Only one copy can exist at a time.
This is a duplication effect.

sin.name: Cherished Wrong
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot the defeated without killing them. Taking loot from a downed but living enemy grants a stack of sin, which increases your damage and is visible to anyone who can sense auras.
Sin stacks fade over 24 hours. Holy beings and temple guards are hostile while you carry any.
This is a dark and sin effect.
sin.tag: This is a dark and sin effect.

skirmish.name: Hit and Grab
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets you dash a short distance in any direction without spending stamina.
Attacking within a moment of the dash inflicts additional damage, and enemies cannot counterattack against it.
This is a mobility effect.

skunk.name: Lingering Warning
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Bodies you loot leave behind a lingering stench. Enemies that walk through it suffer a nausea affliction that reduces their accuracy.
Scavenging monsters will not approach a body you have looted, and it cannot be animated by necromancy while the stench lasts.
This is an affliction and warding effect.
skunk.tag: This is an affliction and warding effect.

sky.name: Open Air Claim
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Flying enemies you kill can be looted before they hit the ground, and their loot is never lost over chasms, water or the edges of astral realms.
Looting a flying enemy grants you a brief jump that clears low walls and gaps.
This is an air effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Gleaning
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Bodies you have killed do not decay or vanish until you have looted them, however long you take to return.
Looting a body you left untouched for a full day yields an additional drop, as though the creature's essence had settled into its remains.
This is a preservation effect.

smoke.name: Vanishing Veil
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body releases a cloud of smoke around it. You are concealed while inside the cloud, and enemies lose track of you if you leave it unseen.
Enemies inside the cloud take reduced accuracy against targets they cannot see.
This is a smoke and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and stealth effect.

snake.name: Venom Gland
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a venomous or poisonous creature extracts its venom as a coating. Your weapon attacks apply that venom's affliction for a short time after looting.
Venoms can be stored as single-use coatings in your inventory instead of applied immediately.
This is a poison effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Lift
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A looted corpse releases a column of rising air for a short time. Stepping into the column lends you or an ally a rush of speed, and ranged attacks made while it lasts inflict increased damage.
The rush fades when you attack with a melee weapon or leave the column.
This is an air and flight effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and flight effect.

song.name: Victor's Refrain
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a defeated enemy sounds a short refrain heard by allies near you. Allies who hear it recover a portion of their stamina and gain a brief boon of increased attack speed.
Refrains from looting several enemies in quick succession build on one another.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Rightful Tribute
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

You can loot enemies that yield to you. A creature of lower rank than you that is reduced below a quarter of its health can be ordered to surrender, handing over its loot and fleeing instead of dying.
Surrendered creatures do not return to the fight. Bosses and creatures of your rank or higher cannot be made to surrender.
This is an authority effect.

spear.name: Recovered Point
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot an enemy killed by a thrown weapon, one weapon it carried is shaped into a spear of light you can throw once as a special attack.
Enemies killed by a thrown weapon from long range yield an additional drop.
This is a recall effect.

spider.name: Silk-Wrapped Larder
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Instead of looting a body, you can wrap it in webbing. A wrapped body becomes a web anchor: enemies that come near it are caught in strands and slowed.
Unwrapping the body later loots it as normal, along with spider silk crafting material.
This is a web and trap effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and trap effect.

spike.name: Bristling Remains
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body leaves its bones jutting up as spikes. The first enemy to step onto them takes piercing damage and a bleeding affliction.
Spikes left by higher-rank creatures are larger and last longer.
This is a trap and bleed effect.
spike.tag: This is a trap and bleed effect.

staff.name: Waystaff Rest
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a defeated enemy grants a stack of travel. Each stack reduces the stamina cost of your next movement ability and the next time you sprint.
Out of combat, spending travel stacks lets you walk without tiring, recovering stamina while moving.
This is a travel effect.

star.name: Starfall Spoils
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
The loot of an enemy killed by a ranged spell or projectile falls to you as a streak of light. The landing point bursts, dealing fire damage to enemies close to you.
Enemies you have looted under an open night sky occasionally yield star-metal, a rare crafting material.
This is a star and fire effect.
star.tag: This is a star and fire effect.

stellar.name: Fallen Star
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Monster cores looted from a kill can be thrown as a falling star. The star lands after a short delay, inflicting fire damage in an area that scales with the core's rank.
Throwing a core consumes it.
This is a fire and cosmic effect.
stellar.tag: This is a fire and cosmic effect.

storm.name: Charged Remains
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A looted corpse holds a static charge for a short time. Any lightning damage you deal near it chains to every enemy within reach of the corpse.
Enemies who step on a charged corpse are shocked and briefly interrupted.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

succubus.name: Willing Gift
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can charm a humanoid enemy of lower rank than you into handing you an item from its loot table without a fight. Charming costs mana and fails if the target is already hostile to you.
A charmed creature remembers the gift fondly and will not attack you for the rest of the day.
This is a charm and mind effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and mind effect.

sun.name: Noon Burning
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Looted bodies are burned away in a flash of sunlight, leaving nothing for necromancers or scavengers to use. Undead and shadow creatures near the flash take holy damage and are briefly revealed if invisible.
In daylight, looting restores a portion of your mana.
This is a light and holy effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and holy effect.

swarm.name: Picked Clean
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill releases a swarm of insects from the corpse that seeks out the nearest enemy, inflicting physical damage over time and reducing its accuracy.
Multiple swarms on the same enemy stack. Swarms disperse when their target dies, then seek a new one.
This is a swarm and conjuration effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and conjuration effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Hands
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting takes no time and can be done mid-stride, mid-attack and while using movement abilities. Passing within a short distance of a body loots it automatically.
Each body looted while moving extends any active movement boon you have.
This is a speed effect.

sword.name: Disarming Victory
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot an armed enemy, you can take its weapon technique along with its weapon. For a short time, your next attack with a weapon of the same type mimics the enemy's signature strike.
Weapons you loot are always dropped intact, never broken.
This is a weapon and technique effect.
sword.tag: This is a weapon and technique effect.

talisman.name: Kept Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Each looted creature can leave a small token instead of its usual loot, at your choice. A token held in your inventory grants a minor passive bonus tied to the creature, such as a spider token improving your climbing or a wolf token improving your hearing.
Up to three tokens can be active at a time.
This is a charm and talisman effect.
talisman.tag: This is a charm and talisman effect.

tentacle.name: Drowned Offering
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a body, tentacles rise from the ground beneath it and seize the nearest enemy, dragging it onto the spot where the body lay and holding it briefly.
An enemy dragged this way is grappled and cannot use movement abilities while held.
This is a conjuration and grapple effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a conjuration and grapple effect.

thread.name: Strand of Kinship
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a creature, a thread runs from its body to the nearest living creature of the same kind. Following the thread leads to its den, nest or pack, which is marked on the map.
Enemies at the end of a thread take increased damage from you for a short time after you arrive.
This is a tracking effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Retrieval
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Loot arrives in your hands with a clap of thunder that deafens nearby enemies, interrupting their spells and preventing them from casting for a short time.
Enemies that were already deafened are stunned instead.
This is a sound and storm effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a sound and storm effect.

time.name: Rewound Kill
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Once per day, after looting a kill, you can rewind the corpse to the moment before it died. The creature stands again at low health, and killing it a second time yields its loot again.
This effect recovers over 24 hours and cannot be used on bosses.
This is a time effect.

tranquil.name: Quieted Field
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill calms the area for a short time. Enemies that have not yet joined the fight lose interest and do not come.
Allies within the calm recover from fear, rage and confusion afflictions.
This is a calming and mind effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calming and mind effect.

transfiguration.name: Shapes of the Fallen
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a beast lets you record its form. You can take a recorded form for a short time, gaining its movement, its natural attacks and its size, but losing access to your spells while transformed.
Transforming costs mana. Only beasts of your rank or lower can be recorded.
This is a transformation effect.

transgression.name: Ill-Gotten Gains
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot from containers, shrines and stalls that are forbidden to you. Doing so yields additional items, but marks you with a sin visible to guards and the faithful until it fades at dawn.
While you carry a sin, your damage is increased.
This is a sin and transgression effect.
transgression.tag: This is a sin and transgression effect.

trap.name: Baited Carcass
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can rig a looted body as a trap. The next enemy to approach it within a short distance triggers a spring-jaw that roots it and inflicts physical damage.
Only a few rigged bodies can exist at once. Rigging a body costs stamina.
This is a trap effect.

tree.name: Grove of the Fallen
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body plants a sapling where it fell. The sapling grows into a tree within moments, blocking movement and line of sight and providing cover.
A tree grown from a higher-rank creature yields wood of matching quality when felled.
This is a nature and conjuration effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and conjuration effect.

troll.name: Gnawed Bones
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill lets you devour part of the corpse, restoring health over time and regrowing any lost limbs or severe wounds.
Fire damage taken interrupts the restoration.
This is a regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Trophy
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting stone, earth and construct creatures yields worked building blocks. Blocks can be placed from your inventory as a short wall that lasts until destroyed.
Placed walls are as durable as the rank of the creature they came from.
This is an earth and construction effect.
trowel.tag: This is an earth and construction effect.

turtle.name: Shell Keeper
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting an enemy while you are below half health draws its remaining vitality into a shell around you, granting a shield that scales with the enemy's rank.
While the shell holds, you cannot be knocked back or knocked down.
This is a shield effect.

twilight.name: Grey Hour Lingering
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill pulls the area into dusk for a short time. While in dusk, you and your allies are harder to see from a distance, and enemies lose track of you if you break line of sight.
Shadow abilities cast during dusk cost less mana.
This is a darkness effect.

undeath.name: Refused Grave
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
A looted corpse can be raised as an undead servant that follows you and fights. Servants are slow and fragile, and slowly decay until they fall apart.
Only one servant can be held per rank. Raising a servant costs mana.
This is a necromantic effect.

unity.name: Common Purpose
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, the health, mana and stamina of every party member near you are evened out toward the group's average.
Damage taken by any party member in the next moment is split among all of you.
This is a link and party effect.
unity.tag: This is a link and party effect.

vast.name: Borderless Spoils
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot any enemy you or your party killed anywhere in the current region, whether or not you are near the body, by selecting it on the map.
Enemies killed in astral realms and dungeons can be looted after you have left them.
This is a space effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling Wagon
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Heavy loot too large for your inventory, such as whole carcasses, statues and siege parts, can be loaded onto a conjured cart that follows you until you reach a settlement, where it unloads to a merchant of your choice.
The cart can be pushed into enemies, knocking lower-rank ones aside.
This is a conjuration and transport effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a conjuration and transport effect.

venom.name: Poison Inheritance
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a body carrying your poison afflictions, the remaining stacks are not lost. They are inherited by the nearest enemy, at their full remaining duration.
Each inheritance after the first in a fight adds one further stack.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Creeper Bloom
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Creepers burst from a looted corpse and spread across the ground nearby. Enemies in the creepers are slowed and entangled briefly if they move.
Creepers can be set alight by fire damage, inflicting fire damage to every enemy in them.
This is a plant effect.

vessel.name: Held Remnant
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a creature with an essence or a strong aura lets you hold a remnant of it inside yourself. While held, you can use one of the creature's simpler abilities once.
Only one remnant can be held. It fades at dawn if unused.
This is a vessel and absorption effect.
vessel.tag: This is a vessel and absorption effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a humanoid enemy lets you take its face. Wearing a taken face makes you appear as that enemy to its allies, who will not attack you until you attack or are identified.
Only one face can be worn at a time, and a face crumbles at sunrise.
This is a disguise and identity effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and identity effect.

vision.name: Shown Moment
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill grants a glimpse of the next few seconds. For a short time, enemy attacks aimed at you are shown on the ground before they land.
Dodging an attack you were shown restores a small amount of mana.
This is a precognition effect.

void.name: Hungry Nothing
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can feed a body to the void instead of looting it. The body and all its drops are destroyed, and you gain a stack of hunger that increases your damage and mana regeneration.
Hunger stacks fade quickly out of combat. Feeding a creature of higher rank than you grants several stacks at once.
This is a void and consumption effect.
void.tag: This is a void and consumption effect.

volcano.name: Magma Vein
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each loot taken during a fight builds pressure inside you. At full pressure, your next attack erupts in a column of magma, inflicting heavy fire damage and leaving burning ground.
Pressure is lost when combat ends.
This is a fire and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and eruption effect.
