vortex.name: Spiral Ward
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill spins up a whirlwind around you for a short time. Arrows, bolts and other physical projectiles that enter the whirlwind are caught and flung back outward in random directions.
The whirlwind breaks if you cast a spell.
This is an air and deflection effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and deflection effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Spoils
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body disturbs the wasps you have bound to it. They burst out and sting enemies within a short distance, inflicting a swelling affliction that slows attacks.
Stings stack on enemies that are hit by several bursts.
This is a summoning and affliction effect.
wasp.tag: This is a summoning and affliction effect.

water.name: Undertow
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a body dissolves it into a wave that rolls outward from where it lay, pushing enemies away from you and extinguishing fires.
Enemies struck by the wave are soaked, taking increased cold and lightning damage for a short time.
This is a water effect.

weave.name: Tied Threads
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looted cloth, hide, sinew and fibre can be woven straight onto your armour, layering on minor bonuses from the creature it came from. Each piece of armour holds a limited number of threads.
Threads come loose when the armour is repaired.
This is a crafting and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is a crafting and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Starving Hunt
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each kill you loot sates a hunger in you, increasing your movement speed and cold damage. The hunger returns over time, and while hungry your damage falls.
Looting several kills in quick succession sends you into a frenzy that inflicts frost on every enemy you strike.
This is a cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Whalefall
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

The body of a very large creature, such as a boss or a monster of great size, can be left as a whalefall. For a day afterwards, it feeds the area around it, and harvesting nodes nearby yield extra materials.
Allies resting beside a whalefall recover health and mana over time.
This is a nature and recovery effect.
whale.tag: This is a nature and recovery effect.

wheel.name: Turning Fortune
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Each body you loot turns a wheel of fortune. Every few turns, the next loot is drawn one rarity tier higher.
If your next loot is poor, the wheel turns faster toward the next upgrade.
This is a fortune effect.

whip.name: Lashing Snatch
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can lash a weapon or shield out of a living enemy's hands, looting it instantly. A disarmed enemy fights unarmed until it retrieves a weapon.
Lashing costs stamina and works only on enemies of your rank or lower.
This is a disarm effect.

wind.name: Carried on the Wind
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Potions, food and ammunition you loot can be sent on a gust of wind to the ally within range who most needs them, arriving in their hands.
A loot gust cuts through enemies in its path, dealing a small amount of wind damage.
This is a wind and support effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and support effect.

wing.name: Stooping Raptor
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
You can loot on the move. While leaping or dashing, you can drop onto a body to loot it, striking enemies near the body on landing.
Looting from a leap refunds the stamina cost of your next leap or dash.
This is a flight effect.

wolf.name: Pack's Share
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
When you loot a kill, a share of the meat goes to every companion and summon nearby, healing them and granting them a brief boon of increased damage.
Kills made by your companions or summons can be looted as your own, and their share returns to them.
This is a pack and support effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and support effect.

wood.name: Living Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Wooden items you loot, such as bows, staves, shields and hafts, keep growing. They repair themselves slowly over time while in your inventory or equipped.
Looting a tree creature or plant monster yields living wood, a crafting material that grants self-repair to anything made with it.
This is a nature and repair effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and repair effect.

wrath.name: Spent Grudge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting an enemy that damaged you during the fight converts that damage into wrath. Wrath can be spent to add fire damage to your next attack equal to a portion of what you stored.
Wrath decays when combat ends.
This is a fire and fury effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fire and fury effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Plunder
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].

Looting an enemy you swore to defeat — the target of an active quest, contract or bounty — fills you with conviction, granting a burst of mana and stamina that can exceed your normal limits for a short time.
Quest and contract targets you loot always yield their quest item, even if it would not normally drop.
This is a conviction effect.

ziz.name: Horizon Shadow
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Loot Ability]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Loot Ability].
Looting a kill spreads your shadow across the area as though something vast flew over. While in your shadow, allies are sheltered from weather, falling projectiles and area attacks from above.
Your shadow lasts a short time and follows you as you move.
This is a shelter effect.

action.name: First Mover
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
When an enemy within aura-sense range begins an attack, ability or charge, its marker flashes on the map before the action resolves.
Tapping a flashing marker as it appears grants a brief burst of movement speed and stamina recovery. This can only trigger once every few seconds.
This is a tracking and precognition effect.
action.tag: This is a tracking and precognition effect.

adept.name: Lesson Replay
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
When a fight ends, you can replay it on the map: the movements of every combatant, where each of your abilities landed and where each one missed.
After viewing a replay, your next fight against the same kind of monster in the same region begins with your mana costs reduced for its first few abilities.
A replay can only be viewed once, and only before you leave the region.
This is a memory and study effect.
adept.tag: This is a memory and study effect.

alchemy.name: Reagent Survey
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Harvestable plants, ore, fibre and creature parts that serve as alchemical reagents appear on the map as they come into view, sorted by the potion families they can feed.
Selecting a potion you know how to brew highlights every reagent it needs within the explored area of the current region.
This is a perception effect.

ambush.name: Blind Corners
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shades every tile that cannot be seen from the nearest enemy's position. You can place up to three ambush pins on shaded tiles.
Attacking an enemy from a pinned tile while unseen treats the first hit as a special attack opener, applying a brief stun. A pin is consumed when used.
This is a tracking and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a tracking and stealth effect.

animate.name: Stirring Cartography
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Objects that are animated, possessed or able to be animated are marked on the map, including golems, haunted armour and puppeted corpses.
You can spend mana on a marked object in sight to wake it briefly as a mindless ally that lumbers toward the nearest enemy. It collapses when the effect ends.
This is a perception and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a perception and animation effect.

anzu.name: Stormglass Chart
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Weather is drawn onto the region map, including incoming storms, wind direction and lightning strike zones, before they arrive.
Once per day you can draw a storm cell onto the map at any explored point. Lightning strikes enemies within that area for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a weather and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a weather and storm effect.

ape.name: Thrown Lot
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Loose heavy objects such as rocks, crates, barrels and fallen masonry are marked on the map.
You can pick up a marked object without slowing and hurl it at an enemy, dealing damage scaled to its size and staggering lower-rank enemies. Throwing costs stamina.
Larger objects cannot be thrown until you have reached the rank needed to lift them.
This is a strength and perception effect.
ape.tag: This is a strength and perception effect.

armour.name: Plated Bearings
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During combat, the edge of the map shows an arrow for every incoming attack, pointing to where it is coming from.
Damage from a marked direction is reduced while you face it. Damage from behind you is not.
Attacks from enemies you cannot see are marked a moment later than attacks from enemies you can.
This is a perception and guard effect.
armour.tag: This is a perception and guard effect.

arsenal.name: Field Ledger
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies within aura-sense range appear on the map. Hovering over an enemy's marker shows its health, resistances and weaknesses, and the damage type it is currently most exposed to.
You can mark one enemy on the map at a time. Allies and summons prioritise a marked enemy.
This is a tracking and perception effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a tracking and perception effect.

aspect.name: Kindred Sight
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Essence users within aura-sense range are marked on the map, with the names of their bonded essences and their confluence beneath the marker.
Essence users of a lower rank than you cannot conceal their essences from this effect. Those of equal or higher rank can, if they know how.
Hovering over a marked essence user shows which of their essences is most like one of yours.
This is a perception and identity effect.
aspect.tag: This is a perception and identity effect.

avatar.name: Gilded Dominion
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

Settlements, shrines and astral landmarks you have visited are crowned on the region map. While you stand within a crowned area, your aura is visible to lower-rank beings, who are less willing to attack you.
Monsters of lower rank than you will not path toward you unless provoked.
This is a domain and intimidation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a domain and intimidation effect.

axe.name: Timber Marks
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Trees, wooden posts, scaffolds and timber walls are marked on the map as fellable.
A special attack against a marked object fells it in the direction you choose on the map. Enemies in its path take heavy damage and are pinned beneath it for a short time.
A felled tree leaves a log that blocks movement until it is cleared.
This is a terrain and special attack effect.
axe.tag: This is a terrain and special attack effect.

balance.name: Scale Reading
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During combat, a balance at the edge of the map weighs your side against the enemy's by rank, number and remaining health.
While the balance tips against you, your cooldowns recover faster. While it tips in your favour, your abilities cost less mana.
While it sits level, neither bonus applies, and your next ability ignores a portion of the target's resistances.
This is a perception and order effect.
balance.tag: This is a perception and order effect.

bat.name: Night Flit
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shades every tile that lies in darkness. At night and underground, the area the map reveals around you widens.
You can spend stamina to flit from one shaded tile to another shaded tile within a short range, passing over enemies and low obstacles.
Flitting cannot be used while you stand in bright light.
This is a darkness and movement effect.
bat.tag: This is a darkness and movement effect.

battlefield.name: War Table
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During combat, the map draws a front line between your side and the enemy's, and shades high ground, chokepoints and cover.
You and your allies deal increased damage while standing on your side of the line, and enemies that cross it are briefly slowed.
This is a tactical and battlefield effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a tactical and battlefield effect.

bear.name: Mother's Ground
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Allies, summons and companions within a short distance of you are shaded on the map.
When an enemy attacks a shaded ally, its marker turns red and stays red until the fight ends. You deal significantly increased damage to red-marked enemies.
Your movement speed increases while you are moving toward a red-marked enemy.
This is a protection and rage effect.
bear.tag: This is a protection and rage effect.

bee.name: Nectar Chart
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Flowering plants are marked on the map. Gathering from a marked plant yields nectar that can be eaten to restore stamina.
Once you have gathered from enough plants in a region, you can mark one point as a hive. Nectar carried to the hive becomes honey, a consumable that restores stamina and mana together.
Only one hive can stand per region.
This is a gathering and life effect.
bee.tag: This is a gathering and life effect.

behemoth.name: Trampled Path
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Destructible terrain such as rubble, thickets and weak walls is shown on the map. You can set a heading on the map and charge along it, crashing through anything destructible in the way.
The charge costs stamina, knocks aside lower-rank enemies and ends at the first indestructible obstacle.
This is a movement and terrain effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a movement and terrain effect.

bird.name: Flock Watch
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Wild birds within a wide radius appear on the map as small flocks.

When something hostile approaches, the nearest flock scatters, and the map marks the direction of the disturbance. Hidden, invisible and ambushing enemies can trigger a scatter even when nothing else detects them.
Flocks do not gather in caves, interiors or astral realms.
This is a warning and perception effect.
bird.tag: This is a warning and perception effect.

blight.name: Rotten Timbers
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Rotting doors, bridges, floors and supports are marked on the map.
You can spend mana to let the rot finish its work on a marked structure in sight. A bridge or floor collapses beneath whatever stands on it; a doorway or support collapses and seals the passage.
Collapsed structures cannot be crossed again until rebuilt.
This is a decay and terrain effect.
blight.tag: This is a decay and terrain effect.

blood.name: Spilled Course
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
An enemy carrying a bleed affliction leaves a trail on the map for as long as the affliction lasts, and the trail shows where it is going.
Bleeding enemies that flee, burrow or turn invisible stay tracked until the bleed ends.
When a tracked enemy dies, you can see where it was heading, including any nest, lair or ally it was running toward.
This is a tracking and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a tracking and blood effect.

bone.name: Marrow Caches
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Bone piles, skeletal remains and ossuaries are marked on the map.
While standing near a marked pile, you can spend mana to burst it into a spray of bone shards that strikes every enemy nearby. A burst pile is gone for good.
Bone piles left by your own kills are marked as well, so a long fight leaves you more to work with.
This is a bone and conjuration effect.
bone.tag: This is a bone and conjuration effect.

boundary.name: Drawn Border
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

You can draw a line on the map, up to a short length, through any tile you can see. Enemies cannot cross the line without breaking it; breaking it costs them a portion of their stamina and stuns them briefly.
Only one line can exist at a time. Drawing it costs mana scaled to its length.
This is a barrier and space effect.
boundary.tag: This is a barrier and space effect.

bounty.name: Overspill Chart
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Crafting nodes, treasure caches and unclaimed loot are marked on the map once you have walked within range of them.
When you or a party member harvests a node you marked, it yields an extra share, and a portion of that share is given to the nearest ally.
This is a perception and fortune effect.
bounty.tag: This is a perception and fortune effect.

bow.name: Range Rings
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows the full reach of your ranged attacks as a ring around you, and highlights enemies standing at its outer edge.
Ranged attacks against an enemy at the outer edge deal increased damage.
High ground is shaded on the map. While standing on it, the ring widens.
This is a perception and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a perception and ranged effect.

brush.name: Closing Thicket
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to seed a thicket at any point on the map that you can see. Within moments it grows into dense brush that slows enemies moving through it and blocks line of sight.
The path you have walked overgrows behind you while you are out of combat, and enemies tracking you lose the trail.
Only a few thickets can stand at once.
This is a growth and terrain effect.
brush.tag: This is a growth and terrain effect.

cage.name: Barred Routes
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Doors, gates, portcullises and grilles are marked on the map, along with whether they are open, closed or locked.
You can spend mana to slam and bar any marked door within range, whether or not you can reach it. A barred door holds for a short time against enemies of your rank or lower.
Enemies of a higher rank break the bar more quickly.
This is a barrier effect.

cat.name: Curious Whiskers
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Gaps, crawlspaces, vents, holes in fences and other openings too small for most enemies are marked on the map.
You can slip through a marked opening at full speed. Enemies larger than you cannot follow and must find another way around.
Openings leading to areas you have not explored are marked more brightly.
This is a perception and movement effect.
cat.tag: This is a perception and movement effect.

cataclysm.name: Fault Lines
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Hidden faults in the ground are drawn on the map. Area-of-effect abilities you land on a fault spread along its length, reaching enemies the ability would not otherwise touch.
Ground struck this way stays cracked for a long time and slows anything crossing it.
This is a perception and earth effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a perception and earth effect.

cattle.name: Village Count
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
In settlements, every resident appears on the map. Residents who have a quest, a need, a bounty or a grudge are marked by what they want.
Society contracts and quests taken from a marked resident pay a larger reward.
Residents you have helped greet you, and shopkeepers among them offer their best stock first.
This is a perception and community effect.
cattle.tag: This is a perception and community effect.

chain.name: Linked Quarry
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to chain two enemy markers together on the map. Chained enemies cannot move further than a short distance apart; one fleeing drags the other with it.
Knockback or pull effects on one chained enemy affect both.
Only one chain can exist at a time. The chain breaks when either enemy dies or when it is struck with enough force.
This is a binding effect.

chaotic.name: Loaded Dice
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Each region map rerolls one hidden event per day: a wandering rare monster, a spilled cache or a sudden storm appears at a marked but random location.
You can spend mana to reroll the event's location once per day. Monsters spawned this way drop loot of higher rarity.
This is a fate and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a fate and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: Painted Signposts
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can place false markers on the map. Enemies tracking you are drawn to a false marker instead of your true position until they reach it.
Your own marker cannot be seen on any other map, scrying or tracking effect while at least one false marker exists.
This is an illusion and anti-tracking effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and anti-tracking effect.

chicken.name: Scratched Ground
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Buried items, coins and caches within a short radius are marked on the map as disturbed ground.
Scratching at a marked spot unearths what is buried there without tools. Buried items are more likely to be old, and old items are more likely to carry enchantments.
When an enemy threatens an ally standing near you, you gain a brief burst of speed toward that ally.
This is a perception and foraging effect.
chicken.tag: This is a perception and foraging effect.

chimera.name: Many-Eyed Map
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map divides into three overlays drawn from your three essences. Each overlay tracks something those essences care about, such as prey, metal or water, and you can cycle between them.
Monsters of a creature type matching one of your essences are always shown on the map once you have killed one of their kind.
This is a tracking effect.

claw.name: Rent Seams
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Armoured enemies, shelled monsters and constructs are marked on the map with the side where their protection is thinnest.
Attacks from the marked side ignore a portion of the target's damage reduction. Repeated attacks there tear open a wound that bleeds.
The marked side shifts each time the enemy turns to face you.
This is a perception and rending effect.
claw.tag: This is a perception and rending effect.

cloth.name: Colours Worn
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Every person on the map is marked with the colours of the faction, guild, church or cult they belong to.
Cultists and spies disguised as ordinary townsfolk show their true colours to this effect, unless their rank is higher than yours.
Hovering over a colour lists the members of that faction you have met in the current region.
This is a perception and allegiance effect.
cloth.tag: This is a perception and allegiance effect.

cloud.name: Fogbank
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to set a fogbank at any explored point on the map and drift it along a path you draw. Enemies inside the fog cannot see beyond a short distance.
You and your allies see through your own fog on the map.
Only one fogbank can exist at a time, and strong wind disperses it early.
This is an air and concealment effect.
cloud.tag: This is an air and concealment effect.

cold.name: Frozen Crossing
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Rivers, lakes and flooded ground are marked on the map with their narrowest crossings.
You can spend mana to freeze a path across marked water to a point you choose. The path holds for a short time, then thaws beneath whatever stands on it.
Enemies on the frozen path move slowly and cannot dodge.
This is a cold and terrain effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and terrain effect.

coral.name: Colony Sense
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Monster nests, egg clutches, spawning pools and other places where monsters breed are marked on the map, along with what they produce.
Destroying a marked colony stops its monsters from returning to the surrounding area for a long time, and yields materials only colonies provide.
Colonies grow slowly. One left alone becomes larger and more dangerous.
This is a perception and colony effect.
coral.tag: This is a perception and colony effect.

corrupt.name: Soft Hearts
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Guards, merchants, officials and cultists who can be bribed, threatened or turned are marked on the map, with what it would take.
A marked guard who accepts your price looks away, opening a locked area or ignoring a crime. A turned cultist will give you one secret about their cult.
Using this on someone of a higher rank than you can fail and makes them hostile.
This is a corruption and influence effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and influence effect.

crocodile.name: Riverbank Hold
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Shorelines, riverbanks and watering holes are marked on the map, along with the creatures that come there to drink.
While you stand in the shallows near a marked bank, you stay perfectly still on enemy tracking effects.
Attacking an enemy at the waterline from the shallows drags it into the water, where it is held for a short time and cannot use movement abilities. Dragging costs stamina scaled to the enemy's size.
This is a water and ambush effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a water and ambush effect.

crystal.name: True Measure
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
When an enemy within aura-sense range begins a ground-targeted or area attack, the exact shape of the area it will strike is drawn on the map and on the ground beneath it.
Standing fully outside a drawn shape guarantees the attack cannot hit you.
Drawn shapes are precise to the tile. Attacks from enemies of a higher rank are drawn later.
This is a precision and perception effect.
crystal.tag: This is a precision and perception effect.

cycle.name: Seasonal Chart
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Respawn timers are shown on the map for cleared monster packs, harvested nodes and looted caches.
When a marked respawn completes while you are in the region, you are notified, and the first kill or harvest after it grants bonus experience.
This is a perception and time effect.
cycle.tag: This is a perception and time effect.

dance.name: Step Pattern
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During combat, the map lays out a pattern of lit tiles around you. Stepping onto them in order builds stacks of grace, which increase your evasion and movement speed.
Finishing the pattern grants a full set of stacks and draws a new one. Missing a step or standing still clears the stacks.
The pattern grows harder to follow as you build stacks.
This is a movement and rhythm effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and rhythm effect.

dark.name: Snuffed Lights
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Torches, lanterns, braziers, campfires and other light sources are marked on the map.
You can spend mana to snuff any marked light within range, whether or not you can reach it. Enemies that rely on sight lose track of anything standing in the darkness it leaves.
Snuffed lights can be relit by enemies who reach them. Magical lights take more mana to snuff.
This is a darkness effect.

dawn.name: First Light
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Unexplored areas within a short radius reveal themselves as you approach, ahead of sight.
Invisible, stealthed and camouflaged beings that enter that radius appear on the map and are exposed for a brief time, ending their stealth.
This is a light and revelation effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

death.name: Final Count
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Each enemy marker within aura-sense range shows how many of your basic attacks it will take to kill, updated as the fight goes on.
When an enemy's count reaches one, its marker turns pale. Killing a pale-marked enemy refunds a portion of the mana and stamina spent in the fight.
The count does not account for healing the enemy receives before you strike.
This is a death and perception effect.
death.tag: This is a death and perception effect.

deep.name: Underlayer
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map can show what lies beneath the ground you stand on: caves, sewers, flooded tunnels and buried chambers, along with every entrance to them.
Spaces you have not entered are drawn as outlines only. Whatever is moving through them is shown as dark shapes.
Viewing the underlayer costs mana for as long as it stays open.
This is a depth and perception effect.
deep.tag: This is a depth and perception effect.

deer.name: Startle Ring
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Every monster within aura-sense range is drawn on the map with a ring showing how close you can come before it notices you.
Rings shrink while you move slowly and grow while you run. Rings of higher-rank monsters are larger.
When you cross a ring and a monster notices you, you gain a brief burst of speed away from it.
This is a perception and flight effect.
deer.tag: This is a perception and flight effect.

desolate.name: Barren Count
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Areas you have cleared of monsters are marked as barren. Monsters respawn in barren areas significantly more slowly, and nothing respawns in them while you are present.
Resting in a barren area recovers health, mana and stamina faster.
This is a death and suppression effect.
desolate.tag: This is a death and suppression effect.

dimension.name: Folded Chart
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Once per day, you can fold the map so that an explored point within a long range lies directly over your position.
For a short time, your spells and ranged attacks can target anything at the folded point as though it stood beside you. Nothing at the folded point can reach you in return.
Folding costs a large amount of mana and recovers over 24 hours.
This is a space effect.

discord.name: Sown Friction
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to mark two separate groups of enemies on the map. For a short time, the marked groups treat each other as hostile and fight among themselves.
Enemies of a higher rank than you shake off the effect more quickly.
The effect ends early on any enemy you attack directly.
This is a discord and influence effect.
discord.tag: This is a discord and influence effect.

discordant.name: Broken Formation
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemy groups appear on the map as linked markers, with lines showing which monsters are protecting, buffing or healing which.
You can spend mana to cut a line, severing that link for a short time and stripping any boon it was supplying.
This is a tracking and disruption effect.
discordant.tag: This is a tracking and disruption effect.

dog.name: Fetch
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can point to any marker on the map within range and send a summon, familiar or companion to it.
Sent to an item, the ally retrieves it and returns it to you. Sent to an enemy, the ally harries it, drawing its attacks and slowing it until you arrive.
Allies sent this way move faster than usual and ignore other enemies on the way.
This is a command and loyalty effect.
dog.tag: This is a command and loyalty effect.

doom.name: Tolling Marker
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can mark one enemy on the map as doomed. A doomed enemy cannot leave the map's tracking by any means, including stealth, teleport or fleeing the region.
When a doomed enemy falls below a quarter of its health, every affliction on it deals its remaining damage at once. Only one enemy can be doomed at a time.
This is a tracking and doom effect.
doom.tag: This is a tracking and doom effect.

doppelganger.name: Second Marker
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
A second marker for you appears on every map, scrying and tracking effect that can see you. You choose where it stands within a short range, and enemies cannot tell which marker is real.
You can spend mana to switch places with your second marker.
This is an illusion and teleport effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is an illusion and teleport effect.

dragon.name: Hoard Sense
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Valuables within a wide radius appear on the map, ranked by worth, including items carried by living enemies.
Enemies carrying an item of rare quality or higher are marked with a flame. Killing a flame-marked enemy guarantees that item drops.
This is a perception and greed effect.
dragon.tag: This is a perception and greed effect.

duck.name: Steady Head
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Your map cannot be falsified, blurred or blanked by illusions, scrying wards or confusion effects, and it shows when someone is trying.
While you are confused, disoriented or under illusion, the map stays accurate and draws your true path to safety.
Allies standing close to you recover from confusion and disorientation more quickly.
This is a clarity effect.

dust.name: Dust Prints
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Footprints on dusty, sandy, muddy or snowy ground are drawn on the map, with their direction and how long ago they were made.
Prints left by invisible creatures appear too, though the creature itself does not.
Hovering over a set of prints shows the size and number of whatever left them.
This is a tracking effect.

earth.name: Ground Sense
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Burrowing creatures and anything walking on the ground within a short radius are felt through your feet and marked on the map, including invisible ones.
You can spend mana to raise a stone pillar at a marked point. A creature beneath or beside it is thrown into the air and lands stunned.
Flying creatures cannot be felt this way.
This is an earth and tracking effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and tracking effect.

echo.name: Thrown Voice
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can throw your voice to any explored point on the map within range. Enemies that are unaware of you hear it and move to investigate.
A thrown sound can be a word, a footstep, a scream or the clash of steel. Louder sounds draw enemies from further away.
Enemies that are already fighting you ignore it.
This is a sound and lure effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and lure effect.

eclipse.name: Penumbra Chart
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Your own marker cannot be seen on any enemy's map, scrying or tracking effect.
Light sources are drawn on the map. You can spend mana to snuff a marked light source at range, darkening its area and making enemies in it lose track of you.
This is a darkness and anti-tracking effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and anti-tracking effect.

edifice.name: Foundation Plan
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Interiors you have entered are recorded as full floor plans, including hidden rooms, sealed doors and passages behind walls, once you have stood next to them.
Structural weak points are shown. Attacks against walls and doors at a weak point break them in a single blow.
This is a perception and structure effect.
edifice.tag: This is a perception and structure effect.

effigy.name: Straw Proxy
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

You can pin an effigy to any explored tile on the map. Area attacks, traps and ground effects that would land on you while you are within a short distance of the effigy's tile land on the effigy instead.
The effigy burns away after absorbing a few such effects. Only one can exist at a time, and pinning one costs mana.
This is a sacrifice and redirection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sacrifice and redirection effect.

elemental.name: Element Wells
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Strong sources of fire, water, earth, air, cold and lightning are marked on the map as wells, each in its element's colour.
While standing near a well, abilities you use of that element deal increased damage and cost less mana.
Once per well, you can draw it dry to fully restore your mana. A drained well recovers over 24 hours.
This is an elemental effect.

elixir.name: Healing Springs
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Healing springs, holy wells and mineral pools are marked on the map.
Drinking from a marked spring restores health, cleanses poison and resets the cooldown on your potions. Each spring can be drunk from once per day.
A potion filled from a spring is stronger than one bought or brewed.
This is a restoration effect.

empower.name: Rallying Points
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can set a rally point on the map. Allies and summons who reach it gain a boon that increases their damage and power for a short time.
Moving the rally point costs mana. Party members see it on their own maps.
This is a boon and command effect.
empower.tag: This is a boon and command effect.

eye.name: Distant Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can look through the map at any explored point within range and see what is happening there as though you stood on that spot.
While you are looking, you cannot move, and you are unaware of your surroundings except through the map.
Looking costs mana for every moment it lasts. Enemies of a higher rank than you may sense the gaze and look back.
This is a scrying effect.

feast.name: Hearth Chart
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Inns, taverns, campfires and cookfires are marked on the map, along with the meals available at each.
Eating a full meal at a marked hearth grants a well-fed boon that increases health and stamina recovery until you next rest.
Allies who share the meal gain the same boon.
This is a sustenance effect.

feeble.name: Small Shadow
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Your marker on enemy maps, aura senses and tracking effects shows you as a rank lower than you are.
Enemies that would avoid or flee from your true rank engage you instead. Your first hit against an enemy that misjudged you deals significantly increased damage and weakens it.
Enemies of a higher rank than you can see through the effect.
This is a deception and weakness effect.
feeble.tag: This is a deception and weakness effect.

fertile.name: Green Survey
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Ground where crops, herbs or fibre plants can be grown is shaded on the map. Planting a seed on a shaded tile grows it to harvest within a day.
Plant-based crafting nodes you have marked regrow significantly faster after harvesting.
This is a life and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a life and growth effect.

fey.name: Fairy Rings
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Hidden fey crossings appear on the map once you are within aura-sense range of them. Stepping into one carries you to another fey crossing you have discovered in the same region.
Each crossing asks a small price on use, chosen at random: a portion of mana, a minor item from your inventory, or a short-lived affliction.
This is a fey and teleport effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey and teleport effect.

fire.name: Tinder Chart
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Flammable ground such as dry grass, oil spills, hay and timber floors is shaded on the map.
When you set a shaded tile alight, the fire is drawn on the map as it spreads, along with where it will go next. You take no damage from fire that you started.
Fire spreads more slowly on wet or windless days.
This is a fire and perception effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and perception effect.

firebird.name: Ash Beacons
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Places where you have fallen in battle are marked with an ember. While an ember is active, a killing blow instead returns you to the most recent ember with a portion of your health, consuming it.
Embers fade after a day. Only three can exist at a time.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Crowd Cover
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Groups of creatures moving together are drawn on the map as one shape, with an arrow showing which way the group faces.
While you stand inside a crowd of townsfolk, travellers or herd animals, you disappear from enemy tracking effects and move with the crowd unnoticed.
Attacking from inside a crowd ends the effect.
This is a concealment effect.

flea.name: Leap Marks
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Rooftops, ledges, cliff tops and treetops within a short range are marked on the map as landing points.
You can spend stamina to leap from where you stand to any marked landing point in range, clearing walls, gaps and enemies along the way.
Landing on an enemy instead of a landing point knocks it down.
This is a movement effect.

flesh.name: Torn Flesh
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
An enemy you have wounded stays tracked on the map until the wound fully heals, wherever it goes.
Hovering over a wounded enemy shows how deep the wound is and how fast it is closing.
Healing an enemy's wound with magic breaks the tracking. Natural healing does not.
This is a tracking and flesh effect.
flesh.tag: This is a tracking and flesh effect.

foot.name: Forced March
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While out of combat, you can set a destination on the region map and march toward it automatically, following the best explored route.
Marching costs no stamina and moves faster than running. It stops the moment an enemy notices you.
Allies and companions who march with you share the speed.
This is a travel effect.

force.name: Impact Map
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Walls, cliffs and hazards adjacent to enemies are highlighted during combat. Knockback effects you inflict send enemies toward the nearest highlighted surface.
Enemies knocked into a wall, cliff edge or hazard take additional force damage and are stunned briefly.
This is a force effect.

forge.name: Ore Chart
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Metal and stone nodes are shown on the map together with the quality tier of what they will yield.
Forges, anvils and crafting stations you have visited are marked. Crafting at a marked station uses fewer materials for metal items.
This is a perception and craft effect.
forge.tag: This is a perception and craft effect.

fork.name: Crossroads Reading
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Where a road, corridor or tunnel splits, hovering over each branch on the map reveals a short stretch of where it leads, including the enemies and loot along it.
At most one branch at each fork can be revealed per visit.
In mazes and dungeons, the branch that leads closest to an exit is marked faintly.
This is a perception and path effect.
fork.tag: This is a perception and path effect.

fortress.name: Held Ground
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can claim a small area of the map as a keep while out of combat. Inside a keep, you and your allies gain damage reduction and enemies are shown as soon as they approach its edge.
Only one keep can exist at a time. Claiming a new one releases the old.
This is a defensive and domain effect.
fortress.tag: This is a defensive and domain effect.

fox.name: Turned Snares
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Traps, snares, pit lids and pressure plates set by enemies are marked on the map.
You can spend mana to turn a marked trap. A turned trap ignores you and your allies and triggers on the next enemy to cross it, including the one who set it.
Turned traps are drawn in your colour so you can steer enemies onto them.
This is a trickery effect.

frog.name: Marsh Chart
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Marshes, puddles, wet ground and rain are shaded on the map. While you stand on shaded ground, you recover stamina quickly.
Lily pads, stepping stones and floating debris are marked. You can spring from one to the next without touching the water, crossing ponds and rivers in a few quick bounds.
Springing from a marked stone onto an enemy knocks it back.
This is a water and movement effect.
frog.tag: This is a water and movement effect.

fungus.name: Mycelium Web
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Fungus patches you have touched join a hidden web beneath the ground. Patches connected to them through the soil are drawn on the map as threads.
Anything that steps on a connected patch is marked on the map for a short time, however far away it is.
You can spend mana to release spores from any connected patch, briefly blinding creatures standing in it.
This is a fungal and tracking effect.
fungus.tag: This is a fungal and tracking effect.

garuda.name: Sunward Pinion
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows a raised view of the whole surrounding area while you are mid-leap or on high ground, revealing a wide radius at once.
Serpent-type, reptile and venomous monsters are always shown on the map, and you deal increased damage to them.
This is a perception and hunting effect.
garuda.tag: This is a perception and hunting effect.

gate.name: Waystone Keys
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can set up to three waygates on explored tiles. While out of combat, you can travel from your position to any of your waygates in the same region by selecting it on the map.
Travel costs mana scaled to distance. Setting a fourth waygate removes the oldest.
This is a dimensional and teleport effect.
gate.tag: This is a dimensional and teleport effect.

gathering.name: Assembly Point
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can set an assembly point on any explored tile. While out of combat, you can call every summon, familiar, companion and party member in the region to it.
Called allies arrive after a short delay, wherever they were. Allies in combat cannot be called.
Calling costs mana scaled to the number of allies called.
This is a space and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a space and gathering effect.

glass.name: Glass Walls
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Walls, doors and rock within a short radius are shown as clear glass on the map, along with whatever stands behind them.
You can spend mana to make one wall in sight transparent in the world as well as on the map. You and your allies can see through it; it still blocks movement and attacks.
A transparent wall shatters if struck hard enough, and stays broken.
This is a clarity effect.

glimeron.name: Prism View
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map splits light into layers. You can view it as a heat layer, a mana layer or a life layer, each revealing creatures and objects the others cannot.
Hidden magical traps, wards and runes appear in the mana layer.
This is a light and perception effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and perception effect.

goat.name: Goat Tracks
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Steep slopes, crags and cliff faces are marked with goat tracks where footing can be found.
You can walk along marked tracks as though they were level ground. Enemies that cannot climb must find another way to reach you.
You cannot be knocked down or knocked back while standing on a goat track.
This is a movement and footing effect.
goat.tag: This is a movement and footing effect.

gorgon.name: Stone Count
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies who have looked directly at you are marked on the map for a short time. A marked enemy that keeps facing you slowly stiffens, losing movement speed with each passing moment.
An enemy fully stiffened this way is petrified briefly.
This is a petrification and tracking effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and tracking effect.

griffin.name: High Claim
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can claim an enemy on the map by holding your view on its marker. A claimed enemy cannot leave your tracking.
Leaping, dashing or moving toward a claimed enemy from higher ground lands your first attack as a special attack that knocks it down.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
griffin.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

growth.name: Spreading Chart
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The explored edges of the map keep growing outward slowly on their own, even while you are elsewhere, revealing terrain and the locations of nodes and landmarks.
Monsters and people are not revealed this way, only the land.
The map grows faster in forests and fields, and does not grow at all in astral realms.
This is a growth effect.

guardian.name: Sentinel's Watch
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Allies are shown on the map with their health. When an ally within a short range falls below half health, their marker pulses and you gain a brief burst of movement speed toward them.
Damage dealt to that ally while you stand between them and its source is partly redirected to you.
This is a tracking and protection effect.
guardian.tag: This is a tracking and protection effect.

hair.name: Tripwires
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can string fine strands across corridors, doorways and paths you have explored. Strung strands appear on the map.
Anything that crosses a strand is marked on the map, and the strand snags it, slowing it for a short time.
Strands cost a small amount of mana each and stay until crossed. Only a limited number can be strung at once.
This is a tracking and binding effect.
hair.tag: This is a tracking and binding effect.

hammer.name: Forge Marks
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Anvils, forges and smithies are marked on the map.
At any marked anvil, you can repair your weapons and armour to full condition without tools or materials.
A weapon repaired this way gains a tempered boon that increases its damage until your next rest.
This is a crafting effect.

hand.name: Workbench Reach
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Workbenches, alchemy tables and crafting stations you have used are marked on the map.
While out of combat, you can craft at any marked station in the same region from wherever you stand, using the materials you carry.
Crafting at a distance takes longer than crafting in person.
This is a crafting and space effect.
hand.tag: This is a crafting and space effect.

harmonic.name: Chord Positions
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During combat, the map marks positions around the enemy that form a chord with your own.
When you and at least one ally stand on chord positions at the same time, all of you resonate, gaining increased damage and reduced mana costs.
The positions shift whenever the enemy moves, and they stop resonating if anyone steps off.
This is a harmony and party effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a harmony and party effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Skies
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Dropped loot, discarded items and enemies carrying stolen goods appear on the map.
You can spend stamina to shriek at a marked enemy within range. The shriek interrupts its current action and has a chance to make it drop the item it carries.
This is a sonic and theft effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sonic and theft effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning Chart
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Monster packs that are about to yield rare drops, cores or quintessence are marked on the map, with the material shown on the marker.
Killing every monster in a marked pack adds a bonus monster core to the loot.
This is a perception and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a perception and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Bridle Paths
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Routes a mount can travel are drawn on the map, including fords, passes and trails too narrow for a cart.
While mounted, the area the map reveals around you widens, and your mount does not tire.
You can mount and dismount instantly at any point on a marked path.
This is a mount effect.

hook.name: Hooked Marker
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to hook an enemy marker on the map within a short range and drag it toward you.
A hooked enemy is pulled a short distance in your direction, interrupting whatever it was doing. Dragging an enemy across a ledge or into water sends it over.
Enemies of a higher rank than you are pulled a shorter distance.
This is a pulling effect.

horse.name: Gallop Mark
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While you are sprinting, the map reveals a long stretch ahead of you in the direction you are running.
Sprinting on open ground such as fields, plains and roads costs no stamina.
Enemies you sprint into on open ground are knocked aside.
This is a movement effect.

hunger.name: Ravening Count
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The longer it has been since you last killed something, the wider the map's tracking radius grows, and the more clearly it shows living creatures.
Killing an enemy resets the radius and restores a portion of your health scaled to how long you went without a kill.
Out of combat, the radius grows slowly. In combat, it grows quickly.
This is a hunger and tracking effect.
hunger.tag: This is a hunger and tracking effect.

hunt.name: Quarry Board
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Bounties and Society hunting contracts available in the region are shown on the region map at the board where they can be taken.
Once accepted, the target's live location is tracked on the map for as long as the contract is open.
Killing a contract target while it is unaware of you increases the reward.
This is a tracking and hunt effect.
hunt.tag: This is a tracking and hunt effect.

hydra.name: Many Heads
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Every summon, familiar and party member acts as a second head: the map reveals terrain and enemies around each of them as though you were standing there.
When a summon or familiar is destroyed, the area it was revealing stays revealed for a short time.
This is a tracking and shared-sight effect.
hydra.tag: This is a tracking and shared-sight effect.

ice.name: Rime Trail
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While moving, you can leave a trail of ice behind you, drawn on the map. Moving along your own ice is significantly faster than walking.
Enemies that step onto your ice slip and fall.
Maintaining the trail costs mana while you move. Ice melts quickly in heat and in sunlight.
This is a cold and movement effect.
ice.tag: This is a cold and movement effect.

immortal.name: Long Memory
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map remembers where things happened. Hovering over a location shows what fell, died or was lost there, including dropped equipment from your own deaths.
Equipment lost when you die can be recovered from its marked location and is never destroyed.
This is a memory and perception effect.
immortal.tag: This is a memory and perception effect.

iron.name: Iron Nails
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Fey crossings, magic circles, enchanted wards and astral thin places are marked on the map.
You can spend mana to drive an iron nail into a marked point. While the nail stands, spells and magical effects cast by lower-rank enemies within a short radius cost them more and are weaker.
Only one nail can stand at a time.
This is an iron and suppression effect.
iron.tag: This is an iron and suppression effect.

juggernaut.name: Momentum Line
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While you are moving in a straight line, the map projects your path ahead of you. You gain movement speed and damage reduction the longer you hold the line.
Enemies standing on the projected path when you reach them take force damage and are knocked aside. Turning or stopping ends the build-up.
This is a movement and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a movement and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Debt Ledger
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Any enemy that has damaged you, or a member of your party, is recorded on the map and stays tracked until it dies or the debt is paid.
A recorded enemy takes increased damage from you, scaled by how much damage it has dealt to your side.
This is a tracking and karmic effect.
karmic.tag: This is a tracking and karmic effect.

knife.name: Turned Backs
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Each enemy within aura-sense range is drawn on the map with a cone showing where it is looking.
Attacks you make from outside an enemy's cone deal significantly increased damage and cannot be dodged.
Enemies alerted to you widen their cones. Enemies of a higher rank than you have wider cones to begin with.
This is a perception and blade effect.
knife.tag: This is a perception and blade effect.

knowledge.name: Library Index
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Books, scrolls, notes, letters and skill books are marked on the map wherever they lie, including on shelves, in chests and carried by enemies.
Skill books are marked in a different colour, along with the skill they teach.
Reading a written note you found this way adds its contents to the map, such as a hidden door or a cult meeting place.
This is a knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Water is shown on the map down to its depth. Creatures moving beneath the surface of any water appear as dark shapes.
You can spend mana to reach from any water tile within range and drag an enemy standing at the water's edge into it, holding it there briefly.
This is a water and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Sounding Wake
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Everything moving within a wide radius disturbs the map, appearing as ripples even when hidden, invisible or out of sight. Ripples show size but not identity.
Larger ripples are drawn for monsters of higher rank, so you know their rank before you can see them.
This is a sensing effect.

life.name: Pulse Chart
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Every living creature within aura-sense range shows a heartbeat on its marker that quickens as it is wounded.
You can spend mana to send a healing pulse to any ally's marker within range on the map, whether or not you can see them.
A pulse heals less the further it travels. Undead and constructs have no heartbeat and do not appear.
This is a life and healing effect.
life.tag: This is a life and healing effect.

light.name: Flare
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to fire a flare onto any point on the map within range. The flare lights the area for a short time.
Invisible, stealthed and shadow-hidden creatures inside the light are revealed on the map and in the world. Creatures looking toward the flare when it bursts are briefly blinded.
Only one flare can burn at a time.
This is a light effect.

lightning.name: Strike Line
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can draw a straight line on the map to a point you can see and become a bolt along it, arriving instantly.
Enemies the line passes through take lightning damage and are briefly stunned.
The line cannot pass through walls. Using it costs a large amount of mana and has a short cooldown.
This is a lightning and teleport effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and teleport effect.

lizard.name: Basking Stones
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Sun-warmed rocks and walls are marked on the map during the day.
Resting on a marked stone restores stamina quickly and grants a warmth boon that increases movement speed and attack speed until nightfall.
While perfectly still on a marked stone, you blend into it and cannot be tracked.
This is a warmth and stillness effect.
lizard.tag: This is a warmth and stillness effect.

locust.name: Stripped Ground
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to mark an area of grass, brush, crops or forest undergrowth on the map. A cloud strips the marked area bare over a short time.
Stripped ground offers no cover. Anything hiding in it is revealed, and enemies cannot use it for stealth.
Stripped ground grows back over several days.
This is a swarm and terrain effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and terrain effect.

lotus.name: Clean Water
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

Corrupted, poisoned and blighted ground is marked on the map. Spending time standing still on a tile cleanses it, and cleansed tiles remove poison and disease afflictions from anyone standing in them.
Springs and still water are marked as places of rest. Resting beside one cleanses all afflictions.
This is a purification effect.

lurker.name: Under-Watch
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While out of combat, you can sink into the ground at any marked soft tile, or settle low in its muddy shallows, and wait there.
While sunk, you cannot be seen or tracked, and the map reveals everything moving above you within a short radius.
Rising beneath an enemy knocks it down and treats your next attack as one from hiding. Staying sunk drains stamina slowly.
This is an ambush and concealment effect.
lurker.tag: This is an ambush and concealment effect.

magic.name: Ley Chart
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Places where ambient mana pools are shown on the map, including ley crossings, shrines and the sites of recent spellcasting.
Spells you cast while standing in a mana pool cost less. You can drain a pool to refill a portion of your mana, which leaves it dry for 24 hours.
Recent spellcasting sites show the school of magic used and roughly how long ago.
This is a perception and mana effect.
magic.tag: This is a perception and mana effect.

malign.name: Hexed Ground
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

You can spend mana to set a hex on any explored tile within range. The hex is invisible to everyone but you. The first enemy to step on it is cursed with a stacking affliction that deepens for as long as it remains in the region.
The curse cannot be cleansed by its victim and is visible to you on the map at any distance.
Up to three hexes can be set at once.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Slow Shallows
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Calm water, shallows and slow rivers are shaded on the map.
While you rest in calm water out of combat, you recover health and stamina significantly faster, and lower-rank monsters ignore you unless you attack them.
Companions and summons resting in the same water share the effect.
This is a water and recovery effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and recovery effect.

manticore.name: Man-Faced Lure
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Hostile beasts and monsters that hunt by sight or sound are marked differently from those that hunt by scent.
You can place a lure on the map that draws a single marked monster away from its pack toward it. The first attack against a lured monster that reaches the lure poisons it.
This is a tracking and lure effect.
manticore.tag: This is a tracking and lure effect.

master.name: Practiced Route
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Routes you have walked many times are drawn in gold. Moving along a gold route grants movement speed and reduces stamina costs.
Areas you have fully cleared before show the positions monsters held last time, so you know where packs will stand on your return.
This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Breaking Lines
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
When you prepare a heavy attack, the map projects where each enemy in its path will be knocked to.
Enemies knocked into walls, obstacles or other enemies take impact damage and are briefly stunned. An enemy knocked into another enemy knocks that one back as well.
Higher-rank enemies are knocked a shorter distance.
This is a force and knockback effect.
might.tag: This is a force and knockback effect.

ministration.name: Ward Rounds
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Wounded allies and wounded friendly townsfolk are marked on the map, along with the afflictions they carry.
Healing an ally whose marker you have visited from the map within a short time heals for more and cleanses one affliction.
This is a tracking and care effect.
ministration.tag: This is a tracking and care effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Mind
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Inside caves, sewers, dungeons and other mazes, the full layout is revealed the moment you enter, including dead ends and exits.
While inside a maze, enemies who cannot see you lose track of your position, and you deal increased damage when charging an enemy along a corridor.
This is a perception and labyrinth effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a perception and labyrinth effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Bearing
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Your true position on enemy maps, tracking and scrying is offset by a short distance in a direction you choose.
Ranged attacks and targeted abilities aimed at you while you are offset have a chance to land on your false position instead.
This is an illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Glass
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

Every reflective surface you have seen becomes a viewpoint on the map, including still water, mirrors and polished metal. You can look through any of them from the map to see and track what stands in front of it.
When an enemy uses a scrying or tracking effect on you, it is reflected back, and the enemy's position appears on your map for a short time.
This is a perception and reflection effect.
