mirror.tag: This is a perception and reflection effect.

monkey.name: Canopy Routes
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Climbable surfaces are marked on the map, including trees, cliff faces, rooftops and scaffolding. You can climb any marked surface at a stamina cost.
While you are on high ground, your ranged attacks deal increased damage and enemies on the ground lose track of you after a short time.
Locked chests and doors are marked along with whether your hands can open them.
This is a movement and perception effect.
monkey.tag: This is a movement and perception effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stones
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Ancient landmarks, ruins and standing stones are marked on the region map, including ones that are buried or overgrown.
Resting beside a marked landmark grants a long-lasting boon of increased fortitude and resistance to knockback and displacement.
This is a perception and endurance effect.
monolith.tag: This is a perception and endurance effect.

moon.name: Moonlit Margins
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
At night, hidden paths, concealed doors and stealthed creatures within aura-sense range glow faintly on the map.
The range at which you can find astral portals is extended at night, and further on nights of a full moon.
This is a light and perception effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and perception effect.

mouse.name: Mousehole Map
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Narrow gaps, crawlspaces, cracks in walls and rafters are marked on the map. You can squeeze through any marked gap.
While inside a crawlspace you cannot be seen, and any enemy tracking you loses your position until you emerge.
This is a stealth and movement effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and movement effect.

myriad.name: Thousand Vantages
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You keep sight from every point you have stood on in the last minute, as though a copy of you remained at each one.
Enemies that pass through any of those points are tracked on the map until they leave the region.
Ambushes cannot be sprung on you from areas you have recently walked through.
This is a perception and tracking effect.
myriad.tag: This is a perception and tracking effect.

mystic.name: Inner Chart
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map can be read with your eyes closed. While you are blinded, in darkness or under an effect that disables sight, the map stays fully accurate and shows every living creature in range.
Mana sources such as ley points, astral portals and charged crystals are sensed and marked from twice your aura-sense range.
This is a mystic and sensing effect.
mystic.tag: This is a mystic and sensing effect.

nebula.name: Dust-Veil Expanse
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows the night sky over the region. Areas beneath astral activity, such as concealed portals, thin places and rifts, glow faintly even before your aura sense reaches them.
Approaching a glowing area reveals the exact location of any astral portal within it.
This is an astral and perception effect.
nebula.tag: This is an astral and perception effect.

needle.name: Pinprick Mark
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can place a pin on a single enemy's marker. The pinned enemy remains tracked through stealth, invisibility, teleportation and illusion until it dies or the pin is moved.
Your critical hits against the pinned enemy strike a vital point, inflicting a bleed affliction that cannot be cleansed while the pin remains.
Only one pin can exist at a time.
This is a tracking and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a tracking and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Sworn Pursuit
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can declare one named enemy, elite or boss as your nemesis. Its location is shown on the region map wherever it goes, including across regions.
You take reduced damage from your nemesis and deal increased damage to it. Declaring a new nemesis is only possible after the current one dies.
This is a tracking and vendetta effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a tracking and vendetta effect.

net.name: Snare Points
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can place up to four snare points on explored tiles. An enemy that runs across a snare point while fleeing or charging is entangled and held in place for a short time.
Fleeing enemies have their escape route drawn on the map as soon as they break away.
Entangled enemies take increased damage from your ranged attacks.
This is a trap and binding effect.
net.tag: This is a trap and binding effect.

network.name: Linked Charts
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Your map is shared with party members, companions and summons. Anything any of them has explored or tracked appears on everyone's map.
You can place pings visible to all of them. Summons move to a pinged location when commanded.
This is a communication effect.

oasis.name: Rest Marker
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Safe ground, where no monster will path or spawn for a while, is shaded on the map.

You can establish one oasis at your position while out of combat. Allies inside it recover health, mana and stamina rapidly, and lower-rank monsters will not enter. It lasts until you leave the region.
This is a sanctuary effect.

ocean.name: Tide Chart
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Coastlines, rivers and lakes show their currents. Moving with a current along its banks and shallows is significantly faster, and you can spend stamina to run with one at speed.
Things the water has carried, such as wreckage, drowned loot and washed-up caches, are marked along shorelines.
This is a water and perception effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and perception effect.

octopus.name: Eight Tethers
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

You can hold up to eight enemies on the map at once with tethers. Tethered enemies stay tracked while within the region, and each one you strike takes slightly more damage for each other tethered enemy still alive.
You can spend mana to burst ink over a tethered enemy's position, blinding it and everything around it for a short time.
This is a tracking and ink effect.
octopus.tag: This is a tracking and ink effect.

omen.name: Portent Shading
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Areas of the map are shaded by how dangerous they are to you, measured against your rank and current health.
Places where an elite, rare or boss monster will appear show a portent mark before it arrives.
When something in the region is about to go badly for you, such as an ambush forming or a higher-rank monster turning your way, the map darkens at its edge in that direction.
This is a divination effect.

onslaught.name: Kill Chain
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
After you kill an enemy, the next nearest enemy is highlighted on the map. Reaching and attacking it within a short time continues the chain.
Each link in the chain grants stacking attack speed. The chain breaks if you go too long without landing a hit on the highlighted enemy.
This is a tracking and combat-rhythm effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a tracking and combat-rhythm effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Compass
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Your marker shows arcs for the directions incoming attacks are coming from. You take reduced damage from attacks arriving from the most-threatened arc.
You can curl up at a stamina cost. While curled, you are immune to damage from all shaded arcs but cannot move or attack. Curling ends when your stamina runs out.
This is a defensive and perception effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and perception effect.

paper.name: Paper Crane
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to fold a paper crane from the map and send it to any point within a long range. It flies there over any terrain, reveals the area around it, and perches.
A perched crane keeps its area visible on your map until it is destroyed. You can keep up to three cranes at once.
You can write a short message on a crane and send it to any party member or companion.
This is a conjuration and scouting effect.
paper.tag: This is a conjuration and scouting effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Nightmare Overlay
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can project a false map onto enemies who track you, filling it with phantom allies, walls and hazards that do not exist.
Enemies under the false map path around phantom obstacles and may attack phantom allies. Projecting it costs mana and lasts a short time.
This is an illusion and fear effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and fear effect.

phoenix.name: Ashen Vigil
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Fallen allies and summons are marked on the map with a smouldering plume for a short time after they die.
You can spend a large amount of mana at a plume to rekindle that ally or summon with a portion of its health. This can be done once per ally per day.
This is a fire and resurrection effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and resurrection effect.

plant.name: Root Network
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Grass, brush, crops and trees within range act as sensors. Anything moving through vegetation appears on the map, including invisible and burrowing creatures.
Creatures hiding in vegetation cannot gain stealth against you.
This is a plant and tracking effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and tracking effect.

potent.name: Potency Glow
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Essences, awakening stones, monster cores and rare-quality items within aura-sense range glow on the map, coloured by their rarity.
Monsters carrying an essence or awakening stone as loot are marked before you fight them.
This is a perception effect.

predatory.name: Weakest of the Herd
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows which enemies in a group are isolated, wounded or lowest in rank.
Attacks against an enemy marked this way deal increased damage, and killing it causes the rest of its group to hesitate briefly before acting.
This is a tracking and predator effect.
predatory.tag: This is a tracking and predator effect.

prison.name: Holding Cell
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can mark a small enclosed area on the map, such as a room or alley. While marked, enemies inside it cannot leave by walking, teleporting or burrowing.
The cell lasts a short time and costs mana scaled to the number of enemies trapped. Enemies of higher rank than you can break out.
This is a confinement effect.

prosperity.name: Market Map
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Merchants and shops you have visited show their current stock on the map, with items they will buy for more than their usual worth highlighted.
Society contracts and quest givers offering bonus rewards today are marked.
This is a commerce and fortune effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a commerce and fortune effect.

pure.name: Unmixed Sight
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows every creature as it truly is. Illusions, decoys and doubles do not appear on it, and disguised or shapeshifted enemies are marked as hostile.
Corrupted ground, blight and undead are shaded on the map. Standing in an area that is not shaded slowly cleanses your afflictions while you are out of combat.
This is a perception and purity effect.
pure.tag: This is a perception and purity effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt Hole
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map always shows your nearest escape route and the closest burrow, cave mouth or doorway that breaks line of sight.
When your health falls low, the route lights up. While you follow it, you gain a large burst of movement speed and stamina recovery.
This effect cannot trigger again for a short time after it ends.
This is a movement and escape effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and escape effect.

rake.name: Combed Ground
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows the tracks left by every creature that has passed through the area recently, with their direction and how fresh they are.
Following a fresh trail to its end gives you increased damage against the creature that made it for the rest of the fight.
Dropped items, spent ammunition and coins lying in the area are marked.
This is a tracking effect.

rat.name: Gutter Routes
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Sewers, drains, tunnels and the undercity are mapped wherever you find an entrance, without your having to explore them.
Vermin within range act as your spies: enemies near any rat, mouse or roach appear on the map.
When your health falls low in a settlement or tunnel, vermin swarm your position and break enemy line of sight for a short time. This effect recovers over a few minutes.
This is a tracking and swarm effect.
rat.tag: This is a tracking and swarm effect.

reagent.name: Slow Conversion
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can mark an explored tile as a cache and leave crafting materials there. Over 24 hours, the materials transmute into a higher tier of the same family.
Only one cache can exist per region. Anyone else who finds the cache can take from it.
This is a transmutation effect.

refracting.name: Bent Sightlines
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows every line of sight between you and enemies, including through reflective surfaces such as water and polished stone.
Spells and ranged attacks you aim at a reflective surface shown on the map are redirected along its angle toward the nearest enemy.
This is a light and redirection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and redirection effect.

renewal.name: Season Clock
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Harvested nodes show how long they have until they regrow. Cleared monster dens show how long until they repopulate.
Once per day, you can renew a depleted node at once, letting it be harvested again.
This is a life and time effect.
renewal.tag: This is a life and time effect.

resolute.name: Unbroken Heading
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can set a heading on the map. While you move toward the point you set, you resist slows, roots, knockback and fear effects.
Reaching the point while in combat restores a portion of your stamina. Turning away from the heading ends the effect.
This is a movement and willpower effect.
resolute.tag: This is a movement and willpower effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Echo
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can send a resonant pulse through the map at the cost of mana. Every creature and object in a wide radius rings back, appearing on the map for a short time.
Enemies hit by consecutive pulses vibrate, taking stacking sonic damage while they remain revealed.
This is a sonic and tracking effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sonic and tracking effect.

roc.name: Shadow Over the Land
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can cast a vast shadow over a chosen area of the map. Lower-rank monsters under the shadow flee it, and higher-rank monsters are slowed by fear.
The shadow lasts a short time and recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a fear and domain effect.
roc.tag: This is a fear and domain effect.

rune.name: Graven Waymarks
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].

You can engrave up to three runes onto explored tiles from the map. Each rune is one of three kinds: an alarm that alerts you when anything crosses it, a binding that slows enemies standing on it, or a lamp that lights its surroundings and strips stealth.
Runes last until you engrave a new one in their place. Engraving costs mana.
This is a rune and ward effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and ward effect.

sacrifice.name: Blood Survey
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend a portion of your health to reveal the entire current region map at once, including all monster packs and nodes, for a short time.
Areas revealed this way stay explored. The health spent cannot be healed until the reveal ends.
This is a blood and revelation effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and revelation effect.

sand.name: Shifting Dunes
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Buried ruins, sunken chests and burrowing monsters beneath sand, soil or ash are shown on the map.

You can spend mana to raise a veil of blowing sand over an area. Allies inside it cannot be seen by enemies outside it, and enemies inside it lose sight of the map's edges and anything beyond a short distance.
This is an earth and concealment effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and concealment effect.

sceptre.name: Rod of Command
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can give orders to your summons and companions by placing them on the map: move here, hold this ground, guard this ally, or attack the marked enemy.
They follow map orders even when out of your sight. Summons acting on an order you gave deal increased damage until the order is complete.
This is a command effect.

scribe.name: Surveyor's Notes
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can write notes onto the map. A note placed on a monster's marker records its kind, rank and abilities once you have fought it, and the note persists on every future monster of that kind.
Monsters you have written notes about take increased damage from you.
This is a record and knowledge effect.
scribe.tag: This is a record and knowledge effect.

serene.name: Still Circle
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While you are out of combat, you can spend mana to draw a calm circle on the map around your position.
Monsters that enter the circle do not begin a fight unless they are attacked. You and your allies recover mana faster while inside it.
The circle ends when anyone within it attacks. It can be drawn again after a short time.
This is a calming and order effect.
serene.tag: This is a calming and order effect.

serpent.name: Coiled Patience
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
While you stand still, your tracking range grows steadily wider, and you are hidden from enemy maps and tracking effects.
The first attack you make after standing still for a long time is a special attack that deals bonus poison damage.
This is a stealth and tracking effect.
serpent.tag: This is a stealth and tracking effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies below half health leave a blood trail on the map that you can follow over a long distance, even after they flee out of sight.
You gain movement speed while moving toward a bleeding enemy, and deal increased damage to it once you reach it.
This is a tracking and predation effect.
shark.tag: This is a tracking and predation effect.

shield.name: Incoming Arcs
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Projectiles and charging enemies headed your way are drawn on the map with their path before they arrive.
Blocking toward a marked projectile at the moment it lands reflects it back along its path. Blocking a marked charge staggers the charger.
This is a defensive and perception effect.
shield.tag: This is a defensive and perception effect.

shimmer.name: Glint Map
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Coins, gems, precious metals and anything else that shines within range glint on the map.
You can spend mana to flash a glint at any point you can see. Enemies at that point are dazzled, missing more often and losing track of anything they were targeting.
This is a light and perception effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and perception effect.

ship.name: Harbour Chart
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Docks, landings and navigable water are marked on the map.
At any shoreline you can spend mana to call a skiff that carries you and your party across open water. Travel by skiff between docks you have visited is significantly faster than walking.
The skiff vanishes when you step off it.
This is a conjuration and travel effect.
ship.tag: This is a conjuration and travel effect.

shovel.name: Buried Chart
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Buried caches, graves, and treasure left by other adventurers are marked on the map once you are close enough. Digging at a marked spot uncovers whatever was left there.
You can dig in at any open ground at a stamina cost, creating a shallow pit that gives you cover from ranged attacks while you stand in it.
This is an earth and discovery effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and discovery effect.

sickle.name: Crescent Marks
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies low enough in health for a single blow from you to kill them carry a crescent on their marker.
Killing a crescent-marked enemy restores a small amount of stamina and briefly increases your attack speed, letting you sweep through a weakened group.
This is a perception and execution effect.
sickle.tag: This is a perception and execution effect.

simulacrum.name: Decoy Outline
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to leave a made likeness of yourself at any explored point within range on the map. Enemies treat the likeness as you, attacking and pursuing it.
The likeness has a portion of your health and cannot attack. Only one exists at a time.
This is a conjuration and decoy effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration and decoy effect.

sin.name: Marked Sinners
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Creatures and people who have murdered, betrayed or broken an oath are marked red on the map. Wanted criminals and the targets of open bounties are marked by name.
You deal increased damage to marked sinners, and they cannot hide from your tracking.
This is a judgement and tracking effect.
sin.tag: This is a judgement and tracking effect.

skirmish.name: Fallback Lines
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During combat, the map marks retreat positions that break line of sight with the most enemies.
Disengaging toward a marked position grants a burst of movement speed. The next attack you make from that position recovers stamina.
This is a tactical movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a tactical movement effect.

skunk.name: Warning Scent
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend stamina to leave a lingering scent at your position, shown on the map as a cloud. Lower-rank monsters refuse to enter it.
Any enemy that passes through the cloud carries its smell and stays tracked on the map for a long time afterward.
Clouds last a few minutes. Up to two can exist at once.
This is a scent and warding effect.
skunk.tag: This is a scent and warding effect.

sky.name: Open Ceiling
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Cliffs, ledges and drops are marked with safe landing points. You take no falling damage when dropping onto a marked landing point.
Dropping from a height onto enemies near a landing point deals impact damage scaled to the distance fallen.
This is an air and movement effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and movement effect.

sloth.name: Patient Watch
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The longer you stand still, the further the map reveals around you, until its radius has grown several times over.
While you stay still and out of combat, enemies cannot track you and do not notice you unless they walk into you.
Moving resets the radius.
This is a perception and stillness effect.
sloth.tag: This is a perception and stillness effect.

smoke.name: Veiled Trail
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to leave a trail of smoke behind you as you move. While inside your own smoke you are hidden from enemy sight and removed from any enemy's tracking.
Enemies that enter the smoke cannot see out of it.
The trail fades after a short time.
This is a smoke and concealment effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and concealment effect.

snake.name: Venom Count
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies carrying your poisons stay tracked on the map at any distance within the region.

Each poisoned enemy's marker shows how long it has left before your poison kills it, if it will. Enemies your poison is certain to kill are marked with a fang, and you receive their loot when they die even if you are out of range.
This is a tracking and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a tracking and poison effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Chart
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Rising air currents are shown on the map. Stepping into one hurls you forward in a long, bounding leap in the direction you choose, clearing gaps, streams and low walls.
Leaping this way costs no stamina, and for a moment after you land you cannot be knocked down or targeted by melee attacks.
This is an air and flight effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and flight effect.

song.name: Carried Tune
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Music, singing and voices are shown on the map as ripples.
You can spend mana to send a melody across the map to every party member and companion within a long range, granting them a brief boon to stamina recovery and resistance to fear.
This is a sound and support effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Survey
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can declare an explored area of the map as your territory. Within it, townsfolk and guards treat you with deference, shop prices fall, and lower-rank monsters will not attack first.
Only one territory can be held at a time. Declaring one requires standing at its centre while out of combat.
This is a domain and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a domain and authority effect.

spear.name: Long Throw
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can place a target marker on any tile the map shows. Thrown weapons and projectiles you release toward the marker arc to land on it, even beyond your sight and around obstacles.
Projectiles thrown at a marker you cannot see deal increased damage on landing.
This is a ranged and targeting effect.
spear.tag: This is a ranged and targeting effect.

spider.name: Silk Tripwires
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can string up to six strands of silk between points on the map. Anything that touches a strand is felt at once and shown on the map, along with its size.
Enemies that break a strand are briefly slowed and remain tracked for a short time.
This is a web and tracking effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and tracking effect.

spike.name: Hazard Chart
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Traps, spikes, pits and environmental hazards are marked on the map before you reach them.
Enemies you knock, pull or drive onto a hazard take increased damage from it. Traps set by enemies can be sprung from a distance through the map, at a mana cost.
This is a perception and trap effect.
spike.tag: This is a perception and trap effect.

staff.name: Walker's Chart
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows the difficulty of terrain. You ignore movement penalties from rough ground, mud, snow and shallow water.
After walking a long distance without fighting, your next ability costs no stamina.
This is a travel effect.

star.name: Far Lights
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Distant landmarks, settlements and beacons appear on the map from much further away, including across region borders.
Astral portals appear on the map as faint stars once you are within twice your aura-sense range, though you must still come within aura-sense range to enter them.
This is a light and perception effect.
star.tag: This is a light and perception effect.

stellar.name: Fixed Stars
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can fix up to three stars to points on the region map. Each star always shows its distance and direction from you, even across regions and in astral realms.
While standing on a star's point, spells you cast deal additional fire damage and you recover mana over time.
This is a star and navigation effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and navigation effect.

storm.name: Conductor's Chart
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Tall objects, metal structures and wet ground are marked as conductors. Lightning damage you deal arcs to enemies standing on or near any conductor in range.
Enemies standing in rain or water are shown on the map and take increased lightning damage from you.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies whose willpower is weakened, such as those who are afraid, charmed or below half health, are marked on the map.
You can spend mana to draw a marked enemy's attention to you. It cannot attack you for a short time, and while it is held you steal a portion of its mana and stamina.
This is a charm and drain effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and drain effect.

sun.name: Noon Reveal
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Once per day, at midday, every creature within the explored part of the region appears on the map for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
In daylight, enemies you can see on the map cannot become stealthed or invisible, and undead creatures standing in open sunlight are marked and take fire damage from your attacks.
This is a sun and revelation effect.
sun.tag: This is a sun and revelation effect.

swarm.name: Hive Sight
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can release a cloud of tiny scouts onto the map. They spread out from you and reveal everything they pass over, and the area they cover stays explored.
Enemies within the cloud are covered by biting insects that inflict a minor damage-over-time affliction. Releasing the cloud costs mana and stamina.
This is a swarm and scouting effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and scouting effect.

swift.name: Shortcut Sense
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Shortcuts are marked on the map, including drops you can safely take, gaps you can leap and gates you can open from one side.
You can dash across a marked gap or down a marked drop without a stamina cost. Taking a shortcut while being chased gives a brief burst of speed.
This is a movement effect.

sword.name: Duellist's Circle
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can declare a duel against one enemy's marker. A circle is drawn on the map around the two of you.
Inside the circle, you and your opponent deal increased damage to each other. Other enemies that enter the circle are slowed, and your opponent cannot leave it while you stand within it.
The duel ends when either of you falls, or when you leave the circle.
This is a challenge and blade effect.
sword.tag: This is a challenge and blade effect.

talisman.name: Kept Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Items that carry a charm, blessing or enchantment are marked on the map wherever they lie, including inside chests and on enemies.
You can bind one amulet you wear to the map. While it is bound, you are warned on the map before stepping into any trap, curse or hostile ward.
This is a perception and warding effect.
talisman.tag: This is a perception and warding effect.

tentacle.name: Long Grasp
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to have a tentacle rise beneath any enemy's marker within a short range of you, seizing it and dragging it to your side.
The tentacle can rise only from water, shadow or open ground. Enemies of higher rank break free partway.
This is a conjuration and grappling effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a conjuration and grappling effect.

thread.name: Lifeline Threads
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
A thread links you to each party member and companion on the map, so you always know where they are, across any distance within the region.
Once per short time, you can pull an ally within range along their thread to your side, lifting them out of whatever is holding them.
This is a binding and rescue effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and rescue effect.

thunderbird.name: Stormcaller's Trail
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Storms in the region are drawn to you. Once a storm reaches you, it follows you until it breaks, travelling with you across the map.
While under your storm, you gain movement speed and your lightning abilities cost less mana. Enemies under it are periodically struck by lightning.
This is a weather and lightning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a weather and lightning effect.

time.name: Recall Point
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map keeps a faint trace of where you stood a few seconds ago. You can spend mana to return to that point, restoring the health you had when you stood there.
This cannot restore more than a portion of your maximum health and recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a time and teleport effect.
time.tag: This is a time and teleport effect.

tranquil.name: Quiet Ground
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies that are unaware of you are shown in a calm colour. While you remain at a distance from an unaware enemy, nothing you do makes noise it can hear.
Monsters that are calm cannot be pulled into a fight by an ally's combat nearby.
This is a stealth and calm effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a stealth and calm effect.

transfiguration.name: Shifting Outline
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
On every enemy map, scrying and tracking effect, your marker appears as a common monster native to the area instead of a person.
Monsters of a kind you are disguised as will not attack you unless you attack them first.
This is a transformation and disguise effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and disguise effect.

transgression.name: Broken Rules
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Restricted areas, warded doors, forbidden shrines and places you are not supposed to be are marked on the map.
Anyone near you who has just broken a law, oath or ward is marked for a short time. You deal increased damage to them and can see them through walls.
This is a detection and transgression effect.
transgression.tag: This is a detection and transgression effect.

trap.name: Baited Ground
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can leave bait at a marked tile and choose a kind of monster. Monsters of that kind within a long range are drawn toward the bait one at a time, letting you pull a single monster from a group.
A monster that reaches the bait is caught by a conjured jaw, rooted and damaged.
Only one bait can be set at a time.
This is a lure and trap effect.
trap.tag: This is a lure and trap effect.

tree.name: Grove Paths
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Large trees are marked on the map. You can spend mana to step into any tree you are touching and out of any other marked tree within range.
Stepping out of a tree grants you brief cover from ranged attacks while you stand against it.
This is a plant and teleport effect.
tree.tag: This is a plant and teleport effect.

troll.name: Regrowth Map
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies that regenerate are marked on the map along with the one damage type that halts their regeneration.
Your own marker shows a tally of damage you have taken in the current fight. When you leave combat, you recover health equal to a portion of that tally almost at once.
This is a regeneration and perception effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and perception effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Plan
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The map shows the structure of buildings, dungeons and ruins, including hidden doors, secret rooms and weak walls.
Broken bridges, collapsed stairs and gaps in walls are marked. You can spend stamina to repair a marked structure, making it passable.
This is a building and perception effect.
trowel.tag: This is a building and perception effect.

turtle.name: Shell Sense
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
When three or more enemies close on your position, the map warns you and your shell rises on its own, blocking the next few hits from any direction.
While the shell is up, the map shows the nearest open ground you can retreat to.
This can happen once per fight.
This is a defensive effect.

twilight.name: Long Dusk
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Night-active monsters are shown on the map during the day, along with where they sleep.
Around you it is always dusk. Enemies beyond a short distance from you cannot see you clearly, and lose track of you whenever you break line of sight.
This is a darkness and stealth effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and stealth effect.

undeath.name: Grave Survey
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Graves, crypts and the remains of the dead are marked on the map, along with the rank each body held in life.
Undead monsters appear on the map at any range in the current region and do not recognise you as living unless you attack them.
This is a death and tracking effect.
undeath.tag: This is a death and tracking effect.

unity.name: Shared Burden
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Allies and summons within a short range of you are linked on the map. Damage dealt to any linked member is spread evenly across all of them.
Links break if a member moves out of range. Party members can see the links on their own maps.
This is a bond and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a bond and protection effect.

vast.name: Borderless Chart
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The outline of every region you enter is drawn on the map at once, showing terrain, water and settlements, though not creatures or loot.
The map does not stop at region borders. You can see the outline of any region next to the one you are in.
This is a space and perception effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and perception effect.

vehicle.name: Road Chart
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Roads and trails are highlighted on the map. You and your mount travel significantly faster on them.
While you stand on any marked road, you can call your mount to you from anywhere in the region.
This is a travel and mount effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and mount effect.

venom.name: Spreading Taint
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Poisons you inflict are shown on the map as a stain that spreads slowly from the poisoned enemy.
Other enemies who stand inside the stain for a time catch the poison at a weaker strength. The stain fades when the original victim dies or is cleansed.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Overgrown Paths
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Forest, grassland and undergrowth tiles are shaded. While you stand on shaded ground, you are hidden from enemy tracking.
You can spend mana to raise creepers along a path drawn on the map, rooting enemies who cross it for a short time.
This is a plant and control effect.
verdant.tag: This is a plant and control effect.

vessel.name: Stored Power
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Pools of loose mana, spent spells and dissipating essences are marked on the map.
Walking into a marked pool fills you with its power, restoring mana and granting a short boon to the next spell you cast.
This is a mana and absorption effect.
vessel.tag: This is a mana and absorption effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Colours
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
After you defeat an enemy, you can take on its face. Until you attack or leave the region, other creatures of its kind are shown on the map as neutral and do not attack you.
Cultists and faction enemies treat you as one of their own while wearing a face from their ranks, letting you pass their camps.
This is a disguise effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Paths
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Every enemy within aura-sense range shows a faint line on the map tracing where it will move over the next few seconds.
Traps and ground effects you place on a foreseen path are triggered at the moment the enemy arrives, and cannot be avoided by it.
This is a precognition effect.

void.name: Blank Patch
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can spend mana to blank out an area of the map. Enemies inside it cannot see, track or target anything outside it, and anything inside it is hidden from enemies outside.
The patch lasts a short time and drains your mana while active.
This is a void and concealment effect.
void.tag: This is a void and concealment effect.

volcano.name: Magma Veins
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Heat beneath the ground is shown on the map. Fire abilities you use on a marked heat vein build pressure in it.
Once enough pressure has built, the vein erupts along its whole length, inflicting heavy fire damage and leaving burning ground.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Spiral Draw
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Loot, dropped items and harvested materials within a wide radius on the map are pulled toward you over time.
You can spend mana to create a pulling spiral at any point on the map within range, drawing enemies toward its centre for a short time.
This is an air and pull effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and pull effect.

wasp.name: Return Sting
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Any enemy that damages you is marked with a sting and stays tracked on the map for a long time.
When an attack hits you from beyond your sight, the attacker's position is marked at once.
Your first attack against a stung enemy inflicts a stacking poison.
This is a tracking and retaliation effect.
wasp.tag: This is a tracking and retaliation effect.

water.name: Flood Lines
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Low ground, basins and dry riverbeds are shaded on the map.
You can spend mana to flood a marked basin you can see. Enemies caught in the water are slowed, cannot sprint, and take increased damage from cold and lightning.
The water drains after a short time.
This is a water and terrain effect.
water.tag: This is a water and terrain effect.

weave.name: Woven Routes
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can draw threads between points of interest on the map. Moving along a thread from one end to the other grants movement speed.
Enemies who cross a thread are tangled in it, slowed briefly and revealed on the map until they break free.
This is a thread and control effect.
weave.tag: This is a thread and control effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Trail
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The scent of living prey is drawn on the map as trails. Following a trail grants movement speed, and you can follow one through snow, rain and darkness.
Killing the creature at the end of a trail restores a large portion of your stamina and removes cold afflictions from you.
This is a hunting and cold effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a hunting and cold effect.

whale.name: Migration Routes
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The routes roaming monsters travel are drawn on the map, including those of rare and wandering monsters, with where they will be and when.
Large creatures anywhere within a very long range appear on the map as faint shapes.
This is a tracking effect.

wheel.name: Patrol Wheels
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The patrol loops of guards, sentries and cult camps are drawn on the map, with the timing of each round.
An enemy you attack while it is at the far end of its patrol, away from its companions, cannot call for help.
This is a perception and timing effect.
wheel.tag: This is a perception and timing effect.

whip.name: Snap Line
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
You can crack a lash line to any tile or ledge within a short range that the map shows, pulling yourself to it.
If the line passes across an enemy, the enemy is struck and spun around, leaving it open to your next attack.
This costs stamina and can be used again after a short time.
This is a movement and lash effect.
whip.tag: This is a movement and lash effect.

wind.name: Wind Rose
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The wind's direction is shown on the map. Projectiles you fire downwind travel further, and enemies upwind of you cannot smell or hear you.
You can spend mana to send a gust along a line on the map, clearing smoke, gas and clouds, and pushing lighter enemies aside.
This is an air effect.

wing.name: Aerial Vantage
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
When you leap, dash or drop from a ledge, the map lifts to a bird's-eye view for a moment and reveals a wide area around you, including rooftops, canopies and ledges.
Enemies standing on high places are marked, and your attacks against them straight out of a leap deal increased damage.
This is a flight and perception effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and perception effect.

wolf.name: Flank Marks
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
During a fight, the map marks the flanks and rear of each enemy engaged with you or an ally.
Enemies attacked by two or more of your side at once take increased damage. You and your summons gain movement speed while moving to a marked flank.
This is a pack and tactical effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and tactical effect.

wood.name: Grain Sight
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Wooden doors, walls, crates and barrels within a short range are transparent on the map, showing whatever stands or rests behind them.
Your attacks pass through wooden barriers you can see through this way, at reduced strength.
This is a perception and wood effect.
wood.tag: This is a perception and wood effect.

wrath.name: Grudge Ledger
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Enemies that have killed an ally, summon or companion of yours are marked in red and stay marked until killed.
While a red-marked enemy is in sight, you build wrath over time. You can spend wrath to make your next attack against that enemy deal heavy damage.
This is a tracking and fury effect.
wrath.tag: This is a tracking and fury effect.

zeal.name: Burning Purpose
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
The objectives of your active quests burn on the map. While moving toward an active objective, you gain movement speed and stamina recovery.
Completing a quest objective restores a portion of your mana and stamina.
This is a quest and willpower effect.
zeal.tag: This is a quest and willpower effect.

ziz.name: Horizon Wing
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Outworlder] ability [Mini Map]. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Mini Map].
Regional hazards such as storms, sandstorms, blizzards and ash falls are shown on the map with their path.
Hazards part around you: a wide area centred on you is unaffected by weather and regional hazards, and allies inside it share that protection.
This is a weather and protection effect.
ziz.tag: This is a weather and protection effect.

action.name: Snap Devour
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Area-of-effect abilities you use within a moment of taking damage resolve instantly, skipping their cast time and wind-up.
An area ability resolved this way costs stamina instead of mana. It cannot trigger again until you have gone a short time without being hit.
This is an area and reflex effect.
action.tag: This is an area and reflex effect.

adept.name: Practiced Ruin
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each area-of-effect ability tracks how many enemies it has struck across your lifetime. At rank milestones of that count, the ability's area grows and its mana cost falls.
Casting an area-of-effect ability so that its edge just catches an enemy, without the centre touching it, deals critical damage to that enemy.
This is a mastery and area effect.
adept.tag: This is a mastery and area effect.

alchemy.name: Crucible Field
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

When an area ability hits enemies carrying different afflictions, those afflictions react with one another. Each pair consumed this way deals a burst of damage whose type depends on the afflictions involved.
Afflictions consumed in a reaction are removed. The burst does not spread past the original area.
This is an area and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an area and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: Closed Jaw
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can seed an area ability onto the ground in advance. It lies invisible to enemies until any one of them enters it, then resolves at full strength with a brief stun.
Only one seeded area can wait at a time. It dissipates if you move far from it or enter combat elsewhere.
This is an area, trap and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is an area, trap and stealth effect.

animate.name: Swallowed Rubble
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Objects destroyed by your area abilities, such as crates, rubble and statues, rise as brief mindless constructs that hurl themselves at the nearest enemy and break apart on impact.
Constructs made this way deal damage scaled to the size of the object. Higher-rank enemies' gear and corpses cannot be animated.
This is an area and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is an area and animation effect.

anzu.name: Eye of the Storm Bird
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities leave a thunderhead overhead for a short time. While it hangs there, lightning strikes the enemy in the area with the most health at regular intervals.
Flying enemies inside the area are struck first and are knocked down to ground level.
This is an area, storm and lightning effect.
anzu.tag: This is an area, storm and lightning effect.

ape.name: Troop Breaker
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can tear up a chunk of ground, a boulder or a fallen enemy and hurl it. Where it lands, it bursts into an area of debris that inflicts physical damage and knocks enemies down.
Enemies knocked down this way are dazed, and turn on the nearest enemy instead of you for a moment when they stand.
This is a physical and area effect.
ape.tag: This is a physical and area effect.

armour.name: Crushing Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities strip armour layer by layer. Each one that strikes an enemy removes a portion of its physical damage reduction until the fight ends.
An enemy stripped of all its armour this way takes increased damage from every area effect, including those of your allies.
While any enemy near you has been fully stripped, you gain physical damage reduction.
This is a sundering and area effect.
armour.tag: This is a sundering and area effect.

arsenal.name: Volley of Everything
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to rain spectral copies of every weapon you carry in your inventory across an area. Each weapon strikes once with its own damage type and on-hit effects.
The more distinct weapon types you carry, the wider the area. This ability recovers over a long cooldown.
This is an area and conjuration effect.
arsenal.tag: This is an area and conjuration effect.

aspect.name: Eye Unveiled
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day you can take on the aspect of the Eye for a short time. Your form swells with light and a vast eye opens behind you.
While the aspect lasts, every enemy in your line of sight is inside your area-of-effect abilities, however far their true area reaches. Mana costs are doubled for the duration.
The aspect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a transformation and area effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and area effect.

avatar.name: Gaze of the Ascended
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day, you can spend mana to take on a towering astral form for a short time. While in it, every area ability you use is centred on you and grows to cover everything you can see.
In the form you cannot move quickly or use movement abilities. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an area and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is an area and transformation effect.

axe.name: Felling Stroke
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your melee attacks cleave in a wide arc, striking every enemy in front of you.
An enemy struck by the arc that falls below a low health threshold is felled outright if it is of your rank or lower. Each enemy felled this way extends the arc of your next attack.
This is a cleave and execution effect.
axe.tag: This is a cleave and execution effect.

balance.name: Even Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Damage from your area-of-effect abilities is pooled and divided evenly among every enemy caught in them, rather than each taking full damage separately.
An enemy brought to zero health by its share has its remaining overflow redistributed across the others in the same area.
You can toggle this effect on or off.
This is a balance and area effect.
balance.tag: This is a balance and area effect.

bat.name: Night Chorus
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to release a shrieking pulse around you. Enemies within it are deafened and lose track of you for a short time, and invisible or hidden enemies are revealed by the echo.
In darkness, the pulse also inflicts sonic damage and reaches significantly further.
This is a sound and area effect.
bat.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

battlefield.name: Scorched Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Ground struck by your area abilities stays churned and burning for a short time. Enemies inside it cannot regain stamina, and allies standing beside it deal increased damage.
Churned ground from several abilities joins together into one field. The field breaks apart once you leave combat.
This is an area and battlefield effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an area and battlefield effect.

bear.name: Mauling Ground
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend stamina to slam the ground, sending a shockwave outward that inflicts physical damage and staggers enemies.
Each enemy staggered by the shockwave grants you a stack of fury. At full stacks, your next shockwave doubles its radius and knocks enemies prone.
This is a physical and area effect.
bear.tag: This is a physical and area effect.

bee.name: Hive Mind Swarm
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave behind a swarm that lingers for a short time, stinging enemies within it and applying a stacking venom affliction.
Swarms left by separate abilities merge when they overlap. A merged swarm grows to cover both areas and follows the enemy with the most venom stacks.
This is a swarm and affliction effect.
bee.tag: This is a swarm and affliction effect.

behemoth.name: Trampled Earth
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities centred on yourself grow with your size. While any size-increasing effect is active, they cover significantly more ground.
Enemies of lower rank caught at the centre of a self-centred area ability are knocked flat and trampled for additional damage.
This is an area and size effect.
behemoth.tag: This is an area and size effect.

bird.name: Raptor's View
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can target area-of-effect abilities anywhere you can see on the map within aura-sense range, as though looking down from above, including over walls and terrain that block line of sight.
Abilities placed this way cost additional mana, and take a moment to fall from the sky before they resolve.
This is a perception and area effect.
bird.tag: This is a perception and area effect.

blight.name: Spreading Rot
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Ground struck by your area-of-effect abilities becomes blighted for a long time. Enemies standing on blighted ground suffer a rot affliction that reduces their healing received.
Blighted ground spreads slowly to adjacent tiles while enemies stand on it, and withers plants, crops and wooden structures it reaches.
This is a blight and area effect.
blight.tag: This is a blight and area effect.

blood.name: Red Tide
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can pay for area-of-effect abilities with health instead of mana. Abilities paid for this way inflict additional blood damage and apply a bleed affliction.
Enemies bleeding from your abilities splash blood when struck, and every splash that lands on you returns a portion of the health you spent.
This is a blood and area effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and area effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Burst
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Corpses inside your area-of-effect abilities detonate into storms of bone shards, inflicting physical damage and a bleed affliction to enemies around them.
Each detonated corpse leaves a ring of jutting bone that slows enemies passing through it for a short time.
This is a bone and area effect.
bone.tag: This is a bone and area effect.

boundary.name: Ruled Annihilation
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can reshape the edges of an area ability before it resolves, drawing it as any closed shape of equal size instead of its normal form.
Allies standing exactly on the edge of a reshaped area are untouched by it. Enemies standing on the edge take its full effect and cannot leave the area until it ends.
This is an area and space effect.
boundary.tag: This is an area and space effect.

bounty.name: Overspill
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies killed by your area abilities drop an additional share of loot, scattered across the area.
Allies who walk over a scattered share recover a portion of health and mana. Shares left on the ground vanish after a short time.
This is an area and abundance effect.
bounty.tag: This is an area and abundance effect.

bow.name: Arrow Rain
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can loose an arrow into the air that splits and falls as a volley across a target area, striking every enemy within it.
The longer you hold the draw, the wider the volley spreads, at the cost of stamina for every moment held.
Arrows from the volley remain stuck in the ground and can be picked up again.
This is a ranged and area effect.
bow.tag: This is a ranged and area effect.

brush.name: Choking Undergrowth
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave dense undergrowth where they land. Enemies inside it are slowed and cannot see beyond its edge; you and your allies can.
Fire set to the undergrowth consumes it in a single blaze, inflicting fire damage to every enemy still inside.
This is a nature and area effect.
brush.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

cage.name: Closing Ring
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to raise a ring of bars around a target area. Enemies inside cannot leave until the ring expires or is broken.
The ring contracts slowly over its duration. When it closes completely, it crushes every enemy still inside for heavy physical damage.
Only one ring can exist at a time.
This is a confinement and area effect.
cage.tag: This is a confinement and area effect.

cat.name: Pounce Zone
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can leap to the centre of a target area. Your landing makes no sound, and enemies nearby that were unaware of you take bonus damage from every effect landing in the area for a short time.
Enemies of lower rank caught by the landing are startled and drop whatever they were channelling.
This is a stealth and area effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and area effect.

cataclysm.name: Faultline
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Each area ability you land in the same place opens a deeper fault in the ground. On the third, the fault erupts, dealing heavy earth damage across a far wider area and destroying destructible terrain.
The ground stays broken and impassable for a long time after the eruption. The eruption cannot be triggered again in the same fight.
This is an area and cataclysm effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an area and cataclysm effect.

cattle.name: Stampede
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day you can call a stampede of spectral cattle that charges across a wide line of the battlefield, trampling every enemy in its path and knocking them aside.
The stampede grows heavier the longer you have gone without using it, carrying more weight and damage. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a conjuration and area effect.
cattle.tag: This is a conjuration and area effect.

chain.name: Linked Fates
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Enemies caught together in one of your area-of-effect abilities are bound with spectral chains for a short time. Damage dealt to one chained enemy is partly shared with every other enemy on the same chain.
Pulling one chained enemy drags the others toward it.
This is a binding and area effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and area effect.

chaotic.name: Loose Odds
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Every area ability you use rolls a random damage type and a random secondary effect, drawn from slow, stun, fear, burn, knockback and pull.
If an area ability rolls the same effect twice in a row, its size doubles for that cast.
This is an area and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is an area and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: Hollow Promise
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to show enemies the outline of an area ability that never resolves. Enemies who see it react as if it were real and move to escape.
While enemies are fleeing a false outline, your next real area ability placed elsewhere deals increased damage. Enemies of higher rank see through the false outline.
This is an area and illusion effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an area and illusion effect.

chicken.name: Brood Defiance
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When an ally near you falls below half health, you erupt in a flurry of beating wings and pecking strikes that hits every enemy near that ally and forces them back.
Enemies driven back are taunted onto you for a short time. This can happen once per ally per fight.
This is a protective and area effect.
chicken.tag: This is a protective and area effect.

chimera.name: Many Mouths
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When an area ability hits enemies of three or more different monster families, each family takes a different bonus effect. Beasts are rent, flyers are grounded, and serpents are crushed.
Enemies of a single family caught in the area take no bonus. The bonus effects follow each family's weakness.
This is an area and grafting effect.
chimera.tag: This is an area and grafting effect.

claw.name: Rending Storm
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend stamina to unleash a whirlwind of claw strikes around you, slashing every enemy within reach several times.
Each strike that lands on an enemy already bleeding deepens the bleed affliction instead of adding a new one.
Enemies at full bleed stacks are rent open, taking a burst of physical damage that ends the affliction.
This is a melee and area effect.
claw.tag: This is a melee and area effect.

cloth.name: Unspooled
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can throw out a sheet of conjured cloth that billows over a target area and settles. Enemies beneath it are blinded and their ranged attacks fail to leave it.
While the sheet holds, you can pull it taut to bind everything beneath together, or tear it away to leave them exposed to increased damage for a short time.
This is a conjuration and area effect.
cloth.tag: This is a conjuration and area effect.

cloud.name: Vapour Shroud
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave clouds that drift with your movement. Enemies inside a cloud lose sight of everything outside it.
You can condense a cloud into rain. Rain douses fire, extinguishes burning afflictions on allies and makes enemies inside vulnerable to lightning and cold damage.
This is a weather and area effect.
cloud.tag: This is a weather and area effect.

cold.name: Winter's Mouth
