cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Areas struck by your abilities hold a lingering chill. Enemies who remain inside the chill are slowed, then frozen solid once they have stood in it for long enough.
Frozen enemies take double damage from the next area effect to strike them, which shatters the ice.
This is a cold and area effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and area effect.

coral.name: Reef Growth
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities seed living coral where they land. The coral grows outward over a short time, cutting any enemy that moves through it.
Coral from separate abilities joins into a single reef. Allies standing on the reef recover health slowly, and enemies within it cannot dash or teleport.
This is a nature and area effect.
coral.tag: This is a nature and area effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Decay
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies caught in your area-of-effect abilities are corrupted for a short time. A corrupted enemy that dies releases a cloud of sweet rot that corrupts every enemy around it.
Corrupted enemies of lower rank than you are drawn toward each other, packing together where your next area effect can reach them all.
This is a corruption and area effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and area effect.

crocodile.name: Drowning Roll
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can mark an area of water, mud or swamp. Enemies that enter a marked area are seized and dragged under, rooted and suffocating for a short time.
An enemy that dies while seized is swallowed whole, restoring a portion of your health and stamina scaled to its rank.
This is a water and restraint effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

crystal.name: Prism Shatter
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities grow crystals on every enemy they strike. Each further area effect adds another layer.
You can spend mana to shatter every crystal at once. Each enemy takes damage for every layer it carries, and the shards strike enemies around it for a portion of that damage.
This is a crystal and area effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and area effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
After one of your area abilities ends, the ground it covered stays marked. When that ability's cooldown completes, the marked area resolves again at a portion of its strength without being cast.
Only the most recent area ability leaves a mark. The repeat does not leave a mark of its own.
This is an area and cycle effect.
cycle.tag: This is an area and cycle effect.

dance.name: Whirling Floor
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While you keep moving without stopping, you trail a spinning ring that strikes every enemy you pass near.
The ring widens with each full turn you make around a group of enemies, and those caught at its centre are dizzied and cannot attack in a straight line.
Stopping ends the ring.
This is a movement and area effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

dark.name: Swallowing Shade
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can open a pool of living shadow beneath a target area. Enemies inside it sink slowly and take dark damage over time, and light sources within it go out.
An enemy that dies inside the pool is devoured completely, leaving no corpse to be raised, looted by others or resurrected. Its loot passes to you.
This is a darkness and area effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and area effect.

dawn.name: Opened East
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities strip invisibility, stealth and illusions from everything inside them, and those enemies cannot become hidden again for a short time.
An enemy revealed this way takes increased damage from the next area ability that hits it. Light-sensitive and undead enemies are also blinded.
This is an area and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is an area and light effect.

death.name: Silent Field
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies that die inside your area-of-effect abilities leave behind a patch of stillness for a short time. No healing works within it, and anything that dies there cannot be raised.
Enemies below a quarter of their health that stand in stillness cannot cast spells.
This is a death and area effect.
death.tag: This is a death and area effect.

deep.name: Fathom Weight
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can bring the pressure of the deep sea down on a target area for a short time. Enemies inside are crushed by water damage over time and slowed heavily.
The pressure builds the longer it lasts. Enemies still inside when it ends are pinned to the ground and cannot move until they break free.
This is a water and area effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and area effect.

deer.name: Scattering Herd
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When an enemy closes to melee range of you, you can spring away in a burst that startles every enemy around your starting point, interrupting their attacks.
Each enemy startled this way is briefly unable to follow you, and its next attack misses if it targets you.
This can happen once every short interval.
This is a movement and area effect.
deer.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

desolate.name: Salted Ground
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Ground covered by your area abilities is left barren for a long time. Enemies inside barren ground cannot be healed, and summoned creatures and plant-based enemies wither while they stand in it.
Barren ground does not affect allies. It stops harvesting nodes inside it from yielding until it fades.
This is an area and desolation effect.
desolate.tag: This is an area and desolation effect.

dimension.name: Folded Arena
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can fold the space of a target area so that its edges meet. Enemies who leave one side reappear on the opposite side, and projectiles fired within it loop back through.
Area effects you cast inside the fold strike every enemy within it, wherever they stand.
The fold lasts for a short time and costs significant mana.
This is a space and area effect.
dimension.tag: This is a space and area effect.

discord.name: Grinding Chorus
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities sound a grinding dissonance. Enemies caught in them have their own abilities misfire, landing on their allies instead of their target, for a short time.
Groups of enemies of the same kind struck together turn on each other briefly. Enemies of higher rank resist.
This is a discord and area effect.
discord.tag: This is a discord and area effect.

discordant.name: Jarring Chord
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies caught together in one of your area abilities are set against each other for a short time. Their buffs, auras and shared effects stop applying to one another.
Enemies who were within the same area when it resolved deal increased damage to each other if they attack each other. Higher-rank enemies resist being set against each other.
This is an area and discord effect.
discordant.tag: This is an area and discord effect.

dog.name: Pack Circle
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities follow the lead of your allies. When an ally attacks an enemy, your next area effect centres on that enemy automatically if it is in range.
Allies standing inside your area effects are unharmed and gain attack speed for a short time.
This is a loyalty and area effect.
dog.tag: This is a loyalty and area effect.

doom.name: Counted Hour
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can pronounce an area instead of casting into it. After a long delay counted aloud in tolls, every enemy still inside the area takes heavy damage that cannot be reduced by resistances.
The area is visible to enemies throughout the delay. Pronouncing costs a large amount of mana and cannot be cancelled once begun.
This is an area and doom effect.
doom.tag: This is an area and doom effect.

doppelganger.name: Echoed Devouring
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When you use an area ability, you can spend additional mana to have a copy of yourself appear elsewhere in sight and cast the same ability at the same time.
The copy's area deals reduced damage. Enemies cannot tell which of you is real until the copy fades.
This is an area and duplication effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is an area and duplication effect.

dragon.name: Furnace Throat
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can convert any area ability into a cone of breath fired from your mouth. A breath cone deals fire damage in addition to its own, and leaves the ground burning.
Using breath this way heats you. While heated, you resist fire and your skin hardens against physical damage, but breath cannot be used again until you have cooled.
This is an area, fire and breath effect.
dragon.tag: This is an area, fire and breath effect.

duck.name: Calm Waters
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can create a still pond across a target area. You and your allies on it cannot be knocked back, stunned or feared.
Enemy area effects that land on the pond slide off it, losing most of their damage.
The pond lasts for a short time.
This is a water and protective effect.
duck.tag: This is a water and protective effect.

dust.name: Grey Settling
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities kick up a pall of dust that settles slowly. Enemies within it are blinded and their attacks have a chance to miss.
Enemies who remain in the pall until it settles are coated grey, revealing them to you through walls and invisibility until the coating is washed or burned off.
This is a dust and area effect.
dust.tag: This is a dust and area effect.

earth.name: Fault Line
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to crack the ground along a line. Jagged stone erupts along its length, inflicting physical damage and throwing enemies into the air.
The broken ground remains as rough terrain for a long time. Enemies crossing it are slowed, and you can trigger a second eruption along the same line at reduced cost.
This is an earth and area effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and area effect.

echo.name: Resounding Blast
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each of your area-of-effect abilities repeats once, a moment after it resolves, at a portion of its strength.
If the echo strikes an enemy that the original missed, the echo deals full damage to it instead.
This is a sound and area effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

eclipse.name: Swallowed Noon
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities can be cast as an eclipse, plunging the area into darkness for a short time. Enemies inside lose sight of everything beyond it, and their ranged attacks cannot leave it.
You and your allies see normally within the darkness. Enemies relying on light-based abilities cannot use them while inside.
This is an area and darkness effect.
eclipse.tag: This is an area and darkness effect.

edifice.name: Raised Ruin
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When your area abilities destroy walls, pillars or other structures, the rubble falls on the enemies beneath it for heavy damage, scaled to the size of what collapsed.
The rubble remains as cover. You can stand on it to cast area abilities from higher ground, extending their range.
This is an area and structure effect.
edifice.tag: This is an area and structure effect.

effigy.name: Burnt Double
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to set down an effigy of yourself. Enemy area attacks that would hit you while the effigy stands strike it instead.
When the effigy has absorbed enough damage, it burns, releasing everything it took as an area of fire around itself. Only one effigy can stand at a time.
This is an area and substitution effect.
effigy.tag: This is an area and substitution effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Cascade
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities take on a random element each time you cast them: fire, cold, lightning, water or earth.
When two abilities of different elements overlap, they combine into a reaction such as steam, a frozen tide or a magnetic storm, which inflicts both types of damage across the combined area.
This is an elemental and area effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and area effect.

elixir.name: Perfected Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can throw a potion so that it bursts across an area rather than being drunk. Allies within the area each receive the potion's full effect.
Thrown harmful potions and poisons strike every enemy within the area instead.
Throwing a potion this way shares its cooldown with drinking it.
This is an alchemical and area effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemical and area effect.

empower.name: Swelling Ring
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Allies standing inside your area abilities when they resolve are not harmed and gain a boon of increased damage instead, stacking once for each enemy also caught in the area.
The boon lasts a short time. The more enemies an area catches, the stronger the boon it grants.
This is an area and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is an area and empowerment effect.

eye.name: Gaze of the Eye
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can open a vast eye in the sky over a target area for a short time. Every enemy beneath it is revealed, cannot become invisible, and has its weaknesses shown on the map.
Enemies that look up at the eye, or attack while it is open, take radiant damage each time.
This is a perception and area effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and area effect.

feast.name: Devouring Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each enemy killed by your area-of-effect abilities is consumed, granting you a stack of satiation. Each stack increases your maximum health slightly until you rest.
At full stacks, you can spend them all to host a feast. Allies around you are healed and cleansed of one affliction each.
This is a consumption and area effect.
feast.tag: This is a consumption and area effect.

feeble.name: Sapping Field
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies inside your area-of-effect abilities are weakened for a short time, dealing reduced damage.
The strength stolen this way gathers around you. While three or more enemies are weakened by you, your own damage and stamina recovery increase.
This is a weakening and area effect.
feeble.tag: This is a weakening and area effect.

fertile.name: Seedburst
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies killed by your area abilities burst into fast-growing thorn thickets. A thicket slows and wounds enemies that pass through it, and heals allies who rest inside it.
Thickets wither after a short time. Corpses of higher-rank enemies grow larger thickets.
This is an area and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is an area and growth effect.

fey.name: Fairy Ring
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities leave a ring of mushrooms around their edge. An enemy that crosses the ring in either direction is beguiled, wandering aimlessly for a short time.
Damage breaks the beguilement. Rings cannot overlap; a new one replaces the oldest.
This is an area and enchantment effect.
fey.tag: This is an area and enchantment effect.

fire.name: Annihilating Flame
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your fire area-of-effect abilities burn away whatever they consume. Corpses, conjurations, barriers and dropped enemy items within the flames are destroyed.
Enemies who die in the flames burn to ash and explode, inflicting fire damage around them.
Once per day you can loose a sea of flame across a wide area, recovering over 24 hours.
This is a fire and annihilation effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and annihilation effect.

firebird.name: Ash Rekindled
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Areas where your fire damage killed an enemy leave a bed of ash. You can spend mana to rekindle all ash beds at once, each one erupting as a smaller version of the ability that made it.
Rekindling consumes the ash. Ash beds you stand in heal you slowly over time.
This is an area, fire and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is an area, fire and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Shoal Surge
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can conjure a shoal of silver fish that sweeps in a broad curve through the air across a target area, striking every enemy it passes.
The shoal turns to follow the direction you move, sweeping back across the same area if you turn back.
This is a conjuration and area effect.
fish.tag: This is a conjuration and area effect.

flea.name: Flea Bite
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can leap from enemy to enemy across a group, striking each as you land on it. Each landing inflicts a small bite and an itching affliction that slows the target's attacks.
The leaps chain until you run out of stamina or no enemy within reach remains unbitten.
This is a movement and area effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

flesh.name: Flesh Tide
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Corpses inside your area-of-effect abilities melt into a slick of living meat that spreads across the area. Enemies standing in it are grasped and slowed.
You can draw the slick into yourself to restore health scaled to the number of corpses it holds.
This is a flesh and area effect.
flesh.tag: This is a flesh and area effect.

foot.name: Long March
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each step you take in combat leaves a tremor. Enemies within a short distance of your path take physical damage when your footprint fades.
The tremors deepen with distance travelled. After a long uninterrupted march, your next stop releases them all as a single quake.
This is a movement and area effect.
foot.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

force.name: Flattening Wave
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities push every enemy they hit outward from the centre. Enemies driven into walls, obstacles or each other take additional force damage and are stunned briefly.
Heavier and higher-rank enemies are pushed shorter distances. The push can be inverted to pull inward by spending stamina.
This is an area and force effect.
force.tag: This is an area and force effect.

forge.name: Struck Twice
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies hit by two area abilities in quick succession are tempered, losing a portion of their armour for the rest of the fight.
Weapons and armour dropped by enemies killed while tempered come out of the fight with a higher quality roll.
This is an area and tempering effect.
forge.tag: This is an area and tempering effect.

fork.name: Branching Point
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your single-target attacks branch when they strike, forking to two additional enemies near the target at reduced damage.
Each fork can branch once more if it strikes an enemy carrying one of your afflictions.
This is a branching and area effect.
fork.tag: This is a branching and area effect.

fortress.name: Curtain of Arrows
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

While you stand still, your area abilities resolve as a ring around you rather than at a target point. Enemies inside the ring take its effect, and the ring blocks enemy projectiles for a short time after.
Moving collapses the ring. Ring areas cannot be used while you are rooted by an enemy effect.
This is an area and fortification effect.
fortress.tag: This is an area and fortification effect.

fox.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to light a dancing foxfire that lures enemies toward it. Enemies of lower rank follow it wherever it moves.
When the foxfire is dispelled or the duration ends, it bursts in a ring of fire that strikes every enemy it has gathered.
Only one foxfire can exist at a time.
This is an illusion and area effect.
fox.tag: This is an illusion and area effect.

frog.name: Spring Tongue
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can lash out a long tongue that sweeps across a wide arc, snatching up every small object and lower-rank enemy it touches and pulling them to you.
Enemies pulled this way land stunned at your feet. If you leap immediately afterward, your landing strikes all of them together.
This is a restraint and area effect.
frog.tag: This is a restraint and area effect.

fungus.name: Spore Bloom
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies struck by your area-of-effect abilities are seeded with spores. A seeded enemy that dies bursts into a fungal bloom that seeds every enemy around it.
Blooms remain where they burst for a long time. Enemies that walk into one are seeded again, and allies who stand in one recover stamina.
This is a fungal and area effect.
fungus.tag: This is a fungal and area effect.

garuda.name: Stooping Sun
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When you leap or fall from height, you can land as an area ability, scattering enemies outward from the point of impact and dealing damage scaled to the height fallen.
Serpent-family enemies caught in the landing are seized and pinned for a short time. Landing this way costs stamina.
This is an area, flight and impact effect.
garuda.tag: This is an area, flight and impact effect.

gate.name: Far Door
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can open a portal at any point in sight and cast an area ability through it, so that the ability resolves at the portal rather than in front of you.
Enemies inside an area cast through a portal can be pulled through to the portal's far side, beside you. Opening a portal costs mana scaled to its distance.
This is an area and space effect.
gate.tag: This is an area and space effect.

gathering.name: Gathered In
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Before an area-of-effect ability resolves, you can spend additional mana to draw every enemy within twice its radius toward its centre.
Enemies drawn in collide with one another, taking physical damage scaled to how many of them were gathered.
This is a space and area effect.
gathering.tag: This is a space and area effect.

glass.name: Shattered Pane
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can raise a pane of glass across a target area. Enemy spells and projectiles that strike it are reflected back the way they came.
When the pane breaks, it shatters into shards that inflict bleed afflictions on every enemy around it. You can break it yourself at any time.
This is a glass and area effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass and area effect.

glimeron.name: Prism Burst
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities split into several smaller areas when they strike a reflective surface, crystal or water, each child area travelling outward along a refracted angle.
Child areas deal reduced damage but blind enemies they hit. Splitting can only happen once per ability.
This is an area and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is an area and refraction effect.

goat.name: Mountain Charge
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend stamina to charge headlong, butting aside every enemy in your path.
Enemies struck by the charge are knocked off ledges, cliffs and walls when there is one behind them, falling and taking damage based on the height.
You cannot be knocked back or slowed while charging.
This is a movement and area effect.
goat.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

gorgon.name: Petrifying Glare
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies facing you when one of your area abilities resolves are slowed more the longer they keep looking at you. If they hold your gaze long enough, they are turned to stone for a short time.
Petrified enemies take heavily increased damage from blunt attacks and shatter if killed. Higher-rank enemies resist petrification.
This is an area, gaze and petrification effect.
gorgon.tag: This is an area, gaze and petrification effect.

griffin.name: Height of the Hunt
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities cast from elevated ground grow larger and deal increased damage, scaling with the height difference between you and the area.
Enemies trying to climb or fly toward you after being hit from above are slowed. Using area abilities from below you suffers no penalty.
This is an area and elevation effect.
griffin.tag: This is an area and elevation effect.

growth.name: Strangling Bloom
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave behind a seed that grows over a short time. While it grows, its area expands steadily outward.
When fully grown, it bursts into thorny vines that root every enemy within its final area.
Seeds can be fed with water or healing effects to grow faster.
This is a growth and area effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

guardian.name: Barred Way
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can place your area abilities between yourself and a chosen ally. Enemies inside the area are forced to target you rather than that ally.
While an area placed this way persists, the ally takes reduced damage. Only one ally can be warded at a time.
This is an area and protection effect.
guardian.tag: This is an area and protection effect.

hair.name: Ten Thousand Strands
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast out a net of countless fine strands across a target area. Enemies caught in it are tangled and slowed, and their movements tighten the strands.
You can pull the net closed, drawing all tangled enemies together. Enemies who struggled hardest take the most damage when it closes.
This is a binding and area effect.
hair.tag: This is a binding and area effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Fall
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can bring a conjured anvil down on a target area. Enemies beneath it are flattened, taking heavy physical damage and being stunned.
Weapons, shields and armour worn by enemies caught beneath it lose durability, and conjured barriers in the area are broken outright.
This is a conjuration and area effect.
hammer.tag: This is a conjuration and area effect.

hand.name: Grasping Field
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities raise grasping hands from the ground. Each hand seizes one enemy and holds it in place.
Enemies held by hands cannot use items, drink potions or swap weapons until they break free. Struggling costs them stamina.
This is a restraint and area effect.
hand.tag: This is a restraint and area effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Collapse
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies of the same kind struck together by your area-of-effect abilities begin to resonate. Each further area effect that strikes them raises the resonance.
At full resonance, they shake apart, taking heavy damage. The more of them resonating together, the greater the damage each takes.
This is a resonance and area effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and area effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Wind
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities carry a foul shriek. Enemies inside cannot cast spells for a moment, and those already casting are interrupted.
Items enemies are using, such as potions and consumables, are knocked loose and snatched into your inventory. Higher-rank enemies keep their grip.
This is an area and sound effect.
harpy.tag: This is an area and sound effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities reap everything harvestable inside them, including crafting nodes, herbs and the loot of enemies they kill, gathering it directly into your inventory.
Nodes reaped this way yield less than when harvested by hand, but take no time. Reaping costs no additional mana.
This is an area and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is an area and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Thundering Herd
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While mounted or moving at full speed, you trail a cloud of churned ground. Enemies caught in it are trampled, taking physical damage and losing stamina.
The trail lengthens the longer you keep moving without stopping, and does not tire you.
This is a movement and area effect.
heidel.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

hook.name: Barbed Reel
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can hurl a spray of barbed hooks across a target area. Each enemy struck is snagged on a line back to you.
You can reel all snagged enemies in at once, dragging them through anything between you and them, or tear the hooks free, inflicting a bleed affliction on each.
This is a hooking and area effect.
hook.tag: This is a hooking and area effect.

horse.name: Cavalry Sweep
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day you can summon a spectral cavalry line that charges across the battlefield in the direction you choose, striking every enemy in its path.
Enemies struck by the charge are knocked aside and scattered, breaking any formation they held. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a conjuration and area effect.
horse.tag: This is a conjuration and area effect.

hunger.name: The Empty Maw
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can open a ravenous maw over a target area for a short time. It drains health from every enemy within it and feeds it to you.
The maw grows as it feeds. If it fails to drain anything for a moment, it closes and costs you a portion of your own health.
This is a hunger and area effect.
hunger.tag: This is a hunger and area effect.

hunt.name: Closing Net of the Hunt
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can mark a single enemy as quarry. Every area-of-effect ability you cast while the quarry lives centres on it if it is in range, and deals bonus damage to it.
Enemies standing near your quarry when it falls are each marked as new quarry, one after another.
This is a hunting and area effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and area effect.

hydra.name: Severed and Doubled
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each time one of your area abilities is interrupted, blocked or dodged entirely, you gain a stack of regrowth. Your next area ability resolves once more at the same spot for each stack.
Stacks are spent when an area ability next resolves. Each repeat after the first deals reduced damage.
This is an area and regeneration effect.
hydra.tag: This is an area and regeneration effect.

ice.name: Frost Spires
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities raise spires of ice where they land. Spires block movement and line of sight for enemies.
You can shatter all of your spires at once, spraying ice shards outward. Enemies near a shattered spire take cold damage and are slowed.
This is a cold and area effect.
ice.tag: This is a cold and area effect.

immortal.name: Unending Hunger
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Damage dealt by your area abilities heals you for a small portion of the damage done. Healing beyond your maximum health is stored as a shell that absorbs the next lethal blow.
Only one shell can be stored at a time. It fades if you leave combat.
This is an area and persistence effect.
immortal.tag: This is an area and persistence effect.

iron.name: Iron Rain
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can call down a rain of cold iron spikes across a target area. Enemies struck take physical damage, and fey, spirits and magical beings take additional damage.
Spikes remain in the ground for a short time. Magical enemies cannot teleport or phase while standing among them.
This is an iron and area effect.
iron.tag: This is an iron and area effect.

juggernaut.name: Crushing Track
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While you are moving in a straight line, your area abilities are cast along your path instead of at a target point, flattening every enemy in a lane ahead of you.
The longer you have been moving in the same direction, the longer the lane. Turning sharply resets it.
This is an area and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is an area and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Settled Account
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Every point of damage enemy area attacks deal to you and your allies is recorded. You can spend mana to release the record as an area of its own, centred on whoever dealt the most of it.
Releasing the record clears it. The record cannot exceed your maximum health.
This is an area and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is an area and retribution effect.

knife.name: Knives in the Dark
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend stamina to fling a fan of hidden blades in every direction around you. Enemies unaware of you take critical damage from them.
Blades that miss remain on the ground as traps, inflicting a bleed affliction on the next enemy to step on each.
This is a blade and area effect.
knife.tag: This is a blade and area effect.

knowledge.name: Burning Library
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each enemy struck by your area-of-effect abilities is studied. When it dies, you learn its resistances and weaknesses for every enemy of its kind.
Area effects deal increased damage to every kind of enemy you have studied, and you can see their health from across the map.
This is a knowledge and area effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and area effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities sprout tentacles from the ground that seize the enemy closest to the centre and drag it below the surface for a short time.
A dragged enemy cannot act and takes crushing damage over time. If the area overlaps water, every enemy inside is seized instead of one.
This is an area and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is an area and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Wake of the Deep
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities send a wave rolling outward from where they land, displacing enemies and extinguishing fires as it passes.
In water, the wave grows several times larger and swallows lower-rank enemies whole, removing them from the fight for a short time.
This is an area, water and displacement effect.
leviathan.tag: This is an area, water and displacement effect.

life.name: Overflowing Life
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Healing you receive beyond your maximum health is stored. When the store is full, it bursts outward, healing every ally around you.
Undead and corrupted enemies caught in the burst take radiant damage equal to the healing it carries.
This is a life and area effect.
life.tag: This is a life and area effect.

light.name: Noonfall
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend mana to flood a target area with blinding light. Enemies inside are blinded, shadows within it vanish, and invisible enemies are revealed.
Shadow, dark and undead enemies inside the light take radiant damage for as long as they remain in it.
This is a light and area effect.
light.tag: This is a light and area effect.

lightning.name: Storm Lattice
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies struck by your area-of-effect abilities become charged for a short time. Lightning arcs between any two charged enemies close together, striking both.
A charged enemy standing in water conducts the charge to every enemy in the same water.
This is a lightning and area effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and area effect.

lizard.name: Basking Stillness
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While you stand still, heat gathers in you. After a short time without moving, your next area-of-effect ability is doubled in radius and damage.
Moving before the ability is used releases the heat harmlessly.
This is a stillness and area effect.
lizard.tag: This is a stillness and area effect.

locust.name: Devouring Cloud
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Once per day you can release a cloud of locusts that moves across the map in a direction you choose. It strips every crop, plant and food item in its path and eats away at the health of every enemy it passes over.
The cloud grows larger for every enemy it kills. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a swarm and annihilation effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and annihilation effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Allies standing inside your area abilities when they resolve are cleansed of one affliction each, and the afflictions removed are added to every enemy in the same area.
If nothing is cleansed, the area grows a bloom at its centre that heals allies standing on it for a short time.
This is an area, cleanse and healing effect.
lotus.tag: This is an area, cleanse and healing effect.

lurker.name: Watcher Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can hide a waiting maw beneath a target area. It is invisible and lies dormant until enemies gather above it.
When enough enemies stand over it, it erupts, inflicting heavy damage and dragging the weakest of them under. Only one maw can wait at a time.
This is a trap and area effect.
lurker.tag: This is a trap and area effect.

magic.name: Unravelling Gaze
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities consume enemy conjurations, wards, barriers and magical boons inside them, removing them before damage is dealt.
For each magical effect consumed this way, you recover a portion of the ability's mana cost.
This is an annihilation and dispel effect.
magic.tag: This is an annihilation and dispel effect.

malign.name: Spite Bloom
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies who survive one of your area-of-effect abilities carry a mark of spite for a short time. When a marked enemy damages you or an ally, the mark bursts, dealing damage to every enemy around it.
An enemy can carry only one mark at a time. Bursting marks cannot trigger other marks.
This is a curse and area effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and area effect.

manatee.name: Slow Tide
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend extra mana to cast an area-of-effect ability as a slow tide. Its area drifts in the direction you face, at walking pace, for a short time, damaging everything it passes over.
While a tide is drifting, you and allies inside it take reduced damage.
This is a water and area effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and area effect.

manticore.name: Quill Storm
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities loose a ring of venomous quills outward from their edge. Quills transfix the first enemy each hits, applying a stacking poison and slowing it.
Enemies fleeing an area ability are struck by more quills than those standing still. Higher-rank enemies shrug off the slow.
This is an area, poison and projectile effect.
manticore.tag: This is an area, poison and projectile effect.

master.name: Earned Precision
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities never harm allies, summons or neutral creatures inside them.
Each enemy hit by an area ability while standing at its exact centre takes a critical hit. You can shrink an area to half its size before it resolves to make it deal significantly more damage.
This is an area and mastery effect.
master.tag: This is an area and mastery effect.

might.name: Crushing Weight of Sky
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities press down on everything inside them. Enemies caught are knocked prone if they are of equal or lower rank, and lose stamina if they are of higher rank.
Enemies knocked prone take increased damage from your next area-of-effect ability.
This is a force and area effect.
might.tag: This is a force and area effect.

ministration.name: Tending Ground
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each enemy struck by one of your area abilities seals a wound on an ally standing within it, healing them for a portion of the damage dealt.
Allies with catastrophic wounding effects are treated first. Healing from a single area cannot exceed one ally's maximum health.
This is an area and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is an area and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Charge
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities raise low walls of earth along their edges, turning the area into a maze for a short time. Enemies inside can only leave by finding the gap.
You can charge through the maze walls freely, goring enemies you pass. Higher-rank enemies can break the walls.
This is an area, terrain and charge effect.
minotaur.tag: This is an area, terrain and charge effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Field
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Areas covered by your area abilities shimmer with heat-haze for a short time. Enemies inside misjudge distance, and their attacks have a chance to land beside their target rather than on it.
You can see through the haze. Enemies outside it cannot see what is inside clearly.
This is an area and illusion effect.
mirage.tag: This is an area and illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

When an enemy uses an area-of-effect ability that reaches you, you can spend mana within a brief window to reflect its shape. A copy of their area forms around them, dealing your damage type to everything inside.
This can trigger once per enemy per fight.
This is a reflection and area effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and area effect.

monkey.name: Pickpocket's Sweep
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities snatch one boon from each enemy they strike and place it on you or the nearest ally for its remaining duration.
Loot, coins and dropped items inside the area are drawn to your feet when it resolves.
This is a theft and area effect.
monkey.tag: This is a theft and area effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can raise a monolith at the centre of an area ability. The monolith casts a long shadow, and enemies standing in the shadow take the area's effect again at intervals for as long as it stands.
Allies in the shadow resist fear. Only one monolith stands at a time, and enemies can destroy it.
This is an area and monument effect.
monolith.tag: This is an area and monument effect.

moon.name: Tide-Pull Eclipse
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Before one of your area-of-effect abilities resolves, everything around its edge is pulled toward the centre, as a tide is drawn by the moon.
At night, or in darkness, the area is larger and enemies at its centre are briefly blinded.
This is a lunar and area effect.
moon.tag: This is a lunar and area effect.

mouse.name: Gnawed Edges
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave unseen gnawing at the edges of their area for a short time. Enemies who step across the edge take damage and have their armour reduced.
Enemies do not see the gnawed edge unless they have aura sense of a higher rank than yours.
This is a stealth and area effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and area effect.

myriad.name: Countless Openings
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When you cast an area-of-effect ability, smaller echoes of it open at random points around the main area, each dealing a portion of its damage.
More echoes open the more enemies the main area strikes. Echoes cannot overlap one another.
This is a space and area effect.
myriad.tag: This is a space and area effect.

mystic.name: Inner Sight
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast area abilities on places you cannot see but can sense with aura sense, including behind walls and through closed doors.
An area cast blind this way reveals everything it hits to you and your allies for a short time. Casting blind costs additional mana.
This is an area and perception effect.
mystic.tag: This is an area and perception effect.

nebula.name: Coalescing Cloud
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area ability as a diffuse cloud, spreading it over a much wider space at a fraction of its strength.
Over time, the cloud drifts inward and coalesces at its centre, its full strength resolving at once on whatever is left standing there. Enemies inside the cloud are chilled and slowed.
This is an area and cosmic effect.
nebula.tag: This is an area and cosmic effect.

needle.name: Pinprick Constellation
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

You can cast an area-of-effect ability as a scatter of needle-fine points instead of a single area. Each point strikes one enemy for concentrated damage that ignores a portion of its damage reduction.
The number of points matches the number of enemies inside the area. Points never strike the same enemy twice.
This is a precision and area effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and area effect.

nemesis.name: Marked for the Eye
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can mark a single enemy as your nemesis. Every area ability you use, wherever it is aimed, also resolves around the nemesis.
The mark lasts until the nemesis dies or leaves your aura-sense range. Marking a new nemesis costs a large amount of mana.
This is an area and pursuit effect.
nemesis.tag: This is an area and pursuit effect.

net.name: Drawstring Ruin
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave a mesh across their area. Enemies inside it cannot leave by movement abilities and are slowed.
You can spend mana to draw the mesh closed, dragging every enemy caught in it to the centre and dealing damage based on how far they were dragged.
This is a restraint and area effect.
net.tag: This is a restraint and area effect.

network.name: Relay Points
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each ally in your party serves as a relay point. You can cast an area ability centred on any ally you can sense, regardless of range.
Allies chosen as relay points are unharmed by the area. An ally can serve as a relay only once every short interval.
This is an area and communication effect.
network.tag: This is an area and communication effect.

oasis.name: Spring in the Waste
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When your area ability kills an enemy, a cool spring wells up at the centre of the area. Allies standing in the spring recover health and mana over time.
The spring dries up after a short time. In deserts and desolate ground, it lasts significantly longer.
This is an area and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is an area and restoration effect.

ocean.name: High Tide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each area ability you use in a fight raises the tide, adding a layer of water to every area you have already cast. Enemies standing in risen water are slowed more with each layer.
At high tide, the water recedes all at once, dragging every enemy in it toward the deepest point. The tide resets when the fight ends.
This is an area and tide effect.
ocean.tag: This is an area and tide effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Armed Grasp
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities sprout up to eight grasping arms from their edge. Each arm seizes the nearest enemy outside the area and drags it in before the area resolves.
Arms cannot seize enemies of a higher rank than yours. A seized enemy is released when the area resolves.
This is a grappling and area effect.
octopus.tag: This is a grappling and area effect.

omen.name: Foreseen Ruin
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can place an omen on the ground instead of casting an area-of-effect ability immediately. The omen shows only to you and resolves as the full ability after a delay.
Enemies standing in an omen when it resolves take significantly increased damage and are stunned briefly. You can hold up to two omens at once.
This is a prophecy and area effect.
omen.tag: This is a prophecy and area effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each time you hit an enemy with an area ability, the cooldown of your other area abilities shortens slightly.
If you use area abilities one after another without a gap, each consecutive one deals increased damage. Missing all enemies with one breaks the rhythm.
This is an area and onslaught effect.
onslaught.tag: This is an area and onslaught effect.

pangolin.name: Rolled Fortress
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While you channel or cast an area-of-effect ability centred on yourself, you curl behind overlapping scales, taking significantly reduced damage from every direction.
Enemies who strike you during that time take damage as scales splinter off, and the splinters scatter across your area.
This is a guard and area effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a guard and area effect.

paper.name: Written Erasure
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can inscribe an area-of-effect ability onto a sheet of paper from your inventory. The page can be thrown later to release the ability at the full strength it had when written.
You can carry a number of inscribed pages that scales with rank. Pages are destroyed if your inventory is emptied by death.
This is an inscription and area effect.
paper.tag: This is an inscription and area effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Crowded Nightmare
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities fill with phantom figures for a short time. Enemies inside waste their attacks on the phantoms and are frightened when a phantom is struck.
Each phantom that is attacked bursts into a smaller version of the area. Higher-rank enemies can tell the phantoms apart.
This is an area and nightmare effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an area and nightmare effect.

phoenix.name: Pyre of Return
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day, a lethal blow consumes you in fire. You burn as a vast area of flame, then rise from the ashes at its centre with a portion of your health.
Everything inside the area takes fire damage, and allies inside it are cleansed of afflictions. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an area, fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is an area, fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Rootbound Feeding
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave roots in the ground across their area. Enemies who stand on rooted ground are held in place for a moment, once each.
When the roots fade, they drain a portion of the damage they took part in from each enemy still inside and return it to you as health.
This is a plant and area effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and area effect.

potent.name: Pinhead Sun
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

You can compress an area-of-effect ability down to a fraction of its size. The compressed version deals its full damage to everything inside its smaller area, multiplied by how much it was compressed.
Compressing costs additional mana, and the ability's cooldown lengthens with the compression.
This is a concentration and area effect.
potent.tag: This is a concentration and area effect.

predatory.name: Cut From the Herd
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When your area abilities hit a group of enemies, the weakest among them is separated, knocked away from the others and marked.
The marked enemy takes increased damage from you and cannot benefit from its allies' auras or healing while marked.
This is an area and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is an area and hunting effect.

prison.name: Walled Yard
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
The edges of your area abilities become barred walls for a short time. Enemies inside cannot leave and enemies outside cannot enter.
Enemies held inside take the area's effect a second time when the walls close. Higher-rank enemies can break out by spending stamina.
This is an area and confinement effect.
prison.tag: This is an area and confinement effect.

prosperity.name: Golden Ruin
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can spend coin instead of mana on area abilities. Abilities paid for with coin grow larger the more coin you spend on them.
Enemies killed by a coin-paid area ability drop a portion of the spent coin back, scattered across the ground.
This is an area and wealth effect.
prosperity.tag: This is an area and wealth effect.

pure.name: Clean Absence
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities cleanse every affliction on allies inside them, consuming each affliction and converting it to damage dealt to the enemy that applied it.
Enemies inside the area cannot gain new boons until the area fades.
This is a purification and area effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and area effect.

rabbit.name: Warren Burst
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Immediately after casting an area-of-effect ability, you can bolt to any point on its edge at no cost.
If you bolt, the area bursts a second time from where you land, dealing a portion of its damage in a smaller radius.
This is a movement and area effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

rake.name: Clean Sweep
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area-of-effect ability as a sweeping line drawn toward you instead of a circle. Enemies, loot and corpses inside it are raked to your feet.
Corpses gathered this way can be consumed for a brief boon of increased damage, one per corpse, stacking.
This is a gathering and area effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and area effect.

rat.name: Rat King's Tithe
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies killed by your area-of-effect abilities leave behind a swarm of rats that gnaw at nearby enemies for a short time, dealing damage over time.
Swarms join together when they meet, growing larger and more damaging. Swarms disperse when no enemies are near them.
This is a swarm and area effect.
rat.tag: This is a swarm and area effect.

reagent.name: Dissolving Pool
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave behind a reactive pool. Throwing a potion into the pool spreads its effect across the whole pool, applying to every ally standing in it.
Harmful potions and bombs thrown into the pool affect every enemy in it instead.
This is an alchemy and area effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and area effect.

refracting.name: Bent Ruin
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When an enemy area attack would hit you, you can spend mana to bend it, moving its whole area a short distance in the direction of your choice.
An enemy area attack bent onto enemies hits them instead. This can only be used once every short interval.
This is an area and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is an area and deflection effect.

renewal.name: Season's End
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Ground struck by your area-of-effect abilities withers for a short time. When the withering ends, the ground blooms again, healing allies standing on it for a portion of the damage the area dealt.
An enemy killed on withered ground heals allies in the area immediately.
This is a cycle and area effect.
renewal.tag: This is a cycle and area effect.

resolute.name: Unmoved Centre
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While you stand still, your area-of-effect abilities grow larger for every second you have not moved, up to a limit.
Casting one while planted also makes you immune to knockback, pulls and forced movement until you next move.
This is a stance and area effect.
resolute.tag: This is a stance and area effect.

resonating.name: Building Hum
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies hit by your area abilities begin to vibrate. Each further area ability that hits a vibrating enemy builds the hum louder, dealing increasing sonic damage over time.
When the hum peaks, the enemy shakes apart, damaging everything near it. Vibrating enemies spread a little of their hum to enemies they touch.
This is an area and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is an area and resonance effect.

roc.name: Shadow Before
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
A vast shadow sweeps over the ground before each of your area abilities lands. Enemies under the shadow are frightened and try to flee the area.
Enemies that stay in the shadow when the area resolves are carried off into the air and dropped for falling damage. Higher-rank enemies resist both effects.
This is an area, flight and fear effect.
roc.tag: This is an area, flight and fear effect.

rune.name: Graven Circle
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave their outline graven into the ground as a rune circle for a short time.
Casting a different area-of-effect ability inside a rune circle combines the two, adding the first ability's damage type and effects to the second. A circle is consumed when combined.
This is a rune and area effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and area effect.

sacrifice.name: Opened Vein
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can pay for area abilities with health instead of mana. An area ability paid for with health deals significantly increased damage and cannot be resisted by enemies of your rank or lower.
You cannot pay with health if it would leave you below a portion of your maximum. Health spent this way cannot be healed for a short time.
This is an area and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is an area and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Grind
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave grinding sand across their area. Every second an enemy stands in it, it loses a sliver of armour, and the loss lingers after it leaves.
The sand drifts with the wind and spreads slowly outward until it fades.
This is an earth and area effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and area effect.

sceptre.name: Royal Decree
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can declare an area as forbidden ground by striking it with a weapon and spending mana. Enemies of lower rank that enter it kneel briefly, unable to act.
Area-of-effect abilities cast into forbidden ground deal increased damage. Only one forbidden area can exist at a time.
This is an authority and area effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and area effect.

scribe.name: Fixed Record
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can record the exact shape, size and position of an area ability as it resolves. Later in the same fight, you can recast it from the record without mana or line of sight.
Only one record can be held at a time, and it is lost when the fight ends. Recasting from a record places that ability on cooldown.
This is an area and record effect.
scribe.tag: This is an area and record effect.

serene.name: Stilled Surface
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities still everything inside them for a moment: projectiles in flight stop and fall, channelled enemy abilities are interrupted, and enemies cannot dodge.
The stillness does not affect you or your allies. Enemies that have been stilled resist further stillness for a short time.
This is a calm and area effect.
serene.tag: This is a calm and area effect.

serpent.name: Tightening Coil
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities can be held after casting, shrinking slowly inward over a short time. Enemies inside take constricting damage that grows as the area tightens.
Releasing the hold resolves the ability at its current size with a venomous strike to every enemy still inside.
This is an area, constriction and poison effect.
serpent.tag: This is an area, constriction and poison effect.

shark.name: Bloodscent Circling
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Wounded enemies inside your area-of-effect abilities leave blood in the area. Your next area-of-effect ability cast on that spot deals increased damage for each wounded enemy that bled there.
Enemies below half health cannot escape the area with movement abilities while it lasts.
This is a predation and area effect.
shark.tag: This is a predation and area effect.

shield.name: Bulwark Bloom
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each ally inside one of your area-of-effect abilities when it resolves gains a shield that absorbs damage, scaled by the number of enemies the area struck.
An ally's shield breaking deals damage to every enemy around them.
This is a shield and area effect.
