shield.tag: This is a shield and area effect.

shimmer.name: Mirage Field
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area-of-effect ability in shimmering silence. Enemies see a false area at a point you choose, while the real one lands where you aimed.
Enemies who dodge toward the false area take increased damage from the real one.
This is an illusion and area effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and area effect.

ship.name: Broadside
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While moving, you can cast an area-of-effect ability as a broadside: it fires in two areas to your left and right instead of one in front.
Each side deals a portion of the full damage. Enemies struck by both sides are knocked back.
This is a movement and area effect.
ship.tag: This is a movement and area effect.

shovel.name: Excavated Ground
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities hollow out the ground they strike, leaving a pit for a short time. Enemies inside the pit cannot leave it without a movement ability and are exposed to ranged attacks.
Ores and buried items in the pit's area are uncovered and can be looted.
This is an earth and area effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and area effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Arc
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area-of-effect ability as a crescent sweeping out from you. Enemies below a portion of their health inside the crescent are cut down outright, if they are of lower rank than you.
Each enemy cut down this way shortens the ability's cooldown.
This is an execution and area effect.
sickle.tag: This is an execution and area effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Ruin
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When you use an area ability, you can leave a crude likeness of yourself at your position. Enemies continue to target the likeness for a short time while you move freely.
When the likeness is destroyed, it collapses into a smaller copy of the last area ability you used. Only one likeness can exist at a time.
This is an area and imitation effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is an area and imitation effect.

sin.name: Cherished Ruin
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Enemies struck by your area-of-effect abilities are marked with their worst deed. A marked enemy takes increased damage from you for each ally of theirs it abandons by fleeing or each innocent it has harmed.
Marked enemies that kill a townsperson or ally are consumed in fire where they stand.
This is a judgement and area effect.
sin.tag: This is a judgement and area effect.

skirmish.name: Parting Shot
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When you use a movement ability to disengage, you can leave an area ability behind at the point you left. It resolves as enemies chase you into it.
Area abilities left this way cost reduced mana. Enemies hit by one are slowed, widening the gap you made.
This is an area and skirmish effect.
skirmish.tag: This is an area and skirmish effect.

skunk.name: Clinging Stench
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies struck by your area-of-effect abilities carry a lingering stench. Other enemies avoid standing near them, breaking up packs and formations.
Stenched enemies cannot hide, turn invisible or benefit from stealth until the stench fades.
This is a repulsion and area effect.
skunk.tag: This is a repulsion and area effect.

sky.name: Open Ceiling
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Outdoors, your area abilities can be cast from the open sky, falling on any point you can see regardless of range or obstacles between.
Indoors, underground or under a roof, this effect does not function. Areas falling from the sky reach the ground a moment later than normal.
This is an area and sky effect.
sky.tag: This is an area and sky effect.

sloth.name: Lazy Annihilation
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area-of-effect ability slowly, taking much longer to resolve. A slow-cast area grows steadily the whole time and deals significantly increased damage when it finally lands.
Enemies inside a slow-cast area are slowed in turn for as long as it is forming.
This is a patience and area effect.
sloth.tag: This is a patience and area effect.

smoke.name: Smoke-Eaten
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities fill their area with smoke for a short time. Enemies inside lose sight of you and their attacks miss more often.
You can step into your own smoke to vanish from enemy targeting, emerging from any other smoke you have made.
This is a smoke and area effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and area effect.

snake.name: Shedding Venom
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave a shed skin of venom on the ground. Any enemy that touches it is poisoned, and the poison deals more damage the longer the enemy stays still.
Killing a poisoned enemy with another area-of-effect ability spills its venom into a new skin where it died.
This is a poison and area effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and area effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Column
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities leave a rising column of hot air at their centre for a short time. Allies who step into it are lifted and glide out of the area in a direction of their choice.
Enemies caught in the column are lifted helplessly and fall when it ends, taking falling damage.
This is an area and air effect.
soaring.tag: This is an area and air effect.

song.name: Crescendo
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each area-of-effect ability you cast in a fight adds a beat. Each beat makes your next area-of-effect ability larger.
At the fourth beat, the next area-of-effect ability resolves twice, the second time as a resonant echo. The beats then reset.
This is a sound and area effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

sovereign.name: Decree of Ruin
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can decree an area forbidden. Lower-rank enemies will not enter a forbidden area of their own will, and those already inside must leave or take damage over time.
Only one decree can stand at a time. Enemies of your rank or higher ignore it.
This is an area and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is an area and authority effect.

spear.name: Falling Volley
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area-of-effect ability as a volley of spears falling across the area over a short time. Each spear pins the enemy it strikes in place briefly.
Spears that miss stay in the ground and can be picked up and thrown by allies for a portion of the ability's damage.
This is a projectile and area effect.
spear.tag: This is a projectile and area effect.

spider.name: Web of the Spinner
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave a web strung between every enemy they strike. Damage dealt to one webbed enemy travels along the web to the others in a portion.
The web breaks when a webbed enemy dies or moves far enough from the others.
This is a binding and area effect.
spider.tag: This is a binding and area effect.

spike.name: Bed of Spikes
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave a field of hidden spikes. The first enemy to step on each spike takes heavy piercing damage and is slowed.
The number of spikes scales with the number of enemies struck. Allies do not trigger spikes.
This is a trap and area effect.
spike.tag: This is a trap and area effect.

staff.name: Pilgrim's Circle
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Striking the ground with a staff or polearm releases your next area-of-effect ability centred on yourself at no mana cost, once per fight.
An area cast this way has a larger radius the further you have travelled since your last rest.
This is a travel and area effect.
staff.tag: This is a travel and area effect.

star.name: Distant Fire
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Once per day you can call down a star onto any point of the map you have explored and can see. It lands after a long delay, marked by a pillar of light, and deals massive fire damage across a wide area.
This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a star and area effect.
star.tag: This is a star and area effect.

stellar.name: Falling Star
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per fight, you can call a burning star down on an area ability you have just cast. The star lands after a long delay, adding heavy fire damage that grows with the time it took to fall.
You choose the delay, up to a limit. The star's landing point is shown to enemies as a slowly brightening light.
This is an area, fire and celestial effect.
stellar.tag: This is an area, fire and celestial effect.

storm.name: Rolling Front
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities can be cast as a storm front that rolls slowly across the ground in a chosen direction, carrying driven rain that soaks every enemy it passes over.
Soaked enemies take increased lightning and cold damage. The front breaks apart against walls and large obstacles.
This is an area and storm effect.
storm.tag: This is an area and storm effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies caught in your area abilities are enticed toward the centre for a short time and lose a small amount of mana and stamina each moment they remain.
What is drained flows to you. Enemies that are already afflicted with fear or charm are drained twice as quickly.
This is an area and drain effect.
succubus.tag: This is an area and drain effect.

sun.name: Noon Blaze
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities burn with sunlight. Undead, shadow creatures and creatures of darkness take significantly increased damage from them.
Under open sky during the day, enemies inside are also blinded briefly, and their shadows burn away, so they cannot use shadow abilities.
This is a light and area effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and area effect.

swarm.name: Boiling Cloud
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities release a swarm that lingers over the area after it resolves. The swarm strips armour from enemies inside, a little at a time.
You can spend mana to send the swarm to converge on a single enemy, leaving the area and covering that target until it is driven off.
This is an area and swarm effect.
swarm.tag: This is an area and swarm effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Burst
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast area-of-effect abilities while moving at full speed without slowing.
An area cast while moving resolves instantly instead of after its usual delay, at the cost of a smaller radius.
This is a speed and area effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and area effect.

sword.name: Thousand Cuts
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities fill their area with drawn blades for a moment. Each enemy inside is struck by a cut that adds a stacking bleed affliction.
When you make a melee attack against an enemy carrying these bleeds, every bleed on it erupts at once.
This is a blade and area effect.
sword.tag: This is a blade and area effect.

talisman.name: Bound Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

You can bind one area ability into a carried charm. While the charm is in your inventory, the bound ability triggers automatically, centred on you, the first time you fall below half health in a fight.
Rebinding the charm costs mana and must be done outside combat. Only one charm can hold an ability at a time.
This is an area and warding effect.
talisman.tag: This is an area and warding effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Deep
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities open a dark pool from which tentacles rise. The tentacles lash the enemies inside, and drag any enemy that falls unconscious or dies under the surface, consuming it.
Each enemy consumed this way restores a portion of your mana and health.
This is a deep and area effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a deep and area effect.

thread.name: Bound in Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can link two of your area-of-effect abilities with a thread of mana. Enemies standing between the two areas are bound to the thread and pulled toward whichever area resolves first.
An enemy that crosses the thread takes damage and is slowed.
This is a binding and area effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and area effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Chain
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When two of your area abilities are active at once, lightning arcs between them, striking every enemy along the line joining their centres.
Each additional active area adds another line. The thunderclap when areas connect deafens enemies, interrupting their spells.
This is an area, lightning and sound effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is an area, lightning and sound effect.

time.name: Held Second
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can hold an area ability in the instant before it resolves. Time stops inside the area while it is held; enemies inside are frozen in place and allies inside can still act.
Releasing the hold resolves the ability. A held area costs mana every moment and releases on its own if you run out.
This is an area and time effect.
time.tag: This is an area and time effect.

tranquil.name: Settled Dust
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies caught in your area abilities are quieted for a short time. Their auras, rages, frenzies and enraged states end, and they cannot enter them again until the effect fades.
Allies inside the same area recover mana slowly while it lasts. Higher-rank enemies are quieted for a shorter time.
This is an area and calm effect.
tranquil.tag: This is an area and calm effect.

transfiguration.name: Remade Ground
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can change the terrain inside an area ability as it resolves, turning ground into water, stone, sand or ice for a short time.
Each terrain applies its own effect to enemies inside: water slows, stone roots, sand blinds and ice makes them slip. Changing terrain costs additional mana.
This is an area and transformation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is an area and transformation effect.

transgression.name: Crossed Line
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies who have used a restricted or forbidden ability, broken a truce, or attacked from stealth are marked as transgressors and shown to you.
Your area abilities deal significantly increased damage to transgressors and cannot be resisted by them. The mark fades after a short time.
This is an area and judgement effect.
transgression.tag: This is an area and judgement effect.

trap.name: Sprung Ground
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can lay an area-of-effect ability as a hidden trap that triggers when enough enemies stand inside it, rather than casting it.
A trap that triggers on a pack of enemies deals significantly increased damage and snaps its jaws shut, holding the enemies in place. Only one trap can be laid at a time.
This is a trap and area effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and area effect.

tree.name: Canopy Shadow
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can plant a seed on any area-of-effect ability. When the area fades, a tree grows in its centre for a short time, casting a canopy of shade.
Allies under the canopy recover health over time. Enemies under it are struck by falling branches.
This is a growth and area effect.
tree.tag: This is a growth and area effect.

troll.name: Only Fire Argues
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Regeneration effects on enemies inside your area abilities stop working for a short time.
While you stand inside one of your own area abilities, you regenerate health quickly. Fire damage taken while standing in it interrupts the regeneration.
This is an area and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is an area and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Laid Foundation
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities can raise low walls around their edge as they resolve. Enemies inside cannot leave until the walls crumble, and enemies outside cannot enter.
The walls block projectiles and crumble after a short time, or immediately if you cast another area-of-effect ability.
This is a construction and area effect.
trowel.tag: This is a construction and area effect.

turtle.name: Shell Within the Storm
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities never harm you or your allies, even ones that otherwise would.
When you cast an area-of-effect ability centred on yourself, you and every ally inside withdraw into a shell for a moment, becoming immune to damage while the area resolves.
This is a guard and area effect.
turtle.tag: This is a guard and area effect.

twilight.name: Long Shadow
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities stretch with the light. At dusk, at dawn and in dim places, they grow significantly larger; in bright daylight, they stay at their normal size.
Enemies at the outer edge of a stretched area have their vision blurred, losing track of you for a moment.
This is an area and dusk effect.
twilight.tag: This is an area and dusk effect.

undeath.name: Refused Grave
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies killed by your area abilities rise briefly as cold husks under your control, staggering toward the nearest enemy until they collapse a short time later.
Husks deal little damage but draw attacks. Higher-rank enemies cannot be raised this way.
This is an area and undeath effect.
undeath.tag: This is an area and undeath effect.

unity.name: Shared Weight
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When your allies use area abilities, you can spend mana to join yours to theirs. The joined area resolves once as a single ability, combining both sizes and both effects.
Joining requires the two areas to overlap. Both abilities go on cooldown.
This is an area and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is an area and unity effect.

vast.name: Borderless Hunger
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day, you can cast an area-of-effect ability with no edge. It covers every enemy within your aura-sense range, dealing a portion of its usual damage to each.
Enemies too far from you to see are struck as well, as long as your aura sense reaches them. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a space and area effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and area effect.

vehicle.name: Running Wreck
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
While mounted, your area-of-effect abilities trail behind your mount as it moves, leaving a long strip of damage along its path instead of a single circle.
Enemies run down by your mount are knocked prone inside the strip.
This is a mounted and area effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a mounted and area effect.

venom.name: Seeping Ground
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities poison the ground, which stays toxic long after the visual fades. Enemies who stand in it gain a stack of poison every few seconds.
Poison stacks applied this way cannot be cleansed while the enemy is inside the toxic ground.
This is a poison and area effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and area effect.

verdant.name: Overgrowth
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Creepers grow up through the ground covered by your area abilities, rooting enemies who stay still and hiding allies inside from ranged attacks.
The creepers persist for a short time and can be burned away by fire, which deals damage to everything standing in them.
This is an area and growth effect.
verdant.tag: This is an area and growth effect.

vessel.name: Poured Out
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Damage your allies' area abilities deal is partly stored in you. You can pour out what you hold as an area ability of your own, its damage type matching what was stored.
Pouring out empties the vessel. What you hold drains away slowly outside combat.
This is an area and containment effect.
vessel.tag: This is an area and containment effect.

visage.name: Stolen Faces
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies killed by your area-of-effect abilities leave their faces behind. You can wear a stolen face, taking on that enemy's appearance until you attack.
Monsters of the same kind as a worn face do not attack you first. Only one face can be kept at a time.
This is a disguise and area effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and area effect.

vision.name: Shown Moment
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Before you cast an area ability, you see where each enemy in range will be standing a moment later, shown as faint afterimages.
Area abilities aimed at those afterimages resolve with increased damage against the enemies who arrive there. Seeing ahead costs a little mana.
This is an area and foresight effect.
vision.tag: This is an area and foresight effect.

void.name: Mouth of Nothing
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Once per fight, an area-of-effect ability you cast can open as a mouth of nothing. Everything inside is pulled toward the centre over a short time, and enemies of lower rank that reach the centre are erased with no corpse or loot.
Enemies of equal or higher rank that reach the centre take massive damage instead.
This is a void and annihilation effect.
void.tag: This is a void and annihilation effect.

volcano.name: Building Pressure
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Each area ability you hold back from casting while in combat builds pressure. When pressure reaches its limit, your next area ability erupts, burying the area in ash and molten rock that burns for a long time.
Pressure builds faster the longer the fight continues. Erupting resets it.
This is an area, fire and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is an area, fire and eruption effect.

vortex.name: Pulling Centre
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area abilities spin into a whirl before resolving, drawing every enemy, projectile and loose item nearby toward their centre.
Projectiles drawn into the whirl are destroyed. Enemies that reach the centre take the area's full effect twice.
This is an area and vortex effect.
vortex.tag: This is an area and vortex effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Cloud
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities release a cloud of wasps that pursues the enemy who has dealt the most damage to you in the fight.
The wasps sting repeatedly, and each sting adds a stack of a burning-pain affliction that increases the damage the enemy takes from you.
This is a swarm and area effect.
wasp.tag: This is a swarm and area effect.

water.name: Pressure Collapse
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can fill an area-of-effect ability with water instead of casting it immediately. The water rises for a short time, slowing everything inside, then collapses all at once under its own weight.
The collapse deals damage based on how long the water was held, and knocks prone every enemy inside.
This is a water and area effect.
water.tag: This is a water and area effect.

weave.name: Woven Pattern
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
When two of your area abilities overlap, they knot together into a woven pattern covering the overlap. Enemies inside the pattern are bound and cannot move until it unravels.
Each further overlap adds to the pattern's size. The pattern unravels after a short time or when you leave combat.
This is an area and binding effect.
weave.tag: This is an area and binding effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Shape
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Enemies caught in your area abilities are chilled with hunger. They cannot benefit from food, potions or healing consumables for a short time.
Each enemy that dies in one of your areas feeds you, restoring stamina and granting resistance to cold for a short time.
This is an area, cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is an area, cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Leviathan's Call
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities sound a deep note that travels far beyond their area. Enemies within a wide radius are stunned briefly and must stop channelling.
Near water, a vast shape breaches through the area and swallows the weakest enemy inside whole.
This is a sound and area effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and area effect.

wheel.name: Grinding Wheel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can cast an area-of-effect ability as a spinning ring rolling outward from you. The ring keeps growing as it rolls, striking each enemy it passes once.
When the ring reaches its limit it rolls back toward you, striking each enemy a second time for a portion of the damage.
This is a rolling and area effect.
wheel.tag: This is a rolling and area effect.

whip.name: Ringmaster's Lash
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can crack a whip or chain weapon around an area-of-effect ability as it resolves. The crack strikes the edge, knocking every enemy on the edge back into the area.
Enemies cracked into the area take the ability's damage a second time.
This is a lash and area effect.
whip.tag: This is a lash and area effect.

wind.name: Scouring Gale
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities leave a gale behind them that blows in the direction you choose, pushing enemies and lingering clouds or fields along it.
Enemy clouds, poison fields and smoke pushed by the gale can be driven back onto the enemies that made them.
This is an air and area effect.
wind.tag: This is an air and area effect.

wing.name: Downbeat
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
You can leap and cast an area-of-effect ability as you land. The force of your landing flattens everything around you.
The higher you leap, the larger the area. Flying enemies inside the area are thrown to the ground.
This is a flight and area effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and area effect.

wolf.name: Den of the Hunt
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities mark the enemies inside as prey for a short time. Your summons, companions and party members deal increased damage to prey.
When an enemy marked as prey dies, the mark leaps to the nearest unmarked enemy.
This is a hunting and area effect.
wolf.tag: This is a hunting and area effect.

wood.name: Grain Devoured
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Your area-of-effect abilities consume wooden objects inside them, including barricades, doors, bows, staves and wooden shields.
Wooden enemies and constructs take significantly increased damage, and each wooden object consumed fuels a living-grain armour on you that absorbs damage.
This is a consumption and area effect.
wood.tag: This is a consumption and area effect.

wrath.name: Spent Grudge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Each time you or an ally takes damage, you gain a stack of wrath. You can spend all your wrath at once to release an area of fire centred on yourself, its size and damage scaled to the stacks spent.
Wrath decays slowly outside combat. Spending it leaves you briefly unable to gain more.
This is an area, fire and fury effect.
wrath.tag: This is an area, fire and fury effect.

zeal.name: Pyre of Conviction
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].

Each enemy struck by your area-of-effect abilities adds conviction. When conviction is full, your next area-of-effect ability can be cast as a pyre that burns for a long time and grows each time an enemy dies in it.
Conviction empties after a short time out of combat.
This is a fire and area effect.
zeal.tag: This is a fire and area effect.

ziz.name: Blotted Sky
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The All-Devouring Eye. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The All-Devouring Eye].
Once per day, you can spread vast wings that blot out the sky over the whole battlefield for a short time. Every area ability you use while the wings are spread covers everything beneath them.
Weather effects, flying enemies and ranged attacks from above cannot reach the ground while the wings are spread. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an area, flight and scale effect.
ziz.tag: This is an area, flight and scale effect.

action.name: Snap Rampart
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When an enemy begins an attack against you, you can spend stamina to raise a waist-high rampart between you and it before the attack lands. The rampart blocks that attack and crumbles a moment later.
This can trigger once every few seconds. If the rampart blocks a special attack, your next defensive ability costs no mana.
This is a reflexive and conjuration effect.
action.tag: This is a reflexive and conjuration effect.

adept.name: Master Mason
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each time one of your defensive abilities absorbs or blocks an attack, it learns that attack. Further hits of the same kind from the same enemy are reduced for the rest of the fight.
Your taunts have their cooldown shortened for each different enemy type you have blocked during the fight.
This is a defensive and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a defensive and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Crucible Wall
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

You can pour a potion into a barrier or wall you have conjured. The structure takes on the potion's effect, applying it to allies who shelter behind it and releasing it as a cloud when the structure breaks.
Harmful concoctions poured this way apply to enemies who strike the structure instead.
Each structure holds one potion at a time.
This is an alchemical and conjuration effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemical and conjuration effect.

ambush.name: Hidden Bastion
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers and walls you conjure can be raised concealed. A concealed structure is invisible to enemies until one of them touches it or is blocked by it.
The first enemy to strike a concealed structure is staggered, and you gain a brief boon of increased damage against it.
This is a concealment and conjuration effect.
ambush.tag: This is a concealment and conjuration effect.

animate.name: Stone Sentinels
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls and barriers you conjure can be woken. A woken structure pulls itself free of the ground as a slow stone sentinel that taunts nearby enemies and walks to stand wherever you point.
A sentinel loses health as it fights and returns to rubble when its health is gone. Only one structure can be woken at a time.
This is an animation and taunt effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and taunt effect.

anzu.name: Storm Bastion
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Structures you conjure draw lightning. Lightning strikes aimed at you or your allies nearby land on the tallest of your structures instead.
Each strike a structure absorbs charges it. When a fully charged structure breaks, it releases a thunderclap that deafens and pushes back nearby enemies.
This is a storm and conjuration effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and conjuration effect.

ape.name: Primate Rampart
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend stamina to tear up a chunk of ground or rubble and set it down as a waist-high barricade. Ranged attacks passing over it are blocked.
While standing behind one of your barricades, you can hurl it at an enemy, dealing physical damage and knocking it down. The barricade is destroyed.
This is a conjuration and earth effect.
ape.tag: This is a conjuration and earth effect.

armour.name: Plated Bulwark
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Every hit you take while a defensive ability is active adds a layer of steel plating to you, up to a limit. Each layer reduces physical damage taken.
When the defensive ability ends, you can shed all layers at once as a ring of shrapnel that deals physical damage to nearby enemies.
This is a defensive and metal effect.
armour.tag: This is a defensive and metal effect.

arsenal.name: Weapon Rack Rampart
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure are studded with racked weapons drawn from your inventory. An ally standing beside the wall can take a weapon from it, using it for a short time without needing to own it.
Enemies that climb or strike the wall are cut by the racked blades.
Weapons return to your inventory when the wall falls.
This is a conjuration and armament effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a conjuration and armament effect.

aspect.name: Effigy of Self
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend mana to raise a statue in your own likeness. Enemies treat the statue as you for the purpose of taunts and target selection, and it shares your taunts while it stands.
Damage dealt to the statue is partly redirected to you as a much smaller amount. The statue crumbles after a short time or when destroyed. Only one can exist at a time.
This is a construct and taunt effect.
aspect.tag: This is a construct and taunt effect.

avatar.name: Colossal Aspect
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

When you use a taunt, you can spend mana to swell into a towering stone-gilded form for a short time. In that form, every enemy that can see you is taunted, and you take reduced damage from enemies of lower rank.
You cannot use movement abilities while the form lasts. The form recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a transformation and taunt effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and taunt effect.

axe.name: Felled Timber
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers and constructs you create can be felled. Felling one topples it in the direction you choose, dealing heavy physical damage to every enemy in its path and leaving it lying as low cover.
A felled construct cannot be restored; it must be built again.
This is a construct and impact effect.
axe.tag: This is a construct and impact effect.

balance.name: Plumb Line
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, damage you take is split evenly between you and every ally within a short distance who is at higher health than you.
Your taunts force taunted enemies to split their attacks evenly between you and your nearest construct.
This is a defensive and equilibrium effect.
balance.tag: This is a defensive and equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Roost Wall
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls and barriers you create are hung with roosting bats. When an enemy strikes one, the bats burst out and swarm it, blinding it briefly.
Your taunts work on enemies that cannot see you, carried to them as a shriek. Enemies taunted this way have their ranged attacks pulled toward the nearest of your walls.
This is a construct and sonic effect.
bat.tag: This is a construct and sonic effect.

battlefield.name: Earthworks
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Out of combat, you can spend stamina to dig trenches and raise earthen banks across the ground, tile by tile. Earthworks persist until you leave the area.
Allies standing in a trench take reduced damage from ranged attacks. Enemies crossing a bank are slowed and cannot charge.
This is an earth shaping and fortification effect.
battlefield.tag: This is an earth shaping and fortification effect.

bear.name: Den Mouth
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Once per fight, you can raise a den of earth and root around yourself. Inside it you recover health over time, and enemies entering its mouth are struck by a mauling blow.
Leaving the den ends it. Your taunts reach further while you are inside.
This is a fortification and earth effect.
bear.tag: This is a fortification and earth effect.

bee.name: Comb and Hive
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your barriers are built as six-sided comb cells. A cell that is broken releases a swarm that stings nearby enemies with a stacking poison affliction.
Adjacent cells share damage, so a wall of several cells fails one cell at a time.
This is a construct and poison effect.
bee.tag: This is a construct and poison effect.

behemoth.name: Living Hillside
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, you count as terrain. Enemies cannot push, pull or knock you down, and smaller enemies must path around you.
Allies standing directly behind you are hidden from enemies on the far side.
Each hit you absorb this way builds bulk. Releasing it slams the ground and knocks back everything in front of you.
This is an earth and immovability effect.
behemoth.tag: This is an earth and immovability effect.

bird.name: Nest Above
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend mana to raise a woven platform to a height above the ground and leap onto it. While on the platform, melee enemies cannot reach you and your taunts pull enemies to its base.
The platform collapses after a short time or when its supports take enough damage, dropping you safely.
This is a construct and elevation effect.
bird.tag: This is a construct and elevation effect.

blight.name: Rotten Palisade
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create are built from blighted wood. Enemies that strike them take a creeping rot affliction that weakens their armour.
When a blighted barrier breaks, it leaves a patch of rotten ground that slows and continues to afflict enemies that stand on it.
This is a construct and blight effect.
blight.tag: This is a construct and blight effect.

blood.name: Lifeblood Mortar
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend health instead of mana to create barriers and constructs. Constructs built with blood are significantly sturdier.
While a blood-built construct stands, enemies that damage it suffer a bleeding affliction, and you recover a portion of the health spent when it expires undamaged.
This is a construct and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a construct and blood effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Wall
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enemies that die near you leave their bones behind. You can spend the bones to raise a wall of bone, sturdier the higher the rank of the creature they came from.
Bone walls can be reshaped into a ring of spikes at any time, ending the wall and damaging enemies on either side of it.
This is a construct and death effect.
bone.tag: This is a construct and death effect.

boundary.name: Line in the Earth
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you raise a wall, you can declare one side of it forbidden. Enemies on the far side cannot pass through, over or around the wall's ends while it stands; ranged attacks and spells still cross.
An enemy that breaks the wall is stunned briefly.
Only one wall can hold a declared side at a time.
This is a boundary and conjuration effect.
boundary.tag: This is a boundary and conjuration effect.

bounty.name: Granary Wall
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Damage your barriers absorb is stored as provisions. Allies who shelter behind a barrier for a short time are restored with health and stamina drawn from what it stored.
When a barrier falls, its remaining provisions spill as pickups for whoever reaches them first.
This is a conjuration and restoration effect.
bounty.tag: This is a conjuration and restoration effect.

bow.name: Arrow Slit
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls and barriers you create have arrow slits. You and your allies can fire ranged attacks and spells through your own walls; enemies cannot fire back through them.
Ranged attacks made from directly behind one of your walls deal increased damage.
This is a construct and ranged effect.
bow.tag: This is a construct and ranged effect.

brush.name: Thicket Hedge
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can grow a dense hedge of thorny undergrowth along a line. It blocks movement and hides anything behind it from enemy sight.
The hedge regrows from any damage it takes over time, and enemies pushing through it are scratched with a bleeding affliction. It withers after a while out of combat.
This is a nature and construct effect.
brush.tag: This is a nature and construct effect.

cage.name: Gaoler's Cell
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When an enemy you have taunted reaches you, you can spend mana to slam bars down around both of you. Neither of you can leave the cage, and nothing outside can enter it.
The cage lasts a short time or until it takes enough damage from outside. Enemies inside it cannot target anyone but you.
This is a confinement and taunt effect.
cage.tag: This is a confinement and taunt effect.

cat.name: Soft Footing
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can climb your own walls and constructs and stand on top of them. Enemies lose track of you while you are on top of a construct and out of their line of sight.
Dropping from a construct onto an enemy you have taunted lands a pouncing blow that stuns it briefly.
This is a construct and stealth effect.
cat.tag: This is a construct and stealth effect.

cataclysm.name: Faultline Fortress
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When a structure you conjured is destroyed, the ground beneath it splits along a faultline. The faultline cuts toward whatever broke the structure, damaging and knocking down enemies along its path.
Ground split this way stays broken, slowing enemies that cross it, until you leave the area.
This is an earth and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an earth and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Yoke and Furrow
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your constructs can be pushed. While you push one, it moves with you as mobile cover, shoving aside enemies in its path.
Pushing a construct costs stamina over time but no mana. You cannot attack while pushing.
This is a construct and strength effect.
cattle.tag: This is a construct and strength effect.

chain.name: Linked Defence
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can chain yourself to one of your constructs or to an ally. Damage the linked target takes is shared with you, and while linked neither of you can be knocked back or pulled.
Your taunts travel along chains, taunting enemies near the linked target as well as those near you. The link breaks if you move too far apart.
This is a chain and defensive effect.
chain.tag: This is a chain and defensive effect.

chaotic.name: Crooked Battlements
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each structure you conjure rolls a random property when it forms: reflecting, thorned, slippery, warding against magic, or collapsing on its attacker.
Structures you place close together can share their properties, and a structure that rolls the same property twice gains an empowered version of it.
This is a chaos and conjuration effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and conjuration effect.

charlatan.name: Painted Siege
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise false fortifications that cost very little mana. Enemies treat false walls as real, pathing around them and attacking them, until one is struck.
A struck false wall vanishes in a burst of plaster dust that blinds whoever struck it.
You can raise a real wall in place of any standing false one at no extra cost.
This is an illusion and conjuration effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and conjuration effect.

chicken.name: Broody Defiance
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While an ally or summon is below half health, your taunts are free to use and taunted enemies take increased damage from that ally.
When you stand over a downed ally, you take reduced damage and cannot be moved from where you stand until they rise or you choose to step away.
This is a protective and taunt effect.
chicken.tag: This is a protective and taunt effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Keep
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

A structure you conjure can be grafted with a part taken from a monster you have looted: a hide that hardens it, a head that bites anyone who touches it, or a tail that sweeps the ground in front of it.
Each structure carries one graft. The part is spent when the structure falls.
This is a grafting and conjuration effect.
chimera.tag: This is a grafting and conjuration effect.

claw.name: Raking Spurs
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create are studded with hooked claws. Enemies that strike or climb a barrier are raked, taking physical damage and a bleeding affliction.
While you stand against one of your barriers, attackers that strike you in melee are raked as well.
This is a construct and bleeding effect.
claw.tag: This is a construct and bleeding effect.

cloth.name: Woven Shelter
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can weave a canopy of cloth over an area. Allies beneath it are hidden from enemies outside it, and ranged attacks from outside lose accuracy.
The canopy can be folded and carried in your inventory once raised, letting you set it up again elsewhere without paying its cost. It is destroyed if it takes enough damage.
This is a construct and concealment effect.
cloth.tag: This is a construct and concealment effect.

cloud.name: Cloudwall
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a wall of condensed vapour. It does not block movement, but enemies passing through it are slowed and lose sight of everything on the far side.
Physical projectiles that pass through the wall lose most of their force. The wall drifts slowly in the direction of the wind and disperses after a while.
This is an air and concealment effect.
cloud.tag: This is an air and concealment effect.

cold.name: Hoarfrost Keep
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create are rimed in frost. Enemies touching or striking them are chilled, slowing their attacks and movement.
An enemy chilled by your barriers enough times is frozen in place for a moment. Frozen enemies are pulled toward you by your taunts more slowly.
This is a cold and construct effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and construct effect.

coral.name: Living Reef
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you build grow while they stand. A barrier gains health over time and slowly widens, up to a limit, as new coral spreads from its edges.
Barriers standing in or near water grow faster. Enemies cut against coral take a lingering bleeding affliction.
This is a construct and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is a construct and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Rot Foundation
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can corrupt an enemy-built or natural structure you touch, such as a wall, door or barricade. It becomes yours for a short time: it blocks enemies and lets your allies pass.
When the corruption ends, the structure crumbles, dealing damage to enemies beside it.
This is a corruption and construct effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and construct effect.

crocodile.name: Sunken Bank
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can sink yourself into the ground or shallow water, leaving only your eyes above it. While sunk you take greatly reduced damage and cannot be targeted from range.
An enemy you have taunted that comes within reach while you are sunk is seized in your jaws and held, unable to act, for a moment. Rising ends the effect.
This is a defensive and ambush effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a defensive and ambush effect.

crystal.name: Obsidian Lattice
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create are crystal. Spells striking a crystal barrier are refracted, scattering as weaker bolts in random directions away from you.
You can shatter a crystal barrier at will, sending shards outward that deal physical damage and leave a field of sharp debris that hurts anything walking through it.
This is a crystal and construct effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and construct effect.

cycle.name: Seasonal Walls
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
A structure that falls leaves its footing behind. A short time later, the footing regrows into the same structure with a portion of its strength.
Each regrowth is weaker than the one before, and a footing regrows only a few times before going fallow.
Burning or salting a footing stops it regrowing.
This is a cycle and conjuration effect.
cycle.tag: This is a cycle and conjuration effect.

dance.name: Shifting Guard
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your defensive abilities do not end when you move. While one is active, each step you take in a new direction grants a brief stack of damage reduction, up to a limit.
Taunted enemies are drawn to follow your movements exactly, stepping where you stepped.
This is a defensive and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.

dark.name: Shadow Masonry
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build walls out of shadow. A shadow wall blocks enemies and their sight but lets you and your shadow-based summons pass through it freely.
Shadow walls cannot be built in bright light, and dissolve if strong light falls on them.
This is a darkness and construct effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and construct effect.

dawn.name: Sunrise Gate
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure glow with first light. Invisible, stealthed and shadow-cloaked enemies are revealed while they stand within the light.
Undead and darkness-based enemies that strike a glowing wall are dazzled and cannot use abilities for a brief time.
This is a light and conjuration effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and conjuration effect.

death.name: Mausoleum
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

When an ally would die, you can spend a large amount of mana to entomb them in stone instead. The entombed ally cannot act or be harmed, and emerges when the fight ends with a portion of their health.
You can entomb one ally per fight. While an ally is entombed, your taunts are free to use.
This is a protective and death effect.
death.tag: This is a protective and death effect.

deep.name: Pressure Hull
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, the more enemies attack you, the stronger the defence becomes. Each attacker adds pressure, increasing your damage reduction up to a limit.
When the defensive ability ends, the stored pressure is released as a crushing pulse that knocks back and damages nearby enemies.
This is a water and defensive effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and defensive effect.

deer.name: Hart's Bound
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you are struck by a heavy blow while a defensive ability is active, you can leap clear of it, taking no damage, and land behind your nearest construct.
This can happen once every short interval. Enemies you taunt lose sight of you for a moment after you leap.
This is a defensive and movement effect.
deer.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.

desolate.name: Salt Ramparts
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Ground inside an enclosure you build becomes barren. Enemies inside cannot be healed, plants and conjured growths cannot take root, and summons inside lose health over time.
The barrenness lingers for a while after the walls come down.
This is a desolation and fortification effect.
desolate.tag: This is a desolation and fortification effect.

dimension.name: Folded Bastion
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you create are folded in space. Their inside is larger than their outside: an enemy that walks into one is turned around and comes out the side it entered.
Allies can step into one of your walls and out of any other wall you have standing.
This is a dimensional and construct effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and construct effect.

discord.name: Grinding Taunt
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your taunts can be thrown onto an enemy instead of yourself. Enemies nearby are compelled to attack the marked enemy, friend or foe.
A marked enemy that is struck by its own allies suffers a stacking affliction that reduces its defences. Higher-rank enemies resist the compulsion.
This is a discord and taunt effect.
discord.tag: This is a discord and taunt effect.

discordant.name: Jarring Bulwark
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enemies taunted by you lose their coordination. A taunted enemy cannot receive boons from its allies, and pack and formation bonuses do not count it.
When two enemies taunted by you stand close together, they jostle and interrupt each other's attacks.
This is a discord and taunt effect.
discordant.tag: This is a discord and taunt effect.

dog.name: Guardian's Bark
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your summons and familiars can use your taunts. A summon that taunts takes reduced damage for its duration.
When an enemy strikes an ally standing next to you, you are alerted and can instantly swap places with that ally, taking the hit yourself.
This is a protective and taunt effect.
dog.tag: This is a protective and taunt effect.

doom.name: Sealed Siege
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can seal an enemy's name into a wall you conjure. While the wall stands, that enemy cannot ignore your taunts and takes increasing damage over time.
If the sealed enemy breaks the wall itself, the accumulated damage is dealt to it all at once.
Only one name can be sealed at a time.
This is a doom and taunt effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and taunt effect.

doppelganger.name: Double Garrison
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you use a taunt, a stone copy of you forms at a point you choose and taunts enemies alongside you. Enemies split their attention between you and the copy.
You can switch places with the copy once before it crumbles. The copy has a fraction of your health and takes no actions beyond taunting.
This is a duplication and taunt effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a duplication and taunt effect.

dragon.name: Scaled Redoubt
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Structures you conjure are armoured in overlapping scale. They are highly resistant to fire and heat, and grow hotter with every hit they absorb.
At full heat, a scaled structure breathes a cone of flame toward whatever is attacking it, then cools again.
This is a fire and conjuration effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and conjuration effect.

duck.name: Slick Plumage
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, afflictions run off you. Each affliction that would be applied to you has a chance to slide off and land on the attacker instead.
Taunted enemies are unbothered by anything but you: they ignore other provocations, but their attacks against you are slightly weaker.
This is a defensive and affliction effect.
duck.tag: This is a defensive and affliction effect.

dust.name: Settling Grey
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When a construct of yours is destroyed, it falls to a cloud of dust that hangs in the air. Enemies inside the cloud cannot see further than arm's reach.
Dust settles over time into a layer that marks the footprints of anything that walks through it, including invisible and hidden enemies.
This is an earth and concealment effect.
dust.tag: This is an earth and concealment effect.

earth.name: Stone Shaping
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can shape stone and earth by touch, raising walls, ramps, pillars and steps out of the ground. Shaping costs mana scaled to the amount of stone moved.
Constructs shaped from the ground stand until destroyed or reshaped. Enemies standing on ground you reshape are thrown off balance.
This is an earth and shaping effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and shaping effect.

echo.name: Answering Wall
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your barriers remember the last attack that struck them. You can spend mana to make a barrier repeat that attack back at the enemy that made it, at reduced strength.
Your taunts echo off your constructs, taunting enemies near each of them as well as near you.
This is a sonic and construct effect.
echo.tag: This is a sonic and construct effect.

eclipse.name: Umbral Battlement
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure cast a deep shadow behind them. Allies inside the shadow cannot be targeted by enemy spells that need line of sight, and gain stealth if they stand still.
Light-based attacks that strike the wall are swallowed and do no damage.
This is a darkness and conjuration effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and conjuration effect.

edifice.name: Cornerstone
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

You can set yourself as a cornerstone, rooting in place. While set, every structure you conjure is joined to you: damage they absorb is shared out across all of them, and none can fall while you stand.
Leaving the cornerstone state releases the join. You cannot set again for a short time.
This is a fortification and foundation effect.
edifice.tag: This is a fortification and foundation effect.

effigy.name: Straw Warden
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build an effigy of yourself from straw, wood or stone gathered from the area. While the effigy stands, a portion of all damage you take is redirected to it instead.
Enemies that strike the effigy count as striking you for the purpose of your counter and retaliation effects.
Only one effigy can stand at a time. Building one takes a short time out of combat.
This is a sacrifice and conjuration effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sacrifice and conjuration effect.

elemental.name: Fourfold Ward
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you create a barrier, it takes on the element of the last damage you took: fire burns those who touch it, cold slows them, lightning arcs to them, and earth is simply harder.
A barrier is immune to the damage type of its own element.
This is an elemental and construct effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and construct effect.

elixir.name: Apothecary Shelf
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can set a potion into one of your constructs. Allies standing beside the construct receive the potion's effect at reduced strength over time while it stands.
A construct holding a potion is sturdier for as long as the potion lasts. Only one potion can be set at a time.
This is a construct and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a construct and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Load-Bearing Strength
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can lay a hand on an allied structure or summon to brace it with your own strength. The braced target gains health and damage reduction scaled to your power while you keep your hand on it.
You can move and use abilities while bracing, but leaving the target's reach ends the effect.
This is an empowerment and fortification effect.
empower.tag: This is an empowerment and fortification effect.

eye.name: Unblinking Post
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each construct you create has an eye. Anything within its sight appears on your map and loses invisibility and stealth effects while it is seen.
Your taunts can be sent through a construct's eye, taunting enemies it sees even when you cannot.
This is a perception and construct effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and construct effect.

feast.name: Laden Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Out of combat, you can raise a long table with a bench. Allies who eat at it receive a boon of increased maximum health and stamina that lasts for some time.
In combat, the table can be upended as hard cover. Food and drink consumed at the table also recover health and mana.
This is a construct and sustenance effect.
feast.tag: This is a construct and sustenance effect.

feeble.name: Hollow Stance
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enemies you have taunted grow feeble while attacking you. Each blow they strike against you reduces their damage for the rest of the fight, up to a limit.
Strength stolen this way is added to your next construct, making it sturdier.
This is a weakening and taunt effect.
feeble.tag: This is a weakening and taunt effect.

fertile.name: Hedgewall
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can sow a wall instead of raising it. A sown wall grows over a short time into a dense living hedge that heals itself and thickens the longer it stands.
Allies resting beside a full-grown hedge recover health. Enemies trying to cut through it are entangled.
Fire damages a hedge heavily.
This is a growth and conjuration effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and conjuration effect.

fey.name: Fairy Ring Bastion
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

You can grow a ring of mushrooms around an area. An enemy that enters the ring uninvited is bound by its rules: it cannot leave until it strikes you, and it takes damage each time it attacks anyone else.
Allies you name when placing the ring pass in and out freely.
Only one ring can exist at a time.
This is a fey and binding effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey and binding effect.

fire.name: Kiln Wall
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can fire your constructs, spending mana to harden them in flame. A fired construct is significantly sturdier and radiates heat, dealing fire damage over time to enemies standing beside it.
A construct can only be fired once. Firing one that is already damaged restores it partly.
This is a fire and construct effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and construct effect.

firebird.name: Kindled Ramparts
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When a structure you conjured falls, it bursts into flame and reforms from its own ash a short time later at full strength. The burst inflicts fire damage on enemies around it.
A structure can rise from its ash once. Each rebirth costs you a portion of your mana when it happens.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

fish.name: Shoal Screen
