fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can conjure a shimmering screen of silver fish that swirls around you. Each attack that would hit you strikes the shoal instead, scattering a few fish, until the shoal is spent.
The shoal reforms slowly over time while you are out of combat. Enemies attacking into the shoal are dazzled.
This is a defensive and conjuration effect.
fish.tag: This is a defensive and conjuration effect.

flea.name: Hopping Bulwark
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can leap from one of your constructs to another in a single bound, regardless of what lies between them.
Landing beside a taunted enemy shakes the ground, interrupting it. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a movement and construct effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and construct effect.

flesh.name: Flesh Buttress
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can grow a thick layer of extra flesh over your body, gaining a large amount of temporary health. While it remains you move more slowly.
Damage taken by the extra flesh can be spent afterward as mana: the more it absorbed, the more mana you recover when it sloughs away.
This is a flesh and defensive effect.
flesh.tag: This is a flesh and defensive effect.

foot.name: Long Watch
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While you stand still, you become rooted to the ground. Each moment you hold your position increases your damage reduction and the range of your taunts, up to a limit.
Being moved by an enemy breaks the rooting and stuns you briefly. Choosing to move ends it without penalty.
This is a defensive and endurance effect.
foot.tag: This is a defensive and endurance effect.

force.name: Battering Wall
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can shove a wall you conjured. The wall slides forward along the ground, pushing every enemy in its path before it until it strikes something solid.
Enemies pinned between the wall and a solid object take heavy impact damage and are stunned.
Shoving a wall costs stamina scaled to its size.
This is a force and conjuration effect.
force.tag: This is a force and conjuration effect.

forge.name: Quenched Steel Wall
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Every blow a structure you conjured absorbs tempers it, increasing its damage reduction for the rest of the fight.
You can feed metal from your inventory into a structure as it forms. A structure built with metal starts tempered and can be harvested for refined metal once the fight ends.
This is a forging and conjuration effect.
forge.tag: This is a forging and conjuration effect.

fork.name: Forked Barrier
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you raise split at their ends into a fork. Enemies caught in the gap between the tines are pinned in place for a moment.
You can split one of your active barriers into two smaller barriers, each with half its remaining strength, and place the second anywhere nearby.
This is a construct and restraint effect.
fork.tag: This is a construct and restraint effect.

fortress.name: Keep and Curtain
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

Out of combat, you can spend a portion of your mana to raise a small keep: four walls, a gatehouse that opens only for your party, and arrow slits through which allies can attack while taking reduced damage.
The keep stands until you leave the area or it is destroyed. It recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fortification and conjuration effect.
fortress.tag: This is a fortification and conjuration effect.

fox.name: Decoy Burrow
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can dig two burrow mouths a short distance apart. Entering one brings you out of the other.
Enemies that see you enter a burrow are taunted toward the wrong mouth. Burrows collapse after a while or when an enemy stands in one.
This is a movement and trickery effect.
fox.tag: This is a movement and trickery effect.

frog.name: Lily Pads
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can lay floating platforms across water, swamp and lava. Allies can walk on them; enemies that step on them sink and are slowed.
While standing on one of your platforms, you can spring from it to any other, knocking back enemies where you land.
This is a construct and water effect.
frog.tag: This is a construct and water effect.

fungus.name: Spore Mound
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your constructs sprout fungus as they stand. Enemies that strike a fungal construct release a cloud of spores that makes them drowsy, slowing their attacks.
When a fungal construct is destroyed, it leaves a mound that sprouts a smaller copy of itself after a short time. A construct can only regrow once.
This is a nature and construct effect.
fungus.tag: This is a nature and construct effect.

garuda.name: Sky Aerie
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a narrow stone pillar with a platform on top. Allies on the platform are out of reach of melee enemies and gain range on their attacks.
Serpent and burrowing enemies cannot climb the pillar and take damage when they try.
You can leap from the platform to the ground near any enemy in sight, slamming down and taunting it.
This is an elevation and conjuration effect.
garuda.tag: This is an elevation and conjuration effect.

gate.name: Gatehouse
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure can be built with a gate. Two gates of yours connect: an ally stepping through one steps out of the other, wherever they stand.
Enemies cannot use your gates, and an enemy that strikes a gate closed is pulled through to the other side.
Only two gates can exist at a time.
This is a portal and conjuration effect.
gate.tag: This is a portal and conjuration effect.

gathering.name: Rallying Point
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can plant a standard at a point. Spending mana while standing at it draws every ally and summon within a wide range to its side.
Allies gathered at the standard share your defensive abilities while they stay close to it. Only one standard can be planted at a time.
This is a space and protective effect.
gathering.tag: This is a space and protective effect.

glass.name: Pane of Clarity
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise walls of glass. Glass walls block movement and attacks, but allies can see and cast spells through them as if they were not there.
Glass is fragile: a glass wall breaks in fewer hits, but when it breaks every enemy beside it suffers a bleeding affliction from the falling shards.
This is a glass and construct effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass and construct effect.

glimeron.name: Prism Facade
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you conjure are faceted. Spells and beams that strike a barrier are split into several weaker beams that scatter away from it, striking enemies in their paths.
Allies' beams fired through the barrier are focused instead, emerging narrower and stronger.
This is a light and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and refraction effect.

goat.name: Crag Footing
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You cannot be knocked down, knocked back or pushed while standing on high ground or on one of your own constructs.
Your taunts can be delivered as a head-butt that strikes a single enemy, staggering it and taunting every enemy that saw the blow.
This is a defensive and stubbornness effect.
goat.tag: This is a defensive and stubbornness effect.

gorgon.name: Statue Garden
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you taunt an enemy, it begins to petrify while it keeps its eyes on you. An enemy fully petrified is turned to stone for a short time and counts as a wall you conjured.
Enemies of higher rank petrify slowly and break free sooner. Each enemy can be fully petrified once per fight.
This is a petrification and taunt effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and taunt effect.

griffin.name: Clifftop Claim
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can claim an elevated spot by standing on it. While you hold a claimed spot, enemies below you take a penalty to hit you, and your taunts reach much further.
Leaping down from a claimed spot onto an enemy taunts it, knocks it down, and lets you claim the ground you land on.
This is an elevation and taunt effect.
griffin.tag: This is an elevation and taunt effect.

growth.name: Rising Walls
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create keep growing for as long as you keep paying mana into them, rising taller, wider and sturdier with no upper limit until you stop.
A barrier that grows into an enemy lifts it, stranding it on top.
This is a growth and construct effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and construct effect.

guardian.name: Shieldwall Vigil
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can choose one ally as your ward. Attacks against your ward from enemies in range are redirected to you, and you take reduced damage from them.
While you guard your ward, your defensive abilities cost less mana. If your ward would die, you are pulled to their side and take the killing blow in their place, once per fight.
This is a protection and taunt effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and taunt effect.

hair.name: Strand Netting
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can string a net of fine strands between any two of your constructs. Enemies that pass through it are tangled, slowing them heavily.
Projectiles caught in the netting stop dead. The netting is nearly invisible and snaps once it has stopped a number of attacks.
This is a construct and restraint effect.
hair.tag: This is a construct and restraint effect.

hammer.name: Anvil's Answer
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can strike one of your constructs to repair it, restoring its health in exchange for stamina.
Striking a construct also drives a shockwave out from its base on the far side, knocking down enemies standing against it.
This is a repair and impact effect.
hammer.tag: This is a repair and impact effect.

hand.name: Joinery
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build structures by hand outside combat: doors, bridges, ladders and shelters, using materials from your inventory instead of mana.
Structures built this way are permanent until destroyed and can be used by anyone. Hand-built defences are sturdier than conjured ones of the same size.
This is a crafting and construct effect.
hand.tag: This is a crafting and construct effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Keystone
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Every construct you have standing hums in the same tone. Each additional construct makes all of them sturdier, up to a limit.
Destroying one of your constructs sends a jarring discord through the others, stunning enemies standing beside any of them.
This is a sonic and construct effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a sonic and construct effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Eaves
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Structures you conjure carry hooked eaves. Flying enemies passing over them are snagged and dragged down to the ground.
When a structure is struck, it shrieks, taunting every enemy within earshot toward the structure for a moment.
This is a sound and conjuration effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and conjuration effect.

harvest.name: Threshing Floor
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can lay a threshing floor of packed earth. Enemies killed on it drop additional crafting materials, and you gain a stacking boon of increased damage reduction from each death on it.
The floor lasts until you leave the area. You can lay a new one once the old one has been cleared.
This is a harvest and fortification effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and fortification effect.

heidel.name: Trampling Line
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, you can charge in a straight line without ending it. Enemies in your path are trampled and taunted.
The charge costs stamina, stops at the first construct or wall, and cannot be used again until the defensive ability ends.
This is a defensive and charge effect.
heidel.tag: This is a defensive and charge effect.

hook.name: Barbed Gate
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build a gate with hooked bars. Enemies that strike the gate are caught on it and held until they spend a turn tearing free.
Your taunts can pull a taunted enemy onto the nearest of your gates, hooking it in place.
This is a construct and restraint effect.
hook.tag: This is a construct and restraint effect.

horse.name: Rider's Barrier
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While mounted, you can raise defensive abilities and constructs without dismounting, and your mount shares your defensive abilities.
Constructs raised from horseback are laid out behind you along your path, forming a line of low walls as you ride.
This is a mounted and construct effect.
horse.tag: This is a mounted and construct effect.

hunger.name: Gnawing Wall
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create are hungry. Each time an enemy strikes one, the barrier bites back and heals from the damage it deals.
A barrier that has fed enough can be swallowed back into you, restoring your health and stamina.
This is a hunger and construct effect.
hunger.tag: This is a hunger and construct effect.

hunt.name: Driven Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your taunts can be used to drive enemies away instead of drawing them in, herding them in the direction you choose.
Enemies driven into one of your constructs or into a wall are stunned on impact. A driven enemy cannot be driven again for a while.
This is a herding and taunt effect.
hunt.tag: This is a herding and taunt effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Wall
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When a wall you conjured is broken, it splits into two smaller walls on either side of the breach, each with a portion of the original's strength.
Split walls can split again until they are too small to stand. Fire damage cauterises a wall and stops it splitting.
This is a regrowth and conjuration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regrowth and conjuration effect.

ice.name: Glacier Floor
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can lay a sheet of ice across the ground around you. Enemies on it slip and cannot charge, dash or stop quickly.
You and your allies move across your own ice normally. Ice cracks and melts over time, faster under fire.
This is a cold and terrain effect.
ice.tag: This is a cold and terrain effect.

immortal.name: Unending Watch
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a taunt you used is still active, you cannot be reduced below a sliver of health by enemies you have taunted.
Damage that would have taken you below that sliver is recorded instead. When the taunt ends, you take the recorded damage over a short time, reduced by your recovery.
This is an endurance and taunt effect.
immortal.tag: This is an endurance and taunt effect.

iron.name: Cold Iron Ward
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you create are banded in cold iron. Spells and magical projectiles striking them are dispersed rather than blocked, and fey, spirits and summoned creatures take damage on contact.
Enemies cannot teleport or blink through a gap between two of your iron-banded barriers.
This is a metal and anti-magic effect.
iron.tag: This is a metal and anti-magic effect.

juggernaut.name: Siege Engine
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

While a defensive ability is active, you can advance. Each step forward while defending builds momentum; at full momentum, enemies in front of you are pushed back and cannot hold their ground against you.
Stopping or turning sheds momentum. Walls and structures in your path are broken through.
This is a momentum and fortification effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and fortification effect.

karmic.name: Ledger Wall
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you conjure record who strikes them and how hard. When a barrier falls, each enemy that struck it takes damage equal to a portion of the damage it dealt to the barrier.
Enemies that struck a barrier and are then killed settle their debt: you recover mana for each.
This is a karmic and conjuration effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and conjuration effect.

knife.name: Murder Hole
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your walls have concealed openings. You can strike through a wall at an enemy pressed against the far side, dealing a hidden critical blow.
An enemy struck this way does not know where the blow came from and attacks the wall instead of you.
This is a construct and ambush effect.
knife.tag: This is a construct and ambush effect.

knowledge.name: Siege Manual
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Looking at any structure shows its weak points. Your attacks against walls, doors, barricades and enemy constructs deal significantly increased damage.
Structural knowledge also shows you the weak point of each of your own constructs; building with that in mind lets you place them sturdier against the direction you choose.
This is a perception and construct effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a perception and construct effect.

kraken.name: Grasping Moat
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can sink a ring of dark water into the ground around a position. Enemies crossing it are seized by tentacles that drag them under and hold them for a brief time.
Allies cross the moat freely. The moat lasts until you leave the area or raise another.
This is a water and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Breakwater
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure turn the tide of a fight. Pushes, pulls, knockbacks and charges aimed at allies behind a wall are absorbed by it.
While standing near one of your walls, you can heave against it, sending a wave over the top that knocks down every enemy on the far side.
This is a water and conjuration effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and conjuration effect.

life.name: Green Lean-To
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Constructs you create are made of living wood. Allies standing in their shelter recover health over time.
A living construct that is badly damaged slowly heals itself, and when destroyed it drops seeds you can plant to raise it again for no mana.
This is a life and construct effect.
life.tag: This is a life and construct effect.

light.name: Lighthouse
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a tower crowned with a beam of light. The beam sweeps around it; enemies caught in it are blinded briefly and taunted toward the tower.
The tower lights the area around it, dispelling darkness effects. It stands until destroyed or for a long time.
This is a light and construct effect.
light.tag: This is a light and construct effect.

lightning.name: Grounding Spire
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your constructs draw lightning to themselves. Lightning attacks aimed at you or your allies nearby strike the nearest construct instead.
A construct that has absorbed lightning stores it. You can release the charge in a burst that arcs to every enemy near the construct.
This is a lightning and construct effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and construct effect.

lizard.name: Basking Stone
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While you lie still against one of your constructs, you take on its colour and are ignored by enemies unless you were taunting them.
Remaining still for a while lets you regrow lost health, and a severing or crippling affliction on you can be shed like a tail, ending it at the cost of some health.
This is a camouflage and recovery effect.
lizard.tag: This is a camouflage and recovery effect.

locust.name: Swarm Shelter
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can call a cloud of locusts into a shifting wall around you. The wall blocks sight and devours enemy conjurations, plants and crops it passes over.
Enemy constructs and summoned barriers inside the swarm decay rapidly. The swarm thins as it feeds and disperses when spent.
This is a swarm and construct effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and construct effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom Ward
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you conjure purify what passes them. Poisons, diseases and corrupting afflictions on an ally standing behind a barrier are slowly cleansed.
Corruption-based attacks that strike the barrier are cleansed into harmless water.
This is a purification and conjuration effect.
lotus.tag: This is a purification and conjuration effect.

lurker.name: Undercroft
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can hollow out a space beneath the ground and sink into it, watching the surface above. While below, you see enemies above you and they cannot see you.
You can rise through the floor beneath an enemy, throwing it into the air. Rising reveals you.
This is a construct and stealth effect.
lurker.tag: This is a construct and stealth effect.

magic.name: Arcane Masonry
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend mana to raise a wall of solid arcana along a short line. Spells cast by enemies that strike the wall are absorbed, and each absorbed spell restores a portion of the mana you spent.
Allies standing behind the wall gain resistance to magic damage.
Only one wall can stand at a time. It fades when its stored mana runs dry.
This is a conjuration and barrier effect.
magic.tag: This is a conjuration and barrier effect.

malign.name: Grudge Ledger
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Every hit an enemy lands on you while it is taunted by you is recorded against it as a grudge.
When the taunt ends, the enemy suffers a spite affliction that inflicts necrotic damage over time, stronger for each grudge recorded. The affliction cannot be cleansed by the enemy's allies.
This is a taunt and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a taunt and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Drifting Bulwark
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability of yours is active, you can wade slowly through water and deep mud without being slowed, and you cannot be knocked back.
Allies who stand close behind you move at your pace and share a portion of your damage reduction.
This is a defensive and aura effect.
manatee.tag: This is a defensive and aura effect.

manticore.name: Quilled Palisade
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure bristle with venomous quills. Enemies that strike a wall in melee are pricked, gaining a stacking poison affliction.
You can command a wall to loose its quills in a volley toward the enemy you have taunted. A wall that looses its quills cannot regrow them.
This is a poison and conjuration effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and conjuration effect.

master.name: Mason's Ease
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each time you use the same defensive ability in a fight, it costs less mana and forms faster, to a floor.
A defensive ability used at its floor has perfect form: it also blocks the first affliction that would land on you while it is active.
The bonus resets when the fight ends.
This is a mastery and fortification effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and fortification effect.

might.name: The Unmoved Wall
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While you are bracing behind a defensive ability, force from incoming blows is stored in your body instead of pushing you.
Your next melee attack after bracing releases the stored force, knocking the target back and dealing additional damage scaled to what was stored. Stored force fades after a short time.
This is a force and defensive effect.
might.tag: This is a force and defensive effect.

ministration.name: Field Hospital
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Out of combat, you can raise a sheltered aid post. Allies resting inside recover health and stamina quickly, and wounding afflictions on them close over time.
During combat, the aid post stands as a fortified structure; downed allies carried inside are stabilised and cannot be finished off.
Only one aid post can stand at a time.
This is a healing and fortification effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and fortification effect.

minotaur.name: The Labyrinth
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

You can spend a large portion of your mana to raise a small maze of stone walls around you and the enemies near you. Enemies inside cannot see over the walls and lose track of anything they cannot see.
You always know where every enemy in the maze stands, and charging down a corridor taunts and knocks down the first enemy you meet.
The maze crumbles after a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a maze and taunt effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a maze and taunt effect.

mirage.name: Shimmering Ramparts
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure appear a short distance from where they really stand. Enemies misjudge them: ranged attacks aimed over a wall strike it, and enemies charging past one run into it.
When an enemy collides with a misplaced wall, it is dazed briefly.
This is an illusion and conjuration effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and conjuration effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend mana to raise a mirrored pane in front of you. The first ranged attack or spell that strikes it is reflected back along its path at the attacker.
An enemy struck by its own reflected attack is taunted by you.
The pane shatters after one reflection or a short time.
This is a reflection and taunt effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and taunt effect.

monkey.name: Jury-Rig
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend stamina to throw together a barricade out of nearby debris, crates, branches or fallen weapons. The barricade blocks movement and absorbs a portion of damage before collapsing.
Climbing onto a barricade you built grants a height advantage, increasing the range of your thrown and ranged attacks.
Up to two barricades can stand at a time.
This is a construction effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a single standing stone that cannot be damaged by enemies of lower rank than you. Allies touching the stone cannot be knocked down or moved.
The stone stays in that place, even after you leave, until you raise another. Returning to it restores a portion of your mana once per day.
This is an earth and permanence effect.
monolith.tag: This is an earth and permanence effect.

moon.name: Tidewall
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your barriers and shields rise and fall like a tide. At their high point, they absorb significantly more damage; at their low point, they let your own attacks pass through outward.
At night, the tide holds high for longer.
This is a light and barrier effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and barrier effect.

mouse.name: Warren Works
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can dig a burrow at your feet. Stepping into the burrow hides you below ground for a short time, during which you cannot be targeted and enemies taunted by you lose track of you.
You can exit through any other burrow you have dug in the area. Up to three burrows can exist at a time.
This is a construction and concealment effect.
mouse.tag: This is a construction and concealment effect.

myriad.name: Garrison of Selves
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you use a taunt, a short-lived copy of you appears beside each taunted enemy. Each copy holds its enemy's attention and absorbs the hits meant for you until destroyed.
Copies have a portion of your health and none of your abilities. The cost of the taunt rises for each copy created.
This is a taunt and duplication effect.
myriad.tag: This is a taunt and duplication effect.

mystic.name: Foreseen Breach
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You sense where the next attack against your structures will land. The spot is marked on the structure a moment before it is struck.
A defensive ability you use on a marked spot reinforces it, so the coming attack is blocked completely and the attacker is staggered.
This is a precognition and fortification effect.
mystic.tag: This is a precognition and fortification effect.

nebula.name: Starfield Barrier
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

Instead of a wall, you can spread a thin barrier of glittering dust across a wide area. It blocks less damage than a wall, but covers far more ground and cannot be broken in one place; damage it absorbs thins the whole field evenly.
The dust slowly gathers back into a solid wall at its centre if left unbroken.
This is a cosmic and conjuration effect.
nebula.tag: This is a cosmic and conjuration effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Seam
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Identifying an enemy's armour or shield reveals its weakest seam. Your attacks against that seam ignore a portion of the target's damage reduction.
When an enemy strikes your shield, a needle of the shield's material lances back into its own weakest seam, inflicting a bleed affliction.
This is a defensive and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a defensive and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Sworn Opponent
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can swear one enemy as your opponent. A sworn opponent is permanently taunted by you for the rest of the fight, and you take reduced damage from it.
If the sworn opponent escapes, the oath persists: it is marked on your map until one of you is dead or you swear another.
This is a nemesis and taunt effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a nemesis and taunt effect.

net.name: Mesh Rampart
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend mana to string a net between two points you can see. Enemies that try to pass through it are entangled and rooted briefly; projectiles that strike it are caught.
Caught projectiles can be thrown back by striking the net, at the nearest enemy.
Only one net can be strung at a time.
This is a conjuration and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a conjuration and restraint effect.

network.name: Linked Walls
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Structures you conjure are linked. Damage dealt to one is shared across all of them, and every structure knows what any of them sees: enemies seen by one are revealed to you and your allies.
An ally standing next to any linked structure can speak to allies next to the others, however far apart.
This is a network and conjuration effect.
network.tag: This is a network and conjuration effect.

oasis.name: Spring Shelter
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you raise an enclosure, a spring rises at its centre. Allies drinking from it recover stamina and mana and are cleansed of heat, thirst and exhaustion afflictions.
Hostile weather and environmental damage do not reach inside the enclosure.
This is a water and fortification effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and fortification effect.

ocean.name: Tide Walls
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure rise and fall like the tide. Every few seconds a wall surges forward a short distance, pushing enemies with it, then draws back to its original line.
Enemies caught by the surge lose a portion of their stamina to the undertow.
This is a water and conjuration effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and conjuration effect.

octopus.name: Eight-Armed Hold
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each taunt you use extends a spectral arm toward the taunted enemy. An enemy held by an arm cannot move away from you, but can still attack.
You can hold up to eight enemies at once. Each held enemy beyond the first increases the stamina drain of your taunts.
This is a taunt and restraint effect.
octopus.tag: This is a taunt and restraint effect.

omen.name: Read Breach
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
A brief sign appears on the ground where an enemy's next heavy attack will land, before the attack begins.
Raising a defensive ability over a sign before the attack lands blocks it entirely and staggers the attacker. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a precognition and defensive effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and defensive effect.

onslaught.name: Hammering Guard
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each attack you block builds rhythm. While you hold rhythm, your counterattacks are free and strike in an unbroken chain against whoever attacked you.
Rhythm is lost if you go a moment without blocking or countering.
This is a rhythm and counter effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a rhythm and counter effect.

pangolin.name: Overlapping Plate
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can curl into a ball of overlapping scales, becoming immune to damage from the front and sides for a short time but unable to attack.
While curled, you can roll in a chosen direction, knocking aside lower-rank enemies in your path. Uncurling costs stamina scaled to how long you stayed curled.
This is a defensive and movement effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and movement effect.

paper.name: Paper Fortress
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can fold sheets of written paper into small wards and place them on the ground. Each ward holds one written command: hold, warn or turn aside.
A hold ward roots the first enemy to cross it, a warn ward marks approaching enemies on the map, and a turn-aside ward deflects the first projectile that passes over it.
Up to five wards can be placed at a time. Folding one costs mana.
This is a construction and ward effect.
paper.tag: This is a construction and ward effect.

phantasmagoria.name: House of Wrong Rooms
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enclosures you build look different from inside. Enemies inside see doors where there are walls and walls where there are doors, and see you standing in several places at once.
Enemies that attack a false image of you are taunted by you for a short time.
This is an illusion and taunt effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and taunt effect.

phoenix.name: Cinder Shrine
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Once per day, a killing blow received while you have enemies taunted turns you into a shrine of burning stone. The shrine keeps taunting those enemies and burns anything that strikes it.
After a short time, or when the shrine is destroyed, you step out of it with a portion of your maximum health. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, rebirth and taunt effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire, rebirth and taunt effect.

plant.name: Rootbound Keep
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you raise put down roots into the ground. A rooted barrier slowly regrows damage it has taken, as long as it stands on earth or soil.
Enemies standing close to a rooted barrier are caught by creeping roots and slowed.
This is a plant and barrier effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and barrier effect.

potent.name: Concentrated Bastion
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can collapse an active barrier into a single point of concentrated power held in your hand. The barrier disappears.
The point can be thrown, detonating on impact and dealing force damage proportional to the strength the barrier had remaining.
This is a force and conversion effect.
potent.tag: This is a force and conversion effect.

predatory.name: Hunting Blind
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build a blind of brush and stone. While inside it, you are hidden, and you can choose one visible enemy as your prey.
Stepping out of the blind taunts your prey alone, pulling it away from its group toward you, and your first strike against it deals increased damage.
This is a stealth and taunt effect.
predatory.tag: This is a stealth and taunt effect.

prison.name: Cell Block
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise bars around a single enemy, caging it. A caged enemy cannot leave or attack anything outside the cage, and taunts from you pull its attention through the bars.
Enemies of higher rank break cages quickly. You can hold a number of cages at once that scales with your rank.
This is an imprisonment and conjuration effect.
prison.tag: This is an imprisonment and conjuration effect.

prosperity.name: Gilded Walls
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend coin from your inventory to reinforce a structure as it forms. Coin-reinforced structures are much sturdier and draw greedy and treasure-seeking enemies toward them.
When a coin-reinforced structure survives a fight, a portion of the coin spent on it is returned.
This is a wealth and conjuration effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a wealth and conjuration effect.

pure.name: Clear Ground
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Ground inside your barriers or behind your defensive line is purified. Allies standing there cannot gain new afflictions, and existing afflictions on them do not tick.
Corrupted, cursed or poisoned terrain within the area is cleansed while your barrier stands.
This is a purification and barrier effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and barrier effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt-Hole
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When your health falls below a quarter while a defensive ability is active, you instantly bolt a short distance away from the nearest enemy, leaving a decoy barrier where you stood.
Enemies taunted by you continue to attack the decoy until it breaks. This effect recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a movement and decoy effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and decoy effect.

rake.name: Heaped Earthwork
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend stamina to rake loose earth, leaves and debris into a low berm in front of you. The berm blocks melee charges and grants cover against ranged attacks.
Loot dropped by enemies that die against the berm is gathered into it and passes to you when you touch it.
This is a construction effect.

rat.name: Swarm Burrow
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When a barrier, wall or barricade of yours breaks, rats pour out of its rubble and swarm the nearest enemies, inflicting a stacking disease affliction.
The rats scatter after a short time. The more damage the barrier absorbed before breaking, the more rats emerge.
This is a summoning and affliction effect.
rat.tag: This is a summoning and affliction effect.

reagent.name: Transmuted Stonework
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can touch a barrier and transmute its material to stone, iron or glass. Stone resists physical damage, iron resists elemental damage, and glass lets you and allies see and cast through it.
Transmuting costs mana, and each barrier can be transmuted once.
This is a transmutation and barrier effect.
reagent.tag: This is a transmutation and barrier effect.

refracting.name: Angled Guard
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, projectiles that strike you glance off at an angle you choose by your facing. A deflected projectile keeps its damage and strikes whatever lies in its new path.
Deflecting a projectile into the enemy that fired it staggers that enemy.
This is a deflection effect.

renewal.name: Turning-Season Walls
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
A barrier of yours that is destroyed leaves a seed behind. After a short time the seed grows back into the barrier at a portion of its full strength.
Allies who stand next to a regrowing seed recover health over time.
A barrier can regrow once.
This is a renewal and barrier effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal and barrier effect.

resolute.name: Planted Standard
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can plant your feet, marking the ground beneath you. While you remain on the marked spot, you cannot be moved, stunned or forced to flee, and your taunts reach significantly further.
Leaving the spot ends the effect, and it cannot be used again for a short time.
This is a defensive and resolve effect.
resolute.tag: This is a defensive and resolve effect.

resonating.name: Humming Stones
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each hit a structure you conjured absorbs makes it hum louder. Structures near one another resonate, raising each other's hum.
When the hum peaks, every structure in resonance releases a shockwave that deafens and damages nearby enemies, then falls silent.
This is a sound and conjuration effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound and conjuration effect.

roc.name: Shadow Fortress
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your taunts carry a vast shadow ahead of you. Lower-rank enemies that fall within the shadow are taunted and pinned in place by fear for a brief time before you arrive.
Allies within your shadow take reduced damage from enemies above them.
This is a shadow and taunt effect.
roc.tag: This is a shadow and taunt effect.

rune.name: Graven Bulwark
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can carve a rune of warding into any wall, door, floor or barrier. Enemies cannot pass a warded door or wall-gap without spending a portion of their stamina to break the rune.
Each rune also grants allies within a short distance resistance to one damage type, chosen when it is carved.
Up to three runes can exist at a time. Carving costs mana.
This is a rune and ward effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and ward effect.

sacrifice.name: Blood Mortar
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can pay health instead of mana to conjure a structure. A structure built with blood is much stronger than one built with mana and heals you a little each time it absorbs a blow.
Structures built with blood cannot be dispelled.
This is a blood and conjuration effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and conjuration effect.

sand.name: Shifting Dune
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a dune of sand that absorbs projectiles and slows anything climbing over it.
When the dune is struck, it shifts toward the attacker, burying its feet and rooting it briefly. A dune that has shifted three times collapses into a cloud that blinds enemies within it.
This is an earth and barrier effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and barrier effect.

sceptre.name: Court of Command
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you taunt an enemy of lower rank than you, it must also kneel briefly, unable to attack or move.
Allies within a short distance of you while you hold a taunt gain a boon of increased damage reduction, as soldiers holding a line under their commander.
This is a taunt and authority effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a taunt and authority effect.

scribe.name: Written Foundation
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can inscribe a plan onto the ground. Out of combat, writing a plan costs nothing; when a fight begins, every structure in the plan raises itself at once at a portion of its normal mana cost.
A plan stays inscribed until you leave the area or write another.
This is an inscription and conjuration effect.
scribe.tag: This is an inscription and conjuration effect.

serene.name: Stillwater Guard
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While none of your abilities have been used for a short time, a calm surface settles over you that negates the first hit you receive.
Enemies that strike the calm surface lose their next taunt immunity and become taunted by you automatically.
This is a defensive and calm effect.
serene.tag: This is a defensive and calm effect.

serpent.name: Coiled Guard
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, you can hold position without acting. The longer you hold, the tighter you coil.
When you release the coil, you strike the nearest enemy and wrap it in place, constricting it for damage over time. The strike's damage and the hold's duration scale with how long you waited.
This is a constriction and counter effect.
serpent.tag: This is a constriction and counter effect.

shark.name: Circling Moat
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend mana to ring yourself with a circle of churning water. A fin circles within it; enemies that cross the ring are bitten for damage and inflicted with a bleed affliction.
Enemies already bleeding are pulled into the ring when they come close.
The ring lasts a short time and moves with you.
This is a water and barrier effect.
shark.tag: This is a water and barrier effect.

shield.name: Shieldwall
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Allies standing next to you while you hold up a shield or defensive ability lock their guard with yours, sharing a single combined damage reduction that grows with each ally in the line.
Damage that breaks through is divided evenly among everyone in the shieldwall.
This is a defensive and formation effect.
shield.tag: This is a defensive and formation effect.

shimmer.name: Mirage Rampart
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each barrier you raise is accompanied by up to two illusory barriers nearby. Enemies cannot tell them apart until they strike one.
Striking an illusory barrier dazzles the attacker, reducing its accuracy for a short time.
This is an illusion and barrier effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and barrier effect.

ship.name: Ship's Timbers
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend stamina to raise a curved hull of timber in front of you. The hull can be pushed forward while you shelter behind it, ramming enemies in its path and carrying them along.
On water, the hull floats, and you and allies can stand on it to cross.
This is a construction and movement effect.
ship.tag: This is a construction and movement effect.

shovel.name: Trench Line
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spend stamina to cut a short trench at your feet. Standing in the trench grants significant resistance to ranged attacks and area-of-effect damage.
The earth removed piles into a low wall on the enemy's side. Enemies who fall into the trench are slowed while climbing out.
This is an earth and fortification effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and fortification effect.

sickle.name: Harvest Fence
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a fence of curved blades in a short arc. Enemies passing through it are cut, taking damage and suffering a bleed affliction.
An enemy below a quarter of its health that touches the fence is cut down outright if it is of lower rank than you.
Only one fence can stand at a time.
This is a conjuration and blade effect.
sickle.tag: This is a conjuration and blade effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build a likeness of an ally out of stone and clay. Enemies attacking that ally are drawn to the likeness instead while it stands within a short distance of them.
The likeness has a portion of your health and crumbles if the real ally moves too far from it.
This is a likeness and taunt effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a likeness and taunt effect.

sin.name: Cherished Wrong
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each enemy that strikes you while taunted takes on a mark of sin. When you deal the killing blow to a marked enemy, you recover health and stamina for each sin it carried.
An enemy carrying many sins is compelled to keep attacking you after the taunt ends, ignoring your allies.
This is a taunt and sin effect.
sin.tag: This is a taunt and sin effect.

skirmish.name: Fighting Withdrawal
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you move away from an enemy you have taunted, a low wall rises behind you, blocking its pursuit. The wall lasts only a moment.
Enemies that go around the wall to reach you remain taunted and take increased damage from your next attack.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a withdrawal and conjuration effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a withdrawal and conjuration effect.

skunk.name: Lingering Warning
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When an enemy strikes you while a defensive ability is active, it is sprayed with a foul musk. Musked enemies are shunned by their own allies, who will not stand close to them.
A musked enemy of lower rank than you may flee rather than attack again.
This is a defensive and repulsion effect.
skunk.tag: This is a defensive and repulsion effect.

sky.name: Cloud Floor
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can conjure floors as well as walls. A cloud floor holds you and your allies over gaps, water, lava and hazardous ground for a short time.
Enemies cannot stand on a cloud floor and fall through it, taking falling damage if there is a drop below.
This is an air and conjuration effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and conjuration effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Fortress
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
The longer you remain still, the harder you become. Damage reduction builds up over time while you do not move, up to a significant amount.
Enemies attacking you while the effect is built up are slowed, as if dragged into your pace. Moving resets it.
This is a defensive and slowing effect.
sloth.tag: This is a defensive and slowing effect.

smoke.name: Veiled Redoubt
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Barriers you raise give off a thick smoke. Allies inside the smoke cannot be targeted by enemies outside it, and ranged attacks through it miss more often.
You can still taunt from within the smoke; taunted enemies must walk into it to reach you.
This is a smoke and concealment effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and concealment effect.

snake.name: Coiled Wall
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While you hold a defensive stance, the first enemy to come within reach is struck automatically by a venomous lash, inflicting a poison affliction.
An enemy poisoned this way that attacks you is briefly paralysed. This can happen once per enemy per fight.
This is a defensive and poison effect.
snake.tag: This is a defensive and poison effect.

soaring.name: Updraft Tower
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Towers you conjure throw a column of rising air from their tops. Allies who step into the column are swept into a bounding rush that carries them anywhere within a long distance, costing no stamina.
While rushing from a tower, allies cannot be targeted by melee attacks.
This is an air and conjuration effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and conjuration effect.

song.name: Rallying Refrain
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your taunts are sung rather than shouted. Every ally who hears a taunt gains a brief boon of increased resistance to fear and stun.
Enemies taunted this way cannot be lured away by any other source until your song ends.
This is a taunt and sound effect.
song.tag: This is a taunt and sound effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Decree
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can decree an area as held ground. Lower-rank enemies inside it must obey your taunts before any other command, including their leader's.
While you stand inside held ground, your structures there cannot be dispelled.
Only one decree can stand at a time. A new decree ends the last.
This is an authority and taunt effect.
sovereign.tag: This is an authority and taunt effect.

spear.name: Braced Spears
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can plant a row of conjured spears in front of you. Enemies that charge or rush into the spears are impaled, taking damage and being stopped in place.
You can pull a planted spear free and throw it. Up to five spears can stand at once.
This is a conjuration and impalement effect.
spear.tag: This is a conjuration and impalement effect.

spider.name: Web Rampart
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spin webbing across gaps, doorways and corridors. Enemies touching a web are stuck for a short time and alert you wherever you are.
You can walk across your own webs as if they were floor, including across pits and chasms.
This is a web and construction effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and construction effect.

spike.name: Caltrop Field
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you raise a defensive ability, a field of iron spikes erupts from the ground around you. Enemies moving across it take damage with every step and are slowed.
Enemies that stand still in the field take no damage. The field lasts as long as the defensive ability.
This is an earth and hazard effect.
spike.tag: This is an earth and hazard effect.

staff.name: Waystaff Ward
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can drive your staff into the ground to anchor a ward. While the staff stands, you and allies within its radius cannot be knocked down or knocked back, and you recover stamina over time.
You can recall the staff to your hand at any distance. It cannot be placed again until a short time has passed.
This is a ward and anchoring effect.
staff.tag: This is a ward and anchoring effect.

star.name: Starlit Aegis
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your barriers are studded with points of distant light. Each time a barrier absorbs a hit, one point detaches and falls on the attacker, dealing radiant damage.
A barrier that loses all its points flares and blinds nearby enemies before breaking.
This is a light and barrier effect.
star.tag: This is a light and barrier effect.

stellar.name: Fixed Star Beacon
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a beacon that burns like a distant star. Every enemy that can see it is compelled to look at it, and enemies of lower rank are taunted toward it from long range.
The beacon burns enemies who come close and goes out after a short time.
This is a stellar and taunt effect.
stellar.tag: This is a stellar and taunt effect.

storm.name: Lightning Rod
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, you are a lightning rod. Lightning damage aimed at nearby allies strikes you instead, and you take reduced damage from it.
Lightning you absorb this way charges your next taunt, which releases it as chain lightning through every enemy it reaches.
This is a storm and taunt effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and taunt effect.

succubus.name: Willing Wall
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enemies you have taunted for long enough become enthralled for a brief time. An enthralled enemy stands between you and its allies, taking their attacks as though it were your barrier.
Enemies of higher rank resist enthralment. Each enemy can be enthralled once per fight.
This is a charm and taunt effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and taunt effect.

sun.name: Noon Wall
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a wall of blazing light. Enemies on the far side are blinded while facing it, and undead and shadow creatures take fire damage when they touch it.
In daylight outdoors, the wall costs no mana to sustain.
This is a light and fire effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and fire effect.

swarm.name: Hive Walls
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].

Walls you conjure are built of thousands of small insects. A wall can be struck many times without falling; each hit only scatters part of it, and the insects swarm the attacker for damage over time before returning.
A wall reforms over time as its swarm comes back to it.
Area-of-effect damage scatters a hive wall much faster.
This is a swarm and conjuration effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and conjuration effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Bastion
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can dash to the side of any ally within a short distance, raising your shield the moment you arrive and intercepting the next attack aimed at them.
Each interception refunds a portion of the dash's stamina cost.
This is a movement and interception effect.
swift.tag: This is a movement and interception effect.

sword.name: Crossed Blades
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Parrying a melee attack while a defensive ability is active forges the parried weapon's shape into a blade that hangs in the air beside you.
Each hanging blade parries one further melee attack for you automatically. Up to three can be held at once, and they fade after a short time.
This is a conjuration and parry effect.
sword.tag: This is a conjuration and parry effect.

talisman.name: Keystone Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can carry a keystone talisman in your inventory. While you carry it, the first structure you conjure in each fight is built around it and cannot fall until the talisman is taken from it.
An enemy that tears the talisman free is taunted by you for the rest of the fight.
This is a talisman and fortification effect.
talisman.tag: This is a talisman and fortification effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Moorings
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Tentacles rise from the ground around barriers you raise. Enemies that come close are seized and dragged against the barrier, rooted there for a short time.
A rooted enemy takes damage each time an ally strikes the barrier's far side.
This is a restraint and barrier effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a restraint and barrier effect.

thread.name: Lifeline
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can tie a thread between yourself and an ally. While tied, a portion of the damage the ally takes is redirected to you instead.
You can pull the thread to drag the ally to your side. The thread breaks if you move too far apart.
This is a binding and protection effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and protection effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderhead Watch
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
A small thunderhead follows you. Each time you use a taunt, it strikes the taunted enemy with lightning, and each time you block an attack, it rumbles, building charge.
At full charge, its next strike splits across every enemy you have taunted.
This is a storm and taunt effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and taunt effect.

time.name: Held Second
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can hold a structure in place in time. A held structure cannot take damage, but it cannot be repaired or moved, and it does not block attacks that began before it was held.
When the hold ends, the structure takes all damage it would have taken.
You can hold one structure at a time, and holding costs mana over time.
This is a time and conjuration effect.
time.tag: This is a time and conjuration effect.

tranquil.name: Still Water Ward
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enemies inside an enclosure you build grow calm. Their rage and frenzy effects end, they cannot use abilities that need a charge-up, and they attack more slowly.
Allies inside cannot be feared, charmed or provoked by anyone but you.
This is a calm and fortification effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calm and fortification effect.

transfiguration.name: Reshaped Bulwark
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can reshape any structure you have conjured into another of your structures without spending mana again. Its current health carries over.
Reshaping a structure next to an enemy traps that enemy in the new shape for a moment.
This is a transfiguration effect.

transgression.name: Trespasser's Wall
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Every structure you build marks a line. An enemy that crosses, climbs or breaks through one is marked as a trespasser.
Trespassers are taunted by you, take increased damage from you, and cannot hide from you until the fight ends.
This is a judgement and taunt effect.
transgression.tag: This is a judgement and taunt effect.

trap.name: Killing Ground
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can set up to three jaw-traps around a barrier or defensive position. A trap that springs on an enemy roots it and taunts it toward you.
Traps are hidden from enemies of your rank or lower. Resetting a sprung trap costs stamina.
This is a trap and taunt effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and taunt effect.

tree.name: Living Rampart
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can grow a tree in place, a living rampart with a portion of your maximum health that blocks movement and projectiles.
Allies sheltering under its canopy recover health over time. Enemies who attack it are lashed by its branches and knocked back.
Only one tree can stand at a time.
This is a plant and construction effect.
tree.tag: This is a plant and construction effect.

troll.name: Regenerating Hide
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While you have enemies taunted, you regenerate health quickly. Fire and acid damage stop the regeneration for a short time.
Structures you conjure while regenerating mend themselves at the same rate.
This is a regeneration and taunt effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and taunt effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Line
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can repair any wall, barrier, gate or structure you touch, restoring it over time while you stay beside it. Structures you have repaired resist damage more strongly for a while.
Out of combat, you can patch a damaged section of a settlement's wall, earning goodwill with that settlement.
This is a repair and construction effect.
trowel.tag: This is a repair and construction effect.

turtle.name: Shell of Ages
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can withdraw into a conjured shell. While inside, you are immune to damage and afflictions cannot be applied to you, but you cannot move, attack or use abilities.
Each second inside the shell restores health. Withdrawing costs mana and cannot be repeated until a long cooldown has passed.
This is a defensive and recovery effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and recovery effect.

twilight.name: Dusk Battlements
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can cast an enclosure into twilight. Within it, enemies can see only a short distance, and allies can see clearly.
Enemies who cannot see you inside the twilight are still taunted by you, and attack your last known position.
This is a darkness and taunt effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and taunt effect.

undeath.name: Graveyard Garrison
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Enemies that die beside a structure you conjured are bound into its stonework. Each bound body strengthens the structure.
You can call a bound body out of the wall as a short-lived undead guard that taunts nearby enemies. A guard returns to dust when its time ends.
This is a necromantic and conjuration effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromantic and conjuration effect.

unity.name: Shared Shield
