unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you use a defensive ability, every party member within range receives a portion of its protection.
Damage that any protected ally takes is spread evenly across all protected allies and you.
Protecting more allies shortens the effect's duration.
This is a unity and protection effect.
unity.tag: This is a unity and protection effect.

vast.name: Borderless Hall
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can expand a barrier into an enclosing dome. Inside the dome, space stretches: enemies that enter take far longer to cross it, while allies move normally.
The dome lasts a short time and can be entered from outside only through its single opening.
This is a space and barrier effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and barrier effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling Siegework
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build a wheeled mantlet, a heavy wooden shield on wheels, and push it ahead of you. Allies sheltering behind it are protected from the front.
The mantlet can be left in place as a barricade, or pushed into enemies to knock them down.
This is a construction and movement effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a construction and movement effect.

venom.name: Envenomed Bulwark
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your barriers and shields are coated in slow-working venom. Enemies that strike them in melee suffer a poison affliction that stacks each time they strike.
An enemy with high enough stacks of the poison is weakened, dealing reduced damage until the affliction ends.
This is a poison and barrier effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and barrier effect.

verdant.name: Briar Wall
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Ground you have stood on during a fight sprouts creepers. You can raise any patch of creepers into a thorned wall without spending mana.
Enemies forced into a briar wall are scratched with a stacking bleed affliction.
Creepers wither when you leave the area.
This is a growth and conjuration effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and conjuration effect.

vessel.name: Hollow Keep
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Structures you conjure are hollow and can hold spells. An ally can cast a spell into a structure, which stores it until an enemy strikes the structure; the spell is then released at the attacker.
Each structure holds one spell at a time. Stored spells fade when the structure falls.
This is a storage and conjuration effect.
vessel.tag: This is a storage and conjuration effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you taunt an enemy, you wear the face of the creature it most hates or fears. Taunted enemies of lower rank than you are too enraged to use abilities, attacking you only with basic attacks.
Enemies of equal or higher rank see through the face after a short time.
This is a taunt and illusion effect.
visage.tag: This is a taunt and illusion effect.

vision.name: Watchtower
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a watchtower that sees through walls and stealth within a wide radius. Enemies it sees are revealed to you and your allies on the map.
The tower shows the path each revealed enemy is about to take a moment before it moves.
Only one watchtower can stand at a time.
This is a perception and conjuration effect.
vision.tag: This is a perception and conjuration effect.

void.name: Null Bastion
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a barrier of nothing. Spells, projectiles and conjurations that touch it are erased, but it does nothing against melee attacks.
Each thing the barrier erases costs you a portion of your mana. The barrier fails when your mana runs out.
This is a void and barrier effect.
void.tag: This is a void and barrier effect.

volcano.name: Basalt Shell
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Each hit you block while a defensive ability is active builds pressure under your skin, which hardens into a basalt crust that grants increasing damage reduction.
When the pressure peaks, the crust erupts, spraying magma over nearby enemies, and resets.
This is a fire and earth effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and earth effect.

vortex.name: Whirlpool Moat
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you use a taunt, the air around you spirals inward. Taunted enemies are pulled steadily toward you and cannot move away from you while the spiral lasts.
Projectiles caught in the spiral are drawn off course and strike the ground at your feet.
This is an air and taunt effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and taunt effect.

wasp.name: Hive Wall
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can build a paper hive onto any wall or barrier. Enemies that come close stir the hive, and wasps swarm out to sting them, inflicting a stacking venom affliction.
Striking the hive enrages the swarm, doubling its stings for a short time. A hive lasts until destroyed.
This is a construction and summoning effect.
wasp.tag: This is a construction and summoning effect.

water.name: Floodwall
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a wall of water. Enemies that try to pass through it are pushed back and slowed, while allies can step through freely.
Fire attacks that strike the wall are put out. The wall slowly drains away over a short time.
This is a water and barrier effect.
water.tag: This is a water and barrier effect.

weave.name: Woven Rampart
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can weave two of your structures together with taut threads. Enemies crossing the threads between them are caught and slowed, and the joined structures share their health.
Weaving more structures together creates a web that covers the whole area between them.
This is a weaving and conjuration effect.
weave.tag: This is a weaving and conjuration effect.

wendigo.name: Hunger Wall
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Walls you conjure are rimed with frost and are always hungry. An enemy touching one has stamina drained into the wall, which repairs itself from what it takes.
Enemies drained to nothing are frozen to the wall for a brief time.
This is a cold and conjuration effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and conjuration effect.

whale.name: Deep Bulwark
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your maximum health increases for each ally sheltering close behind you.
You can let out a deep song that taunts every enemy within a wide radius at once. Enemies far from you are drawn slowly toward you while the song lasts.
The song can be used once per fight.
This is a taunt and sound effect.
whale.tag: This is a taunt and sound effect.

wheel.name: Turning Rim
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Your shield spins while raised. Melee attacks that strike it are deflected to the side, and their attackers are thrown off balance.
You can bowl the spinning shield along the ground. It knocks down enemies in its path and rolls back to you.
This is a defensive and deflection effect.
wheel.tag: This is a defensive and deflection effect.

whip.name: Lash Perimeter
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, a conjured whip cracks around you in a wide circle. Enemies that cross the circle are lashed and pushed back outside it.
You can crack the whip at a single enemy to drag it inside the circle, taunting it.
This is a conjuration and control effect.
whip.tag: This is a conjuration and control effect.

wind.name: Windbreak
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can raise a wall of driving wind. Projectiles striking it are blown off course, and gas, smoke and poison clouds are swept away.
Allies behind the wall move faster while it stands. Enemies trying to walk through it are pushed back.
This is an air and barrier effect.
wind.tag: This is an air and barrier effect.

wing.name: Sheltering Wings
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
You can spread conjured wings to cover up to two allies close beside you. Covered allies cannot be targeted from above and take reduced damage from all directions.
While the wings are spread you cannot attack. Folding them springs you a short distance forward in a leap.
This is a protection and flight effect.
wing.tag: This is a protection and flight effect.

wolf.name: Den of Teeth
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
When you taunt an enemy, your allies and summons gain increased damage against it for as long as it stays taunted.
An enemy you have taunted that tries to flee is set upon by every summon close to you.
This is a taunt and pack effect.
wolf.tag: This is a taunt and pack effect.

wood.name: Grain of the Keep
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Any wooden structure, door, crate or fallen tree you touch can be grown outward into a palisade, blocking movement and projectiles.
A palisade grown from living wood heals itself slowly over time. Each structure can be grown once.
This is a wood and construction effect.
wood.tag: This is a wood and construction effect.

wrath.name: Grudge Bulwark
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
Every hit you absorb while a defensive ability is active is held as a grudge. You can spend your grudges to make your next attack deal additional damage for each one.
Grudges against a specific enemy count double when spent on that enemy. Grudges fade when the fight ends.
This is a rage and counter effect.
wrath.tag: This is a rage and counter effect.

zeal.name: Burning Banner
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While you hold a taunt, you burn with conviction. Allies who can see you are immune to fear, and enemies attacking you take fire damage each time they strike.
If your health falls below a quarter while taunting, the conviction flares, granting you significant damage reduction for a short time. This can happen once per fight.
This is a taunt and fire effect.
zeal.tag: This is a taunt and fire effect.

ziz.name: Weather's Shoulder
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Builder. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Builder].
While a defensive ability is active, you stand above the weather. Environmental hazards, storms and weather-based attacks pass around you and the allies close behind you.
You can spread your guard wide for a brief moment, sheltering every ally within a large radius from the next area-of-effect attack.
This is a weather and protection effect.
ziz.tag: This is a weather and protection effect.

action.name: Unwritten Margin
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
The first spell attack you cast in each fight skips its cast time entirely.

While moving, you can sketch a single glyph on the ground beneath you at no cost. When an enemy steps onto it, the last spell attack you cast fires again from the glyph at that enemy, at reduced strength. Only one glyph can exist at a time.
This is a glyph and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a glyph and haste effect.

adept.name: Practiced Hand
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast keeps a tally in the margin of your awareness. When a spell's tally fills, its next cast is written from memory: it costs no mana and cannot be interrupted.
The tally fills faster for spells you cast in sequence without casting anything else between them, and resets when you rest.
This is a spell and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a spell and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Crucible Script
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can inscribe a spell attack onto a potion in your possession. Drinking or throwing the potion releases the spell alongside the potion's own effect.
A thrown inscribed potion shatters into a lingering cloud that carries both the potion's effect and the spell's damage type. An inscribed potion keeps its spell for a short time before the ink fades.
This is an alchemy and inscription effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and inscription effect.

ambush.name: Silent Rubric
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can write a spell attack into a blind corner, doorway or patch of shadow, where it hides as an invisible rubric. The first enemy to pass through triggers the spell with additional critical chance.
Enemies struck by a hidden rubric cannot sense where it came from, and do not move toward you for a brief time.
You can maintain up to three rubrics. Each costs the spell's full mana when written.
This is a trap and concealment effect.
ambush.tag: This is a trap and concealment effect.

animate.name: Puppeteer's Calligraphy
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks that strike a statue, suit of armour, corpse or loose object can write a command into it, waking it as a temporary construct.
The construct carries the struck spell's damage type in its blows and crumbles when its command is spent, after a short time or a few attacks.
Only one written construct can stand at a time.
This is an animation and inscription effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and inscription effect.

anzu.name: Thunder-Tablet
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You carry a conjured clay tablet. Each spell attack you cast carves a mark into it. At full marks, the tablet cracks and calls a thunderbolt onto the enemy you most recently struck, inflicting lightning damage and a brief stun.
While the tablet is cracked, your spell attacks carry a gust that knocks back lower-rank enemies. The tablet reforms over a short time.
This is a storm and inscription effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and inscription effect.

ape.name: Scrawled Threat
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend stamina in place of mana to cast a spell attack. A spell cast this way is crude: it loses any secondary effects, but its damage is increased and it knocks the target back.
Beasts of lower rank that witness a crude cast treat you as the dominant creature and will not attack you first.
This is a spell and dominance effect.
ape.tag: This is a spell and dominance effect.

armour.name: Plated Script
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can inscribe a spell attack onto your own armour instead of casting it. While inscribed, the spell grants you damage reduction against its damage type.
When you take a hit that would break the inscription, the spell discharges at the attacker. Only one spell can be inscribed at a time.
This is a spell, inscription and protective effect.
armour.tag: This is a spell, inscription and protective effect.

arsenal.name: Grimoire Bandolier
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can bind loose pages of spells to yourself, preparing up to three spell attacks in advance by paying their mana outside combat.
A prepared page can be torn free to cast its spell instantly, ignoring cooldown, without paying mana again. Pages left unused remain bound until you rest.
Tearing a page with a damage type the target is weak to deals additional damage.
This is a preparation and inscription effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a preparation and inscription effect.

aspect.name: Illuminated Self
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Once per day you can write your own name in glyphs across your body. For a short time, every spell attack you cast also issues from a glowing projection of you, standing where you choose within a short distance.
The projection cannot be harmed and vanishes when the effect ends. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a spell and manifestation effect.
aspect.tag: This is a spell and manifestation effect.

avatar.name: Illuminated Halo
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
A ring of glowing script circles your head. Each spell attack you cast adds a line to it, up to a limit.

At full lines, you can spend the halo to assume a greater form for a short time: you grow in size, your spell attacks gain area and cannot be interrupted, and lower-rank enemies hesitate before attacking you.
The halo empties when the form ends.
This is an aura and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is an aura and transformation effect.

axe.name: Severing Stroke
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a single falling line in the air above a target, then spend mana to bring it down. The line strikes as a spell attack that cleaves through every enemy beneath its length.
The line deals increased damage to conjurations, barriers and shields, breaking them outright if they are of lower rank than you.
This is a spell and severing effect.
axe.tag: This is a spell and severing effect.

balance.name: Weighed Ledger
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Your spell attacks record the difference between your health and the target's. When your health is the lower of the two, your spell attacks deal increased damage; when it is the higher, they restore a portion of your mana on hit.
Casting a spell while you and the target are near equal health stuns the target briefly.
This is a spell and equilibrium effect.
balance.tag: This is a spell and equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Echo Glyph
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a sonar glyph that pulses outward through walls and darkness. Enemies the pulse touches are marked, and your spell attacks against marked enemies curve around obstacles to reach them.
The glyph costs mana and fades after a short time. Marked enemies that are invisible or hidden are revealed for as long as the mark lasts.
This is a spell and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a spell and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Field Cartouche
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to draw a large cartouche across the ground, marking out a battlefield. While you stand inside it, your spell attacks travel faster and gain range.
Enemies fighting inside the cartouche are shown on the minimap, and those that leave it carry a brief mark that makes your next spell attack against them strike harder.
Only one cartouche can be drawn at a time.
This is a diagram and battlefield effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a diagram and battlefield effect.

bear.name: Hibernal Tome
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you do not cast during a fight are stored, one charge per spell, while you stand still out of combat.
At the start of your next fight, you can release all stored charges in a single heavy volley. Each released spell deals increased damage, and the volley cannot be interrupted.
This is a spell and storing effect.
bear.tag: This is a spell and storing effect.

bee.name: Hive Script
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks break into a swarm of small glyphs on impact. The glyphs spread to nearby enemies and sting them for a fraction of the spell's damage.
An enemy stung by several of your glyphs within a short time becomes marked by the hive, and further glyphs seek it out first.
This is a spell and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a spell and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Hillside Ledger
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks can be cast as heavy runes: slower to cast and slower to travel, but they knock back and stagger anything of equal or lower rank they strike.
While you cast a heavy rune, you cannot be knocked back or moved.
Heavy runes deal additional damage to shields, barriers and constructs.
This is a weight and rune effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a weight and rune effect.

bird.name: Wingborne Verse
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can cast spell attacks while moving without penalty. Spells cast while you are moving travel further and arc over cover to strike from above.
Flying enemies struck by your spells are briefly grounded.
This is a spell and flight effect.
bird.tag: This is a spell and flight effect.

blight.name: Rotting Text
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Spell attacks you cast leave a glyph of rot written on the ground where they land. The glyph spreads slowly across the ground for a short time, applying a stacking blight affliction to enemies who stand on it.
Plants, wooden barriers and constructs of living material standing on the glyph decay and lose health over time.
This is a spell, blight and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a spell, blight and affliction effect.

blood.name: Blood Ink
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can pay for spell attacks with health instead of mana. Spells paid in blood deal increased damage and apply a bleed affliction.
Diagrams drawn in your own blood persist far longer than normal and cannot be erased by enemy dispels.
This is a spell, blood and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a spell, blood and affliction effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Grammar
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can carve a glyph into the bones of a fallen enemy. The carved corpse becomes a fixed focus that casts your most recently used spell attack at the nearest enemy, at reduced strength, until its bones crumble.
Only two carved corpses can exist at once. Carving costs mana scaled to the corpse's rank.
This is a spell and necromantic effect.
bone.tag: This is a spell and necromantic effect.

boundary.name: The Drawn Line
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to ink a straight line of script along the ground. Enemy spells and projectiles that cross the line lose much of their strength.
Your own spell attacks that cross the line in the other direction gain strength instead.
The line fades after a short time or when you draw another.
This is a barrier and inscription effect.
boundary.tag: This is a barrier and inscription effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Page
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When a spell attack you cast kills an enemy, its leftover magic spills across the page and writes a short boon onto every ally near the corpse, restoring a portion of their mana.
Enemies killed by your spell attacks drop additional crafting materials of the spell's element.
This is a boon and abundance effect.
bounty.tag: This is a boon and abundance effect.

bow.name: Drawn Sigil
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can hold a spell attack before releasing it, drawing it back like a bowstring. The longer it is held, the further it travels and the more damage it deals, up to a limit.
A fully drawn spell pierces through every enemy in a line. Holding a spell drains mana continuously.
This is a spell and charging effect.
bow.tag: This is a spell and charging effect.

brush.name: Overgrown Margins
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Diagrams you draw on the ground sprout thick undergrowth around their edges. Enemies moving through the undergrowth are slowed; you and your allies can stand hidden within it.
Spell attacks cast from inside your undergrowth do not reveal your position.
This is a spell, plant and concealment effect.
brush.tag: This is a spell, plant and concealment effect.

cage.name: Caging Glyph
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a circle of glyphs around an enemy. While inside the circle, the enemy cannot leave it, and each of your spell attacks that strikes it adds another bar of light.
When the bars complete, the circle closes and the enemy is held motionless for a short time. Enemies of higher rank break the circle with effort, taking damage as they do.
This is a spell and confinement effect.
cage.tag: This is a spell and confinement effect.

cat.name: Pawprint Cipher
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While you are unseen, your spell attacks make no sound and leave no trail back to you. The first spell you cast from stealth deals greatly increased damage.
After casting from stealth, you can spend mana to step silently into the nearest shadow.
This is a spell and stealth effect.
cat.tag: This is a spell and stealth effect.

cataclysm.name: Fault Script
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Spell attacks that strike the ground leave a crack of glowing script. When a later spell attack lands on or near an existing crack, every crack within reach ruptures at once, inflicting heavy damage along its length.
Ground ruptured this way stays broken for a short time, slowing everything that crosses it.
Cracks fade if left untouched.
This is an earth and rupture effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an earth and rupture effect.

cattle.name: Herd Rune
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a broad rune on the ground that your allies can stand inside. While three or more allies share the rune, your spell attacks cost less mana and every ally inside gains damage reduction.
The rune lasts until you leave it. Drawing it requires a short uninterrupted cast.
This is a spell and herd effect.
cattle.tag: This is a spell and herd effect.

chain.name: Linked Clauses
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
A spell attack you cast leaps from its target to the next nearest enemy, linking each struck enemy to the last with a chain of glyphs.
Linked enemies cannot move further apart than the chain allows. Damage dealt to one linked enemy by your spells is shared in part with all others on the chain.
This is a spell and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a spell and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Scattered Folio
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast has a chance to scatter into loose pages that rewrite it as a random different spell attack you know, at no extra cost.
A scattered spell always deals more damage than the one it replaced, and the cooldown of the original spell is refunded.
You can suppress this effect at will, but cannot force it.
This is a chaos and inscription effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and inscription effect.

charlatan.name: Forged Signature
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks can be signed with a false origin. Enemies struck by a falsely signed spell believe it came from the nearest other creature, and turn on it for a brief time.
Spells you cast while invisible or disguised do not break the effect.
Higher-rank enemies see through a forged signature more quickly.
This is a deception and inscription effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a deception and inscription effect.

chicken.name: Ruffled Feathers
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When an ally near you is struck, you can spend mana to answer with a spell attack aimed at their attacker, cast instantly without interrupting what you were doing.
The answering spell taunts the attacker, drawing its next attack toward you. This can trigger once every short interval.
This is a spell and protective effect.
chicken.tag: This is a spell and protective effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Verse
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can graft two of your spell attacks together, paying both costs to cast them as a single spell. The grafted spell uses the first spell's shape and both spells' damage types and effects.
A grafted spell puts both spells on cooldown. Spells of opposed elements graft unstably: the result deals more damage but sometimes strikes you as well.
This is a combination effect.

claw.name: Talon Script
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast at close range rake the target in three parallel lines. Each line applies a stacking wound affliction that increases damage the target takes from your spells.
A target carrying enough wound stacks has its armour torn, losing damage reduction for a short time.
This is a spell, wound and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a spell, wound and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Woven Scroll
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can stitch a spell attack into a length of cloth and carry it as an item. A stitched scroll can be thrown and bursts with the spell where it lands, or handed to an ally who can cast it once without spending mana.
You can carry a small number of stitched scrolls at a time. Stitching costs the spell's mana in full.
This is a spell and inscription effect.
cloth.tag: This is a spell and inscription effect.

cloud.name: Vapour Hand
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast leave a drifting cloud at their point of impact. The cloud blocks line of sight and slowly drifts with the wind.
You can recast any spell attack from inside one of your clouds as though you were standing there. Doing so disperses the cloud.
This is a spell and vapour effect.
cloud.tag: This is a spell and vapour effect.

cold.name: Frost Notation
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast write a line of frost across the target. Each line slows its attacks and movement; enough lines and the target's own spells take longer to cast.
When a target carrying frost lines is struck by fire, the lines shatter for additional cold damage and are consumed.
This is a spell and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a spell and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Lattice
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Diagrams you draw grow slowly outward like a reef for as long as they persist, enlarging their area.
A diagram that has grown to its full size hardens. Hardened diagrams cannot be dispelled and strengthen the spells of any ally standing within them.
This is a spell, growth and diagram effect.
coral.tag: This is a spell, growth and diagram effect.

corrupt.name: Sweetened Page
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast corrupt any boon on the target, turning it into an affliction of matching strength.
An enemy carrying a corrupted boon takes increased damage from your spells, and a cleanse used on it spreads the corruption to the cleanser instead.
This is a spell, corruption and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a spell, corruption and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Jawlock Rune
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can lay an unseen rune on the ground and leave it waiting. When an enemy steps onto it, the rune clamps shut, holding the enemy in place and casting your strongest spell attack at it.
Only one rune can wait at a time. A rune left untriggered for long enough deals increased damage when it finally springs.
This is a spell and trap effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a spell and trap effect.

crystal.name: Faceted Spell
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can conjure a floating crystal prism. Spell attacks you cast through the prism split into several weaker beams, or, if you choose, focus into a single beam of greatly increased damage.
The prism costs mana to conjure and shatters after a short time or when struck hard enough.
This is a spell, crystal and conjuration effect.
crystal.tag: This is a spell, crystal and conjuration effect.

cycle.name: Perennial Page
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast leaves its seed on a turning page. When the page has completed a full turn, through one of each of your spell attacks, every spell attack you know comes off cooldown.
Fire spells cast after a cold spell, and cold spells cast after a fire spell, deal additional damage.
This is a cycle and inscription effect.
cycle.tag: This is a cycle and inscription effect.

dance.name: Choreographed Casting
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Each step you take while in combat traces part of a diagram on the ground beneath you. When your footsteps complete a closed shape, it activates and amplifies spell attacks you cast while standing inside it.
The shape fades if you stand still for too long or are knocked down.
This is a spell, movement and diagram effect.
dance.tag: This is a spell, movement and diagram effect.

dark.name: Unlit Characters
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write spell attacks in shadow. Shadow-written spells are invisible in flight and cannot be dodged by enemies who rely on sight.
Spells written in shadow devour light sources they pass through, darkening the area around them for a short time.
This is a spell and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a spell and darkness effect.

dawn.name: First Light Rubric
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks shed light where they land, revealing invisible, hidden and stealthed enemies within that light for a short time.
The first spell attack you cast after entering a dark area, dungeon or astral realm deals significantly increased damage and lights the area around you.
Undead and shadow creatures revealed this way take additional damage from your spells.
This is a light and revelation effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

death.name: Final Sentence
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a sentence of death above an enemy below a portion of its health. The next spell attack you cast at it completes the sentence, killing it outright if it is of lower rank than you.
Against enemies of equal or higher rank, completing the sentence deals greatly increased damage instead. Writing a sentence costs a large amount of mana and can only be done once per fight.
This is a spell and execution effect.
death.tag: This is a spell and execution effect.

deep.name: Pressure Script
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast add weight to the target. Each stack slows it, and a heavily weighted target is pinned to the ground and cannot jump, fly or be knocked back.
Your spells deal increased damage to pinned enemies, and the weight crushes their conjured shields.
This is a spell and pressure effect.
deep.tag: This is a spell and pressure effect.

deer.name: Skittish Glyph
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When an enemy closes to melee range, a warding glyph flares beneath you and casts a spell attack at it automatically, then carries you a short leap away.
This can trigger once every short interval and costs mana each time it fires.
This is a spell and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a spell and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Salted Text
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Ground struck by your spell attacks is salted with script for a short time. Nothing heals, regenerates or is summoned on salted ground.
Enemies standing on salted ground cannot recover mana or stamina, and plants, vines and conjured terrain on it wither away.
This is a desolation and denial effect.
desolate.tag: This is a desolation and denial effect.

dimension.name: Folded Margin
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a pair of linked portals, each a small circle of glyphs. Spell attacks cast into one emerge from the other, keeping their full strength.
Portals persist for a short time, and only one pair can exist at a time. Drawing them costs mana scaled to the distance between them.
This is a spell and dimensional effect.
dimension.tag: This is a spell and dimensional effect.

discord.name: Dissonant Verse
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast make enemies' own spells misfire. A struck enemy casting a spell has a chance for it to strike a random nearby creature instead of its intended target.
Enemies hit by several of your spells in a short time are silenced briefly.
This is a spell and disruption effect.
discord.tag: This is a spell and disruption effect.

discordant.name: Wrong Interval
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Your spell attacks strike a discordant note. An enemy struck by two different spell attacks in quick succession is put out of tune: its own spells and abilities misfire, taking longer to cast and sometimes failing outright.
Enemies that are out of tune and standing close to one another interrupt each other's casting.
This is a sound and disruption effect.
discordant.tag: This is a sound and disruption effect.

dog.name: Fetched Word
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can send a spell attack hunting. A hunting spell does not need a target: it follows the scent of the last enemy you struck, around corners and through crowds, until it finds it or its duration ends.
A hunting spell that finds its quarry deals increased damage and briefly reveals its location to you and your allies.
This is a spell and tracking effect.
dog.tag: This is a spell and tracking effect.

doom.name: The Written End
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can spend mana to write an enemy's ending into the air above it: a sentence that counts down over a short time. When the sentence completes, the enemy takes damage equal to a portion of all spell attack damage you dealt it while the sentence was being written.
Only one sentence can be written at a time. Higher-rank enemies take longer to finish.
This is a doom and inscription effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and inscription effect.

doppelganger.name: Duplicate Manuscript
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to conjure an ink copy of yourself. The copy cannot move, but it mirrors every spell attack you cast at reduced strength, aimed at the same target.
Enemies cannot tell the copy from you at a glance and may attack it instead. The copy dissolves when struck hard enough or after a short time.
This is an illusion and conjuration effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is an illusion and conjuration effect.

dragon.name: Furnace Script
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a diagram of draconic script in front of you and breathe through it: a sustained cone of fire that costs mana each moment it is maintained.
While the cone is held, your skin hardens with scale, reducing physical damage taken.
Fire spell attacks cast through an active diagram are amplified.
This is a fire and diagram effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and diagram effect.

duck.name: Calm Water Hand
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your casting cannot be interrupted by damage. While you are casting, effects that would stun, silence or knock you back are delayed until your spell resolves.
If you finish a cast while carrying a delayed effect, you can spend mana to shrug that effect off entirely.
This is a spell and composure effect.
duck.tag: This is a spell and composure effect.

dust.name: Grey Erasure
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast scatter dust across enemy diagrams, runes and wards they strike, erasing them.
A struck enemy is coated in settling dust that reveals it while invisible and makes its footsteps leave a trail.
This is a spell and dispelling effect.
dust.tag: This is a spell and dispelling effect.

earth.name: Stone Tablet
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can raise a standing stone carved with one of your spell attacks. The stone casts that spell at enemies who come near it until it is destroyed.
The stone provides cover and has health that scales with your rank. Only one stone can stand at a time.
This is a spell, earth and conjuration effect.
earth.tag: This is a spell, earth and conjuration effect.

echo.name: Repeating Line
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast repeats itself a moment later, at reduced strength, from where you stood when you first cast it.
If you have moved away, the echo can strike enemies the original missed. Echoes do not repeat themselves.
This is a spell and echo effect.
echo.tag: This is a spell and echo effect.

eclipse.name: Corona Script
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks can be cast as eclipsed script: light at the edges and darkness at the centre. Eclipsed spells inflict both light and dark damage and briefly blind what they strike.
While you stand in shadow, enemies that cannot see you take additional damage from your eclipsed spells.
This is a light, darkness and blindness effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a light, darkness and blindness effect.

edifice.name: Foundation Glyph
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can lay a glyph as a foundation stone. Spell attacks cast from atop it gain range and strength, and you cannot be knocked off it.
Each spell attack cast from the foundation raises a course of stone wall at its edge, building cover that blocks enemy projectiles. The walls fall when you leave the foundation.
This is an earth and construction effect.
edifice.tag: This is an earth and construction effect.

effigy.name: Named Figure
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to write an enemy's name onto a conjured straw figure. For a short time, spell attacks that strike the figure are also inflicted on the named enemy, wherever it is within sight.
Damage meant for you that strikes the figure is absorbed instead. The figure burns away once it has absorbed a portion of your maximum health.
This is a sympathy and conjuration effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sympathy and conjuration effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Grammar
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Before casting a spell attack, you can rewrite its damage type to fire, cold, lightning or earth. Rewriting costs additional mana.
A spell rewritten to the element the target is weakest against deals increased damage. You learn each enemy's weakest element the first time you strike it.
This is a spell and elemental effect.
elemental.tag: This is a spell and elemental effect.

elixir.name: Distilled Formula
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can write a spell attack's formula into a potion as you drink it. For a short time, the potion's effect is added to every spell you cast, applying it to the targets you strike or the allies your spells pass near.
Healing and restoration potions bound this way affect allies; harmful potions affect enemies.
This is a spell and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a spell and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Raised Annotation
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can annotate an ally's attack in the moment they make it, spending mana to write a line of script over it. The annotated attack carries the damage type of your most recently cast spell attack as additional damage.
Allies whose attacks you annotate gain a brief boon of increased spell power.
This is a boon and inscription effect.
empower.tag: This is a boon and inscription effect.

eye.name: Watching Eye Sigil
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a floating eye sigil that watches a direction you choose. Enemies entering its gaze are struck by your most recent spell attack, cast through the sigil.
The sigil shares its sight with you. It lasts a short time and only one can be active.
This is a spell and perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a spell and perception effect.

feast.name: Gorging Page
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When a spell attack you cast kills an enemy, the spell feeds and grows: it continues on to the next enemy with increased size and damage.
A spell that feeds several times in one cast restores mana to you when it finally ends.
This is a spell and consumption effect.
feast.tag: This is a spell and consumption effect.

feeble.name: Thief's Footnote
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast write a footnote on the target that steals a sliver of its strength. Each footnote reduces the target's damage and grants you a matching boon to spell power.
Stolen strength returns to the target when the footnotes expire. Higher-rank targets lose less and give up less.
This is a spell, weakening and drain effect.
feeble.tag: This is a spell, weakening and drain effect.

fertile.name: Seeded Verse
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast plant a glowing seed where they land. Seeds sprout after a short time into creepers that root enemies standing on them.
A sprouted seed struck by another of your spell attacks blooms, releasing that spell again in a small area at reduced strength.
Seeds that are never triggered leave harvestable plants behind.
This is a growth and diagram effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and diagram effect.

fey.name: Fairy Contract
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can draw a ring of mushrooms and script on the ground. An enemy that enters the ring is bound by a bargain: for a short time, it takes greatly increased damage from your spell attacks, but you cannot use special attacks against it.
Breaking the bargain by using a special attack inside the ring ends it and stuns you briefly.
This is a fey and binding effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey and binding effect.

fire.name: Fire Calligraphy
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write in the air with fire. Words written this way hang burning, damaging enemies who pass through them, and amplify fire spell attacks cast through them.
Writing costs mana for each stroke. Lines left hanging long enough ignite, bursting outward in a final wave of flame.
This is a spell, fire and diagram effect.
fire.tag: This is a spell, fire and diagram effect.

firebird.name: Kindled Quill
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks leave a burning quill-line between you and where they land. You can spend mana to vanish in a burst of flame and reappear anywhere along the most recent line.
The place you left erupts in fire, damaging nearby enemies.
Teleporting this way has a short cooldown.
This is a fire and teleport effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and teleport effect.

fish.name: Shoal Script
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
A spell attack you cast splits into a school of small silver glyphs that move together. The school dodges around enemy projectiles and barriers to reach its target.
When the school arrives, it scatters and surrounds the target, striking it from all sides and ignoring damage reduction from shields held to the front.
This is a spell and schooling effect.
fish.tag: This is a spell and schooling effect.

flea.name: Leaping Glyph
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast bounce. After striking, a spell leaps to an enemy some distance away, preferring those furthest from you, and can bounce several times before it is spent.
Each bounce deals less damage, but a spell that bounces back onto an enemy it already struck deals increased damage to it.
This is a spell and ricochet effect.
flea.tag: This is a spell and ricochet effect.

flesh.name: Flesh Script
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a diagram onto living skin, yours or an ally's. While it lasts, that body becomes a focus: spell attacks you cast can originate from it as though you stood in its place.
The written body takes a small amount of damage each time a spell passes through it. A diagram on an enemy's skin instead makes your spells strike it from inside, ignoring armour.
This is a spell, flesh and inscription effect.
flesh.tag: This is a spell, flesh and inscription effect.

foot.name: Marching Order
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast while walking steadily in one direction build momentum. Each spell cast in the same direction deals more damage than the last, up to a limit.
Changing direction, stopping or being knocked back resets the momentum.
This is a spell and momentum effect.
foot.tag: This is a spell and momentum effect.

force.name: Wedge Glyph
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Your spell attacks can be written as a single blunt wedge of script. Wedged spells lose any secondary effects but deal significantly increased force damage and drive the target back in a straight line.
An enemy driven into a wall, obstacle or another enemy by a wedge is stunned.
This is a force and impact effect.
force.tag: This is a force and impact effect.

forge.name: Anvil Diagram
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw an anvil diagram on the ground. Spell attacks cast through it are hammered into a conjured weapon that hangs in the air, carrying the spell's damage type.
Up to three conjured weapons can hang at once. They strike nearby enemies on their own until they shatter after a short time.
Fire spells forged this way create heavier weapons.
This is a forging and conjuration effect.
forge.tag: This is a forging and conjuration effect.

fork.name: Branching Clause
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When a spell attack you cast reaches its target, it forks into two weaker spells that continue onward at angles. Each fork can fork once more on striking a new enemy.
You can choose to suppress the fork as you cast, keeping the spell whole and dealing increased damage to its single target.
This is a spell and splitting effect.
fork.tag: This is a spell and splitting effect.

fortress.name: Arrow-Slit Script
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can raise a short curtain wall of written stone in front of you. Enemy projectiles and spells cannot pass through it, but your own spell attacks can, through slits that open in the script as you cast.
While you stand behind the wall, your spell attacks gain critical chance.
The wall crumbles after a short time or after absorbing enough damage.
This is a fortification and diagram effect.
fortress.tag: This is a fortification and diagram effect.

fox.name: Misdirected Ink
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can cast a spell attack that appears to come from any point you can see within a short distance. Enemies struck turn toward the false origin rather than toward you.
An enemy fooled this way several times in a fight gives up searching for you briefly, standing confused.
This is a spell and illusion effect.
fox.tag: This is a spell and illusion effect.

frog.name: Springing Rune
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a coiled rune beneath your feet. Stepping off it launches you a long way in the direction you choose, and the rune casts a spell attack at the spot you leave.
Landing near water or wet ground restores a portion of the rune's mana cost. Only one rune can be drawn at a time.
This is a spell, movement and diagram effect.
frog.tag: This is a spell, movement and diagram effect.

fungus.name: Spore Lettering
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast seed spores in their target. When a seeded enemy dies, a cluster of fungal glyphs sprouts from its body and casts the spell that seeded it at nearby enemies, once each.
Fungal glyphs persist briefly before withering. Corpses that sprout cannot be raised or animated by enemies.
This is a spell and spore effect.
fungus.tag: This is a spell and spore effect.

garuda.name: Sun-Wing Sigil
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While leaping or dashing, your spell attacks gain range and strike with additional damage.
Spell attacks you cast against serpents, nagas, snakes and poisonous creatures deal significantly increased damage and purge poison from you.
This is an air and anti-serpent effect.
garuda.tag: This is an air and anti-serpent effect.

gate.name: Arch of Script
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw two connected arches of script anywhere you can see. Spell attacks cast into one arch emerge from the other, aimed in the direction the second arch faces.
Allies can step through the arches between them. Enemies cannot.
Only one pair of arches can exist at a time, and they fade after a short time.
This is a portal and diagram effect.
gate.tag: This is a portal and diagram effect.

gathering.name: Convergent Diagram
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a diagram at a point and set it pulling. Enemies within its reach are drawn steadily toward its centre for a short time.
Spell attacks cast into the centre of the diagram strike every enemy gathered there. The diagram collapses when it has pulled in more weight than your rank allows.
This is a spell, gathering and diagram effect.
gathering.tag: This is a spell, gathering and diagram effect.

glass.name: Pane of Seeing
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can conjure a thin pane of glass etched with glyphs. Your spell attacks pass through it unharmed and gain increased range, while enemy projectiles striking it are stopped.
The pane is fragile: it shatters after absorbing a few hits, spraying shards that damage enemies near it.
This is a spell, glass and conjuration effect.
glass.tag: This is a spell, glass and conjuration effect.

glimeron.name: Prismatic Diagram
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your single-target spell attacks can be cast through a conjured prism, splitting into several weaker beams that each strike a different nearby enemy.
If fewer enemies are present, the beams refocus: each surplus beam strikes the same target, and a beam that strikes a target already struck by the same spell deals additional damage.
This is a light and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and refraction effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Footing
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While standing on high ground, slopes or ledges, your spell attacks deal increased damage and knock targets downhill.
You cannot be pushed, pulled or knocked off your footing while you are casting.
This is a spell and footing effect.
goat.tag: This is a spell and footing effect.

gorgon.name: Graven Gaze
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Enemies struck by your spell attacks while looking at you begin to petrify. Each further spell attack adds to the effect; at full petrification, the enemy turns briefly to stone and cannot act.
A petrified enemy struck by a heavy spell shatters for a portion of its remaining health. Higher-rank enemies petrify more slowly.
This is a petrification effect.

griffin.name: Aerie Glyph
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
From high ground, a ledge or straight after a leap, you can mark an enemy below with a glyph. Your spell attacks against the marked enemy cannot miss and track it as it moves.
When the marked enemy dies, you can descend to its position in a single swooping leap at no cost.
This is a marking and air effect.
griffin.tag: This is a marking and air effect.

growth.name: Unfinished Page
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast grow larger the longer they travel, gaining area and damage the further they go before striking.
A spell that has grown to its full size bursts on impact, striking every enemy near the target as well.
This is a spell and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a spell and growth effect.

guardian.name: Ward-Script
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a ward onto an ally. The next spell or ranged attack aimed at them is intercepted by the ward and answered with your most recently cast spell attack, fired back at its source.
Each ally can carry only one ward. Writing a ward costs mana and has a short cooldown.
This is a ward and retaliation effect.
guardian.tag: This is a ward and retaliation effect.

hair.name: Strand Diagram
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw diagrams with fine, near-invisible strands rather than lines of light. Strand diagrams cannot be seen by enemies until they activate.
Enemies who walk into a strand diagram are tangled, and your next spell attack against a tangled enemy is cast through the strands to strike every other tangled enemy at once.
This is a spell, binding and diagram effect.
hair.tag: This is a spell, binding and diagram effect.

hammer.name: Hammered Seal
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can stamp a seal onto the ground with a spell attack. The seal shockwaves outward, damaging and knocking down enemies near the impact.
Enemies knocked down by a seal take increased damage from your next spell. Stamping costs additional mana.
This is a spell and impact effect.
hammer.tag: This is a spell and impact effect.

hand.name: Guiding Hand
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can conjure a hand of light that holds a written spell. The hand carries the spell to a spot you choose and places it there, waiting, until you clench your fist to release it.
The hand can also pick up an enemy's dropped or thrown item, or a small object, and bring it to you. Only one hand can exist at a time.
This is a spell and conjuration effect.
hand.tag: This is a spell and conjuration effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Chord
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast leave a tone ringing in the target. Striking it again with a spell of the same kind deepens the tone; striking it with a different kind creates a chord.
A chord resonates through every enemy carrying any of your tones, dealing damage to each and stunning those carrying the deepest tones.
This is a spell and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a spell and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Screeching Script
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks shriek as they fly. Enemies they pass close to, but do not strike, are briefly deafened, and cannot hear allies' calls or warnings.
When a spell attack kills an enemy carrying a boon, you can snatch that boon onto yourself for its remaining duration.
This is a sound and theft effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and theft effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning Hand
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks reap a sheaf of mana from every enemy they kill, returning a portion of the spell's cost to you.
When an enemy is below a quarter of its health, your next spell attack against it is written as a sickle: it ignores resistances and cannot be blocked or absorbed.
This is a harvest and execution effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and execution effect.

heidel.name: Hoofbeat Cadence
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While mounted, you can cast spell attacks at full strength without slowing your mount. Spells cast at a gallop trail a wake of glyphs along your path that damage enemies who cross it.
Dismounting stops the wake. Your mount gains stamina recovery while you cast from its back.
This is a spell and mounted effect.
heidel.tag: This is a spell and mounted effect.

hook.name: Barbed Script
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast lodge a barbed glyph in the target. You can spend mana to reel every barbed enemy toward you at once.
Enemies dragged this way take damage on arrival and are briefly unable to cast. Pulling enemies of higher rank drags you toward them instead.
This is a spell and pulling effect.
hook.tag: This is a spell and pulling effect.

horse.name: Charging Verse
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can cast a spell attack as a charge. The spell carries you with it a short distance toward the target, trampling enemies in between, before it strikes.
The charge costs stamina as well as mana. You arrive beside the target and cannot be struck by the first attack aimed at you on landing.
This is a spell and charge effect.
horse.tag: This is a spell and charge effect.

hunger.name: Hungering Word
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast devour the target's mana as well as its health, and return a portion of what they devour to you.
A target drained of mana entirely cannot cast and takes increased damage from your spells until it recovers.
This is a spell and mana-drain effect.
hunger.tag: This is a spell and mana-drain effect.

hunt.name: Quarry Glyph
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can name a single enemy as your quarry. While it lives, your spell attacks against it deal increased damage, and you always know its direction even when it is out of sight.
When your quarry dies, you gain a burst of mana and movement speed. Naming a new quarry requires the old one to die or a short time to pass.
This is a spell and hunting effect.
hunt.tag: This is a spell and hunting effect.

hydra.name: Many-Throated Psalm
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When a spell attack of yours is interrupted, countered or dispelled, two weaker copies of it are cast immediately at no cost.
Spell attacks you cast while below half health fire one additional projectile, and your poison spells deal increased damage over time.
This is a resilience and multiplication effect.
hydra.tag: This is a resilience and multiplication effect.

ice.name: Rime Lexicon
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can freeze a spell attack mid-flight, leaving it hanging in place as an icy shard. Frozen spells thaw and resume their flight when you choose, all at once.
Up to five spells can hang frozen at a time. Enemies who touch a frozen spell are chilled and slowed.
This is a spell and freezing effect.
ice.tag: This is a spell and freezing effect.

immortal.name: Unclosed Chapter
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Once per day, a blow that would kill you writes a final chapter instead: you remain standing at minimal health for a short time, during which your spell attacks cost no mana and have no cooldown.
When the chapter ends, you recover a portion of your health for each enemy killed during it. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a survival and inscription effect.
immortal.tag: This is a survival and inscription effect.

iron.name: Iron Grammar
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast cannot be reflected, absorbed or redirected by enemy abilities of your rank or lower.
Glyphs you draw are anchored with cold iron, making them immune to fey and spirit creatures' tampering and damaging such creatures that cross them.
This is a spell and iron effect.
iron.tag: This is a spell and iron effect.

juggernaut.name: Momentum Script
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast in an unbroken chain, without pausing for longer than a moment, gains strength and size.
At high momentum, your spell attacks plough through enemies, striking everything in their path, and you cannot be slowed.
Momentum is lost if you are stunned or stop casting.
This is a momentum effect.

karmic.name: Debt Ledger
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Damage enemies deal to you is entered into a ledger, against the enemy that dealt it. Your next spell attack against that enemy settles the account, dealing additional damage equal to a portion of what it owed.
A settled account is cleared. An enemy that dies with an unsettled account restores a portion of the debt to you as health.
This is a karmic and retaliation effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and retaliation effect.

knife.name: Concealed Clause
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Knife essence.
