lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can hide a second, smaller spell attack inside a larger one. When the larger spell strikes, the hidden spell emerges and strikes the same target from behind, ignoring any shield or guard it raised.
Hiding a spell costs the mana of both. The hidden spell deals critical damage if the target was distracted by the first.
This is a spell and concealment effect.
knife.tag: This is a spell and concealment effect.

knowledge.name: Turning Pages
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each enemy type you damage with spells is recorded in a spectral book. The more you have recorded of a type, the more damage your spells deal to it.
Skill books and spell scrolls you read add pages to the book, granting you a brief boon of spell power each time a new page is written.
This is a spell and knowledge effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a spell and knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Ink of the Deep
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spill a pool of black ink on the ground. Tentacles of script rise from it to grab enemies that come near, dragging them toward the pool's centre.
Enemies held by a tentacle are blinded by ink, and your spell attacks against them deal additional damage.
Only one pool can exist at a time.
This is a water and restraint effect.
kraken.tag: This is a water and restraint effect.

leviathan.name: Wake-Writing
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Your large-area spell attacks send out a wake of displaced magic. Enemies caught in the wake are pushed outward from the spell's centre, and allies caught in it are carried a short distance in the direction you choose.
Spell attacks cast while you stand in water create a larger wake.
This is a water and displacement effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and displacement effect.

life.name: Living Letters
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast leave glyphs of vitality where they strike. Allies who step onto a glyph absorb it and recover health.
Glyphs left unclaimed for a short time burst, dealing a small amount of damage to enemies near them instead.
This is a spell and healing effect.
life.tag: This is a spell and healing effect.

light.name: Radiant Rubric
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast flare as they land, blinding enemies who are facing the impact for a brief time.
Blinded enemies' attacks miss more often. Undead and shadow creatures struck by your spells take additional radiant damage.
This is a spell and light effect.
light.tag: This is a spell and light effect.

lightning.name: Conductor's Script
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw two glyph-points on the ground. Lightning arcs constantly between them, striking enemies who cross the line.
Spell attacks cast through the arc are charged, dealing additional lightning damage and jumping to a second target. The points fade after a short time.
This is a spell, lightning and diagram effect.
lightning.tag: This is a spell, lightning and diagram effect.

lizard.name: Basking Patience
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While you stand motionless, you slowly gather warmth into a reserve. Your next spell attack after moving spends the reserve, dealing increased damage scaled to how long you stood still.
Standing in sunlight or near fire fills the reserve faster.
This is a spell and gathering effect.
lizard.tag: This is a spell and gathering effect.

locust.name: Plague of Letters
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Once per day you can release the spell attacks you know as a cloud of tiny written glyphs. For a short time the cloud follows you, stripping enemies' boons and dealing small, constant damage to every enemy within it.
The cloud eats conjured objects, barriers and diagrams it passes over. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a spell and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is a spell and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While you stand still, a lotus diagram unfolds beneath you, opening one petal for each moment you remain still. Each open petal cleanses one affliction from you.
Moving releases the lotus: your next spell attack carries one additional strike for every petal that was open.
This is a cleansing and diagram effect.
lotus.tag: This is a cleansing and diagram effect.

lurker.name: Footnote Beneath
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a spell attack onto the ground and sink it below the surface. A sunken spell waits unseen and rises to strike the first enemy that stands above it.
Spells that rise from beneath strike enemies' undefended side and cannot be blocked. Only three sunken spells can wait at once.
This is a spell and ambush effect.
lurker.tag: This is a spell and ambush effect.

magic.name: Marginalia
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast writes a line of marginalia in the air where it lands. A line lingers for a short time.
Casting a different spell attack through a line adds the first spell's damage type to the second. A spell can carry only one borrowed type.
Lines left unused fade and refund a small portion of their mana.
This is an arcane and inscription effect.
magic.tag: This is an arcane and inscription effect.

malign.name: Ledger of Grievance
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When an enemy damages you, its name is written into a hidden ledger. Your spell attacks deal increased damage to enemies in the ledger, scaling with how much damage each has dealt you.
Defeating a listed enemy strikes its name out and restores mana. The ledger clears when you leave combat.
This is a curse and inscription effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and inscription effect.

manatee.name: Tidewritten Script
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a slow glyph onto water or wet ground. It drifts along the surface toward the nearest enemy and bursts as a spell attack when it reaches one.
Up to three glyphs can drift at once. Allies they pass beneath are gently mended.
This is a water and glyph effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and glyph effect.

manticore.name: Quill-Tail Verse
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast also launches a spined quill of written poison at the nearest other enemy, inflicting a stacking poison affliction.
An enemy carrying enough poison stacks takes additional damage from your spell attacks and moves more slowly.
Quills launched this way cost no mana.
This is a poison and projectile effect.
manticore.tag: This is a poison and projectile effect.

master.name: Settled Hand
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each time you cast the same spell attack, your hand settles further into its form, reducing that spell's mana cost and cast time. Mastery of a spell builds over many casts and is kept permanently.
At full mastery, the spell can be cast while moving without penalty, and its diagrams draw themselves.
This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Emphatic Hand
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend stamina in place of part of a spell attack's mana cost. Spells cast this way strike with a heavy shove that knocks lower-rank enemies back.
A spell cast entirely on stamina underlines itself, dealing increased damage, but leaves you briefly winded.
This is a force and spell effect.
might.tag: This is a force and spell effect.

ministration.name: Bandaged Verse
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks can be cast through an ally. The spell passes harmlessly through them, and on the way out it cleanses one affliction from them and restores a small amount of their health.
A spell passed through an ally in this way gains range and does not reveal your position.
This is a healing and channelling effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and channelling effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth Diagram
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to draw a maze of low glowing walls around you. Enemies inside the maze must follow its paths; you and your allies can pass freely through its walls.
Your spell attacks gain damage against enemies that are inside the maze and far from its centre. The maze fades after a short time.
This is a maze and diagram effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a maze and diagram effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Script
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks appear to come from a short distance away from where you actually stand. Enemies that retaliate against the false position miss.
Each spell attack you cast shifts the false position. Enemies that have struck you recently see through the haze until they lose sight of you.
This is an illusion effect.

mirror.name: Reversed Script
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a mirrored diagram in the air before you. A hostile spell striking it is written backwards and returned toward its caster at a portion of its strength.
The diagram breaks after reflecting one spell, or when its duration ends. It cannot reflect spells from casters of higher rank.
This is a reflection and diagram effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and diagram effect.

monkey.name: Pilfered Page
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When an enemy caster within reach begins a spell, you can spend mana to snatch its incantation mid-cast. The enemy's spell fails and its cooldown starts.
For a short time afterward, you can cast a weakened copy of the stolen spell once.
Each enemy can be robbed once per fight.
This is a theft and spell effect.
monkey.tag: This is a theft and spell effect.

monolith.name: Standing-Stone Inscription
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can raise an inscribed standing stone. It does not move, cannot be destroyed by enemies of lower rank, and repeats each spell attack you cast within its sight at reduced strength.
The stone remains until you raise another or leave the area.
This is an earth and repetition effect.
monolith.tag: This is an earth and repetition effect.

moon.name: Tide Tables
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks follow a tide that rises and falls over the course of a fight. At high tide they deal increased damage; at low tide they cost less mana.
You can see the tide's current phase, and a spell cast at the exact turn of the tide gains both benefits.
At night, high tide lasts longer.
This is a lunar and spell effect.
moon.tag: This is a lunar and spell effect.

mouse.name: Mouse Script
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a spell attack in script too small to see. It is cast silently, shows no casting effect, and does not reveal your position while you are hidden.
Spells written this way deal reduced damage, but the first one cast on an unaware enemy deals full damage and briefly confuses it.
This is a stealth and inscription effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and inscription effect.

myriad.name: Chorus of Hands
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When you cast a spell attack, faint copies of you appear briefly and cast the same spell from their own positions at a small portion of its strength.
The number of copies scales with rank. Copies cannot be targeted, and vanish as soon as their spell is cast.
This ability can only trigger once every few seconds.
This is a multiplicity and spell effect.
myriad.tag: This is a multiplicity and spell effect.

mystic.name: Inner Sight Folio
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can close your eyes to read an enemy's magic. While reading, you are slowed, but you see the spell an enemy is about to cast before it begins.
If you strike a reading enemy with a spell attack while it is casting, its spell is broken, and you regain the mana it would have spent.
This is a perception and counter-magic effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and counter-magic effect.

nebula.name: Starfield Verse
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Your spell attacks leave a fine dust of glowing script where they pass. When enough dust gathers in one place, it collapses into a small star that orbits you, firing light at nearby enemies until it burns out.
You can hold several stars at once. Spending a cast to fling them all at one enemy ends the effect.
This is a space and conjuration effect.
nebula.tag: This is a space and conjuration effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Glyph
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

You can narrow a spell attack to a single point, tightening an area or projectile spell to one target. The narrowed spell deals greatly increased damage and pierces part of the target's magic resistance.
A narrowed spell striking a target you hit with your previous spell finds the same wound, dealing additional damage.
This is a precision and spell effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and spell effect.

nemesis.name: Hunting Writ
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a writ against one named enemy. While the writ stands, your spell attacks against that enemy deal significantly increased damage and always know where it is, across the region map.
Your spell attacks against every other enemy deal reduced damage until the named enemy dies or the writ is torn up. Only one writ can stand at a time.
This is a pursuit and marking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a pursuit and marking effect.

net.name: Lattice of Lines
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks that pass close to each other leave connecting lines of light between their impact points. Enemies crossing a line are snared briefly.
When three lines close into a shape, the enclosed area detonates for damage of each spell type that drew it.
Lines fade after a short time.
This is a binding and diagram effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and diagram effect.

network.name: Linked Script
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw lines of script between yourself and your allies. While linked, any ally can cast your most recently cast spell attack from their own position, paying its cost from your mana.
Links extend a short distance and break if stretched beyond it. Each spell can be borrowed this way once before going on cooldown.
This is a connection and channelling effect.
network.tag: This is a connection and channelling effect.

oasis.name: Spring Glyph
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a glyph that wells up as a small pool of clear water. You and your allies standing in it recover mana over time and are cooled, resisting fire and heat damage.
Your spell attacks cast from within the pool are refreshed: the first spell after entering it has no cooldown.
Only one pool can exist at a time.
This is a water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Tidal Script
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast against the same enemy is a returning wave: it arrives with more strength than the last, up to a limit.
When the tide is full, your next spell attack on that enemy recedes, pulling it toward you and resetting the tide. Water spells build the tide faster.
This is a water and escalation effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and escalation effect.

octopus.name: Eightfold Writing
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can prepare up to eight glyphs in advance, each holding a spell attack you cast into it at full mana cost.
A prepared glyph can be released instantly, with no cast time, at any target in range. Releasing several at once spreads them across different targets.
Prepared glyphs fade if not used before you rest.
This is a preparation and glyph effect.
octopus.tag: This is a preparation and glyph effect.

omen.name: Augury Script
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Before a fight begins, a line of script appears above one nearby enemy, naming the damage type it is weakest to.
Spell attacks of that type deal increased damage to it. If you defeat that enemy with a spell of that type, the next enemy you engage also receives a line.
This is a divination and inscription effect.
omen.tag: This is a divination and inscription effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your weakest spell attack can be cast repeatedly in an unbroken stream at a reduced cost, as long as you keep casting.
Each consecutive cast during the stream builds rhythm, increasing attack speed. Being interrupted or stopping for more than a moment ends the stream.
Enemies struck by the stream cannot regain their balance and are unable to block.
This is a rhythm and barrage effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a rhythm and barrage effect.

pangolin.name: Layered Folio
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast adds a thin page of script around you. Each page absorbs a small amount of incoming damage before tearing away.
Pages stack up to a limit that scales with rank. You can curl up behind your pages, spending them all at once to become briefly immune to spell damage.
This is a warding and inscription effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a warding and inscription effect.

paper.name: Living Grimoire
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can tear a written page from the air and fold it into a paper familiar that carries one of your spell attacks. The familiar flies to the target and casts the spell on arrival.
Folding a familiar costs the spell's mana plus a small surcharge. Up to three can be aloft at once.
This is a conjuration and inscription effect.
paper.tag: This is a conjuration and inscription effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Unreliable Page
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Each spell attack you cast is accompanied by several phantom copies of itself, flying at other enemies. Phantoms deal no damage, but enemies cannot tell them from the real spell and try to dodge all of them.
Enemies that dodge a phantom are slowed briefly, as though struck.
This is an illusion and misdirection effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and misdirection effect.

phoenix.name: Ash-Bed Psalm
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your fire spell attacks leave ash where they land. Ash cleanses magical afflictions from allies who walk through it and heals them for a portion of the damage the spell dealt.

Once per day, when you fall below a quarter of your health, every patch of ash you have created erupts in a ring of fire around you, damaging enemies and restoring your health for each patch. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, healing and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire, healing and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Rooted Circle
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a circle into the ground that grows roots over a short time. While you stand inside it, your spell attacks cost less mana and recover their cooldowns faster.
The circle strengthens the longer it grows, up to a limit, and is lost if you leave it. Only one circle can exist at a time.
This is a nature and diagram effect.
plant.tag: This is a nature and diagram effect.

potent.name: Concentrated Ink
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can hold a spell attack before releasing it, concentrating it. A held spell deals increased damage the longer it is held, up to a limit, and costs more mana for each moment of holding.
A fully concentrated spell breaks through an enemy's barriers and shields before dealing damage.
Taking damage while holding a spell cuts the concentration short.
This is a potency and spell effect.
potent.tag: This is a potency and spell effect.

predatory.name: Chosen Quarry
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your first spell attack on an enemy that is isolated from its allies deals significantly increased damage.
Spell attacks you cast while unseen from cover reveal your target to you through walls until it dies or escapes your sight for long enough.
Wounded enemies fleeing from you take additional damage from your spells.
This is a hunting effect.

prison.name: Barred Circle
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to draw a circle of bars around one enemy. It cannot leave the circle, and other enemies cannot enter it, for a short time.
Your spell attacks against the imprisoned enemy deal additional damage, and its attempts to break the bars cost it stamina.
Higher-rank enemies break free sooner.
This is an imprisonment and diagram effect.
prison.tag: This is an imprisonment and diagram effect.

prosperity.name: Gilded Ink
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Enemies killed by your spell attacks drop additional coin. Items they drop are more likely to be of higher rarity.
You can spend coin in place of mana to cast your spell attacks. Spells paid for with coin deal additional damage.
This is a fortune effect.

pure.name: Clean Copy
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks cannot be weakened by enemy debuffs, silences or mana-disruption effects. Any of these you carry are ignored for the purpose of casting, though they remain on you.
A spell attack you cast while carrying no afflictions deals bonus light damage and cleanses one affliction from an ally it passes near.
This is a purity and spell effect.
pure.tag: This is a purity and spell effect.

rabbit.name: Hasty Scrawl
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can cast spell attacks while sprinting, scrawling them in passing. A spell cast while sprinting has no cast time but reduced accuracy.
Each spell cast in a sprint grants a brief burst of movement speed, so a chain of casts can carry you clear of danger.
This is a movement and spell effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and spell effect.

rake.name: Gleaned Lines
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks that miss or are resisted leave scattered fragments of script on the ground. Walking over fragments gathers them.
Gathered fragments restore mana, and each fragment of a given spell reduces that spell's cooldown slightly.
Fragments last until the fight ends.
This is a recovery and inscription effect.
rake.tag: This is a recovery and inscription effect.

rat.name: Gnawed Text
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks gnaw at enemy wards. Each hit strips a layer from the target's barriers, shields or magical buffs before dealing damage.
When several spells hit the same target in quick succession, a swarm of tiny scribbled rats bursts from it and nibbles nearby enemies for small damage.
This is a disruption and spell effect.
rat.tag: This is a disruption and spell effect.

reagent.name: Transmuted Verse
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can rewrite the damage type of a spell attack by spending a reagent from your inventory as you cast. The reagent decides the new type.
Spells cast this way also apply a minor effect drawn from the reagent's potion family, such as a weak poison, a slow or a brief burn.
This is an alchemical and spell effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemical and spell effect.

refracting.name: Bent Margin
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your projectile spell attacks bounce once off walls and obstacles, changing angle toward the nearest enemy.
Enemy projectiles that strike a spell of yours in flight are deflected, flying back toward the enemy that fired them.
Spells that have bounced deal increased damage.
This is a light and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and deflection effect.

renewal.name: Seasonal Canon
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Your spell attacks cycle through four seasons, advancing with each cast. Spring spells mend you slightly, summer spells deal bonus fire damage, autumn spells weaken the target, and winter spells slow it.
You can see which season comes next. Completing the full cycle within a fight restores a portion of your mana.
This is a season and spell effect.
renewal.tag: This is a season and spell effect.

resolute.name: Fixed Reading
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While you stand still, your spell attacks cannot be interrupted, and each spell cast without moving deals more damage than the one before, up to a limit.
Moving resets the build-up. Being knocked back or stunned does not interrupt your cast but does reset the build-up.
This is a steadfast and spell effect.
resolute.tag: This is a steadfast and spell effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Inscription
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Enemies struck by your spell attacks begin to hum. When a humming enemy is struck again, every other humming enemy within range takes a portion of the damage as resonance.
Resonance builds with each strike, and the hum fades if an enemy is left untouched for long enough.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

roc.name: Shadow of the Pinion
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Before one of your large spell attacks lands, its shadow falls across the target area. Enemies inside the shadow are terrified and try to flee it; those who remain when the spell lands take additional damage.
You can spend mana to have a spell of yours seize a lower-rank enemy and carry it a short distance before dropping it.
This is a fear and air effect.
roc.tag: This is a fear and air effect.

rune.name: Graven Seal
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can engrave a rune onto a weapon, wall or the ground. When an enemy comes near it, the rune casts the last spell attack you cast before engraving it.
A rune can be triggered once and lasts until triggered or until you leave the region. The number of runes you can maintain scales with rank.
Engraving costs the stored spell's mana and takes a short channel.
This is a rune and inscription effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and inscription effect.

sacrifice.name: Blood-Ink Covenant
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write your spell attacks in your own blood, paying their cost in health in place of mana.
A spell paid for in blood deals significantly increased damage and cannot be resisted. The more of your health you have spent this way in a fight, the stronger each blood-written spell becomes.
This is a blood and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Verse
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your area spell attacks leave a scatter of sand glyphs across the ground they cover. Enemies in the sand move slowly and cast slowly.
You can recall the sand to you, drawing it inward as a scouring wave that deals earth damage to every enemy it passes.
Recalling the sand ends all of your glyphs at once.
This is an earth and glyph effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and glyph effect.

sceptre.name: Decree
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can speak a decree naming one damage type. For a short time, your spell attacks of that type deal increased damage, and enemies take increased damage from that type from your allies as well.
Enemies of lower rank caught by a decree spell are briefly compelled to kneel, losing their next action.
Issuing a decree costs mana and has a long cooldown.
This is an authority and spell effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and spell effect.

scribe.name: Fixed Record
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can record a spell attack cast by an enemy that strikes you. Recorded spells are kept in a codex and can be cast once each from it, using your own mana.
The codex holds a small number of recorded spells. Recording one requires surviving the spell without blocking it.
This is a recording and inscription effect.
scribe.tag: This is a recording and inscription effect.

serene.name: Still Page
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When you have taken no damage for a short time, your next spell attack is cast with perfect calm: no cast time, no mana cost, and full damage.
Being calm is shown by a page turning slowly at your side. Taking damage closes the book until the calm returns.
This is a calm and spell effect.
serene.tag: This is a calm and spell effect.

serpent.name: Constricting Coil
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can hold a spell attack fully charged, at no ongoing cost, for as long as you wish. While a spell is held, a coil of script tightens around the target you are watching.
The longer the spell is held, the more damage it deals on release, and the coil roots its target for a moment when it lands.
This is a charging effect.

shark.name: Circling Script
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks that miss do not vanish. They circle the area where they missed and strike the nearest enemy that falls below half health.
Spells that strike a wounded enemy this way deal bonus damage, and a kill made this way restores mana.
Only a few missed spells can circle at once.
This is a hunting and spell effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and spell effect.

shield.name: Warding Glyph
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a glyph on an ally. The next spell attack you cast also grants the marked ally a barrier, sized to a portion of the spell's damage.
The glyph lasts until it is used. Only one ally can carry your glyph at a time. Drawing it on yourself halves the barrier.
This is a warding and glyph effect.
shield.tag: This is a warding and glyph effect.

shimmer.name: Prismatic Hand
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks split into a spray of shimmering light as they strike, dazzling nearby enemies so their attacks are more likely to miss.
You can draw a shimmering decoy diagram in the air. Enemies casting spells at you have a chance to target the decoy instead until it breaks.
This is a light and illusion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and illusion effect.

ship.name: Following Wind Script
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a heading onto the air. Your projectile spell attacks curve toward that heading after release, sailing around obstacles and corners.
Spells that travel a long distance along a heading gather speed and deal increased damage.
Only one heading can be written at a time.
This is a guidance and spell effect.
ship.tag: This is a guidance and spell effect.

shovel.name: Furrowed Diagram
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can dig a diagram into the ground in a straight furrow. Spell attacks cast along the furrow travel through the earth and erupt beneath the first enemy standing on it.
Erupting spells knock lower-rank enemies upward, leaving them briefly unable to act.
The furrow fills in after a short time.
This is an earth and diagram effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and diagram effect.

sickle.name: Harvest Arc
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your projectile spell attacks curve in a wide crescent, striking every enemy along the arc instead of the first one hit.
Enemies below a portion of their health that are struck by a crescent take bonus damage. A crescent that defeats an enemy restores some of its mana cost.
This is a harvest and spell effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and spell effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Page
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can tear a page from yourself and set it down as a flat likeness. The likeness casts your basic spell attack at nearby enemies on its own, and enemies treat it as you.
It has a fraction of your health and lasts until destroyed. Only one likeness can exist at a time.
This is a conjuration and decoy effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration and decoy effect.

sin.name: Forbidden Annotation
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can annotate a spell attack with a forbidden line, paying for it in health instead of mana. Annotated spells deal greatly increased damage and cannot be resisted.
Each annotated spell cast in a fight makes the next one cost more health.
Health spent this way cannot be restored by your own healing until the fight ends.
This is a sin and spell effect.
sin.tag: This is a sin and spell effect.

skirmish.name: Loose Line Glyph
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast lets you slip a short distance in any direction immediately afterward, without stamina cost.
Spell attacks cast just after slipping deal additional damage to enemies that were next to you before you moved.
This is a movement and casting effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a movement and casting effect.

skunk.name: Lingering Ink
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks leave a lingering cloud of foul ink on the target. Enemies near an inked target lose accuracy and are reluctant to approach it.
An inked enemy cannot hide or become invisible until the ink fades, and its position stays marked for your allies.
This is a mark and spell effect.
skunk.tag: This is a mark and spell effect.

sky.name: Open Firmament
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks can be cast upward and fall from the sky onto any point you can see, ignoring walls, cover and obstacles between you.
Falling spells take a moment to arrive, and strike everything in a small area where they land.
This is an air and bombardment effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and bombardment effect.

sloth.name: Patient Treatise
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can begin a long treatise: a spell attack with a lengthy channel that grows enormously in power while you write it.
While channelling, you take reduced damage. The treatise is cast at whatever strength it has reached if you are interrupted, and at full strength if you finish.
A finished treatise strikes every enemy in a wide area.
This ability has a long cooldown.
This is a channel and spell effect.
sloth.tag: This is a channel and spell effect.

smoke.name: Smoke Signature
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a spell attack into a column of smoke instead of casting it. The smoke drifts for a short time, then forms the spell and casts it at the nearest enemy.
Enemies cannot tell which column holds a spell. Casting from smoke does not reveal your position.
Up to three columns can hang in the air at once.
This is a smoke and delayed spell effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and delayed spell effect.

snake.name: Venom Script
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks write a coiled script beneath the target's skin. The script deals no damage at first.
After a short delay, or when the target is struck by any of your spells again, the script uncoils and deals poison damage equal to a portion of everything you have dealt it since it was written.
Each enemy can carry only one coil at a time.
This is a poison and delayed spell effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and delayed spell effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Script
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast raise a column of rising air around you, carrying you on in a quick burst of speed for a short time.
While the updraft carries you, your spell attacks cost no stamina to aim and you cannot be knocked down. Stopping ends the updraft.
This is an air and levitation effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and levitation effect.

song.name: Sung Notation
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast is a note. Casting different spells in a sequence you have played before forms a phrase, adding a small burst of sonic damage to the last spell.
You can record up to three phrases. A phrase played in full also grants allies within earshot a brief boon to casting speed.
This is a sound and spell effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and spell effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Decree
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to issue a written decree over an area, forbidding one damage type. For a short time, enemies within the area deal greatly reduced damage of that type.
Your own spell attacks of the forbidden type deal additional damage within the area. Lower-rank enemies cannot cast spells of that type there at all.
This is an authority and decree effect.
sovereign.tag: This is an authority and decree effect.

spear.name: Launched Glyph
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can fold a spell attack into a written javelin and throw it. The javelin travels farther than the spell would and pierces through the first enemy, casting the spell on the second.
Javelins that strike a wall pin the spell in place, casting it on the next enemy that passes.
This is a projectile and spell effect.
spear.tag: This is a projectile and spell effect.

spider.name: Silk Diagram
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can weave a web diagram between nearby surfaces. Enemies touching it are caught briefly, and each spell attack you cast at a caught enemy travels along the web to every other enemy caught in it.
The web holds a limited number of enemies and breaks after a short time or when its strands are destroyed.
This is a web and diagram effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and diagram effect.

spike.name: Barbed Glyph
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can scatter small barbed glyphs on the ground. An enemy stepping on one takes a burst of spell damage and is briefly rooted.
Each spell attack you cast near a glyph sharpens it, increasing the damage it deals when triggered.
The number of glyphs you can maintain scales with rank.
This is a trap and glyph effect.
spike.tag: This is a trap and glyph effect.

staff.name: Wayfarer's Inscription
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While wielding a staff, you can strike it against the ground to inscribe a waymark. You can cast spell attacks from any of your waymarks in range as though you stood there.
Waymarks last until you leave the region. You can hold a small number at once, and they appear on your map.
This is a travel and inscription effect.
staff.tag: This is a travel and inscription effect.

star.name: Constellation
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each enemy struck by your spell attacks gains a point of starlight. When you strike enemies whose stars could be joined into a shape, the shape completes and starfire falls on every enemy within it.
The more stars in the shape, the greater the damage. Stars fade after a short time.
This is a star and diagram effect.
star.tag: This is a star and diagram effect.

stellar.name: Fixed-Point Chart
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks gain damage the further they travel before striking.
You can spend mana to set a burning point of light in the sky. Spell attacks you cast while standing beneath it, or while it is in your line of sight, strike with stellar fire as additional damage.
Only one point can burn at a time.
This is a star and fire effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and fire effect.

storm.name: Front Line Diagram
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a storm front across the battlefield as a line of cloud script. Rain falls along it, soaking enemies who stand beneath it.
Soaked enemies take increased lightning and cold damage from your spell attacks, and lightning spells that strike one soaked enemy arc to every other soaked enemy nearby.
This is a weather and storm effect.
storm.tag: This is a weather and storm effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Enemies struck by your spell attacks while looking at you give up a portion of their mana to you.
An enemy charmed or entranced by you takes no damage from your spell attacks, but surrenders its boons to you one at a time while the effect lasts.
This is a charm and theft effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and theft effect.

sun.name: Noon Sigil
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can raise a sun sigil above the battlefield. Beneath it, your spell attacks deal bonus fire and light damage, and enemies cannot become invisible or hidden.
Enemies standing directly beneath the sigil burn over time. The sigil lasts a short time and has a long cooldown.
In daylight outdoors, the sigil lasts longer.
This is a sun and sigil effect.
sun.tag: This is a sun and sigil effect.

swarm.name: Swarm of Letters
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks can be cast as a cloud of small flying letters. The cloud splits its damage into many tiny strikes that cover a wide area and chase enemies that try to dodge.
Enemies inside the cloud cannot see past it and are slowed. The cloud's damage cannot be fully blocked by shields.
This is a swarm and inscription effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and inscription effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Quill
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Spell attacks you cast in rapid succession cost slightly less mana each, down to a limit, so long as no cast is more than a moment apart.
Breaking the rhythm resets the discount. While the discount is at its limit, your cast times are shortened.
This is a speed and spell effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and spell effect.

sword.name: Edge of the Page
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a spell attack onto your blade. Your next melee strike releases the spell along the line of the cut, extending its reach well beyond the weapon.
A spell released this way counts as both a spell attack and a weapon strike for any effect that triggers on either.
Writing onto the blade costs the spell's mana and holds for a short time.
This is a blade and inscription effect.
sword.tag: This is a blade and inscription effect.

talisman.name: Kept Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can inscribe one spell attack onto your amulet. While the amulet is worn, that spell costs no mana but cannot be cast more than once in a short span.
If a lethal blow strikes you while the amulet is worn, its inscription breaks to absorb it and releases its inscribed spell at full strength around you. A broken inscription must be written anew.
This is a charm and inscription effect.
talisman.tag: This is a charm and inscription effect.

tentacle.name: Reaching Script
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks trail written tendrils that cling to the target. A clinging tendril drags the target a short distance toward you when the spell lands.
Enemies held by a tendril cannot use movement abilities. Larger and higher-rank enemies are slowed rather than dragged.
This is a grasping and spell effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a grasping and spell effect.

thread.name: Stitched Verse
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
A spell attack that strikes two enemies in a row stitches them together with a glowing thread. Damage dealt to one stitched enemy is shared in part with the other.
You can pull the thread taut, dragging the two enemies together and stunning both briefly. Pulling the thread breaks it.
This is a binding and spell effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and spell effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Psalm
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
A storm-bird of written lightning circles above you. When you cast a spell attack, the bird stoops on the same target a moment later, inflicting lightning damage.
When you take a heavy blow, the bird answers instead with a thunderclap around you that deafens and pushes back nearby enemies. It then needs a short time to return.
This is a storm and companion effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and companion effect.

time.name: Wound Spring
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can cast a spell attack with a delay. The spell is written into the moment and lands after a short time of your choosing, at increased strength for the time it waited.
You can hold several delayed spells at once, and release them all early by casting a final spell that unwinds the spring.
This is a time effect.

tranquil.name: Still Water Calligraphy
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks are silent. They do not alert enemies other than the target, and enemies struck by them lose their enraged or frenzied states.
While you are not in combat, your mana recovers rapidly, and your first spell attack of each fight costs no mana.
This is a calm and silence effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calm and silence effect.

transfiguration.name: Rewritten Form
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can rewrite the damage type of any spell attack you know into another damage type you have used in the current fight. The rewritten spell keeps its shape and secondary effects.
Rewriting a spell costs mana, and the spell keeps its new type until you rest.
This is a transfiguration effect.

transgression.name: Crossed-Line Codex
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Enemies that have just broken a rule of the fight, by fleeing, using a forbidden or restricted ability, attacking from stealth or striking a downed ally, are marked in red script.
Your spell attacks against marked enemies cannot be dodged, blocked or reflected, and deal additional damage.
This is a judgement and marking effect.
transgression.tag: This is a judgement and marking effect.

trap.name: Counterspell Snare
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can set a written snare on an area. The first enemy to begin casting a spell or ability inside it has the cast torn apart, silencing it briefly and sending its cooldown into effect.
The snare then casts your most recent spell attack at the silenced enemy.
Only one snare can be set at a time.
This is a trap and counterspell effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and counterspell effect.

tree.name: Annual Rings
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack you cast in a fight adds a ring of written bark around you. Each ring grants a small amount of damage reduction and increases your maximum mana slightly.
Rings last until the fight ends and stack up to a limit that scales with rank. At full rings, you cannot be knocked back.
This is a growth and inscription effect.
tree.tag: This is a growth and inscription effect.

troll.name: Fireproof Margin
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Health you lose while casting a spell attack begins to regenerate quickly once the spell is cast.
Enemies that regenerate are suppressed by your fire spell attacks: they cannot regenerate for a short time after being struck, and take additional damage from your other spells while suppressed.
This is a regeneration and fire effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and fire effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Diagram
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a straight diagram on the ground that rises into a low wall of written stone. The wall blocks enemy movement and projectiles.
Your own spell attacks pass through the wall, gaining bonus earth damage as they do.
The wall crumbles after a short time or once it has absorbed enough damage.
This is a construction and diagram effect.
trowel.tag: This is a construction and diagram effect.

turtle.name: Shell Script
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can withdraw into a shell of overlapping script, becoming immobile and greatly reducing incoming damage.
While shelled, you can still cast spell attacks, and each one cast from inside the shell costs no mana.
The shell has a limited duration and a long cooldown.
This is a warding and spell effect.
turtle.tag: This is a warding and spell effect.

twilight.name: Grey-Hour Script
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can spend mana to cast the grey hour over an area. Inside it, enemies have reduced vision range and cannot see you clearly beyond a short distance.
Your light and dark spell attacks deal additional damage inside the grey hour. Long shadows cast by objects within it are solid enough to block enemy projectiles.
This is a twilight effect.

undeath.name: Cold-Hand Scripture
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Enemies killed by your spell attacks rise briefly as hollow scribes that cast your basic spell attack at their former allies, then collapse.
Your spell attacks deal increased damage to living enemies whose health is lower than yours, and are not weakened while you are under a death or decay affliction.
This is an undeath and conjuration effect.
undeath.tag: This is an undeath and conjuration effect.

unity.name: Joined Hand Diagram
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When you and an ally strike the same enemy at the same moment, your spell attack and their attack combine into a single, stronger blow carrying both damage types.
Allies near you share a portion of your spell power. The more allies stand with you, the greater the share.
This is a unity and combination effect.
unity.tag: This is a unity and combination effect.

vast.name: Borderless Text
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks have no maximum range against enemies you can see or that appear on your map through tracking effects.
Spells cast at targets far beyond their normal range take longer to arrive and deal slightly reduced damage, but cannot be blocked by terrain.
This is a space and spell effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and spell effect.

vehicle.name: Carriage Glyph
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While mounted or riding, you can cast spell attacks without slowing or dismounting.
Spells cast while moving at speed carry your momentum, travelling faster and striking harder the faster you are going.
A mount you ride gains a portion of the barriers your spells grant.
This is a momentum and spell effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a momentum and spell effect.

venom.name: Thinned Wards
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each spell attack that hits an enemy thins its magical defences, stacking a vulnerability that increases all spell damage it takes.
Stacks wear off slowly. At full stacks, the target's magic resistance is lost entirely until the stacks fall away.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Creeper Script
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks leave creeping vines of green script along the ground in their path. The vines slow enemies who cross them and spread slowly over a short time.
When you cast a spell attack while standing on your own vines, the vines lash out at enemies standing on them with additional nature damage.
This is a nature and diagram effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature and diagram effect.

vessel.name: Open Cup Psalm
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can hold an enemy's spell inside yourself instead of being struck by it, spending mana to absorb it.
A held spell can be poured into your next spell attack, adding its damage and effects. You can hold only one spell at a time, and holding it slowly drains your health until it is released.
This is an absorption and channelling effect.
vessel.tag: This is an absorption and channelling effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Hand
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can copy the handwriting of an enemy you have seen cast. For a short time, your spell attacks appear to come from that enemy's allies.
Enemies struck by a spell they believe came from their own side turn on the apparent caster.
Each enemy's hand can be copied once per fight.
This is a disguise and spell effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and spell effect.

vision.name: Shown Moment
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You see faint glowing script on the ground where an enemy's attack is about to land, a moment before it does.
Spell attacks you cast at the place an enemy is about to move to strike with certainty and deal additional damage.
This is a precognition effect.

void.name: Blank Page
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw an empty diagram in the air. Any spell, yours or an enemy's, that enters it is erased.
Each spell erased this way is stored as blank mana, which you can draw on to pay for your next spell attacks.
The diagram lasts a short time and has a long cooldown.
This is a void and diagram effect.
void.tag: This is a void and diagram effect.

volcano.name: Building Pressure
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].

Mana you spend on spell attacks builds pressure inside you. At full pressure, your next spell attack erupts as a column of magma beneath its target, followed by a rain of burning ash over the surrounding area.
After the eruption, your skin crusts over, reducing damage taken for a short time, and pressure begins to build again.
This is a fire and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and eruption effect.

vortex.name: Spiral Diagram
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a spiral on the ground that slowly turns. Enemies near it are pulled toward its centre, and enemy projectiles passing over it curve inward.
Spell attacks cast into the spiral's centre spin outward again, striking every enemy caught in it.
Only one spiral can turn at a time.
This is an air and gathering effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and gathering effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Strokes
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks break into a cloud of tiny written stings on impact. The stings chase the target, striking it several times for small damage.
An enemy that attacks you while stung is struck again by every sting still on it.
This is a sting and spell effect.
wasp.tag: This is a sting and spell effect.

water.name: Pooling Script
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks leave pools of written water where they land. Pools spread into one another and join.
Casting a spell into a pool spreads its effect across every connected pool, striking each enemy standing in water.
Pools evaporate after a short time.
This is a water and spell effect.
water.tag: This is a water and spell effect.

weave.name: Warp and Weft
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your spell attacks leave threads of script hanging in the air where they pass. Threads crossing one another knot into a web of magic that holds enemies caught in it.
You can tug the web to drag every caught enemy toward its centre. Spell attacks cast into a held web strike every enemy caught in it.
This is a binding and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Ink
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your cold spell attacks inflict a hunger affliction. Enemies carrying it lose stamina over time and cannot be healed.
When an enemy dies under the hunger affliction, its remaining vitality feeds your mana. While you are below half mana, your cold spell attacks deal additional damage.
This is a cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Deep Notation
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can sound a low written note that travels outward a long way. Enemies it reaches are revealed to you and your allies, including those behind walls.
Spell attacks you cast at revealed enemies resonate, dealing bonus sonic damage that ignores physical cover.
The note has a long cooldown.
This is a sound and detection effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and detection effect.

wheel.name: Turning Wheel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw a wheel diagram around yourself that turns slowly. Spell attacks you cast are flung outward from the rim of the wheel at the point it faces, rather than from your hand.
Each full turn of the wheel releases a ring of light damage around its rim.
The wheel lasts a short time.
This is a rotation and diagram effect.
wheel.tag: This is a rotation and diagram effect.

whip.name: Lash Glyph
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can draw out a spell attack as a lash of written light. The lash strikes in an arc at mid range and cracks at its tip, dealing increased damage to an enemy struck by the tip alone.
A lash can wrap around an enemy and pull it off its feet, briefly knocking it down.
This is a lash and spell effect.
whip.tag: This is a lash and spell effect.

wind.name: Windwritten
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a spell attack onto the wind. It travels with the current, scattering across a long, narrow path and striking each enemy along it for reduced damage.
Spells written onto the wind cut through smoke, fog and gas, clearing them as they pass.
This is a wind and spell effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and spell effect.

wing.name: Winged Script
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your projectile spell attacks fly in an arc over obstacles and enemies to strike targets behind them.
Flying enemies struck by your spells are grounded briefly, losing flight and taking increased damage while grounded.
This is a flight and spell effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and spell effect.

wolf.name: Pack Hunt Text
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
When an ally strikes an enemy, your next spell attack at that enemy is cast with shortened cast time.
Each different ally that has struck an enemy in the last few moments adds bonus damage to your spells against it.
A target struck by you and two or more allies in quick succession is briefly staggered.
This is a pack and spell effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and spell effect.

wood.name: Grain of the Wood
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
While wielding a wooden staff, wand or bow, your spell attacks follow the grain of the weapon, gaining range and leaving behind splinters that root enemies briefly.
A wooden weapon used this way slowly absorbs your casting, growing in power over many fights and carrying a portion of that power to whoever wields it next.
This is a wood and spell effect.
wood.tag: This is a wood and spell effect.

wrath.name: Grudge Ledger
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Each hit you take in a fight writes a line of grudge. You can spend grudge in place of mana to cast your spell attacks.
Spell attacks paid for with grudge deal additional fire damage and cannot be interrupted. Grudge fades when the fight ends.
This is a wrath effect.

zeal.name: Burning Creed
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
You can write a creed across your own skin. For a short time, your spell attacks deal bonus holy fire damage and you cannot be feared, charmed or silenced.
When the creed ends, its remaining fervour bursts outward, damaging nearby enemies and leaving you briefly drained of mana.
The creed has a long cooldown.
This is a holy and spell effect.
zeal.tag: This is a holy and spell effect.

ziz.name: Horizon Script
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Celestial Book. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Celestial Book].
Your area spell attacks can be cast at enormous size, covering a large portion of the battlefield, at greatly increased mana cost and cast time.
While you cast one, you cannot be moved, and enemy projectiles and weather effects are turned aside around you.
Spells cast this way have a long cooldown.
This is an air and scale effect.
ziz.tag: This is an air and scale effect.

action.name: Unlisted Reflex
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
One awakening stone socketed in your confluence slot can be marked as unlisted. An ability awakened from an unlisted stone has no cast time and cannot be interrupted.
Abilities awakened this way do not appear on your character sheet or to any identification effect, and enemies receive no telegraph before they resolve.
Changing which stone is unlisted can only be done at a rank-up.
This is a concealment and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a concealment and haste effect.

adept.name: Unwritten Mastery
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you socket an awakening stone into an Adept ability, you can choose an ability candidate that the stone would not normally offer, drawn from any restricted stone you have identified before.
An ability awakened this way has no name and cannot be identified by others. It advances at an accelerated rate while it stays unnamed.
This is an awakening and concealment effect.
adept.tag: This is an awakening and concealment effect.

alchemy.name: Forbidden Distillate
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can dissolve an awakening stone into a draught instead of socketing it. Drinking it grants one ability the stone would have awakened, usable until you next rest, with no socket required.
Draughts brewed from restricted stones can be drunk regardless of rank. Each draught you drink above your rank inflicts a stacking toxicity affliction that only clears over 24 hours.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: The Quiet Socket
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can leave one awakening-stone socket deliberately empty. While it is empty, the first ability you use against an enemy that has not detected you is treated as having been awakened in that socket, gaining the full bonus of a fourth stone.
Enemies cannot identify, track or read the aura of the empty socket; to aura sense you appear one socket short.
This is a stealth and concealment effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and concealment effect.

animate.name: Waking the Unworn
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An awakening stone you carry but have not socketed can be thrown and woken. It takes a small body of moving stone and fights beside you, using one ability the stone would have awakened.
Restricted stones wake into larger, stronger bodies that will not always obey. Only one stone can be awake at a time, and it returns to your inventory as a stone when it falls.
This is an animation and summoning effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and summoning effect.

anzu.name: Stolen Thunder
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
