When an enemy within sight uses an ability, you can spend mana to snatch its name. For a short time the enemy cannot use that ability again, and the stolen name crackles around you, adding lightning damage to your attacks.
Stealing from an enemy of higher rank costs health as well as mana. Only one name can be held at a time.
This is a storm and theft effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and theft effect.

ape.name: Pelt of No Name
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can wear the essence of a defeated beast for a short time, gaining one of its natural attacks as a special attack. Wearing it costs stamina while active.
While you wear a borrowed essence, identification effects read you as that beast, and lower-rank beasts of its kind do not attack you first.
This is a transformation and disguise effect.
ape.tag: This is a transformation and disguise effect.

armour.name: Plate Without a Maker
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Armour you wear has no rank. Rank-gated armour can be equipped regardless of your rank, at the cost of a portion of your maximum stamina for each rank it exceeds yours.
Attacks that would break, corrode or strip your armour fail while you are below half health.
This is a protection and restriction-breaking effect.
armour.tag: This is a protection and restriction-breaking effect.

arsenal.name: Contraband Rack
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Weapons and items restricted by rank can be carried and equipped regardless of your rank. While equipped, a restricted item's power is capped at one rank above your own.
Shops, guards and Society inspectors cannot see restricted items you carry, and they never appear on any identification effect used on you.
This is a concealment and arsenal effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a concealment and arsenal effect.

aspect.name: Face Behind the Face
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You carry a hidden second aspect. Once per day you can swap your active essence abilities for those of the hidden aspect, chosen from the abilities you discarded when awakening. The swap lasts until you rest. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
Enemies that have identified you lose that knowledge when you swap.
This is an identity and concealment effect.
aspect.tag: This is an identity and concealment effect.

avatar.name: Crown Without a Name
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can take on a greater form whose essences cannot be identified. While in it, enemies cannot read your rank, and those below your rank cannot target you with abilities that require identifying you.
The greater form costs mana over time, and its strength scales with the number of restricted essences and stones you carry.
This is a transformation and concealment effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and concealment effect.

axe.name: The Unmarked Blow
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your first special attack against an enemy that has never seen you before cannot be blocked, parried or reduced by damage reduction.
An enemy struck by it cannot identify or track you for a short time afterward.
This is a special attack and concealment effect.
axe.tag: This is a special attack and concealment effect.

balance.name: Uneven Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can socket one awakening stone into a slot that is already full, exceeding its socket limit. While the slot is overfilled, the essence in it costs more mana to use and one of your other essences is suppressed at random each time you rest.
Removing the extra stone restores balance immediately.
This is an awakening and restriction-breaking effect.
balance.tag: This is an awakening and restriction-breaking effect.

bat.name: Echo in the Unlit
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
While you stand in darkness, your aura cannot be sensed, and aura-sense and tracking effects show an empty space where you are.
You can sense restricted essences, awakening stones and cursed items through walls within aura-sense range. They appear as silent shapes on the map.
This is a perception and concealment effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and concealment effect.

battlefield.name: Unmapped Ground
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can declare a stretch of ground where you stand as unmapped. Inside it, maps and tracking effects fail, and enemies lose track of any ally not directly in their sight.
Allies within the unmapped ground can use one ability from a restricted stone you carry, as if it were their own.
Only one unmapped ground can exist at a time, and declaring it costs mana and stamina.
This is a battlefield and concealment effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a battlefield and concealment effect.

bear.name: Den Hoard
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted awakening stones you carry can be absorbed into your body instead of stored. An absorbed stone grants a portion of its effect to every essence you hold, without needing a socket.
Each absorbed stone reduces your maximum health. Absorbed stones can be removed only by resting in a safe place.
This is an awakening and absorption effect.
bear.tag: This is an awakening and absorption effect.

bee.name: Hive Without Queen
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Awakening stones of the same kind socketed across different essences link together. Each linked stone strengthens the others, and linked abilities share a single cooldown that is shorter than any of them alone.
If a linked ability is suppressed, the others are also suppressed.
This is an awakening and link effect.
bee.tag: This is an awakening and link effect.

behemoth.name: The Uncounted Weight
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Every restricted essence or stone you carry adds to your size and mass. You resist knockback, displacement and forced movement in proportion to how much you carry that you should not.
At enough weight you cannot be moved at all by enemies of your rank or lower, but your movement speed falls.
This is a growth and resistance effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a growth and resistance effect.

bird.name: Cage Door Open
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Effects that bind, seal or restrict your essences, such as silence, suppression and essence locks, last only a brief time on you.
When you break free of one, you gain a short burst of flight-speed movement and immunity to the same effect for a short time.
This is a freedom and cleanse effect.
bird.tag: This is a freedom and cleanse effect.

blight.name: Root of the Unlisted
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your afflictions carry no name. They cannot be identified, and cleanses that target a named affliction type fail against them.
A blight that sits unidentified on an enemy for long enough spreads to every enemy that touches it.
This is an affliction and concealment effect.
blight.tag: This is an affliction and concealment effect.

blood.name: Blood Price
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can pay health instead of mana for any ability that is restricted to a higher rank than yours, using it at your own rank's strength. The health cost scales with the rank gap.
Health spent this way cannot be healed back until you rest.
This is a blood and restriction-breaking effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and restriction-breaking effect.

bone.name: Ossuary Socket
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your skeleton holds one hidden socket. Any awakening stone can be set into it, including stones restricted to other races or ranks. Its effect applies to you directly rather than to an ability.
The hidden socket cannot be seen, identified or emptied by enemies, and it does not count against any essence's socket limit.
This is an awakening and body effect.
bone.tag: This is an awakening and body effect.

boundary.name: Beyond the Margin
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Barriers, wards and sealed doors keyed to rank do not hold you. You can pass through rank-locked thresholds, astral seals and portal limits of up to one rank above your own.
Crossing one costs a portion of your maximum mana, which does not recover until you return to the near side or rest.
This is a space and boundary effect.
boundary.tag: This is a space and boundary effect.

bounty.name: Overspilled Socket
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Monsters you kill have a chance to drop an awakening stone that does not appear on any loot table. These stones cannot be identified until socketed.
When you socket one, an ally nearby receives a lesser copy of the ability it awakens, lasting until they next rest.
This is a fortune and awakening effect.
bounty.tag: This is a fortune and awakening effect.

bow.name: The Uncounted Arrow
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Projectiles you fire cannot be traced back to you. Enemies struck by them search for an attacker in the wrong direction.
Once per fight you can loose a shot that ignores rank, dealing damage to a higher-rank enemy as though it were your rank.
This is a ranged and concealment effect.
bow.tag: This is a ranged and concealment effect.

brush.name: Overgrown Path
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted areas, sealed doors and astral portals you have found but cannot enter grow a path of brush toward you over time. Once the path reaches you, you can walk the path through the seal once.
A path grows faster in regions where you have absorbed an essence.
This is a passage and growth effect.
brush.tag: This is a passage and growth effect.

cage.name: Bars That Hold Nothing
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can seal one of an enemy's essence abilities inside a cage for a short time. The sealed ability cannot be used, and you know its name and effects while it is held.
While an ability is caged, you can spend mana to use it once yourself at your own rank. Caging costs mana and fails against enemies more than one rank above you.
This is a seal and theft effect.
cage.tag: This is a seal and theft effect.

cat.name: Quiet Paws, Quiet Stones
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted essences and awakening stones you carry cannot be detected by guards, shopkeepers, the Society or identification effects.
Your footsteps make no sound while you carry a restricted item, and you can slip past lower-rank creatures without waking them.
This is a stealth and concealment effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and concealment effect.

cataclysm.name: Unwritten Ruin
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can shatter a socketed awakening stone. Its ability fires once at enormously increased power, then the stone and the ability are gone, and the socket stays cracked and unusable until you rank up.
Shattering a restricted stone this way leaves the ground beneath it ruined for the rest of the day, damaging any enemy that stands on it.
This is a destruction and sacrifice effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a destruction and sacrifice effect.

cattle.name: Yoke Unseen
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Awakening stones you have consumed leave a residue in you. Each residue grants a small amount of maximum stamina, and residues build up indefinitely.
When you have built up enough residue, you can spend it to awaken a new ability candidate in any essence without using a stone.
This is an awakening and endurance effect.
cattle.tag: This is an awakening and endurance effect.

chain.name: Link Without End
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can bind an awakening stone to a chain of your essence power and swing it as a weapon. Struck enemies suffer that stone's effect for a short time.
A chained stone is not socketed, does not count against any limit and can be swapped between fights.
This is a conjuration and awakening effect.
chain.tag: This is a conjuration and awakening effect.

chaotic.name: Loose Stone
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per day, you can socket an unidentified awakening stone blind. It awakens one ability rolled from every candidate it could produce, including candidates from other essences you do not have.
The result is random and cannot be rerolled. If you do not want it, you can remove it at your next rank-up.
This is a chaos and awakening effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and awakening effect.

charlatan.name: False Ledger
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can choose what any identification effect reports about you: your essences, your rank, your abilities and your race. You can present as any combination you have seen.
Enemies that rely on reading you choose their resistances and tactics against the false version. A higher-rank identifier sees through the lie on its second attempt.
This is an illusion and deception effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and deception effect.

chicken.name: Brood Kept Hidden
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Unawakened awakening stones you carry slowly ripen. A stone carried long enough hatches into one random restricted stone of the same rank.
While you carry a ripening stone, you fight harder in defence of allies, gaining damage when an ally near you is struck.
This is an awakening and protection effect.
chicken.tag: This is an awakening and protection effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Socket
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can graft a monster core into an empty awakening-stone socket. The socket gains one of that monster's natural abilities, such as a breath, a bite or a hide, for as long as the core lasts.
The core wears out over a number of uses, and the grafted ability sometimes fires on its own when you are hurt.
This is a grafting and monstrous effect.
chimera.tag: This is a grafting and monstrous effect.

claw.name: Talons Past the Seal
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your special attacks tear through seals, wards and barriers as though they were not there, dealing their damage to whatever stands behind them.
Striking a sealed container or locked chest with a special attack opens it without triggering any trap.
This is a special attack and seal-breaking effect.
claw.tag: This is a special attack and seal-breaking effect.

cloth.name: Shroud Without Seams
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can weave a shroud over any one item, essence or stone you own. A shrouded thing cannot be identified, stolen, destroyed or forcibly removed from you.
While shrouded, it also hides its effects from your enemies' perception abilities. Only one thing can be shrouded at a time.
This is a concealment and protection effect.
cloth.tag: This is a concealment and protection effect.

cloud.name: Vapour Ledger
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can dissolve an awakening stone into mist and hold it outside any socket. A misted stone can be condensed into any of your sockets in the middle of a fight, replacing the stone there for a short time.
The replaced stone returns when the effect ends. Condensing a stone costs mana.
This is an awakening and transformation effect.
cloud.tag: This is an awakening and transformation effect.

cold.name: Frozen Clause
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can freeze one of your essence abilities at its current strength. A frozen ability does not weaken from suppression, curses or rank-difference penalties.
While an ability is frozen, it cannot advance. Thawing it takes a short time at rest.
This is a cold and preservation effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and preservation effect.

coral.name: Grown Over the Seal
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An awakening stone left in a socket slowly grows into it. A fully grown stone cannot be removed by any means, and its effect strengthens with every rank you gain.
A grown stone also grants a small amount of resistance to the damage type of its essence.
This is an awakening and growth effect.
coral.tag: This is an awakening and growth effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Forbidden Fruit
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can absorb a cursed or corrupted awakening stone without suffering its curse. The curse turns outward and is applied to the next enemy you strike instead.
Each corrupted stone you absorb this way makes healing on you slightly weaker until you rest.
This is a corruption and absorption effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and absorption effect.

crocodile.name: Jaw That Keeps
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you kill an enemy that carries an essence ability you have never seen, you can hold that ability in your jaw. You can use a held ability once, at its original strength, before it is lost.
Only one ability can be held at a time. Holding one reduces your movement speed.
This is a theft and essence effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a theft and essence effect.

crystal.name: Facet Behind Facet
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your awakening stones grow an extra facet. Each socketed stone grants a second, lesser effect drawn from a stone you have previously consumed, chosen when the stone is socketed.
Facets are invisible to identification and cannot be suppressed separately from their stone.
This is an awakening and crystal effect.
crystal.tag: This is an awakening and crystal effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An awakening stone you remove from a socket is not destroyed. It goes fallow in your inventory and, after a full day, can be socketed again to awaken a different ability from the same stone.
A stone can only return once. Restricted stones return a rank higher than they left.
This is a cycle and renewal effect.
cycle.tag: This is a cycle and renewal effect.

dance.name: The Step Not Taken
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Abilities restricted from use while moving can be used while moving. Abilities restricted from use while stationary can be used while stationary.
Each time you break a use restriction this way, your next dodge is free.
This is a movement and restriction-breaking effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and restriction-breaking effect.

dark.name: Shadow's Second Slot
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Your shadow holds a fourth essence slot that only exists in darkness. Any essence you have previously absorbed and lost can be placed there, but its abilities can be used only while you stand in shadow.
An essence in the shadow slot cannot form or affect your confluence.
This is an essence and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is an essence and darkness effect.

dawn.name: The Hour Before Naming
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
At dawn in the game world, any restricted essence or stone within your aura-sense range is revealed to you, along with what it is and where it lies, even inside sealed containers or astral realms.
Abilities from restricted stones deal extra radiant damage during the first hour after dawn.
This is a light and revelation effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

death.name: Name Struck from the Register
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you would die, your name is struck out instead. You return immediately with a portion of your health, and for the rest of the fight no enemy can target you by name, mark or tracking effect.
This effect recovers over 24 hours. While it recovers, quest givers do not recognise you.
This is a death and identity effect.
death.tag: This is a death and identity effect.

deep.name: Pressure Below the Rank
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can enter restricted astral realms and sealed depths one rank above your own. While inside one, your abilities are not weakened by the rank gap.
Each minute spent in such a place reduces your maximum mana until you leave and rest.
This is a passage and pressure effect.
deep.tag: This is a passage and pressure effect.

deer.name: Startle the Seal
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When an enemy tries to suppress, silence or seal one of your abilities, you flinch out of reach of the effect and gain a brief burst of speed.
This can happen once every short interval. Enemies that fail to seal you this way are briefly startled and lose their next action.
This is an evasion and seal-breaking effect.
deer.tag: This is an evasion and seal-breaking effect.

desolate.name: Salted Socket
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can salt an enemy's essence. For a short time, the enemy cannot use abilities awakened from its awakening stones, only its base essence abilities.
An enemy that dies while salted drops no awakening stones, and nothing grows or respawns where it fell for the rest of the day.
Salting costs mana and works only on enemies at your rank or lower.
This is a suppression and desolation effect.
desolate.tag: This is a suppression and desolation effect.

dimension.name: Pocket Beyond the Count
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can fold a whole essence out of yourself and store it in a pocket of space, freeing its slot. A folded essence keeps its abilities and stones, ready to unfold into an empty slot later.
Unfolding takes a short ritual at rest. Folding an essence out removes your confluence until it returns.
This is an essence and dimensional effect.
dimension.tag: This is an essence and dimensional effect.

discord.name: The Wrong Note Sounded
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can socket awakening stones that clash with their essence, such as a fire stone in an ice essence. A clashing stone produces an unstable ability candidate that combines both natures.
Unstable abilities have a chance to backfire on use, dealing a portion of their effect to you instead.
This is an awakening and discord effect.
discord.tag: This is an awakening and discord effect.

discordant.name: Wrong Interval
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Your attacks can strike a wrong note in an enemy's confluence. An enemy struck this way has its confluence abilities fail for a short time, and its three essences briefly work against each other, dealing damage to it whenever it uses an ability.
The same enemy cannot be struck this way again until the effect ends.
This is a disruption and sound effect.
discordant.tag: This is a disruption and sound effect.

dog.name: Faithful to the Forbidden
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your familiars and summons can carry one restricted awakening stone each. A summon carrying a stone gains that stone's effect on its own attacks.
If a stone-carrying summon is destroyed, the stone returns to your inventory rather than being lost.
This is a summoning and awakening effect.
dog.tag: This is a summoning and awakening effect.

doom.name: Final Sealing
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can seal one of your own abilities in an enemy's name. That ability goes dark for you, and the enemy is marked. When the mark ends after a long delay, the sealed ability resolves on the enemy at full power wherever it is, and comes back to you.
Only one ability can be sealed at a time. If the marked enemy dies first, the ability returns immediately.
This is a doom and delayed effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and delayed effect.

doppelganger.name: Two Sheets
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You keep a second set of awakening-stone sockets that no one can see. Once per day, out of combat, you can swap your visible stones for the hidden set.
Abilities from the hidden set are invisible to identification, and enemies who have fought you before are not prepared for them.
This is a duplication and concealment effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a duplication and concealment effect.

dragon.name: Hoard of the Nameless
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Every restricted essence and awakening stone you carry, socketed or not, counts toward a hoard. Your fire damage and your resistance to damage increase with the size of the hoard.
If the hoard is stolen or lost, you gain a fury that heightens your fire damage until it is recovered or you rest.
This is a fire and hoard effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and hoard effect.

duck.name: Water Off the Seal
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restrictions placed on you by others, such as bans, wanted notices, guild prohibitions and quest locks, do not stick. Settlements forget you were banned after you rest outside them.
Afflictions that would prevent you from absorbing an essence or socketing a stone are cleansed from you when you rest.
This is a cleanse and freedom effect.
duck.tag: This is a cleanse and freedom effect.

dust.name: Grey Ledger
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can grind an awakening stone into dust and scatter it in an area. Every ally standing in the dust gains that stone's effect for a short time.
Stones of a higher rank than you can be ground this way, but their dust fades quickly.
This is an awakening and area effect.
dust.tag: This is an awakening and area effect.

earth.name: Stone Under Stone
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Crafting nodes you harvest have a chance to yield a buried awakening stone that is not on any loot table.
Buried stones are always unidentified until socketed and are drawn from the restricted list.
This is a harvesting and discovery effect.
earth.tag: This is a harvesting and discovery effect.

echo.name: What Was Unsaid
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

When an enemy uses an essence ability near you, an echo of that ability lingers in the air for a short time. You can absorb the echo to awaken it as a temporary ability candidate in one of your essences.
A temporary ability lasts until you rest. You can hold only one at a time.
This is an essence and echo effect.
echo.tag: This is an essence and echo effect.

eclipse.name: Swallowed Name
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
While standing in darkness, your essences cannot be detected by aura sense and your abilities cannot be identified, even by enemies above your rank.
You can spend mana to cast a moving shadow over an ally, extending the same concealment to them for a short time.
This is a darkness and concealment effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and concealment effect.

edifice.name: Foundation Stone
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can set an awakening stone into the ground as a foundation stone. A structure of stone rises around it that uses the stone's ability against nearby enemies.
While a stone is laid this way, its socket in you is empty. Picking the structure up returns the stone. Only one foundation stone can stand at a time.
This is a construction and awakening effect.
edifice.tag: This is a construction and awakening effect.

effigy.name: Straw Name
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can bind your name into an effigy made from an awakening stone. While the effigy stands, any effect that targets you by name, mark or identification lands on the effigy instead.
The effigy breaks after absorbing enough harm and the stone is destroyed. Only one effigy can exist at a time, and it cannot move.
This is a sacrifice and redirection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sacrifice and redirection effect.

elemental.name: Raw and Nameless
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can strip the element from one of your abilities, leaving raw, typeless damage that no resistance or immunity reduces.
A stripped ability loses any secondary elemental effect, such as burning or freezing, until you restore it at rest.
This is an elemental and restriction-breaking effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and restriction-breaking effect.

elixir.name: Draught of the Unlisted
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can dissolve an awakening stone into a potion. Drinking it grants the stone's effect to every ability you have for a short time.
A dissolved stone is consumed. Potions made this way cannot be identified by others and cannot be sold.
This is an alchemy and awakening effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and awakening effect.

empower.name: Lent Socket
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can lend one of your awakening stones to an ally by touch. For a short time, the ally can use the ability it awakened, empowered by your own stats, while the socket in you sits empty.
If the ally is of a lower rank, the lent ability ignores their rank limit while it lasts. The stone returns when the effect ends or the ally falls.
This is an empowerment and boon effect.
empower.tag: This is an empowerment and boon effect.

eye.name: The Eye That Is Not Seen
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can identify restricted items, essences and stones that refuse identification, learning their full effects.
Any creature that tries to identify you sees nothing, and the attempt reveals to you everything about the creature that made it.
This is a perception and counter-identification effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and counter-identification effect.

feast.name: Seat at the Closed Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted vendors, black markets and hidden stalls open to you. They sell restricted awakening stones and essences unavailable anywhere else.
Food you eat from a restricted stall grants a feast boon that lasts until you next rest.
This is a trade and discovery effect.
feast.tag: This is a trade and discovery effect.

feeble.name: Borrowed Weakness
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can take the rank-based weakness of a stronger enemy into yourself. While you carry it, you take more damage, but the enemy loses its rank advantage over you.
Carrying a weakness costs mana over time and ends if either of you falls below half health.
This is a weakness and rank effect.
feeble.tag: This is a weakness and rank effect.

fertile.name: Seeded Stone
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can plant a spent or cracked awakening stone in fertile ground. Over the following days it grows into a node that can be harvested for awakening stones of the same essence.
Stones grown this way are always unidentified, and one in each harvest is restricted. Only one stone can be growing at a time.
This is a growth and harvest effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and harvest effect.

fey.name: Bargain Without Witness
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can strike a bargain with an intelligent enemy before combat: name a single ability, and neither of you may use the equivalent ability type for the fight.
Whoever breaks the bargain loses access to all their awakening-stone abilities for the rest of the fight. Enemies of higher rank can refuse.
This is a binding and pact effect.
fey.tag: This is a binding and pact effect.

fire.name: Pyre for the Unnamed
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can burn an unidentified awakening stone in a pyre. The flames reveal what it was and grant you its effect for a short time as a fire aura.
Burning a restricted stone this way leaves its ash, which can be crafted into an item that carries a lesser form of the stone's effect.
This is a fire and awakening effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and awakening effect.

firebird.name: Ash Without a Mark
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you move with a movement ability, you can leave burning ash behind in your place. Tracking effects, marks and lock-ons follow the ash rather than you.
The ash burns enemies that stand in it and fades after a short time, after which any mark it carried is lost.
This is a fire and evasion effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and evasion effect.

fish.name: Shoal of Stones
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Duplicate awakening stones you carry merge into a shoal. A shoal of three stones can be socketed as a single stone with a stronger effect.
A shoal counts as one stone for socket limits but cannot be split apart once merged.
This is an awakening and merge effect.
fish.tag: This is an awakening and merge effect.

flea.name: Leap Past the Rank
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per day, you can attempt a quest, contract or bounty that is restricted to a higher rank than yours. Rewards from it are scaled to the higher rank.
While on such a quest, you cannot flee from fights by normal means. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a quest and rank-breaking effect.
flea.tag: This is a quest and rank-breaking effect.

flesh.name: Meat Remembers the Stone
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you absorb an awakening stone, your body keeps a scar of it. Scars grant a small passive bonus related to that stone's essence and never fade.
Scars from restricted stones are larger and visible, and characters who see them may react with fear or suspicion.
This is an awakening and body effect.
flesh.tag: This is an awakening and body effect.

foot.name: Unmapped March
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Places that do not appear on any map, such as hidden realms, unmarked ruins and forgotten paths, can be found by walking. Travelling for long enough in a region reveals one of them nearby.
You move faster across unexplored ground.
This is a discovery and movement effect.
foot.tag: This is a discovery and movement effect.

force.name: Brute Exception
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your physical attacks ignore rank-based damage reduction entirely. An enemy above your rank takes your physical damage as if it were your rank.
Each hit against a higher-rank enemy costs you stamina in proportion to the gap in rank.
This is a force and rank-breaking effect.
force.tag: This is a force and rank-breaking effect.

forge.name: Billet Stone
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
At an anvil, you can hammer two awakening stones of the same essence into one. The result awakens an ability drawn from both stones' candidate pools.
Forging a restricted stone into an ordinary one makes the result restricted. Forging always risks cracking both stones, and the risk rises with each forging the stone has already undergone.
This is a crafting and fusion effect.
forge.tag: This is a crafting and fusion effect.

fork.name: Third Tine
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When awakening an ability, you can choose two candidates instead of one. The second becomes a branch of the first, and you switch between them freely between fights.
Branches share advancement, so each grows more slowly.
This is an awakening and branching effect.
fork.tag: This is an awakening and branching effect.

fortress.name: Sealed Keep
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your essences and awakening stones cannot be suppressed, stripped, stolen or sealed by any effect from an enemy of your rank or lower.
You can extend this protection to allies standing within a short distance of you, at the cost of mana over time while you hold still.
This is a protection and fortification effect.
fortress.tag: This is a protection and fortification effect.

fox.name: Forged Provenance
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted items you carry can be given a false identity. Others who identify them see an ordinary item of your choosing.
Items with a false identity can be sold at their true value to vendors who would normally refuse them.
This is a deception and trade effect.
fox.tag: This is a deception and trade effect.

frog.name: Spring From the Sealed Pool
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When an ability of yours is suppressed or sealed, it gathers pressure instead of going quiet. When the seal ends, the ability's cooldown resets and its next use is significantly stronger.
The longer the seal lasted, the stronger the release.
This is a release and seal-breaking effect.
frog.tag: This is a release and seal-breaking effect.

fungus.name: Mycelial Sockets
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Awakening stones socketed into the same essence spread a hidden network between them. Each stone in a full essence grants a lesser copy of its effect to the abilities in your other essences.
The network is invisible to identification, and dispel effects cannot sever it.
This is an awakening and network effect.
fungus.tag: This is an awakening and network effect.

garuda.name: High Exemption
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
For a moment after you leap or dash, you are exempt from rank-based restrictions on abilities and items. Restricted stones you carry can be used even if their rank is above your own.
The exemption ends as you come to rest, and any restricted ability used during it goes on a long cooldown.
This is a flight and exemption effect.
garuda.tag: This is a flight and exemption effect.

gate.name: Unnumbered Door
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can open a doorway into a small space that appears on no map. Restricted essences and stones placed there cannot be found, stolen or detected by anyone else.
Once per day, you can step through the doorway yourself and step out at any doorway you have previously passed through.
This is a space and concealment effect.
gate.tag: This is a space and concealment effect.

gathering.name: Drawn From Nowhere
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per day you can call an awakening stone you own to your hand from any distance, including from storage, a sold stack at a shop, or a companion's inventory. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
A stone called from a shop leaves its price owed, and the vendor remembers.
This is a summoning and dimensional effect.
gathering.tag: This is a summoning and dimensional effect.

glass.name: Cracked Lens
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can see the ability candidates an awakening stone would offer before socketing it, including hidden candidates that normally only appear at higher rank.
Choosing a hidden candidate cracks the stone's socket, which cannot hold another stone until you rank up.
This is a perception and awakening effect.
glass.tag: This is a perception and awakening effect.

glimeron.name: Split Name
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When an identification effect reads you, it receives a scatter of partial results instead of one true one. Each fragment reports a different essence, rank or ability.
Your spell attacks also split into several weaker beams when they pass through an ally, each striking a different enemy.
This is a light and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and refraction effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Against the Rule
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Effects that would forcibly change your essences, swap your abilities, steal your stones or reroll your awakening fail against you.
Each time one fails, you gain a brief boon of increased resistance to all damage.
This is a protection and stubbornness effect.
goat.tag: This is a protection and stubbornness effect.

gorgon.name: Stone That Was Never Cut
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An enemy who meets your gaze while its abilities are on cooldown has its essence turned briefly to stone: it cannot use awakening-stone abilities until it looks away.
An enemy petrified this way that dies drops an unidentified awakening stone of one of its own essences.
This is a petrification and gaze effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and gaze effect.

griffin.name: Claim From Above
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted essences and stones within your sight from a high place are marked as claimed. A claimed item cannot be picked up or used by anyone else until you have had a chance to reach it.
Leaping onto a claimed item's location deals impact damage to all enemies near it.
This is a claim and flight effect.
griffin.tag: This is a claim and flight effect.

growth.name: Growth Past the Limit
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
One of your essence abilities can keep advancing beyond the limit of your current rank. It continues gaining strength from use, up to the strength of one rank above.
That ability costs more mana to use while it exceeds your rank.
This is an advancement and rank-breaking effect.
growth.tag: This is an advancement and rank-breaking effect.

guardian.name: Barred Inheritance
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Effects that would strip, steal or suppress an ally's essences or awakening stones are redirected to you, provided you are close enough to them.
While you hold a redirected effect, your own restricted abilities deal increased damage. Each redirected effect costs you a portion of your health.
This is a protection and redirection effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and redirection effect.

hair.name: Ten Thousand Tethers
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can thread one strand of an awakening stone's power through every ability in an essence. Each ability gains a sliver of the stone's effect while the stone stays socketed.
Threading costs mana when the stone is socketed and cannot be done while in combat.
This is an awakening and binding effect.
hair.tag: This is an awakening and binding effect.

hammer.name: Unmade on the Anvil
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can break an awakening stone with a special attack to strike with its full power once. The blow carries the stone's effect, amplified, in a burst around the target.
A stone broken this way is gone. Restricted stones break with a larger burst.
This is a special attack and awakening effect.
hammer.tag: This is a special attack and awakening effect.

hand.name: The Hand That Signs Nothing
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can craft items that use restricted materials and stones as ingredients without the required recipe, guild licence or rank.
Items you craft this way carry no maker's mark and cannot be identified by anyone else.
This is a crafting and restriction-breaking effect.
hand.tag: This is a crafting and restriction-breaking effect.

harmonic.name: Off-Key Harmony
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your confluence can form from essences that do not normally combine. When it does, you gain a nameless confluence whose abilities are drawn from the three essences' shared traits.
A nameless confluence cannot be identified, and it can change its nature once each time you rank up.
This is a confluence and restriction-breaking effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a confluence and restriction-breaking effect.

harpy.name: Snatched Stone
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you strike an enemy with a leaping attack, you can tear one awakening stone's power from it. The enemy loses that ability for the rest of the fight, and you can use it once.
Stealing from a higher-rank enemy causes a shriek that alerts every enemy nearby. The same enemy cannot be robbed twice.
This is a theft and flight effect.
harpy.tag: This is a theft and flight effect.

harvest.name: Gleaned Essence
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

When you kill an enemy with an essence you do not hold, you can glean a trace of it. Gleaned traces accumulate, and once enough of a single essence is gathered they condense into an essence of that type.
Gleaning works on restricted and unlisted essences. Only one essence can be gleaned at a time, and switching discards the progress.
This is a harvest and essence effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and essence effect.

heidel.name: Hooves on Hidden Roads
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can summon a mount that walks on roads no one else can see. While riding, you can cross region borders, guarded gates and sealed passes without challenge.
The mount refuses to enter settlements and is dismissed if you attack from its back.
This is a mount and passage effect.
heidel.tag: This is a mount and passage effect.

hook.name: Barbed Theft
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your special attacks can hook an awakening stone's effect out of an enemy's ability, suppressing it for a short time.
While you hold a hooked effect, your next ability carries it. Hooking costs stamina and fails against enemies more than one rank above you.
This is a theft and special attack effect.
hook.tag: This is a theft and special attack effect.

horse.name: Ride Through the Seal
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you charge, you can carry one ally through sealed barriers, wards and locked doors alongside you.
Barriers breached this way cannot be closed again for a short time, and enemies behind them are knocked back.
This is a movement and seal-breaking effect.
horse.tag: This is a movement and seal-breaking effect.

hunger.name: Appetite for the Forbidden
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can eat an essence instead of absorbing it. Eating it grants a large permanent increase to one attribute of your choice, related to that essence.
You can eat a number of essences that scales with your rank. Eating an essence that would form a forbidden confluence grants a larger increase.
This is an essence and consumption effect.
hunger.tag: This is an essence and consumption effect.

hunt.name: Trail of the Unnamed Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can track creatures that carry restricted essences, including ones that are hidden from all other tracking. Their trail appears on your map.
Killing such a creature guarantees one restricted awakening stone as loot.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
hunt.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

hydra.name: Severed Regrowth
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When one of your awakening-stone abilities is sealed, suppressed or stripped, a second copy of it grows into an empty socket and remains usable while the effect lasts.
Each copy that grows this way costs a portion of your maximum health until you rest.
This is a regrowth and resistance effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regrowth and resistance effect.

ice.name: Frost-Locked Socket
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can lock an awakening stone in ice inside its socket. A locked stone cannot be removed, stolen or suppressed, and its effect cannot be dispelled.
While any stone is locked, your movement speed is slightly reduced. Unlocking takes a short time at rest.
This is a cold and protection effect.
ice.tag: This is a cold and protection effect.

immortal.name: The Unrecorded Year
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Once per day, when you would die, your name is struck from death's record instead. You remain standing at a portion of your maximum health and cannot be targeted by identification or marks for a short time.
While the effect is recovering, restricted abilities you use cost health in place of mana. The effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a survival and erasure effect.
immortal.tag: This is a survival and erasure effect.

iron.name: Iron Against the Unseen
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You deal increased damage to creatures that are invisible, nameless, unidentifiable or hidden from tracking.
Striking such a creature with a weapon reveals it to you and your allies for a short time.
This is a revelation and anti-concealment effect.
iron.tag: This is a revelation and anti-concealment effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Clause
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
While you are charging or moving at full speed, effects that would restrict, seal or root you fail.
Each effect that fails this way adds momentum, increasing the damage of your next collision. Stopping voluntarily ends the momentum.
This is a momentum and immunity effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and immunity effect.

karmic.name: Debt Unsettled
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When an enemy uses a restricted or forbidden ability against you, the debt is recorded. You can spend mana to call it in, forcing the same ability back on the enemy at its full power.
Only one debt can be held at a time, and it expires if you rest.
This is a karmic and reflection effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and reflection effect.

knife.name: Knife Between the Lines
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can cut a single restriction from an item, such as a rank requirement, a race requirement or a soulbind. The item can then be used, equipped or traded freely.
Each item can only have one restriction cut. Cutting one damages the item's durability.
This is an item and restriction-breaking effect.
knife.tag: This is an item and restriction-breaking effect.

knowledge.name: Margins of the Book
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can read and absorb skill books that are forbidden, sealed or restricted to other ranks and races.
Each forbidden book absorbed grants its skill and a hidden passive from its margins. Hidden passives are not shown on your character sheet.
This is a knowledge and restriction-breaking effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and restriction-breaking effect.

kraken.name: From Below the Listing
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can reach into deep water or darkness and pull out an unidentified awakening stone, once per day.
The stone is always of an essence you do not hold, and socketing it into one of your essences awakens an ability that uses its essence instead.
This is a deep and awakening effect.
kraken.tag: This is a deep and awakening effect.

leviathan.name: Wake of the Unlisted
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your passing disturbs the essences of everything around you. Enemies within a short distance of you suffer increased cooldowns while you are moving.
Allies near you are carried along instead, gaining reduced cooldowns while they keep pace with you.
This is a water and disruption effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and disruption effect.

life.name: Life Without a Ledger
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Healing you receive cannot be prevented or reduced by anti-healing afflictions.
When you are healed above your maximum health, the excess is held as a nameless reserve. The reserve heals you automatically when you fall below a quarter of your health.
This is a healing and reserve effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and reserve effect.

light.name: What the Light Won't Show
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can cast a light that reveals restricted essences, stones and hidden effects on any creature or item it touches.
The same light, cast on yourself, makes you appear to carry nothing restricted at all, for a short time.
This is a light and revelation effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

lightning.name: Arc Across the Rank
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per fight, you can channel lightning into an ability restricted to a higher rank. That ability is usable once at your rank's strength.
Using it this way leaves you briefly stunned when the ability resolves.
This is a lightning and rank-breaking effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and rank-breaking effect.

lizard.name: Shedding Skin
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per day, you can shed the effects of every negative status, curse, mark and tracking effect on you at once.
The shed skin remains where you stood and is mistaken for you by enemies for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a cleanse and decoy effect.
lizard.tag: This is a cleanse and decoy effect.

locust.name: Swarm of Unspoken Stones
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can release your unsocketed awakening stones as a swarm. The swarm surrounds you, granting each stone's effect to your abilities while it lasts.
Each stone in the swarm has a chance to be lost when the swarm ends. Restricted stones are never lost.
This is an awakening and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is an awakening and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Out of Corruption
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Corrupted, cursed and tainted awakening stones can be socketed without their drawbacks. You receive the ability; the corruption stays in the stone.
Cleansing yourself also cleanses any corruption from stones you carry, turning them into ordinary restricted stones.
This is a purification effect.

lurker.name: Below the Register
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You do not appear on any quest log, bounty board, kill tally or settlement registry. Enemies cannot call for help against you, and guards do not respond to your crimes.
While unregistered, you cannot receive quest rewards from official sources.
This is a concealment and anonymity effect.
lurker.tag: This is a concealment and anonymity effect.

magic.name: Unwritten Arcana
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Once per rank, you can absorb an awakening stone of a type your essences would normally reject. The ability it awakens is unnamed, cannot be identified by anyone but you, and draws on raw mana with no element.
Spells you cast from unnamed abilities ignore resistances tied to a specific damage type.
This is a magic and concealment effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and concealment effect.

malign.name: Grudge Ledger
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An enemy that damages you is entered in a ledger only you can read. Abilities you use against an entered enemy cannot be identified, predicted or countered by it.
When an entered enemy dies, you may strike its name out, gaining a brief boon of increased damage against its kin for the rest of the day.
This is a curse and concealment effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and concealment effect.

manatee.name: Drifting Socket
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
One awakening-stone socket on each of your essences is unmoored. Out of combat, you can move the stone in an unmoored socket to the unmoored socket of a different essence without destroying it.
The ability it awakens takes on the new essence's flavour until moved again. Moving a stone can be done once per day.
This is an awakening and transference effect.
manatee.tag: This is an awakening and transference effect.

manticore.name: Second Face
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Identification effects used on you show a mundane person of no rank. Enemies treat you as non-threatening until you attack.
Your first attack against an enemy that has misread you this way fires a spined volley from your hidden tail, inflicting a paralytic affliction.
This is a deception and venom effect.
manticore.tag: This is a deception and venom effect.

master.name: Mastery Unsanctioned
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Abilities awakened from restricted stones advance at an accelerated rate and can be raised one rank above your own.
An ability raised above your rank this way costs significantly more to use until you reach its rank.
This is a mastery and advancement effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and advancement effect.

might.name: Weight Beyond Rank
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your special attacks ignore the damage reduction enemies gain for being higher rank than you.

Once per day, you can spend a large portion of your stamina to strike as if you were one rank higher for the duration of a single special attack. Afterward you are exhausted, and stamina recovery stops for a short time.
This is a force and rank-defying effect.
might.tag: This is a force and rank-defying effect.

ministration.name: Unwritten Remedy
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your healing can treat afflictions that are listed as uncleansable, sealed or unremovable. Each such affliction you remove is drawn into you instead, and its duration is halved while you carry it.
Healing an ally of a higher rank costs additional mana.
This is a healing and transference effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and transference effect.

minotaur.name: The Uncharted Maze
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can turn the area around you into a maze that appears on no map. Enemies inside lose all tracking and map information and move more slowly when not moving toward you.
You know the maze perfectly, and your charges inside it ignore walls you raised. The maze lasts a short time and costs stamina to raise.
This is a maze and terrain effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a maze and terrain effect.

mirage.name: Where It Should Not Be
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can project a false image of an awakening stone, essence or item onto the ground. Enemies who can see it are drawn toward it and will try to pick it up.
An enemy that touches the false item triggers one of your restricted abilities at its position. Only one false item can exist at a time.
This is an illusion and lure effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and lure effect.

mirror.name: Unanswered Reflection
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Identification, tracking and divination effects aimed at you return a false reflection of their caster instead of you.
When an enemy uses an ability that copies or mimics, you can spend mana to make the copy turn on its maker. Its own reflection attacks it briefly before vanishing.
This is a reflection and concealment effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and concealment effect.

monkey.name: Light Fingers
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can lift an awakening stone or restricted item from a living enemy's possession by striking it from behind while unseen. The stolen item goes straight to your inventory, and the enemy does not notice the theft until the fight ends.
Each enemy can be robbed once. Higher-rank enemies notice immediately and become enraged.
This is a theft and stealth effect.
monkey.tag: This is a theft and stealth effect.

monolith.name: Before Naming
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can raise a standing stone engraved with no name. Within its shadow, no essence can be identified, sealed or suppressed — yours, your allies' or your enemies'.
The stone lasts until you leave the area. Only one can stand at a time, and raising it costs a significant portion of mana.
This is an earth and neutrality effect.
monolith.tag: This is an earth and neutrality effect.

moon.name: Tidelocked Sockets
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Awakening stones socketed into your essences wax and wane with the night. Abilities they awaken grow stronger after dark and weaker by day.
On the night of a full moon, you can socket a fifth stone into one essence. The stone falls loose at dawn, unharmed, and can be socketed again on the next full moon.
This is a lunar and awakening effect.
moon.tag: This is a lunar and awakening effect.

mouse.name: Missing From the Count
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You do not appear in head-counts, guard rosters or tracking effects while you stand still in cover.
Restricted areas, sealed vaults and forbidden shelves in shops do not register you as an intruder unless you are seen directly. Anything you take from such places cannot be traced back to you.
This is a stealth and concealment effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and concealment effect.

myriad.name: Unnumbered Self
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can keep a second, unnamed set of awakening stones bound to you without socketing them. Once per day, out of combat, you can swap your socketed stones for the unnamed set in a single moment.
Enemies that identified you before the swap see the abilities you had, not the abilities you have.
This is a dimensional and identity effect.
myriad.tag: This is a dimensional and identity effect.

mystic.name: Knowing the Unknowable
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can identify items, essences and awakening stones that are otherwise unidentifiable, including restricted, sealed and astral ones. This requires meditation for a short time out of combat.
Identifying something above your rank costs a portion of your maximum mana until you rest.
This is a perception and insight effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and insight effect.

nebula.name: Thinned Essence
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can spread one essence's abilities thinly across all of your sockets. Every ability from that essence becomes weaker but gains greater area of effect and reach.
While spread, that essence cannot be targeted by suppression effects because it is not anywhere in particular. You can gather it back out of combat.
This is a space and dispersal effect.
nebula.tag: This is a space and dispersal effect.

needle.name: Eye of the Needle
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can thread a single awakening stone through a sealed or occupied socket, stitching it alongside the stone already there. The stitched stone adds one effect of its own to the ability, chosen when you stitch it.
Only one essence can hold a stitched stone at a time. Removing it destroys the stone.
This is a precision and awakening effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and awakening effect.

nemesis.name: Name Unforgotten
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can mark one enemy as nameless to the world. It cannot be identified, protected or buffed by its allies, who fail to recognise it as one of their own.
The mark lasts until the enemy dies or you mark another. Marking an enemy above your rank costs significant mana.
This is a hunting and isolation effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a hunting and isolation effect.

net.name: Mesh of the Unlisted
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can cast a net of restriction over an area. Enemies inside cannot use abilities granted by awakening stones of a rarity higher than the net's rank.
Restricted, cursed or nameless items dropped inside the net are drawn to you when it closes. The net costs mana to hold open and closes after a short time.
This is a binding and suppression effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and suppression effect.

network.name: Hidden Thread
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can link your party through an unseen thread. Every ally linked can use any one restricted ability you have, once per fight, without socketing anything.
The link is invisible to identification. If an ally leaves the party, the link breaks for everyone.
This is a network and sharing effect.
network.tag: This is a network and sharing effect.

oasis.name: Haven of the Unlisted
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can create a hidden rest-place that only you and your allies can find. While resting there, restricted afflictions and rank-sickness clear fully.
Restricted abilities used from within the haven cost no mana. Only one haven can exist at a time.
This is a sanctuary and rest effect.
oasis.tag: This is a sanctuary and rest effect.

ocean.name: What the Tide Brings
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Each time you return to a place you have visited before, you find something restricted that the tide has brought: an unidentified stone, a forbidden item, or a sealed core.
The tide only brings something once per place per day. Higher-rank regions bring rarer finds.
This is a tide and discovery effect.
ocean.tag: This is a tide and discovery effect.

octopus.name: Eight Hidden Holds
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
