lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can conceal up to eight items inside your own body instead of your inventory. Concealed items cannot be found, stolen, identified or confiscated by any means.
A concealed awakening stone can be absorbed in an instant, even in combat. Doing so costs a portion of your maximum health that returns over 24 hours.
This is a concealment and absorption effect.
octopus.tag: This is a concealment and absorption effect.

omen.name: Unspoken Portent
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Before you absorb an essence or awakening stone, you see the ability it would awaken, including restricted outcomes that would ordinarily stay hidden.
Once per rank, you can refuse an awakening after seeing it. The stone is kept, unspent, and will offer a different ability the next time it is absorbed.
This is a divination and awakening effect.
omen.tag: This is a divination and awakening effect.

onslaught.name: Unrelenting Exemption
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
While you attack without pause, restricted abilities in your kit have no cooldown between consecutive uses on the same target.
The chain breaks the moment you stop attacking for even a brief time, and every restricted ability then goes on full cooldown at once.
This is a relentless and chain effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a relentless and chain effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Lock
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your awakening stones and essences cannot be stripped, suppressed, stolen or sealed by any effect.
While curled in a guard stance, you are immune to identification and essence-draining effects, and enemy attacks that would remove your boons glance off your scales instead.
This is a defensive and sealing effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and sealing effect.

paper.name: Erased Entry
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can absorb a skill book written for another race, faction or rank tier that would normally refuse you. The book's text is erased as you absorb it, and no record of the skill remains anywhere but in you.
Skills learned this way cannot be identified, copied or taught by others.
This is a skill and erasure effect.
paper.tag: This is a skill and erasure effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Room Full of Wrong Names
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can fill the area with phantoms bearing false names and false essences. Enemy identification, aura sense and targeting choose a phantom at random instead of the intended target.
The phantoms dissipate after a short time or when struck. The effect costs mana scaled to how many phantoms you create.
This is an illusion and confusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and confusion effect.

phoenix.name: Rebirth Unrecorded
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you are revived by any means, you return with a fresh set of awakening-stone sockets: you can socket a new set of stones immediately without waiting for a rank-up.
This can happen once per day. The stones in your old sockets burn away when you return.
This is a rebirth and renewal effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a rebirth and renewal effect.

plant.name: Root Under the Seal
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can plant an awakening stone in the ground of a node or garden. Over several days, it grows into a plant that bears seeds of the same stone type.
Seeds grown this way are unnamed stones. They can be socketed into any essence, regardless of the usual compatibility.
This is a growth and awakening effect.
plant.tag: This is a growth and awakening effect.

potent.name: Unrefined Dose
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can absorb an awakening stone of a rank higher than your own. The ability it awakens is usable at full strength, but each use costs a portion of your maximum health as well as its normal cost.
The health cost ends when you reach the stone's rank.
This is a power and rank-defying effect.
potent.tag: This is a power and rank-defying effect.

predatory.name: Quarry Without a Name
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can single out one enemy from a group. That enemy loses its name to its allies' eyes: they cannot target it with healing or support, and it stands apart.
Your damage against the singled-out enemy increases the longer it remains isolated. Choosing another quarry ends the effect.
This is a hunting and isolation effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and isolation effect.

prison.name: Sealed Cell
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can lock an enemy's essence in a sealed cell. While locked, the enemy cannot use abilities from the chosen essence.
The cell lasts until the enemy breaks it or you release it. Enemies above your rank break it quickly; enemies below your rank may be held for the entire fight.
This is a sealing and imprisonment effect.
prison.tag: This is a sealing and imprisonment effect.

prosperity.name: Black Market Fortune
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Merchants who would not normally trade in restricted essences and stones will trade with you. Their prices are higher, and their stock is unidentified.
Selling a restricted item to such a merchant earns more than its listed worth. A merchant you trade with this way will not report you.
This is a trade and fortune effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a trade and fortune effect.

pure.name: Undiluted
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your essences cannot be corrupted, diluted or mixed by any effect, including those of restricted essences.
You can spend mana to purify a corrupted or cursed awakening stone, revealing what it was before it was tampered with. A purified stone is safe to absorb.
This is a purification and cleansing effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and cleansing effect.

rabbit.name: Through the Gap
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Sealed doors, warded thresholds and rank-locked barriers have a gap only you can find. You can bolt through one by spending stamina, ignoring its lock or rank requirement.
Each barrier can be passed this way once. Guards and wards behind it are alerted only after you are through.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

rake.name: Gathered Leavings
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When an enemy dies, any unabsorbed essence residue or broken awakening stone it leaves is raked into a shard pile at your feet.
Enough shards of one type fuse into an unnamed awakening stone of that type. Unnamed stones awaken abilities that are absent from every catalogue.
This is a gathering and awakening effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and awakening effect.

rat.name: What the Swarm Keeps
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Shadow rats gather restricted goods for you. Once per day, they bring one forbidden or black-market item from the region you are in: an awakening stone, a skill book or a cursed relic.
Items brought this way have no recorded owner. Selling or using them draws no attention from the Society or the city watch.
This is a summoning and acquisition effect.
rat.tag: This is a summoning and acquisition effect.

reagent.name: Unsanctioned Distillation
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can dissolve a restricted awakening stone into a potion. Drinking it grants the stone's ability for a short time without absorbing it.
The potion's effect can be shared with an ally, letting them use an ability their essences could never awaken. Each stone yields one potion.
This is an alchemical and awakening effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemical and awakening effect.

refracting.name: Bent Identification
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Identification and tracking effects aimed at you are bent away and land on another target nearby, chosen at random.
If the effect lands on an enemy, that enemy's own information is revealed to you instead.
This is a light and deflection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and deflection effect.

renewal.name: Second Season
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An awakening stone consumed by absorption leaves a husk. Once per season, you can let a husk wither and grow back, restoring it as a whole stone of the same type.
The regrown stone cannot be identified by anyone but you, and awakens a different ability from the original.
This is a renewal and awakening effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal and awakening effect.

resolute.name: Unbent Rule
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Effects that would forcibly change your essences, stones or abilities fail against you, including transformations, rank suppression and forced awakenings.
While you stand your ground without moving, enemies cannot apply suppression or silencing effects to you.
This is a resistance and anchoring effect.
resolute.tag: This is a resistance and anchoring effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Stone
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you use an ability from a restricted stone, every other stone you carry of the same essence hums. Each humming stone adds a portion of that ability's power.
The hum grows louder with each consecutive use and can be heard by enemies nearby, drawing attention to you.
This is a resonance and amplification effect.
resonating.tag: This is a resonance and amplification effect.

roc.name: Shadow From Above
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your shadow can be sent ahead of you across a short distance. Enemies within the shadow are struck by one of your restricted abilities before you arrive.
Sending the shadow costs mana, and you cannot use that ability again until you have caught up with the shadow.
This is a shadow and reach effect.
roc.tag: This is a shadow and reach effect.

rune.name: Graven Exception
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can carve a rune onto an awakening stone before absorbing it. The rune fixes one effect of the ability that awakens.
Once per rank, you can carve a nameless rune instead. The awakened ability breaks one rule of its ability type: a special attack that can be cast at range, or a spell that can be used while silenced.
This is a rune and awakening effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and awakening effect.

sacrifice.name: Unpaid Price
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can use an awakening-stone ability above your rank by paying its cost in maximum health instead of mana.
The health paid this way does not recover until you rest. If the cost would kill you, the ability fails and you are left at the brink.
This is a blood and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Grains Past Counting
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can grind an awakening stone into sand and scatter it across your essences. Each essence gains a faint trace of the stone's ability: a minor version of one of its effects, applied to every ability that essence grants.
A stone ground this way cannot be recovered. Only one stone can be scattered at a time.
This is an earth and dispersal effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and dispersal effect.

sceptre.name: Authority Unwritten
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can grant a companion or party member permission to use one of your restricted abilities. While the permission lasts, they wield it as if it were their own.
Revoking the permission is instant. Only one ally can hold it at a time, and granting it costs mana for as long as it is held.
This is a command and sharing effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a command and sharing effect.

scribe.name: Struck From the Record
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can strike an enemy's ability from the record by naming it in writing. For a short time, the enemy cannot use the struck ability.
Writing a name costs mana and requires you to have seen the ability used. Striking an ability above your rank shortens its duration.
This is a writing and erasure effect.
scribe.tag: This is a writing and erasure effect.

serene.name: Stillwater Seal
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted abilities you use cause no backlash, corruption or instability, including those that normally harm their user.
Once per day, you can calm a volatile awakening stone or essence. A calmed stone can be socketed safely into an essence that would otherwise reject it.
This is an order and stabilising effect.
serene.tag: This is an order and stabilising effect.

serpent.name: Shed Sockets
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per day, you can shed your awakening-stone sockets like a skin. Every negative effect on your essences and abilities is left behind in the shed skin.
After shedding, your awakened abilities strike with venom for a short time. The shed skin can be left as a decoy that enemies will attack.
This is a renewal and evasion effect.
serpent.tag: This is a renewal and evasion effect.

shark.name: Scent of the Forbidden
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You sense restricted essences, unidentified stones and cursed items within a wide range, as a pull in the direction of the nearest.
An enemy carrying a restricted essence is marked to you. Your attacks against it deal additional damage, and it cannot flee from you while marked.
This is a tracking and hunting effect.
shark.tag: This is a tracking and hunting effect.

shield.name: Warded Vault
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can raise a ward over a party member that hides their essences and stones from every identification, tracking and suppression effect.
While warded, an ally can socket an awakening stone that their essences would normally reject. The stone stays socketed only while the ward holds. Holding the ward costs mana over time.
This is a protective and concealment effect.
shield.tag: This is a protective and concealment effect.

shimmer.name: Misread Light
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Anyone who identifies you sees a false set of essences and abilities of your choosing. You can change the false set out of combat.
Enemies that plan against the false set are dazzled the first time one of your true abilities strikes them.
This is an illusion and concealment effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and concealment effect.

ship.name: Smuggler's Hold
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Restricted items in your inventory cannot be detected by searches, wards or customs checks when you enter a settlement.
Selling restricted goods to the right buyers in a port or city pays at black-market value. Each settlement has one such buyer, revealed to you the first time you enter.
This is a concealment and trade effect.
ship.tag: This is a concealment and trade effect.

shovel.name: Dig Beneath the Seal
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Sealed ground, buried vaults and graves warded against disturbance yield to your digging. You can dig through them without triggering their wards.
Digging on the site of a buried sealed thing has a chance to unearth a restricted essence or awakening stone, once per site.
This is an earth and excavation effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and excavation effect.

sickle.name: Harvest of the Nameless
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you kill an enemy carrying awakening stones, you can reap one of its awakened abilities before it fades. A reaped ability is held as a single charge you can use once.
Only one reaped charge can be held at a time. A charge held past the end of the day withers.
This is a harvest and theft effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and theft effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In Essence
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can create a near-copy of an essence you have seen another use. The copy acts as a fourth essence slot, awakening one ability from that essence's pool.
The copy is imperfect: its ability is weaker than the real one and it fades after a long time or when you rank up.
This is a copy and imitation effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a copy and imitation effect.

sin.name: Cherished Wrong
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Each restricted essence or stone you carry adds a mark of sin to your aura. Each mark increases the power of your restricted abilities, and also the damage you take from holy and light effects.
You can show your marks to an enemy to frighten lower-rank foes who sense them, sending them fleeing.
This is a sin and corruption effect.
sin.tag: This is a sin and corruption effect.

skirmish.name: Unregistered Contact
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
After each exchange of blows with an enemy, you can break away without the enemy being able to track where you went.
Each time you re-engage the same enemy after breaking away, your first restricted ability against it costs nothing.
This is a skirmish and evasion effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a skirmish and evasion effect.

skunk.name: Warning Unheeded
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Any creature that tries to identify, track or steal from you is doused in a lingering stench. Doused creatures are revealed to you and shunned by their allies, which will not stand close to them.
The stench lingers until the doused creature is cleansed or a short time passes.
This is a warning and retaliation effect.
skunk.tag: This is a warning and retaliation effect.

sky.name: No Ceiling Above
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your rank does not cap the number of awakening stones you can carry or the essences you can hold in reserve. You may carry restricted essences unbonded without suffering rank-sickness.
Restricted essences carried this way faintly empower your movement, letting you leap higher and fall without harm.
This is a sky and freedom effect.
sky.tag: This is a sky and freedom effect.

sloth.name: The Slow Forbidden
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can absorb a restricted awakening stone over several days instead of all at once. While it is absorbing, its ability cannot be detected, and the stone cannot be refused or rejected by your essences.
When the absorption completes, the ability awakens one tier stronger than it would have done.
This is a patience and awakening effect.
sloth.tag: This is a patience and awakening effect.

smoke.name: Vanished Ledger
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your essences, stones and abilities are veiled in smoke. They cannot be identified, and records of them on Society contracts, bounty boards and the guild ledger blur into nothing.
Bounties placed on you lose track of you each time you rank up.
This is a smoke and concealment effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and concealment effect.

snake.name: Venom in the Socket
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can coat an awakening stone in venom before giving or selling it. Anyone else who absorbs it takes a lingering poison affliction that cannot be cleansed for a short time, and the stone's ability awakens weakened.
Absorbing a venomed stone yourself grants its ability with an added poison effect.
This is a poison and trap effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and trap effect.

soaring.name: Weightless Exemption
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
For a moment after you leap or dash, your restricted abilities cost no mana.
Each restricted ability used in that moment extends it. Coming to rest ends it and puts every ability used during it on cooldown.
This is a flight and exemption effect.
soaring.tag: This is a flight and exemption effect.

song.name: Unsung Verse
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You know a verse that has no name and is sung in no tongue. Singing it out of combat lets you hear which restricted essences and stones lie within the area.
Sung in combat, it silences the effects of every awakening stone on nearby lower-rank enemies for a short time. Singing it costs mana and stamina over time.
This is a sound and suppression effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and suppression effect.

sovereign.name: Decree Without a Seal
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can decree a rule over a short distance around you: one ability type, essence or damage type is forbidden. Any creature that breaks the decree takes damage and is briefly silenced.
You are bound by your own decree. Only one decree can stand at a time, and declaring it costs significant mana.
This is a decree and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a decree and authority effect.

spear.name: Point Past the Ward
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your thrown weapons pierce wards, barriers and conjured shields without breaking them, striking whatever stands behind.
A thrown weapon that strikes a restricted-ability user pins its essence. The struck enemy cannot use abilities from that essence while the weapon remains in it.
This is a piercing and suppression effect.
spear.tag: This is a piercing and suppression effect.

spider.name: Web of Hidden Things
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can lay webs across a region map's explored areas. A web catches word of any restricted item, essence or stone that passes through it, and marks it on your map.
Webs last until you rank up. You can hold up to three at a time.
This is a tracking and network effect.
spider.tag: This is a tracking and network effect.

spike.name: Socket Spike
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can drive a broken awakening stone into an empty socket. A spiked socket grants no ability, but strikes back at any enemy that tries to suppress, seal or steal from your essences, dealing damage scaled to your rank.
A spike can be pulled free at any time, destroying it.
This is a retaliation and defensive effect.
spike.tag: This is a retaliation and defensive effect.

staff.name: Pilgrim's Pass
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Astral realms and sealed regions do not refuse you on account of rank. You can enter them as soon as you can find them.
While inside a realm above your rank, your restricted abilities cost less mana. The realm's hostile wards treat you as a traveller rather than an intruder until you attack.
This is a travel and passage effect.
staff.tag: This is a travel and passage effect.

star.name: Unlisted Star
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per rank, you can name a star that no chart records. While it stands in the night sky, abilities awakened by unnamed stones deal additional damage and cost no mana.
The star can be seen by anyone who looks for it, but no one else can find it again once it sets.
This is a celestial and empowering effect.
star.tag: This is a celestial and empowering effect.

stellar.name: Unnamed Star
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can fix an unnamed star over a point on the map. While you stand beneath it, your restricted abilities burn with stellar fire, dealing extra damage.
Enemies beneath the star cannot hide from your aura sense. Only one star can be fixed at a time, and it fades at dawn.
This is a stellar and revelation effect.
stellar.tag: This is a stellar and revelation effect.

storm.name: Storm Without a Source
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Lightning damage you deal cannot be traced to you. Enemies struck by it do not know where it came from and do not turn to attack you.
Each strike that goes unanswered builds a storm charge; spending the charge calls lightning onto every enemy that has been struck without seeing you.
This is a storm and concealment effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and concealment effect.

succubus.name: Willingly Given
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
An ally can willingly give you one of their awakening-stone abilities. You can use it as your own until you rest; they cannot use it in that time.
An enemy charmed or under your influence can be made to give an ability the same way, for a shorter time.
This is a charm and transfer effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and transfer effect.

sun.name: Noon Without Shadow
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
In full daylight, restricted abilities used against you are burned away before they land, and the user suffers fire damage.
Once per day, you can expose an enemy's hidden or unidentifiable abilities under a blaze of light. Exposed abilities can be identified, and suppression effects work on them.
This is a sunlight and exposure effect.
sun.tag: This is a sunlight and exposure effect.

swarm.name: Spread Too Thin to Name
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can scatter into a swarm for a short time. While scattered, you cannot be identified, sealed, or targeted by single-target abilities.
Abilities from restricted stones used while scattered hit every enemy the swarm touches. Reforming costs stamina.
This is a swarm and dispersal effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and dispersal effect.

swift.name: Before the Name Is Spoken
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Unnamed abilities you use take effect before any reaction can be made to them. They cannot be interrupted, dodged by anticipation or countered by triggered effects.
Each unnamed ability can be used this way once per fight.
This is a speed and evasion effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and evasion effect.

sword.name: Unsheathed Without Leave
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Weapons with rank, faction or bloodline restrictions can be wielded by you as if you met them.
Once per day, a restricted weapon you wield can release its sealed power. It deals its full damage regardless of your rank for a short time, after which it is dormant until the following day.
This is a weapon and rank-defying effect.
sword.tag: This is a weapon and rank-defying effect.

talisman.name: Small Unlisted Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can bind an awakening stone into a ring or amulet instead of socketing it. The jewel grants a passive effect drawn from the stone's ability while worn.
Rings and amulets made from restricted stones grant stronger effects but cannot be identified by anyone, including you, until worn for a full day.
This is a charm and binding effect.
talisman.tag: This is a charm and binding effect.

tentacle.name: Grasp From Below
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can reach into an enemy's essence and pull loose one awakening stone's effect. The enemy loses that ability for a short time, and you can use it once while it is held.
Reaching costs a portion of your health and fails against enemies of higher rank. Each enemy can be grasped once per fight.
This is a theft and drain effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a theft and drain effect.

thread.name: Bound to the Unnamed
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can tie a thread between two of your abilities from different essences. Using one triggers a weaker version of the other at no cost.
Only one thread can be tied at a time. Retying it takes a day, and abilities from restricted essences can be bound to any other ability regardless of type.
This is a binding and linking effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and linking effect.

thunderbird.name: The Storm That Follows
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
A small, unnamed storm follows you. Whenever you use a restricted ability, the storm strikes the nearest enemy with lightning.
The storm grows with each strike during a fight and dissipates when combat ends. Enemies above your rank are struck less often.
This is a storm and companion effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and companion effect.

time.name: Unrecorded Moment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Once per day, you can step into a moment that is not recorded. For a brief time, nothing you do appears to enemies, and abilities you use resolve only when the moment ends.
Restricted abilities used during the moment resolve together at the end, at increased power. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a time and concealment effect.
time.tag: This is a time and concealment effect.

tranquil.name: The Quiet Unnaming
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can quiet an enemy's essence. While quieted, the enemy's essences emit no aura and its awakening-stone abilities cost twice as much to use.
Quieting is silent and cannot be identified by the enemy. It costs mana and lasts a short time, ending early if you attack the target.
This is a calm and suppression effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calm and suppression effect.

transfiguration.name: Remade Socket
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can transfigure one socketed awakening stone into a stone of a different essence, keeping its rank and quality. The new stone awakens an ability from the new essence's pool.
This can be done once per rank, and only at rest. Transfiguring a restricted stone always yields another restricted stone.
This is a transformation and awakening effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and awakening effect.

transgression.name: Seen Transgressions
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can see who near you carries restricted essences, stolen stones or forbidden abilities. They are marked to your eyes and to your map.
You deal increased damage to marked enemies, and they cannot conceal their abilities from your identification.
This is a perception and judgement effect.
transgression.tag: This is a perception and judgement effect.

trap.name: Forbidden Bait
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

You can set a false restricted essence as bait. Enemies that sense essences are drawn to it, ignoring other targets, and it snaps shut on the first to touch it, rooting it and sealing its abilities for a short time.
Only one bait can be set at a time. Setting it costs mana.
This is a trap and lure effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and lure effect.

tree.name: Rings No One Counted
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Each rank you climb grows a hidden ring in your essences. A ring can store one awakening stone without socketing it, and the stone's ability is passively active at reduced strength.
Rings cannot be identified, stripped or suppressed. They hold their stones for as long as you live.
This is a growth and storage effect.
tree.tag: This is a growth and storage effect.

troll.name: Closing Thick Hide
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Damage from abilities of essences you do not hold heals over time rather than staying. Damage from fire does not heal this way.
The rate scales with the number of restricted essences and stones you carry.
This is a regeneration and resistance effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and resistance effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Hidden Course
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can wall a restricted item or essence into stone, sealing it in any wall or floor you can touch. Sealed items cannot be found by any means but your own hand.
Out of combat, you can open a hidden course in a sealed wall to retrieve what you left there, from any region you have visited.
This is a sealing and storage effect.
trowel.tag: This is a sealing and storage effect.

turtle.name: Shell Within the Shell
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your awakening stones are housed within a second, inner shell. Effects that destroy, corrupt or drain stones strike the outer shell instead, which absorbs the damage and slowly regrows.
While the outer shell is broken, your restricted abilities cannot be used until it recovers over 24 hours.
This is a defensive and sealing effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and sealing effect.

twilight.name: Grey Hour Exemption
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
During dusk and dawn in the game world, rank-based restrictions on your abilities and items do not apply.
You can spend mana to carry a grey hour with you for a short time outside those hours. It can be done once per day and recovers over 24 hours.
This is a twilight and exemption effect.
twilight.tag: This is a twilight and exemption effect.

undeath.name: Refused Unbinding
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
When you are reduced to zero health, your restricted abilities remain usable for a short time while your body refuses to stop. During that time you cannot heal.
If you deal enough damage while refusing to fall, you return to life at a sliver of health. Otherwise, you fall. This can happen once per day.
This is an undeath and endurance effect.
undeath.tag: This is an undeath and endurance effect.

unity.name: Shared Burden
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
The cost of restricted abilities — in health, mana or stamina — can be spread across willing allies in your party.
Allies who share the cost gain a portion of the ability's effect for a short time.
This is a unity and sharing effect.
unity.tag: This is a unity and sharing effect.

vast.name: Beyond the Border
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your essences can bond with a fifth, unnamed essence that occupies no slot. It cannot form a confluence and has no sockets, but grants a single passive ability drawn from the borderless whole.
The fifth essence can be released and replaced once per rank.
This is a space and essence effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and essence effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling Contraband
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your mount or vehicle carries a hidden compartment. Items in it cannot be found by any search, and a restricted essence stowed there passively grants its abilities to the mount.
A mount empowered this way gains speed and resistance to rank-based effects while you ride it.
This is a mount and concealment effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a mount and concealment effect.

venom.name: Slow-Working Corruption
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your afflictions slowly corrupt an enemy's essences. An enemy carrying enough of your poison stacks loses access to one of its awakened abilities until the afflictions are cleansed.
Corruption cannot be cleansed by any effect that requires identifying it. When a corrupted enemy dies, its corrupted stone drops as an unnamed stone.
This is a poison and corruption effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and corruption effect.

verdant.name: Root Through the Seal
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Roots grow from the ground where you stand. Roots can reach into sealed containers, rank-locked chests and warded spaces, carrying out any essence or stone within.
The roots take time to grow and can be broken by enemies. Growing them costs mana over time.
This is a growth and access effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and access effect.

vessel.name: Kept Thing
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can hold one essence that is not yours inside you without bonding it. While held, you resist that essence's abilities and can release its power once as a single blast.
Releasing it destroys the essence. Holding it causes rank-sickness if it is above your rank.
This is a vessel and containment effect.
vessel.tag: This is a vessel and containment effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Face, Borrowed Gifts
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can wear the face of a defeated enemy for a day. While wearing it, you can use one of its awakened abilities, and those who knew it treat you as it.
Wearing a face hides your own essences and nature abilities from identification. Only one face can be worn at a time.
This is a disguise and theft effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and theft effect.

vision.name: Shown Before Hidden
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You are shown, a moment in advance, any restricted or forbidden ability an enemy is about to use against you, including those hidden from identification.
Dodging a foreseen ability grants you a stack of insight; enough stacks let you use the same ability once yourself.
This is a foresight and insight effect.
vision.tag: This is a foresight and insight effect.

void.name: The Hungry Socket
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
One of your sockets is empty and hungry. Any awakening stone placed in it is devoured, and its ability is added to the next ability you use, once.
The hungry socket can also devour an enemy's suppression, seal or identification effect as it lands, negating it. Devouring costs mana.
This is a void and negation effect.
void.tag: This is a void and negation effect.

volcano.name: Pressure Behind the Seal
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Each time one of your abilities is sealed, suppressed or interrupted, pressure builds in your essence. When the pressure is full, you erupt, dealing fire damage to everything nearby and breaking all seals on you.
Pressure fades slowly out of combat.
This is a fire and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and eruption effect.

vortex.name: Unspiralled Essence
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can create a pulling vortex that draws in loose essences, awakening stones and monster cores from the ground across a wide area, delivering them to your inventory.
Enemies caught in the vortex have their boons drawn away to you. The vortex lasts a short time and costs mana.
This is a vortex and attraction effect.
vortex.tag: This is a vortex and attraction effect.

wasp.name: Sting of Exclusion
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your stings can mark an enemy as excluded. An excluded enemy cannot receive boons, healing or shared abilities from its allies for a short time.
An enemy excluded while using a restricted ability takes heavy damage and is interrupted.
This is a sting and exclusion effect.
wasp.tag: This is a sting and exclusion effect.

water.name: Pressure of the Deep Unknown
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can submerge an awakening stone in water to dissolve its name. The dissolved stone cannot be identified, and when absorbed it awakens an ability shaped by water, regardless of its original type.
In combat, pressure builds around enemies who use identification on you, slowing them and crushing their mana regeneration.
This is a water and concealment effect.
water.tag: This is a water and concealment effect.

weave.name: Woven Exception
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can weave two of your abilities together into one. The combined ability uses both effects and costs both costs, and it occupies one slot on your hotbar.
Weaving a restricted ability into an ordinary one makes the result restricted. Unweaving them requires a full rest.
This is a weaving and combination effect.
weave.tag: This is a weaving and combination effect.

wendigo.name: Starved for the Forbidden
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can devour an awakening stone or monster core to gain a surge of health, mana and stamina, regardless of its rank.
Devouring restricted items grants a stronger surge but leaves a growing cold hunger that drains stamina until you devour again or rest.
This is a hunger and consumption effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a hunger and consumption effect.

whale.name: Song of the Sunken
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can hear restricted essences calling from deep water, sealed caves and astral realms, and you can follow the call across the region map.
Once per day, you can sing back. Any restricted essence within range rises to the surface and can be claimed, if its guardian is defeated.
This is a sound and discovery effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and discovery effect.

wheel.name: Wheel of Forbidden Turns
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].

Once per day, you can turn the order of your socketed stones in a single essence. Each stone grants its effect to the socket it lands in, changing the ability that essence grants until you turn it back.
Turning abilities this way can produce combinations no catalogue lists.
This is a rotation and awakening effect.
wheel.tag: This is a rotation and awakening effect.

whip.name: Lash of Revocation
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your lash can strip a boon granted by an awakening stone from an enemy and pull it to you. You gain the stolen boon for its remaining duration.
Stripping a restricted boon also deals damage to the enemy that held it. The lash costs stamina and can strip one boon per strike.
This is a lash and theft effect.
whip.tag: This is a lash and theft effect.

wind.name: Wind Without a Name
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can scatter your essences' scent to the wind. Tracking, identification and essence-sensing effects lose you, sensing only the wind.
Once per day, a gust can carry an unidentified item in your inventory to any ally on the region map.
This is a wind and concealment effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and concealment effect.

wing.name: Pinions Past the Ceiling
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Rank ceilings on movement do not bind you. You can leap and dash in places where such movement is forbidden, including sealed vaults, warded cities and astral realms.
A leap onto an enemy of higher rank lets your attacks ignore its rank-based damage reduction for a moment.
This is a flight and rank-defying effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and rank-defying effect.

wolf.name: Pack Without Names
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Your companions and summons share your immunity to identification and tracking.
When an ally carries an unidentified item you gave them, they gain your nature immunity as well as a brief burst of damage when they attack an enemy that has tried to track the pack.
This is a pack and concealment effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and concealment effect.

wood.name: Grain Against the Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
You can carve an awakening stone's effect into a wooden weapon or staff, binding it there instead of in an essence. Anyone who wields it can use that ability.
The carving grows with the wood over time, slowly increasing in strength. Only one carved weapon can exist at a time.
This is a crafting and binding effect.
wood.tag: This is a crafting and binding effect.

wrath.name: Grudge Without Limit
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Anger builds each time an enemy uses a restricted ability or forbidden power. When anger is full, your next restricted ability ignores all resistances and rank-based defences.
Anger fades slowly out of combat and cannot be spent on ordinary abilities.
This is a fury and rank-breaking effect.
wrath.tag: This is a fury and rank-breaking effect.

zeal.name: Conviction Unsanctioned
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Religious, holy and faction-based restrictions do not bind you. You can enter consecrated ground, use temple shrines and absorb holy stones, whatever gods you follow or defy.
When you defeat an enemy that serves a faith, you gain a stack of conviction, increasing the damage of your restricted abilities until the end of the fight.
This is a zeal and defiance effect.
zeal.tag: This is a zeal and defiance effect.

ziz.name: Too Large to Name
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Nameless. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Nameless].
Weather, terrain and hazard effects cannot affect your essences or awakening stones.
Your shadow, cast across a wide area, shelters allies from enemy identification and tracking while they stand in it.
This is a scale and shelter effect.
ziz.tag: This is a scale and shelter effect.

action.name: Quickened Ending
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
The first affliction ability you use in each fight has no cast time and does not go on cooldown.
If you afflict an enemy before it has acted in a fight, its first attack or ability is delayed while the affliction takes hold.
This is an affliction and haste effect.
action.tag: This is an affliction and haste effect.

adept.name: Practiced Ruin
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Inflicting an affliction slightly shortens the remaining cooldown of your other affliction abilities.
Once per fight, you can spend the combined mana cost of every affliction ability you have to inflict all of them on one target in a single motion.
This is an affliction effect.

alchemy.name: Grave Distillery
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

You can spend mana to distil two different afflictions on one enemy into a single compound affliction. The compound carries the effects and stacks of both, and a cleanse must remove it whole or not at all.
An enemy that dies carrying a compound affliction drops a vial of it. A thrown vial inflicts the compound on whatever it shatters against.
This is an alchemical and affliction effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemical and affliction effect.

ambush.name: Blind Corner
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying your afflictions loses track of you whenever you break line of sight with it, and has to search for you as though you had never been seen.
Attacking an enemy that is searching for you adds a stack to each affliction it carries.
This is a stealth and affliction effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and affliction effect.

animate.name: Strings of the Dying
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

An enemy at low health that carries your afflictions can be taken on puppet-strings. You can spend mana to direct where it walks and whom it attacks, including its own allies, until your afflictions kill it.
A puppeted enemy cannot be healed. Enemies of higher rank than you cannot be puppeted.
This is a control and affliction effect.
animate.tag: This is a control and affliction effect.

anzu.name: Stolen Tablet
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy carries the full stacks of any of your afflictions, the strongest ability it has is torn from it for the rest of the fight.
Each time you tear an ability away, a thunderclap stuns enemies close to the target.
This is a storm and affliction effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and affliction effect.

ape.name: Thrown Back
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy afflicts you, you can spend stamina to tear the affliction off and hurl it at the nearest enemy at its current stacks. Each affliction type can be thrown back once per fight.
An enemy carrying an affliction of a kind it inflicts itself takes increased damage from it.
This is an affliction and reflection effect.
ape.tag: This is an affliction and reflection effect.

armour.name: Rusting Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each stack of your afflictions eats into the target's physical damage reduction.

When an enemy dies while carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions, the armour it shed settles over you as a layer of plate, granting damage reduction for a short time. Layers stack up to a limit that scales with rank.
This is an affliction and protection effect.
armour.tag: This is an affliction and protection effect.

arsenal.name: Bandolier of Ends
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Outside combat, you can spend mana to prepare your affliction abilities in advance. You can hold a number of prepared afflictions that scales with your rank.
A prepared affliction is thrown instantly, without cast time or cooldown. Prepared afflictions are lost when you rest.
This is a preparation and affliction effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a preparation and affliction effect.

aspect.name: Mask of the Harvest
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

Once per day, you can spend mana to wear the Reaper's aspect for a short time. While it lasts, every enemy close to you gains a stack of each affliction you have inflicted during the fight, and your afflictions cannot be cleansed.
While the aspect is worn, your affliction abilities cost more mana. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a transformation and affliction effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and affliction effect.

avatar.name: Herald's Mantle
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While three or more enemies carry your afflictions, a vast shadow of the Reaper rises behind you. Your melee reach is extended, and each melee hit adds a stack to every affliction its target carries.
The mantle falls away when fewer than three enemies remain afflicted.
This is a transformation and affliction effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation and affliction effect.

axe.name: Headsman's Mark
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

An enemy at low health that carries your afflictions is marked for the headsman. Your next special attack against a marked enemy consumes every affliction you have on it and inflicts all of their remaining damage at once.
Enemies of higher rank than you must fall lower before the mark appears.
This is an affliction and execution effect.
axe.tag: This is an affliction and execution effect.

balance.name: Even Ledger
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you are afflicted, the enemy carrying the most of your afflictions receives a matching affliction with equal stacks.
When an enemy cleanses one of your afflictions, you are cleansed of one affliction of your choice.
This is an affliction and cleanse effect.
balance.tag: This is an affliction and cleanse effect.

bat.name: Night Feeders
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that dies carrying your afflictions releases a shadow bat familiar that lasts a short time. The bat seeks the nearest enemy and inflicts a bleeding affliction with each bite.
Bats are invisible to enemies while in darkness.
This is a summoning, darkness and affliction effect.
bat.tag: This is a summoning, darkness and affliction effect.

battlefield.name: Broken Flank
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, the enemies fighting beside it falter. For a short time their damage reduction is lowered and their attacks are slower.
While three or more enemies are faltering at once, their group cannot use coordinated or pack abilities.
This is a morale and affliction effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a morale and affliction effect.

bear.name: Mauling Weight
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions is weighed down: it is slowed and cannot dash, leap or use movement abilities.
Your melee attacks against a weighed-down enemy add a stack of bleeding.
This is an affliction and slowing effect.
bear.tag: This is an affliction and slowing effect.

bee.name: The Hive
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each enemy carrying at least one of your afflictions belongs to your hive. Your affliction abilities cost less mana for each member of the hive.
While the hive is large, your afflictions sting: each hit you land on a member makes all of its afflictions tick once.
This is an affliction effect.

behemoth.name: Shadow of the Hill
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies of lower rank than you cannot resist, reduce or cleanse your afflictions.
You gain damage reduction for each lower-rank enemy close to you that carries your afflictions.
This is a rank and affliction effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a rank and affliction effect.

bird.name: Carrion Flight
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per fight, you can spend mana to make every affliction on one enemy take flight. The afflictions leave it and settle on every enemy in a wide area around it at reduced stacks.
The original target keeps none of them.
This is an affliction and dispersal effect.
bird.tag: This is an affliction and dispersal effect.

blight.name: Withering Ground
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each tick of your afflictions blights the ground beneath the target for a short time. Your afflictions do not lose duration while their target stands on blighted ground.
Blighted ground withers terrain and plants conjured by enemies.
This is a decay and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a decay and affliction effect.

blood.name: Blood Tithe
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can pay health instead of mana to use affliction abilities. Afflictions paid for in health deal increased damage.
As a health-paid affliction ticks, it returns the health you spent, so long as the target is still alive. If the target dies early, the remainder is lost.
This is a blood and affliction effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and affliction effect.

bone.name: Marrow Count
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each enemy that dies carrying your afflictions adds a bone to your count, up to a limit that scales with rank. The count empties after a while out of combat.
You can spend bones to inflict a brittle affliction, one stack per bone. Brittle enemies take additional damage from bludgeoning attacks and critical hits.
This is a death and affliction effect.
bone.tag: This is a death and affliction effect.

boundary.name: The Last Line
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to draw a line on the ground, up to a short length. An afflicted enemy that crosses the line gains a stack of every affliction it carries.
Afflictions on enemies on the far side of the line from you cannot be cleansed by their allies.
Only one line can exist at a time.
This is a boundary and affliction effect.
boundary.tag: This is a boundary and affliction effect.

bounty.name: Gleaner's Share
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that dies carrying your afflictions drops additional loot, more for each different affliction it carried.
At the moment of its death, the ally nearest to the body receives a brief healing effect.
This is an abundance and affliction effect.
bounty.tag: This is an abundance and affliction effect.

bow.name: Long Harvest
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions you inflict last longer the farther you are from the target when you apply them.
Your ranged attacks against an afflicted enemy draw its afflictions' next tick forward, so it lands immediately.
This is an affliction effect.

brush.name: Thornbed Trail
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

Enemies carrying your afflictions leave a trail of trampled, withering undergrowth that you and your allies can see and follow, even after the enemy leaves sight. The trail shows on your map until it fades.
Each stack of your afflictions makes the target slightly worse at dodging.
This is a tracking and affliction effect.
brush.tag: This is a tracking and affliction effect.

cage.name: Sentence
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying three or more of your afflictions is caged. A caged enemy cannot teleport or use movement abilities.
Cleansing a caged enemy removes only one affliction at a time.
This is an affliction and confinement effect.
cage.tag: This is an affliction and confinement effect.

cat.name: Unheard Death
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions you inflict while unseen, or from behind, are silent. The target does not notice them or alert its allies until it falls to half health.
A silent affliction deals increased damage on its first tick.
This is a stealth and affliction effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and affliction effect.

cataclysm.name: Aftershock
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, the ground under it cracks. After a short delay, an aftershock deals damage to every enemy in an area around the crack, scaled to the stacks the dead enemy carried.
Destructible terrain inside the area is broken.
This is an earth and affliction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an earth and affliction effect.

cattle.name: Slow Grazing
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An affliction you have not refreshed for a while grows heavier with each tick instead of fading.
Your afflictions continue to tick on enemies that leave combat with you.
This is an affliction effect.

chain.name: Linked Fates
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to chain two afflicted enemies together for a short time. Damage either takes from your afflictions is also dealt to the other.
If one chained enemy dies, the survivor receives all of its afflictions.
This is an affliction and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is an affliction and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Scattered Odds
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each time you inflict an affliction, the number of stacks it lands with swings unpredictably, from a single stack up to its full maximum.
When an affliction lands at full stacks this way, the target is staggered, and another affliction you know is chosen at random and inflicted alongside it.
This is a chaos and affliction effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chaos and affliction effect.

charlatan.name: Painted Boon
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
To the target and its allies, your afflictions look like boons. Enemies will not try to cleanse them.
When an enemy uses a support ability on an ally carrying one of your disguised afflictions, the affliction gains a stack instead of the boon landing.
This is a deception and affliction effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a deception and affliction effect.

chicken.name: Pecking Order
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions tick far more often, for smaller amounts each time.
Each tick interrupts a channelled ability being used by an enemy of your rank or lower.
This is an affliction and interruption effect.
chicken.tag: This is an affliction and interruption effect.

chimera.name: Grafted Plague
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each affliction you inflict has a second, different affliction you know grafted onto it.
Cleansing one half of a grafted pair moves all of its stacks onto the other half.
This is a grafting and affliction effect.
chimera.tag: This is a grafting and affliction effect.

claw.name: Open Wounds
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each hit you land on an afflicted enemy rends it, inflicting a bleed that cannot be cleansed while any of your other afflictions remain on the target.
An enemy carrying the full stacks of your bleed cannot be healed until it leaves combat.
This is a bleeding and affliction effect.
claw.tag: This is a bleeding and affliction effect.

cloth.name: Shroud-Weaving
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy killed while carrying your afflictions is wrapped in a burial shroud. A shrouded corpse cannot be raised, consumed or used by enemy abilities.
You can loot a shrouded corpse from a distance.
This is a death and binding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a death and binding effect.

cloud.name: Grey Haze
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying your afflictions is wreathed in a grey haze. Its ranged attacks and spells miss more often for each of your afflictions it carries.
The haze hides the enemy from its own allies' support abilities.
This is a concealment and affliction effect.
cloud.tag: This is a concealment and affliction effect.

cold.name: Grave Chill
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each of your afflictions on an enemy slows its attack and casting speed.
An enemy that dies while slowed this way freezes solid and shatters, chilling every enemy close to it.
This is a cold and affliction effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and affliction effect.

coral.name: Reefgrowth
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When a stack of your afflictions expires, it leaves a hard growth on the target that slows its movement. Growths fall away when the target is cleansed.
Looting an enemy that died with growths yields reef stone, a crafting reagent of a quality matching its rank.
This is a growth and affliction effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and affliction effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Rot
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Healing received by an enemy carrying your afflictions is turned into a corruption affliction of equal strength.
Corruption cannot be cleansed by the target's allies, only by the target itself.
This is a corruption and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Death Roll
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
The first time an enemy carrying your afflictions tries to move away from you, the afflictions bite down and root it briefly. This happens once per enemy per fight.
While an enemy is rooted this way, your afflictions on it tick faster.
This is an affliction and restraint effect.
crocodile.tag: This is an affliction and restraint effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Coffin
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When one of your afflictions reaches its full stacks, it crystallises: it stops ticking and stores the damage it would have dealt, and the target is briefly encased.
Any attack that strikes the encased enemy shatters the crystal and releases all of the stored damage at once.
This is a crystal and affliction effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and affliction effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When one of your afflictions runs out naturally, it returns after a short delay with a portion of its stacks. Each affliction can return once.
An enemy that dies to a returned affliction leaves fallow ground behind. Your affliction abilities used while you stand on fallow ground cost less mana.
This is a cycle and affliction effect.
cycle.tag: This is a cycle and affliction effect.

dance.name: Danse Macabre
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each time you dodge an afflicted enemy's attack or move past it, you add a stack of each affliction it already carries.
While you keep moving, your afflictions on every enemy do not expire.
This is a movement and affliction effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and affliction effect.

dark.name: Unseen Rot
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions you inflict in darkness or shadow do not appear on the target's status, and cannot be removed by cleanses that require identifying the affliction.
Your shadow-based summons and familiars recover health from damage dealt by your afflictions.
This is a darkness and affliction effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and affliction effect.

dawn.name: First Light
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions you inflict in the opening moments of a fight land at full stacks.
An enemy that ambushes you, or attacks you before you have seen it, is afflicted by every affliction ability you have off cooldown the moment it is revealed.
This is a light and affliction effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and affliction effect.

death.name: The Final Quiet
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that would be resurrected, revived or raised while carrying your afflictions fails to return.
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, you gain a brief boon of increased mana recovery for each affliction it carried.
This is a death and affliction effect.
death.tag: This is a death and affliction effect.

deep.name: Undertow
