deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each stack of your afflictions makes the target heavier. An enemy carrying enough of them cannot fly, leap or levitate.
A flying enemy dragged to the ground this way is stunned when it lands.
This is a weight and affliction effect.
deep.tag: This is a weight and affliction effect.

deer.name: Flinch
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
The first affliction you place on an unaware enemy startles it, making it flee from you for a moment.
An afflicted enemy flinches when you close to melee range, losing its next attack. This can happen once every short interval per enemy.
This is a fear and affliction effect.
deer.tag: This is a fear and affliction effect.

desolate.name: Salted Earth
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, the ground around it is salted for a long time. Enemies standing on salted ground cannot be healed, and conjured plants and terrain cannot grow on it.
Monsters do not return to a heavily salted area of a region until the salt fades.
This is a desolation and affliction effect.
desolate.tag: This is a desolation and affliction effect.

dimension.name: Folded Grave
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to fold one of your afflictions out of a target and into a pocket of space, where it waits unchanged.
For a short time, you can release a folded affliction onto any enemy you can see, at its full stacks. Only one affliction can be folded at a time.
This is a dimensional and affliction effect.
dimension.tag: This is a dimensional and affliction effect.

discord.name: Discordant End
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying three different afflictions from you becomes discordant for a brief time and attacks the nearest creature, friend or foe.
Each enemy can be made discordant once per fight. Enemies of higher rank resist it.
This is a mind and affliction effect.
discord.tag: This is a mind and affliction effect.

discordant.name: Split Chord
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions cannot benefit from their allies' auras or support abilities.
An afflicted enemy that tries to use an ability that supports its allies inflicts a stack of its own afflictions on them instead.
This is a discord and affliction effect.
discordant.tag: This is a discord and affliction effect.

dog.name: Hounding
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your summons and familiars inflict a stack of your most recently used affliction with each attack.
When an afflicted enemy attacks you, your nearest summon throws itself in the way and takes the blow. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a summoning and affliction effect.
dog.tag: This is a summoning and affliction effect.

doom.name: Counted Hour
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per fight, you can spend mana to pronounce doom on an enemy carrying your afflictions, and a visible count begins over it.
When the count ends, a doomed enemy that still carries any of your afflictions dies if it is your rank or lower. An enemy of higher rank loses a large portion of its health instead.
Cleansing every one of your afflictions before the count ends averts the doom.
This is a doom and affliction effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and affliction effect.

doppelganger.name: Worn Face
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies to your afflictions, you can take its face and wear it for a short time. Enemies of its kind treat you as one of their own.
The first affliction you inflict while wearing a face ends the disguise and lands with additional stacks.
This is a disguise and affliction effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a disguise and affliction effect.

dragon.name: Ember Hoard
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Affliction damage left unspent when an enemy dies is hoarded as embers, up to a limit that scales with your rank.
You can spend the whole hoard to breathe a cone of fire that inflicts a burn affliction with one stack for each ember spent. The hoard empties after a while out of combat.
This is a fire and affliction effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and affliction effect.

duck.name: Unruffled
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions inflicted on you by an enemy you have afflicted last a much shorter time.
An enemy carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions cannot afflict you.
This is an affliction resistance effect.
duck.tag: This is an affliction resistance effect.

dust.name: Settling Grey
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that dies carrying your afflictions collapses into a cloud of grey dust that settles over the area for a short time.
Enemies inside the dust cannot see out of it. You can see through it. Dust from several deaths gathers into a single, larger cloud.
This is a concealment and death effect.
dust.tag: This is a concealment and death effect.

earth.name: Open Grave
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to split the ground beneath an afflicted enemy. Jagged stone erupts, dealing damage for each stack of your afflictions it carries, and leaves an open grave.
An enemy that ends its movement in an open grave is rooted. The grave closes after a short time.
This is an earth and affliction effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and affliction effect.

echo.name: Toll
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When one of your afflictions expires, it returns once, at reduced stacks.
An affliction that is cleansed echoes onto whoever cleansed it instead.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

eclipse.name: Swallowed Light
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each stack of your afflictions narrows how far the target can see. An enemy carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions is blinded and can only target what is directly beside it.
Light-based abilities used by a blinded enemy fail.
This is a darkness and affliction effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and affliction effect.

edifice.name: Mausoleum
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, you can seal its body in a stone tomb where it fell. Tombs block movement and projectiles.
A few tombs can stand at once. They crumble after a while, or when you seal a new one past the limit.
This is a construction and death effect.
edifice.tag: This is a construction and death effect.

effigy.name: Named Figure
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to make a straw effigy of an enemy carrying your afflictions. Afflictions you inflict on the effigy are inflicted on that enemy as well, wherever it is.
The effigy burns away when its enemy dies or after a short time. Only one effigy can exist at a time.
This is a sympathy and affliction effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sympathy and affliction effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Collapse
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions take on the element of the damage that applied them, and each element stacks separately.
An enemy carrying afflictions of three different elements suffers a collapse, losing its resistance to all three for a short time.
This is an elemental and affliction effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and affliction effect.

elixir.name: Poisoner's Cabinet
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend a potion to coat your next affliction with a corrupted version of that potion's effect. A healing potion becomes a decay; a draught of speed becomes a slow; a mana potion drains mana.
The potion is used up by the coating.
This is an alchemy and affliction effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and affliction effect.

empower.name: Lent Ruin
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can touch an ally and spend mana to lend them one of your afflictions. For a short time, their attacks inflict a stack of it.
Stacks your ally inflicts count as yours for all of your other effects.
This is an empowerment and affliction effect.
empower.tag: This is an empowerment and affliction effect.

eye.name: Watcher of the Dying
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can see every enemy carrying your afflictions, through walls and darkness, along with how long each affliction has left.
Your afflictions on the enemy you are currently targeting do not expire.
This is a perception and affliction effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and affliction effect.

feast.name: Wake Feast
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

An enemy that dies carrying your afflictions lays out a share of its life where it fell. You and each ally who passes over the corpse recover health and stamina, more for every stack it carried when it died.
Each ally can feast on a given corpse once.
This is a death and healing effect.
feast.tag: This is a death and healing effect.

feeble.name: Withering Theft
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy deals reduced damage for each of your afflictions it carries.
You deal increased damage by the same measure, drawn from every afflicted enemy close to you, up to a limit that scales with rank.
This is an affliction and theft effect.
feeble.tag: This is an affliction and theft effect.

fertile.name: Seeded Ending
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each affliction you inflict plants a seed in the target. When the target dies, the seeds burst into thorned vines that root every enemy close to the body and inflict a bleed.
The more afflictions the target carried, the wider the vines spread.
This is a growth and affliction effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and affliction effect.

fey.name: Thorn-Crown Law
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per fight, you can declare a law: no healing, no fleeing, or no spellcasting.
Any enemy carrying your afflictions that breaks the law has every affliction it carries raised to its full stacks.
This is a fey and affliction effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey and affliction effect.

fire.name: Cinder Shroud
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Burn afflictions you inflict cannot be cleansed while the target is below half health.
When an enemy carrying your burns dies, its remaining stacks leap to the nearest enemy, and the corpse smoulders as a pyre that inflicts fire damage over time.
This is a fire and affliction effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and affliction effect.

firebird.name: Kindled Wake
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you move away from an enemy carrying your afflictions, you leave a burning afterimage beside it. The afterimage adds a stack of a burn affliction to the enemy each second for a short time.
Only a few afterimages can burn at once.
This is a fire and affliction effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and affliction effect.

fish.name: The Shoal
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you afflict an enemy, every other enemy of the same kind close to it receives a single stack of that affliction.
Enemies of the same kind share the duration of your afflictions: refreshing it on one refreshes it on all of them.
This is an affliction effect.

flea.name: Plague Fleas
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an afflicted enemy is struck by a critical hit, one of your afflictions leaps from it to a different enemy a long distance away, keeping its stacks.
An affliction that has leapt cannot leap again.
This is an affliction effect.

flesh.name: Carving
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each stack of your afflictions opens the target's flesh, increasing the physical damage it takes.
Looting an enemy that died carrying your afflictions also yields flesh reagents of a quality matching its rank.
This is a flesh and affliction effect.
flesh.tag: This is a flesh and affliction effect.

foot.name: Death March
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions tick each time the target covers a certain distance, in addition to their normal ticks.
An enemy that keeps running from you accumulates heavier afflictions the longer it runs.
This is an affliction effect.

force.name: Blunt Accounting
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions ignore resistances.
Enemies that are immune to an affliction you inflict still take a reduced portion of its damage.
This is a force and affliction effect.
force.tag: This is a force and affliction effect.

forge.name: Quench
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, you can quench your weapon in the body. For a long time afterward, the weapon inflicts a stack of one of that enemy's afflictions with each hit.
Quenching again in a body of higher rank tempers the weapon further, raising the stacks it inflicts. Changing weapons loses the quench.
This is a forging and affliction effect.
forge.tag: This is a forging and affliction effect.

fork.name: Forked Fate
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you inflict an affliction, you can split it between two enemies at half stacks each.
If both halves come to rest on the same enemy, they rejoin at their full stacks.
This is an affliction effect.

fortress.name: Murder Holes
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you stand behind cover, a barrier or a conjured wall, your ranged attacks and spells inflict an additional stack of each affliction they carry.
Enemies attacking the cover you shelter behind gain a stack of each affliction they already carry.
This is a fortification and affliction effect.
fortress.tag: This is a fortification and affliction effect.

fox.name: Trickster's Toll
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions you inflict appear to their targets as beneficial effects. An enemy will not cleanse a disguised affliction until it has dealt half of its damage.
Identification effects see through the disguise.
This is an illusion and affliction effect.
fox.tag: This is an illusion and affliction effect.

frog.name: Sudden Spring
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each time one of your afflictions gains a stack, the target is jolted a short distance away from you.
An enemy jolted into a wall or another enemy is briefly stunned.
This is an affliction and knockback effect.
frog.tag: This is an affliction and knockback effect.

fungus.name: Dormant Bloom
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can inflict afflictions dormant. A dormant affliction does nothing, cannot be detected and cannot be cleansed.
You can spend mana to make every dormant affliction on every enemy bloom at once, waking with additional stacks.
This is a spore and affliction effect.
fungus.tag: This is a spore and affliction effect.

garuda.name: Serpent-Eater
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions deal greatly increased damage to serpents, nagas and any enemy that uses poison.
You are immune to poisons inflicted by enemies carrying your afflictions. When one tries, the poison is turned back on it as a stack of your own affliction.
This is a predation and affliction effect.
garuda.tag: This is a predation and affliction effect.

gate.name: The Far Side
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to open a door behind an enemy carrying your afflictions and push it through. The enemy is removed from the fight for a short time, alone with its afflictions, which go on ticking.
It returns where it left when the door closes. Enemies of higher rank than you resist being pushed through.
This is a portal and affliction effect.
gate.tag: This is a portal and affliction effect.

gathering.name: Reaper's Gathering
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to draw every enemy carrying your afflictions toward a point you choose.
Each enemy pulled together takes damage for every other afflicted enemy pulled in with it.
This is a spatial and affliction effect.
gathering.tag: This is a spatial and affliction effect.

glass.name: Clear Count
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can see exactly how much health each afflicted enemy has left, and whether your afflictions alone will kill it.
An enemy your afflictions will kill can be marked as condemned. Your allies and summons ignore condemned enemies and turn to other targets.
This is a perception and affliction effect.
glass.tag: This is a perception and affliction effect.

glimeron.name: Refracted Ruin
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each tick of your damaging afflictions is split, like light through a prism, into whichever damage types the target is weakest to.
Enemies that change resistances, shift form or wear elemental shields are re-read with every tick.
This is a light and affliction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and affliction effect.

goat.name: Stubborn Plague
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
The first cleanse used against each of your afflictions fails.
An affliction that survives a cleanse gains a stack.
This is an affliction effect.

gorgon.name: Stone Gaze
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying your afflictions that faces you builds stacks of petrification. At full stacks it turns to stone for a short time.
While an enemy is stone, its other afflictions stop ticking and store their damage. When the stone breaks, all of the stored damage lands at once.
This is a petrification and affliction effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and affliction effect.

griffin.name: Stoop
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you land on an enemy carrying your afflictions from a leap, a drop or a dash, you deal damage for every stack it carries and knock it to the ground.
Afflictions you inflict from higher ground last longer.
This is an aerial and affliction effect.
griffin.tag: This is an aerial and affliction effect.

growth.name: Burgeoning
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each of your afflictions gains a stack on its own at regular intervals, with no maximum, until the target dies or is cleansed.
An affliction that has grown past its normal maximum cannot be refreshed.
This is a growth and affliction effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and affliction effect.

guardian.name: Standing Watch
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy strikes an ally close to you, it gains a stack of each affliction it already carries from you.
Enemies carrying your afflictions deal reduced damage to allies who are behind you.
This is a protection and affliction effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and affliction effect.

hair.name: Grave Strands
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each affliction you inflict ties a thin strand between you and the target. While a strand holds, its afflictions cannot expire.
You can spend stamina to tug a strand, pulling the target a short distance toward you. A strand snaps if the target gets far enough away.
This is a binding and affliction effect.
hair.tag: This is a binding and affliction effect.

hammer.name: Coffin Nail
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each heavy attack against an afflicted enemy drives your afflictions deeper, extending their duration and causing the next cleanse used on it to fail.
Your heavy attacks knock down an enemy carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions.
This is an affliction and impact effect.
hammer.tag: This is an affliction and impact effect.

hand.name: Laying On of Hands
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can touch an afflicted ally and draw their afflictions into your hand, removing them from the ally.
You hold what you draw harmlessly until your next attack, which inflicts all of it on the enemy you strike.
This is an affliction and cleanse effect.
hand.tag: This is an affliction and cleanse effect.

harmonic.name: Resonant Decay
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When several enemies carry the same affliction from you, all of them tick in unison.
Each unison tick deals increased damage for every other enemy resonating with it.
This is a resonance and affliction effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and affliction effect.

harpy.name: Snatching Wind
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions cannot drink potions or use consumables. When one tries, the item is snatched out of the air and lands in your inventory.
You can spend stamina to shriek, briefly interrupting every afflicted enemy close to you.
This is a theft and affliction effect.
harpy.tag: This is a theft and affliction effect.

harvest.name: Owed Increase
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies that die carrying your afflictions grant additional experience, and additional advancement toward your affliction abilities' next level.
Killing an enemy above your rank this way grants a great deal more.
This is a harvest and advancement effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and advancement effect.

heidel.name: Run Down
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Moving through an enemy carrying your afflictions, on foot or mounted, knocks it down and adds a stack of each affliction it carries.
You recover stamina for each enemy you run down.
This is a trampling and affliction effect.
heidel.tag: This is a trampling and affliction effect.

hook.name: Barbed Hooks
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions are barbed. When one is cleansed, or the target moves out of your range, the barb tears free and deals the affliction's remaining damage at once.
This is an affliction effect.

horse.name: Pale Rider
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per day, you can spend mana to call a pale horse and ride it for a short time.
Every enemy you ride past gains a stack of a fear affliction, and enemies at low health flee rather than fight. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a summoning, mount and fear effect.
horse.tag: This is a summoning, mount and fear effect.

hunger.name: Gnawing
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each tick of your afflictions also takes a sliver of the target's mana or stamina, whichever it has more of.
What your afflictions take flows to you.
This is a draining and affliction effect.
hunger.tag: This is a draining and affliction effect.

hunt.name: Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can declare one afflicted enemy your quarry. Your quarry appears on your map wherever it goes, and cannot shed your afflictions by fleeing out of range.
Your afflictions deal increased damage to your quarry the longer the chase lasts.
This is a tracking and affliction effect.
hunt.tag: This is a tracking and affliction effect.

hydra.name: Regrown Neck
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When one of your afflictions is cleansed, two different afflictions you know grow back in its place, each with half its stacks.
An affliction that has regrown cannot regrow again from the same cleanse.
This is a regrowth and affliction effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regrowth and affliction effect.

ice.name: Frostbitten
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions do not lose duration while their target is chilled or frozen.
When a frozen enemy thaws, each of your afflictions on it ticks once immediately.
This is an ice and affliction effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and affliction effect.

immortal.name: Long Memory
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You remember every enemy that has afflicted you. When you meet one again, even in a later fight, it is inflicted with the same affliction it gave you, at full stacks.
Named and unique enemies stay remembered until they die.
This is a memory and affliction effect.
immortal.tag: This is a memory and affliction effect.

iron.name: Iron Maiden
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying your afflictions takes damage each time it attacks you, more for each stack it carries.
Afflicted spirits, fey and incorporeal enemies cannot phase or become intangible.
This is an iron and affliction effect.
iron.tag: This is an iron and affliction effect.

juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Course
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While three or more enemies carry your afflictions, you cannot be slowed, rooted, knocked back or knocked down.
Enemies that try to block your path while afflicted are pushed aside and gain a stack of each affliction they carry.
This is a momentum and affliction effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and affliction effect.

karmic.name: Settled Debt
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Damage an enemy deals to you is recorded as a debt against it.
Your afflictions on an indebted enemy deal increased damage until they have dealt back as much as it owes. Then the debt is settled and the bonus ends.
This is a karmic and affliction effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and affliction effect.

knife.name: Hidden Edge
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your critical hits inflict a bleed that ignores armour and damage reduction.
Each critical hit also refreshes every other affliction you have on the target.
This is a bleeding and affliction effect.
knife.tag: This is a bleeding and affliction effect.

knowledge.name: Book of the Dead
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each kind of creature that dies carrying your afflictions is recorded in your book of the dead.
Against a recorded kind, you know which affliction it resists least, and that affliction deals increased damage to it.
This is a knowledge and affliction effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and affliction effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to send a grasping tentacle at an enemy carrying your afflictions, at long range. It seizes the enemy and drags it toward you.
An enemy that is dragged is silenced until it reaches you, and its afflictions cannot be cleansed while it is held.
This is a grasping and affliction effect.
kraken.tag: This is a grasping and affliction effect.

leviathan.name: Swell
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per fight, you can spend mana to raise a swell that rolls outward from you across a wide area.
Every enemy it washes over is knocked prone, and each affliction it carries ticks once at once. Enemies standing in water are carried along with the swell.
This is a water and affliction effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and affliction effect.

life.name: Spared
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can choose for your afflictions not to kill. They stop with the target at a sliver of health, leaving it alive to be captured, questioned or finished by someone else.
An enemy spared this way cannot attack while it carries your afflictions.
This is a life and affliction effect.
life.tag: This is a life and affliction effect.

light.name: Lantern Ruin
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions glow, lighting the area around them. They cannot become invisible or hidden.
Your afflictions deal additional damage to undead and creatures of darkness while they are glowing.
This is a light and affliction effect.
light.tag: This is a light and affliction effect.

lightning.name: Conducted Ruin
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Dealing lightning damage to an afflicted enemy makes every affliction on it tick at once.
Afflictions you inflict on enemies standing in water arrive with additional stacks.
This is a lightning and affliction effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and affliction effect.

lizard.name: Shed Skin
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you stand still, your afflictions tick faster and last longer. Moving ends the effect.
Once every short interval, you can shed an affliction from yourself like old skin. It lies where you stood and attaches to the first enemy that walks over it.
This is an affliction effect.

locust.name: Locust Swarm
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to release a locust swarm onto an afflicted enemy. The swarm devours every affliction on it, then flies outward.
For each affliction it devoured, the swarm strips one boon from every enemy it passes before it disperses.
This is a swarm and affliction effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and affliction effect.

lotus.name: Untouched
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you carry no afflictions yourself, your afflictions deal increased damage.
You are immune to any affliction of a kind you have inflicted in the current fight.
This is a purity and affliction effect.
lotus.tag: This is a purity and affliction effect.

lurker.name: The Watcher Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to place unseen marks on the ground. Only a few marks can exist at once.
When an afflicted enemy steps on a mark, something below seizes it: the enemy is rooted, and gains a stack of each affliction it already carries.
This is a trap and affliction effect.
lurker.tag: This is a trap and affliction effect.

magic.name: Hexwright
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your spells can carry an affliction you have already inflicted in the current fight, applying a single stack of it to every enemy the spell strikes.
Enemies carrying three or more stacks of your afflictions take increased damage from spells of any source.
This is a magic and affliction effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and affliction effect.

malign.name: Grudge
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy cleanses one of your afflictions, it gains a grudge. A grudge cannot be cleansed and lasts until the end of the fight.
When the grudge ends, every affliction that enemy cleansed during the fight returns to it at a single stack.
This is a curse and affliction effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and affliction effect.

manatee.name: Drowsing Current
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions last significantly longer on enemies standing in water.
An enemy that carries your afflictions without attacking for a short time falls into a stupor. While in the stupor it attacks slowly and does not call for help.
This is a water and affliction effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and affliction effect.

manticore.name: Spined Tail
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your special attacks fire quills from behind you at every enemy within range that carries your afflictions. Each quill inflicts a stack of a venom affliction.
Venom inflicted by quills cannot be cleansed while the target is in your range.
This is a venom and affliction effect.
manticore.tag: This is a venom and affliction effect.

master.name: Settled Form
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
The affliction ability you have used most often in a fight costs less mana and inflicts an additional stack for the rest of that fight.
Your affliction abilities advance toward their next level at an accelerated rate.
This is a mastery and affliction effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and affliction effect.

might.name: Crushing Burden
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your melee hits drive your afflictions deeper. Each hit adds a stack to the affliction with the fewest stacks on the target.
A heavy blow against an enemy at full stacks knocks it down and makes all of its afflictions tick once immediately.
This is a force and affliction effect.
might.tag: This is a force and affliction effect.

ministration.name: Hospice
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions on allies close to you deal reduced damage.
Each time an affliction ticks on one of those allies, the enemy that inflicted it gains a stack of one of your afflictions.
You can spend mana to ease a dying enemy that carries your afflictions out of the fight. It stops attacking and dies without resistance.
This is a care and affliction effect.
ministration.tag: This is a care and affliction effect.

minotaur.name: Labyrinth
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions lose their way. They cannot path around obstacles and cannot find the exits of the area they are fighting in.
Each time an afflicted enemy runs into a wall or obstacle, it gains a stack of each affliction it carries.
This is a confusion and affliction effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a confusion and affliction effect.

mirage.name: False Water
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to place the mirage of a healing spring. Enemies carrying your afflictions see it as real and are drawn to it.
An afflicted enemy standing in the mirage has the stacks of every affliction it carries doubled. The mirage fades after a short time.
This is an illusion and affliction effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and affliction effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy inflicts an affliction on you, a copy of it is reflected back onto that enemy at the same number of stacks.
You can spend mana to swap your afflictions with those on an enemy you can see. You take on its afflictions and it takes on yours. This can be used once per fight.
This is a reflection and affliction effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and affliction effect.

monkey.name: Light Fingers
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your melee hits against afflicted enemies can steal one of their active boons, which transfers to you for a short time.
Stealing a boon this way adds a stack of each affliction the enemy is carrying.
This is a theft and affliction effect.
monkey.tag: This is a theft and affliction effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per fight, you can raise a standing stone. Afflictions on enemies within the stone's shadow do not expire.
The stone cannot be destroyed by enemies of your rank or lower, and remains until the fight ends.
This is a stone and affliction effect.
monolith.tag: This is a stone and affliction effect.

moon.name: Waning Tide
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
At night, your afflictions tick faster. By day, they last longer.
Once per night, you can call the tide out of an afflicted enemy. Its afflictions are drawn off and pooled over you as a shroud that heals you for each stack drawn.
This is a lunar and affliction effect.
moon.tag: This is a lunar and affliction effect.

mouse.name: Gnawed Through
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions gnaw at an enemy's equipment as well as its body. An enemy carrying them for long enough loses armour, and its resistances fall.
Enemies afflicted this way do not notice the gnawing: your afflictions on them do not draw their attention to you.
This is a stealth and affliction effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and affliction effect.

myriad.name: Thousand Deaths
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, an illusory copy of it rises for a short time and suffers the same afflictions again. Enemies near the copy take a portion of the damage it suffers.
Only one copy can exist at a time.
This is an illusion and affliction effect.
myriad.tag: This is an illusion and affliction effect.

mystic.name: Closed Eye
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can sit and close your eyes in combat. While you stay still and take no other action, your afflictions on every enemy tick twice as often, and you recover mana over time.
Taking damage breaks the stillness.
This is a meditation and affliction effect.
mystic.tag: This is a meditation and affliction effect.

nebula.name: Thin Spread
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to spread one of your afflictions over a wide area as a thin veil of dust. It lingers for a long time.
Every enemy in the veil gains a single stack of the affliction at regular intervals.
This is a dust and affliction effect.
nebula.tag: This is a dust and affliction effect.

needle.name: Pinprick
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your critical hits inject a single stack of each of your afflictions into the target, whether or not it is already carrying them.
Enemies carrying your afflictions have a weak point marked on them. Hits to the weak point bypass a portion of their armour.
This is a precision and affliction effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and affliction effect.

nemesis.name: Unforgiven
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that escapes a fight with you while carrying your afflictions becomes your nemesis. Its afflictions never expire.
When you meet your nemesis again, its afflictions resume ticking and you deal increased damage to it. Only one nemesis can be held at a time.
This is a pursuit and affliction effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a pursuit and affliction effect.

net.name: Gathered Catch
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to cast a net of rot over an area. Enemies in it are slowed, and any affliction one of them carries spreads to the others inside the net at a single stack.
The net lasts a short time and breaks if you move far from it.
This is a conjuration and affliction effect.
net.tag: This is a conjuration and affliction effect.

network.name: Held Thread
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions are nodes in your network. Every enemy an afflicted enemy can see appears on your map.
When an afflicted enemy is killed, you learn the position of every other enemy of its group.
This is a tracking and affliction effect.
network.tag: This is a tracking and affliction effect.

oasis.name: Rest-Place
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Allies close to you recover health over time for each enemy nearby that carries your afflictions.
An ally who kills an afflicted enemy is cleansed of one affliction.
This is a sanctuary and affliction effect.
oasis.tag: This is a sanctuary and affliction effect.

ocean.name: Returning Tide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per fight, you can draw every one of your afflictions out of every enemy at once, as a tide going out. You hold them harmlessly for a short time.
When the tide returns, each affliction goes back to the enemy it came from with additional stacks. An enemy that died in the meantime sends its share to the nearest enemy instead.
This is a tidal and affliction effect.
ocean.tag: This is a tidal and affliction effect.

octopus.name: Eight Patient Arms
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can hold up to eight different afflictions on a single enemy, and each affliction type beyond the third makes the others tick slightly faster.
When an enemy carrying eight different afflictions tries to flee, it is held in place for a moment.
This is a grappling and affliction effect.
octopus.tag: This is a grappling and affliction effect.

omen.name: Read Sign
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You see a mark of doom over any enemy whose afflictions will kill it before it can be healed or cleansed.
Afflicting an enemy that bears the mark of doom ends it at once. Enemies of higher rank than you are immune to this.
This is a divination and affliction effect.
omen.tag: This is a divination and affliction effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you hit an afflicted enemy at least once every few seconds, its afflictions cannot be cleansed and each hit extends their duration.
Missing the rhythm ends the effect on that enemy.
This is a rhythm and affliction effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a rhythm and affliction effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Hoard
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
For each affliction you have inflicted that is still ticking, you gain a layer of damage reduction. The layers end when those afflictions do.
While you hold enough layers, curling up stops you from taking damage for a moment and pulses one stack of each of your afflictions onto adjacent enemies. This can be used once per fight.
This is a defensive and affliction effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and affliction effect.

paper.name: Signed Warrant
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to inscribe an affliction onto a scrap of paper and carry it. Up to three written afflictions can be held at once.
A written affliction can be thrown, or left as a trap that triggers when an enemy steps on it. On release it applies the affliction at full stacks.
This is a writing and affliction effect.
paper.tag: This is a writing and affliction effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Private Nightmare
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each affliction on an enemy conjures a phantom that only that enemy can see.
An enemy carrying three or more of your afflictions sometimes attacks its phantoms instead of you, and takes a tick of each affliction whenever it does.
This is an illusion and affliction effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and affliction effect.

phoenix.name: From the Ash
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per day, a lethal blow instead burns you away. Every affliction on every enemy close to you deals its remaining damage at once.
You return from the ash with health for each enemy killed this way. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, rebirth and affliction effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire, rebirth and affliction effect.

plant.name: Root Rot
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies that stand still while carrying your afflictions put down roots. Each moment spent in place slows them further until they are rooted.
A rooted enemy cannot be healed by allies who are not touching it.
This is a plant and affliction effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and affliction effect.

potent.name: Distilled Ruin
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].

You can spend mana to concentrate an affliction on a target, consuming all of its stacks to apply one concentrated stack. A concentrated stack deals the combined damage of the stacks it replaced over a shorter time.
A concentrated stack can only be cleansed by a cleanse of equal or higher rank than you.
This is a concentration and affliction effect.
potent.tag: This is a concentration and affliction effect.

predatory.name: Chosen One
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can choose one afflicted enemy as your prey. Its allies do not notice when it is attacked.
Your afflictions on your prey tick faster while no other enemy is close to it.
This is a predation and affliction effect.
predatory.tag: This is a predation and affliction effect.

prison.name: Barred Door
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to bar the doorways and exits of the room or area you are fighting in. Enemies carrying your afflictions cannot pass through a barred exit.
An afflicted enemy that tries to force a barred exit is stunned and gains a stack of each affliction it carries. The bars lift when the fight ends.
This is an imprisonment and affliction effect.
prison.tag: This is an imprisonment and affliction effect.

prosperity.name: Paid in Coin
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can pay gold instead of mana for your affliction abilities. Afflictions paid for in gold land with an additional stack.
Enemies that die carrying your afflictions drop additional gold.
This is a wealth and affliction effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a wealth and affliction effect.

pure.name: Undiluted
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While an enemy carries only one type of affliction from you, that affliction ignores the enemy's resistances.
Your afflictions cannot be converted, stolen or redirected by enemy abilities.
This is a purity and affliction effect.
pure.tag: This is a purity and affliction effect.

rabbit.name: Bolted Quarry
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying your afflictions that runs from you takes a stack of each affliction for every short distance it covers.
You gain a burst of movement speed whenever an afflicted enemy turns its back on you.
This is a pursuit and affliction effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a pursuit and affliction effect.

rake.name: Raked Leavings
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an afflicted enemy dies, its unspent affliction stacks fall to the ground as a residue that lasts a short time.
You can sweep the residue toward you with a gathering motion, absorbing it as mana, or sweep it across enemies to apply the stacks to them.
This is a gathering and affliction effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and affliction effect.

rat.name: Plague Bearer
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You cannot be affected by disease afflictions. A disease affliction that would land on you is carried instead, and passes to the next enemy you strike in melee.
While you carry a disease, enemies near you gain a stack of it over time.
This is a disease and affliction effect.
rat.tag: This is a disease and affliction effect.

reagent.name: Slow Transmutation
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once an affliction has ticked for long enough on an enemy, you can transmute it into another affliction you know, keeping its stacks and remaining duration.
A corpse that carried your afflictions yields an alchemical reagent when looted.
This is an alchemy and affliction effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and affliction effect.

refracting.name: Bent Path
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Projectiles and spells fired at you by enemies carrying your afflictions bend away from you, more sharply for each stack.
A projectile that bends away from you has a chance to strike another afflicted enemy instead.
This is a deflection and affliction effect.
refracting.tag: This is a deflection and affliction effect.

renewal.name: Turning Season
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each time an enemy carrying your afflictions dies, the season turns: your next heal is significantly stronger, and its strength scales with how many stacks the enemy carried.
Healing you receive while an enemy carries your afflictions also adds a stack to that enemy.
This is a healing and affliction effect.
renewal.tag: This is a healing and affliction effect.

resolute.name: Planted Verdict
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you stand your ground without moving, your afflictions tick faster and cannot expire.
Enemies cannot force you to move with knockback or pulls while you are standing still and any enemy within reach carries your afflictions.
This is a resolve and affliction effect.
resolute.tag: This is a resolve and affliction effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic String
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you strike an enemy carrying your afflictions, every afflicted enemy of the same kind within range resonates and takes a portion of the damage.
Each resonance makes the next one louder, until the fight ends or you strike an enemy of a different kind.
This is a resonance and affliction effect.
resonating.tag: This is a resonance and affliction effect.

roc.name: Shadow on the Ground
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you leap or dash, your shadow passes over the ground well ahead of you. Every enemy it crosses gains a stack of one of your afflictions.
Lower-rank enemies crossed by your shadow cower for a moment.
This is a shadow and affliction effect.
roc.tag: This is a shadow and affliction effect.

rune.name: Graven Doom
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can carve a rune of ending into the ground. Enemies who stand on it take a stack of each affliction you have inflicted this fight.
An enemy that dies on the rune leaves its afflictions carved there, and the rune applies those too. Only one rune can exist at a time, and it fades when you leave the area.
This is a rune and affliction effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and affliction effect.

sacrifice.name: Paid Price
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can sacrifice one of your summons or familiars. Its remaining health is turned into an affliction inflicted on every enemy close to where it stood.
You can sacrifice a boon you carry instead to raise one affliction on a target to its full stacks.
This is a sacrifice and affliction effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a sacrifice and affliction effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Wounds
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each affliction you inflict shows a falling hourglass over the target. When the sand runs out, the affliction deals the rest of its damage at once and ends.
Enemies blinded by sand or dust take double stacks from your afflictions.
This is an earth and affliction effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and affliction effect.

sceptre.name: Royal Decree
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to decree a sentence on an enemy. Its allies who strike you suffer the afflictions it carries.
Lower-rank enemies under a sentence will not flee, and they will not be helped by their allies. A sentence lasts until the enemy dies or you decree another.
This is an authority and affliction effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and affliction effect.

scribe.name: Written Sentence
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Out of combat, you can spend mana and a sheet of paper to write one of your afflictions down as a scroll.
Reading a scroll inflicts its affliction at full stacks on the enemy you are looking at. Scrolls can be given to allies, who can read them too.
This is a writing and affliction effect.
scribe.tag: This is a writing and affliction effect.

serene.name: Untroubled Water
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you have not taken damage for a short time, your afflictions grow by a stack every few seconds on each target.
Being struck ends the stillness, and every afflicted enemy within reach takes one tick of its afflictions at once.
This is a calm and affliction effect.
serene.tag: This is a calm and affliction effect.

serpent.name: Coil
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you stay beside an enemy carrying your afflictions, you coil around it. A coiled enemy cannot use movement abilities, and each of its afflictions gains a stack every few seconds.
Moving away from it releases the coil.
This is a constriction and affliction effect.
serpent.tag: This is a constriction and affliction effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can sense any creature carrying a bleed, regardless of distance, within the region.
Enemies below half health that carry your bleeds draw you to them: your movement speed toward them is increased and your attacks against them deal additional damage.
This is a bleed and affliction effect.
shark.tag: This is a bleed and affliction effect.

shield.name: Warding Rot
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy carrying your afflictions strikes your shield or block, the afflictions it carries tick twice.
Afflictions that would land on you while you are blocking are caught on your guard instead. Your next shield strike applies them to the enemy you hit.
This is a guard and affliction effect.
shield.tag: This is a guard and affliction effect.

shimmer.name: Glamour of Ruin
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions are cloaked in light. Enemies see them as boons and will not try to cleanse them until they have ticked for a while.
An enemy that discovers the deception takes all remaining ticks at once and is dazzled briefly.
This is an illusion and affliction effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and affliction effect.

ship.name: Ferryman
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, its spirit is ferried to you, granting a portion of mana and stamina. Up to three spirits can be carried at once.
You can release carried spirits to row ahead of you along a straight line, applying their afflictions to everything they pass through.
This is a spirit and affliction effect.
ship.tag: This is a spirit and affliction effect.

shovel.name: Six Feet
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can dig a grave at your feet with a short channel. An enemy that steps into an open grave while afflicted is pulled half under the earth and cannot move until it breaks free.
An enemy that dies while in a grave cannot be raised, and its corpse yields its loot directly to you.
This is an earth and affliction effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and affliction effect.

sickle.name: Reaper's Swing
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Sweeping melee attacks harvest your afflictions. Each enemy struck takes all of its remaining affliction damage at once, and the afflictions end.
For each enemy harvested this way, you recover a portion of health.
This is a harvest and affliction effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and affliction effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to raise a likeness from the body of an enemy that died carrying your afflictions. The likeness fights for you for a short time.
Each hit the likeness lands inflicts one of the afflictions its original died with.
This is a summoning and affliction effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a summoning and affliction effect.

sin.name: Cherished Wrong
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies that have killed someone in the current fight are marked with sin. Your afflictions on a sinful enemy cannot be cleansed and deal additional damage.
When a sinful enemy dies to your afflictions, its sin passes to the enemy closest to it.
This is a sin and affliction effect.
sin.tag: This is a sin and affliction effect.

skirmish.name: Hit and Fade
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you hit an afflicted enemy and then move away from it shortly after, it gains a stack of each affliction it carries.
Staying beside the same enemy for too long resets the effect on it.
This is a skirmishing and affliction effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a skirmishing and affliction effect.

skunk.name: Lingering Warning
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions leave a stench on the target. Lower-rank enemies will not approach an enemy carrying the stench.
When an enemy carrying the stench dies, it releases a lingering cloud that afflicts and nauseates enemies who stand in it.
This is a scent and affliction effect.
skunk.tag: This is a scent and affliction effect.

sky.name: Cloud-Floor
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions do not lose duration while their target is airborne.
You can spend stamina to throw an afflicted enemy of your rank or lower into the air. It stays aloft for a short time, unable to act, and lands prone.
This is an air and affliction effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and affliction effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Certainty
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions tick slowly, but each tick is stronger, and no affliction you inflict can expire before it has dealt all of its damage.
Enemies carrying your afflictions lose attack speed for every affliction they carry.
This is a slowness and affliction effect.
sloth.tag: This is a slowness and affliction effect.

smoke.name: Choking Veil
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to release a cloud of smoke. Enemies inside it lose sight of you, and their afflictions tick faster while they breathe it.
While you stand inside your own smoke, your afflictions cannot be traced back to you, so cleansing them does not alert an enemy to your position.
This is a smoke and affliction effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and affliction effect.

snake.name: Coiled Strike
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
If you hold still for a moment before striking, your next melee attack applies a stack of each affliction you have inflicted this fight.
An enemy hit by a coiled strike while unaware of you is paralysed briefly.
This is a venom and affliction effect.
snake.tag: This is a venom and affliction effect.

soaring.name: Carrion Thermal
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, warm air rises from the body for a short time. Stepping into it carries you forward in a long, swift bound.
Afflictions you inflict while borne on the thermal land with additional stacks.
This is an air and affliction effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and affliction effect.

song.name: Dirge
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you have afflictions ticking on any enemy, a dirge plays around you. Enemies who hear it take increased damage from your afflictions.
Allies who hear it are not afraid, and are immune to fear effects for as long as the dirge plays.
This is a sound and affliction effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and affliction effect.

sovereign.name: Given Word
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to command lower-rank enemies carrying your afflictions to kneel. Every one of them in sight is held kneeling for a short time and cannot act.
Each of their afflictions ticks once as they kneel. An enemy that has knelt once cannot be commanded again in the same fight.
This is an authority and affliction effect.
sovereign.tag: This is an authority and affliction effect.

spear.name: Pinned Through
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your thrown weapons and projectiles carry your afflictions, passing through the first enemy they strike and applying the afflictions to each enemy behind it.
An afflicted enemy pinned against a wall by a thrown weapon cannot move until it pulls itself free.
This is a piercing and affliction effect.
spear.tag: This is a piercing and affliction effect.

spider.name: The Patient Web
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each enemy carrying your afflictions is tied to you by an invisible thread. You can pull on a thread to draw that enemy a short distance toward you.
Paralysis and restraint effects last longer on enemies tied to you by a thread.
This is a web and affliction effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and affliction effect.

spike.name: Barbed Ground
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to raise spikes over an area. Enemies that move across the spikes take a stack of a bleed affliction for each step.
Afflicted enemies knocked onto the spikes are impaled and take their remaining bleed damage at once.
This is a terrain and affliction effect.
spike.tag: This is a terrain and affliction effect.

staff.name: Traveler's Burden
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Striking the ground with your staff sends a ripple outward. Every afflicted enemy the ripple reaches has the duration of its afflictions extended.
Enemies far from their allies when the ripple reaches them are also slowed.
This is a staff and affliction effect.
staff.tag: This is a staff and affliction effect.

star.name: Dead Star
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying many stacks of your afflictions, it collapses inward as a dying star, pulling nearby enemies toward its corpse.
After a short delay the star bursts, dealing damage scaled to the stacks the enemy carried.
This is a stellar and affliction effect.
star.tag: This is a stellar and affliction effect.

stellar.name: Dying Star
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy carrying the full stacks of three or more of your afflictions begins to collapse like a dying star. For a moment it pulls nearby enemies toward it.
Then it bursts, inflicting a burn affliction on every enemy that was pulled in.
This is a star and affliction effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and affliction effect.

storm.name: Driven Rain
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to bring rain down over a wide area for a short time. Enemies carrying your afflictions cannot be cleansed while they stand in the rain.
Lightning damage dealt by anyone to an afflicted enemy in the rain adds a stack to each affliction it carries.
This is a weather and affliction effect.
storm.tag: This is a weather and affliction effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy of your rank or lower carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions is charmed. It will not attack you and moves to stay close to you.
While an enemy is charmed, each tick of its afflictions restores some of your health.
Damaging a charmed enemy with anything other than afflictions breaks the charm.
This is a charm and affliction effect.
succubus.tag: This is a charm and affliction effect.

sun.name: Noon Exposure
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
In daylight, enemies carrying your afflictions cannot become invisible, hide in shadow or use stealth.
Your afflictions tick faster on enemies standing in direct sunlight, and they inflict a burning sunstroke once they reach full stacks.
This is a light and affliction effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and affliction effect.

swarm.name: Crawling Mass
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions crawl. Every few seconds, each affliction moves on its own from its current host to whichever nearby enemy has the least health left, taking its stacks with it.
An affliction never crawls onto an enemy that already carries it.
This is a swarm and affliction effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and affliction effect.

swift.name: Racing Decline
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your movement speed increases for each enemy carrying your afflictions.
Every time you overtake or pass an afflicted enemy, its afflictions skip ahead, dealing their next tick immediately.
This is a speed and affliction effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and affliction effect.

sword.name: Drawn Blade
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
