Sheathing your sword mid-fight draws the remaining afflictions out of every enemy you struck with it, dealing their remaining damage at once. The sword cannot be drawn again for a short time.
Your sword attacks apply a bleed to enemies already carrying another of your afflictions.
This is a blade and affliction effect.
sword.tag: This is a blade and affliction effect.

talisman.name: Kept Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that dies to your afflictions leaves a small token of its kind. You can carry a few tokens at a time.
While you carry a token, your afflictions deal increased damage to enemies of that kind, and you resist the afflictions they inflict.
This is a talisman and affliction effect.
talisman.tag: This is a talisman and affliction effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Deep
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you inflict an affliction, a spectral tentacle wraps the target for a short time. While wrapped, the target cannot be moved by allies' pulls, teleports or rescues.
You can spend mana to have every wrapping tentacle squeeze at once, making each wrapped enemy's afflictions tick.
This is a binding and affliction effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a binding and affliction effect.

thread.name: Cut Thread
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can see each enemy's thread of life. Its length shows how long that enemy will live under your afflictions alone.
Once per fight you can cut a thread that has run short, ending that enemy. Enemies of higher rank than you take heavy damage instead.
This is a fate and affliction effect.
thread.tag: This is a fate and affliction effect.

thunderbird.name: Storm Follows
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
In combat, a storm gathers over you. Every few seconds, lightning strikes whichever enemy carries the most stacks of your afflictions.
Each strike adds a stack of a shock affliction that makes the target's next action slower.
This is a storm and affliction effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and affliction effect.

time.name: Run-Out Hour
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each tick of your afflictions ages the target. Its boons run out faster, and its abilities take longer to come off cooldown.
An enemy carrying the full stacks of any of your afflictions moves and attacks as though tired.
This is a time and affliction effect.
time.tag: This is a time and affliction effect.

tranquil.name: Settled Dust
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions go quiet. They cannot shout, raise an alarm, call for reinforcements or use sound-based abilities.
Enrage and frenzy states end on an enemy when it gains full stacks of any of your afflictions, and cannot begin again while those stacks remain.
This is a calming and affliction effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calming and affliction effect.

transfiguration.name: Remade Line
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to change one affliction on an enemy into a different affliction you know. The new affliction keeps the old one's stacks and remaining duration.
An enemy that resists one affliction can be given one it does not resist this way.
This is a transfiguration and affliction effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transfiguration and affliction effect.

transgression.name: Named Sin
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that has struck down an ally, a bystander or a companion within your sight is marked as a transgressor until it dies.
Your afflictions on a transgressor cannot be resisted, and each one lands with an additional stack.
This is a judgement and affliction effect.
transgression.tag: This is a judgement and affliction effect.

trap.name: Sprung Jaw
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Traps you set store an affliction you have recently inflicted. An enemy that triggers the trap receives it at full stacks.
Traps triggered by afflicted enemies reset once, catching the next enemy that steps there.
This is a trap and affliction effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and affliction effect.

tree.name: Hollow Trunk
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, a dead tree grows from its corpse. The tree lasts a short time.
Enemies near the dead tree have their healing reduced, and allies who rest against it recover stamina.
This is a growth and affliction effect.
tree.tag: This is a growth and affliction effect.

troll.name: Only Fire Argues
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Enemies carrying your afflictions cannot regenerate health.
You regenerate health over time for each enemy close to you carrying your afflictions. Fire damage stops your regeneration for a short time.
This is a regeneration and affliction effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and affliction effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Tomb
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can spend mana to brick an afflicted enemy into a tomb of stone. It cannot act or be reached while sealed, but its afflictions keep ticking.
The tomb crumbles after a short time or when the enemy dies. Enemies of higher rank than you break out early.
This is a sealing and affliction effect.
trowel.tag: This is a sealing and affliction effect.

turtle.name: Withdrawn Death
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While your afflictions are ticking on any enemy, you can withdraw into a shell, taking greatly reduced damage while unable to move or attack.
Your afflictions tick faster for as long as you remain withdrawn.
This is a defensive and affliction effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and affliction effect.

twilight.name: Long Shadow
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your shadow lengthens for each enemy carrying your afflictions, stretching out in the direction you face.
Enemies standing in your shadow gain a stack of one of your afflictions every few seconds, and cannot see you while you stand in dim light.
This is a shadow and affliction effect.
twilight.tag: This is a shadow and affliction effect.

undeath.name: Refused Grave
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
An enemy that dies carrying your afflictions can rise as a servant under your control, still carrying them. It fights for you until its afflictions run out, and then it falls for good.
Only a few servants can stand at once. Enemies of higher rank than you cannot be raised.
This is a necromancy and affliction effect.
undeath.tag: This is a necromancy and affliction effect.

unity.name: One Purpose
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Afflictions your allies inflict on an enemy you have afflicted join your own. They count as yours for all your effects, and they share your stacks and duration.
Each ally who adds an affliction to a shared target extends every affliction on it.
This is a unity and affliction effect.
unity.tag: This is a unity and affliction effect.

vast.name: Borderless Blight
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions persist on enemies no matter how far away they go, including across region boundaries and into astral realms.
An enemy that flees the fight while carrying your afflictions keeps them until it dies or rests, and you are told when that enemy dies.
This is a space and affliction effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and affliction effect.

vehicle.name: Running Over
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While mounted, your mount's charges apply your afflictions to every enemy they strike.
Enemies knocked down by a mounted charge while afflicted are trampled, taking an extra tick of each affliction.
This is a mounted and affliction effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a mounted and affliction effect.

venom.name: Slow Work
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your poisons build quietly. They deal no damage until the target reaches full stacks, then deal everything they have stored at once.
Enemies do not notice your poisons until they reach full stacks, and cleanses attempted before then do not detect them.
This is a poison and affliction effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and affliction effect.

verdant.name: Grave Green
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, green growth spreads over the ground where it fell.
Allies standing on the growth recover health over time. Enemies standing on it are slowly overgrown: each second they spend there slows them further.
This is a growth and affliction effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and affliction effect.

vessel.name: Filled Shape
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, you can draw its unspent afflictions into yourself. You hold them harmlessly, up to a limit that scales with your rank.
You can spend mana to pour everything you hold out in a cone. It inflicts each stored affliction on every enemy caught in it.
This is a containment and affliction effect.
vessel.tag: This is a containment and affliction effect.

visage.name: Death Mask
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy dies carrying your afflictions, you can take its face. While you wear it, enemies of its kind treat you as one of their own until you attack.
Removing the mask releases the afflictions it carried onto the nearest enemy. Only one face can be worn at a time.
This is a disguise and affliction effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and affliction effect.

vision.name: Shown Moment
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You see the attacks of enemies carrying your afflictions a moment before they begin, as a shadow of the motion.
Avoiding an attack you were shown this way adds a stack to each affliction the attacker carries.
This is a foresight and affliction effect.
vision.tag: This is a foresight and affliction effect.

void.name: Hungry Nothing
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy cleanses one of your afflictions, the cleanse is consumed by the void, along with one of the enemy's boons.
An enemy carrying three or more of your afflictions cannot receive boons from any source.
This is a void and affliction effect.
void.tag: This is a void and affliction effect.

volcano.name: Building Pressure
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each tick of your afflictions builds pressure in the target. When the pressure is full, the target erupts. It takes heavy fire damage, and a column of ash blinds every enemy close to it.
An enemy can erupt once per fight.
This is a volcanic and affliction effect.
volcano.tag: This is a volcanic and affliction effect.

vortex.name: Pulling Centre
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
While you stand still, enemies carrying your afflictions are steadily drawn in toward you. The pull is stronger on enemies with more stacks.
An afflicted enemy pulled all the way to you is knocked down at your feet.
This is a vortex and affliction effect.
vortex.tag: This is a vortex and affliction effect.

wasp.name: Vindictive Sting
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Whenever an enemy damages you, you can sting it in return at no cost, applying a stack of each affliction it already carries.
An enemy stung several times in quick succession swells, taking increased damage from all of your attacks for a short time.
This is a retaliation and affliction effect.
wasp.tag: This is a retaliation and affliction effect.

water.name: Drowning Lungs
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can fill an afflicted enemy's lungs with water. It cannot cast spells while drowning and takes damage over time until it coughs the water out.
Drowning afflictions cannot be cleansed by enemies standing in water.
This is a water and affliction effect.
water.tag: This is a water and affliction effect.

weave.name: Held Pattern
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When you inflict three different afflictions on the same enemy in quick succession, they weave together into a shroud. The woven enemy takes a burst of damage scaled to all three.
A woven enemy cannot be cleansed until the shroud is cut by an ally's attack or the target leaves combat.
This is a weaving and affliction effect.
weave.tag: This is a weaving and affliction effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Shape
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each tick of your afflictions hollows the target out, lowering its maximum health for the rest of the fight. You gain the lost maximum health for as long as the target lives.
Hollowed enemies are chilled and move more slowly.
This is a cold, hunger and affliction effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold, hunger and affliction effect.

whale.name: Whale Fall
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When a large or high-rank enemy dies carrying your afflictions, its body becomes a feeding ground for a short time. You and your allies recover health and mana while standing near it.
The bigger the creature, the longer its body sustains you.
This is a sustenance and affliction effect.
whale.tag: This is a sustenance and affliction effect.

wheel.name: Breaking Wheel
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Each affliction you inflict turns a wheel over the target. When the wheel makes a full turn, the target is broken: its armour is shattered and it is staggered.
After breaking, the wheel restarts, turning faster each time it completes on the same target.
This is a cyclic and affliction effect.
wheel.tag: This is a cyclic and affliction effect.

whip.name: Lashing Fever
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your whip and lash attacks can flick an affliction from one enemy onto another within reach, moving all of its stacks.
An enemy struck by a lash while carrying three or more afflictions is driven back toward you.
This is a lash and affliction effect.
whip.tag: This is a lash and affliction effect.

wind.name: Carried on the Wind
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Airborne afflictions you inflict, such as poisons, spores and diseases, drift downwind to enemies standing in the wind's path.
You always know which way the wind is blowing, and your afflictions tick faster on enemies standing downwind of you.
This is a wind and affliction effect.
wind.tag: This is a wind and affliction effect.

wing.name: Vulture's Wing
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
When an enemy carrying your afflictions falls below a quarter of its health, you can leap to it in a single long bound.
Landing beside a dying enemy adds a stack of each of its afflictions and grants you a brief boon of evasion.
This is a flight and affliction effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and affliction effect.

wolf.name: Culling the Herd
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
The weakest afflicted enemy in a group is marked as culled. Your allies and summons gain increased damage against it.
When a culled enemy dies, the next weakest afflicted enemy is culled.
This is a pack and affliction effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and affliction effect.

wood.name: Woodworm
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Your afflictions eat into wooden things: barricades, doors, bows, staves and wooden constructs weaken and break over time.
An enemy whose wooden weapon breaks this way is disarmed and takes a splintering bleed.
This is a rot and affliction effect.
wood.tag: This is a rot and affliction effect.

wrath.name: Held Grudge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Damage you take builds a grudge, up to a limit that scales with your rank.
You can spend the whole grudge on your next affliction. It lands with one additional stack for each portion of grudge spent. The grudge cools after a while out of combat.
This is a wrath and affliction effect.
wrath.tag: This is a wrath and affliction effect.

zeal.name: Burning Conviction
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
You can declare an enemy condemned. Your afflictions on a condemned enemy cannot be resisted, but you take a portion of the damage they deal.
If a condemned enemy dies, you gain a burst of mana and stamina that can exceed your normal limits for a short time.
This is a zeal and affliction effect.
zeal.tag: This is a zeal and affliction effect.

ziz.name: Horizon-Shadow
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Reaper. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Reaper].
Once per day, you can spread a vast wing of shadow across a wide area for a short time. Every enemy beneath it gains a stack of each affliction you know.
Weather, terrain and environmental effects cannot cleanse or weaken afflictions inflicted beneath the wing. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a shadow and affliction effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shadow and affliction effect.

action.name: First Note
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
The first healing ability you use in a fight has no cast time and costs no mana.

When an ally drops below a quarter of their health, you can heal them by reflex as they are struck, spending the healing ability's cost from stamina instead of mana. This can happen once per ally per fight.
This is a healing and reaction effect.
action.tag: This is a healing and reaction effect.

adept.name: Practised Refrain
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each time you cast the same healing ability on the same ally in succession, it heals for more, up to a limit. Casting any other ability resets the count.
At full count, the heal also cleanses one affliction.
This is a healing and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a healing and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Distilled Refrain
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Overhealing from your abilities is not lost. It condenses into a tincture in your inventory, one per fight, that restores the stored amount of health when drunk.
Potions you drink, or hand to an ally, also cleanse one affliction.
This is a healing and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a healing and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Held Breath
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities make no sound and no light, and do not draw enemy attention to you or to the target.
An ally you heal while they are unseen by every enemy also gains a short concealment, and their next attack from concealment deals bonus damage.
This is a healing and stealth effect.
ambush.tag: This is a healing and stealth effect.

animate.name: Song for the Still
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities work on constructs, golems, animated objects and conjured summons, which ordinary healing cannot touch.
Healing a construct that has already been destroyed in this fight, while its remains are intact, wakes it again with a portion of its health. This can happen once per construct per fight.
This is a healing and animation effect.
animate.tag: This is a healing and animation effect.

anzu.name: Thunderhead Hymn
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While you channel a healing ability, a small thunderhead gathers above you. When the channel ends, lightning strikes the nearest enemies, and each strike heals the ally closest to its target.
Healing done during rain or storm weather restores additional stamina.
This is a healing and storm effect.
anzu.tag: This is a healing and storm effect.

ape.name: Grooming Chant
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend stamina to tend an adjacent ally by hand for a short channel. While tending, the ally regenerates health quickly and has one affliction removed when the channel completes.
An ally tended this way deals increased damage for a short time afterward.
This is a healing and channel effect.
ape.tag: This is a healing and channel effect.

armour.name: Plated Hymn
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing that would raise an ally above maximum health is kept as a layer of song-forged plating instead. The plating absorbs damage and fades slowly over time.
Plating cannot exceed a portion of the ally's maximum health.
This is a healing and shield effect.
armour.tag: This is a healing and shield effect.

arsenal.name: Field Kit
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can bind one healing ability into each of up to three slots in a bandolier. An ally can trigger a bound heal on themselves at your mana cost, without you casting it.
A bound heal goes on cooldown for everyone once it is used, and the bandolier refills when you rest.
This is a healing and preparation effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a healing and preparation effect.

aspect.name: Mirrored Verse
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

Once per fight, you can spend mana to sing an ally's true shape back to them. Any transformation, polymorph or shape-altering affliction on them ends, and they are healed for a portion of the health lost while it lasted.
For a short time after, the ally cannot be transformed against their will.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
aspect.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

avatar.name: Gilded Psalm
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

You can spend a large amount of mana to take on a radiant greater form for a short time. In that form every healing ability you use affects all allies within a wide radius of you, and you cannot be interrupted.
You cannot attack while the greater form is held. It recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and transformation effect.
avatar.tag: This is a healing and transformation effect.

axe.name: Woodcutter's Rhythm
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Every third melee hit you land plays a beat that heals the nearest wounded ally.
Hitting an enemy with a heavy blow while an ally is below half health heals that ally for a portion of the damage dealt.
This is a healing and rhythm effect.
axe.tag: This is a healing and rhythm effect.

balance.name: Weighed Harmony
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend mana to even the health of every ally in a short radius. Their combined health is divided between them by proportion of their maximum, then each is healed for a small amount.
This cannot reduce an ally below a portion of their maximum health.
This is a healing and redistribution effect.
balance.tag: This is a healing and redistribution effect.

bat.name: Echo-Mending
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities can be bounced off walls and terrain to reach allies out of your line of sight.
Each wounded ally a bounced heal passes near is revealed to you through walls for a short time, along with their remaining health.
This is a healing and echolocation effect.
bat.tag: This is a healing and echolocation effect.

battlefield.name: Battle Hymn
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can plant a standard where you stand. While the fight lasts, allies within its reach recover health over time, and recover it faster while they are outnumbered.
Enemies that tear down the standard are briefly stunned. Only one standard can stand at a time.
This is a healing and banner effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a healing and banner effect.

bear.name: Winter's Lullaby
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

Out of combat, you can sing a resting song. Allies who rest within its range recover health, mana and stamina rapidly and gain a boon of increased maximum health that lasts until they next take damage.
Resting is interrupted if any enemy comes within aura-sense range.
This is a healing and rest effect.
bear.tag: This is a healing and rest effect.

bee.name: Hive Tending
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals leave a drop of honey on the target that slowly heals them over time. Honey stacks.
When an ally carrying honey takes damage, one drop bursts, healing them and any adjacent ally for a small amount.
This is a healing and conjuration effect.
bee.tag: This is a healing and conjuration effect.

behemoth.name: Deep Chant
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities also raise the target's maximum health for a short time, by a portion of the amount healed.
While you heal, you cannot be knocked back, knocked down or pulled.
This is a healing and fortitude effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a healing and fortitude effect.

bird.name: Dawn Chorus
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
At the start of each fight, a chorus rises around you. For a short time, your heals carry over open ground to allies at long range, and each heal grants a brief burst of movement speed.
The chorus can be called again once you have been out of combat for a short time.
This is a healing and sound effect.
bird.tag: This is a healing and sound effect.

blight.name: Rot Lancing
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you cleanse an affliction from an ally, the rot is drawn into a festering mote that you can throw at an enemy. The mote applies the cleansed affliction to them at its original stacks.
Only one mote can be held at a time.
This is a healing, cleanse and affliction effect.
blight.tag: This is a healing, cleanse and affliction effect.

blood.name: Transfusion
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can pay your own health instead of mana for any healing ability. Heals paid for in blood are significantly stronger and stop bleeding afflictions on the target.
You cannot pay with health that would take you below a portion of your maximum.
This is a healing and blood effect.
blood.tag: This is a healing and blood effect.

bone.name: Bonesetter's Song
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals end slow, cripple and broken-limb afflictions on their target, and grant brief immunity to them.
Healing a target who has been stunned or knocked down stands them back up immediately.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
bone.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

boundary.name: Verse of Sanctuary
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing a circle onto the ground. Allies inside it receive increased healing, and enemy area-of-effect damage cannot cross its edge.
The circle lasts while you stand inside it and keep singing. Singing drains mana over time.
This is a healing and barrier effect.
boundary.tag: This is a healing and barrier effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Cup
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Overhealing on your target spills to the nearest wounded ally, and then to the next, until it is spent.
When a heal spills to three or more allies, you recover a portion of its mana cost.
This is a healing and abundance effect.
bounty.tag: This is a healing and abundance effect.

bow.name: Arrow of Mending
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can loose a healing ability as an arrow. The arrow travels in a straight line, healing the first ally it strikes for more the further it flew.
An arrow that strikes an enemy first instead pins it, rooting it briefly.
This is a healing and projectile effect.
bow.tag: This is a healing and projectile effect.

brush.name: Thicket Shelter
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Where you heal an ally, undergrowth springs up around them for a short time. Allies in the undergrowth regenerate health and are harder for ranged enemies to target.
Enemies moving through the undergrowth are slowed.
This is a healing and terrain effect.
brush.tag: This is a healing and terrain effect.

cage.name: Caged Breath
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per fight, when an ally would fall, you can spend mana to cage their last breath. For a short time they cannot drop below one health, but cannot attack or cast.
When the cage opens, they are healed for a large portion of their maximum health.
This is a healing and protection effect.
cage.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

cat.name: Nine Lives Purr
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You keep a count of lives that refills over 24 hours. When an ally would be dealt a lethal blow, you can spend one life to have them land at a sliver of health instead.
An ally saved this way regenerates health rapidly for a short time while they are not attacking.
This is a healing and survival effect.
cat.tag: This is a healing and survival effect.

cataclysm.name: Song of the Aftershock
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an ally takes a single hit of catastrophic damage, the ground answers. A shockfront throws back nearby enemies, and the ally is healed for a portion of the damage the blow dealt.
This can happen once per fight for each ally. Wounding afflictions inflicted by that blow are removed.
This is a healing and earth effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a healing and earth effect.

cattle.name: Herd Calling
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies standing close together heal one another passively. The more allies in the group, the stronger the shared healing.
An ally who strays from the group takes no part in it until they return.
This is a healing and group effect.
cattle.tag: This is a healing and group effect.

chain.name: Linked Refrain
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your single-target heals chain to a second and third wounded ally nearby, each link healing for less.
You can bind two allies with a chain of song. While bound, damage dealt to either is shared between them. Only one binding can exist at a time.
This is a healing and link effect.
chain.tag: This is a healing and link effect.

chaotic.name: Loose Melody
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each healing ability you use rolls a random extra effect on its target: a cleanse, a short boon of speed, a brief shield, or a burst of mana or stamina.
Once per fight, you can reroll the extra effect as it lands, at a mana cost.
This is a healing and chance effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a healing and chance effect.

charlatan.name: Borrowed Applause
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you heal an ally, enemies see the heal land on a different ally of your choice, and change their targets toward the decoy.
You can also feign a heal at no cost. It has no effect, but enemies react to it as though it were real.
This is a healing and deception effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a healing and deception effect.

chicken.name: Mother Hen
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an enemy attacks an ally below half health within your sight, you can spend stamina to rush between them, taking the blow yourself. Rushing in this way heals the ally.
Enemies who have struck a protected ally are taunted to you for a short time.
This is a healing and protection effect.
chicken.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

chimera.name: Many-Throated Song
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing in three voices at once. Each voice is a separate healing-over-time ability that can be placed on a different ally, and the three run together.
Changing the target of any one voice cancels it. Holding all three drains mana over time.
This is a healing and song effect.
chimera.tag: This is a healing and song effect.

claw.name: Field Surgery
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals can cut out lodged afflictions. Healing an ally removes the affliction with the most stacks on them, at the cost of a small amount of the ally's health.
Each affliction removed this way leaves the ally briefly immune to it.
This is a healing and cleanse effect.
claw.tag: This is a healing and cleanse effect.

cloth.name: Bandage Weave
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can wrap an ally in conjured bandages. Bandages heal over time and absorb the first bleed, burn or poison applied to the ally while they last.
Bandages can be prepared out of combat and are kept in your inventory, to be applied later without cost.
This is a healing and conjuration effect.
cloth.tag: This is a healing and conjuration effect.

cloud.name: Mist Psalm
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend mana to raise a drifting cloud of healing mist. The cloud follows the most wounded ally in range and heals everything beneath it over time.
Allies within the mist are concealed from enemies at range.
This is a healing and mist effect.
cloud.tag: This is a healing and mist effect.

cold.name: Frost-Stilled Wound
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can chill an ally's wounds. For a short time, damage-over-time afflictions on them are frozen in place and deal no damage, and their duration does not run down.
When the chill ends, any affliction still frozen is halved in stacks.
This is a healing and cold effect.
cold.tag: This is a healing and cold effect.

coral.name: Reef Nursery
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can grow a coral spire on the ground. The spire heals allies within its reach over time and grows larger, and its healing stronger, the longer it stands.
Enemies can destroy the spire. Only one can stand at a time.
This is a healing and conjuration effect.
coral.tag: This is a healing and conjuration effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Poison
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

Your heals can be sung in reverse onto an enemy. A reversed heal applies a decay affliction that deals damage over time, and heals any ally who strikes the target for a portion of the damage they deal.
Reversed heals cost more mana than ordinary ones.
This is a healing, corruption and affliction effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a healing, corruption and affliction effect.

crocodile.name: Basking Psalm
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies standing in water or on sun-warmed ground regenerate health while they remain still.
An ally who stays still for a short time sheds one affliction, and their next attack after moving deals increased damage.
This is a healing and patience effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a healing and patience effect.

crystal.name: Lattice Hymn
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can store a heal inside a crystal and place it on the ground. The crystal holds the heal until an ally's health falls below half within its reach, then shatters and heals them.
Up to three crystals can be placed at once. Each costs the mana of the heal stored in it.
This is a healing and crystal effect.
crystal.tag: This is a healing and crystal effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When a healing-over-time effect you placed expires, it begins again on the same target at a portion of its strength. The second round does not repeat.
Your healing abilities that come off cooldown while you are below half health return with their cooldowns reduced.
This is a healing and renewal effect.
cycle.tag: This is a healing and renewal effect.

dance.name: Healing Reel
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While you keep moving, you emit a reel that heals allies you pass close to.
Dodging an attack while the reel plays heals every ally within a short radius. This can happen once every few seconds.
This is a healing and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is a healing and movement effect.

dark.name: Nightsong
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals on allies standing in darkness or shadow are silent and unseen. Enemies cannot detect them, and healing does not draw enemy attention.
Allies in darkness regenerate a small amount of health while unseen by enemies.
This is a healing and darkness effect.
dark.tag: This is a healing and darkness effect.

dawn.name: Aubade
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per day, you can sing up the dawn around you. Every ally within a wide radius is healed, and cleansed of darkness and blinding afflictions. Concealed enemies within it are revealed.
The song works in any place, including caves and astral realms. It recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and light effect.
dawn.tag: This is a healing and light effect.

death.name: Psychopomp's Refrain
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an ally falls, you have a short window to sing them back. Channelling the song revives them at a portion of their health.
The channel is broken if you take damage. Each ally can be sung back once per day; this recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and revival effect.
death.tag: This is a healing and revival effect.

deep.name: Fathom Song
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals add a layer of pressure to the target. While pressurised, they cannot be knocked back, pulled or knocked down, and take reduced damage from crushing attacks.
Pressure fades as the heal is spent.
This is a healing and stability effect.
deep.tag: This is a healing and stability effect.

deer.name: Fawn's Call
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an ally takes a heavy hit, you can spend stamina to call them. They bound toward you, out of the threat, and are healed when they land.
An ally answering the call cannot be struck while in mid-bound.
This is a healing and movement effect.
deer.tag: This is a healing and movement effect.

desolate.name: Salt Hymn
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities cleanse poison, disease and rot afflictions first, before any others, and leave the target immune to new ones of the same kind for a short time.
Enemies standing where you have healed cannot recover health for a short time.
This is a healing and purification effect.
desolate.tag: This is a healing and purification effect.

dimension.name: Folded Mending
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals can reach any ally you can see on the map, regardless of distance or obstruction, at an increased mana cost.
An ally healed through folded space can be pulled through it to your side instead of being healed. Pulling recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a healing and space effect.
dimension.tag: This is a healing and space effect.

discord.name: Counter-Melody
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an enemy casts a heal or a boon within your hearing, you can spend mana to sing against it. The heal is halved and the remainder goes to the nearest of your allies.
Enemy healers affected this way are briefly silenced.
This is a healing and disruption effect.
discord.tag: This is a healing and disruption effect.

discordant.name: Resolved Chord
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Enemy boons and auras that heal or empower other enemies are suppressed for a short time when you heal an ally near them.
When you suppress an enemy's healing this way, the healing it would have done goes to your target instead.
This is a healing and dissonance effect.
discordant.tag: This is a healing and dissonance effect.

dog.name: Loyal Lick
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your summons and familiars carry your heals. Commanding one to an ally makes it run to them and deliver a heal on arrival.
A summon carrying a heal that is struck down releases it to every ally around it.
This is a healing and summoning effect.
dog.tag: This is a healing and summoning effect.

doom.name: Stayed Sentence
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing a delay over an ally carrying an execute, doom-mark or countdown affliction. The affliction stops counting for as long as you keep singing, which drains mana over time.
When you stop, the affliction resumes from where it was held. Cleansing it while it is held costs no mana.
This is a healing and doom effect.
doom.tag: This is a healing and doom effect.

doppelganger.name: Echoing Voice
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend mana to conjure a singing copy of yourself at a point you can see. The copy casts the same healing abilities you do, at the same time, on targets near it.
The copy has a sliver of your health and dissolves after a short time or when struck.
This is a healing and conjuration effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a healing and conjuration effect.

dragon.name: Hoardsong
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing you receive while below half health also grants a short layer of scale that reduces fire and physical damage.
Burn afflictions cannot be placed on an ally for a short time after you heal them.
This is a healing and fire effect.
dragon.tag: This is a healing and fire effect.

duck.name: Water Off a Back
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals coat the target in a slick film for a short time. The next affliction applied to them slides off and does not take hold.
Allies coated this way take reduced damage from water and cold effects.
This is a healing and protection effect.
duck.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

dust.name: Settling Dust
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Damage dealt near you settles into a fine dust over the ground. You can spend mana to sing the dust back up; each ally standing in it is healed for a portion of the damage that made it.
Dust disperses if not gathered within a short time.
This is a healing and recovery effect.
dust.tag: This is a healing and recovery effect.

earth.name: Rooted Chant
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While you stand on natural ground and do not move, your heals are significantly stronger and cost less mana.
You can root yourself to keep this effect while being pushed, pulled or knocked back, but cannot move until you uproot.
This is a healing and earth effect.
earth.tag: This is a healing and earth effect.

echo.name: Second Voice
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each heal you cast repeats itself as an echo a moment later, healing the same target again for a portion of the original.
If the target is at full health when the echo arrives, it moves to the most wounded ally nearby instead.
This is a healing and echo effect.
echo.tag: This is a healing and echo effect.

eclipse.name: Corona Lament
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
For a short time after you heal an ally, a ring of light around them blinds the first enemy to strike them.
While you stand in shadow, your healing abilities can target allies through walls and around corners within their normal range.
This is a healing and shadow effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a healing and shadow effect.

edifice.name: Mortar Psalm
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing an ally who is standing still also grants them stacking damage reduction while they remain in place. The stacks fall away when they move.
You can heal walls, gates, barricades and other structures as you would an ally.
This is a healing and structure effect.
edifice.tag: This is a healing and structure effect.

effigy.name: Straw Choir
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing a likeness of an ally into being beside them. The first afflictions placed on that ally while the likeness stands go to the likeness instead, up to a few.
When the likeness burns away or is struck down, the ally is healed for a portion of their maximum health. Only one likeness can stand at a time.
This is a healing and sacrifice effect.
effigy.tag: This is a healing and sacrifice effect.

elemental.name: Four-Part Harmony
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals take on the element of the last damage the target received. A fire-wounded ally is healed with water, a frost-bitten one with flame, and so on, ending afflictions of that element.
Healing in an opposing element grants brief resistance to the element that caused the wound.
This is a healing and elemental effect.
elemental.tag: This is a healing and elemental effect.

elixir.name: Philter Song
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Potions you or your allies drink within your hearing take full effect immediately rather than over time, and their potion cooldown is shortened.
You can sing a healing ability into an empty flask, creating a potion of it that any ally can drink later. Flasks recover over 24 hours.
This is a healing and alchemy effect.
elixir.tag: This is a healing and alchemy effect.

empower.name: Rising Cadence
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing an ally to full health converts the rest of the heal into a boon of increased damage for a short time, scaled to the amount left over.
Boons you grant cannot be stripped from an ally while they are above half health.
This is a healing and empowerment effect.
empower.tag: This is a healing and empowerment effect.

eye.name: Watchful Hymn
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You see the health and afflictions of every ally within aura-sense range, including through walls.
Enemies preparing an attack on an ally below half health are marked; healing that ally before the attack lands grants them a shield against it.
This is a healing and perception effect.
eye.tag: This is a healing and perception effect.

feast.name: Breaking Bread
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can set a table out of combat. Allies who eat from it gain a well-fed boon that increases health regeneration and maximum stamina until it wears off.
Food eaten at your table heals for significantly more than it otherwise would.
This is a healing and boon effect.
feast.tag: This is a healing and boon effect.

feeble.name: Lend Strength
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Weakness, exhaustion and stamina-drain afflictions you cleanse from an ally are transferred to an enemy you can see.
You can sacrifice a portion of your own stamina to restore an equal amount to an ally instantly.
This is a healing and transfer effect.
feeble.tag: This is a healing and transfer effect.

fertile.name: Seedsong
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each healing ability you use leaves a seed on the ground where the target stood. A seed sprouts after a short time and heals whoever stands on it.
Seeds sown on crafting nodes cause the node to yield an extra harvest.
This is a healing and growth effect.
fertile.tag: This is a healing and growth effect.

fey.name: Fairy Bargain
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can offer an ally a bargain: a full heal at once, in exchange for a portion of their mana or stamina taken back over the following short time. The ally must accept it.
An enemy that strikes an ally under a bargain is cursed with a thorn affliction that wounds it each time it attacks.
This is a healing and bargain effect.
fey.tag: This is a healing and bargain effect.

fire.name: Ember Psalm
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals cauterise. Healing an ally ends bleed afflictions on them and leaves a warmth that heals over time.
While the warmth lasts, enemies that strike the ally in melee take a small amount of fire damage.
This is a healing and fire effect.
fire.tag: This is a healing and fire effect.

firebird.name: Ember Lullaby
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you move, you leave a trail of warm embers behind you for a short time. Allies who walk through it are healed over time.
Enemies who walk through it take fire damage over time instead.
This is a healing and fire effect.
firebird.tag: This is a healing and fire effect.

fish.name: Shoal Song
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies moving in the same direction as you heal over time.
When three or more allies move together, they can scatter at your call, each dashing a short distance and being healed as they land.
This is a healing and formation effect.
fish.tag: This is a healing and formation effect.

flea.name: Hopping Cure
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heal-over-time effects jump. When one expires, a fresh copy leaps to the nearest wounded ally who is not carrying it.
A heal can jump a limited number of times before it is spent.
This is a healing and spread effect.
flea.tag: This is a healing and spread effect.

flesh.name: Knitting Flesh
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can heal grievous and wounding afflictions that ordinary healing cannot touch.
An ally recovering from a wounding affliction healed this way gains bonus maximum health for a short time as the new flesh sets.
This is a healing and restoration effect.
flesh.tag: This is a healing and restoration effect.

foot.name: Road Song
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While travelling out of combat, you and your party regenerate health and stamina and are not slowed by rough terrain.
The first fight after a long march begins with every ally carrying a small heal-over-time.
This is a healing and travel effect.
foot.tag: This is a healing and travel effect.

force.name: Bracing Verse
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities land with a pulse of force that knocks back every enemy close to the target, without harming the target.
An ally being knocked back or knocked down can be healed mid-fall, which cancels the knockdown.
This is a healing and force effect.
force.tag: This is a healing and force effect.

forge.name: Anvil Chant
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each time an ally you have healed in the last short while is struck, they gain a stack of tempering, up to a cap. Each stack reduces the damage of the next hit.
Tempering stacks are consumed together when the ally is healed again, restoring extra health for each one.
This is a healing and tempering effect.
forge.tag: This is a healing and tempering effect.

fork.name: Forked Hymn
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each of your single-target heals can split at the moment of casting, dividing its strength between two allies of your choice.
A split heal on two allies standing on opposite sides of an enemy also staggers that enemy.
This is a healing and split effect.
fork.tag: This is a healing and split effect.

fortress.name: Keep Song
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies behind you, relative to the enemy you are facing, receive increased healing from you.
While you channel a healing ability, you are treated as a wall: projectiles aimed past you at those allies strike you instead, and you take reduced damage from them.
This is a healing and defence effect.
fortress.tag: This is a healing and defence effect.

fox.name: Trickster's Tune
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals can be disguised as harm. An enemy watching sees the ally struck and wounded, and treats them as a weaker target.
An ally healed in disguise deals increased damage to the first enemy that attacks them.
This is a healing and illusion effect.
fox.tag: This is a healing and illusion effect.

frog.name: Croaking Chorus
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can croak a deep note that heals every ally within a short radius. The note grows louder and stronger each time it is repeated without a pause, up to a limit.
A full-strength note knocks back nearby enemies.
This is a healing and sound effect.
frog.tag: This is a healing and sound effect.

fungus.name: Spore Cradle
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Corpses near you sprout healing mushrooms after a short time. Any ally who walks over a mushroom eats it and is healed.
Mushrooms grown from higher-rank corpses heal for more and also restore mana.
This is a healing and growth effect.
fungus.tag: This is a healing and growth effect.

garuda.name: Amrita
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per day, you can sing a single drop of amrita onto an ally. It restores them to full health and full mana, cleanses every affliction, and grants immunity to poison for a long time.
Serpent and naga creatures that see it flee. It recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and divine effect.
garuda.tag: This is a healing and divine effect.

gate.name: Threshold Song
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can open a small doorway beside a wounded ally and another beside you. Stepping through it brings the ally to your side, healing them as they arrive.
The doorway stays open for a short time and costs mana to open. Enemies cannot pass through it.
This is a healing and portal effect.
gate.tag: This is a healing and portal effect.

gathering.name: Gathering Hymn
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend mana to sing your party together. Every ally within long range is drawn to your side and healed for a portion of their missing health.
Allies drawn this way cannot be targeted while in transit. This ability recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a healing and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a healing and gathering effect.

glass.name: Clear Note
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can strike a clear note that shatters every magical shield, ward and barrier on enemies within a short radius.
Each shield shattered heals the nearest ally for a portion of the shield's remaining strength.
This is a healing and shattering effect.
glass.tag: This is a healing and shattering effect.

glimeron.name: Prism Psalm
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
A single-target healing ability you cast can be split through a prism into up to three beams, each healing a different ally for a share of the total.
Beams that pass through an enemy on the way to an ally deal light damage to that enemy.
This is a healing and light effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a healing and light effect.

goat.name: Mountain Bleat
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies standing on higher ground than any enemy nearby regenerate health and cannot be knocked down.
Your heals reach allies on ledges, cliffs and walls above you as easily as those beside you.
This is a healing and terrain effect.
goat.tag: This is a healing and terrain effect.

gorgon.name: Unstoning Song
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities cleanse petrification, paralysis and root afflictions, and break statues made from living creatures back into flesh.
An enemy that tries to petrify, paralyse or root an ally you healed in the last short while has the effect reflected onto itself.
This is a healing and cleanse effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a healing and cleanse effect.

griffin.name: High Cry
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing abilities you cast from higher ground than your target heal for more.
Once per fight, you can leap to a wounded ally from a distance, landing beside them with a cry that heals them and briefly frightens enemies near them.
This is a healing and leap effect.
griffin.tag: This is a healing and leap effect.

growth.name: Overgrown Life
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing that would take an ally above maximum health instead raises their maximum health for a short time, up to a limit.
Raised maximum health shrinks back slowly once the effect ends, without dealing damage.
This is a healing and growth effect.
growth.tag: This is a healing and growth effect.

guardian.name: Shieldsong
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can take on a share of the damage dealt to an ally you are healing over time, for as long as the effect lasts. You heal yourself for a portion of the damage you take this way.
Allies under your watch cannot be taunted away from you.
This is a healing and guarding effect.
guardian.tag: This is a healing and guarding effect.

hair.name: Sutured Strand
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can tie a strand of your hair to an ally. While tied, they regenerate health and you know their exact position and condition at any distance.
Up to three allies can be tied at once. A strand snaps if you change region.
This is a healing and tracking effect.
hair.tag: This is a healing and tracking effect.

hammer.name: Hammerbeat Hymn
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Striking the ground with a heavy blow rings out a chime that heals every ally within its radius.
Your heals also repair a portion of the durability of the target's armour.
This is a healing and repair effect.
hammer.tag: This is a healing and repair effect.

hand.name: Laying On of Hands
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Heals delivered by touch to an adjacent ally are significantly stronger and cost no mana, but take a moment to channel.
A touch heal on an ally who is unconscious or downed wakes them.
This is a healing and touch effect.
hand.tag: This is a healing and touch effect.

harmonic.name: Perfect Chord
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each different healing ability you cast in succession adds a note to a chord. When the chord holds three notes, the next heal you cast resonates to every ally within range.
Repeating a healing ability breaks the chord.
This is a healing and resonance effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a healing and resonance effect.

harpy.name: Shrill Reprieve
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can shriek to steal a boon from an enemy and give it to an ally, healing the ally as it lands.
The shriek interrupts any enemy casting a healing or support ability nearby. It costs mana and has a short cooldown.
This is a healing and theft effect.
harpy.tag: This is a healing and theft effect.

harvest.name: Gleaner's Song
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each enemy that dies near you leaves a sheaf behind. You can gather sheaves by walking over them, and each one you hold strengthens your next healing ability.
Sheaves are spent all at once and decay after a short time if unused.
This is a healing and harvest effect.
harvest.tag: This is a healing and harvest effect.

heidel.name: Hoofbeat Pulse
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While mounted or sprinting, you leave a steady pulse behind you that heals allies who follow in your path.
You can spend stamina to stamp, healing every ally within a short radius and briefly removing movement-impairing afflictions from them.
This is a healing and movement effect.
heidel.tag: This is a healing and movement effect.

hook.name: Rescue Line
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can cast a line of song to a distant ally and haul them to you. They are healed as they arrive.
An ally caught in a grab, hold or restraint is freed when hauled.
This is a healing and pull effect.
hook.tag: This is a healing and pull effect.

horse.name: Galloping Relief
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals travel along the ground at speed, curving around obstacles to reach their target.
A travelling heal tramples any enemy in its path, dealing a small amount of damage and briefly knocking it down.
This is a healing and movement effect.
horse.tag: This is a healing and movement effect.

hunger.name: Shared Hunger
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies below half health gain a hunger that makes their attacks steal health from enemies.
The lower an ally's health, the stronger the theft. The hunger ends as soon as they rise above half health.
This is a healing and drain effect.
hunger.tag: This is a healing and drain effect.

hunt.name: Tracker's Remedy
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can follow the trail of a wounded ally on the map, even one lost in another part of the region.
An enemy that wounded an ally is marked. Damage dealt to a marked enemy by anyone in your party heals the ally it wounded.
This is a healing and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a healing and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Many-Headed Hymn
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an ally loses a large portion of their health in a single hit, the wound regrows: they are healed over time for a share of the damage, starting at once.
If the wound was caused by fire or acid, the regrowth does not start until the affliction is cleansed.
This is a healing and regeneration effect.
hydra.tag: This is a healing and regeneration effect.

ice.name: Frost Splint
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can encase a badly wounded ally in healing ice. While encased, they take no damage and heal over time, but cannot act.
You or the ally can break the ice early. It breaks on its own after a short time.
This is a healing and ice effect.
ice.tag: This is a healing and ice effect.

immortal.name: Unending Refrain
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per day, when you would die, you instead keep singing. For a short time you cannot fall below a sliver of health, and every healing ability you use costs no mana.
When the song ends, you are left at a sliver of health with a long weakening affliction. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and deathless effect.
immortal.tag: This is a healing and deathless effect.

iron.name: Iron Lung
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal cannot be silenced, choked or prevented from breathing for a short time.
An ally under this effect who is struck by a stun shrugs it off and is healed instead. This can happen once per ally per fight.
This is a healing and resistance effect.
iron.tag: This is a healing and resistance effect.

juggernaut.name: Marching Song
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
