lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can heal while moving at full speed. Each step you take while channelling a healing ability adds to its strength, up to a cap.
Stopping or being slowed ends the build-up.
This is a healing and momentum effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a healing and momentum effect.

karmic.name: Ledger Hymn
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

Damage an enemy deals to an ally you have healed in the last short while is recorded against it. When that enemy is struck by any ally, a portion of the recorded damage heals the ally it was taken from.
The ledger is cleared when the enemy dies or leaves the fight.
This is a healing and karmic effect.
karmic.tag: This is a healing and karmic effect.

knife.name: Surgeon's Edge
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals on an ally carrying more than one affliction cut out the most damaging one first and grant a brief resistance to it.
Critical hits you land with a blade heal the nearest wounded ally.
This is a healing and precision effect.
knife.tag: This is a healing and precision effect.

knowledge.name: Physician's Learning
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Every affliction you cleanse is recorded. Afflictions you have cleansed before are removed more easily, and your heals grant the target resistance to them.
Hovering an enemy shows which of its attacks inflict afflictions you have already recorded.
This is a healing and knowledge effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a healing and knowledge effect.

kraken.name: Drawn-Under Song
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities reach much further, travelling along a tentacle of water that wraps the target.
You can choose to pull the healed ally a short distance toward you along the tentacle, breaking roots and grapples on them.
This is a healing and reach effect.
kraken.tag: This is a healing and reach effect.

leviathan.name: Tidal Psalm
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can release a slow wave of healing water that rolls outward from you in a wide arc, healing allies and pushing enemies back as it passes.
The wave is stronger for each ally it has already healed. It costs a large amount of mana and has a long cooldown.
This is a healing and water effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

life.name: Wellspring
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You carry a reservoir of life that fills slowly over time. Your heals draw from the reservoir first, costing no mana while it lasts.
When the reservoir is full, your next heal also restores a portion of the target's mana and stamina.
This is a healing and life effect.
life.tag: This is a healing and life effect.

light.name: Radiant Canticle
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals give off a flash of light that blinds enemies adjacent to the target for a brief time.
Allies standing in your light are revealed to you through any concealment, and invisible enemies near them are exposed.
This is a healing and light effect.
light.tag: This is a healing and light effect.

lightning.name: Defibrillating Hymn
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your heals jolt the target. An ally who is stunned, paralysed or frozen is freed immediately when healed.
Healing a recently fallen ally with a jolt revives them at a sliver of health. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing and lightning effect.
lightning.tag: This is a healing and lightning effect.

lizard.name: Moulting Refrain
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend mana to have an ally shed their skin. Every affliction on them is removed at once, and they regenerate health rapidly for a short time.
An ally who has shed recently cannot do so again until the effect recovers.
This is a healing and cleanse effect.
lizard.tag: This is a healing and cleanse effect.

locust.name: Swarm Remedy
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can loose a swarm of tiny singing motes. They spread out to every wounded ally within range and heal each for a small amount over time.
The swarm consumes poisons, toxins and parasitic afflictions it encounters on allies.
This is a healing and swarm effect.
locust.tag: This is a healing and swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Every heal you cast cleanses one affliction from its target, choosing the one with the most stacks.
An ally with no afflictions left on them after your heal blooms briefly, becoming immune to new afflictions for a short time.
This is a healing and purity effect.
lotus.tag: This is a healing and purity effect.

lurker.name: Hidden Choir
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While you are unseen by enemies, your heals cost no mana and do not reveal you.
You can heal an ally from hiding without line of sight, so long as they are within aura-sense range.
This is a healing and stealth effect.
lurker.tag: This is a healing and stealth effect.

magic.name: Unwritten Verse
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Mana you spend on healing spells is not fully consumed. A portion lingers around the healed ally as a faint verse, which they can spend on their next spell to reduce its mana cost.
If the ally is a caster with no mana remaining, the verse instead restores a small amount of their mana over time.
This is a magic and healing effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and healing effect.

malign.name: Bitter Refrain
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

When you heal an ally, the enemy that most recently damaged them is marked with a spiteful refrain. The marked enemy takes damage over time equal to a portion of the healing done, for as long as the ally stays above half health.
An enemy can carry only one refrain from you at a time.
This is a curse and healing effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and healing effect.

manatee.name: Slow Water Lullaby
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing a slow lullaby while standing still. Allies within a short distance regenerate health and stamina steadily, and the regeneration grows stronger the longer you keep singing.
The song ends the moment you move or are struck. Enemies of lower rank that enter the area grow drowsy and attack more slowly.
This is a song, healing and calming effect.
manatee.tag: This is a song, healing and calming effect.

manticore.name: Barbed Lullaby
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal grow a ring of spines for a short time. Enemies that strike them in melee are pierced and take a stacking poison affliction.
Each poison stack inflicted this way heals the ally who carries the spines.
This is a healing and venom effect.
manticore.tag: This is a healing and venom effect.

master.name: Practised Hands
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Using the same healing ability on the same ally several times in a row grants stacks of mastery. Each stack lowers that ability's mana cost and cast time on that ally.
Healing a different ally or using a different ability resets the stacks.
This is a healing and mastery effect.
master.tag: This is a healing and mastery effect.

might.name: Anthem of Standing
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing you deliver to an ally who is below a quarter of their health surges past their maximum, granting the excess as a temporary shield that fades slowly.
While the shield holds, the ally cannot be knocked down, staggered or pushed back.
This is a healing and fortification effect.
might.tag: This is a healing and fortification effect.

ministration.name: Bedside Hymn
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Out of combat, you can tend an ally by hand. Tending heals them steadily and removes lasting wound afflictions, maimed limbs and long debuffs that ordinary healing does not touch.
In combat, healing abilities you cast on an ally standing beside you heal for more.
This is a healing and care effect.
ministration.tag: This is a healing and care effect.

minotaur.name: Song of the Labyrinth
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can raise a short ring of earthen walls around a wounded ally, with a single opening that faces you.
Allies inside the ring are healed over time, and enemies must path around to the opening to reach them. The walls crumble after a short time or when struck enough.
This is a healing and terrain effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a healing and terrain effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Hymn
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal shimmer for a short time. The first attack aimed at a shimmering ally strikes an illusion a step away from them.
While shimmering, the ally appears at full health to enemies.
This is a healing and illusion effect.
mirage.tag: This is a healing and illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Harmony
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you heal an ally, a reflected echo of the same healing strikes you as well, at a reduced strength.
When an ally heals you, you can spend mana to answer in kind, returning a reflection of that healing to them instantly. Answering has a short cooldown.
This is a reflection and healing effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and healing effect.

monkey.name: Quick Hands Ditty
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can toss a healing potion or consumable to an ally within throwing range. It is used the moment it reaches them, without consuming their action.
While humming, you can swap the consumable in a party member's quick slot for one from your own inventory.
This is a healing and dexterity effect.
monkey.tag: This is a healing and dexterity effect.

monolith.name: Standing-Stone Chant
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can raise a standing stone. While it stands, the healing abilities you cast within its shadow-line heal for more and cannot be interrupted.
The stone lasts until you raise another, and must be raised again in each new area.
This is a healing and stone effect.
monolith.tag: This is a healing and stone effect.

moon.name: Tide-Hymn
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing waxes and wanes on a slow cycle shown beside your mana bar. At the full of the cycle, your heals also cleanse one affliction; at the dark of the cycle, they cost significantly less mana.
At night, the cycle moves faster and your healing spells reach further.
This is a moon and healing effect.
moon.tag: This is a moon and healing effect.

mouse.name: Whisper Mend
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing you deliver makes no sound and no light. It does not break an ally's stealth, does not draw enemy attention to you, and cannot be detected by aura sense.
While unseen, you can heal an ally through walls and closed doors if you know where they are.
This is a stealth and healing effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and healing effect.

myriad.name: Chorus of Many
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you cast a single-target heal, you can spend additional mana to split into a brief chorus of ghostly selves. Each one sings the same heal onto a different injured ally within range.
The split heals are each weaker than the original. Chorus cannot be used again until your mana is above half.
This is a duplication and healing effect.
myriad.tag: This is a duplication and healing effect.

mystic.name: Inner Ear
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You sense the health and afflictions of every ally within aura-sense range, including through walls and in other rooms.
Once per fight, you can heal an ally you can sense but cannot see, at an increased mana cost.
This is a healing and perception effect.
mystic.tag: This is a healing and perception effect.

nebula.name: Starcloud Song
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can disperse a healing-over-time ability into a drifting cloud instead of placing it on a target. The cloud heals every ally inside it for a share of the total.
The cloud drifts slowly in the direction you choose and thins as it heals.
This is a healing and cloud effect.
nebula.tag: This is a healing and cloud effect.

needle.name: Suture Note
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing closes wounds with a single high note. A healed ally stops bleeding immediately, and bleed afflictions on them cannot reapply for a short time.
Catastrophic wounds and lost limbs heal at a significantly faster rate while under your care between fights.
This is a precision and healing effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and healing effect.

nemesis.name: Hunter's Mercy
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can mark one enemy as an adversary. Allies heal a portion of every point of damage they deal to it.
The mark cannot be moved until the adversary dies or the fight ends. Allies the adversary damages are healed more by you.
This is a healing and marking effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a healing and marking effect.

net.name: Catching Chorus
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can cast a mesh of song over an area. Any ally who falls to zero health within it is caught by the mesh instead, hanging at the edge of death for a few seconds while you heal them.
If no healing reaches them before the mesh fades, they fall as normal. The mesh can catch only one ally and recovers over a long cooldown.
This is a song and death-prevention effect.
net.tag: This is a song and death-prevention effect.

network.name: Shared Chorus
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can link up to three allies with threads of song. A heal on any linked ally heals the others for a share of it.
Linked allies can see one another's health and afflictions. Links break if an ally moves out of range.
This is a healing and link effect.
network.tag: This is a healing and link effect.

oasis.name: Cool Spring
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can call up a spring at your feet. Allies who stand in it recover health, mana and stamina, and are cleansed of heat, thirst and exhaustion afflictions.
The spring lasts a short time in combat, and a long time out of it, where it also counts as a resting place.
This is a healing and water effect.
oasis.tag: This is a healing and water effect.

ocean.name: Returning Tide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing over time you place on an ally ebbs and flows. It heals little at first and swells to a strong surge before it ends.
If the ally takes no damage before the surge, the surge also grants them a short shield.
This is a healing and tide effect.
ocean.tag: This is a healing and tide effect.

octopus.name: Eightfold Carol
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While channelling a healing spell, you extend up to eight threads of song to allies within range. Each thread heals its ally slowly for as long as you keep channelling.
Threads break if the ally moves too far away. You can still walk slowly while channelling.
This is a channelled and healing effect.
octopus.tag: This is a channelled and healing effect.

omen.name: Augury Hymn
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies who are about to take a heavy blow show a pale sign above their heads a moment before it lands.
Healing an ally while they carry the sign grants them a pre-emptive shield sized to the coming blow. If the blow is avoided entirely, the shield instead heals them as it fades.
This is a precognition and healing effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and healing effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Every hit an ally lands on an enemy while carrying your healing-over-time effect extends that effect by a moment, up to a cap.
An ally who keeps attacking without pause also heals a small amount with each blow.
This is a healing and rhythm effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a healing and rhythm effect.

pangolin.name: Scale Verse
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each heal you deliver to an ally lays one overlapping scale of song over them, up to a small number of scales. Each scale reduces the damage of the next hit they take, then breaks.
While an ally carries the full number of scales, they can curl up to become briefly immune to damage, consuming every scale.
This is a healing and protection effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a healing and protection effect.

paper.name: Penned Remedy
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Out of combat, you can write one of your healing spells onto a sheet of paper as a remedy. Any party member can read the remedy to cast that heal once, without spending mana.
You can carry a small number of written remedies at a time. A remedy written at a higher rank heals more.
This is a writing and healing effect.
paper.tag: This is a writing and healing effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Fever Dream Hymn
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Fear, confusion and charm afflictions on an ally are cleansed first by your heals and replaced with a short calm that makes them immune to the same afflictions.
Enemies near the healed ally see shifting phantoms for a short time and attack wildly.
This is a healing and illusion effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is a healing and illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Ash Psalm
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per day, an ally who dies near you is wrapped in flame and reborn from the ash after a short time with a portion of their health.
The rebirth fire burns enemies near the ally while it lasts. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a healing, fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a healing, fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Rooted Hymn
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing spells you cast on the ground leave a rooted sprout behind. The sprout heals any ally standing next to it slowly, and grows stronger the longer it is left undisturbed.
Enemies can trample sprouts. Only a small number can exist at once; planting another uproots the oldest.
This is a plant and healing effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and healing effect.

potent.name: Distilled Aria
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can hold a healing spell before releasing it, concentrating it. Each second held increases its healing significantly but narrows its range.
A fully concentrated heal also restores a portion of the ally's stamina and mana. Holding costs mana continuously.
This is a concentration and healing effect.
potent.tag: This is a concentration and healing effect.

predatory.name: Stalking Song
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can tell which enemy is targeting each ally. A heal on an ally marks the enemy targeting them, revealing it and making it take increased damage from that ally for a short time.
Marked enemies cannot conceal themselves while the mark lasts.
This is a healing and hunting effect.
predatory.tag: This is a healing and hunting effect.

prison.name: Barred Rest
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can seal a gravely wounded ally inside a cage of light. Inside it they cannot act and cannot be harmed, and are healed steadily.
The cage holds for a short time or until you open it. It costs a large amount of mana.
This is a healing and binding effect.
prison.tag: This is a healing and binding effect.

prosperity.name: Generous Hymn
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Health potions and consumables used by allies near you heal for more.
At the end of each fight, you can spend coin to heal every ally fully and cleanse lasting afflictions on them, at a price that scales with rank.
This is a healing and fortune effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a healing and fortune effect.

pure.name: Pure Note
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing removes every affliction of lower rank than you from its target, and one affliction of equal or higher rank.
An ally cleansed this way is briefly immune to new afflictions of lower rank than you.
This is a cleansing and healing effect.
pure.tag: This is a cleansing and healing effect.

rabbit.name: Bolting Refrain
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an ally at low health takes damage, you can spend mana to sing them a bolting refrain: they gain a sudden burst of speed away from the nearest enemy and heal steadily while running.
The healing stops if they attack. Each ally can be given this refrain once per fight.
This is a movement and healing effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and healing effect.

rake.name: Gathered Leavings
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing you deliver that would overheal an ally is not wasted. The overflow gathers on the ground as a small pool of light.
Any ally who steps into a pool is healed by the amount it holds. Pools fade after a short time and merge if they are close together.
This is a healing and conjuration effect.
rake.tag: This is a healing and conjuration effect.

rat.name: Plague-Song
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Disease and poison afflictions you cleanse from allies are not destroyed. They are carried in your song and can be sung onto an enemy in range as a single burst, at the stacks they were removed with.
You can carry a small number of cleansed afflictions at a time. Uncarried ones fade after a fight ends.
This is a cleansing and affliction effect.
rat.tag: This is a cleansing and affliction effect.

reagent.name: Alembic Verse
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing potions you brew or carry are steeped in song. A potion you hand to an ally heals them over time instead of at once, for significantly more in total.
Out of combat, you can sing a common healing potion into a stronger grade at the cost of mana and a reagent.
This is an alchemy and healing effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and healing effect.

refracting.name: Bent-Light Psalm
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing projectiles bend around obstacles and enemies to reach their target, and cannot be blocked or intercepted.
A healing projectile that would hit an enemy reflecting it is instead turned back on the reflector as light damage.
This is a healing and light effect.
refracting.tag: This is a healing and light effect.

renewal.name: Season's Turn
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per day, you can sing a season's turn over your party. Every ally within range is restored to full health and has all afflictions cleansed, but the effect arrives slowly over a few seconds.
Allies who die before it completes are returned to life at a small portion of their health when it ends. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a renewal, healing and resurrection effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal, healing and resurrection effect.

resolute.name: Unbending Hymn
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While you stand your ground without moving, your healing spells cannot be interrupted, silenced or reduced by enemy effects.
An ally you heal while you are planted gains resistance to fear, charm and forced movement for a short time.
This is a resolve and healing effect.
resolute.tag: This is a resolve and healing effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic String
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each heal you cast makes a tone that lingers on its target. Further heals on the same target grow louder and stronger, up to a cap.
At the cap, the tone rings out once, healing every ally nearby, and resets.
This is a healing and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a healing and resonance effect.

roc.name: Shadow of Wings
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spend mana to cast a vast wing-shadow over an area. Allies under the shadow are healed over time and hidden from ranged attacks.
Enemies under the shadow are slowed by fear for a short time.
This is a healing and shadow effect.
roc.tag: This is a healing and shadow effect.

rune.name: Graven Psalm
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can carve a healing rune onto an ally's armour. The rune triggers on its own the first time they fall below half health, healing them and briefly increasing their damage reduction.
Each ally can bear one rune at a time. Carving one costs mana and cannot be done during combat.
This is a rune and healing effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and healing effect.

sacrifice.name: Opened Vein
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can pay for any healing ability with your own health instead of mana. Healing paid for this way heals the target for considerably more.
You cannot bring yourself below a sliver of health this way.
This is a healing and blood effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a healing and blood effect.

sand.name: Hourglass Hymn
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Damage an ally takes while under your hymn is not dealt all at once. It trickles in over a few seconds instead, like falling sand, giving your healing time to catch up.
Healing an ally removes the damage still waiting to fall before it lands. Only one ally can carry the hymn at a time.
This is a time-delay and healing effect.
sand.tag: This is a time-delay and healing effect.

sceptre.name: Royal Benediction
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can name one party member as your charge. Healing you deliver to your charge is significantly stronger, and any healing they receive from other sources also heals you for a portion.
Townsfolk and allied guards who witness you heal treat you with respect. Changing your charge can only be done out of combat.
This is an authority and healing effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and healing effect.

scribe.name: Written Remedy
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can write a remedy into a scroll out of combat, storing one casting of a healing ability. Any ally can read the scroll to cast it, with no mana cost.
You can carry a few scrolls at a time. They are lost if you rank up.
This is a healing and scripture effect.
scribe.tag: This is a healing and scripture effect.

serene.name: Still Water Psalm
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal are calmed: fear, confusion and rage effects on them end, and they cannot be affected by those effects again for a short time.
While no ally in your party is below half health, your mana regenerates significantly faster.
This is a calming and healing effect.
serene.tag: This is a calming and healing effect.

serpent.name: Shed Skin
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you heal an ally carrying many afflictions, they shed them all at once like a skin, which lies on the ground in their place.
An enemy that steps on the shed skin takes all of those afflictions. This can happen once per ally per fight.
This is a healing and transfer effect.
serpent.tag: This is a healing and transfer effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You sense every wounded creature within aura-sense range, friend or foe, and their remaining health.
When an enemy near a wounded ally drops below a quarter of its health, your next heal on that ally is significantly stronger, fed by the circling hunger of the fight.
This is a perception and healing effect.
shark.tag: This is a perception and healing effect.

shield.name: Shield Hymn
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing you deliver to an ally at full health is converted into a barrier on them instead, up to a portion of their maximum health.
When the barrier breaks, it rings out, healing other allies nearby for a small amount.
This is a barrier and healing effect.
shield.tag: This is a barrier and healing effect.

shimmer.name: Glimmering Canticle
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing spells leave a dancing glimmer on their target for a short time. Enemies attacking an ally with the glimmer have a chance to strike an illusory image instead, missing entirely.
Each missed attack heals the ally for a small amount.
This is an illusion and healing effect.
shimmer.tag: This is an illusion and healing effect.

ship.name: Sea Shanty
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While travelling with your party outside combat, you can sing a shanty. Every party member regenerates health and stamina while moving, and the party moves faster as a group.
The shanty ends when combat begins, but allies keep a short burst of regeneration from it into the first moments of the fight.
This is a song, travel and healing effect.
ship.tag: This is a song, travel and healing effect.

shovel.name: Gravedigger's Grace
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can dig a fallen ally out of death. Standing over an ally who has died within the last few seconds, you can channel to return them to life at a small portion of their health.
Channelling costs a large amount of mana and stamina and is broken by damage. It can be used once per fight.
This is a resurrection effect.

sickle.name: Harvest Hymn
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an enemy dies near you, you reap its remaining vitality as a sheaf of song. You can hold a small number of sheaves.
Spending a sheaf on a heal adds a burst of healing over time to it at no mana cost. Sheaves from higher-rank enemies are larger.
This is a harvest and healing effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and healing effect.

simulacrum.name: Understudy
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can make a stand-in copy of a wounded ally. Enemies treat the stand-in as the ally while the real ally stands still and recovers health over time, unseen.
The stand-in breaks after taking a few hits or when the ally attacks.
This is a healing and stand-in effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a healing and stand-in effect.

sin.name: Penitent Song
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can take an ally's afflictions onto yourself. Each affliction you take is weakened in your hands, and while you carry it, your healing on others is significantly stronger.
You cannot heal yourself while you carry another's affliction.
This is a sacrifice and healing effect.
sin.tag: This is a sacrifice and healing effect.

skirmish.name: Give Ground
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal can retreat at no stamina cost for a short time, and gain health back for every step taken away from an enemy.
An ally who breaks contact with every enemy is healed again, briefly.
This is a healing and retreat effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a healing and retreat effect.

skunk.name: Warning Cadence
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you heal an ally, a lingering scent hangs around them for a short time. Enemies of lower rank than the ally will not choose them as a target while it lingers.
If an enemy attacks through the scent anyway, it is nauseated, attacking more slowly for a short time.
This is a deterrent and healing effect.
skunk.tag: This is a deterrent and healing effect.

sky.name: Open-Air Aria
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities have no maximum range outdoors, so long as you can see the target and nothing is overhead.
Allies falling from a height are caught by an updraft and land unharmed if you have healed them in the last short while.
This is a healing and air effect.
sky.tag: This is a healing and air effect.

sloth.name: Slow Psalm
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing over time effects last significantly longer but tick more slowly.
An ally who keeps one of your healing over time effects for its full duration without being interrupted gains a lingering boon of increased maximum health until they next rest.
This is a healing effect.

smoke.name: Veiled Requiem
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When an ally drops to low health, you can spend mana to wrap them in a veil of smoke. While veiled, they cannot be targeted by enemies and heal steadily, but cannot attack or cast.
The veil lasts a short time or ends early if the ally acts. Each ally can be veiled once per fight.
This is a concealment and healing effect.
smoke.tag: This is a concealment and healing effect.

snake.name: Venom Cure
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Poison afflictions on allies you heal are converted rather than cleansed: each stack becomes a stack of healing over time instead.
An ally who has had poison converted this way is resistant to that poison for the rest of the day.
This is a poison-transmutation and healing effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison-transmutation and healing effect.

soaring.name: Rising Air Song
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While channelling a healing ability, you are borne up by rising song. You cannot be knocked down while channelling, and the channel costs no stamina.
When the channel ends, a gust of song heals allies around you in a small area.
This is a healing and flight effect.
soaring.tag: This is a healing and flight effect.

song.name: The Carrying Melody
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing continuously while fighting and casting. Allies within hearing range heal slowly for as long as the song lasts, and the song's reach grows with every ally who hears it.
Singing drains stamina over time. If you are silenced, the song carries on without you for a few seconds before it fades.
This is a song and healing effect.
song.tag: This is a song and healing effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Decree of Mending
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can decree that an ally will not fall. For a short time that ally cannot drop below a sliver of health, and every heal they receive is increased.
Each ally can be under a decree once per fight. Enemies of lower rank than you cannot break it.
This is a healing and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a healing and authority effect.

spear.name: Hurled Remedy
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can throw a single-target heal as a spear of light. It travels far beyond your normal healing range, piercing through enemies and healing every ally it passes through.
The heal is strongest on the last ally it reaches. Hurled Remedy has a short cooldown.
This is a projectile and healing effect.
spear.tag: This is a projectile and healing effect.

spider.name: Silk Mending
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can weave a web of silk song between allies. Damage taken by any ally linked to the web is shared evenly among every ally on it.
Healing one ally on the web heals all of them for a portion. The web breaks if any linked ally moves too far away.
This is a link and healing effect.
spider.tag: This is a link and healing effect.

spike.name: Thorn Hymn
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal grow a coat of song-thorns for a short time. Enemies that strike them in melee take damage equal to a portion of the healing that ally received.
Thorns do not trigger on attacks from enemies of significantly higher rank.
This is a retaliation and healing effect.
spike.tag: This is a retaliation and healing effect.

staff.name: Wayfarer's Rest
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

You can plant your staff and sing a resting circle. Inside it, allies recover health, mana and stamina as quickly as they would during a full rest, and wounds that need a long rest to heal begin to close.
The circle cannot be used during combat and breaks if an enemy enters it.
This is a song, rest and healing effect.
staff.tag: This is a song, rest and healing effect.

star.name: Distant Light
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can mark a party member with a star. You can heal a marked ally from any distance, including across the region map, as long as they are in the same region as you.
Healing at long distance arrives after a delay and costs significantly more mana. Only one ally can be marked at a time.
This is a star and long-range healing effect.
star.tag: This is a star and long-range healing effect.

stellar.name: Fixed-Star Chant
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can fix a point of starlight above the battlefield. It pulses healing onto the ally nearest to it at a steady interval.
Moving the star costs mana. It burns enemies that stand directly beneath it.
This is a healing and star effect.
stellar.tag: This is a healing and star effect.

storm.name: Rain-Song
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can bring a short rainfall over an area. Allies in it are healed over time and cleansed of burn afflictions; enemies in it take increased lightning damage.
The rain moves with you if you keep singing, at a mana cost over time.
This is a healing and weather effect.
storm.tag: This is a healing and weather effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can hold an enemy's gaze to draw its warmth from it. While you hold the gaze, the enemy loses health over time and the ally nearest you gains it.
Breaking line of sight ends the effect. Enemies of higher rank resist it.
This is a healing and draining effect.
succubus.tag: This is a healing and draining effect.

sun.name: Noonday Chorus
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing spells burst into a brief noon blaze where they land. Allies within the blaze are healed, and undead, shadow and incorporeal enemies within it take holy damage.
Under open sky in daytime, the blaze is larger.
This is a holy, light and healing effect.
sun.tag: This is a holy, light and healing effect.

swarm.name: Hive-Hum
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can release a swarm of tiny singing motes that spread among nearby allies, each mote healing a small amount when it lands.
The motes seek out the most wounded allies first. A mote that lands on an enemy stings it instead.
This is a healing and swarm effect.
swarm.tag: This is a healing and swarm effect.

swift.name: Quickened Note
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing spells can be cast while moving at full speed, and their cast time is significantly shorter.
Each heal you land grants you a brief burst of speed, and chaining heals onto different allies in quick succession extends it.
This is a speed and healing effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and healing effect.

sword.name: Battle Hymn of the Blade
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your melee weapon strikes carry a healing note. Each hit you land heals the most injured ally within range for a small amount.
Healing you deliver through weapon strikes costs no mana, but it cannot heal an ally above three-quarters of their health.
This is a weapon and healing effect.
sword.tag: This is a weapon and healing effect.

talisman.name: Knotted Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Out of combat, you can knot a charm for an ally. A charmed ally is healed automatically, once, the first time they drop below half health.
An ally can carry one charm at a time. Making a charm costs mana and a minor crafting material.
This is a healing and charm effect.
talisman.tag: This is a healing and charm effect.

tentacle.name: Deep Embrace
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can reach out with a grasping tendril of song and pull a wounded ally to your side, healing them as they arrive.
Pulling an ally out of an enemy's grip, a hold or a binding effect breaks that effect. The tendril has a short cooldown and limited reach.
This is a pull and healing effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a pull and healing effect.

thread.name: Lifeline
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can tie a thread of song to one ally. Your heals reach them along the thread even out of line of sight, and when they are thrown, knocked back or pulled, the thread stops them short.
If the tied ally falls, the thread holds them at the brink for a moment, giving you one chance to heal them before they go down. This can happen once per fight.
This is a tether and healing effect.
thread.tag: This is a tether and healing effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap Hymn
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you heal an ally who is stunned, the stun breaks with a clap of thunder that deafens nearby enemies, interrupting their casting.
Allies you heal are immune to stuns for a short time afterward.
This is a healing and thunder effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a healing and thunder effect.

time.name: Turned-Back Hour
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per fight, you can sing an ally's wounds back by a few moments, restoring the health and removing the afflictions they took in that span.
The ally's position and cooldowns are not changed. This has a long cooldown and costs a large amount of mana.
This is a healing and time effect.
time.tag: This is a healing and time effect.

tranquil.name: Hush
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies who stand still near you for a moment out of danger enter a hush, recovering health and mana rapidly.
Being struck or moving ends the hush. Enemies cannot see an ally in a hush unless they are already adjacent.
This is a healing and calm effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a healing and calm effect.

transfiguration.name: Remade Flesh
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities restore lost limbs, removed body parts and transformation afflictions, returning an ally to their own shape.
You can choose to reshape a healed ally briefly instead: harder skin for reduced damage, or lighter frame for increased speed.
This is a healing and transformation effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a healing and transformation effect.

transgression.name: Absolution
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Curses and afflictions that punish an ally for breaking a rule or condition are cleansed by your heals, including those that cannot ordinarily be removed.
When you cleanse such a curse, the enemy that placed it is marked as a transgressor and takes increased damage for a short time.
This is a healing and absolution effect.
transgression.tag: This is a healing and absolution effect.

trap.name: Sprung Mercy
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can set a healing snare on the ground. When an ally steps on it, it springs, healing them in a burst. When an enemy steps on it, it springs as a jaw of song that holds them briefly.
You can set a small number of snares at a time. Snares you set are invisible to enemies of lower rank.
This is a trap and healing effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and healing effect.

tree.name: Canopy Song
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Once per fight, you can sing up a towering green tree of light. Allies standing beneath its canopy heal steadily and take reduced damage from ranged attacks and spells falling from above.
The tree has its own health and withers when destroyed or when the fight ends.
This is a conjuration and healing effect.
tree.tag: This is a conjuration and healing effect.

troll.name: Knitting Song
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal regenerate health over time for as long as they are not burning.
While this regeneration is active, bleeding afflictions cannot stack on the ally.
This is a healing and regeneration effect.
troll.tag: This is a healing and regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Mending
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

Your healing spells repair what they touch as well as who. Healing an ally also restores durability to their equipped gear, and healing a constructed ally, barricade or summoned wall restores its health.
Healing spells cast on a broken object restore it to working order once per day.
This is a repair and healing effect.
trowel.tag: This is a repair and healing effect.

turtle.name: Shell Song
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

When you are reduced below a quarter of your health, you withdraw into a shell of song. You cannot act or move, but you are immune to damage and heal yourself and adjacent allies steadily until you emerge.
You can emerge at any time. The shell can form once per fight.
This is a protection and healing effect.
turtle.tag: This is a protection and healing effect.

twilight.name: Grey-Hour Song
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can call the grey hour over an area. Inside it, allies heal steadily and are harder to see, and enemies lose track of targets that move.
The grey hour lasts a short time, or a long time at dusk and dawn. It costs a large amount of mana.
This is a healing and twilight effect.
twilight.tag: This is a healing and twilight effect.

undeath.name: Song for the Unburied
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing abilities heal undead allies and summons as well as the living.
When your healing is used on an undead enemy, it deals heavy damage instead and cannot be resisted.
This is a healing and necromantic effect.
undeath.tag: This is a healing and necromantic effect.

unity.name: Joined Hands
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When one ally in your party takes damage, a share of it can be spread evenly across every other ally nearby, at your choice, and you are healed for a small amount each time.
Spreading damage costs mana over time while it is active.
This is a healing and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a healing and unity effect.

vast.name: Borderless Hymn
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your area healing spells have no fixed edge. They reach every ally in the same room, clearing or cave chamber, regardless of distance.
The more allies an area heal reaches, the less each one is healed. Borderless Hymn cannot reach allies in a different region or realm.
This is a space and healing effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and healing effect.

vehicle.name: Road Hymn
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies riding a mount, cart or vehicle with you are healed steadily for as long as it is moving, and the mount itself is healed by your area spells.
When a mount or vehicle is destroyed, its riders take no damage from the fall and are healed for a portion of their health.
This is a travel and healing effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a travel and healing effect.

venom.name: Antidote Aria
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can coat an ally's weapon in a slow-working anti-venom. Their attacks inflict a poison that also stops the target from healing for its duration.
Your own healing cannot be reduced or blocked by healing-denial afflictions.
This is a poison and healing effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and healing effect.

verdant.name: Creeper Song
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Wherever you heal an ally, green creepers spread across the ground. Allies standing on the creepers heal over time.
Enemies standing on the creepers are slowly entangled and rooted if they stay too long.
This is a healing and plant effect.
verdant.tag: This is a healing and plant effect.

vessel.name: Open Cup
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing that would be wasted on full-health targets is held inside you, up to a cap scaled to your rank.
You can pour out the held healing all at once onto a single ally, or spread it across the party.
This is a healing and vessel effect.
vessel.tag: This is a healing and vessel effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
When you heal an ally, you can wear their face for a short time. Enemies that were targeting the ally switch to you instead, and the ally is ignored until they attack.
While you wear another's face, healing you receive is significantly stronger.
This is a disguise and healing effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and healing effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Wound
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You see a warning above any ally about to take a heavy blow a moment before it lands.
A heal cast on a warned ally before the blow lands also grants them a shield sized to absorb part of it.
This is a healing and foresight effect.
vision.tag: This is a healing and foresight effect.

void.name: Hollow Lament
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing a lament into a point on the ground. Damaging spells and projectiles entering the area vanish into it.
Each spell the void swallows adds healing to it. When the lament ends, all the healing it stored is released onto allies within the area at once. The lament has a long cooldown.
This is a void and healing effect.
void.tag: This is a void and healing effect.

volcano.name: Pressure Song
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Each heal you cast builds pressure. When pressure is full, your next healing ability erupts, healing every ally around you and throwing molten rock at nearby enemies.
Pressure fades slowly if you stop healing.
This is a healing and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is a healing and eruption effect.

vortex.name: Gathering Spiral
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can draw a spiral that pulls nearby allies toward you over a short time, healing them as they come.
Enemies in the spiral are pulled toward its centre too, but take damage instead of healing.
This is a healing and air effect.
vortex.tag: This is a healing and air effect.

wasp.name: Sting and Salve
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sting an enemy that has harmed an ally, marking it. Each time the marked enemy attacks anyone, the ally it harmed is healed for a small amount.
Stinging costs stamina. If the marked enemy is struck by that ally, the mark bursts into a heal for them.
This is a mark and healing effect.
wasp.tag: This is a mark and healing effect.

water.name: Running Water Hymn
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Healing you deliver to an ally who is standing in water is significantly stronger and also restores their stamina.
You can sing a spring out of the ground, creating a pool of fresh water that lasts a short time. The pool extinguishes burning afflictions on anyone who enters it.
This is a water and healing effect.
water.tag: This is a water and healing effect.

weave.name: Woven Refrain
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Two different healing-over-time abilities placed on the same ally weave together into a single effect that lasts longer and heals more than the two apart.
Woven effects cannot be dispelled by enemies.
This is a healing and weaving effect.
weave.tag: This is a healing and weaving effect.

wendigo.name: Hearthsong
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Cold and starvation afflictions on allies are cleansed by your heals, and allies you heal are immune to freezing for a short time.
Each cold affliction you cleanse is turned on the nearest enemy, which is chilled and slowed.
This is a healing and cold effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a healing and cold effect.

whale.name: Song of the Deep
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing a long, low call that travels further than any other song. Every party member who hears it heals over a long duration, even through walls and across a large area.
Party members separated from you by a great distance can hear the call and see its direction marked on the map. The call has a long cooldown.
This is a song, communication and healing effect.
whale.tag: This is a song, communication and healing effect.

wheel.name: Round Refrain
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].

Your healing spells pass around your party in turn. A heal you cast on one ally travels to the next ally in a fixed order after a short delay, then to the next, until it has passed around the whole party once.
It grows weaker with each pass. Only one round refrain can be travelling at a time.
This is a chain and healing effect.
wheel.tag: This is a chain and healing effect.

whip.name: Lash of Mercy
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can crack a lash of song between two allies. The ally with more health gives a portion of it to the ally with less, healing them, and both gain a brief burst of speed.
The lash cannot reduce the giving ally below half health. It has a short cooldown.
This is a transfer and healing effect.
whip.tag: This is a transfer and healing effect.

wind.name: Carried on the Wind
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your area heals ride the wind. They drift in the direction you face after landing, healing every ally they pass over.
Scattered enemies caught in the drifting heal are pushed back a short distance. Drifting heals fade after a short time.
This is an air and healing effect.
wind.tag: This is an air and healing effect.

wing.name: Feathered Descant
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can sing an ally light on their feet for a short time. While the song holds, they cannot be knocked down, melee attacks against them often miss, and they heal steadily.
When the song ends they settle with a short leap to a spot they choose nearby. Each ally can be sung light once per fight.
This is a flight and healing effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and healing effect.

wolf.name: Pack Chorus
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Your healing spells count every ally in your party as a member of your pack. Each heal you deliver also heals every other pack member within a short distance of the target for a small amount.
When a pack member falls, the rest heal in a burst and gain brief resistance to damage.
This is a pack and healing effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and healing effect.

wood.name: Heartwood Hymn
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Allies you heal grow a layer of living bark over their wounds. The bark absorbs a portion of incoming damage and slowly converts what it absorbs back into healing.
Bark burns quickly, so fire damage removes it at once.
This is a wood and healing effect.
wood.tag: This is a wood and healing effect.

wrath.name: Battle-Rage Psalm
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
Damage you take builds wrath. You can spend wrath instead of mana to cast healing abilities, and heals paid for with wrath also grant the target a short boon of increased damage.
Wrath empties when the fight ends.
This is a healing and wrath effect.
wrath.tag: This is a healing and wrath effect.

zeal.name: Fervent Psalm
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
While you are below half health, your healing spells are significantly stronger and cost no extra mana, burning on conviction rather than reserve.
An ally healed while you are below half health gains a brief boon of increased damage. Fervent Psalm cannot heal you directly.
This is a zeal and healing effect.
zeal.tag: This is a zeal and healing effect.

ziz.name: Sheltering Wing
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Seeker of Songs. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Seeker of Songs].
You can spread a vast wing over your allies. For a short time, weather effects, falling hazards and area-of-effect damage from above cannot reach anyone beneath it.
Allies beneath the wing are healed over time. The wing costs a large amount of mana and has a long cooldown.
This is a healing and shelter effect.
ziz.tag: This is a healing and shelter effect.

action.name: Trigger-Finger Edict
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can ready a special attack instead of using it. A readied attack is held for a short time and fires the instant an enemy enters its reach or begins an attack against you.
A readied attack that interrupts an enemy's attack staggers that enemy. Readying costs the attack's normal resources up front, and only one attack can be readied at a time.
This is a reflex and interrupt effect.
action.tag: This is a reflex and interrupt effect.

adept.name: Practiced Form
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you use builds mastery in that attack for the rest of the fight. At full mastery, the attack costs no stamina and cannot be interrupted.
Using a different special attack between two uses of the same one keeps the mastery of both. Mastery is lost when combat ends.
This is a technique effect.

alchemy.name: Crucible Strike
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can coat a special attack in a potion from your inventory, consuming it. The attack applies the potion's effect to every enemy it strikes, inverted where the effect is restorative: a healing draught inflicts damage over time, and a stamina tonic drains stamina.
Each potion type can be coated this way once per fight.
This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.
alchemy.tag: This is an alchemy and transmutation effect.

ambush.name: The First Cut
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

A special attack made against an enemy that has not yet noticed you is a coronation strike. It inflicts critical damage, cannot be blocked or parried, and leaves the target unable to call for help from nearby allies for a short time.
After a coronation strike, you have a brief window to break line of sight. If you do, nearby enemies lose track of you.
This is a stealth and execution effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and execution effect.

animate.name: Strings of the Court
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

When a special attack strikes an inanimate object, such as a statue, a suit of armour, a fallen weapon or a corpse, it wakes the object as a brief puppet that repeats the same special attack once, aimed at the nearest enemy.
Puppets cannot be healed or commanded, and fall still after the repeated attack. Only one puppet can exist at a time.
This is an animation effect.

anzu.name: Thunderclaw Stoop
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can spend stamina to make a special attack from above: you leap high, then crash down onto the target. The impact adds lightning damage and a peal of thunder that deafens nearby enemies, preventing them from casting spells for a short time.
Through the leap, ranged attacks against you are deflected by wind.
This is a storm and leap effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and leap effect.

ape.name: Knuckle Drag
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can seize a stunned or staggered enemy of your rank or lower and use it as the weapon for your next special attack. The thrown or swung enemy takes the attack's damage, as does everything it strikes.
Seizing an enemy costs stamina and leaves you unable to block until the attack resolves.
This is a grappling and physical effect.
ape.tag: This is a grappling and physical effect.

armour.name: Plated Stride
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While a special attack is in motion, you cannot be staggered, knocked back or knocked down, and damage you take during it is reduced.
Hits you absorb during a special attack are stored as weight. The next special attack releases that weight as additional physical damage.
This is an armour and stance effect.
armour.tag: This is an armour and stance effect.

arsenal.name: Bandolier of Answers
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can bind up to three weapons from your inventory to your special attacks. When you use a special attack, it is performed with whichever bound weapon best exploits the target's weaknesses, swapped into your hand for the strike and returned to storage afterwards.
The weapon's own effects and damage type apply to the attack.
This is a conjuration and weapon effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a conjuration and weapon effect.

aspect.name: Throne-Shaped
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Once per day, you can take the aspect of a sovereign for a short time. Your form grows larger, your special attacks gain significantly increased reach, and lower-rank enemies struck by them are knocked to their knees.
While the aspect holds, spells cost you double mana. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a transformation effect.

avatar.name: Crowned Form
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Each special attack you land adds a layer to a gilded greater form. At full layers, you can spend mana to ascend for a short time. While ascended, you are larger, cannot be knocked back, and your special attacks strike a wide arc in front of you.
Ascension ends early if you are reduced below a quarter of your health, and the form takes time to rebuild.
This is a transformation effect.

axe.name: Headsman's Fall
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Overhead special attacks deal increased damage to enemies below half health, and execute lower-rank enemies below a small portion of their health outright.
An execution refunds the attack's stamina cost and resets its cooldown.
This is an execution effect.

balance.name: Counterweight
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
