Your special attacks deal more damage the closer your health, mana and stamina are to the same proportion of their maximums.
When a special attack lands, your lowest resource is restored by a portion of your highest. This can happen once every few seconds.
This is an equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Echo Swoop
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After a special attack lands, you can spend mana to vanish in a short burst of speed and reappear behind the struck enemy.
Special attacks made against an enemy's back within a moment of reappearing ignore its block and apply a brief blind.
This is a flight and teleport effect.
bat.tag: This is a flight and teleport effect.

battlefield.name: Holding the Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your first special attack in a fight plants your standard where it lands. Allies within the standard's area gain increased damage on their own special attacks.
Enemies driven out of the standard's area by your attacks are briefly routed and cannot attack. Planting a new standard removes the old one.
This is a battlefield and command effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a battlefield and command effect.

bear.name: Mauling Embrace
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your melee special attacks against a single target pin it in a crushing hold for a brief moment, during which each of your basic attacks deals bleed.
While you hold an enemy, other enemies attacking you deal reduced damage. Breaking the hold early costs nothing.
This is a grappling and bleed effect.
bear.tag: This is a grappling and bleed effect.

bee.name: Thousand Stings
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack leaves a sting in the target. Stings stack and inflict a mild poison.
You can spend stamina to make every sting in every enemy around you burst at once, dealing damage for each one. A target that bursts with many stings is briefly stunned.
This is a poison and detonation effect.
bee.tag: This is a poison and detonation effect.

behemoth.name: Hillside Charge
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks cannot be interrupted, and you cannot be knocked back while performing one.

When a special attack strikes an enemy of your rank or lower, the enemy is thrown back. Enemies it collides with take impact damage and are knocked down. Thrown enemies that strike a wall are stunned.
This is a force and impact effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a force and impact effect.

bird.name: Stooping Strike
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you use a special attack after a jump, dash or fall, you dive onto the target from above. The dive deals damage scaled to the distance travelled.
Enemies struck by a dive cannot attack you for a brief moment while they recover their footing.
This is a movement and aerial effect.
bird.tag: This is a movement and aerial effect.

blight.name: Withering Edge
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks rot armour. Each hit permanently reduces the target's physical resistance for the rest of the fight, and the reduction does not cap.
Blight left this way spreads to plants and terrain, withering cover and undergrowth the target stood in.
This is a blight and armour-breaking effect.
blight.tag: This is a blight and armour-breaking effect.

blood.name: Red Tithe
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can pay any special attack's cost in health instead of stamina. Attacks paid for in health deal increased damage and inflict bleed.
Damage your bleeds deal returns to you as health, up to the amount you spent.
This is a blood effect.

bone.name: Marrow Breaker
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can fracture an enemy's limbs. A fractured enemy moves more slowly and attacks with reduced force, and a second fracture on the same enemy cripples it for the rest of the fight.
Skeletal and undead enemies take significantly increased damage from your special attacks.
This is a bone and crippling effect.
bone.tag: This is a bone and crippling effect.

boundary.name: Severed Threshold
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A slashing or sweeping special attack leaves a line on the ground along its path for a short time. Enemies cannot cross the line; those that try are struck by a weaker copy of the original attack.
Only one line can exist at a time, and allies and summons cross it freely.
This is a barrier and space effect.
boundary.tag: This is a barrier and space effect.

bounty.name: Spoils of the Strike
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack that lands knocks loose a share of the target's vigour as a glowing mote on the ground. Picking up a mote restores some of your stamina; an ally who picks it up restores the same.
An enemy killed by a special attack drops an additional roll on its loot table.
This is a life and bounty effect.
bounty.tag: This is a life and bounty effect.

bow.name: Loosed Throne
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Holding a ranged special attack draws it further, up to three stages. Each stage adds damage and range; a fully drawn attack pierces every enemy in a line.
Moving while drawing drops one stage. Being struck while fully drawn releases the attack immediately.
This is a ranged and charge effect.
bow.tag: This is a ranged and charge effect.

brush.name: Thicket Sweep
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Sweeping special attacks leave a band of thorned undergrowth along their arc. Enemies moving through it are slowed and take damage.
You and your allies move through your undergrowth freely and are harder to target while standing in it.
This is a plant and terrain effect.
brush.tag: This is a plant and terrain effect.

cage.name: Closing Bars
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
The first special attack you land on an enemy raises bars of force around both of you. Neither of you can leave until the cage expires or the enemy dies.
While caged, your special attacks against that enemy deal increased damage, and other enemies cannot enter. This can be used once per fight.
This is a barrier and duel effect.
cage.tag: This is a barrier and duel effect.

cat.name: Ninth Life
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
If a lethal blow strikes you during a special attack, you twist free instead: the blow misses, the attack completes and you land unharmed nearby.
This can happen a number of times per day equal to your rank plus one, and recovers over 24 hours.
This is an evasion effect.

cataclysm.name: Faultline Blow
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

A special attack that strikes the ground opens a fault along the direction you were facing. A short delay later, an aftershock erupts along the fault, inflicting heavy damage and knocking down every enemy on it.
Ground broken this way stays broken for the rest of the fight and slows anyone who crosses it. This can be used once every short interval.
This is an earth and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is an earth and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Herd's Momentum
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Charging special attacks gather allies. Allies within a short distance of your path charge with you, adding their own attacks to the impact.
A charge that strikes a group of enemies scatters them, knocking lower-rank enemies down.
This is a charge and rally effect.
cattle.tag: This is a charge and rally effect.

chain.name: Linked Blows
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When a special attack lands, it chains to the nearest enemy that has not yet been struck, dealing reduced damage. It can chain several times.
You can spend mana as it chains to bind the struck enemies together. Bound enemies cannot move further apart than the chain allows.
This is a chain and binding effect.
chain.tag: This is a chain and binding effect.

chaotic.name: Loaded Dice
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Every special attack rolls a random bonus when it lands: an extra hit, a damage type the target is weak to, a brief stun, a cooldown refund, or nothing at all.
Rolling nothing three times in a row guarantees that the next special attack triggers every bonus at once.
This is a chaos effect.

charlatan.name: The Pretender's Feint
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to make a special attack a feint. Enemies react to the feint as if it were real, dodging, blocking or using a defensive ability, while the attack itself never lands.
The next special attack you make within a short window ignores any defence the target spent on the feint and deals bonus damage.
This is an illusion and deception effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion and deception effect.

chicken.name: Flock Fury
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When an ally or summon near you is struck, your next special attack against that attacker costs no stamina and deals increased damage.
Every enemy you strike this way is distracted, turning its attention to you rather than to the ally it hit.
This is a protective and retaliation effect.
chicken.tag: This is a protective and retaliation effect.

chimera.name: Three Throats
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Your special attacks alternate between three animal aspects in a fixed order: lion, goat and serpent. Lion attacks deal heavy physical damage, goat attacks knock back, and serpent attacks inflict poison.
Landing all three aspects on the same enemy in order makes it panic and flee for a short time.
This is a beast and transformation effect.
chimera.tag: This is a beast and transformation effect.

claw.name: Raking Talons
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your melee special attacks strike three times in a single motion. Each strike adds a stack of a rending bleed.
An enemy at full rending stacks has its next block or parry fail.
This is a claw and bleed effect.
claw.tag: This is a claw and bleed effect.

cloth.name: Wrapping Cut
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can conjure a length of cloth around your weapon. A special attack made with it wraps the target, blinding or binding its arms for a short time.
Spending stamina while the cloth is wrapped yanks the target toward you.
This is a conjuration and binding effect.
cloth.tag: This is a conjuration and binding effect.

cloud.name: Mist Lunge
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Lunging special attacks carry you through enemies as vapour. You pass through them without collision and strike each one you cross.
While you are vapour, you cannot be struck by physical attacks.
This is a vapour and movement effect.
cloud.tag: This is a vapour and movement effect.

cold.name: Frostbitten Edge
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks numb the target, slowing its attacks. An enemy numbed three times in a short span freezes solid for a brief moment.
Special attacks against a frozen enemy shatter the ice for significantly increased damage.
This is a cold and freeze effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and freeze effect.

coral.name: Reef Crust
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack that lands grows a layer of coral over your skin, granting damage reduction. Layers stack and decay slowly out of combat.
Spending stamina breaks off every layer as a burst of jagged shards around you, dealing damage for each layer lost.
This is a growth and armour effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and armour effect.

corrupt.name: Rot Kiss
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks corrupt whatever boons the target carries. Each corrupted boon turns into an affliction of the same strength that it inflicts on its bearer.
Corrupted boons cannot be removed by the enemy's own cleanses.
This is a corruption effect.

crocodile.name: Death Roll Strike
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A special attack that lands on a target you have held still for a short time, by root, grab or stun, clamps on. You roll with it, dealing repeated damage and dragging it with you as you move.
Water and mud under the target double the length of the clamp.
This is a grappling and aquatic effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a grappling and aquatic effect.

crystal.name: Faceted Blow
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks leave a crystal shard lodged in the target. Spells that strike a shard refract off it, hitting the target again and splitting toward one nearby enemy.
A target carrying many shards takes increased damage from your next special attack, which shatters them all.
This is a crystal and refraction effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and refraction effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When one of your special attacks comes off cooldown, the next use of it strikes as though it had been charged for its full cooldown, dealing increased damage the longer it waited unused.
When a special attack kills an enemy, its cooldown resets.
This is a cycle effect.

dance.name: Turning Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Using two different special attacks in quick succession links them into a flowing combo. Each linked attack costs less stamina and repositions you to face the next target.
Breaking the rhythm by pausing too long ends the combo; a combo of five or more attacks restores your stamina when it ends.
This is a technique and movement effect.
dance.tag: This is a technique and movement effect.

dark.name: Shadow-Hand Strike
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can emerge from your shadow instead of from you, striking any enemy your shadow touches.
In darkness, your shadow extends further and attacks made through it cannot be seen coming, ignoring the target's block.
This is a darkness and shadow effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and shadow effect.

dawn.name: Breaking the East
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks flare with first light, revealing invisible, hidden or disguised enemies within a short distance of the impact and removing any stealth they carry.
Enemies revealed this way take increased damage from you and your allies for a short time. A special attack made in darkness shines brighter and reveals further.
This is a light and revelation effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

death.name: Last Stroke
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
An enemy killed by your special attack cannot be resurrected, raised or reanimated.
Its death leaves a mark of ending on the ground for a short time. Enemies standing on it take increased damage from special attacks.
This is a death effect.

deep.name: Fathom Pressure
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks carry the weight of deep water. Each hit increases pressure on the target, slowing it; at full pressure it is pinned to the ground and cannot jump, fly or dash.
Releasing a pinned target with another special attack deals additional crushing damage.
This is a water and weight effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and weight effect.

deer.name: Antler Toss
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When an enemy closes to melee range, you can spend stamina on a reflexive special attack that tosses it away and leaps you clear in the opposite direction.
This can be used once every short interval and does not trigger the attack's normal cooldown.
This is a reflex and knockback effect.
deer.tag: This is a reflex and knockback effect.

desolate.name: Salt the Ground
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Ground struck by your special attacks is left barren for a while. Enemies standing on barren ground cannot be healed, and conjured plants, summons and spawned creatures that touch it wither and take damage over time.
Barren patches fade one at a time, oldest first, and only a limited number can exist at once.
This is a death and desolation effect.
desolate.tag: This is a death and desolation effect.

dimension.name: Fold-Strike
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to fold the space between you and an enemy, making any special attack reach it as if in melee range, up to a medium distance.
Folded attacks ignore walls and obstacles but cannot cross between regions or into astral realms.
This is a dimensional effect.

discord.name: Wrong Note
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks ring with dissonance. Enemies struck have their own next special attack or spell misfire, failing and consuming its cost.
An enemy whose ability misfires this way is briefly stunned. Each enemy can misfire once per fight.
This is a sound and disruption effect.
discord.tag: This is a sound and disruption effect.

discordant.name: Split Chord
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A special attack that strikes an enemy while it is buffed by an ally sunders the link. The buff is removed, and the ally who granted it is staggered.
Enemies struck by your special attacks cannot benefit from group abilities, formations or pack bonuses for a short time.
This is a discord and dispel effect.
discordant.tag: This is a discord and dispel effect.

dog.name: Pack Lunge
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you use a special attack, each of your summons and familiars within range lunges at the same target.
A target struck by you and at least two companions at once is knocked down.
This is a pack and summoning effect.
dog.tag: This is a pack and summoning effect.

doom.name: Counted Hour
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can spend mana to toll an enemy with a special attack. The tolled enemy carries a visible count. Every special attack you land on it afterwards advances the count, and when it completes, the enemy takes a final blow equal to a portion of all special attack damage dealt to it since the toll.
Only one enemy can be tolled at a time. A higher-rank enemy needs a longer count.
This is a doom and execution effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and execution effect.

doppelganger.name: Mirror-Shape Strike
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

When you use a special attack, a second self steps out of you and makes the same attack from the opposite side of the target. The second self's attack deals reduced damage but flanks the target, ignoring its facing and shields.
Enemies cannot tell which of you is the original; their next attack targets one at random. The second self vanishes after the strike.
This is a duplication and illusion effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a duplication and illusion effect.

dragon.name: Furnace-Throat
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Each special attack you land builds heat behind your breastbone. At full heat, your next special attack is followed by a cone of dragonfire breath in the direction of the strike, inflicting heavy fire damage and a lingering burn.
While you are holding full heat, your skin hardens and you take reduced physical damage. Heat bleeds away slowly out of combat.
This is a fire and draconic effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and draconic effect.

duck.name: Undisturbed
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks cannot be interrupted, slowed or reduced by afflictions you carry. Afflictions do not tick on you while a special attack is in motion.
When a special attack completes, one affliction on you sheds like water and is removed.
This is a cleanse and resilience effect.
duck.tag: This is a cleanse and resilience effect.

dust.name: Grit Cloud
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks kick up a cloud of dust around the impact. Enemies inside it are blinded and lose track of you.
Your next special attack from inside your own dust cloud strikes with the force of a surprise attack.
This is a dust and concealment effect.
dust.tag: This is a dust and concealment effect.

earth.name: Fault Line
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Ground-striking special attacks open a fissure running in the direction of the strike. Enemies along it are thrown into the air and take earth damage.
The fissure remains as rough ground for a short time, slowing everything except you.
This is an earth and terrain effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and terrain effect.

echo.name: Second Swing
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A moment after each special attack, an echo of it repeats from the same place at reduced strength.
You can spend mana as the echo forms to move it to a different target within range.
This is an echo and repetition effect.
echo.tag: This is an echo and repetition effect.

eclipse.name: Swallowed Noon
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to darken a special attack. A darkened attack blots out the light around the target, blinding it and every enemy close to it, and they lose sight of you for a short time.
Light-based abilities and auras within the blotted area are suppressed while it lasts, including enemy healing that uses light.
This is a darkness and blinding effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness and blinding effect.

edifice.name: Load-Bearing Blow
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While standing still, you can lay a footing beneath you. Special attacks made from your footing deal increased damage, cannot be interrupted, and send a shockwave along the ground toward the target.
Moving off the footing removes it. Laying a new footing takes a brief moment of stillness and costs stamina.
This is an earth and structure effect.
edifice.tag: This is an earth and structure effect.

effigy.name: Burnt Double
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land shapes a straw likeness of the target at your feet. When that enemy next strikes you, the likeness takes the blow instead and burns away.
Destroying a likeness inflicts the damage it absorbed back onto the enemy it was shaped from. Only one likeness per enemy can exist at a time.
This is an effigy and retribution effect.
effigy.tag: This is an effigy and retribution effect.

elemental.name: Element Shift
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Before a special attack, you can choose an element for it: fire, cold, lightning or earth. The attack deals that damage type and applies its minor effect, burning, chilling, shocking or staggering.
Using all four elements in one fight grants a brief surge in which every special attack carries all four.
This is an elemental effect.

elixir.name: Draught Strike
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can coat your weapon with a potion from your inventory. Your next special attack delivers the potion to the target instead of yourself, harming foes with healing tinctures turned toxic and offensive potions doubled.
Coating a weapon shares the potion's cooldown.
This is an alchemy effect.

empower.name: Lent Weight
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend stamina to strike an ally with a special attack instead of an enemy. The ally takes no damage; instead, their next special attack carries the full force of yours added to it.
An ally empowered this way also cannot be knocked down until they use that attack. This can be used once every short interval.
This is an empowerment effect.

eye.name: Weak Point
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While you focus on an enemy, a weak point appears on it and moves as it fights. A special attack that strikes the weak point is a guaranteed critical hit and ignores resistance.
Switching focus to a new enemy resets the weak point.
This is a perception and precision effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and precision effect.

feast.name: Gorged Strength
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Eating food grants a feast charge for a long time. Each special attack consumes a charge to deal increased damage and restore stamina.
Food of higher quality grants more charges. Charges do not stack beyond a limit set by your rank.
This is a sustenance effect.

feeble.name: Sapping Blow
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack steals a portion of the target's strength for a short time, lowering its damage and adding the same amount to yours.
Stolen strength stacks across different targets but not from the same target twice.
This is a draining effect.

fertile.name: Seed in the Wound
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Your special attacks plant a seed in the target. Each special attack landed on a seeded enemy grows it; at full growth, roots burst out of the enemy and through the ground, rooting it and every enemy beside it in place.
An enemy killed while seeded leaves a flowering plant that heals allies standing near it for a short time.
This is a growth and restraint effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and restraint effect.

fey.name: Thorn-Crown Bargain
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

At the start of a fight, you can name a strange bargain from a short list, such as "I will not move", "I will not be struck from behind" or "I will strike only once at a time". While you keep it, your special attacks deal significantly increased damage.
Breaking the bargain ends the bonus and silences your special attacks for a short time. A higher-rank bargain offers a larger reward.
This is a fey and oath effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey and oath effect.

fire.name: Pyre Sweep
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks trail fire along their whole arc, setting burning stacks on everything they pass through.
Once per fight, you can spend mana to make every burning enemy around you flare at once, dealing fire damage for each burn stack and consuming them.
This is a fire effect.

firebird.name: Ash-Nest Strike
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

After using a special attack, you can spend mana to burst into flame and reappear a short distance away in a direction of your choice. The place you left burns as a nest of embers that damages enemies.
Ember nests left this way explode if a second special attack strikes an enemy standing in them.
This is a fire and teleport effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and teleport effect.

fish.name: Shoal Rush
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A special attack can be scattered into a shoal of conjured silver strikes that fan out toward every enemy in front of you, dividing its damage between them.
The fewer enemies the shoal reaches, the more of its damage falls on each one.
This is a conjuration and scatter effect.
fish.tag: This is a conjuration and scatter effect.

flea.name: Bounding Bite
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After a special attack, you can leap a great distance to any visible enemy and strike it with a small bite that resets one special attack's cooldown.
The leap can be repeated while each bite lands on a different enemy, up to a number of times set by your rank.
This is a leaping effect.

flesh.name: Meat Hook
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks tear flesh loose from the target. Torn flesh heals you or reshapes into a temporary layer of muscle that increases your damage.
Choosing muscle over healing is decided at the moment of the hit; muscle layers fade over a short time.
This is a flesh effect.

foot.name: Marching Heel
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Kicking special attacks drive the target back a set distance. A target driven into a wall or another enemy is stunned.
Each step you take in combat builds momentum; your next kick spends it for additional knockback and damage.
This is a knockback effect.

force.name: Weight Behind It
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks ignore a portion of the target's damage reduction and break through shields and barriers rather than being absorbed by them.
A special attack that breaks a shield deals the shield's remaining strength to the enemy behind it as bonus damage.
This is a force and penetration effect.
force.tag: This is a force and penetration effect.

forge.name: Quenched Edge
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each time you are struck, your weapon is tempered by the blow. Your next special attack consumes the tempering, dealing bonus damage for every hit you took since your last special attack.
Water, ice or cold damage you take while tempered quenches the weapon, making that special attack also shatter armour and leave the target with reduced damage reduction for a short time.
This is a forge and tempering effect.
forge.tag: This is a forge and tempering effect.

fork.name: Branching Thrust
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Thrusting special attacks split at the point of impact, continuing past the target in two diverging lines that strike anything behind it.
A target struck by both branches of a single thrust is pinned briefly.
This is a piercing effect.

fortress.name: Arrow-Slit Stance
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can raise a curtain wall in front of you for a short time, blocking enemy ranged attacks from that direction. You can make special attacks through the wall, and they strike as if from cover, dealing increased damage.
Melee enemies that attack the wall are struck by a gatehouse counter-blow. Raising the wall costs stamina and puts it on a long cooldown.
This is a fortification effect.

fox.name: Feint and Bite
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can feint any special attack, spending a small amount of stamina to start its motion and then cancel it. Enemies that react to the feint by blocking, dodging or countering are left open.
Your next real special attack against an open enemy deals significantly increased damage.
This is a deception effect.

frog.name: Spring-Loaded
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Crouching before a special attack coils it. The longer you crouch, up to a short limit, the further the attack launches you and the harder it lands.
A coiled attack that lands on an enemy springs you back off it, letting you use a second special attack before you have found your footing.
This is a leaping and charge effect.
frog.tag: This is a leaping and charge effect.

fungus.name: Spore Burst
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks seed spores in the target. Seeded enemies release a cloud of spores when they die, confusing enemies caught in it for a short time.
A confused enemy attacks whatever is nearest, including its allies.
This is a fungal and confusion effect.
fungus.tag: This is a fungal and confusion effect.

garuda.name: Sun-Wing Descent
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks deal greatly increased damage to serpents, snakes, poisonous creatures and anything inflicting poison on you or an ally.
A special attack against such an enemy also sweeps you clear on a gust from golden wings, removing poison afflictions from you and carrying you out of ground effects.
This is a flight and purification effect.
garuda.tag: This is a flight and purification effect.

gate.name: Doorway Strike
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to open a small portal beside any enemy you can see. Your next special attack is made through the portal, striking that enemy from where you stand regardless of distance.
The portal closes after the attack. An enemy struck through a portal is briefly disoriented and turns toward the portal instead of you.
This is a portal and space effect.
gate.tag: This is a portal and space effect.

gathering.name: Drawn Together
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Before a special attack, you can spend mana to pull every enemy within a medium radius toward the point you are aiming at.
The attack then strikes every gathered enemy as if each were its sole target. Larger enemies are pulled a shorter distance.
This is a gathering and space effect.
gathering.tag: This is a gathering and space effect.

glass.name: Shatterpoint
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can make yourself glass-edged for a short time. Your special attacks deal significantly increased damage, but you also take increased damage.
While glass-edged, a special attack that kills an enemy shatters it into shards that strike everything around the body.
This is a glass and risk effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass and risk effect.

glimeron.name: Prism-Shard Cut
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When a special attack lands, it splits into scattered beams of light that strike up to three other nearby enemies for a portion of the damage.
When an enemy's spell strikes you, part of its damage is refracted into your next special attack as bonus light damage.
This is a light and refraction effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a light and refraction effect.

goat.name: Ram's Headlong
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Charging special attacks cannot be stopped by enemies of your rank or lower; you push straight through them, knocking each one aside.
Charges made uphill or down steep ground cost no stamina and deal increased damage.
This is a charge effect.

gorgon.name: Statue's Verdict
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A special attack made against an enemy facing you meets its eye. Each one adds petrification to the target, slowing it; at full petrification, the enemy turns to stone for a short time.
A petrified enemy takes significantly increased damage from the next special attack, which ends the petrification. Enemies of higher rank resist petrification.
This is a petrification effect.

griffin.name: Height Claim
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks made while dropping from a ledge, cliff or jump onto an enemy are diving strikes. A diving strike deals damage scaled by the height fallen and pins the target beneath you.
While an enemy is pinned, you can use one more special attack on it before it breaks free. Pinned enemies cannot dodge or block.
This is a flight and pinning effect.
griffin.tag: This is a flight and pinning effect.

growth.name: Swelling Might
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land in a fight makes you a little larger. Your size increases your reach and damage, but lowers your movement speed.
You return to your normal size gradually after combat, or at once if you choose to release the growth as a ground-shaking slam.
This is a growth effect.

guardian.name: Barred Way
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When an enemy attacks an ally standing near you, you can spend stamina to step between them and answer with a special attack. The ally takes no damage from the interrupted attack.
An enemy you intercept this way is taunted toward you for a short time. Intercepting has a short cooldown.
This is a protection and intercept effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and intercept effect.

hair.name: Ten Thousand Threads
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can extend your hair into lashes for a short time. Your special attacks become whip strikes with long reach that can wrap a limb or a weapon.
A wrapped weapon can be torn from a lower-rank enemy's grip, disarming it until it recovers the weapon.
This is a conjuration and disarm effect.
hair.tag: This is a conjuration and disarm effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Ring
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Heavy special attacks ring out on impact. The ring staggers every enemy around the target and interrupts spells being cast in the area.
Striking the same enemy with two heavy special attacks in quick succession stuns it.
This is a sound and stagger effect.
hammer.tag: This is a sound and stagger effect.

hand.name: Open Palm
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your unarmed special attacks deal damage as though you were wielding your best weapon, and gain its effects.
A palm strike that lands can take hold of whatever the enemy is carrying, pulling a consumable or loose item from it into your inventory.
This is an unarmed and theft effect.
hand.tag: This is an unarmed and theft effect.

harmonic.name: Struck Chord
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you use has a pitch. Using three special attacks in a rising sequence completes a chord that resonates through every enemy you struck, dealing damage again.
A completed chord shortens the cooldown of each attack in it.
This is a resonance effect.

harpy.name: Shriek and Snatch
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks steal. Each one that lands takes a boon from the target and places it on you, or snatches a consumable from its inventory if it has no boons.
A screech accompanies each theft, interrupting spellcasting in enemies near the target.
This is a theft and sound effect.
harpy.tag: This is a theft and sound effect.

harvest.name: Gleaner's Sweep
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A sweeping special attack that strikes several enemies reaps from each of them. For every enemy struck, you recover health and stamina, and your next special attack deals increased damage.
Enemies below a quarter of their health struck by the sweep are cut down outright if they are of lower rank than you.
This is a harvest and execution effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and execution effect.

heidel.name: Trampling Pace
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While mounted, your special attacks gain the mount's momentum, dealing increased damage the faster you are moving.
Enemies you pass close to while riding are trampled, taking damage and being knocked down.
This is a mounted effect.

hook.name: Catch and Reel
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A special attack can be thrown as a hook on a line. The hook catches the first enemy it strikes and reels it to you, or reels you to it if it is larger than you.
Your next special attack against a reeled enemy strikes before it can act.
This is a pull effect.

horse.name: Cavalry Charge
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can conjure a spectral steed for the length of a single charge. The charge carries you a long distance and ends with your chosen special attack at full force.
The steed tramples enemies in its path. It vanishes when the charge ends and returns after a short cooldown.
This is a conjuration and charge effect.
horse.tag: This is a conjuration and charge effect.

hunger.name: Ravenous Strike
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks devour a portion of the target's mana and stamina, restoring yours.
While your stamina is low, your special attacks deal increased damage, growing stronger the emptier you are.
This is a devouring effect.

hunt.name: Quarry's Mark
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can mark one enemy as your quarry. You always know its direction, and your special attacks against it deal increased damage.
If the quarry flees, your movement speed increases while you pursue it. Killing it lets you mark a new quarry at once.
This is a hunting and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunting and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Regrown Neck
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When one of your special attacks is blocked, dodged or interrupted, it grows a second head: it strikes again immediately with a weaker copy of itself.
A copy that is also blocked grows another, up to three times. Each copy inflicts a stacking poison.
This is a regrowth and poison effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regrowth and poison effect.

ice.name: Icebound Rampart
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks that strike the ground raise a wall of ice along their path. The wall blocks movement and projectiles for a short time.
A special attack that strikes your own ice wall shatters it outward, sending shards into everything on the far side.
This is an ice and conjuration effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and conjuration effect.

immortal.name: Refused End
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Once per day, when a blow would kill you, you instead survive with a sliver of health and are free to make one special attack that costs nothing and deals massive damage. This recovers over 24 hours.
For a short time after this triggers, damage you take is converted into increased damage on your special attacks.
This is an undying effect.

iron.name: Cold Iron Verdict
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks deal increased damage to fey, spirits and magically-sustained creatures, and suppress their regeneration for a short time.
Conjured weapons and barriers struck by your special attacks break.
This is an iron and anti-magic effect.
iron.tag: This is an iron and anti-magic effect.

juggernaut.name: Rolling Weight
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land in succession without being knocked down adds momentum. Momentum increases your movement speed and the damage of your special attacks.
At full momentum, your movement itself becomes a special attack: enemies you run into take damage and are trampled. Being knocked down, stunned or rooted loses all momentum.
This is a momentum effect.

karmic.name: Ledger of Blows
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Every hit an enemy lands on you is written against it. A special attack made against that enemy settles the account, dealing bonus damage equal to a portion of everything it has done to you this fight.
Once an account is settled, it starts again from nothing. Hovering over an enemy shows what it owes.
This is a karmic and retribution effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and retribution effect.

knife.name: Between the Ribs
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks made from behind or against an unaware enemy cost no stamina and inflict a deep wound that bleeds heavily.
A deep wound cannot be healed while you remain within sight of the target.
This is a backstab and bleed effect.
knife.tag: This is a backstab and bleed effect.

knowledge.name: Read the Opening
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each time you fight a kind of enemy, you learn it. With enough fights, its attacks show their timing to you, and a special attack used in that window counters the attack outright.
Knowledge gained this way is kept across fights and regions.
This is a knowledge and counter effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and counter effect.

kraken.name: Drawn Under
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks reach further than your weapon should, extending as a lashing tentacle of force. An enemy struck at the far end of the reach is seized and dragged to you.
An enemy dragged into deep water, a pit or a chasm this way is pulled down and takes heavy damage. Enemies far larger than you resist the drag.
This is a reach and grapple effect.
kraken.tag: This is a reach and grapple effect.

leviathan.name: Wake of the Hull
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack sends out a wave that pushes all nearby enemies and loose objects a short distance away from you, clearing space and interrupting enemies caught mid-attack.
In water, the wave is a crushing surge that deals heavy damage and drags swimming enemies under.
This is a water and displacement effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and displacement effect.

life.name: Lifeblow
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks heal the nearest ally for a portion of the damage they deal.
A special attack that would kill an enemy can instead be pulled, leaving it at the edge of death and fully healing the ally beside you. This can be done once per fight.
This is a healing effect.

light.name: Radiant Cut
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks flash with light on impact, blinding the target and revealing any invisible or hidden enemies nearby.
Undead and shadow creatures take increased damage from your special attacks and cannot regenerate while blinded.
This is a light and revealing effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revealing effect.

lightning.name: Thunderstep
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to become lightning for the length of one special attack, crossing to the target instantly and striking it with lightning damage.
The bolt arcs to a second enemy near the first. This shares a cooldown with the attack used.
This is a lightning and teleport effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and teleport effect.

lizard.name: Shed Skin
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When an enemy's attack would hit you during a special attack's wind-up, you can shed a husk of skin that takes the hit for you. The husk stays in place as a distraction.
You can shed once per fight. The skin regrows over time out of combat.
This is an evasion and decoy effect.
lizard.tag: This is an evasion and decoy effect.

locust.name: Swarm Strike
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks release a cloud of locusts that follows the target, dealing small damage over time and devouring any food, potions and consumables it uses.
The cloud jumps to a new target when the first dies.
This is a swarm effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Using a special attack cleanses one affliction from you. If it is a poison, corruption or curse, the attack deals bonus damage of a matching type to the target.
A special attack made while you carry no afflictions blooms, granting you a brief boon of damage reduction.
This is a purification effect.

lurker.name: From Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can sink into the ground or shadow, or crouch still in shallow water, and wait unseen, with your stamina recovering while you wait.
Your first special attack after emerging strikes from beneath the target, launching it into the air and dealing significantly increased damage.
This is a concealment and ambush effect.
lurker.tag: This is a concealment and ambush effect.

magic.name: Arcane Edge
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can be charged with mana as you begin them. A charged special attack also counts as a spell, triggering effects that respond to either.
A charged special attack that strikes a spell barrier or magical shield breaks it outright instead of being absorbed.
This is a magic and special attack effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and special attack effect.

malign.name: Grudge Blade
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each enemy that damages you is marked with a grudge. Your next special attack against a grudge-marked enemy consumes every grudge it carries and deals additional damage for each one.
Grudges never expire while the enemy lives. Only the enemy that dealt the damage is marked.
This is a curse and special attack effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and special attack effect.

manatee.name: Drifting Current
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks made without moving for a short time beforehand cost no stamina.
While standing in water, your special attacks push struck enemies away on a slow current, and they cannot act against the current until it fades.
This is a water and special attack effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and special attack effect.

manticore.name: Spined Tail
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land is followed by a scorpion-tail strike from behind you at the same enemy, injecting a venom affliction that slows the target.
You can spend stamina to fire the tail's quills instead, striking every enemy in a cone in front of you with a lesser dose of the venom.
This is a venom and beast effect.
manticore.tag: This is a venom and beast effect.

master.name: Settled Form
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Each special attack you use has its own mastery, which grows every time it lands. As mastery rises, the attack gains reduced cost, then reduced cooldown, then a perfect-strike window: pressing it at the exact moment a previous attack connects makes it critical.
Mastery is kept between fights and resets only if the attack is replaced.
This is a mastery effect.

might.name: Overbearing Blow
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend additional stamina on a special attack as you begin it. The attack deals significantly more damage and knocks down any struck enemy of equal or lower rank.
An enemy that blocks an overbearing blow takes the damage anyway and has its guard broken for a short time.
This is a force and special attack effect.
might.tag: This is a force and special attack effect.

ministration.name: Laid Hand
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Damage dealt by your special attacks is partly returned as healing to the ally with the lowest health near you.
An ally healed this way also has one wounding or bleeding affliction closed. A special attack that kills an enemy heals that ally fully if they are below a quarter of their health, once per fight.
This is a healing effect.

minotaur.name: Heart of the Maze
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

When you begin a fight, you can claim the ground around you as your maze. Inside it, enemies that turn away from you become lost briefly, and your special attacks against them become charging gores that knock them into walls.
Enemies that try to leave the maze are slowed. The maze holds until you leave it.
This is a terrain and disorientation effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a terrain and disorientation effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Lunge
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While you are moving, you appear to stand a short distance from where you actually are. Enemies aim at the false position.
A special attack made from inside the haze strikes before the target sees it coming and cannot be dodged. Standing still for a moment dispels the haze.
This is an illusion effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

When an enemy strikes you with a special attack, you can spend mana in the instant it lands to answer with a mirrored image of it. The image strikes the attacker with a portion of the attack's damage and effects.
This can trigger once every short interval.
This is a reflection and special attack effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and special attack effect.

monkey.name: Sleight of Hand
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can snatch a struck enemy's held item, buff or carried consumable, placing it in your inventory or removing it from the fight.
An enemy robbed this way is briefly confused, turning to search for what it lost.
Each enemy can be robbed once per fight.
This is a theft and special attack effect.
monkey.tag: This is a theft and special attack effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can drive a special attack into the ground to raise a standing stone. The stone blocks movement and projectiles, and enemies next to it take damage from your special attacks a second time as the shock passes through the stone.
The stone endures for a long time, and only one can stand at once.
This is an earth and monument effect.
monolith.tag: This is an earth and monument effect.

moon.name: Tide Turn
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks pull struck enemies toward you or push them away, alternating with each use like a tide.
At night, special attacks that strike an enemy under moonlight reveal it to you and your allies for a short time, including through invisibility.
This is a light and special attack effect.
moon.tag: This is a light and special attack effect.

mouse.name: Underfoot Strike
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks against enemies much larger than you strike their legs, slowing them and leaving them unable to target you for a moment.
After a special attack, you can scurry a short distance in any direction without breaking stealth or provoking reactions.
This is a stealth and special attack effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and special attack effect.

myriad.name: Thousand Hands
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

When you make a special attack, you can spend mana to have several brief selves strike alongside you from different angles. Each self strikes once for a portion of the attack's damage before dissolving.
The number of selves scales with your rank.
This is a multiplicity and special attack effect.
myriad.tag: This is a multiplicity and special attack effect.

mystic.name: Inner Sight
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You sense the weakest point of every enemy within aura-sense range, shown as a mark on its body. A special attack that strikes the mark is always critical and restores mana.
The mark moves to a new point after each hit, and you can sense it through stealth and illusions.
This is a perception and precision effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and precision effect.

nebula.name: Forming Core
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Your special attacks leave a drifting cloud of dust and cold gas behind them. Clouds slowly draw together. When several clouds touch, they collapse into a forming star that detonates, damaging every enemy around it.
The more clouds that merge, the larger the detonation. Clouds fade if left alone too long.
This is a cosmic and delayed effect.
nebula.tag: This is a cosmic and delayed effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks strike through armour and damage reduction entirely, but deal reduced damage against enemies wearing none.
A special attack that strikes the same point as your previous one within a short time pins the enemy in place briefly.
This is a piercing and special attack effect.
needle.tag: This is a piercing and special attack effect.

nemesis.name: Marked Name
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can declare one enemy your nemesis. Your special attacks against your nemesis deal significantly increased damage and track it through stealth, illusions and teleports.
Your special attacks against everything else deal reduced damage until the nemesis dies or you release it. A nemesis that escapes you remains marked the next time you meet it, even in another region.
This is a pursuit effect.

net.name: Trawling Sweep
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your sweeping special attacks drag every struck enemy into a single cluster at the end of the swing.
Enemies clustered this way are entangled together and slowed for a short time, and an area attack that strikes the cluster damages all of them.
This is a restraint and special attack effect.
net.tag: This is a restraint and special attack effect.

network.name: Passed Word
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you land a special attack, every ally in your party learns the target's weaknesses and remaining health instantly.
Allies who strike the same target within a short time after you have their special attacks' cooldowns reduced. Your own next special attack is reduced in cost for each ally who followed up.
This is a coordination effect.

oasis.name: Cool Spring
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Each special attack you land fills a reserve. You can spend the full reserve to plant a spring where you stand. Allies resting at the spring recover health, mana and stamina quickly, and are cleansed of heat, burning and exhaustion afflictions.
The spring lasts for a short time and fully restores the reserve if you fight beside it.
This is a water and sanctuary effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and sanctuary effect.

ocean.name: Tide's Return
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After a special attack, you are drawn back like the tide to where you stood before making it. Every enemy you pass on the way back is struck by a lesser wave.
Repeating the same special attack on the same enemy erodes it, reducing its maximum health by a small amount for the rest of the fight with each repeat.
This is a water and erosion effect.
ocean.tag: This is a water and erosion effect.

octopus.name: Eightfold Grip
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After a special attack lands, ghostly arms keep hold of the target, striking it repeatedly for a short time and preventing it from leaving melee range.
You can release the hold early to throw the enemy a short distance.
Only one enemy can be held at a time.
This is a grapple and special attack effect.
octopus.tag: This is a grapple and special attack effect.

omen.name: Read Opening
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Moments before an enemy becomes vulnerable, through recovering from an attack, losing its guard or turning away, a sign appears over it.
A special attack made while the sign is shown is a guaranteed critical hit and resets that special attack's cooldown.
This is a divination and special attack effect.
omen.tag: This is a divination and special attack effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
If you use a special attack within a short window of the previous one landing, it continues the rhythm. Every attack in a rhythm deals increased damage and the target cannot act between them.
The rhythm breaks if you miss a beat, are struck, or pause. A rhythm of five or more ends in a finishing blow that knocks the target down.
This is a combo effect.

pangolin.name: Scaled Lunge
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While a special attack is being performed, your armour overlaps into a shell and you take significantly reduced damage from the front.
You can curl and roll into a special attack, closing distance while rolling. Ranged attacks that strike you during the roll are deflected.
This is a defensive and special attack effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and special attack effect.

paper.name: Written Strike
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can inscribe a special attack onto a scroll while out of combat, at the cost of mana. Reading the scroll in combat performs that special attack instantly without using its cooldown.
Only a few scrolls can be carried at once, and they are consumed when read.
This is a scroll and special attack effect.
paper.tag: This is a scroll and special attack effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Unreliable Room
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Every special attack you land conjures a phantom attacker in the target's mind. The target sees enemies that are not there and spends its next attacks on them.
An enemy haunted by three phantoms is consumed by nightmare and cannot act for a short time. Enemies immune to mind effects ignore phantoms.
This is an illusion and mind effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and mind effect.

phoenix.name: Kindled Crest
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you fall below a quarter of your health, your next special attack ignites you: it deals heavy fire damage in an area and returns a large portion of the damage dealt as healing to you.
After this ignition, it cannot happen again until your health has been fully restored and you have rested out of combat.
This is a fire and rebirth effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and rebirth effect.

plant.name: Rooting Blow
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks leave a seed in struck enemies. Seeds sprout after a short delay, rooting the enemy and draining its health to heal you.
An enemy can carry only one seed at a time. Rooted enemies can still attack anything in reach.
This is a plant and special attack effect.
plant.tag: This is a plant and special attack effect.

potent.name: Condensed Strike
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your area special attacks can be condensed into a single target as you begin them. A condensed attack strikes one enemy for the combined damage it would have spread across the whole area.
This is a power and special attack effect.
potent.tag: This is a power and special attack effect.

predatory.name: Chosen One
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
In every group of enemies, you can see which one is weakest: the lowest health, the most afflicted, or the least able to escape. That enemy is marked.
Your special attacks deal increased damage to the marked enemy, and closing the distance to it costs no stamina. When it dies, the mark passes to the next weakest.
This is a hunting effect.

prison.name: Held Key
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to make a special attack a sentence. A sentenced enemy is chained to the spot where it was struck; it can attack but cannot move further than a short tether from that spot.
Sentences stack in length with each special attack, and higher-rank enemies break their chains sooner.
This is a binding effect.
