prosperity.name: Golden Year
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend currency to empower a special attack. The more you spend, the greater the damage, up to a cap that rises with rank.
Enemies killed by an empowered attack drop currency equal to a portion of what was spent, and any equipment they drop is one rarity higher.
This is a fortune effect.

pure.name: Undiluted Cut
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks strip one boon from the enemies they strike, and cleanse one affliction from you for each boon stripped.
Special attacks against corrupted, undead or tainted enemies deal additional damage and cannot be resisted.
This is a purification and special attack effect.
pure.tag: This is a purification and special attack effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt and Strike
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After a special attack, you can bolt away at high speed for a moment, leaving enemies briefly unable to track you.
A special attack made immediately after taking damage launches you past the attacker, striking it on the way through.
This is a movement and special attack effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and special attack effect.

rake.name: Gathered Leavings
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your sweeping special attacks drag loot, dropped weapons and scattered projectiles on the ground toward you.
Dropped weapons gathered this way can be hurled at enemies as a follow-up, dealing damage based on their quality.
This is a gathering and special attack effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and special attack effect.

rat.name: Swarming Bite
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks release a scattering of spirit rats that swarm the struck enemy, gnawing at it for a short time.
While you are below a portion of your maximum health, the rats instead scatter around you, intercepting attacks. Each rat is destroyed when it intercepts.
This is a summoning and special attack effect.
rat.tag: This is a summoning and special attack effect.

reagent.name: Volatile Edge
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can coat your weapon with a potion from your inventory. Your next few special attacks apply that potion's effect to the enemies they strike instead of to you, turning healing into harm and boons into afflictions where appropriate.
This consumes the potion.
This is an alchemy and special attack effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and special attack effect.

refracting.name: Bent Beam
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
For a brief moment after you use a special attack, projectiles and spell bolts that strike you are deflected in a direction you choose.
A projectile deflected into an enemy deals its full damage to that enemy plus the damage of your special attack.
This is a deflection effect.

renewal.name: Seasonal Cycle
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks cycle through four seasons in order. Spring heals you, summer burns, autumn strips a boon, and winter slows.
Completing a full cycle against the same enemy restores the cooldowns of all your special attacks.
This is a renewal and special attack effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal and special attack effect.

resolute.name: Planted Stand
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While you plant yourself and do not move, you cannot be knocked back, staggered or interrupted, and your special attacks deal increased damage for each second you have held position.
Moving ends the effect. Holding position costs stamina over time.
This is a stance and special attack effect.
resolute.tag: This is a stance and special attack effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic String
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Each special attack strikes a tone in the target. Striking the same enemy again raises the tone; at its peak, the enemy shatters with a resonant burst that damages every enemy that shares its species or type nearby.
Armoured and crystalline enemies resonate faster.
This is a sound and resonance effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound and resonance effect.

roc.name: Shadow Before
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend stamina to cast your vast shadow across an area before striking. Enemies under the shadow are frozen in fear for a short time, unable to move or attack.
The special attack that follows lands on everything beneath the shadow at once. Enemies of higher rank shake off the fear sooner.
This is a fear and area effect.
roc.tag: This is a fear and area effect.

rune.name: Graven Mark
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack carves a rune into the struck enemy. Different special attacks carve different runes.
When an enemy bears three different runes from you, you can spend mana to detonate them together for heavy damage and a brief stun.
This is a rune and special attack effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and special attack effect.

sacrifice.name: Paid Price
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can pay health instead of mana or stamina for your special attacks. Attacks paid for in health deal significantly increased damage, scaled by how much was paid.
A special attack paid in health that kills an enemy returns the price to you.
This is a blood and sacrifice effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a blood and sacrifice effect.

sand.name: Grinding Sands
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks throw grit into the struck enemy's eyes, reducing its accuracy for a short time. This stacks with each hit.
An enemy at full stacks is blinded briefly and loses track of you, letting your next special attack strike as though from stealth.
This is an earth and special attack effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and special attack effect.

sceptre.name: Royal Decree
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can declare a special attack against a chosen enemy. Until that attack lands or a short time passes, lower-rank enemies near the target will not interfere, and allies who strike the target gain increased damage.
If the declared attack lands, the target must kneel, losing its next action.
This is an authority and special attack effect.
sceptre.tag: This is an authority and special attack effect.

scribe.name: Fixed Record
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

The damage of your special attacks is written down. Once per fight, you can spend mana to make the next special attack deal exactly the highest damage recorded for that attack, regardless of the target's resistances.
Records are kept between fights, and you can view them in your ability ledger.
This is a recording effect.

serene.name: Still Water Form
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While you have not taken damage for a short time, your next special attack cannot miss and cannot be blocked, parried or dodged.
Taking damage while serene grants a brief window in which a special attack counters the blow instead of being made normally.
This is a stance and special attack effect.
serene.tag: This is a stance and special attack effect.

serpent.name: Strike from the Coil
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While you stand still, you coil, building tension over time. Your next special attack releases it, lunging further and dealing increased damage the longer you waited.
Fully coiled, the strike sheds your skin: you leave behind any affliction you carried and are briefly untargetable.
This is a serpent and lunge effect.
serpent.tag: This is a serpent and lunge effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Bleeding enemies within aura-sense range are marked to you. Your special attacks against a bleeding enemy deal increased damage, and against one below half health they strike twice.
You gain movement speed while moving toward a marked enemy.
This is a predatory and special attack effect.
shark.tag: This is a predatory and special attack effect.

shield.name: Shield Bash
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While blocking, you can perform a special attack without lowering your guard. The attack strikes with the shield, staggering the target.
Blocking an attack in the moment before it lands grants a stack of retort. Your next special attack consumes all stacks for additional damage.
This is a defensive and special attack effect.
shield.tag: This is a defensive and special attack effect.

shimmer.name: Afterimage Strike
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you make a special attack, a shimmering afterimage remains where you stood for a short time. Enemies see the afterimage as you and attack it.
You can spend mana to switch places with your afterimage while it remains. This is an illusion and teleport effect.

ship.name: Broadside
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks made while moving carry your momentum, dealing increased damage scaled to your speed.
Your sweeping special attacks fire a broadside to both flanks, striking enemies to your left and right for a portion of the attack's damage.
This is a momentum and special attack effect.
ship.tag: This is a momentum and special attack effect.

shovel.name: Undermining Strike
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can be driven into the ground, opening a pit beneath enemies in front of you. Enemies in the pit are slowed and cannot dodge.
You can spend stamina to throw the turned earth, blinding enemies it strikes for a moment.
This is an earth and special attack effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and special attack effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Arc
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your arcing special attacks deal increased damage to every enemy below half health they strike, and execute lower-rank enemies below a small portion of their health outright.
Each enemy executed this way returns a portion of the attack's stamina cost.
This is a harvest and special attack effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and special attack effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to leave a near-copy of yourself standing where you are. It holds your stance and draws attacks for a short time.
When you use a special attack, the stand-in makes the same attack against its own nearest enemy. The stand-in breaks after taking a few hits.
This is a simulacrum effect.

sin.name: Cherished Wrong
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Enemies that have harmed allies, civilians or the helpless carry a mark of sin you can see. Your special attacks deal increased damage to them for each sin they carry, and cannot be resisted by them.
Enemies with no sin take reduced damage from your special attacks.
This is a judgement and special attack effect.
sin.tag: This is a judgement and special attack effect.

skirmish.name: Given Ground
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After a special attack lands, you can disengage with a quick step backward that costs no stamina and leaves you untargetable for an instant.
An enemy that chases you after a disengage runs into a free counter-strike. Disengaging puts the step on a short cooldown.
This is a skirmish and movement effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a skirmish and movement effect.

skunk.name: Musk Strike
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks leave a lingering stench on struck enemies. Other enemies avoid standing near a stenched enemy, breaking up groups.
A stenched enemy that flees is followed by the cloud. Allies are unaffected.
This is a repellent and special attack effect.
skunk.tag: This is a repellent and special attack effect.

sky.name: Ceiling Off
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can launch the target into the air. A launched enemy is helpless until it lands, and you can follow it up with a leaping special attack that drives it back into the ground.
An enemy slammed down this way takes impact damage and creates a shockwave around it. Heavy and higher-rank enemies cannot be launched.
This is an air and juggle effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and juggle effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Strike
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can perform a special attack slowly, taking significantly longer to execute it. A slow special attack deals heavy damage and cannot be interrupted.
Enemies struck by a slow special attack are slowed for the same time it took you to perform it.
This is a deliberation and special attack effect.
sloth.tag: This is a deliberation and special attack effect.

smoke.name: Vanishing Strike
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
After making a special attack, you can spend mana to vanish into smoke, becoming invisible for a short time.
The first special attack you make from smoke reappears you behind your target and deals critical damage.
This is a smoke and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and stealth effect.

snake.name: Coiled Strike
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can hold a special attack coiled, waiting with it ready. While coiled, the first enemy to come within reach is struck instantly and poisoned.
Holding a coil costs stamina over time. Moving releases it.
This is a poison and special attack effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and special attack effect.

soaring.name: Thermal Rise
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land catches you on an updraft. While it carries you, you move in a rush of wind and your special attacks cost no stamina.
Stopping ends the rush. Taking a heavy hit while it carries you knocks you out of it and ends the effect early.
This is a flight effect.

song.name: Measure and Rhythm
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks made in time with a steady rhythm of your basic attacks build cadence. Each special attack made on the beat deals increased damage and costs less stamina.
Allies who hear your cadence gain attack speed. Missing the beat resets it.
This is a sound and special attack effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and special attack effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Command
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can speak a command as you use a special attack: kneel, halt or yield. An enemy of lower rank struck by the attack obeys, kneeling helpless, halting in place, or dropping its weapon, for a short time.
Enemies of equal rank resist the command but are staggered. Each command can only be given once per fight to the same enemy.
This is a command and authority effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command and authority effect.

spear.name: Thrown Point
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Any melee special attack can be thrown instead, striking at range with your weapon. The weapon returns to your hand after it strikes or reaches its maximum distance.
A thrown special attack that pierces an enemy continues to the next enemy in line at reduced damage.
This is a ranged and special attack effect.
spear.tag: This is a ranged and special attack effect.

spider.name: Strung Web
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack strings a strand of web between you and the target. While strands are attached, you can pull yourself to any tethered enemy.
An enemy tethered by three strands is bound in a web, unable to move for a short time.
This is a web and special attack effect.
spider.tag: This is a web and special attack effect.

spike.name: Waiting Point
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks leave spikes in the ground where they land. Enemies that walk over a spike are struck by the special attack again at reduced damage.
Only a few spikes can exist at a time. The oldest breaks when a new one forms.
This is a trap and special attack effect.
spike.tag: This is a trap and special attack effect.

staff.name: Vaulting Staff
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can begin a special attack by vaulting over obstacles or small enemies, striking from above when you land.
A vaulting special attack ignores the target's guard, and you take no damage from attacks made against you during the vault.
This is a movement and special attack effect.
staff.tag: This is a movement and special attack effect.

star.name: Falling Star
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Once per fight, you can perform a special attack with a mighty leap. You spring out of reach and crash down like a star on the target area, dealing heavy fire damage to all enemies there.
The landing marks the ground with starlight that empowers your next special attack made inside it.
This is a fire and special attack effect.
star.tag: This is a fire and special attack effect.

stellar.name: Fixed Point
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks gain range the further away the target is, and those made from long range strike as falling starlight, inflicting heavy fire damage in a small area.
The further you are from the target, the greater the damage. Special attacks made at close range are unaffected.
This is a star and ranged effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and ranged effect.

storm.name: Strike-Path
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You carry a storm front with you during combat. Each special attack calls a lightning strike onto the target, and enemies standing in water or rain take additional damage and are briefly stunned.
In real rain, every special attack calls two strikes instead of one.
This is a storm and lightning effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and lightning effect.

succubus.name: Taken Breath
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks draw warmth from the target. Each one that lands steals a portion of the target's stamina and gives it to you.
An enemy drained of all stamina becomes charmed for a short time and fights beside you. Higher-rank enemies cannot be charmed but are drained twice as fast.
This is a draining and charm effect.
succubus.tag: This is a draining and charm effect.

sun.name: High Noon
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks flash with blinding light, briefly blinding enemies facing you.
During daylight, outdoors, your special attacks deal additional fire damage and enemies cannot hide from them in shadow or stealth.
This is a light and special attack effect.
sun.tag: This is a light and special attack effect.

swarm.name: Covering Cloud
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you use a special attack, you break apart into a swarm for an instant and reform behind or beside the target, striking from the new position.
While you are a swarm, you take no damage from single-target attacks. The swarm passes through enemies and leaves each one it touched with a crawling affliction that deals damage over time.
This is a swarm and dispersal effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and dispersal effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Chain
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Making a special attack shortens the cooldowns of your other special attacks by a small amount.
Using three different special attacks in quick succession grants a brief burst of speed during which special attacks cost no stamina.
This is a speed and special attack effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and special attack effect.

sword.name: Drawn Blade
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can sheathe your weapon as you prepare a special attack. The first special attack made from the sheath is a draw-cut that strikes before the enemy can react, interrupting any action it was taking.
Resheathing takes a moment and cannot be done while taking damage.
This is a technique and special attack effect.
sword.tag: This is a technique and special attack effect.

talisman.name: Kept Token
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can bind one ring or amulet you wear to your special attacks. While it is bound, every special attack carries the jewel's passive effect, and on a critical hit, a copy of that effect is applied to the target as well.
Changing the bound ring or amulet requires resting out of combat.
This is a talisman effect.

tentacle.name: Abyssal Grasp
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks extend long tentacles from the deep, increasing their reach significantly.
An enemy struck at the edge of that reach is dragged into melee range and held for a moment.
This is a reach and special attack effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a reach and special attack effect.

thread.name: Stitched Wound
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks stitch struck enemies to one another with binding thread. Damage dealt to one stitched enemy is shared with every other enemy on the same thread at reduced strength.
A thread can bind only a few enemies and snaps after a short time or when any of them dies.
This is a binding and special attack effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and special attack effect.

thunderbird.name: Thunderclap
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend stamina to make your next special attack a thunderclap. It deals lightning damage to everything around you and deafens enemies, interrupting spellcasting.
After a thunderclap, a storm-bird follows you for a short time, diving onto any enemy you strike with a special attack.
This is a storm and summoning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and summoning effect.

time.name: Delayed Moment
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can delay a special attack. It lands normally, but its damage is withheld for a short time and then delivered all at once, increased by a portion for every second it waited.
While damage is withheld, the target does not know it has been struck and does not react. Only one attack can be withheld at a time.
This is a time effect.

tranquil.name: Settled Dust
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks quieten enemies. Each one removes a stack of frenzy, rage or haste from the target and calms it.
A calm enemy struck by a special attack is lulled, falling still for a short time. Striking a lulled enemy wakes it but deals critical damage.
This is a calming effect.

transfiguration.name: Remade Line
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can rest out of combat to reshape one special attack. Its damage type, range and shape can be changed between options that fit your essences, such as a thrust becoming a sweep or a physical blow becoming a fire blow.
A reshaped attack keeps its level and cooldown. Each attack can be reshaped once per day.
This is a transformation effect.

transgression.name: Named Sin
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You see the transgressions of enemies around you: those that have attacked from behind, broken a truce, fled from a fight they started or struck a downed foe are marked.
Your special attacks against a marked enemy deal significantly increased damage and cannot be resisted.
This is a judgement effect.

trap.name: Sprung Jaw
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can set a special attack as a trap on the ground instead of performing it. The trap triggers the full special attack on the first enemy to step on it and starts the attack's cooldown at that moment.
Only one special attack can be set as a trap at a time. Traps are invisible to enemies of lower rank.
This is a trap and special attack effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and special attack effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Swing
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While standing near trees or in a forest, your special attacks draw strength from the ground, healing you for a portion of the damage they deal.
Once per fight, you can root yourself for a short time. While rooted you cannot move or be moved, and your special attacks strike every enemy within reach.
This is a nature and special attack effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and special attack effect.

troll.name: Knotted Muscle
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land closes your wounds, restoring health and removing a bleed. You can spend health to extend your reach with a special attack, your arm stretching to strike distant enemies.
Fire damage stops this regeneration for a short time.
This is a regeneration effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Course
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks raise a low course of wall behind struck enemies, preventing them from retreating or being knocked back past it.
An enemy driven into the wall by a later special attack takes additional damage and is stunned briefly.
This is a construction and special attack effect.
trowel.tag: This is a construction and special attack effect.

turtle.name: Shell Retort
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can withdraw into a shell for a short time, taking almost no damage and storing a portion of the damage you would have taken.
Your first special attack after leaving the shell releases the stored damage onto its target.
Withdrawing costs stamina and cannot be repeated until the shell recovers.
This is a defensive and special attack effect.
turtle.tag: This is a defensive and special attack effect.

twilight.name: Closing Dark
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

You can call the grey hour around you, dimming the light for a short time. In that dimness, enemies have trouble seeing you, and your special attacks made from the shadows count as attacks from behind.
Special attacks made under the dimness lengthen it. Calling it costs mana.
This is a darkness and stealth effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and stealth effect.

undeath.name: Refused Grave
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
An enemy killed by a special attack rises briefly as a cold-handed corpse that makes one attack of its own before falling for good.
Your special attacks deal increased damage to undead enemies and prevent them from rising again.
This is a necromantic effect.

unity.name: Joined Hand
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you and an ally strike the same enemy with special attacks at nearly the same time, the attacks merge into a single joint strike that deals the combined damage plus a large bonus.
A joint strike shares its cooldown reduction between both of you and stuns the target.
This is a cooperation effect.

vast.name: Borderless Reach
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to make a special attack strike any enemy you can see, regardless of distance. The strike folds space to arrive in front of the target.
A distant strike deals reduced damage. It can only be used every short interval.
This is a space and special attack effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and special attack effect.

vehicle.name: Ramming Charge
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
While mounted, you can perform special attacks without dismounting, and your mount's speed is added to their damage.
When unmounted, a special attack made at the end of a sprint carries you through the target, striking every enemy in your path.
This is a mounted and special attack effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a mounted and special attack effect.

venom.name: Lingering Dose
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks inject slow-working venom that deals no damage at first. When the venom runs its course, it deals all of its damage at once.
Each further special attack on the same enemy deepens the venom, adding to the final damage and extending its course.
This is a poison and special attack effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and special attack effect.

verdant.name: Root-Thread
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Special attacks you make while standing on soil, grass or plant matter draw creepers up around the target, entangling it and holding it for a short time.
Entangled enemies take bonus damage from your next special attack, which tears the creepers free and spreads them to an adjacent enemy.
This is a plant and entangle effect.
verdant.tag: This is a plant and entangle effect.

vessel.name: Carried Power
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can absorb an enemy's special attack. When you are struck by one, you can spend stamina to hold it within you instead of taking damage.
Your next special attack releases the held attack alongside your own, with all of its effects. Only one attack can be held at a time.
This is a vessel and absorption effect.
vessel.tag: This is a vessel and absorption effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Face
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When you defeat an enemy with a special attack, you can take its face. While wearing it, other enemies of its kind treat you as an ally until you attack.
Your first special attack made while wearing a face is a critical hit and removes the face.
This is a disguise and special attack effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and special attack effect.

vision.name: Shown Moment
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You see the next attack of any enemy you are facing a moment before it happens, shown as a ghostly image.
A special attack used to counter a shown attack lands first, cancels it, and deals critical damage. Countering successfully puts your special attack on a reduced cooldown.
This is a precognition effect.

void.name: Hungry Nothing
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks open a small tear of void at the point of impact. The tear pulls nearby enemies and projectiles inward for a short time and devours any projectile that reaches it.
A tear that devours enough projectiles collapses violently, damaging every enemy around it.
This is a void and special attack effect.
void.tag: This is a void and special attack effect.

volcano.name: Ash Column
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Each hit you take builds pressure. You can release all built pressure through your next special attack, which erupts in a column of ash and magma, dealing fire damage around the target and leaving burning ground.
The more pressure released, the greater the eruption. Pressure fades slowly out of combat.
This is a fire and eruption effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and eruption effect.

vortex.name: Pulling Centre
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks leave a spinning vortex where they land for a short time. Enemies near the vortex are pulled toward its centre.
A second special attack into the vortex makes it collapse, striking everyone it has gathered at once.
This is an air and pull effect.
vortex.tag: This is an air and pull effect.

wasp.name: Vengeful Sting
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each time an enemy damages you, your next special attack against it gains a stacking sting. At full stacks, the special attack paralyses the enemy briefly.
Stings can be delivered as fast darting strikes that do not trigger the special attack's cooldown, but deal reduced damage.
This is a venom and special attack effect.
wasp.tag: This is a venom and special attack effect.

water.name: Breaking Wave
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks send a wave forward from the point of impact, carrying struck enemies with it and slamming them into walls or other enemies.
Enemies soaked by the wave take increased cold and lightning damage for a short time.
This is a water and special attack effect.
water.tag: This is a water and special attack effect.

weave.name: Tied Knot
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Each special attack you land ties a thread from you to the target. Enemies tied together with threads share a portion of each other's damage.
Striking one tied enemy with a special attack sends a weaker copy of it through every thread. Threads snap if enemies move too far apart.
This is a binding and chain effect.
weave.tag: This is a binding and chain effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Shape
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks deal cold damage and frost the target, slowing it. Each special attack that lands feeds your hunger, briefly increasing your movement speed.
While you have not landed a special attack for a short time, your hunger grows, increasing your special attack damage but slowly draining your health until you strike again.
This is a cold and hunger effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and hunger effect.

whale.name: Deep Call
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].

Your heaviest special attacks release a deep, resonating call on impact that travels through the ground. Enemies within a wide area are staggered, and enemies hidden or burrowed are forced into the open.
The call cannot be blocked by walls or terrain.
This is a sound and special attack effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and special attack effect.

wheel.name: Turning Rim
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your spinning special attacks keep spinning while you hold them, striking repeatedly and moving with you. Each rotation costs stamina.
The longer a spin lasts, the faster it turns and the more damage each rotation deals.
This is a momentum and special attack effect.
wheel.tag: This is a momentum and special attack effect.

whip.name: Cracking Lash
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks can be lashed out at long reach, striking only at the tip. A strike at the tip deals critical damage and disarms the enemy of its held weapon.
Disarmed enemies fight with reduced damage until they recover the weapon.
This is a reach and special attack effect.
whip.tag: This is a reach and special attack effect.

wind.name: Razor Gale
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Your special attacks release a blade of wind that continues past the target in a line, cutting every enemy it passes through.
Releasing a special attack with the wind at your back carries the blade farther and faster.
This is an air and special attack effect.
wind.tag: This is an air and special attack effect.

wing.name: Diving Pinion
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can leap forward on a great spring as you begin a special attack, then dive onto any enemy in sight, landing the attack from above.
A diving special attack knocks the target to the ground and scatters nearby enemies with the beat of your wings.
This is a flight and special attack effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and special attack effect.

wolf.name: Pack Strike
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
When an ally or summon strikes an enemy, your next special attack against that same enemy deals increased damage and briefly hamstrings it, slowing its movement.
Your summons and familiars follow up on your special attacks, attacking the same target immediately.
This is a pack and special attack effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and special attack effect.

wood.name: Living Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
A wooden weapon you wield grows with you. Each enemy of equal or higher rank you defeat with a special attack adds a ring to the weapon's grain, permanently increasing its special attack damage.
A weapon that breaks while carrying rings regrows itself from a splinter after a day.
This is a growth and special attack effect.
wood.tag: This is a growth and special attack effect.

wrath.name: Held Grudge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
Taking damage builds wrath. You can spend wrath instead of mana or stamina for your special attacks.
A special attack paid for in wrath deals increased fire damage and cannot be blocked. Unspent wrath fades out of combat.
This is a fury effect.

zeal.name: Burning Conviction
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can declare a vow to defeat a chosen enemy. While the vow holds, your special attacks against it cost no stamina and you cannot be feared or charmed.
If you defeat the enemy, all your special attack cooldowns reset. If you abandon the fight, you lose a portion of your maximum health until you rest.
This is a vow and special attack effect.
zeal.tag: This is a vow and special attack effect.

ziz.name: Horizon-Shadow
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The Sundered Throne. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The Sundered Throne].
You can spend mana to spread vast wings for a short time. While they are spread, ranged attacks and weather effects coming at you and your allies from above are blocked.
Your special attacks while the wings are spread strike in a huge arc, hitting every enemy in front of you, and knock flying enemies out of the air.
This is a flight and shelter effect.
ziz.tag: This is a flight and shelter effect.

action.name: Kindled Reflex
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When an enemy attack is about to strike you, you can trigger a movement ability you have off cooldown without it costing mana or stamina. The movement happens before the attack resolves.
Each reflexive movement leaves a small burst of flame at your starting point, damaging the attacker.
This can only happen once every short interval.
This is a movement and fire effect.
action.tag: This is a movement and fire effect.

adept.name: Practiced Flight
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each movement ability you use the same way twice in a row, on the same path shape, costs less mana or stamina the second time.

You can record one movement pattern of up to three consecutive movement abilities. Activating the recording performs all three in sequence for the cost of one, then the recording is spent until you record again out of combat.
This is a movement and mastery effect.
adept.tag: This is a movement and mastery effect.

alchemy.name: Phoenix Distillate
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Potions you drink while a movement ability is active spread their effect along your path, affecting allies you pass close to.
You can throw a potion as you dash. It shatters at your destination, splashing its effect over everyone in a small area and leaving the ground burning for a short time.
This is a movement and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a movement and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Ash Approach
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While unseen, your movement abilities make no sound and leave no light.

A movement ability that ends behind an unaware enemy erupts in fire as you arrive, inflicting fire damage and briefly blinding it with ash. Your next special attack against that enemy counts as striking from concealment.
This is a fire, stealth and movement effect.
ambush.tag: This is a fire, stealth and movement effect.

animate.name: Cinder Puppet
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, the place you left holds a smouldering figure in your shape for a short time. Enemies that lose sight of you attack the figure instead.
When the figure is destroyed or expires, it bursts, inflicting fire damage on nearby enemies and healing nearby allies.
Only one figure can exist at a time.
This is a conjuration, fire and healing effect.
animate.tag: This is a conjuration, fire and healing effect.

anzu.name: Thunderfeather Wings
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can conjure wings of storm-lit flame that carry you in great bounding leaps. While they are active, lightning damage you inflict adds fire damage. The wings consume mana.
The wings can be detonated in a thunderclap that inflicts lightning and fire damage on nearby enemies and stuns flying enemies, while healing you and nearby allies.
After a detonation, the wings cannot be conjured again until their strength recovers over 24 hours.
This is a flight, storm and healing effect.
anzu.tag: This is a flight, storm and healing effect.

ape.name: Canopy Swing
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Trees, pillars, banners and overhangs within a short range count as anchor points. Using a movement ability toward an anchor swings you around it, carrying you a greater distance in a curve you choose.
Landing from a swing onto an enemy knocks it down and grabs one item it is holding or wearing, which drops at your feet.
This is a movement and seizing effect.
ape.tag: This is a movement and seizing effect.

armour.name: Molten Plate
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your armour glows while you move. Damage you take during a movement ability is reduced significantly, and attackers that strike you mid-movement are burned.
At the end of a movement ability, you can shed the glow as molten slag on the landing spot. Enemies standing in it are slowed and burned, and your armour stays cool until your next movement ability.
This is a fire, armour and movement effect.
armour.tag: This is a fire, armour and movement effect.

arsenal.name: Phoenix Quiver
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you use a movement ability, a burning feather is added to a quiver of up to five. Feathers persist out of combat for a short time.

You can throw a feather as a ranged attack that inflicts fire damage, or plant one in the ground. Using a movement ability while a planted feather is in sight lets you arrive at the feather's position instead of your normal destination.
This is a fire, conjuration and teleport effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a fire, conjuration and teleport effect.

aspect.name: Ascendant Shape
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to take a phoenix aspect for a short time: wings of light, great bounding leaps over obstacles and immunity to slows and roots.
While the aspect is active, each landing from a leap inflicts fire damage in an area scaled to how long the aspect has burned. Ending the aspect early refunds a portion of its mana.
This is a transformation and flight effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and flight effect.

avatar.name: Ascendant Plumage
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, you can take on a greater form wreathed in phoenix fire for a short time. In this form your movement abilities have no cooldown, you are immune to slows and roots, and you leave burning ground wherever you land.
When the form ends, it collapses into a burst of healing fire that restores you and nearby allies. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a transformation, fire and healing effect.
avatar.tag: This is a transformation, fire and healing effect.

axe.name: Falling Edge
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Movement abilities that carry you forward in a leap let you end them in a downward cleave. The cleave deals fire and physical damage in a line at the landing point, its length scaling with the length of the leap.
Enemies struck by the cleave have their armour sundered for a short time.
This is a movement and fire effect.
axe.tag: This is a movement and fire effect.

balance.name: Even Wings
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You cannot be knocked back, knocked down or displaced while a movement ability is resolving.

When you end a movement ability, your health and mana move toward each other: a portion of whichever is higher, as a share of its maximum, is transferred to the lower. This can occur once every short interval.
This is a movement and equilibrium effect.
balance.tag: This is a movement and equilibrium effect.

bat.name: Dusk Wing
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
In darkness, your movement abilities make no sound and break line of sight. Enemies lose track of you for a moment after you move.
You sense the shape of the area around you by echo while moving, revealing hidden passages and invisible enemies along your path.
At night or underground, the bursts of speed from your movement abilities last longer.
This is a movement, darkness and perception effect.
bat.tag: This is a movement, darkness and perception effect.

battlefield.name: Burning Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

The path of each movement ability you use in combat becomes a line of fire for a short time. Allies standing on your side of the line gain a brief boon of increased damage; enemies who cross it take fire damage and are slowed.
Only your most recent line exists at a time.
This is a fire, terrain and battlefield effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a fire, terrain and battlefield effect.

bear.name: Charging Ember
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can be used as a bull-rush: you barrel forward on all fours, knocking back the first enemy you strike and leaving a smouldering furrow that burns enemies who cross it.
After a bull-rush you gain damage reduction for a short time, and your landing roar draws the attention of nearby lower-rank enemies.
This is a movement, fire and taunt effect.
bear.tag: This is a movement, fire and taunt effect.

bee.name: Swarm Flight
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can spend mana to break apart into a cloud of burning bees and rush as the swarm for a short distance, through enemies. Every enemy you pass through takes fire damage and gains a stinging affliction.
Allies you pass through gain a small heal over time.
This is a transformation, movement and fire effect.
bee.tag: This is a transformation, movement and fire effect.

behemoth.name: Molten Stride
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities cannot be interrupted, stopped or redirected by enemy effects.
Lower-rank enemies in your path are knocked aside and set burning; destructible terrain in your path is smashed.
Your movement abilities cost additional stamina while this is active, and it can be toggled.
This is a movement, force and fire effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a movement, force and fire effect.

bird.name: Thermal Rider
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can bound onward after any jump, fall or movement ability, carried a short way further in any direction at no cost.
Fire you create rises as a heat column for a short time. Dashing through a heat column hastens you and restores stamina.
This is a flight and fire effect.
bird.tag: This is a flight and fire effect.

blight.name: Ash and Rot
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Ground you move across is left blighted for a short time. Enemies standing in it cannot be healed, and plants and summoned growth there wither.

Once per day, you can detonate every blighted patch you have left at once. Each burns away in a flash of fire, damaging enemies within it and cleansing disease and poison from allies standing in it. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a blight, fire and cleanse effect.
blight.tag: This is a blight, fire and cleanse effect.

blood.name: Burning Veins
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can pay for movement abilities with health instead of mana or stamina.
Health spent this way is not lost but banked as smouldering blood. Your next detonation, explosion or fire ability releases the bank as healing on you and bonus fire damage on enemies around you.
This is a blood, fire and movement effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood, fire and movement effect.

bone.name: Marrow Kindling
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can vault off a corpse as though it were a step, launching yourself a long distance. The corpse shatters into burning bone shards that strike enemies around it.
Corpses you walk through crumble to burning bone dust, reducing the remaining cooldown of your movement abilities. Each corpse can be used once.
This is a bone, fire and movement effect.
bone.tag: This is a bone, fire and movement effect.

boundary.name: Threshold Flame
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to draw a short wall of phoenix flame. Allies passing through it are healed and cleansed of one affliction; enemies cannot pass through it while you are on the far side.
Using a movement ability across your own wall resets that ability's cooldown. Only one wall can exist at a time.
This is a barrier, fire and healing effect.
boundary.tag: This is a barrier, fire and healing effect.

bounty.name: Ember Largesse
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Healing you receive while a movement ability is active overflows onto allies you pass, healing them for a portion of the amount.
When you use a movement ability at full health, you drop a burning ember at your starting point. An ally who touches it recovers health, mana and stamina.
This is a healing and fire effect.
bounty.tag: This is a healing and fire effect.

bow.name: Arc of the Firebird
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can loose a burning arrow at any visible point and spend mana to dash along its path, arriving where it lands. Enemies along the path take fire damage as you pass them.
During the dash, you can fire one more arrow, which deals increased damage.
This is a movement, ranged and fire effect.
bow.tag: This is a movement, ranged and fire effect.

brush.name: Wildfire Spring
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Undergrowth springs up where your movement abilities end. Burning it creates a fire that spreads through connected brush.
When undergrowth you grew burns away, fresh growth sprouts in its place after a short time, healing allies who stand within it.
This is a nature, fire and healing effect.
brush.tag: This is a nature, fire and healing effect.

cage.name: Burnt Bars
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Movement abilities you use while rooted, caged, grappled or held break the restraint, and the restraint's source takes fire damage.

Once per day, you can circle a point with a movement ability to leave a ring of fiery bars. Enemies inside cannot leave without taking heavy fire damage, and allies inside are healed over time. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, escape and confinement effect.
cage.tag: This is a fire, escape and confinement effect.

cat.name: Cat's Landing
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You take no falling damage and always land facing the direction you choose.
You can leap from a height onto an enemy, landing on it with a pounce that inflicts heavy damage and a brief stun.
Each attack you avoid with a movement ability grants a stack of poise. At nine stacks, your next movement ability costs nothing and leaves a trail of fire.
This is a movement and fire effect.
cat.tag: This is a movement and fire effect.

cataclysm.name: Fallstar
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Once per day, you can leap high and crash down as a burning meteor onto a point you can see. The impact inflicts heavy fire and force damage, leaves a crater of burning ground and destroys terrain.
You and allies within the outer edge of the blast are healed and cleansed of magic and poison afflictions. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, movement and destruction effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a fire, movement and destruction effect.

cattle.name: Plough Line
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Movement abilities that cover ground cut a furrow behind you. Allies who walk in the furrow move faster and recover stamina.
Your movement abilities cannot be interrupted, and enemies of lower rank in your path are shouldered aside.
This is a movement and support effect.
cattle.tag: This is a movement and support effect.

chain.name: Tethered Return
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, a burning chain links your starting point to where you arrive. For a short time, you can pull yourself back along the chain to the starting point at no cost.
Enemies that cross the chain while it exists are bound briefly and take fire damage.
This is a movement, binding and fire effect.
chain.tag: This is a movement, binding and fire effect.

chaotic.name: Wildfire Flight
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Each time you use a movement ability, a random additional effect fires at your arrival point: a burst of fire damage, a healing pulse, a cleanse, a brief speed boon for allies, or a short teleport to a random nearby point.
You cannot choose the effect, and the same effect cannot fire twice in a row.
This is a movement and chaos effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a movement and chaos effect.

charlatan.name: False Ashes
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to collapse into a pile of ash as though slain. Enemies stop targeting you and lose track of you for a short time.
While in this state you can move unseen at reduced speed. When you rise, flame bursts outward, inflicting fire damage on nearby enemies and healing you for a portion of your maximum health.
This is an illusion, fire and healing effect.
charlatan.tag: This is an illusion, fire and healing effect.

chicken.name: Brood Fire
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When an ally near you falls below a quarter of their health, you can spend mana to dash to their side, wrapping burning wings around them. While wrapped, they take reduced damage and heal over time, and enemies that strike them are burned.
You cannot attack while wrapping an ally. The wrap ends when either of you moves.
This is a protection, fire and healing effect.
chicken.tag: This is a protection, fire and healing effect.

chimera.name: Many-Winged
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You carry three sets of grafted wings, of flame, feather and leather. Each has its own cooldown: flame wings let you leap forward through enemies, burning them; feather wings carry you in a long bound; leather wings let you dart aside in a blink.
Using all three in quick succession grants a short boon of increased speed and damage.
This is a flight and movement effect.
chimera.tag: This is a flight and movement effect.

claw.name: Talon Dive
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Movement abilities that end on an enemy rake it with burning talons. The attack applies a bleeding affliction and a burn affliction together.
If the raked enemy dies while carrying both, the cooldown of the movement ability you used is reset.
This is a movement, bleed and fire effect.
claw.tag: This is a movement, bleed and fire effect.

cloth.name: Woven Wings
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your cloak, mantle or robes catch the wind as you move, carrying your dashes further and steadying every landing.

You can spend mana to set your cloak alight and cast it over an ally. The cloak shields them from the next significant hit and burns away, healing them and cleansing one affliction. A new cloak forms over time.
This is a flight, fire and protection effect.
cloth.tag: This is a flight, fire and protection effect.

cloud.name: Cloud Step
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
After any movement ability, each step you take for a short time leaves a puff of cloud that lingers at your feet.
Allies standing in your clouds are veiled, and enemies inside a cloud cannot see out of it.
This is a flight and air effect.
cloud.tag: This is a flight and air effect.

cold.name: Embers in the Frost
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You are immune to the slowing and freezing effects of cold. Moving through ice or snow does not hinder you, and frozen water is solid ground beneath you.
When you would be frozen solid, you instead shatter free, dealing cold damage to nearby enemies and gaining a short burst of speed. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a cold and movement effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and movement effect.

coral.name: Reef Spawning
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You move through shallow water as fast as on land, and standing in water steadies your footing and your breath.
Your movement abilities can end in a spray of coral that grows into a brief reef at your landing point. Allies standing in the reef take less damage; enemies that cross it are cut and bleed.
This is a water, movement and bleed effect.
coral.tag: This is a water, movement and bleed effect.

corrupt.name: Sweet Pyre
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, you can detonate in rotting flame. Enemies nearby take fire damage and gain a corruption affliction that turns any healing they receive into damage for a short time. You and your allies are cleansed of corruption, disease and poison.
After the detonation, your movement abilities leave corrupting embers that apply the same affliction for the rest of the fight. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a corruption, fire and cleanse effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption, fire and cleanse effect.

crocodile.name: Death Roll Lunge
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While standing in water or standing still, you charge a lunge. The longer you wait, up to a short limit, the further your next movement ability carries you and the harder it hits on arrival.
A charged lunge that ends on an enemy seizes it and drags it with you for a short distance before releasing it.
This is a movement and seizing effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a movement and seizing effect.

crystal.name: Glassfire Glide
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities leave a line of crystal behind you. You can spend mana to blink to any point along your most recent line.
When the line expires it shatters, dealing fire damage to enemies standing along it.
This is a crystal, teleport and fire effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal, teleport and fire effect.

cycle.name: Second Spring
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each movement ability you use advances a cycle of four seasons. Spring heals you; summer adds fire damage to your next attack; autumn cleanses an affliction; winter grants a shield.
Once per day, when you would be killed, the cycle completes: you fall, and rise again at the start of spring with a portion of your health. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a rebirth, healing and fire effect.
cycle.tag: This is a rebirth, healing and fire effect.

dance.name: Unbroken Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Chaining movement abilities within a short window of each other builds rhythm. Each point of rhythm increases your damage and evasion; standing still or being stunned ends it.
At full rhythm, your next movement ability ends in a spinning flare that heals nearby allies and burns nearby enemies, and resets your rhythm.
This is a movement and fire effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and fire effect.

dark.name: Shadow Rebirth
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, when you would die, your body collapses into shadow and is gone. You can move freely as an untargetable shadow for a short time, then reform anywhere you have reached, at a portion of your health. Enemies lose track of you while you are a shadow.
Your black flames deal damage that ignores fire resistance. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a darkness, movement and rebirth effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness, movement and rebirth effect.

dawn.name: Sunrise Wings
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities trail first light. Concealed, invisible and shadow-hidden enemies along your path are revealed for a short time.

Once per day, you can detonate into a burst of dawn that inflicts holy and fire damage on nearby enemies, ends darkness effects in the area, and heals you and allies. Revealed enemies take increased damage from the burst. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a light, fire and healing effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light, fire and healing effect.

death.name: The Pyre Remembered
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend a large amount of mana at a fallen ally's body to burn it on a pyre. Once the pyre burns out, the ally rises at a portion of their health, cleansed of every affliction.
Each ally can be raised this way once per day. Allies of higher rank than you cost more mana to raise.
This is a death, fire and resurrection effect.
death.tag: This is a death, fire and resurrection effect.

deep.name: Pressure Breach
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You move through deep water and mud as freely as on dry ground, and the weight of water does not slow you.
When you leave water with a movement ability, you erupt in a boiling burst that deals fire and water damage to nearby enemies and knocks them back. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a water, fire and movement effect.
deep.tag: This is a water, fire and movement effect.

deer.name: Startled Bound
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you take damage from an enemy you could not see, you instantly bound away from it for free. This can happen once every short interval.
Your bounds leave trails of light that allies can follow at increased speed for a short time.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Scorched Passage
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
The ground along your movement paths is burned bare for a short time. Enemies on it cannot be healed or regenerate, and summoned creatures standing on it take fire damage over time.
You recover stamina while standing on bare ground of your own making.
This is a fire and terrain effect.
desolate.tag: This is a fire and terrain effect.

dimension.name: Folded Path
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can pass through walls and solid obstacles up to a short thickness, so long as the destination is open ground you have seen.
You can leave a fold at any point you move from. Once per fight, you can step back through the fold to that point.
This is a movement and space effect.
dimension.tag: This is a movement and space effect.

discord.name: Grinding Wake
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
