Enemies you pass close to with a movement ability are disoriented for a short time. A disoriented enemy's attacks have a chance to strike a random target near it, including its allies.
An enemy disoriented twice in a short time loses its current target and must find you again.
This is a movement and confusion effect.
discord.tag: This is a movement and confusion effect.

discordant.name: Clashing Flight
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Enemies you pass through or close beside with a movement ability are struck with discord for a brief time. A discordant enemy cannot benefit from its allies' boons or auras.
Passing between two enemies with a single movement ability makes them briefly attack each other.
This is a movement and discord effect.
discordant.tag: This is a movement and discord effect.

dog.name: Called to Heel
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, your summons and companions within a short range move with you, arriving around you at your destination.
You can send a summon or companion ahead along a path. When it arrives, you can spend mana to swap places with it, leaving a flare of fire at both ends.
This is a movement, summoning and teleport effect.
dog.tag: This is a movement, summoning and teleport effect.

doom.name: Appointed Ashes
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can name a place as your pyre. Once per day, when you would be killed, you burn away and are reborn at the named place with a portion of your health and every affliction cleansed. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
Enemies within range of where you fell are marked; for a short time after your rebirth, your fire damage against marked enemies is significantly increased.
Renaming the pyre requires standing at the new place out of combat.
This is a rebirth, teleport and fire effect.
doom.tag: This is a rebirth, teleport and fire effect.

doppelganger.name: Ashen Double
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When you use a movement ability, you can spend mana to leave behind a double of burning ash that copies your next attack. The double does not inflict damage, but you can switch places with it at any time before it crumbles.
Switching places with the double heals you for a small amount and leaves the double's position burning.
This is an illusion, teleport and fire effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is an illusion, teleport and fire effect.

dragon.name: Dragonflight
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can conjure scaled wings of dragonfire that carry you in long, beating leaps. While they are active, you take reduced physical damage and your fire damage ignores a portion of fire resistance. The wings consume mana.
You can spend a large amount of mana while the wings are active to breathe a cone of fire along your path.
When the wings are dismissed, the heat sinks inward and heals you over a short time.
This is a flight, fire and healing effect.
dragon.tag: This is a flight, fire and healing effect.

duck.name: Water Off Wings
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Afflictions slide off you while you are moving: each movement ability you use removes your oldest affliction.
You move across shallow water at normal speed. A movement ability you start while standing in water costs no mana or stamina.
This is a movement and cleanse effect.
duck.tag: This is a movement and cleanse effect.

dust.name: Ashfall Veil
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities raise a cloud of grey ash and dust where you start and where you land. Enemies in the clouds cannot see you, and ranged attacks through them miss more often.
You can spend mana to ignite all of your clouds at once, burning enemies inside them.
This is a concealment and fire effect.
dust.tag: This is a concealment and fire effect.

earth.name: Magma Leap
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you land from a leap, jump or movement ability, the ground cracks and molten stone wells up in a ring around you. The ring deals fire damage over time and blocks enemy movement through it.
Standing inside your own ring grants you damage reduction.
This is an earth, fire and movement effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth, fire and movement effect.

echo.name: Second Flight
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

A short time after you use a movement ability, a burning echo of you repeats it along the same path. The echo deals fire damage to enemies it passes through and draws the attention of enemies that cannot see you.
If you are struck while your echo exists, you can switch places with it once.
This is an echo, fire and movement effect.
echo.tag: This is an echo, fire and movement effect.

eclipse.name: Corona Dive
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While a movement ability is active, you are wreathed in a dark corona. Light-based and ranged attacks aimed at you strike the corona instead and are absorbed.
When the movement ends, the corona flares, inflicting fire damage on nearby enemies scaled to the damage it absorbed and briefly blinding them.
This is a darkness, fire and movement effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a darkness, fire and movement effect.

edifice.name: Pyre Foundation
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to raise a stone brazier where you stand. Using a movement ability that ends beside your brazier refreshes that ability's cooldown and heals you.
From anywhere within a long distance, you can end a movement ability on top of your brazier, landing in a burst of fire that damages enemies around it.
Only one brazier can exist at a time.
This is a construction, teleport and fire effect.
edifice.tag: This is a construction, teleport and fire effect.

effigy.name: Burning Likeness
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to set a straw effigy of yourself at a place you stand. While it exists, the first lethal blow you would take is redirected to the effigy, which burns away instead.
When the effigy burns, you are carried to its position in a column of flame, healed for a portion of your maximum health and cleansed of poison and magic afflictions.
Only one effigy can exist at a time, and it cannot be set again for 24 hours after it burns.
This is a sacrifice, teleport and healing effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sacrifice, teleport and healing effect.

elemental.name: Shifting Wings
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your wings and trails take the element of the terrain you start a movement ability on: fire on dry ground, water near water, air at height, stone underground.
Each element adds its own effect to your landing: fire burns, water slows, air knocks back, and stone grants you a brief shield.
This is an elemental and movement effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and movement effect.

elixir.name: Phoenix Tears
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, you can weep a phoenix tear into an empty vial. Drinking the tear fully heals the drinker and cleanses every affliction. A creature that has died within the last few moments can be revived by it.
Healing potions you drink also grant you a brief burst of movement speed. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is an alchemy, healing and rebirth effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy, healing and rebirth effect.

empower.name: Lending Flame
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When you use a movement ability that ends beside an ally, you can spend mana to lend them the ability. Their next movement ability carries them along the same kind of path and leaves the same fire behind.
An ally you lend to gains a brief boon of increased speed and fire damage.
Each ally can borrow from you once every short interval.
This is a boon, movement and fire effect.
empower.tag: This is a boon, movement and fire effect.

eye.name: Watchfire
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can place one burning eye at any point you have moved through. It reveals the area around it, including stealthed enemies, and is shown on your map.
You can spend mana to travel instantly to your burning eye. Doing so consumes it.
This is a perception and teleport effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and teleport effect.

feast.name: Feast of Embers
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Food you eat burns hot in you. For a long time after a meal, your movement abilities cost less and your health regenerates.

Once per day you can share a feast with allies. For a long time afterwards, each ally who ate leaves a trail of fire when using movement abilities and recovers stamina while moving. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a feast, support and movement effect.
feast.tag: This is a feast, support and movement effect.

feeble.name: Stolen Flight
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Enemies you pass through with a movement ability lose a portion of their movement speed for a short time, and you gain what they lose.
A flying enemy you pass through is grounded briefly.
This is a weakening and movement effect.
feeble.tag: This is a weakening and movement effect.

fertile.name: Ashfield Bloom
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Fire you leave behind with movement abilities does not scorch the ground. When the flames burn out, the ground blooms with ember-flowers for a short time.
An ally who steps on an ember-flower is healed and gains a brief boon of increased stamina recovery. Each flower is consumed when touched.
This is a fire, growth and healing effect.
fertile.tag: This is a fire, growth and healing effect.

fey.name: Faerie Ring of Ash
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can spend mana to burn a ring into the ground. While a ring exists, any movement ability you use can end inside it instead of at its normal destination, regardless of distance, provided the ring is in the same region.
An enemy that steps into the ring is bound by a strange bargain: it cannot attack you while you stand inside the ring with it, but neither can you attack it.
Only one ring can exist at a time.
This is a fey, teleport and fire effect.
fey.tag: This is a fey, teleport and fire effect.

fire.name: Nirvanic Flare
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities leave a trail of fire that burns enemies. Fire damage you deal heals you for a small portion of the damage.

Once per day, when you would die, you burst into flame. Enemies around you take heavy fire damage, you and nearby allies are healed and cleansed of magic and poison, and you rise from the ashes at a portion of your health. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, healing and rebirth effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire, healing and rebirth effect.

firebird.name: Twice-Burned Plume
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you use a movement ability, the place you leave keeps burning in your shape. A short time later, it releases a second, smaller burst of fire there.
If you return to a burning place before it bursts, the burst heals you instead and the movement ability's cooldown is reduced.
This is a fire and movement effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and movement effect.

fish.name: Silver Scatter
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When you use a movement ability, you can scatter into a shoal of silver flashes that dart along separate paths before rejoining at your destination. Attacks that hit a flash deal only a fraction of their damage to you.
In water, the shoal moves faster and can split around enemies to pass them.
This is a water, movement and evasion effect.
fish.tag: This is a water, movement and evasion effect.

flea.name: Flea Bound
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your jumps reach heights and distances far beyond your size, clearing walls and the heads of crowds.
You can leap onto a large enemy and cling to it. While clinging, you move with it, it cannot target you with melee attacks, and your attacks against it deal increased damage. Jumping off is free.
This is a movement and leaping effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and leaping effect.

flesh.name: Regrown Flesh
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Wound afflictions on you, including bleeds, broken limbs and severe wounding effects, burn closed when you use a movement ability, removing them.
Once per day, after a catastrophic wound, your body burns away the damage and regrows, healing you fully over a short time while you can still move. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, healing and regeneration effect.
flesh.tag: This is a fire, healing and regeneration effect.

foot.name: Pilgrim's Fire
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Walking long distances outside combat builds a reserve of momentum. Your first movement ability in a fight spends the reserve, travelling further and dealing fire damage in proportion to how far you walked.
Allies travelling with you tire more slowly and regain stamina faster out of combat.
This is a movement and endurance effect.
foot.tag: This is a movement and endurance effect.

force.name: Rising Impact
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Force confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities carry force. The first enemy you collide with during one takes force damage scaled to the distance you travelled before impact, and is knocked back.
Knocking an enemy into a wall or another enemy stuns both.
This is a force and movement effect.
force.tag: This is a force and movement effect.

forge.name: Quenched Stride
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you are struck by a heavy blow while a movement ability is active, you are tempered: you gain a stacking boon of damage reduction that lasts until you rest.
You can spend all of your stacks to dash in a straight line as a white-hot ingot, passing through enemies and dealing fire damage that scales with the stacks spent.
This is a fire, defence and movement effect.
forge.tag: This is a fire, defence and movement effect.

fork.name: Crossroads Flame
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you start a movement ability, you can choose two destinations. A burning double of you travels to the second and remains for a short time.
At any point while the double remains, you can trade places with it. Enemies attacking the double are burned when it fades.
This is an illusion, teleport and fire effect.
fork.tag: This is an illusion, teleport and fire effect.

fortress.name: Burning Keep
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When you stand still for a moment, phoenix fire rises around you as a ring of walls. Ranged attacks from outside the walls cannot reach you or allies inside, and enemies who step through take fire damage.
The walls collapse as soon as you use a movement ability, bursting outward and healing allies they touched.
This is a fire, barrier and healing effect.
fortress.tag: This is a fire, barrier and healing effect.

fox.name: Will-o'-Wisp
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, a small foxfire wisp runs off in another direction. Enemies that lose sight of you chase the wisp instead.
Enemies that catch the wisp are burned and confused for a short time.
This is an illusion and fire effect.
fox.tag: This is an illusion and fire effect.

frog.name: Springing Ember
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Crouching for a moment before a movement ability turns it into a spring that clears gaps, water and enemies in a single high arc.
Your tongue of flame can lash out mid-spring to grab a light item, a small enemy or an ally's hand and pull it to where you land.
This is a movement and seizing effect.
frog.tag: This is a movement and seizing effect.

fungus.name: Spore Cradle
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities shed spores. Where you stop, a cluster of glowing mushrooms grows for a long time.

Once per day, when you would die, your body crumbles into spores and you regrow from the mushroom cluster you planted most recently, at a portion of your health. Destroying the cluster first denies the regrowth. This recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fungal, movement and rebirth effect.
fungus.tag: This is a fungal, movement and rebirth effect.

garuda.name: Gold Pinion
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can conjure wings of golden fire that carry you in swift bounding leaps. While they are active, you are immune to poison and venom afflictions, and serpentine enemies take increased fire damage from you. The wings consume mana.
Detonating the wings releases a golden flash that cleanses every poison affliction from you and nearby allies and heals them significantly. Enemies caught in it are knocked to the ground.
After detonation, the wings cannot be conjured again until their strength recovers over 24 hours.
This is a flight, healing and cleanse effect.
garuda.tag: This is a flight, healing and cleanse effect.

gate.name: Ash Doorway
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
The start and end points of your movement abilities remain as a linked pair of burning doorways for a short time. You and your allies can step through either doorway to arrive at the other.
Enemies who step through a doorway are set burning and arrive slowed.
This is a teleport and fire effect.
gate.tag: This is a teleport and fire effect.

gathering.name: Flock to the Flame
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to light a beacon. For a short time, allies who use a movement ability are drawn to the beacon, arriving beside it.
When three or more allies are gathered at your beacon, it flares, healing everyone near it and cleansing one affliction from each.
This is a gathering, movement and healing effect.
gathering.tag: This is a gathering, movement and healing effect.

glass.name: Prism Flight
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While using a movement ability, you become transparent and cannot be targeted by spells.

Light and fire spells that strike you while you move are refracted through you, splitting into several weaker beams aimed at nearby enemies. If you are struck by enough damage during the movement, you shatter into shards and reform at its end with a portion of your health lost.
This is a glass, light and movement effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass, light and movement effect.

glimeron.name: Prismatic Wake
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities split your fire. While one is active, any fire damage you deal is divided into separate beams that strike the target and up to two other enemies nearby.
Beams that strike an ally instead heal them for a small amount.
This is a fire and light effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a fire and light effect.

goat.name: Cliffside Fire
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can climb steep slopes, cliff faces and ledges at full speed. Terrain that would block movement for others counts as walkable for you if it has any footing at all.
Leaping down from a height onto an enemy butts it with a burning charge that knocks it back and dazes it.
This is a movement and terrain effect.
goat.tag: This is a movement and terrain effect.

gorgon.name: Petrifying Ash
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Enemies who look at you as you arrive from a movement ability are briefly slowed by a crust of hardening ash.
An enemy slowed this way three times within a short time is turned to ash-stone for a moment. Striking it with fire shatters the stone, inflicting heavy damage.
Enemies of higher rank resist being turned to stone.
This is a petrification and fire effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and fire effect.

griffin.name: Diving Talon
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can mark an enemy you can see from higher ground or while dashing. Your next movement ability carries you directly to the marked enemy in a burning pounce, inflicting fire damage and pinning it to the ground briefly.
The pounce costs no mana if you began it from higher ground.
This is a flight, movement and fire effect.
griffin.tag: This is a flight, movement and fire effect.

growth.name: Rising Sapling
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities grow vines behind you that slow enemies and can be burned to deal fire damage.
You move faster along vine trails you created, and leaping from the end of one carries you a long distance. Each movement ability you use on a trail thickens it and strengthens its slow.
This is a growth and movement effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and movement effect.

guardian.name: Shielding Wings
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can spend mana to blink to an ally within range, regardless of your movement abilities' cooldowns. On arrival you wrap them in burning wings, and the next attack against them strikes you instead, with reduced damage.
An ally you arrive beside this way is healed for a small portion of their maximum health.
This is a teleport, protection and healing effect.
guardian.tag: This is a teleport, protection and healing effect.

hair.name: Burning Tresses
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your hair burns like a mane of fire. You can extend it to wrap around a point within range and haul yourself to it.
Enemies caught by your hair while you travel are pulled along behind you and burned.
This is a movement, binding and fire effect.
hair.tag: This is a movement, binding and fire effect.

hammer.name: Meteor Fall
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to leap high and far and crash down at a chosen point like a burning meteor. The impact deals fire and physical damage in an area and knocks enemies down.
The higher your starting point, the larger the impact. This has a long cooldown.
This is a movement, fire and impact effect.
hammer.tag: This is a movement, fire and impact effect.

hand.name: Lifted Hands
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can conjure a burning hand that catches an ally and carries them a short distance to wherever you point, out of danger or into position.
An ally carried this way is healed a little and cannot be attacked during the carry.
This is a conjuration, movement and support effect.
hand.tag: This is a conjuration, movement and support effect.

harmonic.name: Singing Flight
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities ring with a clear note. Allies who use a movement ability within a short window of yours share its harmony, gaining a brief shield.
When you and an ally move in harmony several times in one fight, the note peaks and heals every ally who heard it.
This is a resonance, movement and healing effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance, movement and healing effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Updraft
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability that passes close by an enemy, you can snatch one item, buff or loose object from it in passing: a held throwable, a boon, or a projectile in flight.
Snatched boons apply to you for their remaining duration. A screech of hot wind follows you, briefly interrupting spellcasting by enemies you passed.
This is a theft, movement and interruption effect.
harpy.tag: This is a theft, movement and interruption effect.

harvest.name: Gleaning Flight
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities gather what lies along their paths: loot, crafting materials from nodes you pass, and dropped items are pulled into your inventory.
Each enemy you kill within a short time after using a movement ability reduces that ability's cooldown.
This is a movement and gathering effect.
harvest.tag: This is a movement and gathering effect.

heidel.name: Long Road
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Mounts you ride and companions travelling beside you share your movement abilities and never tire.
You can summon a burning mount for a long journey. If the mount falls, it bursts into fire and returns after a short time.
This is a mount, movement and rebirth effect.
heidel.tag: This is a mount, movement and rebirth effect.

hook.name: Grapnel Flare
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can hurl a burning hook at a surface or enemy and pull yourself to it. A hook that strikes a lighter enemy pulls it to you instead.
An enemy struck by the hook burns while the hook remains in it, and you can pull yourself to it again at no cost.
This is a movement, seizing and fire effect.
hook.tag: This is a movement, seizing and fire effect.

horse.name: Firestorm Gallop
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Moving in a straight line for a short time builds speed until you break into a burning gallop. While galloping, you trample lower-rank enemies in your path and leave fire behind you.
Mounts you ride move faster, are immune to fear, and heal over time.
This is a mount, movement and fire effect.
horse.tag: This is a mount, movement and fire effect.

hunger.name: Hungry Flame
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities consume burning ground, fire conjurations and fire-based afflictions you pass through, removing them and restoring your mana.
Enemies' fire attacks and spells feed you while you are moving, healing you instead of damaging you.
This is a consumption, fire and movement effect.
hunger.tag: This is a consumption, fire and movement effect.

hunt.name: Firebird's Pursuit
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can mark an enemy as your quarry. While it lives, your movement abilities toward it cost less and travel further, and it cannot escape your sight.
When your quarry tries to flee or teleport, you follow it automatically, arriving beside it in a burst of flame. This can happen once per quarry.
This is a hunt, movement and tracking effect.
hunt.tag: This is a hunt, movement and tracking effect.

hydra.name: Three Heads of Flame
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When one of your movement abilities is interrupted, stopped or put on a cooldown by an enemy effect, a second charge of that ability grows back immediately.
An ability can grow back up to two times before it rests for 24 hours. Each regrown charge leaves fire damage behind it in a wider path.
This is a regeneration, movement and fire effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regeneration, movement and fire effect.

ice.name: Steam Rise
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can glide on ice and frozen ground at greatly increased speed.

Your fire and ice effects react where they meet: fire landing on your ice explodes into scalding steam that damages and blinds enemies inside it. Allies inside your steam are cleansed of burning and freezing.
This is a fire, cold and movement effect.
ice.tag: This is a fire, cold and movement effect.

immortal.name: Unspent Ashes
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Once per day, when you would be killed, you burn to ash and are reborn on the spot with full health, cleansed of every affliction. Enemies nearby take fire damage and are knocked back.
After a rebirth, you carry a mark of ash until the effect recovers over 24 hours. While marked, your maximum health is reduced by a portion, and the effect cannot trigger again.
This is a rebirth, fire and healing effect.
immortal.tag: This is a rebirth, fire and healing effect.

iron.name: Ironshod Descent
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities end in a heavy iron landing that breaks enemy shields and barriers in a small area.
Landing on a forge or a crafting node heats your weapon, adding fire damage to your next few attacks.
Your iron-shod landings ring loudly, pulling the attention of lower-rank enemies to you and briefly reducing their damage.
This is a forge, movement and taunt effect.
iron.tag: This is a forge, movement and taunt effect.

juggernaut.name: Unbroken Charge
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Using a movement ability that carries you through enemies extends it: each enemy struck lengthens the path a little further, up to a limit.
For the duration of an extended movement, you cannot be stunned, knocked down or rooted, and the trail behind you burns.
This is a momentum, movement and fire effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum, movement and fire effect.

karmic.name: Debt of Fire
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Damage you take while a movement ability is active is recorded against the enemy who dealt it.
The next time you use a movement ability that ends next to that enemy, the recorded damage is repaid to it as fire damage and the record is cleared. Half of the repaid amount heals you.
This is a karmic, fire and healing effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic, fire and healing effect.

knife.name: Flicker Cut
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your shortest movement abilities cost no resource and have their cooldown shortened.
When you pass behind an enemy with a movement ability, your next attack against it deals bonus fire damage and applies a burn that cannot be cleansed for a short time.
This is a movement and fire effect.
knife.tag: This is a movement and fire effect.

knowledge.name: Charted Flight
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each place you end a movement ability is remembered for a short time. You can spend mana to blink to any remembered place you can see.
Enemies that have badly wounded you are marked on your map. Your movement abilities cost less while you move toward a marked enemy.
This is a knowledge and teleport effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and teleport effect.

kraken.name: Burning Reach
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to lash a tentacle of flame at a point or creature you can see. If it strikes terrain, you are pulled to it; if it strikes an enemy, the enemy is dragged to you and set burning.
Allies struck by the tentacle are pulled to you and healed.
This is a pull, movement and fire effect.
kraken.tag: This is a pull, movement and fire effect.

leviathan.name: Steaming Wake
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You wade through water as easily as open ground, and your movement abilities travel further across water.

A movement ability that ends in water raises a scalding wave that knocks back nearby enemies and inflicts fire damage. The steam it leaves behind hides you and allies from ranged attacks for a short time.
This is a water, fire and movement effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water, fire and movement effect.

life.name: Stubborn Spark
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities heal allies you pass through.
You can blink to an ally below half health within sight. On arrival, both of you settle to the average of your two health totals. This can be used once every short interval.
This is a life, healing and teleport effect.
life.tag: This is a life, healing and teleport effect.

light.name: Dawn Wings
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can travel as a beam of light to any point in your line of sight, passing through enemies and blinding them.
Undead and shadow creatures you pass through take holy fire damage. Allies you pass through are cleansed of one magical affliction.
This is a light, teleport and cleanse effect.
light.tag: This is a light, teleport and cleanse effect.

lightning.name: Thunder Wing
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can move as a bolt of lightning, jumping between enemies within short range up to several times. Each jump deals lightning damage and briefly stuns the enemy struck.
After the final jump you reappear beside the last enemy. Each jump costs mana.
This is a lightning and movement effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and movement effect.

lizard.name: Basking Rebirth
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Standing in sunlight or on fire you created restores your health and mana over time.

When you lose a large portion of your health in a single blow, you shed a burning husk and dart away a short distance. The husk takes the next attack aimed at you. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a regeneration and evasion effect.
lizard.tag: This is a regeneration and evasion effect.

locust.name: Burning Plague
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can spend mana to rush as a cloud of burning locusts, sweeping across the ground and through enemies. The cloud strips crops, nodes and loose loot from the ground you pass, sending the loot to your inventory.
Enemies in the cloud take fire damage over time and have their buffs devoured one at a time.
This is a swarm, movement and fire effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm, movement and fire effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom Rising
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you use a movement ability, one affliction on you is burned away and cannot be reapplied by the same source for a short time.

Once per day, you can rise through a blooming flame that cleanses every affliction on you and allies nearby, and makes them immune to new afflictions for a short time. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a cleanse and fire effect.
lotus.tag: This is a cleanse and fire effect.

lurker.name: Rising From Below
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can sink into the ground or the shadows and travel beneath them unseen for a short time.
Rising from below under an enemy erupts in flame, damaging and lifting it off its feet. Your first attack against an enemy that has not yet seen you deals increased damage.
This is a stealth, movement and fire effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth, movement and fire effect.

magic.name: Arcane Vector
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Using a movement ability leaves a mote of raw arcana at your starting point. The next spell you cast within a short time fires from the mote as well as from you, striking the same target.
Only one mote can exist at a time.
This is a movement and magic effect.
magic.tag: This is a movement and magic effect.

malign.name: Spiteful Ash
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When an enemy forces you to move with a knockback, pull or fear, you leave a smouldering ember where you were. When that enemy next moves within reach of the ember, it erupts, inflicting fire damage and a lingering burn affliction.
Each enemy can trigger only one ember at a time.
This is a fire and retaliation effect.
malign.tag: This is a fire and retaliation effect.

manatee.name: Drifting Grace
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While you are in water or slowed by any effect, your movement abilities cost no stamina, and each one mends you over time.
Allies you pass during a movement ability share the mending at reduced strength.
This is a movement and healing effect.
manatee.tag: This is a movement and healing effect.

manticore.name: Quill Leap
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities fling burning quills behind you. Each quill that strikes an enemy inflicts a stacking burning venom affliction that combines fire and poison damage.
An enemy carrying enough stacks of burning venom is slowed whenever it tries to follow you.
This is a fire, poison and movement effect.
manticore.tag: This is a fire, poison and movement effect.

master.name: Perfect Glide
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Using the same movement ability repeatedly builds mastery for the rest of the day. Each stack reduces its cost and leaves a cleaner, hotter trail of fire behind it.
At full mastery, the ability's cooldown resets whenever you use it to avoid an attack that would otherwise have struck you.
Mastery fades when you rest.
This is a movement and fire effect.
master.tag: This is a movement and fire effect.

might.name: Crashing Ascent
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can carry you through enemies of lower rank rather than around them, knocking them aside and inflicting disruptive-force damage.
You can leap high and come down at a chosen point, launching nearby enemies and inflicting fire and disruptive-force damage that scales with how far you leapt. This has a long cooldown.
This is a force, fire and movement effect.
might.tag: This is a force, fire and movement effect.

ministration.name: Warm Hands
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can carry you to a wounded ally you can see, regardless of their normal range. You arrive in a soft burst of flame that heals the ally over time and cleanses one affliction.
An ally can only be reached this way once every short interval, and healing them this way also eases bleeding and wounding effects.
This is a movement and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a movement and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Burning Labyrinth
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

The fire your movement abilities leave behind lingers as walls rather than ground. Over a fight, these walls form a maze that only you can pass through freely; enemies must go around or take fire damage passing through.
You deal increased damage with your next attack after charging an enemy along a path between your walls.
This is a fire, terrain and movement effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a fire, terrain and movement effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Step
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
For a short time after you use a movement ability, the air around you shimmers with heat. Enemies attacking you strike a point slightly off from where you really are, and ranged attacks often miss.
Enemies who miss you this way take a small amount of fire damage from the haze.
This is an illusion and fire effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and fire effect.

mirror.name: Answering Flight
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When an enemy uses a movement ability within your sight, you can spend mana to copy it once. The copy takes the enemy's path shape but begins from your position.
Copied movement retains its distance and any movement-based effects, but not its damage.
This is a mirroring and movement effect.
mirror.tag: This is a mirroring and movement effect.

monkey.name: Branch to Branch
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Trees, posts, banners, pillars and other tall objects become anchor points. You can swing between anchor points within a short distance without using a movement ability, at a small stamina cost.
While swinging you cannot be targeted by ground-bound melee attacks, and the first attack you make after landing gains increased damage.
This is a movement and acrobatic effect.
monkey.tag: This is a movement and acrobatic effect.

monolith.name: Standing Flame
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can raise a pillar of unburning flame at a point you can see. It cannot be destroyed and lasts a long time.

While a pillar stands, you can use any movement ability to arrive at it from anywhere in the region, at the cost of that ability's full cooldown. Allies standing beside the pillar recover health slowly.
Only one pillar can stand at a time.
This is a fire, teleport and healing effect.
monolith.tag: This is a fire, teleport and healing effect.

moon.name: Moonlit Passage
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
At night, movement abilities you use leave you and your allies briefly hidden from enemies more than a short distance away.
At night, you can step from one patch of moonlight to another within sight, crossing gaps and walls. Each step cleanses one affliction.
This is a light, stealth and teleport effect.
moon.tag: This is a light, stealth and teleport effect.

mouse.name: Underfoot
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can pass through gaps, grates, holes and spaces between enemies too small for your body, and do not provoke attacks from enemies you pass.
After you use a movement ability, enemies that lose sight of you forget your position until you attack.
This is a movement and evasion effect.
mouse.tag: This is a movement and evasion effect.

myriad.name: Thousand Departures
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you use a movement ability, a burning afterimage of you remains at the start of its path for a short time. Enemies treat afterimages as you for targeting.
When an afterimage is struck it bursts into flame, damaging enemies around it. Up to three afterimages can exist at once.
This is a fire, illusion and movement effect.
myriad.tag: This is a fire, illusion and movement effect.

mystic.name: Inner Flight
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You sense where an incoming attack is going to land a moment before it arrives, shown as a faint glow on the ground.
Using a movement ability to leave a glowing area before the attack lands refunds the ability's mana cost and restores a portion of your mana.
This is a precognition and movement effect.
mystic.tag: This is a precognition and movement effect.

nebula.name: Scattered Plumage
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to disperse into a drifting cloud of embers for a short time. In this form you move freely, cannot be targeted, and pass through enemies and obstacles.
Enemies inside the cloud take fire damage over time. Allies inside it are healed slowly.
When the effect ends, you reform anywhere within the cloud.
This is a transformation, fire and healing effect.
nebula.tag: This is a transformation, fire and healing effect.

needle.name: Pinpoint Landing
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When a movement ability ends adjacent to an enemy, your next attack against that enemy strikes a weak point, ignoring a portion of its armour and inflicting a bleed affliction.
Ending a movement ability exactly on a marked target point on the ground refunds its stamina cost.
This is a movement and precision effect.
needle.tag: This is a movement and precision effect.

nemesis.name: Hunting Flame
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can name one enemy as your quarry. Your movement abilities move further and faster when heading toward your quarry, and ignore terrain that would block them.
If your quarry flees beyond sight, a trail of embers on the map leads you to it. Only one quarry can be named at a time, and naming a new one requires the previous to die or a day to pass.
This is a tracking, movement and fire effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a tracking, movement and fire effect.

net.name: Firenet Glide
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to stretch a burning net between the start and end of a movement ability. Enemies crossing the net are entangled and burned.
Allies who fall onto the net, from knockbacks or heights, are caught and healed instead of taking damage.
This is a fire, conjuration and restraint effect.
net.tag: This is a fire, conjuration and restraint effect.

network.name: Kindled Network
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Allies in your party are linked by threads of flame. You can use a movement ability to travel along a thread to any linked ally you can see, regardless of distance.
When you arrive, both you and the ally are healed, and any ally whose thread you passed along gains a brief speed boon.
This is a teleport, healing and network effect.
network.tag: This is a teleport, healing and network effect.

oasis.name: Shaded Spring
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability out of combat, you leave a small spring of warm water where you landed. It lasts until you rest.

Resting at a spring you left fully restores you and your allies and cleanses every affliction, as though you had rested at a settlement. Only three springs can exist at a time, and using any movement ability to arrive at one costs no mana.
This is a water, healing and rest effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water, healing and rest effect.

ocean.name: Returning Tide of Fire
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each movement ability you use is followed, a short time later, by a burning tide that sweeps back along the same path in the opposite direction.
Enemies caught by the tide are pulled back toward where you started and set burning. Allies caught by it are carried with it and healed.
This is a fire, tide and movement effect.
ocean.tag: This is a fire, tide and movement effect.

octopus.name: Eight Directions
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While a movement ability is cooling down, you can still slip in any direction once by expending a portion of your mana, releasing a cloud of ink and ash that blinds enemies caught in it.
You can do this once per movement ability use.
This is a movement and obscuring effect.
octopus.tag: This is a movement and obscuring effect.

omen.name: Read the Flight
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

For a moment before an enemy attack lands, a burning sign marks the ground where it will strike. Using a movement ability to leave a marked area as the sign appears costs no stamina and resets the movement ability's cooldown.
This can reset the cooldown once in a short interval.
This is a precognition and movement effect.
omen.tag: This is a precognition and movement effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Wingbeat
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
After a movement ability that ends next to an enemy, your attacks against that enemy come faster for a short time, each one adding a stack of burning.
Using another movement ability to reach a different enemy before the time runs out carries the speed and all accumulated burn stacks to the new target.
This is a fire and momentum effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a fire and momentum effect.

pangolin.name: Rolling Plumage
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can curl into a ball of overlapping burning scales as a movement ability. While rolling you take significantly reduced damage, and enemies you roll into are knocked back and burned.
Rolling costs stamina over time and ends if you are stunned.
This is a movement, defence and fire effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a movement, defence and fire effect.

paper.name: Folded Wings
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can write a destination onto a sheet of paper. Burning the sheet carries you to that place in a flash of fire, provided it is within the current region and you have visited it.
Only one sheet can be written at a time. Burning it cannot be done in combat, and recovers over 24 hours.
This is a teleport and fire effect.
paper.tag: This is a teleport and fire effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Phantom Flock
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you use a movement ability, a flock of illusory firebirds bursts from your starting point and scatters across the area. Enemies cannot tell which bird or figure is you for a short time.
Enemies who attack an illusion are briefly confused. The illusions inflict no damage.
This is an illusion effect.

phoenix.name: Nest of Embers
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, when you would be killed, you collapse into an egg of fire that cannot be damaged. After a short time the egg hatches, returning you with full health and all cooldowns reset, while a burst of flame damages nearby enemies and heals nearby allies.
Allies who stand beside the egg until it hatches are cleansed of every affliction. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a rebirth, fire and healing effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a rebirth, fire and healing effect.

plant.name: Rooted Leap
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can plant a seed at your current position. Only one seed can be planted at a time, and planting takes a short time out of combat.
From anywhere in the same region, you can spend mana to be pulled back to the seed along a growing vine, arriving in a burst of leaves that heals allies nearby. The seed is consumed.
This is a life and teleport effect.
plant.tag: This is a life and teleport effect.

potent.name: Flashpoint
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can hold a movement ability to charge it, increasing its distance the longer you hold it. A fully charged movement ability ends in an explosion of fire that damages nearby enemies.
Charging costs mana over time, and you cannot move while charging.
This is a fire and movement effect.
potent.tag: This is a fire and movement effect.

predatory.name: Stalking Cinders
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While you are unseen and not in combat, your movement abilities have no cooldown.
The first movement ability you use to close on an enemy from concealment ends in a pounce of flame that pins the enemy for a moment and inflicts a burning wound that cannot be healed while it lasts.
This is a stealth, movement and fire effect.
predatory.tag: This is a stealth, movement and fire effect.

prison.name: Cage of Flight
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to trace a circle around an enemy with a movement ability. A cage of fire rises along the path, holding the enemy inside for a short time.
The caged enemy cannot use movement abilities, and takes fire damage if it touches the bars. Enemies of higher rank break free more quickly.
This is a fire and restraint effect.
prison.tag: This is a fire and restraint effect.

prosperity.name: Golden Ash
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Enemies killed by fire you leave behind with movement abilities drop additional loot and coin.
When you arrive at a merchant or settlement by any means, the burning gold in your trail leaves you and your party with a brief boon of increased healing received.
This is a fortune and fire effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a fortune and fire effect.

pure.name: Clean Flame
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each movement ability you use cleanses one affliction from you, starting with the most recently applied.
Allies you pass through during a movement ability are also cleansed of one affliction. An ally can be cleansed this way once in a short interval.
This is a cleanse and movement effect.
pure.tag: This is a cleanse and movement effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt Hole
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While you are below half health, your movement abilities travel significantly further and cost no stamina.
When you use a movement ability at low health, you leave behind a burrow mouth. Using a movement ability again within a short time returns you to the burrow mouth instead.
This is a movement and escape effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and escape effect.

rake.name: Gathered Embers
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities draw loose loot, dropped items and spent projectiles along your path to you.
Fire, burning ground and embers you cross are gathered too, and stored as embers. The next attack you make releases every stored ember as additional fire damage.
This is a gathering and fire effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and fire effect.

rat.name: Scatter and Return
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, a lethal blow instead bursts you into a swarm of burning rats that flee in every direction. After a short time the swarm regathers at the point furthest from your enemies and you reform with a portion of your health.
While scattered, you cannot be targeted and the rats burn any enemy they pass. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire, swarm and rebirth effect.
rat.tag: This is a fire, swarm and rebirth effect.

reagent.name: Ashen Reagent
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Potions you drink while using a movement ability also affect allies you pass, at reduced strength.

You can brew a phoenix draught from your own ash once per day. Drinking it heals you and cleanses magic and poison afflictions; an ally who drinks it instead receives the full effect. The draught spoils after a day.
This is an alchemy and healing effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and healing effect.

refracting.name: Bent Path
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can turn a corner once along their path, at an angle of your choosing.
Projectiles that strike you while a movement ability is active are bent away along your path instead and continue in the direction you were heading, striking enemies in front of you.
This is a deflection and movement effect.
refracting.tag: This is a deflection and movement effect.

renewal.name: Season's Turning
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you use a movement ability, you leave behind a patch of new growth that heals allies standing in it for a short time.

Once per day, a lethal blow instead withers you to ash and regrows you as new over a short time, at full health but without any boons. You cannot act while regrowing. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a life and rebirth effect.
renewal.tag: This is a life and rebirth effect.

resolute.name: Unmoved Ground
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can choose to refuse any knockback, pull or forced movement. Refusing it costs stamina, and the force is converted into a burst of flame around you instead.
Your own movement abilities cannot be interrupted by enemy attacks or stuns once begun.
This is a fire and steadfast effect.
resolute.tag: This is a fire and steadfast effect.

resonating.name: Humming Ascent
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Each movement ability you use within a short time of the last raises a building hum. At low intensity it grants allies nearby a speed boon; at high intensity it shakes enemies nearby, interrupting their casts.
At full intensity, your next movement ability releases the hum as a shockwave of fire and sound that damages enemies and heals allies, and the hum starts over.
This is a sound, movement and fire effect.
resonating.tag: This is a sound, movement and fire effect.

roc.name: Sky-Wide Shadow
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While dashing or mid-movement, you cast an enormous burning shadow ahead of you. Lower-rank enemies within the shadow are frightened and flee.
You can spend mana to sweep up one ally or lower-rank enemy and carry it with you through a movement ability. An enemy carried this way is flung down at the end of the path, taking heavy damage.
This is a flight, fear and movement effect.
roc.tag: This is a flight, fear and movement effect.

rune.name: Graven Waypoint
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can carve up to three burning runes onto the ground. A movement ability that ends on one of your runes can be continued instantly to any other rune you have carved within a short distance.
Runes fade if you leave the area. Carving a rune costs mana.
This is a rune and teleport effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and teleport effect.

sacrifice.name: Price of the Wing
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can pay for any movement ability with health instead of its normal cost, ignoring its cooldown.

Health spent this way is not lost; it is held in a burning reserve. When the reserve is full, or when you choose, it is released as a burst that heals you and allies nearby for the amount spent and burns nearby enemies.
This is a sacrifice, movement and healing effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a sacrifice, movement and healing effect.

sand.name: Dune Skimmer
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Sand, dust and loose earth do not slow you, and your movement abilities across them throw up a scouring cloud that blinds enemies behind you.
Sand you cross is fused into glass by your passage. Enemies stepping on the glass take fire damage and are slowed.
This is a movement, earth and fire effect.
sand.tag: This is a movement, earth and fire effect.

sceptre.name: Herald's Procession
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to command an ally to move to a point you choose. They travel there in a trail of flame as though using a movement ability of your own, and cannot be interrupted on the way.
An ally can be commanded once in a short interval.
This is a command and movement effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a command and movement effect.

scribe.name: Written Flight
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can record the path of a movement ability as a burning line of script on the ground. Recorded paths persist until you rest.
Any ally can step onto a recorded path to travel its full length instantly. You can hold up to three recorded paths at a time.
This is a writing, movement and fire effect.
scribe.tag: This is a writing, movement and fire effect.

serene.name: Still Water Glide
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can walk on water and glide over still liquids, including lava, without harm.
While you have not taken damage for a short time, your movement abilities cost no stamina and calm afflictions on you, pausing their ticks until you are struck again.
This is a movement and calm effect.
serene.tag: This is a movement and calm effect.

serpent.name: Shed Skin of Flame
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, you can shed your burning skin at your starting point. Every affliction on you stays with the shed skin instead.
The skin smoulders for a short time, inflicting the afflictions it holds on any enemy who touches it. This can happen once every short interval.
This is a cleanse, fire and movement effect.
serpent.tag: This is a cleanse, fire and movement effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Wounded enemies within aura-sense range leave a visible trail. Movement abilities you use toward an enemy below half health travel further and end beside it.
Your first attack after such a movement inflicts a bleed affliction that grows heavier while the enemy keeps moving.
This is a predatory and movement effect.
shark.tag: This is a predatory and movement effect.

shield.name: Burning Aegis
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can use a movement ability to leap to an ally, raising a shield of fire wings around them on arrival. The shield absorbs damage and burns melee attackers.
The shield lasts a short time or until broken. When it breaks, it heals the ally it protected.
This is a fire, shield and movement effect.
shield.tag: This is a fire, shield and movement effect.

shimmer.name: Heat Haze
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
For a short time after any movement ability, you appear to enemies to be standing a short distance from your true position, shimmering like heat over stone.
Attacks aimed at the false position miss. The effect ends early if you attack.
This is a light and illusion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and illusion effect.

ship.name: Tailwind Crossing
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can cross deep water at running speed, drawn along on burning sails. Allies following directly behind you can cross it with you.
At sea or on a lake, you can travel between visited shores along the region map, as long as you are out of combat.
This is a movement and travel effect.
ship.tag: This is a movement and travel effect.

shovel.name: Fire Beneath
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can use a movement ability to dive into the ground and resurface at its end point. While underground you cannot be targeted.
You erupt from the ground in a burst of flame and thrown earth, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies. Diving costs additional stamina.
This is an earth, fire and movement effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth, fire and movement effect.

sickle.name: Reaping Arc
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can follow a curved path of your choosing instead of a straight line. Enemies inside the curve take fire damage as you complete it.
Killing an enemy this way refunds the movement ability's cooldown.
This is a fire and movement effect.
sickle.tag: This is a fire and movement effect.

simulacrum.name: Ember Understudy
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you are stunned, rooted or knocked down, an ember likeness of you steps out of your body and keeps moving at your direction for a short time, able to use your movement abilities.
When the control effect ends, or when you choose, you take the likeness's place. The control effect stays behind in your old position and burns away.
This can happen once every short interval.
This is a conjuration, teleport and fire effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a conjuration, teleport and fire effect.

sin.name: Cherished Ember
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can keep one wound instead of healing it. A kept wound reduces your maximum health, but each movement ability you use while carrying it deals fire damage to every enemy you pass.

You can tear the kept wound open as you dash, spending a portion of your health to double the distance of the movement ability and set every enemy along the path burning. Tearing it open closes it, restoring your maximum health.
This is a fire and sacrifice effect.
sin.tag: This is a fire and sacrifice effect.

skirmish.name: Broken Contact
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability to leave melee range of an enemy, that enemy is marked with an ember for a short time.
Your ranged attacks and spells against an ember-marked enemy inflict additional fire damage, and each hit reduces the cooldown of the movement ability you used to break away.
An enemy that closes back to melee range with you loses the mark and is briefly slowed.
This is a movement, fire and skirmish effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a movement, fire and skirmish effect.

skunk.name: Parting Gift
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability to leave melee range, you leave a choking cloud behind you. Enemies inside it cannot follow you with a movement ability and are weakened.
The cloud lingers for a short time and can be ignited by any fire damage, exploding.
This is a poison and escape effect.
skunk.tag: This is a poison and escape effect.

sky.name: Open Heaven
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can carry you vertically: onto rooftops, cliff tops, ledges and walls you can see, ignoring terrain between.
While standing on high ground you reached this way, your fire damage reaches further and you cannot be reached by enemies without ranged attacks or flight.
This is an air and movement effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and movement effect.

sloth.name: Long Patience
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
