For every moment you remain still, your next movement ability gains distance and stores healing, up to a limit.
When you finally move, the stored healing is released to you and to allies near your destination.
This is a stillness and healing effect.
sloth.tag: This is a stillness and healing effect.

smoke.name: Smokewalk
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can travel through fire, smoke and burning ground as a movement ability, entering any one and exiting any other within a short distance.
Exiting smoke leaves you unseen until you attack or a short time passes.
This is a smoke and teleport effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and teleport effect.

snake.name: Shed Skin
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Your movement abilities can leave a burning shed skin at your starting point. Enemies that were targeting you attack the skin instead for a moment, and those that strike it take poison and fire damage.
Each skin carries away one affliction from you. Only one skin can exist at a time.
This is a poison, fire and decoy effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison, fire and decoy effect.

soaring.name: Endless Thermal
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Fire you leave behind with movement abilities sends up rising heat. Stepping into rising heat lightens your stride into a run that costs nothing and lasts as long as you remain on burning ground.
While running on the heat, you recover mana and stamina over time and can use movement abilities without cooldown, but cannot attack.
This is a flight and fire effect.
soaring.tag: This is a flight and fire effect.

song.name: Flight Song
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
While you sing, at a cost of mana over time, allies who can hear you gain movement speed and their movement abilities recover faster.
Singing a rising note launches every ally who can hear you a short distance in the direction they are moving. This ends your song and can be used once every short interval.
This is a sound and movement effect.
song.tag: This is a sound and movement effect.

sovereign.name: Decreed Ascension
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can spend mana to command allies to move. Every ally in your party who can hear you immediately uses one of their own movement abilities toward a point you choose, ignoring its cooldown.
Allies who arrive are wreathed in fire for a short time, taking reduced damage and burning enemies who strike them.
This can be used once every long interval.
This is a command, movement and fire effect.
sovereign.tag: This is a command, movement and fire effect.

spear.name: Thrown Self
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can hurl your weapon and, with a movement ability, become the throw: you hurtle after it in a burning line and catch it on impact.
Every enemy along the line takes the weapon's damage as fire damage.
This is a fire and movement effect.
spear.tag: This is a fire and movement effect.

spider.name: Silk Updraft
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can fire a burning strand to any surface in sight and pull yourself to it. Strands remain for a short time and can be travelled along again by you or your allies.
Enemies touching a strand are snared and burned.
This is a fire, web and movement effect.
spider.tag: This is a fire, web and movement effect.

spike.name: Waiting Pyre
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
The end point of each movement ability bristles with burning spikes for a short time. Enemies that step into the spikes are impaled, rooted briefly and burned.
You and your allies can cross the spikes unharmed.
This is a fire and trap effect.
spike.tag: This is a fire and trap effect.

staff.name: Pilgrim's Step
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Out of combat, you never tire from walking and travel significantly faster across roads and paths.
When you plant your staff, you vault from it to any point within a short distance, leaving a ring of flame where it stood.
This is a travel and fire effect.
staff.tag: This is a travel and fire effect.

star.name: Starfall
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can leap high into the air and descend as a falling star on any point you can see, damaging enemies at the landing with fire and light.
Allies near the landing are healed. This recovers slowly and cannot be used while rooted.
This is a fire, light and movement effect.
star.tag: This is a fire, light and movement effect.

stellar.name: Fixed Star Fall
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each movement ability you use in quick succession stores heat as a gathering star above you. Stored heat grows over time and is lost if you stand still.
You can release the star at any time, dropping it onto a point you can see. It inflicts fire damage scaled to the heat stored and heals allies at the edge of the impact.
This is a star, fire and healing effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star, fire and healing effect.

storm.name: Riding the Front
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
In rain, storms or wind, your movement abilities travel significantly further and can be used again sooner.

Lightning strikes the point where each of your movement abilities ends during a storm, inflicting lightning and fire damage on enemies nearby. Out of storms, you can spend mana to call a single strike this way.
This is a storm, movement and fire effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm, movement and fire effect.

succubus.name: Drawn Warmth
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you pass close to an enemy with a movement ability, you draw warmth out of it, slowing it briefly and restoring your stamina.
Warmth you have drawn is held as a reserve. You can release it as a healing touch on an ally, healing them for the warmth stored and granting them a brief speed boon.
This is a drain, movement and healing effect.
succubus.tag: This is a drain, movement and healing effect.

sun.name: Noon Wings
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
In daylight, you can conjure wings of sunlight that carry you in swift, bright bounds, at a cost of mana over time. Enemies along your path are blinded.
The wings can be released as a burst of light that heals allies and cleanses blindness, fear and darkness afflictions. After release, the wings cannot be conjured again until the next dawn.
This is a light, flight and healing effect.
sun.tag: This is a light, flight and healing effect.

swarm.name: Ember Swarm
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When you use a movement ability, you can break apart into a swarm of burning motes that travels the path instead of you. In swarm form, you take damage only from area effects and you burn every enemy you pass through.
You reform at the end of the path. Breaking apart costs mana and can only happen once every short interval.
This is a transformation, fire and movement effect.
swarm.tag: This is a transformation, fire and movement effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Feather
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can be used twice in succession before going on cooldown.
If the second use follows immediately on the first, both together cost the stamina of one.
This is a speed and movement effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and movement effect.

sword.name: Drawn Advance
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Drawing your weapon is a movement ability: you close on the nearest enemy in a streak of flame and strike as you arrive.
The strike counts as a special attack and gains increased damage if the enemy was unaware of you.
This is a fire, movement and blade effect.
sword.tag: This is a fire, movement and blade effect.

talisman.name: Feather Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can bind one of your movement abilities into a phoenix feather charm and give it to an ally. The ally can use that movement ability once, after which the charm returns to you.

If the bearer would be killed while carrying the charm, the charm burns instead, healing them for a portion of their maximum health and carrying them a short distance away from danger. A charm that burns cannot be made again for 24 hours.
This is a talisman, movement and healing effect.
talisman.tag: This is a talisman, movement and healing effect.

tentacle.name: Grasp and Haul
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can lash out with a burning tentacle to seize an enemy or ally in sight. A seized ally is pulled to your side; a seized enemy is dragged with you through your next movement ability and released burning at its end.
Seizing costs mana. Enemies of higher rank cannot be dragged.
This is a fire, grasp and movement effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a fire, grasp and movement effect.

thread.name: Lifeline
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can tie a burning thread between yourself and one ally. While tied, either of you can use a movement ability to pull the other along.
You can spend mana to reel the tied ally to your position, or yourself to theirs, regardless of obstacles between you. The thread burns enemies it passes through as it reels.
This is a bond and movement effect.
thread.tag: This is a bond and movement effect.

thunderbird.name: Following Storm
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
A storm cloud follows you, a short way behind. Each time you use a movement ability, the cloud catches up and strikes the place you left with lightning, inflicting damage on enemies there.
Enemies struck carry a static charge for a short time. Your fire damage against charged enemies arcs to other charged enemies nearby.
This is a storm, fire and movement effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm, fire and movement effect.

time.name: Unwound Flight
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
For a short time after using a movement ability, you can wind it back: you return to where you started, and your health and mana return to what they were at that moment.
Winding back cannot undo death, and the ability's cooldown starts over when you do it. This can be done once every long interval.
This is a time and movement effect.
time.tag: This is a time and movement effect.

tranquil.name: Settled Ash
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

When you stand still for a moment after using a movement ability, the fire around you dies down into quiet embers. While you remain still, you and allies within the embers recover health and mana over time, and enemies entering them lose any boons from rage or frenzy.
Using any movement ability ends the effect.
This is a calming and healing effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calming and healing effect.

transfiguration.name: Nirvanic Form
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can take one of three phoenix forms, changing between them at the cost of mana: a fledgling form that is fast and small and slips through gaps, a full form that bounds across the ground in great leaps, and an ash form that cannot be harmed but cannot attack.
Changing form cleanses one affliction and heals you for a small amount. Each form has its own cooldown once left.
This is a transformation and movement effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and movement effect.

transgression.name: Line-Crossing Flame
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities ignore barriers, wards and zones that forbid passage, carrying you through them.
Crossing a barrier this way breaks a portion of its strength and leaves the edge burning, damaging enemies who sheltered behind it.
This is a fire, movement and barrier-breaking effect.
transgression.tag: This is a fire, movement and barrier-breaking effect.

trap.name: Sprung Departure
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can set a hidden firetrap at your feet. When an enemy triggers it, you are flung to the trap's location in a burst of flame, arriving behind the enemy.
Only two traps can be set at a time. Setting a trap costs mana.
This is a trap and teleport effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and teleport effect.

tree.name: Heartwood Rebirth
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Standing beneath a tree for a moment lets you step into it and out of any other tree within a short distance.
While inside a tree, you regain health and stamina over time and cannot be targeted. You are forced out after a short time or when the tree burns.
This is a life and teleport effect.
tree.tag: This is a life and teleport effect.

troll.name: Searing Closure
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Wounds you take are cauterised by your own fire while a movement ability is active, and you regenerate health rapidly for its duration.
Bleeding, wounding and anti-healing afflictions on you are burned away each time you use a movement ability. Fire damage from enemies slows your regeneration.
This is a regeneration and fire effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and fire effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Line
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can lay a raised causeway of fused stone behind you. The causeway crosses gaps, water and hazardous ground, and allies on it move faster.
Causeways crumble after a short time. Only one can exist at a time.
This is an earth, construction and movement effect.
trowel.tag: This is an earth, construction and movement effect.

turtle.name: Shell of Embers
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can withdraw into a shell of hardened ember, becoming immune to damage but unable to move or act. While withdrawn you heal over time.
Leaving the shell bursts it outward, burning nearby enemies. You can withdraw once in a long interval.
This is a fire, defence and healing effect.
turtle.tag: This is a fire, defence and healing effect.

twilight.name: Grey Hour Wings
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities leave a dusk behind them: a stretch of dim light where you and allies are harder to see and enemies are unable to target anything at range.
While standing in your own dusk, your movement abilities cost no mana.
This is a darkness and movement effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and movement effect.

undeath.name: Cold Ember
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, when you would be killed, you keep moving as a cold, burnt-out shell for a short time. In this state you cannot be healed or killed, your movement abilities have no cooldown, and every place you land is chilled ash that slows enemies.
When the state ends, you fall. If an ally heals you before the state ends, you rise with a portion of your health instead. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is an undeath and movement effect.
undeath.tag: This is an undeath and movement effect.

unity.name: Shared Flight
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, every ally within a short distance travels with you in formation and arrives beside you.
Damage that would strike any one of you during the movement is spread across all of you equally. Allies who travel with you gain a brief speed boon on arrival.
This is a movement and unity effect.
unity.tag: This is a movement and unity effect.

vast.name: Horizon Stride
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Out of combat, you can step to any visited point on the region map that you can see from where you stand, across any distance, in a single burning stride.
In combat, your movement abilities have their range significantly extended but cost additional mana.
This is a space and travel effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and travel effect.

vehicle.name: Burning Wheels
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can conjure a burning chariot that carries you and up to two allies at high speed. Enemies struck by the chariot are knocked aside and burned.
The chariot lasts until dismissed or until you enter combat with an enemy of higher rank, and costs mana to maintain.
This is a conjuration, fire and travel effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a conjuration, fire and travel effect.

venom.name: Venom Wake
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities leave a trail that inflicts a poison affliction on enemies who cross it. Each crossing adds a stack.
Stacks of this poison on an enemy can be burned away by any fire damage, dealing their remaining damage at once.
This is a poison, fire and movement effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison, fire and movement effect.

verdant.name: Greenfire Trail
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Fire you leave behind with movement abilities is green flame. It does not harm plants or allies, and creepers grow along it as it burns.
Enemies standing in the green flame are tangled by creepers and rooted briefly. Allies standing in it regenerate health.
This is a nature, fire and healing effect.
verdant.tag: This is a nature, fire and healing effect.

vessel.name: Vessel of the Phoenix
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Fire damage you receive is absorbed into you as stored phoenix fire instead of harming you, up to a limit. While you hold stored fire, your movement abilities leave a burning trail.
You can release all stored fire at once in a burst that heals you and nearby allies and inflicts fire damage on enemies, scaled to the amount held.
This is a fire, absorption and healing effect.
vessel.tag: This is a fire, absorption and healing effect.

visage.name: Borrowed Plumage
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
After a movement ability, you can take on the appearance of the nearest creature for a short time. Enemies do not attack a creature they believe to be one of their own until it acts.
When you drop the borrowed form, you burst out of it in a dash of flame, and nearby enemies lose track of you for a moment.
This is a disguise and movement effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and movement effect.

vision.name: Foreseen Landing
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Before you use a movement ability, you see a brief vision of what is waiting at its destination: hidden enemies, traps and incoming attacks.
If a vision shows danger, you can cancel the movement without spending its cost or cooldown. Traps you see this way are disarmed if you move onto them.
This is a precognition and movement effect.
vision.tag: This is a precognition and movement effect.

void.name: Black Fire Passage
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities pass through the void instead of the world. You cannot be damaged during them, and they ignore walls and obstacles up to a short thickness.
Each passage through the void costs a portion of your health, which the void returns as black fire around your exit point, damaging nearby enemies.
This is a void, fire and teleport effect.
void.tag: This is a void, fire and teleport effect.

volcano.name: Eruption Launch
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Standing still builds pressure. The longer you stand, the further and more violently your next movement ability launches you.
At full pressure, the launch erupts from the ground beneath you, inflicting heavy fire damage around your starting point and raining burning ash where you land.
Pressure is lost if you take damage while building it.
This is a fire, eruption and movement effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire, eruption and movement effect.

vortex.name: Spiral Ascent
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each movement ability you use ends in a spiral of burning wind that pulls nearby enemies toward its centre for a short time.
Using a second movement ability out of the centre of an active spiral flings you further than normal and releases the trapped enemies, setting them burning.
This is a wind, pull and fire effect.
vortex.tag: This is a wind, pull and fire effect.

wasp.name: Dive and Sting
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can dart in short bursts of speed. Lunging onto an enemy from a dart inflicts a burning sting that stacks each time you strike the same enemy this way.
After a lunge, you spring back out of reach at no stamina cost.
This is a flight and affliction effect.
wasp.tag: This is a flight and affliction effect.

water.name: Tideborne Return
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities leave a trail of running water for a short time. Allies moving through it gain speed; enemies standing in it are slowed.

Once per day, a lethal blow instead dissolves you into water. You reform at the end of your most recent movement ability's path with a portion of your maximum health. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a water, movement and rebirth effect.
water.tag: This is a water, movement and rebirth effect.

weave.name: Woven Wake
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Paths left by your movement abilities persist as burning threads. Where two of your threads cross, a knot forms.
A knot heals allies who stand on it and burns enemies who stand on it. Crossing three threads at one point turns the knot into a net of flame that roots enemies inside it.
Threads fade when you leave combat.
This is a weaving, fire and healing effect.
weave.tag: This is a weaving, fire and healing effect.

wendigo.name: Starved Stride
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities cover longer distances the lower your health and stamina are.

Each enemy you pass through with a movement ability has warmth torn out of it, inflicting cold damage and restoring a portion of your stamina. The fire you leave behind burns cold and slows enemies standing in it.
This is a cold, hunger and movement effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold, hunger and movement effect.

whale.name: Migration Call
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can sing a long call that carries across the whole region. Every party member who hears it can travel to you once, arriving at your side, as long as they are out of combat.
The call recovers over 24 hours. Deep water does not slow you or your allies while travelling to you.
This is a sound and travel effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and travel effect.

wheel.name: Wheel of Fire
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Your movement abilities can be used in a circle that returns you to your starting point. Enemies within the circle are struck by a ring of fire as it closes.
Each completed circle reduces the cooldown of your next movement ability.
This is a fire and movement effect.
wheel.tag: This is a fire and movement effect.

whip.name: Lash and Swing
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can crack a burning lash at any enemy within a short distance and pull yourself to it, or pull it to you if it is of lower rank.
The lash leaves a burn affliction where it strikes.
This is a fire and movement effect.
whip.tag: This is a fire and movement effect.

wind.name: Thermal Rise
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Fire you create sends up rising thermals. Stepping into a thermal lightens you into a swift, weightless stride, during which you cannot be struck by melee attacks.
When the stride ends, it sends out a ring of cutting wind that pushes enemies back.
This is an air, fire and flight effect.
wind.tag: This is an air, fire and flight effect.

wing.name: Wings of the Burning Pinion
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

You can conjure wings of flame that drive you forward in long, beating bounds, at a cost of mana over time. While they are active, each beat of your wings sends a gust of embers at enemies around you.
The wings can be folded around you to block an incoming attack, taking no damage. Folding them ends the bounding and the wings cannot be conjured again for a short time.
This is a fire and flight effect.
wing.tag: This is a fire and flight effect.

wolf.name: Running with the Pack
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
When you use a movement ability, allies and summons within a short distance move with you, arriving in formation around your destination.
Enemies surrounded on arrival by you and at least two others are briefly unable to flee.
This is a pack and movement effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and movement effect.

wood.name: Living Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Wooden floors, bridges, ships and trees bend to carry you. Your movement abilities on or across wood travel further and cost no stamina.
Wood you burn regrows over a day, and wooden objects you have burned can be used as kindling points to start your next movement ability from.
This is a life, fire and movement effect.
wood.tag: This is a life, fire and movement effect.

wrath.name: Fury Kindling
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
Each time you are struck, you gain a point of wrath. You can spend wrath instead of mana or stamina to use movement abilities.

Spending a large amount of wrath at once on a single movement ability turns it into a burning charge that inflicts fire damage on everything in its path and leaves you with a brief boon of increased damage.
Wrath fades out of combat.
This is a rage, fire and movement effect.
wrath.tag: This is a rage, fire and movement effect.

zeal.name: Conviction's Charge
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].
You can declare a target. Movement abilities toward the declared target cannot be stopped, slowed or rooted, and each one leaves a blazing trail that heals allies who follow it.
The declaration ends when the target dies or you move away from it.
This is a fire, movement and healing effect.
zeal.tag: This is a fire, movement and healing effect.

ziz.name: Horizon-Wide Wings
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by The World-Phoenix. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: The World-Phoenix].

Once per day, you can spread wings of flame so wide that they shelter everything in a large area beneath them for a short time. Rain, falling attacks and ranged attacks from above cannot reach anyone beneath the wings.

Allies sheltered beneath the wings are healed over time; enemies beneath them take fire damage over time. When the wings fold, you can use any movement ability without cost. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a flight, protection and healing effect.
ziz.tag: This is a flight, protection and healing effect.

action.name: Spoken Go
action.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Action confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend mana to speak a single word to an ally within sight. That ally's next ability is used without its cast or wind-up time.
If the ally uses that ability within a brief window, both of you recover a portion of stamina.
This effect can be used again after a short cooldown, and cannot target the same ally twice in a row.
This is a command and haste effect.
action.tag: This is a command and haste effect.

adept.name: The Taught Word
adept.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Adept essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you grant a boon to an ally, you can spend additional mana to lend them one of your own passive abilities for as long as the boon lasts.
An ally carrying a lent passive gains experience toward their own matching ability, if they have one, as though they had used it themselves.
Only one passive can be lent at a time.
This is a boon and instruction effect.
adept.tag: This is a boon and instruction effect.

alchemy.name: Shared Tincture
alchemy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Alchemy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

When you drink a potion, you can speak its effect onto one ally within a short range instead of keeping it. The ally receives the potion's full effect, and the potion's cooldown is applied to you alone.
Boons you grant to an ally who is already under a potion's effect have their duration extended.
This is a support and alchemy effect.
alchemy.tag: This is a support and alchemy effect.

ambush.name: Held Breath
ambush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ambush confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can whisper a word of silence over an ally out of combat. Until that ally attacks, they are unseen by enemies of their rank or lower, and their footsteps make no sound.
The first attack that ally makes from silence carries a brief stun.
Only one ally can be silenced at a time. Breaking silence by attacking ends the effect.
This is a stealth and support effect.
ambush.tag: This is a stealth and support effect.

animate.name: Lent Motion
animate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Animate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can speak to an unattended weapon, shield or piece of armour within a short range. It rises and guards the nearest ally for a short time, blocking an attack aimed at them and striking at enemies that come close.
An object that blocks a killing blow falls inert and cannot be woken again for a day.
Waking an object costs mana scaled to its quality.
This is an animation and protection effect.
animate.tag: This is an animation and protection effect.

anzu.name: Thunder's Herald
anzu.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Anzu confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant carry a charge of storm. When an ally under one of your boons is struck in melee, a peal of thunder answers, inflicting lightning damage on the attacker and knocking it back.
Each boon can answer this way only once.
Allies under your boons are immune to being knocked down by wind and storm effects.
This is a storm and support effect.
anzu.tag: This is a storm and support effect.

ape.name: Troop Signal
ape.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ape essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can issue a wordless signal to every ally within a short range: charge, scatter, or hold. Allies who act on the signal within a brief window gain a boon matching it — damage for a charge, movement speed for a scatter, damage reduction for a hold.
Summons and companions obey the signal immediately.
This is a command and boon effect.
ape.tag: This is a command and boon effect.

armour.name: Mantle of Plates
armour.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Armour essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Each boon you place on an ally also places a plate of conjured armour on them. Plates stack, and each one absorbs a single hit before breaking.
When an ally's last plate breaks, you can spend mana to reforge one on them instantly. This can be done once per ally per fight.
This is a boon and conjuration effect.
armour.tag: This is a boon and conjuration effect.

arsenal.name: Quartermaster's Word
arsenal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Arsenal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend mana to issue an ally a conjured copy of any weapon in your inventory. The copy lasts until the fight ends and carries the weapon's base stats, but none of its enchantments.
An ally wielding an issued weapon deals bonus damage against the damage type the weapon's original owner was weakest to.
Only one weapon can be issued to each ally at a time.
This is a conjuration and support effect.
arsenal.tag: This is a conjuration and support effect.

aspect.name: Borrowed Aspect
aspect.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Aspect essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Once per fight, you can speak an ally's true aspect aloud. For a short time, that ally takes on a greater form: larger, harder to move, and with a portion of your own attributes added to theirs.
While an ally wears their aspect, you cannot grant boons to anyone else.
This effect recovers when you leave combat.
This is a transformation and boon effect.
aspect.tag: This is a transformation and boon effect.

avatar.name: Borrowed Crown
avatar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Avatar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

Once per fight, you can name one ally as your champion. For a short time, the champion's attacks and abilities count as one rank higher for the purpose of resistances, and enemies of lower rank hesitate before attacking them.
While your champion is active, your own boons cost less mana.
The champion's mantle ends early if the champion is reduced below a quarter of their health.
This is an ascension and support effect.
avatar.tag: This is an ascension and support effect.

axe.name: Felling Call
axe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Axe essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can name a single enemy as felled. Allies attacking the named enemy deal increased damage, and the first ally to land a special attack on it breaks one of its active boons.
When the named enemy dies, every ally who struck it recovers stamina.
Only one enemy can be named at a time.
This is a mark and boon effect.
axe.tag: This is a mark and boon effect.

balance.name: Even Scales
balance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Balance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend mana to equalise your party. Health, mana and stamina are pooled across every ally in range and redistributed as an equal portion of each ally's maximum.
Afflictions are spread evenly in the same way, so no single ally carries all of the stacks.
This effect can be used once per fight.
This is a support and balance effect.
balance.tag: This is a support and balance effect.

bat.name: Echo-Guide
bat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons can see through magical and natural darkness, and enemies hidden by stealth or invisibility are outlined for them while within a short distance.
If an ally carrying your boons is blinded, the blindness is converted into a brief boon of increased evasion instead.
This is a perception and boon effect.
bat.tag: This is a perception and boon effect.

battlefield.name: Rally Line
battlefield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Battlefield confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can plant a spoken line on the ground in front of you. Allies standing behind it take reduced damage from ranged attacks; allies who step across it toward the enemy gain a brief burst of attack speed.
The line lasts until you place another or move far enough from it.
Calling the line costs stamina rather than mana.
This is a battlefield and support effect.
battlefield.tag: This is a battlefield and support effect.

bear.name: Den Mother
bear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

When an ally near you falls below a quarter of their health, you can let out a roar. Every enemy near that ally is forced to attack you for a short time, and the ally gains a brief boon of rapid health regeneration.
While the roar is active, you take reduced damage from enemies that are attacking you because of it.
This effect recovers after a long cooldown.
This is a taunt and boon effect.
bear.tag: This is a taunt and boon effect.

bee.name: Hive Hum
bee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons share a low hum. While three or more of them are within a short range of one another, each of their boons lasts longer and their stamina recovers faster.
When an ally carrying your boons dies, the others gain a brief frenzy of attack speed.
This is a support and swarm effect.
bee.tag: This is a support and swarm effect.

behemoth.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
behemoth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Behemoth confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
While an ally is standing close to you, neither of you can be knocked back, pulled or displaced by enemies of your rank or lower.
You can spend stamina to plant yourself, becoming immovable for a short time. Allies directly behind you are untargetable by charges and dashes while you hold.
This is a weight and protection effect.
behemoth.tag: This is a weight and protection effect.

bird.name: Carried on the Wind
bird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bird essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you cast can be sent as a small bird of light. It flies to an ally anywhere within your sight, ignoring walls and line-of-effect, and delivers the boon on arrival.
Once per fight, the bird can carry an ally instead: it lifts them a short distance in the direction you choose, out of a hazard or over an obstacle.
This is a boon and conjuration effect.
bird.tag: This is a boon and conjuration effect.

blight.name: Blighted Tithe
blight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Blight essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally is cleansed of an affliction by any source, you can catch the affliction and pass it onto a nearby enemy at full stacks instead of letting it disappear.
An enemy carrying an affliction passed this way cannot be targeted by its own allies' cleanses.
This is a curse and support effect.
blight.tag: This is a curse and support effect.

blood.name: Blood Oath
blood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Blood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can swear a blood oath with one ally, paying a portion of your health. While the oath holds, damage that would kill the ally is taken by you instead, and every boon you grant them is significantly stronger.
The oath ends when either of you leaves combat, or when it saves the ally's life.
This is a blood and bond effect.
blood.tag: This is a blood and bond effect.

bone.name: Marrow Ward
bone.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bone essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons cannot have their bones broken, their limbs crippled or their movement reduced by wounding effects.
When an ally carrying your boons takes a critical hit, a lattice of bone erupts across them, absorbing part of the damage and leaving them immune to further critical hits for a brief time.
This effect can occur once per ally per fight.
This is a bone and protection effect.
bone.tag: This is a bone and protection effect.

boundary.name: Sanctuary Word
boundary.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Boundary confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a ring of sanctuary around an ally. Enemies that are outside the ring cannot enter it for a short time, though their ranged attacks and spells pass through.
An enemy already inside the ring when it forms is pushed to its edge.
Speaking sanctuary costs a significant amount of mana and can be used once per fight.
This is a barrier and support effect.
boundary.tag: This is a barrier and support effect.

bounty.name: Overflowing Cup
bounty.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bounty confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When a boon you grant would be applied to a target already at its maximum stacks or strength, the excess spills to the nearest ally who lacks it.
Health, mana and stamina you restore to a full ally overflow the same way.
Allies who receive overflow from you this way also gain a small amount of extra loot from the next enemy they kill.
This is an abundance and support effect.
bounty.tag: This is an abundance and support effect.

bow.name: Drawn String
bow.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Bow essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant can be fired as arrows. An arrow passes harmlessly through allies, granting the boon to every ally along its path, and stops at the first enemy it reaches.
An enemy struck by a boon arrow is briefly marked. Ranged attacks from your allies against a marked enemy cannot miss.
This is a boon and projectile effect.
bow.tag: This is a boon and projectile effect.

brush.name: Undergrowth Shelter
brush.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Brush essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call a patch of thick undergrowth around an ally. While inside it, the ally is concealed from enemies beyond melee range and regenerates health slowly.
Enemies that enter the undergrowth are slowed and lose track of anyone concealed in it.
Only one patch can exist at a time.
This is a nature and concealment effect.
brush.tag: This is a nature and concealment effect.

cage.name: Ward of Bars
cage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can close a cage of conjured bars around an ally. Nothing can enter or leave the cage, and the ally inside cannot be targeted by attacks or afflictions, but also cannot act.
The cage holds for a short time or until you dismiss it. It costs mana to close and recovers after a long cooldown.
This is a barrier and conjuration effect.
cage.tag: This is a barrier and conjuration effect.

cat.name: Soft Steps
cat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons make no sound when they move, and enemies do not notice them until they come within a short distance.
The first attack an ally carrying your boons makes from concealment lands as a critical hit, consuming the concealment.
This is a stealth and boon effect.
cat.tag: This is a stealth and boon effect.

cataclysm.name: Aftershock Blessing
cataclysm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cataclysm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When a boon you granted expires on an ally, it breaks open, releasing a shockwave around them that inflicts force damage and knocks lower-rank enemies off their feet.
The shockwave is stronger the longer the boon lasted.
You can end one of your boons early to trigger this, at a cost of mana.
This is a force and support effect.
cataclysm.tag: This is a force and support effect.

cattle.name: Yoke of the Herd
cattle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cattle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
While allies carrying your boons stand close together, they share stamina. Any one of them can draw on the others' stamina to keep acting when their own runs out.
Allies sharing stamina this way cannot be knocked back or knocked down while they remain close together.
This is a stamina and support effect.
cattle.tag: This is a stamina and support effect.

chain.name: Linked Fates
chain.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Chain essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can bind up to three allies together with chains of light. Damage dealt to any linked ally is divided evenly among all of them.
A linked ally who is pulled, knocked back or teleported against their will drags the chain taut and is held in place instead.
Linking costs mana for each ally and lasts until combat ends.
This is a binding and support effect.
chain.tag: This is a binding and support effect.

chaotic.name: Loaded Dice
chaotic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Chaotic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Each boon you grant rolls a random secondary effect from a short list: bonus damage of a random type, a brief shield, movement speed, mana recovery, or a cleanse of one affliction.
Once per fight, you can speak a word to reroll every secondary effect on every ally at once.
This is a chance and support effect.
chaotic.tag: This is a chance and support effect.

charlatan.name: Good Word
charlatan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Charlatan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can vouch for an ally to a townsperson, merchant or guard. That ally is treated as if they had your reputation with that person's faction for a day.
In combat, you can speak a false word over an ally, making enemies believe the ally is already beaten. Enemies of lower rank turn to other targets for a brief time.
The false word ends if the ally attacks.
This is a deception and support effect.
charlatan.tag: This is a deception and support effect.

chicken.name: Mother Hen
chicken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Chicken essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an enemy attacks an ally who is weaker or of lower rank than you, you can spend stamina to throw yourself between them, taking the hit in their place.
Each time you take a hit this way, your boons on that ally are refreshed to their full duration.
This is a protection and boon effect.
chicken.tag: This is a protection and boon effect.

chimera.name: Many-Mouthed Blessing
chimera.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Chimera confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons gain one trait borrowed from an animal of your choosing when you grant the boon: a lion's heavier strikes, a goat's sure footing, or a serpent's venom on their attacks.
An ally can carry only one borrowed trait at a time. Choosing a different trait replaces it.
This is a grafting and support effect.
chimera.tag: This is a grafting and support effect.

claw.name: Rallying Scratch
claw.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Claw essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons inflict a bleed affliction with their basic attacks.
When an enemy dies with bleeds from three or more different allies on it, every ally who contributed a bleed recovers a portion of their mana.
This is a bleed and boon effect.
claw.tag: This is a bleed and boon effect.

cloth.name: Woven Favour
cloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

Boons you grant can be woven into an ally's clothing or armour instead of placed on them. A woven boon lasts until the ally takes it off or until a set number of hits are taken, rather than expiring with time.
Each ally can carry one woven boon. Weaving costs more mana than casting.
This is a boon and weaving effect.
cloth.tag: This is a boon and weaving effect.

cloud.name: Veil of Vapour
cloud.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cloud essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can wrap an ally in drifting cloud. For a short time, attacks against them have a chance to pass straight through, and they can walk across gaps and shallow water as though it were ground.
When the cloud lifts, it leaves a patch of fog behind that blocks enemy line of sight.
This is a vapour and evasion effect.
cloud.tag: This is a vapour and evasion effect.

cold.name: Still Blood
cold.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cold essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can chill an ally's blood. For a short time, their afflictions stop ticking, their bleeding halts, and they cannot be panicked or enraged.
When the effect ends, any affliction that was paused has a portion of its remaining stacks frozen away.
This is a cold and support effect.
cold.tag: This is a cold and support effect.

coral.name: Living Reef
coral.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Coral essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Each boon you place on an ally seeds a small growth of coral on their armour. Coral growths add to their armour, and slowly spread to any ally standing beside them.
Enemies that strike an ally covered in coral take a small amount of damage and a brief slow.
Coral growths fall away when the ally leaves combat.
This is a growth and protection effect.
coral.tag: This is a growth and protection effect.

corrupt.name: Sweetened Word
corrupt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Corrupt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can corrupt an enemy's boon in place. A corrupted boon stays on the enemy and appears unchanged to them, but its effect is inverted for its remaining duration.
Corrupting a boon of an enemy higher in rank than you costs significantly more mana.
This is a corruption and boon effect.
corrupt.tag: This is a corruption and boon effect.

crocodile.name: Lie in Wait
crocodile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Crocodile essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can tell an ally to wait. While they stand still, they build up a stacking boon of damage and their presence on enemy aura sense fades.
Their next attack consumes every stack, and if it hits, it holds the target in place for a time scaled to the number of stacks.
This is a patience and boon effect.
crocodile.tag: This is a patience and boon effect.

crystal.name: Crystal Clarity
crystal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Crystal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can encase one of your active boons on an ally in crystal. An encased boon cannot be dispelled, stolen or reduced, and it does not expire until the crystal is broken.
The crystal breaks the first time the ally is struck by a critical hit. Each ally can carry one encased boon at a time.
This is a crystal and boon effect.
crystal.tag: This is a crystal and boon effect.

cycle.name: Turned Season
cycle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Cycle confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When a boon you granted expires naturally, it returns to the same ally after a short pause at reduced strength, then expires for good.
An ally who dies while under one of your boons returns the boon to you as a portion of its mana cost.
This is a cycle and support effect.
cycle.tag: This is a cycle and support effect.

dance.name: Partner's Step
dance.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dance essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can choose one ally as your partner. Whenever either of you uses a movement ability, the other may follow with a free step in the same direction.
While you and your partner are moving within a short distance of each other, both of you gain evasion that grows with each step and resets when either of you stops.
This is a movement and bond effect.
dance.tag: This is a movement and bond effect.

dark.name: Shadow Shelter
dark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can pull an ally into your own shadow. While there, they cannot be seen or attacked, and they recover mana and stamina, but they cannot act.
They return when you release them or when you take damage, stepping out from your shadow in the direction you are facing.
Only one ally can shelter at a time.
This is a darkness and shelter effect.
dark.tag: This is a darkness and shelter effect.

dawn.name: First Light
dawn.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dawn confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons cannot be blinded, and invisible or stealthed enemies within a short range of them are revealed.
Once per day, at the start of a fight, you can speak the first word of morning: every ally in sight is cleansed of fear and gains a brief boon of increased damage.
This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a light and support effect.
dawn.tag: This is a light and support effect.

death.name: Last Rite
death.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Death essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally would die, you can speak a last rite. The ally does not die until the rite ends a short time later, and during that time they deal increased damage and ignore pain and fear.
If the ally is healed above a quarter of their health before the rite ends, they survive. Otherwise they fall.
This effect can be used once per day.
This is a death and support effect.
death.tag: This is a death and support effect.

deep.name: Fathom Weight
deep.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Deep essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons are not slowed while standing in water, and the weight of being wet does not drag at them.
You can lay the pressure of the deep on an ally. For a short time they cannot be knocked back, pulled, lifted or thrown, and each hit they land pushes the target down, slowing it.
This is a water and pressure effect.
deep.tag: This is a water and pressure effect.

deer.name: Flight Instinct
deer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Deer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an enemy begins a powerful attack aimed at an ally carrying your boons, the ally is warned with a flash at the edge of their sight.
An ally who moves away within the warning window gains a burst of movement speed and takes no damage from the attack if they clear its area.
This is a warning and evasion effect.
deer.tag: This is a warning and evasion effect.

desolate.name: Bare Ground
desolate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Desolate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a silence over an area. Enemies within it cannot benefit from their own boons or healing for a short time, while allies within it keep yours.
Plants, summoned greenery and conjured terrain within the area wither away.
Speaking this silence costs a significant amount of mana and can be used once per fight.
This is a silence and support effect.
desolate.tag: This is a silence and support effect.

dimension.name: Folded Ally
dimension.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dimension essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can fold the space between yourself and an ally you can see, swapping your positions instantly.
Boons on each of you are copied to the other when you swap.
This costs mana, and recovers after a short cooldown.
This is a space and teleport effect.
dimension.tag: This is a space and teleport effect.

discord.name: Off-Key
discord.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Discord essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Whenever an enemy grants a boon to another enemy within your aura, you can answer it with a discordant note. The boon is placed on the wrong target: the enemy furthest from the caster.
Enemies with boons misplaced this way lose a portion of their mana.
This can trigger once every few seconds.
This is a discord and disruption effect.
discord.tag: This is a discord and disruption effect.

discordant.name: Set Against
discordant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Discordant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Whenever an enemy grants a boon to another enemy within sight of you, you can spend mana to unstring it. The boon is removed, and a weaker copy of it is granted to your nearest ally.
This can happen once every short interval.
Enemies that share a pack or summoner with an unstrung target take a brief penalty to coordination, attacking less often.
This is a disruption and support effect.
discordant.tag: This is a disruption and support effect.

dog.name: Loyal Watch
dog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can set a guard on an ally. Your summons and companions stay close to that ally and attack anything that strikes them.
Any enemy that attacks the guarded ally is marked, and your summons deal increased damage to marked enemies.
This is a guard and command effect.
dog.tag: This is a guard and command effect.

doom.name: Appointed Hour
doom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Doom confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can pronounce an enemy's ending in front of your allies. Every ally who can see that enemy deals increased damage to it for the rest of the fight.
If the enemy dies within a short time of the pronouncement, your boons on every ally are refreshed to their full duration.
Only one enemy can be pronounced at a time, and higher-rank enemies resist the pronouncement's damage bonus.
This is a doom and support effect.
doom.tag: This is a doom and support effect.

doppelganger.name: Second Voice
doppelganger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Doppelganger confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can spend mana to send a faint double of yourself to stand beside an ally. The double cannot attack, but it casts copies of the boons you grant from its position, letting you support allies outside your normal range.
Enemies sometimes target the double instead of you. It vanishes when struck.
Only one double can exist at a time.
This is a duplication and support effect.
doppelganger.tag: This is a duplication and support effect.

dragon.name: Kindled Breast
dragon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dragon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant kindle a slow heat in the ally that hardens their skin. They take reduced damage from fire, and their attacks inflict a stacking burn affliction.
You can spend mana to speak the heat out of every ally at once. Each ally breathes a short cone of fire, ending your boons on them.
This is a fire and support effect.
dragon.tag: This is a fire and support effect.

duck.name: Water Off a Back
duck.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Duck essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
The first affliction applied to an ally carrying your boons slides off them and is lost.
This protection returns after a short time without being afflicted. While it is active, the ally cannot be made to panic, flee or lose control of their actions.
This is a calm and protection effect.
duck.tag: This is a calm and protection effect.

dust.name: Settling Grey
dust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Dust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can raise a cloud of dust around your party. While inside it, allies are harder for enemies to target from range, and enemy ranged attacks against them fall short.
When the dust settles, it leaves a thin grey layer on enemies within it, revealing them to your allies through walls for a short time.
This is a dust and concealment effect.
dust.tag: This is a dust and concealment effect.

earth.name: Stone Footing
earth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Earth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can raise a low wall of jagged stone beside an ally. The wall blocks attacks from its side and lasts until destroyed.
Allies standing in contact with a stone wall you raised gain increased damage reduction and cannot be knocked down.
Only two walls can stand at once.
This is an earth and conjuration effect.
earth.tag: This is an earth and conjuration effect.

echo.name: Returning Word
echo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Echo essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Every boon you grant echoes a moment later, landing a second time on the ally nearest to its original target.
The echo is weaker than the original and does not echo again.
This is a sound and boon effect.
echo.tag: This is a sound and boon effect.

eclipse.name: Shade of the Covered Sun
eclipse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Eclipse confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can place yourself between an ally and the enemy's sight. Ranged attacks and spells aimed at that ally strike you instead for a short time, at reduced damage.
While you shield an ally this way, the ally is hidden from enemies that cannot see past you, and their first attack from that shade deals bonus damage.
This is a concealment and protection effect.
eclipse.tag: This is a concealment and protection effect.

edifice.name: Raised Footing
edifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Edifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can speak a block of stone into being under an ally's feet. The ally is raised above the field, gains a bonus to ranged attack range and accuracy, and cannot be reached by melee enemies without climbing.
The block lasts until it is broken or the ally steps off. Only one block can stand at a time.
Raising a block costs mana and can be done again after a short cooldown.
This is an earth and support effect.
edifice.tag: This is an earth and support effect.

effigy.name: Straw Stand-In
effigy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Effigy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can name a straw likeness after an ally and set it down within sight of them. The first killing blow that ally would take is taken by the likeness instead, which burns away. The ally is left at a sliver of health.
Only one likeness can stand at a time, and each ally can be saved this way once per day.
Making a likeness costs a significant amount of mana.
This is a sacrifice and protection effect.
effigy.tag: This is a sacrifice and protection effect.

elemental.name: Elemental Tongue
elemental.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Elemental essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you grant a boon, you can attune it to fire, water, earth or air. The ally's attacks deal additional damage of that element, and the ally gains resistance to it.
An enemy struck by two different attuned elements in a short time suffers an elemental reaction: a burst of damage of both types.
This is an elemental and boon effect.
elemental.tag: This is an elemental and boon effect.

elixir.name: Shared Draught
elixir.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Elixir essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you drink a potion, you can speak its effect onto an ally within range. They receive the full effect of the potion as well.
When an ally carrying your boons drinks a potion, the potion's cooldown is shortened for them.
This is an alchemy and support effect.
elixir.tag: This is an alchemy and support effect.

empower.name: Invested Hand
empower.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Empower confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can invest a portion of your own maximum mana into an ally for as long as you choose. The ally's abilities deal increased damage while the investment lasts, scaling with how much you lent.
While mana is invested, your maximum mana is reduced by the same amount. You can recall the investment at any time.
This is an empowerment and support effect.
empower.tag: This is an empowerment and support effect.

eye.name: Watchful Gaze
eye.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Eye essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can open an eye above an ally. While it is open, the ally sees whatever you see, including enemies revealed by your aura sense, and you see whatever they see.
Enemies that attack the ally from outside their field of view are revealed and lose any bonus for attacking from behind.
This is a perception and bond effect.
eye.tag: This is a perception and bond effect.

feast.name: Open Table
feast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Feast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Food you eat out of combat feeds your whole party. Every ally in range receives the meal's full effect.
Boons you grant while a meal's effect is active on the target last significantly longer.
This is a provision and boon effect.
feast.tag: This is a provision and boon effect.

feeble.name: Lightened Load
feeble.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Feeble essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you apply a weakening effect to an enemy, the strength it loses is given to an ally of your choice as a boon for the same duration.
If the weakened enemy is of higher rank than the ally, the boon is stronger.
This is a drain and boon effect.
feeble.tag: This is a drain and boon effect.

fertile.name: Seeded Word
fertile.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fertile confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant plant a seed where the ally is standing. When the boon expires, the seed sprouts into a small green patch that restores health over time to allies who stand in it.
Patches last for a short time. Several patches can stand at once, and patches that overlap restore health faster.
This is a growth and healing effect.
fertile.tag: This is a growth and healing effect.

fey.name: Fair Bargain
fey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fey confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can offer an ally a bargain: a strong boon of increased damage and speed, in exchange for a condition you name from a short list — no healing received, no retreating, or no abilities above a cooldown.
If the ally keeps the condition until the boon ends, they recover a portion of health and mana. If they break it, the boon ends and they are briefly slowed.
This is a bargain and support effect.
fey.tag: This is a bargain and support effect.

fire.name: Kindling Word
fire.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fire essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant set a small flame burning in the ally's hands. Their attacks inflict a stacking burn affliction while the boon lasts.
You can call the flame back early. It returns to you and heals you and the ally for a portion of the burn damage the ally dealt.
This is a fire and boon effect.
fire.tag: This is a fire and boon effect.

firebird.name: Ember Return
firebird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Firebird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

An ally who falls while under one of your boons leaves an ember behind. For a short time, you can spend a large amount of mana to speak them back up from it, returning them with a portion of their health and wreathed in flame that burns nearby enemies.
Each ally can be rekindled once per day. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a fire and revival effect.
firebird.tag: This is a fire and revival effect.

fish.name: Shoal
fish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fish essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

While three or more allies carrying your boons move close together, they move as a shoal. Each gains movement speed, and enemies attacking one of them have a chance to strike a different member of the shoal instead.
A shoal that scatters gives each member a brief burst of speed.
This is a group and movement effect.
fish.tag: This is a group and movement effect.

flea.name: Spring in the Step
flea.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Flea essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons can leap a long distance instead of dodging, clearing enemies, low walls and gaps.
An ally who lands from a leap within a short distance of an enemy gains a brief boon of increased attack speed.
This is a movement and boon effect.
flea.tag: This is a movement and boon effect.

flesh.name: Grafted Flesh
flesh.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Flesh essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can pay a portion of your own health to close an ally's wounds. The ally is healed for more than you paid, and any wounding affliction on them is removed.
While you are below half health, this costs stamina instead of health.
This is a flesh and healing effect.
flesh.tag: This is a flesh and healing effect.

foot.name: Marching Order
foot.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Foot essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Outside combat, you can set the pace for your party. Allies travelling with you move faster and do not tire, and mounts and companions keep up without effort.
When combat begins while the pace is set, every ally starts the fight with full stamina.
This is a travel and support effect.
foot.tag: This is a travel and support effect.

force.name: Driving Word
force.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Force confluence.
