lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a word behind an ally's next strike. The strike inflicts additional force damage and shoves the target back a significant distance.
A target shoved into a wall, another enemy or an obstacle is stunned briefly.
This costs stamina and can be used again after a short cooldown.
This is a force and support effect.
force.tag: This is a force and support effect.

forge.name: Tempering Word
forge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Forge confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Each time an ally under your boon is struck, they gain a stack of temper, reducing the damage they take from the same damage type.
When the boon ends, the ally can quench their temper, converting all stacks into a brief burst of damage reduction against every type.
Temper is lost if the ally leaves combat.
This is a forge and protection effect.
forge.tag: This is a forge and protection effect.

fork.name: Split Path
fork.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fork essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you cast a single-target boon, you can split it between two allies. Each receives the boon at a reduced strength.
If both allies strike the same enemy within a short time, the boons rejoin at full strength on whichever ally struck second.
This is a boon and division effect.
fork.tag: This is a boon and division effect.

fortress.name: Gatehouse Watch
fortress.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fortress confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can declare a doorway, gate or narrow passage as held. Allies standing within it take significantly reduced damage from enemies outside it, and cannot be flanked.
The hold ends when no ally stands in it, or after a long time.
Out of combat, a held doorway warns you when any creature approaches it, even if you are elsewhere in the same area.
This is a fortification and support effect.
fortress.tag: This is a fortification and support effect.

fox.name: Trickster's Favour
fox.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fox essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can hide a boon on an ally. A hidden boon does nothing until an enemy tries to dispel, steal or copy it, at which point it springs: the enemy is stunned briefly and the boon activates at full strength.
Each ally can carry one hidden boon at a time.
This is a trick and boon effect.
fox.tag: This is a trick and boon effect.

frog.name: Leapfrog
frog.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Frog essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spring off an ally, vaulting over them to a point a short distance beyond. The ally is pushed down and cannot be knocked back for a brief time, and you land with a burst of movement speed.
If you vault over an ally who is being attacked, the attacker is knocked down by your landing.
This is a movement and support effect.
frog.tag: This is a movement and support effect.

fungus.name: Spore Network
fungus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Fungus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant leave spores on the ground where the ally stood. Any ally who later walks across them receives a weak copy of the boon.
Enemies walking across them are slowed and briefly poisoned.
Spores last until the end of the fight.
This is a spore and boon effect.
fungus.tag: This is a spore and boon effect.

garuda.name: Carried Aloft
garuda.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Garuda confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend mana to lift an ally on golden wind and set them down anywhere within a moderate range that you can see. The ally passes over enemies, gaps and water.
An ally set down beside a serpent-type or poisonous enemy deals bonus damage to it for a short time.
This can be used again after a short cooldown.
This is a flight and support effect.
garuda.tag: This is a flight and support effect.

gate.name: Open Door
gate.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Gate confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak open a pair of doors: one beside you and one beside an ally within sight. Any ally can step through either door to arrive at the other.
The doors last for a short time or until an enemy passes through one.
Opening them costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a portal and support effect.
gate.tag: This is a portal and support effect.

gathering.name: Muster Call
gathering.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Gathering essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call your party together. Every ally within your sight is drawn to your side, arriving after a brief delay.
Allies who arrive this way gain a boon of damage reduction that grows with the number of allies standing close to you.
This costs mana for each ally drawn in and recovers after a long cooldown.
This is a space and gathering effect.
gathering.tag: This is a space and gathering effect.

glass.name: Glass Witness
glass.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Glass essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can place a pane of conjured glass between an ally and an enemy. The pane shatters on the first attack that strikes it, blocking the attack completely and showering the attacker with shards that inflict a bleed affliction.
Up to three panes can stand at once.
This is a glass and protection effect.
glass.tag: This is a glass and protection effect.

glimeron.name: Split Blessing
glimeron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Glimeron confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you grant a boon, you can split it like light through a prism. Up to three allies within a short range each receive the boon at reduced strength.
Allies holding a split boon reflect a small portion of the light-based or spell damage they take back at the caster.
This is a refraction and support effect.
glimeron.tag: This is a refraction and support effect.

goat.name: Mountain Footing
goat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Goat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons ignore difficult terrain, climb steep ground and ledges without slowing, and gain damage when attacking from higher ground.
An ally carrying your boons who is knocked down stands back up immediately and gains a brief boon of increased resistance to being moved.
This is a terrain and boon effect.
goat.tag: This is a terrain and boon effect.

gorgon.name: Hold Their Gaze
gorgon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Gorgon confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can fix your stare on an enemy that is attacking an ally. The enemy is slowed for as long as you keep looking at it, and becomes briefly petrified if you hold the stare for long enough.
While you stare, you cannot attack or cast other spells.
Higher-rank enemies are only slowed, never petrified.
This is a petrification and protection effect.
gorgon.tag: This is a petrification and protection effect.

griffin.name: Highwatch
griffin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Griffin confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies within a moderate range of you can see what you see. Enemies you have in sight are visible to them, even through walls and fog.
Once per fight, you can mark the enemy you are looking at. The first ally to strike it gains a pouncing leap that closes the distance instantly.
This is a perception and support effect.
griffin.tag: This is a perception and support effect.

growth.name: Unchecked Growth
growth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Growth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant grow stronger the longer they remain on an ally, reaching their full strength midway through their duration and increasing beyond it until they expire.
A boon that has grown past its normal strength cannot be dispelled.
This is a growth and boon effect.
growth.tag: This is a growth and boon effect.

guardian.name: Stand Behind Me
guardian.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Guardian confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call an ally to your side. For a short time, a portion of all damage that ally takes is redirected to you instead, and you take reduced damage from all sources.
If you would fall while protecting the ally, the effect ends and you are briefly invulnerable.
This can be used once per fight.
This is a protection and guard effect.
guardian.tag: This is a protection and guard effect.

hair.name: Strand Bond
hair.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hair essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can tie a single conjured strand between yourself and up to five allies. Through it, you can feel their condition, and you can send a boon along the strand to any ally on it without line of sight.
If an ally on the strand is knocked out of position, you can pull them back toward you once per fight.
This is a binding and boon effect.
hair.tag: This is a binding and boon effect.

hammer.name: Anvil Word
hammer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hammer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can strike the ground and speak. Every ally within a short range has their weapon tempered for a short time: their attacks break enemy guard, interrupt channelled abilities and deal additional damage to barriers and armour.
This costs stamina and recovers after a moderate cooldown.
This is a forging and boon effect.
hammer.tag: This is a forging and boon effect.

hand.name: Steadying Hand
hand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can lay a hand on an ally's shoulder. While your hand is there, neither of you can be disarmed, knocked down or interrupted, and the ally's attacks and spells cannot miss.
The hand stays as long as you remain beside the ally and take no other action.
This is a touch and support effect.
hand.tag: This is a touch and support effect.

harmonic.name: Chord of the Party
harmonic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Harmonic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

When three allies carrying your boons each use an ability within a short time of one another, the party strikes a chord: every ally gains a brief boon of increased damage and recovers a portion of their mana.
A chord can be struck once every few seconds.
This is a resonance and boon effect.
harmonic.tag: This is a resonance and boon effect.

harpy.name: Shrieking Cover
harpy.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Harpy confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can let out a shriek that drowns every other sound. Enemies within range lose concentration on spells they are casting, and cannot call for help from nearby packs for a short time.
Allies covered by the shriek can disengage freely, and enemies cannot follow them for a brief moment.
This costs stamina and can be used again after a long cooldown.
This is a sound and support effect.
harpy.tag: This is a sound and support effect.

harvest.name: Gleaner's Share
harvest.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Harvest confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally under one of your boons kills an enemy, the boon reaps a portion of that enemy's remaining strength. The ally recovers some health and stamina, and the boon's duration is extended.
A boon can be extended this way only a few times.
Allies who reap this way gather extra crafting materials from the kill.
This is a harvest and support effect.
harvest.tag: This is a harvest and support effect.

heidel.name: Steady Stride
heidel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Heidel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Mounts ridden by your allies carry your boons as well as their riders. A mounted ally carrying your boons cannot be dismounted by attacks.
You can speak a word to a mount, ridden or not, and it will carry a downed ally to you at full speed.
This is a mount and support effect.
heidel.tag: This is a mount and support effect.

hook.name: Reel In
hook.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hook essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can throw a conjured hook to an ally in danger and haul them to your side, breaking roots, holds and grapples on them as they come.
An ally reeled in this way gains a brief boon of damage reduction.
This costs mana and recovers after a moderate cooldown.
This is a rescue and movement effect.
hook.tag: This is a rescue and movement effect.

horse.name: Cavalry Charge
horse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Horse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can sound a charge. For a short time, every ally carrying your boons gains movement speed, and the first enemy each of them strikes after moving a long distance is knocked down.
Allies who knock down an enemy this way recover stamina.
This is a charge and boon effect.
horse.tag: This is a charge and boon effect.

hunger.name: Empty Maw
hunger.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hunger essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons heal for a small portion of the damage they deal.
Any healing an ally gains this way while already at full health is passed on to the most wounded ally carrying your boons.
This is a drain and support effect.
hunger.tag: This is a drain and support effect.

hunt.name: Called Quarry
hunt.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hunt essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call a quarry. The chosen enemy is visible to your whole party wherever it goes, including through walls and while stealthed.
Allies chasing the quarry gain movement speed. If the quarry tries to flee, it is slowed when it passes the limit of your aura sense.
This is a tracking and hunt effect.
hunt.tag: This is a tracking and hunt effect.

hydra.name: Second Head
hydra.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Hydra confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an enemy cleanses or dispels a boon you granted, the boon regrows. It returns to the ally after a brief pause, and a second weaker copy of it is granted to another ally nearby.
A boon can regrow only once.
This is a regeneration and support effect.
hydra.tag: This is a regeneration and support effect.

ice.name: Frostbound Guard
ice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ice essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can coat an ally in a thin shell of ice. Enemies that strike the ally in melee are slowed and accumulate frost; at full frost they are frozen solid for a moment.
The shell absorbs a small amount of damage before shattering, and shattering freezes the ground around the ally.
This is an ice and protection effect.
ice.tag: This is an ice and protection effect.

immortal.name: Refused Ending
immortal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Immortal confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a refusal over an ally. For a short time, that ally's health cannot fall below a sliver, no matter how much damage they take.
When the refusal ends, the ally takes a portion of the damage that was refused, spread over a few seconds.
This can be used on each ally once per day. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a persistence and protection effect.
immortal.tag: This is a persistence and protection effect.

iron.name: Cold Iron Oath
iron.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Iron essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons cannot be charmed, possessed, controlled or have their loyalties turned.
Fey, spirit and astral enemies that strike an ally carrying your boons are burned by cold iron and take additional damage.
This is an iron and protection effect.
iron.tag: This is an iron and protection effect.

juggernaut.name: Momentum Word
juggernaut.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Juggernaut confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons build momentum while they keep moving toward enemies. At full momentum, they cannot be stunned, slowed or knocked down, and their first strike flattens lower-rank enemies.
Momentum is lost when the ally stops or moves away from the enemy.
This is a momentum and support effect.
juggernaut.tag: This is a momentum and support effect.

karmic.name: Settled Account
karmic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Karmic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

While an ally is under one of your boons, a ledger records the damage they take. When the boon ends, the ally can settle the account, returning a portion of the recorded damage to the last enemy that struck them.
The returned damage is lost if the enemy is dead.
Allies who settle an account receive less damage from that enemy for a short time.
This is a karmic and support effect.
karmic.tag: This is a karmic and support effect.

knife.name: Quiet Blade
knife.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Knife essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can whisper a target to an ally. That ally's next attack against the whispered enemy ignores its armour and damage reduction.
If the attack kills the enemy, the whisper passes to another ally and another nearby enemy of your choice.
This is a precision and boon effect.
knife.tag: This is a precision and boon effect.

knowledge.name: Open Page
knowledge.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Knowledge essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
While you are in a party, every ally gains experience toward their abilities and skills whenever you do.
You can read aloud from a skill book you know. Allies listening learn the book's skill for as long as they stay in your party.
This is a knowledge and support effect.
knowledge.tag: This is a knowledge and support effect.

kraken.name: Long Reach
kraken.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Kraken confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can extend a coiling tether to an ally anywhere within a long range. While tethered, you can drag the ally toward you, pulling them out of danger, or drag an enemy that is holding them away.
The tether breaks if the line between you is blocked.
Pulling costs stamina. The tether can be extended again after a short cooldown.
This is a pull and support effect.
kraken.tag: This is a pull and support effect.

leviathan.name: Bow Wave
leviathan.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Leviathan confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you move, you push a swell of water ahead of you that carries allies along. Allies within your wake move faster and are swept out of ground-based area effects.
Once per fight, you can breach: a great wave rolls outward from you, displacing every lower-rank enemy and granting allies a brief shield.
This is a water and support effect.
leviathan.tag: This is a water and support effect.

life.name: Unquiet Pulse
life.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Life essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant carry a steady pulse of life. Allies carrying them regenerate health over time, and the regeneration doubles while they are below half health.
When a boon expires on an ally, it releases a final pulse that heals every ally close to them.
This is a life and healing effect.
life.tag: This is a life and healing effect.

light.name: Lantern Word
light.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Light essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can set a lantern of light above an ally. It lights the area around them, reveals invisible and stealthed enemies within its glow, and blinds the first enemy to attack the ally.
Undead and darkness-based enemies within the glow take damage over time.
This is a light and revelation effect.
light.tag: This is a light and revelation effect.

lightning.name: Spark Relay
lightning.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Lightning essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant can leap between allies. When you cast one, it arcs instantly from the first ally to each other ally within a short distance of them, in a chain.
Each leap also strikes a nearby enemy with a jolt of lightning, interrupting it.
This is a lightning and boon effect.
lightning.tag: This is a lightning and boon effect.

lizard.name: Cold Patience
lizard.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Lizard essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies carrying your boons who stand still for a moment become stone-still: enemies cannot detect them by sight or aura sense, and they recover stamina quickly.
Once per fight, an ally who loses a limb to a crippling effect regrows it instantly.
This is a stillness and boon effect.
lizard.tag: This is a stillness and boon effect.

locust.name: Swarm Cover
locust.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Locust essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can release a cloud of locusts around an ally. The cloud follows them, blocking a portion of incoming projectiles and gnawing at enemies within it.
Enemies inside the cloud have their boons eaten away one at a time.
This is a swarm and protection effect.
locust.tag: This is a swarm and protection effect.

lotus.name: Clean Bloom
lotus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Lotus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant float a lotus above the ally. The lotus absorbs the next affliction that would be applied to the ally and closes around it, holding it harmlessly until the boon ends.
When the boon ends, the lotus opens and the affliction is gone.
An ally can carry only one lotus at a time.
This is a cleanse and protection effect.
lotus.tag: This is a cleanse and protection effect.

lurker.name: Under the Surface
lurker.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Lurker essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can sink into the ground or into shadow and move unseen beneath your allies. While sunk, you cannot attack, but you can grant boons to allies above you.
Surfacing beneath an enemy knocks it into the air and ends the effect.
This is a stealth and support effect.
lurker.tag: This is a stealth and support effect.

magic.name: Spoken Arcana
magic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Magic essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you grant an ally a boon, you can spend additional mana to inscribe it with arcana. An inscribed boon also reduces the mana cost of the ally's spells for its duration.
Allies under an inscribed boon recover a small amount of mana each time they land a spell.
This is a magic and boon effect.
magic.tag: This is a magic and boon effect.

malign.name: Spite Shared
malign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Malign essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can mark an enemy with a whispered grudge. Allies who strike the grudged enemy gain a stacking boon of increased damage that lasts until the enemy dies or the fight ends.
When the grudged enemy dies, every ally carrying the boon is cleansed of one affliction.
Only one enemy can carry a grudge at a time.
This is a curse and boon effect.
malign.tag: This is a curse and boon effect.

manatee.name: Slow Water Hymn
manatee.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Manatee essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies who stand still near you gain a building boon of damage reduction and health regeneration. The boon fades quickly once they move.
Allies standing in water receive the full boon immediately and keep it while they wade.
This is a water and boon effect.
manatee.tag: This is a water and boon effect.

manticore.name: Spined Escort
manticore.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Manticore confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
While an ally is under one of your boons, any enemy that strikes them in melee is hit by a spine loosed from your direction, inflicting a stacking venom affliction.
An enemy with enough stacks is briefly transfixed, unable to move.
This can happen once every short interval per ally.
This is a venom and protection effect.
manticore.tag: This is a venom and protection effect.

master.name: Instructor's Word
master.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Master confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can teach an ally one of your own special attacks for a short time. The ally can use it once, at your level of mastery, without it taking up one of their slots.
While you are partied with an ally, skills that ally levels advance at an accelerated rate.
Teaching an attack costs mana and can be done again after a long cooldown.
This is a mastery and support effect.
master.tag: This is a mastery and support effect.

might.name: Borrowed Strength
might.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Might essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can spend stamina to lend your power to an ally for a short time. The ally gains a boon of increased power and knockback on melee attacks, while you suffer a matching reduction for the same duration.
Lent strength cannot be granted to the same ally again until the effect recovers.
This is a strength and boon effect.
might.tag: This is a strength and boon effect.

ministration.name: Bedside Manner
ministration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ministration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Out of combat, you can tend a resting ally. Wounding effects, lingering afflictions and reduced maximum health on that ally recover significantly faster while you stay beside them.
In combat, allies under your boons receive increased healing from every source.
This is a care and healing effect.
ministration.tag: This is a care and healing effect.

minotaur.name: Lowered Horns
minotaur.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Minotaur confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a charge into an ally. Their next dash or movement ability becomes a goring charge that inflicts damage on every enemy in its path and pins the last one hit against any wall it reaches.
In narrow passages and corridors, allies under your boons deal increased damage.
The charge costs stamina and can be granted again after a short cooldown.
This is a charge and support effect.
minotaur.tag: This is a charge and support effect.

mirage.name: Heat-Haze Veil
mirage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Mirage confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons shimmer. Enemies attacking them from range have a chance to strike at a false position a step away instead.
You can spend mana to make an ally's image waver further for a short time, causing the next melee attack against them to miss entirely.
This is an illusion and protection effect.
mirage.tag: This is an illusion and protection effect.

mirror.name: Answering Image
mirror.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Mirror essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Any boon you cast on yourself is reflected onto the nearest ally at a portion of its strength. Any boon you cast on an ally is reflected back onto you at a portion of its strength.
A reflected boon cannot be reflected again.
This is a reflection and boon effect.
mirror.tag: This is a reflection and boon effect.

monkey.name: Quick Hands
monkey.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Monkey essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can toss a consumable from your inventory to an ally within a short range. It takes effect on them as if they had used it.
Allies who catch a tossed consumable gain a brief boon of increased attack speed.
This is a utility and boon effect.
monkey.tag: This is a utility and boon effect.

monolith.name: Standing Stone
monolith.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Monolith confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can raise a standing stone on the field. Allies within its shadow gain resistance to fear, charm and confusion, and recover stamina over time.
The stone cannot be destroyed by enemies of lower rank. It crumbles when you raise another or leave the area.
Raising a stone costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is an earth and inspiration effect.
monolith.tag: This is an earth and inspiration effect.

moon.name: Tidecall
moon.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Moon essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant wax and wane. A waxing boon grows stronger over its duration; a waning boon starts strongest and weakens. You choose which when granting it.
At night, boons you grant last significantly longer, and waning boons do not weaken.
This is a moon and boon effect.
moon.tag: This is a moon and boon effect.

mouse.name: Small Voice
mouse.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Mouse essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant can be cast without breaking stealth, and they make no sound or visible effect.
An ally under one of your boons who has not yet been noticed by an enemy draws less attention, and enemies take longer to detect them.
This is a stealth and boon effect.
mouse.tag: This is a stealth and boon effect.

myriad.name: Many Mouths
myriad.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Myriad essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
A single-target boon you cast can be split among several allies. Each receives a portion of its strength, and the total strength grows with the number of allies sharing it.
You can split a boon among as many allies as your rank allows.
This is a multiplication and boon effect.
myriad.tag: This is a multiplication and boon effect.

mystic.name: Quiet Knowing
mystic.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Mystic confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You sense the condition of every ally in your party at all times, wherever they are in the same region: their health, mana, stamina and any affliction they carry.
When an ally falls below a quarter of their health, you know their direction and distance.
Boons you grant to an ally you cannot see cost no more than boons granted in sight, as long as they are in your party.
This is a perception and support effect.
mystic.tag: This is a perception and support effect.

nebula.name: Diffused Self
nebula.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Nebula confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spread yourself into a cloud of starlit dust for a short time. While diffused, you cannot be targeted, and every ally standing in the cloud gains your active boons at reduced strength.
You reform at the cloud's densest point when the effect ends.
Diffusing costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a cosmic and support effect.
nebula.tag: This is a cosmic and support effect.

needle.name: Pinned Word
needle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Needle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can pin a boon to a single ally. A pinned boon cannot be dispelled, stolen or purged, and lasts until the ally is defeated or you pin another.
Allies under a pinned boon gain increased critical hit chance against enemies they have already struck.
This is a precision and boon effect.
needle.tag: This is a precision and boon effect.

nemesis.name: Marked for the Hunt
nemesis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Nemesis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can mark one enemy as your party's quarry. Allies always know the quarry's position, even across a region, and move faster while moving toward it.
An ally who strikes the quarry after chasing it a long distance deals a heavy bonus hit.
The mark lasts until the quarry dies or you mark another.
This is a pursuit and support effect.
nemesis.tag: This is a pursuit and support effect.

net.name: Catching Mesh
net.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Net essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can cast a mesh between yourself and up to two allies. Damage dealt to anyone in the mesh is spread across everyone in it.
If an ally in the mesh would be knocked back, pulled or thrown, the mesh holds them in place instead and breaks.
This is a binding and protection effect.
net.tag: This is a binding and protection effect.

network.name: Party Line
network.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Network confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Party members can speak to one another silently at any distance within the same region.
When any party member spots an enemy, that enemy appears on every party member's map.
When one party member is affected by a boon you grant, you can relay it down the line to the next party member at reduced strength, for a small mana cost.
This is a communication and support effect.
network.tag: This is a communication and support effect.

oasis.name: Cool Spring
oasis.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Oasis confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call up a spring of cool water where you stand. Allies who drink from it recover mana and stamina and are cleansed of heat, burning and exhaustion effects.
Enemies will not willingly fight within the spring's shade, and lower-rank monsters stop pursuing an ally who reaches it.
The spring lasts for a short time and can be called once per fight.
This is a water and restoration effect.
oasis.tag: This is a water and restoration effect.

ocean.name: Returning Tide
ocean.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ocean confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant ebb and flow. They weaken slightly over a few seconds, then surge back stronger than their base, repeating for their full duration.
An ally who acts at the height of the surge has their ability's cost reduced.
Each surge wears down the armour of enemies the ally strikes.
This is a tide and support effect.
ocean.tag: This is a tide and support effect.

octopus.name: Eight Errands
octopus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Octopus essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can maintain several boons on different allies without each one occupying your attention. Boons you grant do not end when you are stunned, silenced or out of range.
When an ally under your boon is grabbed or restrained, they can slip free once, after which the boon ends.
This is a boon effect.

omen.name: Spoken Sign
omen.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Omen essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Shortly before an enemy uses a powerful attack, allies under your boons receive a warning sign above its head and a brief burst of movement speed.
An ally who avoids an attack they were warned about gains a boon of increased damage against that enemy.
This is a foresight and boon effect.
omen.tag: This is a foresight and boon effect.

onslaught.name: Unbroken Rhythm
onslaught.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Onslaught confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
While an ally under your boon keeps attacking without a gap, each hit grants a stack of rhythm, increasing their attack speed.
If the ally stops attacking for even a moment, the stacks fall away.
You can speak the beat back into an ally once per fight, restoring their lost stacks.
This is a rhythm and support effect.
onslaught.tag: This is a rhythm and support effect.

pangolin.name: Overlapping Plates
pangolin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Pangolin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies standing close together each gain a stacking boon of armour for every other ally touching them.
When an ally in the group takes a critical hit, the group curls inward and briefly becomes immune to further critical hits.
This is a defensive and boon effect.
pangolin.tag: This is a defensive and boon effect.

paper.name: Written Charge
paper.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Paper essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can write a boon onto a slip of paper and store it in your inventory. Any ally you hand it to can tear it to receive the boon at full strength, even if you are absent.
You can keep a limited number of written boons at once, scaling with rank. Writing one costs the boon's mana up front.
This is a scribing and boon effect.
paper.tag: This is a scribing and boon effect.

phantasmagoria.name: Crowded Room
phantasmagoria.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Phantasmagoria confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can fill the space around an ally with phantoms of the party. Enemies near the ally see several copies of every party member and divide their attacks between them.
Phantoms vanish when struck. The effect ends after a short time or when every phantom is gone.
Conjuring the crowd costs mana and can be done again after a long cooldown.
This is an illusion and support effect.
phantasmagoria.tag: This is an illusion and support effect.

phoenix.name: Kindled Again
phoenix.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Phoenix confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When a boon you granted expires, it can be burned instead of lost. Burning the boon cleanses the ally of every affliction and restores a portion of their health.
Each ally can burn one boon per fight.
Allies who burn a boon are briefly immune to fire.
This is a fire and renewal effect.
phoenix.tag: This is a fire and renewal effect.

plant.name: Rooted Blessing
plant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Plant essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant to an ally standing on soil or grass take root. A rooted boon cannot be removed while the ally stays within a short distance of where it was granted.
Rooted allies regenerate health slowly and cannot be knocked down.
This is a nature and boon effect.
plant.tag: This is a nature and boon effect.

potent.name: Concentrate
potent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Potent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can collapse every boon on an ally into one. The combined boon lasts only briefly, but its effect is the sum of all the boons it consumed, significantly amplified.
A concentrated boon cannot be refreshed or extended.
This is a power and boon effect.
potent.tag: This is a power and boon effect.

predatory.name: Picked Out
predatory.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Predatory confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can point out the weakest enemy in sight. Every ally who can see it knows which enemy you mean, and their attacks against it cannot be dodged for a short time.
If that enemy tries to flee, every ally gains a burst of speed toward it.
This can be used again after a short cooldown.
This is a hunting and support effect.
predatory.tag: This is a hunting and support effect.

prison.name: Holding Cell
prison.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Prison confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak bars around an enemy that is threatening an ally. The enemy cannot leave a small cell for a short time, though it can still attack anything within reach.
Allies outside the cell deal increased damage to the enemy inside.
Higher-rank enemies can break the cell early. Speaking bars costs mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a confinement and support effect.
prison.tag: This is a confinement and support effect.

prosperity.name: Open Purse
prosperity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Prosperity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies in your party receive better prices at shops and contracts while you are with them.
You can spend currency in combat to grant an ally a strong boon of increased damage and defence. The more you spend, the longer it lasts.
This is a prosperity and support effect.
prosperity.tag: This is a prosperity and support effect.

pure.name: Undiluted Word
pure.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Pure essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant cleanse one affliction from the target when applied.
An ally carrying no afflictions receives your boons at significantly increased strength.
This is a purity and cleanse effect.
pure.tag: This is a purity and cleanse effect.

rabbit.name: Bolt Call
rabbit.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Rabbit essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call a single word to an ally in danger. They immediately dash a short distance away from the nearest enemy and gain a brief boon of evasion.
An ally can be called this way once every short interval.
This is a movement and rescue effect.
rabbit.tag: This is a movement and rescue effect.

rake.name: Raked Share
rake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Rake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When a boon you granted expires naturally, its leftover strength gathers into a pool. You can spend the pool to grant a brief boon of equal strength to any ally.
The pool empties at the end of each fight.
This is a gathering and boon effect.
rake.tag: This is a gathering and boon effect.

rat.name: Last Rat Standing
rat.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Rat essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally falls, the boons they carried pass to the nearest surviving ally.
An ally who is the last of your party standing besides you gains a boon of damage reduction and movement speed until another ally rises.
This is a survival and boon effect.
rat.tag: This is a survival and boon effect.

reagent.name: Transmuted Gift
reagent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Reagent essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can transmute an affliction on an ally into a boon of the matching kind: a poison into poison resistance, a burn into fire damage, a slow into evasion.
Each affliction can be transmuted once. Transmuting costs mana scaled to the affliction's strength.
This is an alchemy and boon effect.
reagent.tag: This is an alchemy and boon effect.

refracting.name: Bent Light
refracting.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Refracting confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Spell attacks and projectiles aimed at an ally under one of your boons bend away from them. The first projectile each ally is targeted by every short interval is redirected to a random enemy nearby.
You can spend mana to bend everything aimed at a single ally for a brief moment.
This is a light and protection effect.
refracting.tag: This is a light and protection effect.

renewal.name: Season's Turn
renewal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Renewal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When a boon you granted expires, the ally recovers a portion of their health and stamina.
Once per day, you can renew every boon on every ally to its full duration. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a renewal and boon effect.
renewal.tag: This is a renewal and boon effect.

resolute.name: Planted Banner
resolute.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Resolute essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can plant your voice in a spot. Allies within the area cannot be feared, charmed or forced to move.
While you stand inside the area yourself, its boons extend to allies who leave it for a short time afterward.
Only one area can exist at a time.
This is a resolve and zone effect.
resolute.tag: This is a resolve and zone effect.

resonating.name: Sympathetic Hum
resonating.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Resonating confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under the same boon from you resonate with one another. Each additional ally carrying the boon makes it stronger on all of them.
When three or more allies resonate, any of them can release the tone, shaking nearby enemies and ending the boon on every ally at once.
This is a resonance and support effect.
resonating.tag: This is a resonance and support effect.

roc.name: Shadow Arrives First
roc.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Roc confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can cast a vast shadow ahead of your party. Lower-rank enemies caught in it flee, and same-rank enemies are slowed.
You can spend mana to carry an ally out of the shadow's far edge, lifting them to a position you choose within its range.
The shadow can be cast once per fight.
This is a fear and support effect.
roc.tag: This is a fear and support effect.

rune.name: Graven Promise
rune.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Rune essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can carve a rune of a boon into an ally's equipped weapon or armour. While the item is worn, the ally holds that boon permanently at reduced strength.
An item can hold one carved rune. Carving one costs a monster core of your rank.
This is a rune and boon effect.
rune.tag: This is a rune and boon effect.

sacrifice.name: Paid For
sacrifice.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sacrifice confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can pay for a boon with your own health instead of mana. A boon paid in health is significantly stronger than one paid in mana.
You can also take an ally's affliction onto yourself, removing it from them and doubling its remaining duration on you.
This is a sacrifice and support effect.
sacrifice.tag: This is a sacrifice and support effect.

sand.name: Grain by Grain
sand.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sand essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant shed grains as they tick down. An enemy that strikes an ally carrying your boon has its accuracy reduced for a short time.
While three or more allies carry your boons, a thin sandstorm surrounds the party, obscuring them from ranged attackers beyond a short distance.
This is an earth and concealment effect.
sand.tag: This is an earth and concealment effect.

sceptre.name: Sceptred Word
sceptre.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sceptre essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can issue a decree naming one action: attack, hold or fall back. Allies who follow it within a short time gain a boon matched to that action; allies who ignore it gain nothing.
Summons and companions under your command always follow a decree.
A new decree can be issued once every short interval.
This is a command and boon effect.
sceptre.tag: This is a command and boon effect.

scribe.name: Written Order
scribe.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Scribe confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Out of combat, you can write a boon onto a scroll. Any ally can read the scroll later to receive the boon at full strength, without you being present.
You can hold a limited number of written scrolls at once, and scrolls fade after a day.
Writing a scroll costs the boon's full mana and reduces your maximum mana until it is read.
This is a writing and support effect.
scribe.tag: This is a writing and support effect.

serene.name: Still Surface
serene.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Serene essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons cannot be enraged, confused or made to panic.
When an ally would lose control of themselves to an affliction or effect, the boon breaks in its place and the ally recovers a portion of their mana.
This is a calm and protection effect.
serene.tag: This is a calm and protection effect.

serpent.name: Coiled Patience
serpent.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Serpent confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant to an ally who has not attacked for a few seconds grow stronger the longer they wait.
When the ally finally strikes, the stored strength is spent in one attack that deals heavy bonus damage and inflicts poison.
The waiting strength resets if the ally takes damage.
This is a patience and support effect.
serpent.tag: This is a patience and support effect.

shark.name: Blood in the Water
shark.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Shark essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an enemy drops below half health, every ally under your boons gains increased movement speed toward it and increased damage against it.
When that enemy dies, the bonus passes to the next most wounded enemy nearby.
This is a hunting and boon effect.
shark.tag: This is a hunting and boon effect.

shield.name: Raised Guard
shield.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Shield essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a guard onto an ally. The next attack against them is blocked completely, and the blocked damage is converted into a short boon of damage reduction for everyone nearby.
A guarded ally cannot be guarded again until the effect recovers.
This is a protection and boon effect.
shield.tag: This is a protection and boon effect.

shimmer.name: Dancing Lights
shimmer.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Shimmer essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons are wrapped in shimmering light that makes them harder to target. Enemies attacking them from range have a chance to strike a flickering afterimage instead.
When an afterimage is struck, it bursts and briefly blinds the attacker.
This is a light and illusion effect.
shimmer.tag: This is a light and illusion effect.

ship.name: Fair Wind
ship.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ship essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
While travelling with companions, your party moves faster across the region map and mounts tire more slowly.
In combat, allies moving in the same direction as you gain a boon of movement speed and stamina recovery.
This is a travel and boon effect.
ship.tag: This is a travel and boon effect.

shovel.name: Dug In
shovel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Shovel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend stamina to dig a shallow trench at an ally's feet. An ally standing in the trench gains significant damage reduction against attacks from the front and cannot be knocked back.
The trench remains until the end of the fight. Only one can exist at a time.
This is an earth and fortification effect.
shovel.tag: This is an earth and fortification effect.

sickle.name: Harvest Hand
sickle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sickle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally under your boon defeats an enemy, the boon's remaining duration is reset.
An ally who defeats several enemies in quick succession gains a boon of increased attack speed that grows with each kill and fades shortly after the last.
This is a harvest and boon effect.
sickle.tag: This is a harvest and boon effect.

simulacrum.name: Stand-In
simulacrum.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Simulacrum confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

When an ally falls, you can spend mana to raise a likeness of them in their place for a short time. The likeness fights with the ally's basic attacks and draws enemy attention, but cannot use their abilities.
While the likeness stands, the fallen ally cannot be finished by enemies.
This can be used once per fight.
This is a likeness and support effect.
simulacrum.tag: This is a likeness and support effect.

sin.name: Shared Sin
sin.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sin essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can take an affliction from an ally onto yourself. While you carry it, you gain a boon of increased damage that scales with how strong the affliction is.
You cannot take an affliction you are immune to, and afflictions taken this way cannot be cleansed from you until they expire.
This is a sacrifice and boon effect.
sin.tag: This is a sacrifice and boon effect.

skirmish.name: Given Ground
skirmish.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Skirmish confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons can disengage freely. Moving away from an enemy does not provoke it, and their first step away is a short dash.
An ally who returns to the fight within a short time of disengaging deals bonus damage with their first strike.
This is a skirmish and support effect.
skirmish.tag: This is a skirmish and support effect.

skunk.name: Fair Warning
skunk.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Skunk essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons carry a lingering warning. Melee enemies that strike them repeatedly are overcome by a foul cloud and flee for a moment.
Beasts and monsters of lower rank avoid attacking an ally who carries the warning unless no other target is available.
This is a deterrence and boon effect.
skunk.tag: This is a deterrence and boon effect.

sky.name: Cleared Heavens
sky.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sky confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak the sky open above your party. For a short time, allies can leap a long distance upward and land anywhere within range, crossing walls and obstacles.
Allies who land among enemies stagger every lower-rank enemy where they come down.
This can be used once per fight.
This is an air and support effect.
sky.tag: This is an air and support effect.

sloth.name: Unhurried Vow
sloth.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sloth essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant take a short time to settle before they activate. A settled boon lasts significantly longer and cannot be cut short by any effect.
You can choose to grant a boon immediately instead, at normal duration.
This is a patience and boon effect.
sloth.tag: This is a patience and boon effect.

smoke.name: Veiled Allies
smoke.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Smoke essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend mana to wrap an ally in smoke. Enemies lose track of them, and any enemy targeting them must reacquire a target.
An ally leaving the smoke gains a brief boon of increased damage on their next attack.
This is a smoke and stealth effect.
smoke.tag: This is a smoke and stealth effect.

snake.name: Venom Tongue
snake.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Snake essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons apply a stacking poison affliction with their attacks.
Poison applied by your allies ticks faster on enemies who are already afflicted by you personally.
This is a poison and boon effect.
snake.tag: This is a poison and boon effect.

soaring.name: Lifting Air
soaring.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Soaring confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons cannot be knocked down, and they land light-footed when they leap from ledges.
Allies landing from a leap cannot be targeted by melee attacks for a moment, and their next ranged attack deals bonus damage.
Out of combat, your party's climbing and jumping costs no stamina.
This is an air and support effect.
soaring.tag: This is an air and support effect.

song.name: Marching Song
song.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Song essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can sing to sustain your boons. While you sing, boons on nearby allies do not tick down and you cannot attack or cast other abilities.
Singing drains mana over time. When you stop, every ally who heard you gains a brief boon of increased stamina recovery.
This is a song and boon effect.
song.tag: This is a song and boon effect.

sovereign.name: Royal Decree
sovereign.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sovereign confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can issue a decree to your party: one rule from a short list, such as "no one retreats", "strike as one" or "hold this ground". Allies who obey it gain a strong boon for as long as they do.
An ally who breaks the decree loses its boon for the rest of the fight.
Only one decree can stand at a time.
This is an authority and support effect.
sovereign.tag: This is an authority and support effect.

spear.name: Thrown Word
spear.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Spear essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Your boons reach allies at long range, travelling to them as a visible spear of light that passes through enemies in its path.
Enemies the spear passes through are briefly staggered.
This is a light and projectile effect.
spear.tag: This is a light and projectile effect.

spider.name: Web of Words
spider.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Spider essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons are joined by a fine web you can feel through. You sense when any of them is struck, and can see their surroundings briefly when they are.
You can pull on the web to draw one ally a short distance toward you.
This is a sensing and movement effect.
spider.tag: This is a sensing and movement effect.

spike.name: Waiting Point
spike.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Spike essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can lay a boon on the ground as a hidden spike. The first ally to step on it receives the boon; the first enemy to step on it is impaled and rooted briefly.
Laid boons last until triggered or until you leave the area.
This is a trap and boon effect.
spike.tag: This is a trap and boon effect.

staff.name: Walking Company
staff.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Staff essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies who travel beside you gain a slowly building boon of stamina regeneration that persists into the next fight.
An ally can lean on you when below a portion of their health, slowing your movement but granting them significant damage reduction while you stay together.
This is a support and endurance effect.
staff.tag: This is a support and endurance effect.

star.name: Distant Light
star.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Star essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can place a star above an ally. Every other ally can see it through walls and across the map, and gains movement speed while moving toward it.
An ally under the star gains a boon of increased spell damage for as long as it shines.
Only one star can shine at a time.
This is a star and guidance effect.
star.tag: This is a star and guidance effect.

stellar.name: Guiding Star
stellar.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Stellar confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can set a star above an ally. Every party member can see it from anywhere in the region, and the ally under it cannot be blinded or lost in darkness.
Allies standing near the starred ally deal additional fire damage with their spells.
Only one star can hang at a time.
This is a star and support effect.
stellar.tag: This is a star and support effect.

storm.name: Brought Weather
storm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Storm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak rain over a fight. While it falls, allies' lightning damage is increased, enemies' fire damage is reduced, and wet enemies take bonus damage from lightning.
The rain lasts for a short time and moves with you.
Calling rain costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a storm and support effect.
storm.tag: This is a storm and support effect.

succubus.name: Willing Gift
succubus.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Succubus confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can draw warmth from a charmed or pacified enemy. The enemy's stamina and mana drain slowly, and what is drained is passed to your lowest ally.
An ally who receives drained warmth this way is cleansed of chill and fatigue effects.
Only one enemy can be drawn from at a time, and higher-rank enemies resist.
This is a draining and support effect.
succubus.tag: This is a draining and support effect.

sun.name: High Noon
sun.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sun essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant in daylight also grant a brief radiance that burns enemies standing close to the ally.

Once per day, you can call noon. For a short time every ally under your boons is fully cleansed and radiant, and undead and shadow-based enemies near them take ongoing holy damage. This effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a sun and holy effect.
sun.tag: This is a sun and holy effect.

swarm.name: Covering Cloud
swarm.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Swarm confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can release a cloud of tiny insects that settles over an ally. Enemies that strike the ally in melee are bitten for small damage, and enemies that try to target them from range lose sight of them for a moment.
The cloud thins with every bite and disperses when spent.
Releasing a cloud costs stamina and can be done again after a short cooldown.
This is a swarm and protection effect.
swarm.tag: This is a swarm and protection effect.

swift.name: Quicksilver Tongue
swift.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Swift essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Your boons have no cast time and can be granted while you move or dash.
Allies who receive a boon from you while moving gain a brief burst of speed and a shortened cooldown on their next movement ability.
This is a speed and boon effect.
swift.tag: This is a speed and boon effect.

sword.name: Drawn Together
sword.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Sword essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When you and an ally strike the same enemy within a moment of each other, both of you gain a boon of increased weapon damage and the enemy's guard is broken.
Allies under your boons can parry an attack aimed at you if they stand beside you, once every short interval.
This is a weapon and teamwork effect.
sword.tag: This is a weapon and teamwork effect.

talisman.name: Knotted Charm
talisman.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Talisman confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can tie a charm for each ally in your party. A charmed ally carries one of your boons permanently at reduced strength, even when you are far away.
Charms can be cut by enemy dispels, and a cut charm takes a day to retie.
You can hold only as many charms as you have party members.
This is a ward and support effect.
talisman.tag: This is a ward and support effect.

tentacle.name: Grasping Help
tentacle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Tentacle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can summon a spectral tentacle beside an ally. It grabs the first enemy to approach them and holds it in place briefly.
While the tentacle holds an enemy, the ally deals increased damage to it.
Only one tentacle can exist per ally.
This is a conjuration and restraint effect.
tentacle.tag: This is a conjuration and restraint effect.

thread.name: Lifeline
thread.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Thread essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can bind a thread between yourself and one ally. While bound, healing either of you receives is shared with the other at a portion of its strength.
If the bound ally would die, the thread snaps instead and they survive with minimal health. The thread cannot be rebound to them until the effect recovers over 24 hours.
This is a binding and protection effect.
thread.tag: This is a binding and protection effect.

thunderbird.name: Storm Follows
thunderbird.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Thunderbird confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can summon a storm-bird to circle above an ally. Whenever the ally uses a special attack, lightning strikes the target too.
The storm-bird stays for a short time and can be sent to a different ally once while it lasts.
Summoning it costs mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a storm and summoning effect.
thunderbird.tag: This is a storm and summoning effect.

time.name: Bought Seconds
time.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Time confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spend mana to give an ally back a few seconds: their abilities on cooldown advance by a short amount.
Alternatively, you can delay an incoming attack against an ally, holding it in place for a moment before it lands, giving the ally time to move.
Each use takes a long time to come around again.
This is a time and support effect.
time.tag: This is a time and support effect.

tranquil.name: Stilled Mind
tranquil.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Tranquil confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak quiet into an ally's mind. They are cleansed of fear, confusion, charm and rage effects, and are immune to them for a short time.
Allies under your boons recover mana faster while they are standing still.
This can be used again after a short cooldown.
This is a calming and support effect.
tranquil.tag: This is a calming and support effect.

transfiguration.name: Borrowed Shape
transfiguration.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Transfiguration confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

You can reshape an ally for a short time into a form you choose from a short list: a heavier form that takes reduced damage, a lighter form that moves faster, or a smaller form that enemies struggle to hit.
The ally's abilities are unchanged in any form. They can drop the form at will.
Reshaping costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a transformation and support effect.
transfiguration.tag: This is a transformation and support effect.

transgression.name: Witnessed Wrong
transgression.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Transgression confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an enemy strikes an ally from behind, strikes an ally who is fleeing, or attacks an ally who is helpless, the wrong is named. That enemy takes increased damage from every ally for a short time.
In settlements, you can see which nearby people have recently committed a crime.
This is a judgement and support effect.
transgression.tag: This is a judgement and support effect.

trap.name: Sprung Ward
trap.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Trap essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
A boon you grant can be primed. A primed boon stays dormant until the ally takes heavy damage in a single hit, then springs to full strength and briefly stuns the attacker.
An ally can carry one primed boon at a time.
This is a trap and boon effect.
trap.tag: This is a trap and boon effect.

tree.name: Standing Grove
tree.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Tree essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can grow a sapling where you stand. Allies within its shade gain a boon of health regeneration and resistance to afflictions.
The sapling grows larger the longer the fight lasts, widening its shade. It withers when the fight ends.
This is a nature and zone effect.
tree.tag: This is a nature and zone effect.

troll.name: Thick-Skinned Word
troll.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Troll confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons regenerate health quickly while they are below half health.
Fire damage suppresses the regeneration for a short time.
An ally who regenerates back above half health in this way gains a brief boon of increased damage.
This is a regeneration and support effect.
troll.tag: This is a regeneration and support effect.

trowel.name: Mason's Word
trowel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Trowel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Your boons repair the equipment of the allies they touch, restoring durability over their duration.
Barriers and conjured walls made by your allies last longer and gain additional durability while you stand near them.
This is a repair and fortification effect.
trowel.tag: This is a repair and fortification effect.

turtle.name: Shell Word
turtle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Turtle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can enclose an ally in a shell. They cannot move or attack, but take almost no damage and recover health quickly while inside.
The ally can break out at any time. The shell breaks on its own after a short time.
This is a protection and recovery effect.
turtle.tag: This is a protection and recovery effect.

twilight.name: Long Evening
twilight.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Twilight confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can draw the grey hour around your party. Allies within it are harder to see, and enemies further away cannot target them.
Shadow and dark damage from allies is increased while they stand in the grey.
The grey lasts for a short time, and can be drawn again after a long cooldown.
This is a darkness and support effect.
twilight.tag: This is a darkness and support effect.

undeath.name: Unfinished Business
undeath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Undeath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally falls, you can speak to them as they go. For a short time they keep fighting, unable to be healed, while their health drains away.
If the fight is won before the time runs out, the ally survives with a sliver of health. If not, they fall.
This can be used once per fight.
This is an undeath and support effect.
undeath.tag: This is an undeath and support effect.

unity.name: Shared Weight
unity.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Unity confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can join your party for a short time. Damage dealt to any party member is divided evenly among every party member within range.
Afflictions applied to one joined ally are applied to all at reduced strength and duration.
Joining costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a unity and support effect.
unity.tag: This is a unity and support effect.

vast.name: Borderless Voice
vast.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Vast essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Your boons reach any party member in the same region, regardless of distance or line of sight.
