You can speak to party members anywhere in the region, and they can answer.
Boons granted at long range cost significantly more mana.
This is a space and communication effect.
vast.tag: This is a space and communication effect.

vehicle.name: Rolling Column
vehicle.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Vehicle essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can call allies into formation behind you. While they follow your path, they share your movement speed and take reduced damage from the front.
When the formation breaks, each ally gains a short burst of speed in the direction they leave.
This is a movement and formation effect.
vehicle.tag: This is a movement and formation effect.

venom.name: Antivenom
venom.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Venom essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons slowly build resistance to any poison they are exposed to, until they become immune for the rest of the fight.
Once an ally is immune to a poison, their attacks inflict that same poison on enemies.
This is a poison and adaptation effect.
venom.tag: This is a poison and adaptation effect.

verdant.name: Rooted Ground
verdant.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Verdant confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Where you walk, creepers spread for a short time. Allies standing on the creepers cannot be knocked back and recover a small amount of health over time.
Enemies who step on the creepers are slowed, and are briefly snared if they stay.
Creeper growth stops while you are in water or on stone.
This is a growth and support effect.
verdant.tag: This is a growth and support effect.

vessel.name: Open Cup
vessel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Vessel confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can hold boons granted to you by others instead of receiving them, keeping them in reserve for a long time.
You can pour a held boon onto any ally at full strength.
You can hold a limited number of boons at once.
This is a vessel and support effect.
vessel.tag: This is a vessel and support effect.

visage.name: Worn Faces
visage.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Visage essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can give an ally another face. Enemies treat them as one of their own until they attack, and townsfolk treat them as a stranger with no reputation.
The first attack an ally makes from behind a borrowed face deals significantly increased damage and ends the effect.
This is a disguise and illusion effect.
visage.tag: This is a disguise and illusion effect.

vision.name: Foresight
vision.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Vision confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an enemy begins a powerful attack, you see where it will land a moment before it does. Allies in your party see a warning marker at the same spot.
Once per fight, you can show an ally exactly what is coming. Their next dodge is guaranteed to avoid the attack.
This is a foresight and support effect.
vision.tag: This is a foresight and support effect.

void.name: Hollow Silence
void.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Void essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a silence around an ally. Spells and projectiles entering it are swallowed, and enemies inside it cannot cast.
The silence lasts briefly and costs a large portion of your mana. The ally inside cannot cast either.
This is a void and silence effect.
void.tag: This is a void and silence effect.

volcano.name: Building Pressure
volcano.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Volcano confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].

Boons you grant build pressure over their duration. When a boon reaches full pressure, the ally erupts, inflicting fire damage around them and burying nearby lower-rank enemies in ash, briefly slowing them.
Allies cannot be harmed by their own eruption.
An ally can release pressure early at reduced strength.
This is a fire and support effect.
volcano.tag: This is a fire and support effect.

vortex.name: Drawing In
vortex.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Vortex confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can open a whirl around an ally. Enemies near the ally are pulled toward its centre, and projectiles fired at the ally are drawn aside.
Allies standing at the edge of the whirl deal increased damage to enemies being pulled.
The whirl lasts for a short time and can be opened again after a long cooldown.
This is a pull and support effect.
vortex.tag: This is a pull and support effect.

wasp.name: Stinging Reply
wasp.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wasp essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally under your boon is struck, a spectral wasp launches at the attacker, inflicting a stacking sting affliction that reduces its damage.
An attacker carrying enough stings is briefly unable to attack.
This is a conjuration and retaliation effect.
wasp.tag: This is a conjuration and retaliation effect.

water.name: Current Carry
water.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Water essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant flow along a path of water from you to the ally. Other allies standing on the path receive a portion of the boon as it passes.
Allies standing in water receive your boons without a cast time.
This is a water and boon effect.
water.tag: This is a water and boon effect.

weave.name: Woven Together
weave.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Weave confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can tie threads between allies. Allies tied together share boons: any boon granted to one is shared with the other at reduced strength.
A tied pair attacking the same enemy deals bonus damage.
Threads break if the allies move too far apart. You can tie a limited number of pairs.
This is a weaving and support effect.
weave.tag: This is a weaving and support effect.

wendigo.name: Shared Hunger
wendigo.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wendigo confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons cannot be slowed or frozen by cold effects, and their attacks chill enemies.
When an ally kills an enemy, every ally nearby recovers stamina, as though they had eaten.
In cold regions, allies in your party move faster and do not tire.
This is a cold and support effect.
wendigo.tag: This is a cold and support effect.

whale.name: Deep Call
whale.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Whale essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can sound a long, low call. Every ally within a wide radius gains a boon of maximum health for the rest of the fight, and enemies of lower rank are briefly stunned.
The call can be sounded once per fight. Its radius grows with rank.
This is a sound and boon effect.
whale.tag: This is a sound and boon effect.

wheel.name: Turning Rim
wheel.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wheel essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Boons you grant rotate among your allies. Every few seconds, each boon moves to the next ally in the circle, refreshing its duration as it arrives.
You can stop the rotation at any time to fix every boon where it is.
This is a rotation and boon effect.
wheel.tag: This is a rotation and boon effect.

whip.name: Cracking Command
whip.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Whip essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can lash an ally's shadow to spur them on. The ally's cooldowns are reduced immediately by a portion, and they gain increased attack speed briefly.
An ally spurred this way takes slightly increased damage until the effect ends.
This is a command and haste effect.
whip.tag: This is a command and haste effect.

wind.name: Shear Wind
wind.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wind essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Allies under your boons are surrounded by a cutting wind. Projectiles aimed at them are deflected, and enemies standing beside them take slashing damage over time.
The wind grows stronger the faster the ally is moving.
This is an air and protection effect.
wind.tag: This is an air and protection effect.

wing.name: Lifting Pinion
wing.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wing essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can grant an ally a brief lightness. They can leap over gaps and low walls, and cannot be knocked down for the duration.
An ally landing from a leap onto enemies knocks them down.
This is a flight and boon effect.
wing.tag: This is a flight and boon effect.

wolf.name: Pack Word
wolf.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wolf essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Every boon you grant also grants a weaker copy of itself to each other ally within a short distance of the target.
When three or more allies attack the same enemy, they all gain increased critical hit chance against it.
This is a pack and boon effect.
wolf.tag: This is a pack and boon effect.

wood.name: Living Grain
wood.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wood essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
Wooden weapons, bows and staves wielded by allies under your boons grow thorns, inflicting a bleeding affliction on hit.
Damaged wooden equipment carried by your allies slowly regrows its durability during a fight.
This is a nature and weapon effect.
wood.tag: This is a nature and weapon effect.

wrath.name: Kindled Grudge
wrath.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Wrath confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
When an ally is struck hard, you can kindle their grudge against the enemy that hit them. The ally's damage against that enemy rises for a short time, and their strikes against it cannot be blocked.
The grudge ends when that enemy is dead or the time runs out.
Kindling a grudge costs mana and can be done again after a short cooldown.
This is a wrath and support effect.
wrath.tag: This is a wrath and support effect.

zeal.name: Burning Conviction
zeal.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Zeal essence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can speak a vow over an ally naming one enemy. Until that enemy dies, the ally deals significantly increased damage to it and cannot be feared or stunned.
If the vow ends without the enemy dying, the ally is exhausted, losing stamina regeneration briefly.
This is a conviction and boon effect.
zeal.tag: This is a conviction and boon effect.

ziz.name: Sheltering Wing
ziz.transfigured: Transfigured from [Astral Blessing] by Word in the Silence. Catalyst: Ziz confluence.
lines: Retains all effects of [Astral Blessing: Word in the Silence].
You can spread a vast wing over your party. Allies beneath it take significantly reduced damage from area effects, rain, storms and attacks from above.
While the wing is spread, you move slowly and cannot attack.
Spreading the wing costs a significant amount of mana and can be done once per fight.
This is a shelter and support effect.
ziz.tag: This is a shelter and support effect.
